events.name: HIMSS MN & Minnesota e-Health Virtual Conference 2026
events.description:
Explore the forefront of healthcare innovation at the HIMSS MN & Minnesota e-Health Virtual Conference 2026, a dynamic online series presented by MN HIMSS and the Minnesota e-Health Initiative this Fall. This series provides current perspectives and aims to advance e-health understanding and practical applications, relevant for Minnesota and the broader healthcare community.

The program includes focused discussions, such as a Minnesota Industry Leader Roundtable on innovation and collaboration. A significant session will address "Building Trust: Governance, Policy, and Ethics around AI and innovation." Further topics delve into "Minnesota e-Health Today: Progress, Partnerships, and What's Next" and "Preparing the Health Workforce for the Future."

These sessions offer a setting for professionals to consider new ideas and discuss the evolving landscape of health.

events.name: ICE China Flexible Coil Processing Technology Exhibition 2026

location.venue: Shenzhen World Exhibition & Convention Center (Bao'an New Venue)

events.description:
The ICE China Flexible Coil Processing Technology Exhibition 2026 is poised to redefine the converting industry, taking place from October 27-29 at the Shenzhen World Exhibition & Convention Center. Organized by RX, the exhibition will feature advanced equipment and complete technical solutions for coating, laminating, slitting, rewinding, and printing flexible sheet materials such as film, tape, and labels.

Professionals from flexible packaging, automotive assembly, medical beauty, and new energy sectors can explore innovations that advance material sustainability and green production. Held concurrently with the Shenzhen International Film & Tape Exhibition, this event provides significant opportunities for connecting with international partners, exchanging global technological insights, and contributing to industrial transformation. Attendees can also meet over 40,000 potential buyers and industry leaders, offering valuable insights into market trends and the future of flexible coil processing.

events.name: ABA Compliance School Foundational 2026
events.description:
Elevate your compliance career with the ABA Compliance School Foundational 2026, a comprehensive virtual program running from November 2-18, 2026.

This program is intended for professionals with fewer than five years of experience in the field. It offers thorough instruction in the foundational federal banking laws and regulations, allowing participants to gain an essential technical understanding of basic deposit and lending rules.

Participants will learn directly from respected compliance practitioners and experts. The training provides current knowledge and practical skills needed to develop and maintain effective compliance programs, equipping individuals to navigate both present challenges and future changes. Opportunities for interaction with peers and industry leaders are also part of the experience, helping to build a strong foundation for professional development in banking compliance.

events.name: AASLD The Liver Meeting 2026
events.description:
The global hepatology community is invited to AASLD The Liver Meeting 2026, taking place November 5-9 in Denver, Colorado. Held at the Colorado Convention Center, this event brings together professionals to explore the latest scientific breakthroughs and clinical insights. It's a place where connections are made, all contributing to the advancement of liver care.

The program includes a Postgraduate Course, an ILTS Course, and a Basic Science Symposium. There will also be Late Breaking Oral Abstract Sessions and POCUS Workshops. The meeting is for physicians, scientists, allied health professionals, and trainees, offering a setting where collaboration and knowledge sharing naturally occur.

An All-Access Pass provides entry to key courses. For those unable to attend in person, virtual content will be available through TLMdX OnDemand. This gathering offers an opportunity to contribute to the ongoing development of liver health and patient outcomes.

events.name: Weight Management Summit 2026
events.description:
The Weight Management Summit 2026, a free digital event presented by Food Navigator and organized by William Reed Group, is set to redefine the future of health and nutrition. Held across two sessions on November 5 and November 19, this summit is designed for professionals navigating the rapidly changing weight management market.

Participants will explore the metabolic health revolution, moving beyond GLP-1s to consider whole-body balance and new nutrition solutions. It will also examine how consumer trends are shifting towards weight-conscious eating that prioritizes taste and pleasure. Discussions will cover smarter ingredients, innovations that promote satiety, and new food formats such as portion-controlled meals.

The aim is to provide practical strategies and emerging scientific understanding to help meet evolving consumer expectations and foster innovation within the food and drink industry.

events.name: AHA Scientific Sessions 2026
events.description:
The global community of cardiovascular pioneers and changemakers will converge in Chicago, Illinois, for AHA Scientific Sessions 2026, from November 6–9. This gathering brings together scientists, clinicians, and researchers, offering a significant forum to delve into the latest scientific discoveries and educational content that shapes clinical practice.

Participants will explore the breadth of cardiovascular science, covering everything from fundamental research breakthroughs to clinical trials and their real-world applications. It's a chance to share insights, build connections, and collectively advance the field of cardiovascular health.

The Sessions play a role in developing new researchers and shaping global guidelines. This work ultimately helps transform how care is delivered and contributes to improving health and well-being for people everywhere.

events.name: IAEM Annual Conference & EMEX 2026
events.description:
Prepare to elevate your expertise and expand your network at the premier gathering for emergency management professionals: the IAEM Annual Conference & EMEX 2026. From November 13-18, 2026, in Long Beach, CA, the conference will offer a program designed to benefit professionals at every stage of their career.

Attendees will have opportunities to engage with current strategies, participate in valuable training sessions before and after the main event, and explore new developments showcased at the EMEX exhibition. The program includes insightful plenary sessions and various ways to connect with others.

Whether someone is a seasoned leader, an aspiring new emergency manager, or a student, the conference provides avenues for professional growth. It's a place to consider the evolving landscape of emergency management and build connections with colleagues who share a commitment to strengthening communities, including through special events and the Certification Awards Program.

events.name: ACR Convergence 2026
events.description:
Immerse yourself in the cutting edge of rheumatology as ACR Convergence 2026 unfolds in Orlando, Florida, from November 6–11.

This international gathering brings together individuals from various backgrounds, all focused on understanding the newest advancements and pivotal research shaping rheumatology. The program includes a range of sessions, from interactive formats like the Knowledge Bowl, Thieves Market, and Image Competition, to dedicated discussions such as the Patient Perspectives Program and the Global Rheumatology Summit. Participants will have opportunities to engage with new research through abstract presentations and hear directly from leading speakers.

Beyond the structured sessions, there will be ample time to connect with peers and colleagues. The event also provides the chance to earn Continuing Medical Education (CME) credits while exploring significant developments in the field. It serves as an important forum for fostering clinical and scientific excellence in rheumatology.

events.name: Royal Agricultural Winter Fair 2026
events.description:
Get ready for an unparalleled celebration of agriculture, local food, and equestrian excellence at the Royal Agricultural Winter Fair 2026. Each November, Toronto hosts this significant gathering, recognized as the world's largest indoor agriculture fair and international equestrian competition. It draws hundreds of thousands of people, from the general public to Canadian and international breeders and growers, who come to see champions recognized and experience a rich display of Canadian heritage.

A central part of the fair is the Royal Horse Show, recognized as North America's premier indoor equestrian event. Beyond this, visitors can find exciting agriculture competitions, delicious food and lifestyle exhibits, and engaging entertainment. The Royal Paddock offers unique shopping opportunities, and there are chances to learn from industry leaders. It's a place where friends and family can make lasting memories, offering something for every age group.

events.name: Les Automnales 2026
events.description:
Geneva's Palexpo will host Les Automnales 2026 from November 6 to 15, inviting 140,000 visitors to a vibrant 10-day celebration. This annual public event offers a wide range of entertainment, culinary experiences, and shopping opportunities for those attending.

The Automnales Market features clearance sales and military surplus items. For food enthusiasts, the Automnales Food Festival includes the Cook’n’show culinary event and the Arvinis wine salon. Another section, Automnales Émotion, presents diverse activities such as an International Cat Exhibition, the RE&UP Genève initiative focused on sustainability, and the 10 km de Palexpo indoor race.

With 700 exhibitors participating and the Swiss Army's Swissint serving as guest of honor, Les Automnales offers something for a wide array of interests and age groups.

events.name: At the Vineyards! Brest 2026
events.description:
Prepare your palate for an exceptional culinary experience at At the Vineyards! Brest 2026 marks its 42nd year, taking place from November 6 to 9 at Brest Expo - Parc de Penfeld. This gathering brings together 290 artisans and producers from across France, presenting a wide selection of wines and gourmet foods.

Visitors can connect directly with these producers, learning about their craft and the stories behind their products. The offerings span exquisite regional wines, including organic choices, alongside artisanal chocolates, charcuterie, and cheeses. Products are available at direct producer prices. Whether someone has a deep appreciation for fine food and drink or is simply exploring new tastes, the event offers a rich experience.

Entry is 5€, with free admission for those under 18. Some free entries may also be available. A mandatory INAO tasting glass costs 2€.

events.name: AMIA Annual Symposium 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for the AMIA Annual Symposium 2026, the leading event for professionals at the forefront of biomedical and health informatics. Here, significant research connects with practical applications, encouraging new approaches in clinical care, public health, and translational science.

Participants will have the opportunity to engage with leaders in the field, learn about key advancements in areas like AI, data science, and health IT, and discuss strategies for enhancing patient outcomes and healthcare delivery. This gathering serves as a crucial space for researchers, clinicians, educators, and policymakers to work together, exchange perspectives, and influence the direction of health information.

The symposium brings together individuals dedicated to using informatics to build a healthier world. It's a collective effort to advance progress within the continually evolving landscape of digital health.

events.name: CIKM 2026
events.description:
The 35th International ACM Conference on Knowledge and Information Management, CIKM 2026, invites researchers and practitioners to historic Rome, Italy, from November 7-11. This event will delve into the foundations, systems, and applications of information retrieval, knowledge management, data mining, and database systems. A central theme will be the profound influence of Artificial Intelligence, encompassing large language models, generative AI, and the ongoing efforts to ensure AI is responsible, trustworthy, and capable of independent action. The discussions aim to help shape the next generation of intelligent information access systems.

The program includes a variety of activities: tutorials, an Industry Day, a PhD Symposium, workshops, Analyticup, and the main conference sessions. These components are structured to foster shared understanding and new ideas among the international CIKM community.

events.name: SUFFA 2026
events.description:
The essential industry meeting point for the modern butchery trade, SUFFA 2026, returns to Messe Stuttgart. This event is designed specifically for craft businesses, small and medium-sized enterprises, and direct marketers in the meat industry. Those attending can expect to find innovation, high-quality offerings, and forward-thinking solutions that can help advance their work.

The event will offer focused information, practical insights, and a wide array of products and services. SUFFA 2026 aims to create a personal, collegial atmosphere, providing opportunities for meaningful discussions and shared learning. It serves as a valuable setting for young talent, experienced professionals, and exhibitors to find inspiration and practical solutions for daily business challenges. The gathering reflects the innovative spirit and craftsmanship present across the butchery industry.

events.name: Asia Education Technology Symposium 2026
events.description:
Hong Kong is set to host the Asia Education Technology Symposium 2026 from November 07-09, a pivotal gathering for anyone passionate about the future of learning. This symposium brings together researchers, practitioners, and industry professionals to explore new developments in educational technology. Discussions will cover key areas such as e-Learning, mobile learning, augmented reality, and how artificial intelligence is shaping education, including human-AI collaboration, the Metaverse, and generative AI in K-12 settings.

With support from The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, the event will feature prominent keynote speakers and special sessions, all designed to encourage meaningful conversations. Those attending will have opportunities to connect with peers and, for accepted papers, a chance for publication in the Scopus-indexed Springer book series, Lecture Notes in Educational Technology.

events.name: Western Surgical Association Annual Meeting 2026
events.description:
Prepare for an unparalleled professional development experience at the Western Surgical Association Annual Meeting 2026, hosted in the vibrant cultural hub of Santa Fe, New Mexico. This annual gathering at the elegant Eldorado Hotel provides surgical professionals an opportunity to connect with leading experts, delve into current research, and discuss the advancements shaping the future of surgery.

Participants can expect collaborative sessions, informative presentations, and valuable networking with colleagues and mentors. The meeting will also include an exhibit area, presenting new technologies and solutions from key partners. Information regarding registration and the hotel block will be available this summer.

events.name: NZB National Bridge Congress 2026
events.description:
Bridge enthusiasts, mark your calendars for New Zealand's premier event: the NZB National Bridge Congress 2026. From November 7th to 14th, the Palmy Function Centre will welcome more than 800 players, including those traveling from abroad, representing all skill levels.

This eight-day event includes a full schedule of competitions. Players can participate in events such as NZ Open Teams and Pairs, Swiss Pairs, and Congress Teams, catering to Senior, Restricted, Intermediate, and Junior categories. Beyond the competitive play, there are also social occasions, including a Quiz Night and a Fancy Dress day. Youth players receive a 50% discount on their entry.

The deadline for early registration is September 30th, 2026. Participants who register by this date will be entered into a draw to win back their entry fee. The congress offers a week of strategic challenge and opportunities for camaraderie among bridge players.

events.name: Antiquaria Padova 2026
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in a world of timeless treasures as Antiquaria Padova returns for its 42nd edition in 2026. The event takes place over two weekends in November: the 7th and 8th, followed by the 12th, 13th, 14th, and 15th. Hosted at the Quartiere fieristico di Padova in Italy, this gathering serves as a significant meeting point for those involved in the antique trade, drawing participants from across North-East Italy and neighboring regions, including areas from Milan to Slovenia and Austria.

Antiquaria Padova 2026 provides a setting to explore a broad range of Italian antiques, particularly focusing on high-quality pieces. Individuals with a long-standing interest in collecting, as well as those new to historical artifacts, will find a diverse array of items. Many exhibitors will present their selections, offering a chance to view various unique pieces and engage with those knowledgeable in the field.

events.name: AFP 2026
events.description:
The treasury and finance community's most anticipated event, AFP 2026, offers an unparalleled in-person experience. Nearly 7,000 professionals will gather to discuss the industry's evolving landscape, sharing challenges and exploring innovative ideas that will shape future financial strategies.

Over 140 sessions are planned, designed to deliver practical insights directly from experienced speakers. These discussions will help attendees understand future trends, develop preparation strategies, and acquire essential tools for adapting to significant industry shifts.

The event provides a setting to enhance one's expertise and broaden professional connections within the treasury and finance sector.

events.name: MWC Doha 2026
events.description:
Step into the heart of digital transformation at MWC Doha 2026, scheduled for 8-11 November at the Doha Exhibition and Convention Center in Qatar. This event, in partnership with MCIT, convenes over 9,400 global leaders, decision-makers, and subject matter experts from 110 countries, including a significant C-suite presence and 60 government delegations. It offers a setting for fostering collaborations and advancing business within the ambitious digital market of the MENA region.

Attendees will encounter new developments across connectivity, AI, and monetization, presented by more than 250 exhibitors and sponsors. The program also features over 275 thought leaders from governments, telecommunications companies, and adjacent industries, who will share insights on enabling industry evolution and economic growth.

MWC Doha 2026 highlights how intelligent innovation is shaping a sustainable digital future for the region and beyond.

events.name: ISPOR Europe 2026
events.description:
Shaping the future of healthcare value, ISPOR Europe 2026 is set to gather global healthcare leaders and HEOR experts in Vienna, Austria, from 8-11 November 2026. As a leading European forum for Health Economics and Outcomes Research, this gathering provides a space to explore and share current developments.

Participants will engage in important conversations about how to create, encourage, and distribute value in a lasting way for health systems, patients, and those who develop new technologies. Over four days, the program will facilitate connections, encouraging collaboration among colleagues and experts globally.

The event offers an opportunity to gain new perspectives and contribute to progress in healthcare solutions.

events.name: AMA Symposium for the Marketing of Higher Education 2026
events.description:
Elevate your institution's marketing strategy and connect with leading minds at the AMA Symposium for the Marketing of Higher Education 2026. From November 8-11, the Gaylord Rockies Resort & Convention Center in Aurora, Colorado, brings together higher education marketers focused on shaping the future of their field. This four-day gathering provides an opportunity for professionals to collaborate, share challenges, and gain insights from their peers.

The program includes carefully reviewed content, offering relevant best practices and valuable learning experiences. Attendees can explore innovative solutions in the exhibit hall, meeting with various higher education solution providers. This is a setting where ideas can lead to practical strategies, helping institutions advance their goals and strengthen their overall standing.

events.name: AIChE Annual Meeting 2026
events.description:
The AIChE Annual Meeting 2026, set to unfold from November 8-12 in Minneapolis, MN, stands as the premier educational forum for chemical engineers worldwide. The meeting will take place across the Minneapolis Convention Center, Hilton Minneapolis, and Hyatt Regency Minneapolis, bringing together a broad community of academic and industry experts.

Those attending will explore cutting-edge research, examine new technologies, and learn about emerging growth areas that are redefining the field. The event supports professional growth, encouraging innovation and collaboration among participants.

The call for abstracts opens in January 2026, seeking contributions from a wide range of perspectives. Additionally, the AIChE® Foundation offers limited stipends for registration and travel, aiming to support participation from underrepresented groups.

events.name: ICCA Congress 2026
events.description:
Prepare to connect, learn, and innovate as the ICCA Congress 2026 arrives in vibrant Panama City, Panama, from 8-11 November. This gathering brings together professionals from various parts of the industry, including association leaders, event planners, and suppliers from around the world. Those attending will have opportunities to expand their professional networks, develop new collaborations, and gain valuable knowledge from educational sessions and workshops.

The program will focus on addressing key industry challenges, exploring new approaches, and discussing topics like sustainability and inclusivity, all aimed at advancing the field of association meetings. There will also be opportunities for informal networking and social interaction, encouraging connections within the global events community.

events.name: Boutique Design New York 2026
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the future of boutique hospitality design at Boutique Design New York 2026, held November 8-9 at the Jacob K. Javits Center in NYC.

The event serves as a gathering point for designers, leading brands, and vendors, all looking to explore what's next in luxury spaces. Attendees will find hospitality products not commonly seen elsewhere, offering fresh perspectives on design possibilities and emerging industry trends.

Specific features include the BDNY Dine & Design Popup, which highlights innovative restaurant and bar concepts, and "Designed Spaces," where products can be experienced at scale, curated by prominent design firms. Beyond the exhibits, opportunities for connection are available through social events, design tours, and awards galas. These interactions are intended to support professional development and inspire new creative directions within the field.

events.name: EEI Financial Conference 2026
events.description:
Gain unparalleled insights into the future of the electric power sector at the EEI Financial Conference 2026. This conference brings together electric company leaders, Wall Street analysts, institutional investors, and energy regulators to discuss capital strategies and policy directions.

Participants will delve into key topics such as market forces, investment priorities, capital market trends, and policy developments. These discussions will focus on how to build a more resilient grid, invest in new infrastructure, and modernize the sector. The program includes sessions featuring insights from C-suite executives, who will share their perspectives on emerging opportunities.

The conference also offers opportunities to connect with industry executives and financial leaders, facilitating discussions and potential collaborations.

events.name: International Mechanical Engineering Congress & Exposition 2026
events.description:
Prepare to explore the forefront of mechanical engineering innovation at the International Mechanical Engineering Congress & Exposition 2026, hosted by ASME. This gathering will take place from November 8-12, 2026, at the Vancouver Convention Centre in British Columbia, Canada. It is expected to bring together over 2,000 research leaders and professionals from academia, government, and industry.

The congress operates under the theme "Advancing Global Solutions: Convergence to Transformative Impact." It will present nearly 20 technical tracks covering areas such as Advanced Manufacturing, Biomedical Engineering, Energy, and Heat Transfer, among others. Participants will have the opportunity to engage with current research, explore new technologies in the exhibition running from November 9-11, and establish professional relationships with colleagues.

This event offers a setting for individuals to expand their knowledge, discover new research directions, and contribute to advancements that influence global challenges.

events.name: NALP Elevate 2026
events.description:
Prepare to elevate your business at NALP Elevate 2026, the landscape industry's premier event, taking place November 8-11 at the Tampa Convention Center in Tampa, FL.

The event brings together landscape professionals and their teams, offering insights to help them grow their businesses, refine their strategies, and identify new opportunities for expansion.

Attendees can explore the ELEVATE Expo, which showcases the latest technology, solutions, and equipment. A program of educational sessions will feature industry experts and speakers, alongside specialized tracks designed to address current challenges and foster adaptability in the evolving marketplace. This gathering provides a setting for professionals to connect and learn.

events.name: MSCA Annual Education Conference 2026
events.description:
Prepare to elevate your leadership and business strategies at the 40th Annual MSCA Education Conference 2026, held at the Austin Marriott Downtown in Austin, Texas. This gathering is for mechanical service contractors and industry leaders looking to understand and prepare for the future.

Attendees will find a setting for open discussions and connecting with colleagues. The goal is to help individuals take a moment to reflect, consider their own well-being, and gather actionable ideas. Keynote speakers Doug Brown, Anthony Robles, and Marc Koehler will share their perspectives, offering new ways of thinking and practical strategies for leading a business.

events.name: People Development Executive Summit Fall 2026
events.description:
Designed exclusively for senior executives from Fortune 1000 and leading enterprises, the People Development Executive Summit Fall 2026 offers an unparalleled opportunity to shape the future of human capital. This invitation-only gathering will take place from November 15-17, 2026, at the Omni Rancho Las Palmas Resort & Spa in Rancho Mirage, CA. It convenes Chief Learning Officers, Chief Talent Officers, and VPs of L&D, Talent, and HR.

Participants will delve into strategic conversations covering evolving L&D models, developing future leaders, and using technology for skill enhancement. The agenda includes prescheduled one-on-one meetings with solution providers, opportunities for connection that extend to an off-site activity, and collaborative sessions designed for sharing and comparing best practices.

The aim is for attendees to leave with fresh perspectives and actionable insights to foster growth, improve retention, and ensure learning initiatives align closely with core business goals.

events.name: Planadviser 360 2026
events.description:
Planadviser 360 2026, taking place November 8-11 at The Ritz-Carlton Orlando, Grande Lakes, is the premier event for top retirement plan advisers and industry leaders.

This gathering explores the rapidly changing landscape of retirement plan advisory work. It aims to provide practical insights and proven strategies for navigating new business models, evolving client expectations, and expanding service offerings.

The agenda includes discussions on critical subjects such as private market investments within DC plans, understanding private equity's involvement with advisory firms, and strategies for future-proofing practices through scalable processes and digital tools. Participants will also have the chance to engage in conversations about compliance, team culture, and client engagement, fostering connections with peers and industry experts.

Beyond the formal sessions, opportunities exist for informal connections, including a golf tournament, welcome receptions, and an awards ceremony. These activities are designed to facilitate interaction among professionals working in the retirement, wealth, and insurance sectors.

events.name: NextGen UGM 2026
events.description:
Prepare to elevate your expertise at NextGen UGM 2026, scheduled for November 8-11 at the magnificent Gaylord Pacific in Chula Vista, CA, within the vibrant San Diego area. This User Group Meeting is specifically for NextGen Healthcare's licensed clients and affiliated practices.

Those attending will find a program filled with instructional sessions. These are designed to help them better understand and make the most of NextGen's healthcare technology solutions. Drawing from feedback received after UGM 2025, this year's meeting is structured to provide an even more impactful and enriching experience. It offers a chance for employees from client practices to connect with peers, learn new strategies, and gather practical insights aimed at improving practice efficiency and patient care. A select group of invited partners will also be present, contributing to a collaborative atmosphere.

Attendance requires registration.

events.name: NARUC Annual Meeting 2026
events.description:
As the definitive capstone event for utility regulation, the NARUC Annual Meeting 2026 offers an unparalleled platform for industry leaders, policymakers, and stakeholders. The agenda will feature a year-end summary from NARUC President Ann Rendahl. Additionally, a new president and officers will be installed, helping to guide the organization's focus for the coming year.

Attendees will engage in discussions covering important topics across all utility sectors, from energy and water to telecommunications. The event is supported by organizations including Edison Electric Institute, Google, NAWC, and American Clean Power Association. It creates opportunities for individuals to connect, collaborate, and contribute to the development of utility services and regulatory policy.

events.name: TAIS Annual Conference 2026
events.description:
Educators and school leaders are invited to explore the intersection of vision and execution at the TAIS Annual Conference 2026. This event will be held on November 8-9, 2026, at Presbyterian Day School in Memphis, Tennessee. It is an important gathering for independent schools, built around the theme, "Focus & Form - See What Matters. Create What’s Next."

Participants from across Tennessee and the Southeast will examine how to refine their approaches to discernment and articulation, aiming to give greater purpose to their teaching and leadership. The conference will include more than 100 sessions, led by over 180 presenters. These sessions will explore various topics, organized into areas such as Classroom Toolkit, Whole-Child Communities, and Strategic Directions.

The program, developed from proposals that highlighted teacher and student perspectives, offers a chance to engage with new ideas, build connections, and consider how art and innovation can shape the future of education.

events.name: CRO Exchange Fall 2026
events.description:
Miami, FL, will become the nexus for elite revenue leadership from November 8-10, 2026, as CRO Exchange Fall 2026 convenes at the Marriott Biscayne Bay. This invitation-only summit is designed for top revenue executives, Chief Revenue Officers, and senior sales leaders who are focused on achieving significant growth. It brings together a select group, representing the highest tier of leadership in the field.

Over 48 hours, participants will engage in focused, strategic discussions. The program includes private boardrooms, Champagne Roundtables, and the CRO War Room, all structured for peer-led problem-solving. Discussions will center on building scalable revenue operations, utilizing AI for improved efficiency, and navigating market changes effectively.

The event also features over 250 pre-scheduled one-on-one consultations and ample opportunities for professional connection. Those attending will establish meaningful relationships and acquire practical strategies to drive lasting organizational change and consistent revenue achievement.

events.name: MarcoPoloLine Group Annual Conference 2026
events.description:
Prepare for a landmark gathering as the MarcoPoloLine Group celebrates its 20th anniversary at the 17th Annual Conference in stunning Cancun, Mexico. This significant event brings together members from over 447 offices across 87 countries, facilitating global discussions and fostering collaboration within the group's extensive network.

Hosted by DAMBER, the conference agenda will explore the evolving landscape of logistics and freight forwarding. Participants will examine critical topics such as advanced supply chain management, the integration of AI in logistics, robust quality control, and navigating complex global trade. The sessions are designed to offer insights into current industry challenges and future directions.

Beyond the specific topics, this gathering marks two decades of the MarcoPoloLine Group's journey. It provides a collective moment to acknowledge past achievements and to consider the future trajectory of global logistics, drawing on the diverse perspectives of its international membership.

events.name: CISO Executive Leadership Forum 2026
events.description:
Designed exclusively for top-tier security and technology leaders, the CISO Executive Leadership Forum 2026 offers a distinctive, curated experience. The event will be held from November 8-9 at the Grand Hyatt Vail Resort & Spa, bringing together CISOs, CIOs, and senior executives for focused discussions on the most critical challenges in cybersecurity.

Attendees will explore key topics such as AI governance, human-centered security, and the evolving role of the CISO in an era of autonomous AI. Expert-led sessions, featuring insights from Laura Harder and Dr. Erik J. Huffman, will address board-level accountability and leadership approaches designed to mitigate burnout.

Beyond the structured discussions, there will be opportunities for peer connection through unique activities, including fly fishing instruction and a dinner prepared by Chef Makoto Okuwa. The forum aims to provide practical strategies and valuable insights for navigating the complexities of tomorrow's threat landscape.

events.name: Higher Ed Facilities Forum 2026

location.venue: Hyatt Regency Hill Country Resort & Spa

events.description:
The Higher Ed Facilities Forum 2026, an exclusive, invitation-only retreat, convenes the nation's top higher education facilities leaders from November 8-10 at the Hyatt Regency Hill Country Resort & Spa in San Antonio, TX. This gathering is limited to 200 industry professionals, designed to encourage focused discussions and build lasting relationships, offering an experience distinct from a typical trade show.

Participants will explore key topics such as campus AI, future energy solutions, and modern security integration. These discussions will take place through Innovation Talks, Sourcing Sessions, and peer roundtables. The event provides complimentary registration, which covers accommodation and meals, creating an environment where attendees can concentrate on evaluating new solutions and establishing valuable connections.

The aim is to facilitate collaboration, the exchange of fresh ideas, and collective efforts to shape the future of campus planning, construction, operations, and sustainability.

events.name: Base.Camp Madrid 2026
events.description:
An exclusive, invite-only gathering awaits senior AdOps and publishing revenue leaders at Base.Camp Madrid 2026. This three-day experience, taking place in Fall 2026 at the Thompson Hotel in Madrid, is designed for individuals focused on tackling the industry's most complex challenges.

Participants will work together in hands-on sessions. The discussions will center on creating new revenue streams, influencing key organizational decisions, and helping shape the future of publishing. This is a focused environment where leaders can share insights and collectively drive change.

The aim is to move beyond simple solutions and address the most challenging issues in ad tech and media. It's a place for strategic leaders to connect, innovate, and help shape the future of digital revenue.

events.name: Underwater Minerals Conference 2026
events.description:
Dive into the future of ocean resources at the Underwater Minerals Conference 2026, themed "Marine Minerals: Fostering Science, Innovation and Stewardship." This international event is organized by the International Marine Minerals Society (IMMS) in collaboration with a Japanese Local Committee. It will take place in Toyama, Japan, from November 8-13. The conference brings together professionals from government, academia, and industry, representing more than 25 countries.

The gathering offers an opportunity to explore geological and biological studies, regulatory frameworks, and technological advancements related to marine minerals. A significant part of the discussions will address the increasing attention on manganese nodule mining, emphasizing the importance of science-based regulations and effective strategies for environmental protection.

Beyond the formal sessions, participants will find opportunities to connect with peers, engage in cultural workshops, and join field trips. These activities aim to encourage collaboration among researchers, business leaders, and governing authorities as they work towards the responsible development of underwater resources.

events.name: K12 Facilities Forum 2026

location.venue: Hyatt Regency Hill Country Resort & Spa

events.description:
The K12 Facilities Forum 2026 offers an exclusive, invite-only retreat for senior K12 Facilities Leaders, gathering in San Antonio, TX, from November 8-10. With attendance capped at 250 leaders, this gathering is intentionally structured as a departure from typical trade shows, focusing instead on a more focused and collaborative experience.

The program includes TED-style talks, unfiltered fireside chats, and Deep Dive Roundtables, all designed to encourage new ways of thinking. These sessions create an environment for leaders to openly share insights and learn from one another on pressing issues, such as innovative maintenance strategies and the balance between security measures and an inclusive environment.

Beyond the structured sessions, there will be opportunities for genuine connection, taking advantage of the San Antonio environment to build valuable relationships. Additionally, pre-planned 1:1 Vendor Matchmaking facilitates focused conversations with carefully selected partners, all contributing to discussions about the future direction of K12 facilities.

events.name: HFMA Region 9 Annual Conference 2026
events.description:
Shape the future of healthcare finance at the HFMA Region 9 Annual Conference 2026, a premier gathering designed for forward-thinking professionals. The conference takes place November 8-10 at the Sheraton New Orleans, bringing together leaders from Arkansas, Louisiana, Mississippi, Oklahoma, and Texas.

Attendees can expect a robust educational program, offering up to 20 CPE credits. Sessions will feature insights from senior healthcare executives and experts.
