With a focused audience size, attendees will have direct access to insights from experienced leaders such as Jeb Blount, Amy Franko, and Anthony Iannarino. This structure ensures a learning environment with relevant content, free from promotional pitches.

events.name: General Counsel Conference East 2026
events.description:
Legal leaders seeking to navigate the evolving corporate landscape will converge at the General Counsel Conference East 2026, taking place November 9-10, 2026, at the New York Hilton Midtown. This gathering is designed for general counsel, legal executives, and other in-house professionals.

Attendees will explore key aspects of AI integration, strategic leadership, and managing cybersecurity and data privacy risks. Speakers will discuss global supply chain issues, recent regulatory changes, and current legal technologies. The agenda focuses on practical business strategies that address stakeholder expectations, from the C-suite to shareholders.

Over two days, the conference provides opportunities for in-depth learning, professional development, and connecting with colleagues. Participants can explore best practices and solutions relevant to the evolving landscape of legal leadership.

events.name: World Lottery Summit 2026
events.description:
Sydney, Australia, will host the World Lottery Summit 2026, commencing November 9, bringing together the global lottery industry's most influential minds. The World Lottery Association (WLA) organizes this event, which serves as an important meeting point for its members, regional associations, and professionals from around the world.

Those attending will have the opportunity to engage with key companies and partners in the industry. This includes Platinum-level participants such as Scientific Games, INTRALOT, Pollard Banknote, and Brightstar, as well as Gold-level participants like Jumbo and OpenBet. The summit provides a setting to explore the future of lotteries, encourage collaboration, and discuss the significant trends and innovations influencing the sector's development. It is a chance to gather new perspectives, build professional connections, and contribute to the ongoing progress of the global lottery industry.

events.name: Ace Convention 2026
events.description:
Set to inspire and empower the entertainment community, Ace Convention 2026 will take place from November 9th to 12th at the Holiday Inn Austin Midtown in Austin, TX. This four-day gathering is for entertainers looking to sharpen their skills, explore new ideas, and connect with others in the field.

Attendees can browse various vendors, including brands like FAB Paints, which offer tools and supplies. There will also be hands-on classes, such as the Balloon Class, and a Body Art Showcase.

Whether someone is an experienced professional or an "ACE Newbie," this event offers a chance to learn, build connections, and enhance performance abilities within the entertainment industry.

events.name: LDC NatGas To Power Forum 2026
events.description:
The LDC NatGas To Power Forum 2026 offers a vital platform for leaders and innovators in the natural gas to power sector. This three-day event will take place from November 09 to 11 at the Marriott Riverwalk in San Antonio, Texas, bringing together key individuals from the industry.

Participants will explore critical market dynamics, regulatory landscapes, and technological advancements that are shaping the future of natural gas power generation. The forum is designed to facilitate meaningful connections, allowing individuals to interact with peers, experts, and potential collaborators. The agenda will feature strategic discussions and insights, offering practical knowledge for navigating and influencing this evolving energy sector.

events.name: CEBA Conference & Expo 2026
events.description:
Shape the future of the cold chain at the CEBA Conference & Expo 2026, November 9-11, at the Hyatt Regency Lost Pines Resort in Austin, Texas.

This gathering brings together professionals involved in temperature-controlled construction, including executives, engineers, owners, operators, architects, and builders. It's an opportunity for those who are innovating within the cold chain to connect and share knowledge.

The program explores topics such as sustainable design, integrating automation, and advancements in insulated materials. It also addresses critical challenges facing the industry, including energy efficiency, labor availability, and supply chain management. Attendees can explore new technologies and solutions for cold storage and food processing facilities, and engage with peers and experts on these subjects.

events.name: Identiverse Washington D.C. 2026
events.description:
"Identity in the Capital" takes center stage at Identiverse Washington D.C. 2026, convening senior identity, security, policy, and digital trust leaders from November 9-10 at the MGM National Harbor. This two-day gathering is designed for public sector and enterprise executives who are navigating the complexities where digital identity meets national policy.

Participants will explore key subjects such as Identity-First Security, the changing landscape of AI and Non-Human Identity, and the future of Authentication with Passkeys. The program features 50 speakers across two tracks, also covering Policy, Privacy, Public Sector Identity, and approaches to Identity Resilience and Fraud Prevention.

The event offers a chance to hear diverse perspectives, discuss current challenges, and connect with 300 professionals working in this field in the nation's capital.

events.name: ALTSTX 2026
events.description:
Prepare for two days of unparalleled insights at ALTSTX 2026, the premier education-focused alternative investment event. From November 9-10, 2026, The Ritz-Carlton, Dallas, will host the investor community involved in managing, advising on, or allocating to alternative investments.

Attendees will explore key areas such as global asset allocation, private markets, real assets, private equity, hedge funds, and crypto. The program features leading CIOs and founders, including Kenneth Hersh and Kyle Bass, who will share their perspectives on institutional portfolio construction, risk management, and emerging opportunities in private debt and impact investing.

This gathering provides an environment to refine investment strategies, broaden professional connections, and obtain valuable CPE credits. Qualified investors receive complimentary registration.

events.name: Biomanufacturing World Summit 2026
events.description:
Celebrating "A Decade Strong," the Biomanufacturing World Summit 2026 offers an unparalleled deep dive into the future of biomanufacturing. From November 9-11, at the Hilton San Diego Bayfront in San Diego, CA, this gathering brings together senior manufacturing, technical operations, and quality executives—with over 68% holding Director-level positions or higher. Their discussions will focus on innovative strategies, emerging trends, and best practices within the field.

Those attending will hear from more than 27 thought leaders, including executives from companies like AstraZeneca, Eli Lilly, and Amgen. These experts will share their perspectives and experiences. As it marks its tenth anniversary, the summit will also recognize an individual with the Michael Kamarck Technical Operations Leadership Award. This award acknowledges a leader who has significantly contributed to the advancement of the biopharmaceutical industry.

events.name: RIA Edge Private Markets 2026
events.description:
RIA Edge Private Markets 2026 offers a focused platform for investment leaders and advisors to navigate the increasingly accessible yet complex world of private market investing. This gathering brings together over 150 professionals from RIAs, family offices, and private banks, all focused on private market strategy.

Discussions will cover essential topics like evaluating fund structures, asset classes, fees, and liquidity terms. Participants will also refine their approach to due diligence when incorporating private credit, private equity, real estate, and infrastructure into client portfolios. More than 35 experts, including leaders from KKR and Mercer Advisors, will share their perspectives through educational sessions, peer discussions, and focused roundtables.

The event will also examine innovative technology designed to support fund access, reporting, and compliance, helping attendees manage and explain private market investments more effectively.

events.name: I Love Failure 2026
events.description:
On November 9, 2026, the Romanian National Opera Bucharest will host I Love Failure 2026, Europe's largest courage conference. This one-day event explores vulnerability through candid accounts of setbacks and the wisdom gained from them. Speakers include Grace Miller, Head of Failure & Experimentation for The Diary of a CEO Podcast, and Herman Jagpal, Creator of Daily Rejection, who will share their personal journeys.

Individuals attending, whether professionals or students, will have the opportunity to engage in an "Emotional Gym." This segment offers practical exercises designed to build courage, fostering genuine connections among participants through shared experiences and open dialogue.

Beyond the personal insights gained, participation in the conference contributes to funding school events. This support aims to help a younger generation feel more comfortable discussing their fears and challenges openly.

events.name: Fraud Prevention Summit 2026
events.description:
Staying ahead of evolving digital threats is paramount for every organization. The Fraud Prevention Summit 2026, held on November 9th at the Hilton Canary Wharf in London, brings together senior professionals to strengthen their approach to security.

Attendees will have pre-arranged one-to-one meetings, connecting them directly with fraud prevention solution providers and key suppliers. They will explore topics such as ecommerce fraud, mobile security, data-led regulatory compliance, and digital identity verification. Through keynote presentations from experts, interactive discussion panels, and opportunities to connect with peers, participants can expand their understanding, potentially gain certification, and learn best practices for protecting their operations against current threats.

events.name: Precious Metals Summit Zurich 2026
events.description:
Elevate your understanding and investment strategies in the global precious metals market at the expanded Precious Metals Summit Zurich 2026. The by-invitation-only conference will be held from November 9-11 at the Park Hyatt Zurich. It has been extended by an additional day, enhancing the opportunities for interaction among attendees. The event aims to connect institutional investors, family offices, and private wealth advisors with over 120 explorers, developers, and emerging producers of gold, silver, and platinum group metals.

The program is structured around one-on-one meetings, company presentations, and daily keynote sessions. These sessions will feature insights from experts such as Felix Zulauf, Marc Faber, and Dr. Thomas S. Kaplan. The summit provides a setting for strategic networking and exploring new ventures within the mining and mineral exploration sectors.

events.name: National Premium Tax Conference 2026
events.description:
The National Premium Tax Conference 2026 offers an essential gathering for professionals navigating the complexities of premium tax. From November 9-13, 2026, the Eldorado Hotel Casino in Reno will host this event. The program is designed to explore critical industry updates, regulatory changes, and established best practices.

Attendees will find comprehensive sessions aimed at strengthening their expertise and supporting compliance within this specialized field. Over five days, the conference provides a setting for connecting with peers, exchanging insights, and learning practical approaches from experienced professionals, all with the goal of effectively managing premium tax challenges.

events.name: Connect South + Faith 2026
events.description:
An unparalleled opportunity for event professionals awaits at Connect South + Faith 2026, taking place November 9-11, 2026, at the Branson Convention Center in Branson, MO. Organized by Informa Connect, this three-day event brings together event planners and suppliers. It focuses on connecting those planning Southern events and faith-based meetings with relevant destinations, hotels, and venues.

An AI-powered matching system helps arrange focused one-on-one meetings between attendees. Beyond these connections, the agenda includes practical education relevant to both regional and faith-based event planning. There will also be opportunities for networking to build new professional relationships.

events.name: Grassroots Connect Fall 2026
events.description:
The outdoor industry's premier fall tradeshow, Grassroots Connect Fall 2026, is set to gather independent retailers and top exhibitors in Kansas City, MO, from November 8-12, 2026. The Grassroots Outdoor Alliance organizes this gathering, which begins Sunday, November 8. That day features a Retailer Education Day and the Discovery Marketplace, providing participants with insights and a first look at upcoming products.

The main "Connect by Grassroots" event runs from Monday, November 9, through Thursday, November 12. During these days, participants can engage in strategic buying, networking, and collaboration. Retailers will have direct access to brands, allowing them to explore new products and strengthen their market position. Meanwhile, exhibitors can present their newest offerings to an attentive group of industry leaders. This gathering facilitates important discussions and connections that help advance the outdoor retail sector.

events.name: OutBound Conference 2026
events.description:
Prepare to redefine your sales strategy and leadership prowess at the OutBound Conference 2026, "The World’s Premier Leadership & Sales Training Conference." From November 9-12, 2026, at the Red Rock Resort & Spa in Las Vegas, NV, this gathering aims to provide sales professionals and leaders with practical strategies, resources, and perspectives.

Attendees will explore ways to navigate modern challenges such as buyer resistance, the impact of AI, and difficulties in prospecting, drawing on insights from experienced sales experts. The main sessions will focus on overcoming buyer resistance. Additionally, a dedicated Leadership Summit on November 12th will offer strategies for maintaining performance in an AI-driven environment. Participants will find tactics to help them achieve their goals and foster growth, whether they work independently or lead a team.

events.name: SSSS Annual Conference 2026
events.description:
The Society for the Scientific Study of Sexuality (SSSS) proudly presents its 69th Annual Conference, a groundbreaking virtual event taking place from November 9th to 13th, 2026. This year, for the first time, the conference will include presentations in Spanish and French, alongside English, reflecting a broader commitment to global scholarship.

The virtual format was intentionally chosen to ensure safety, promote equity, extend its reach, and enhance accessibility for scholars, clinicians, educators, advocates, and students worldwide. Participants can expect to explore current research and interdisciplinary perspectives, with keynote addresses from Dr. Cristóbal Calvillo Martinez and Wascar Ramirez, MEd.

The event offers a platform for advancing the scientific study of sexuality, provides Continuing Education credits, and facilitates connections among professionals dedicated to the field's development.

events.name: CIO Japan Summit Tokyo Fall 2026
events.description:
Set to convene Japan's foremost IT and digital leaders, the CIO Japan Summit Tokyo Fall 2026 will unfold on November 9-10 at the prestigious Hotel Chinzanso Tokyo. This invitation-only gathering is designed for Heads of Information Systems Departments, other senior IT decision-makers, and leading solution providers. Participants will engage in discussions, listen to keynote speeches, and join interactive sessions, all focused on creating digital value and achieving sustainable transformation.

The summit's agenda, shaped by direct feedback from Japanese IT leaders, will explore key areas such as the strategic role of the CIO, the opportunities and challenges of AI technology, advanced cybersecurity strategies, and nurturing digital talent. This environment offers a chance to gain fresh insights, share innovative ideas, and strengthen connections within Japan's IT community.

events.name: Care Providers of Minnesota Convention & Exposition 2026
events.description:
The 78th annual Care Providers of Minnesota Convention & Exposition invites professionals and staff from across the full spectrum of long-term care to the Mystic Lake Center in Prior Lake, MN, from November 9–11, 2026. This three-day gathering is intended for those working in Skilled Nursing, Assisted Living, and other care provider organizations, whether non-profit or for-profit.

Participants can expect educational opportunities designed to address the changing care landscape in Minnesota. The program includes keynote presentations and an exposition hall where attendees can connect with exhibitors presenting new solutions.

There will also be time for connecting with colleagues and peers. The convention will recognize award recipients and honor Leading4Life graduates, alongside other special events focused on improving the quality of care.

events.name: Shop Arabia KSA 2026
events.description:
The future of physical retail in the Kingdom will be unveiled at Shop Arabia KSA 2026, taking place from November 9-10 at Riyadh Front, Saudi Arabia. This two-day gathering will present the latest advancements in store design, digital displays, checkout systems, and immersive in-store technology.

The event brings together 3,000 participants, 125 companies exhibiting their solutions, and 75 expert speakers. It serves as a central meeting point for leading retailers, brands, designers, and technology innovators from across the region. Running alongside Seamless Saudi Arabia, it provides a comprehensive view of smart store technologies and strategies for improving customer engagement and evolving retail environments.

Attendees will encounter carefully selected displays of new concepts, have opportunities to connect with industry leaders, and hear perspectives from prominent speakers. These interactions and insights aim to contribute to shaping the next generation of retail experiences.

events.name: NYBA Financial Services Forum 2026
events.description:
Prepare for three days of unparalleled insights and strategic discussions at the NYBA Financial Services Forum 2026, taking place from November 9-11 at the luxurious JW Marriott in Marco Island, FL. This event is for financial services professionals, particularly those in banking, who want to understand the changes happening in the industry.

Participants will explore new strategies, discuss important industry trends, and have conversations with colleagues and leaders in the field. The forum aims to provide the understanding and practical approaches needed to address upcoming challenges, encourage new ideas, and improve how organizations operate. Attendees can speak with experts and exchange ideas on what works well, all within a pleasant coastal environment.

events.name: CHA Annual Meeting 2026

location.venue: JW Marriott Phoenix Desert Ridge Resort & Spa

events.description:
The CHA Annual Meeting 2026, themed "Elevating Excellence," will convene on Thursday, June 11, at the Bristol Event Center. This gathering brings together over 400 healthcare leaders, staff, state health officials, and community partners. It's an opportunity to acknowledge outstanding care and strengthen collaborative efforts within the healthcare community.

Attendees can look forward to hearing from keynote speaker David Pogue, a New York Times bestselling author, who will discuss technology's significant influence on health, work, and society. The agenda includes conversations about the fast-changing landscape of healthcare delivery, exploring how artificial intelligence is transforming clinical care and how digital tools are connecting patients. These discussions aim to support the delivery of high-quality, affordable care throughout Connecticut.

The meeting will also mark important leadership changes, including the election of Jeffrey Flaks as the new CHA Board of Trustees Chairman. Additionally, an awards ceremony will recognize individuals who have made exceptional contributions to healthcare.

events.name: Canadian Investment Institute 2026
events.description:
Elevate your investment strategy at the Canadian Investment Institute 2026, held from November 9-11 at The Royal at Atlantis Paradise Island, Nassau, Bahamas. This gathering is intended for experienced labour and management trustees, public sector trustees, and administrators who have worked in investment for at least three years. It provides a forum to hear from leading Canadian investment and economic professionals about navigating today's rapidly evolving economic landscape.

The Institute's discussions center on strategies for maximizing returns on plan assets, ensuring robust trustee oversight, and exploring avenues for a fund's future growth. Attendees will engage in a variety of investment sessions and interactive workshops. There will also be opportunities to connect with peers and discuss shared challenges and successes. For those looking to deepen their expertise, pre-conference Advanced Trust Management Standards (ATMS™) sessions are available. The aim is to offer insights into diverse fund approaches and their rationale, helping participants consider how to best position their own investments.

events.name: California Craft Beer Summit 2026
events.description:
The California Craft Beer Summit 2026, hosted by the California Craft Brewers Association, invites professionals to the Hyatt Regency Irvine from November 9-11, 2026. This three-day event brings together California's craft beer community, creating opportunities for learning and building relationships.

The program features over 20 expert-led sessions, providing extensive content on advocacy, education, and communication relevant to the industry. Attendees can explore more than 70 exhibitor booths, take part in off-flavored tastings, and attend various networking events to meet colleagues and industry leaders.

It offers a chance to learn about best practices, discover new developments, and appreciate the dedication within California's craft beer community.

events.name: WASPC Fall Training Conference 2026
events.description:
Washington's top law enforcement executives will converge at the WASPC Fall Training Conference 2026, a pivotal event designed to foster collaboration and advance public safety. This gathering brings together sheriffs, police chiefs, and leaders from state, tribal, and federal agencies, creating a space for high-level discussions.

Participants will attend educational sessions and training that explore current challenges facing law enforcement. These discussions will cover topics such as criminal justice reform, behavioral health, and how to effectively integrate new technologies. Beyond the scheduled learning, an exhibit area will display the latest public safety products and services, giving attendees a chance to see new developments in the field.

The conference offers opportunities for networking and sharing best practices among peers. It's a setting where leaders can collectively contribute to shaping the future of law enforcement, aiming to enhance community trust throughout Washington state.

events.name: Connected World KSA 2026
events.description:
Riyadh Front will become the epicenter of global connectivity on November 9-10, 2026, as Connected World KSA 2026 convenes. This significant gathering for wholesale, carrier, and connectivity leaders will bring together more than 6,000 international professionals, including telecom operators, subsea, and satellite companies, all focused on the future of the connected world.

Over two days, attendees will hear from over 150 expert speakers, exploring the critical networks, partnerships, and policies driving data movement. The program includes a conference, an exhibition featuring more than 150 global companies, and a dedicated area for over 50 innovative startups.

Held alongside Hyperscale Live and with support from founding partners Mobily and STC, this gathering offers opportunities for forming strategic alliances and advancing digital transformation across the region.

events.name: Hyperscale Live KSA 2026
events.description:
Set to redefine the future of AI infrastructure in the Middle East, Hyperscale Live KSA 2026 convenes on November 9-10 at Riyadh Front. This two-day gathering brings together 3,000 data centre operators, hyperscalers, investors, and government leaders, all working to advance Saudi Arabia's sovereign AI ambitions.

Attendees will gain valuable perspectives from 100 speakers discussing key topics such as AI-first data centre design, GPU strategy, sustainable energy solutions, and long-term investment models. The event will also feature innovations from 150 exhibitors showcasing the latest in cloud and digital infrastructure.

Opportunities for connection are available through various networking events, including curated roundtables and a dedicated social gathering. These interactions are intended to foster collaborations and contribute to the development of the Kingdom's digital future.

events.name: Sports & Active Nutrition Summit Europe 2026
events.description:
On Monday, November 9, 2026, London will host the Sports & Active Nutrition Summit Europe 2026, an essential event for industry leaders, researchers, and innovators.

NutraIngredients organizes this summit, bringing together professionals to explore and discuss developments in active, lifestyle, and sports nutrition. The program allows individuals to understand the changing market, examine the science behind fueling performance with ingredients like proteins and collagen, and learn about recovery strategies supported by evidence. Discussions will also cover the future of weight management, metabolic health, and how to build trust through digital marketing.

After six successful years, the event provides opportunities for individuals to connect through roundtable discussions and a dedicated drinks reception. These interactions often lead to new ideas and collaborations.

events.name: Thompson Grants Federal Grants Forum 2026
events.description:
Navigating the complexities of federal grants just got clearer with the Thompson Grants Federal Grants Forum 2026, a virtual event taking place on November 9-10.

The two-day event, organized by Thompson Grants, focuses on equipping professionals with the knowledge and confidence needed to establish a strong compliance foundation for 2026 and beyond. Discussions will center on understanding grant requirements and best practices.

Participants will explore the practical implications of the 2024 Uniform Guidance updates, discuss strategies for aligning policies, and address common compliance challenges. This content is relevant for new grant professionals, program managers, and finance staff working with nonprofits, state, and local agencies. Expert-led training will be provided, and attendees have the opportunity to earn up to 14.4 NASBA CPEs & 14.4 GPCI CEUs. The virtual setting allows for a thorough review of these topics from any location.

events.name: Home Delivery Saudi Arabia 2026 2026
events.description:
Prepare to revolutionize your retail logistics and supply chain strategies at Home Delivery Saudi Arabia 2026, held on November 9-10 at Riyadh Front. This event will bring together 3,000 professionals from delivery services, grocers, retailers, manufacturers, and warehousing sectors.

Attendees will find solutions showcased by 150 exhibitors, with a focus on autonomous technologies, AI, robotics, and sustainable practices. The program features 75 expert speakers who will explore critical topics such as final mile delivery, urban logistics, omnichannel fulfillment, and cross-border shipping. Discussions will also address innovative approaches to inventory management, customer experience, and reverse logistics.

Co-located with Seamless Saudi Arabia, the event offers a setting for connecting with industry leaders, sharing insights, and discussing the future of supply chain excellence.

events.name: World Congress on Primary Healthcare and Medicare Summit 2026
events.description:
Dedicated to "Transforming Challenges into Opportunities for Better Health," the 6th World Congress on Primary Healthcare and Medicare Summit 2026 convenes global experts in Bangkok, Thailand, from November 09–10. This hybrid event, taking place at the Grand Mercure Bangkok Atrium, will bring together healthcare professionals, researchers, policymakers, and industry leaders from around the world.

Attendees will engage in keynotes, panel discussions, and workshops. These sessions will explore important topics, ranging from strengthening health systems and advanced diagnostics to preventive medicine and patient-centered care models. The Summit aims to encourage collaboration, facilitate the sharing of current research, and discuss emerging trends, contributing to the evolution of primary healthcare systems and improving health outcomes globally.

events.name: Liverpool Fashion Week 2026
events.description:
The vibrant heart of Liverpool will once again beat to the rhythm of high fashion as Liverpool Fashion Week unfolds on **13 October 2025** at The Liner Hotel. This gathering offers a unique perspective on luxury goods, art, culture, and emerging technologies, appealing to individuals with a keen interest in contemporary style. Visitors can expect to see a thoughtful selection of designs from both established names and rising talents, highlighting innovation and creative spirit within the industry.

Beyond the fashion presentations, the week creates a space for meaningful connections and opportunities, bringing together those who shape and appreciate the fashion world. It also serves to highlight the distinct creative talent found in Liverpool.

events.name: Accounting & Business Expo Saudi Arabia 2026
events.description:
Saudi Arabia's digital transformation journey takes center stage at the Accounting & Business Expo 2026. This event, taking place on 9-10 November at Riyadh Front, is designed for accountants, finance leaders, and business owners who are navigating the Kingdom's evolving economic and technological landscape. It aims to provide insights into the strategies and tools needed for success in this environment.

Attendees can expect to hear from 150 expert speakers covering key areas such as digital transformation, tax regulations, CFO strategies, and growth for small and medium-sized enterprises. The expo also features 150 exhibitors showcasing various solutions. Opportunities for connecting with peers and industry leaders will be available, including options for pre-booked meetings and a dedicated social gathering.

The expo is co-located with Seamless Saudi Arabia and is CPD-certified. It offers a setting for individuals to connect, learn, and explore innovations that contribute to smarter, more efficient finance operations. Attendance at this event is free.

events.name: Enlit Europe 2026
events.description:
Prepare to shape the future of Europe's energy landscape at Enlit Europe 2026, taking place from 10-12 November at Messe Wien in Vienna, Austria.

This gathering brings together over 15,000 individuals from more than 140 countries, all focused on the energy transition. It offers a comprehensive look at the path forward for Europe's energy system, aiming to address the challenges and opportunities in creating a dependable, decarbonised, and digitalised energy future.

Attendees will find over 750 exhibitors showcasing new developments and hear from more than 600 expert speakers across a detailed program. Discussions and presentations will cover essential areas like smart grids, hydrogen, energy storage, cybersecurity, and eMobility. This is where utilities, grid operators, technology leaders, policymakers, and innovators converge, fostering shared efforts.

The event's structure, including its Expo, Summit, and EU Projects Zone, facilitates these connections and collaborations, supporting the development of the future energy workforce.

events.name: Adobe Max 2026
events.description:
Get ready to ignite your imagination at Adobe Max 2026, taking place in vibrant Miami Beach from November 10–12. This conference brings together designers, photographers, filmmakers, and web developers interested in the latest creative innovations.

Attendees will experience a dynamic environment where new tools and techniques are introduced, and hear from visionaries who are influencing the future of digital artistry. It's an opportunity to connect with a global community, develop skills, and find inspiration to enhance one's work.

Information regarding registration and the full agenda will be shared as it becomes available.

events.name: Electronica Germany 2026
events.description:
Munich, Germany, will once again host Electronica Germany 2026, the world's leading trade fair and conference dedicated to the entire spectrum of modern electronics.

The event offers a comprehensive look at innovations, current trends, and the future trajectory of global electronics. It explores a wide range of topics, including high-performance systems, semiconductors, micro systems technology, measurement, sensors, displays, and vehicle electronics – from power management to active assistance systems. A significant emphasis is placed on how electronics drive the increasing connectivity across communication, knowledge, machines, and infrastructure.

Trade professionals and innovative exhibitors from around the world gather to connect and exchange ideas. Insights are shared through presentations from leading experts, a CEO Roundtable discussion, and the Automotive Conference. The program also includes specific areas dedicated to new companies and career development.

events.name: GESS Dubai 2026
events.description:
The future of learning takes center stage at GESS Dubai 2026, hosted from 10-12 November at the Dubai World Trade Centre. This gathering aims to foster advancements in education, encouraging new ideas and creative solutions for classrooms globally. It brings together educators, school leaders, and technology innovators to examine new tools and effective teaching methods.

Attendees will have the opportunity to explore current developments in artificial intelligence, immersive technologies, gamification, and how sustainability can be integrated into school curricula. The program includes various opportunities for professional growth, practical workshops, and a ceremony recognizing achievements in education. Participants can hear from leading speakers during GESS Talks Live, acquire insights into leadership, and discover game-based learning approaches at Gaming@GESS.

The event serves as a significant forum for those dedicated to improving educational experiences for students and enhancing teaching practices around the world.

events.name: SEMICON Europa 2026
events.description:
The future of European microelectronics will converge in Munich, Germany, for SEMICON Europa 2026, taking place November 10–13.

Held alongside electronica, this gathering unites professionals from across the semiconductor supply chain. Participants will encounter new developments in areas such as advanced packaging, smart manufacturing, and AI chip design.

Discussions with industry leaders will take place at the CxO Summit, and emerging technologies will be highlighted at the SEMI Startup Showcase. Specialized topics are also addressed in dedicated forums, including the Fab Management Forum and the MEMS & Imaging Sensors Summit. The event provides an opportunity for professionals to connect, share ideas, and contribute to the ongoing progress of semiconductor technology throughout Europe.

events.name: Digital Asset Summit London 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for the premier institutional event in digital assets. The Digital Asset Summit London 2026, held November 10-11 at the Hilton Park Lane, is for asset managers, financial institutions, allocators, and policymakers working within the evolving digital asset space.

Over two days, the summit will feature focused discussions. Topics include Real-World Assets (RWAs) and onchain institutional finance, the global impact of stablecoins, and developments in DeFi and risk management. Attendees will have the opportunity to hear from leading experts, understand emerging trends, and connect with peers.

The event will also explore how blockchain innovation is creating enterprise solutions and influencing global regulatory frameworks, contributing to the future of digital finance.

events.name: BrauBeviale 2026
events.description:
From November 10 to 12, 2026, the Nuremberg Exhibition Centre in Germany will transform into the epicenter of beverage industry innovation for BrauBeviale 2026. This significant European gathering explores the entire process of beverage production, from the initial raw materials and bottling stages through to packaging and marketing at the point of sale.

Those involved in manufacturing and bottling beer, wine, spirits, and non-alcoholic beverages, along with their suppliers, will find a wide range of new products, solutions, and services. Beyond the main exhibition, there are dedicated areas such as Wine@BrauBeviale, the Start-up Zone, and the Craft Drinks Area.

People attending can connect with others in the industry, gather important insights, and examine the trends that are influencing the global beverage landscape.

events.name: Automechanika Dubai 2026
events.description:
Accelerate into the future of the automotive aftermarket at Automechanika Dubai 2026, the Middle East & Africa region's largest international trade show. From November 10-12, the Dubai Exhibition Centre will host more than 2,400 global brands, ranging from established Tier-1 suppliers to innovative startups, all presenting the full scope of the aftermarket industry. Industry leaders, innovators, and professionals, including African buyers and workshop experts, will gather to explore new solutions across parts, diagnostics, and digital technologies.

The event offers various avenues for learning and connection. The Automechanika Academy provides interactive sessions, while Innovation4Mobility highlights future trends. AfriConnections is available for networking. Additionally, dedicated sessions like Modern Workshop and Fleet FWD will offer perspectives on digital solutions, sustainability, electrification, and AI's influence on logistics. These discussions also provide context on the significant market growth anticipated in the GCC aftermarket, projected to reach $13 billion.

events.name: #RISK EUROPE 2026
events.description:
Elevate your strategic influence at #RISK EUROPE 2026, Europe's foremost expo for Risk, GRC, Security, and RegTech professionals. The event takes place on November 10-11, 2026, at ExCeL London. It is designed to help professionals shift their perspective, supporting a move from purely compliance-driven work to becoming strategic business partners.

The agenda spans five content stages, exploring new categories beyond traditional GRC. Discussions will cover topics such as AI and cloud security, human risk, operational resilience, financial crime, and the complexities of ESG and supply chain security. Specific areas like DORA, NIS2, unified GRC platforms, and the regulatory impact of AI will also be addressed.

This gathering provides an opportunity for security leaders, risk owners, and C-suite executives to connect, challenge ideas, and navigate the intricate global risk landscape.

events.name: Sitecore Symposium 2026

location.venue: Walt Disney World Swan And Dolphin Resort

events.description:
Prepare to redefine the future of digital experience at Sitecore Symposium 2026, taking place in Orlando from November 10-12.

The three-day event, under the theme "REWIRED," will address how AI is reshaping customer expectations and the imperative for marketers to adapt. Discussions will center on developing personalized, intelligent experiences by rethinking current strategies and technology stacks.

Attendees can explore four distinct tracks: brand visibility, AI-native content supply chains, orchestrating experiences with agents, and establishing an AI-ready technology foundation. The program offers insights into analytics, commerce, personalization, and digital transformation. The Symposium also includes the Sitecore Digital Impact Awards, which recognize organizations leading the way in digital innovation. This gathering brings together marketers, developers, and digital leaders interested in the future of customer engagement.

events.name: Intermodal Europe 2026
events.description:
Shape the future of global logistics and container shipping at Intermodal Europe 2026, from 10 to 12 November at Rotterdam Ahoy, Netherlands. Over three days, the event brings together approximately 4,000 attendees from more than 90 countries, alongside over 130 leading suppliers in the industry.

The exhibition floor will showcase new developments and solutions. Attendees can also hear perspectives from over 50 speakers across two dedicated theatres. The conference program focuses on Agility, Reliability, and Responsibility, addressing current trends and important topics influencing intermodal trade.

For 2026, an Executive Visitor Pass is available, providing opportunities for focused networking. A new event app will also be introduced to support attendees during their visit. The event provides a setting for strengthening existing relationships and forming new connections within the industry.

events.name: Global Wellness Summit 2026
events.description:
Celebrating its 20th anniversary, the Global Wellness Summit 2026 invites the world's foremost leaders and innovators to Phuket, Thailand, from November 10-13. This invitation-only event serves as a key gathering for those actively shaping the $6.8 trillion global wellness economy.

Over four days, participants will engage with deep insights, strategic discussions, and new research from the Global Wellness Institute. There will be opportunities to explore the Innovation Village and connect with fellow professionals who are driving the future of wellness.

This significant summit is hosted by the Thailand Convention & Exhibition Bureau, Amazing Thailand, and the Ministry of Public Health. It provides a platform to contribute to and further the global business of well-being.

events.name: P2PI Live 2026
events.description:
Prepare to redefine the future of retail at InStore Ignite, P2PI Live 2026, a dynamic 2.5-day event hosted by the Path to Purchase Institute at The Hilton Chicago. This event brings together CPG brands, leaders, and solution providers interested in improving their in-store marketing strategies and understanding how digital influences sales.

Participants will explore key areas like conversion, visibility, connectivity, and customer experience. The aim is to provide practical understanding that helps address current challenges in implementing strategies. The program includes interactive sessions, such as the Pitch Tank, along with specific networking opportunities and an awards program. These elements offer a chance to engage with professionals who are shaping the retail environment, learn about new solutions, and build connections that can support growth in the changing retail world.

events.name: AIMed26 2026
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the future of healthcare at AIMed26 2026, taking place from November 10th to 13th at the Renaissance Orlando at Seaworld, Florida. This gathering brings together over a thousand clinicians, investors, data scientists, and administrative leaders from hundreds of hospitals.

Participants can expect to hear from leading experts in keynotes, attend specialized Chief AI Officer Gatherings, and explore a dedicated Pediatric AI Track. The program also includes hands-on workshops and an exhibit hall where attendees can see the latest in AI applications, digital health, and extended reality. It's a chance to learn practical strategies for implementing AI solutions, witness the Shark Tank startup pitch, and contribute to discussions about the responsible and impactful use of AI in medicine.

The event fosters an environment for learning, collaboration, and connecting with peers from across the healthcare ecosystem.

events.name: EHIN 2026
events.description:
Driving the future of Norway's health sector, EHIN 2026 returns on November 10th and 11th, 2026, as the nation's largest e-health conference. This gathering focuses on advancing the digitalization of health services and exploring new ways to improve healthcare for the future.

Professionals from across the health sector will come together to discuss important topics such as general health, digitalization, and elder care. They will examine recent advancements and key strategies. The event provides a space for people from both public and private sectors to share their knowledge and collaborate.

The aim is to bring together individuals dedicated to improving patient care and the efficiency of health services. Through these discussions and collaborations, participants collectively work towards shaping the future of health services in Norway.

events.name: AMP Annual Meeting & Expo 2026
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the forefront of molecular pathology at the AMP Annual Meeting & Expo 2026. From November 10–14, 2026, the Seattle Convention Center in Seattle, Washington, will bring together professionals focused on advancing molecular diagnostics and research.

Organized by the Association for Molecular Pathology, this gathering provides a significant opportunity to explore new research, see emerging technologies, and discuss important clinical applications. Those attending can expect to gain insights from experts, build connections with peers, and learn about the innovations that are shaping the future of the field.

events.name: EuroTier 2026
events.description:
The future of professional animal husbandry converges at EuroTier 2026, held from November 10-13 in Hanover, Germany. This four-day event focuses on "Intelligence in animal farming," highlighting new technologies and innovations for livestock management. Visitors can expect to see advancements across areas like animal health and welfare, housing, feeding technology, automation, robotics, sensor technology, and AI.

Running alongside EnergyDecentral and the Inhouse Farming - Feed & Food Show, EuroTier offers a comprehensive perspective on sustainable agricultural practices. Key features include the DLG Spotlight ‘Barn Robot Event,’ which will focus on automated dairy solutions, and the DLG Expert Stages, where discussions will cover digitalisation and animal welfare.

The event provides an opportunity for professionals to observe and discuss the evolving landscape of livestock management.

events.name: The MarTech Summit London 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for The MarTech Summit London 2026, a pivotal event for senior marketing and technology leaders, taking place on 10 & 11 November at Convene 155 Bishopsgate. The summit, centered around the theme "Smarter Stacks. Stronger Growth.", will bring together over 500 senior executives, with 85% holding Director-level positions or higher, from prominent organizations including Amazon, BBC, and Charlotte Tilbury.

Over two days, the program will offer insights across three distinct stages. Discussions will cover critical areas such as customer-centric marketing, AI-powered personalization, MarTech integration, and first-party data strategies. The agenda features keynotes, case studies, and interactive panels designed for both B2B and B2C marketing executives.

Beyond the scheduled sessions, there will be opportunities for attendees to connect and exchange ideas during energizer breakfasts, dedicated breaks, and exclusive dinners. Exhibitors, including Optimizely and Treasure Data, will also be present, showcasing their latest technology solutions that can help refine marketing approaches.

events.name: PLUS Conference 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for the 39th Annual PLUS Conference, taking place from November 10 to 12, 2026, in beautiful San Diego, CA. This event focuses on the professional liability insurance market, offering a space for professionals to gain new perspectives and advance their understanding of the field.

The program will feature discussions on current industry topics, presentations from experienced professionals, and opportunities to explore new ideas. Participants, including underwriters, brokers, attorneys, and risk managers, can earn up to 4 CE/CLE Credits. The conference provides a forum for the professional liability insurance industry to consider its future and address evolving needs.

events.name: API Cybersecurity Conference for the Oil and Natural Gas Industry 2026

location.venue: The Woodlands Waterway Marriott Hotel & Convention Center

events.description:
The 21st Annual API Cybersecurity Conference for the Oil and Natural Gas Industry 2026 is set for November 10-11. Participants can attend in person at the Woodlands Waterway Marriott in The Woodlands, Texas, or virtually via livestream. This event serves as a key forum for cybersecurity professionals dedicated to protecting the critical infrastructure within the oil and natural gas sector.

The program will explore current cyber threats, innovative defense strategies, and complex regulatory challenges. Discussions will cover safeguarding both operational technology (OT) and information technology (IT) systems.

It offers an opportunity to engage with leading experts, exchange best practices, and learn about solutions that strengthen an organization's cyber resilience in today's complex digital landscape.

events.name: NextGen Payments & RegTech Forum USA 2026
events.description:
Set for November 12, 2026, at the Hyatt Regency in Austin, Texas, the NextGen Payments & RegTech Forum USA 2026 is the definitive gathering for over 400 payments, compliance, and RegTech leaders. This full-day event will examine the evolving landscape of US financial services.

Professionals from banks, fintechs, regulators, and merchants will explore strategies for navigating instant and A2A payments, digital wallets, and embedded finance. The forum will also address the complexities of regulatory shifts, the future of crypto and CBDCs, and the impact of AI and Agentic AI on fraud detection, AML, and compliance.

Through keynotes, fireside chats, and interactive panels, attendees will have opportunities for networking and focused one-to-one discussions, supporting their strategic initiatives.

events.name: EHI techdays 2026
events.description:
The World Conference Center Bonn will host EHI techdays 2026 on November 10-11, bringing together retail's leading decision-makers, digital pioneers, and strategists. Over these two days, the event will explore the significant technological advancements shaping retail's future. Discussions will cover essential areas such as smart store concepts, cybersecurity, enhancing customer experience, and the practical applications of AI, Generative AI, and Robotics for retail.

The program includes talks from technology leaders, focused fireside chats, and hands-on masterclasses. These sessions are designed to provide a deeper understanding of current trends and to explore various approaches to common challenges.

EHI techdays 2026 provides an environment for professionals in retail technology to connect, share perspectives, and exchange ideas. It's an opportunity for those working in the field to engage with peers and discuss the evolving landscape of retail innovation.

events.name: Global Pharma And Biotech Summit 2026
events.description:
Prepare to shape the future of healthcare at the Global Pharma And Biotech Summit 2026, a pivotal gathering for distinguished innovators, investors, and C-suite executives.

The summit will explore how geopolitical shifts and economic disruptions are influencing global research and development, manufacturing, and market access. Conversations will address the emergence of new pharmaceutical leaders, the intricate regulatory landscape for technologies such as AI and Real-World Evidence, and ongoing pressures related to drug costs.

Participants can expect to delve into significant advancements in precision medicine and treatments for obesity, including how AI is transforming drug discovery. The agenda also includes discussions with experts on topics like clinical trials, market access, and patient empowerment, offering perspectives on navigating differing regulations and changes within health systems.

events.name: World Business Forum Mexico 2026
events.description:
Redefine your leadership vision at the World Business Forum Mexico 2026, taking place on November 10 & 11 at Expo Santa Fe, CDMX.

The event brings together thousands of senior executives, decision-makers, innovators, and industry leaders from around the world. Attendees will experience two days of insights from a distinguished group of global thought leaders, including Francis Ford Coppola, Renée Mauborgne, and Nouriel Roubini.

Discussions will cover critical themes like innovation, strategy, AI, business transformation, and global economic resilience. The aim is to provide practical strategies relevant for navigating today's evolving business landscape.

Beyond the main presentations, there will be opportunities to connect with peers through dedicated networking sessions. Participants also receive year-round access to WOBI’s global executive community.

events.name: Montréal International Game Summit 2026
events.description:
Forge critical partnerships and unlock new opportunities at the Montréal International Game Summit 2026.

From November 10-11, the Grand Quay in Montréal will host Canada's largest and longest-running B2B video game conference. It serves as a key entry point to the North American industry, bringing together international game developers, publishers, service providers, and investors. The focus for attendees is on securing investment and finalizing important agreements.

The summit offers three content stages where experts will share insights on industry trends and development best practices. A dedicated Business Lounge, supported by MeetToMatch, provides a structured environment for connecting with key decision-makers. Attendees can also visit the Indie Zone to see upcoming games, take part in the MIGS Indie Pitch Competition, and examine new tools and business development opportunities on the show floors.

events.name: Foam Expo Europe 2026
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the forefront of foam innovation at Foam Expo Europe 2026, taking place from November 10-12 at Messe Stuttgart, Germany. This three-day event is Europe's largest free trade fair and conference for the technical foam industry. It's a place to explore new technologies and connect with professionals from every part of the supply chain.

A free pass also includes entry to co-located events such as Adhesives & Bonding Expo Europe and Thermal Management Expo Europe, along with partner shows like Automotive Interiors Expo Europe and Global Automotive Components and Suppliers. Conference sessions, led by experts, will cover current topics in sustainability, automotive applications, and manufacturing. It's a chance to see new developments, learn important information, and meet other professionals and decision-makers working in the foam industry.

events.name: HR World Horizon Summit 2026
events.description:
The HR World Horizon Summit 2026 invites CHROs, HR leaders, and their teams to Amsterdam for a pivotal two-day event on 17-18 November at the Hilton Amsterdam Schiphol. This event will bring together over 600 HR professionals from EMEA and beyond, all with a shared purpose: to explore and shape the future of human resources and organizational transformation.

Attendees will engage in thoughtful discussions, explore emerging trends, and collaborate on strategies that redefine leadership and the world of work. The summit provides an opportunity to gain valuable insights from industry leaders, address current challenges, and connect with an extensive network of colleagues.

The aim is to collectively chart a course for impactful HR leadership within an evolving global environment.

events.name: Technology Sourcing 2026
events.description:
Transforming procurement from a cost center to a strategic profit engine, Technology Sourcing 2026 is the essential gathering for senior IT and procurement leaders. The event will be held November 10-11, 2026, at the Aon Ballroom, Navy Pier, Chicago. It is specifically designed for CPOs, CIOs, and digital futurists.

Attendees include a significant number of buy-side leaders, collectively managing over $30 billion in IT spending across Fortune 500 companies and high-growth startups. Discussions will focus on how AI, automation, and orchestration are reshaping sourcing strategies. Participants can expect peer-led sessions, interactive roundtables, and a dedicated technology marketplace.

The agenda aims to provide practical strategies for fostering innovation through effective supplier partnerships and optimizing technology investments to deliver business value. Networking opportunities, including champagne roundtables, are designed to facilitate meaningful connections. The goal is for attendees to depart with insights and relationships that can support organizational growth.

events.name: Space Economy Summit 2026
events.description:
The 4th annual Space Economy Summit, presented by Economist Impact, will convene global leaders in Orlando, USA, on November 10th & 11th, 2026. This gathering, a key part of UCF Space Week, focuses on "Maximising returns to Earth: the infinite potential of space." It brings together representatives from space agencies, businesses, investors, and technology innovators.

The summit provides a forum for these diverse groups to discuss and work together. Discussions will cover essential subjects such as sustainable growth, manufacturing in space, building robust systems, funding approaches, and the changing financial landscape of lunar and cislunar operations. With more than 60 sessions and 100 speakers anticipated, participants can expect to deepen their understanding of how to balance the sector's expansion with responsible oversight, ultimately influencing the direction of the fast-growing space industry.

events.name: Automotive Logistics & Supply Chain Mexico 2026
events.description:
Uncover the strategic imperatives shaping Mexico's automotive supply chain at Automotive Logistics & Supply Chain Mexico 2026, hosted by Automotive Logistics. This 2.5-day summit takes place from November 10-12 at the Marquis Reforma Hotel in Mexico City, bringing together over 650 senior decision-makers from OEMs, suppliers, and logistics providers.

The event's theme, "Decisive logistics: Moving Mexico with clarity, speed and local excellence," will guide the discussions. Attendees can expect insights from more than 30 expert speakers, including leaders from companies like Chirey, BMW Group, Volkswagen, and Audi. Conversations will explore how to redesign logistics networks, the drive towards nearshoring, enhancing cross-border flows, and leveraging digital transformation for better visibility and flexibility. Over 20 hours are dedicated to networking, providing opportunities to build partnerships and advance operations amidst evolving trade dynamics and regulatory landscapes.

events.name: The EMEA Stakeholder Conference 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for The EMEA Stakeholder Conference 2026, set to unfold from 10-12 November in vibrant Dubai, UAE. This three-day event brings together professionals from the hospitality and real estate sectors. It aims to connect industry leaders, encourage collaboration, and support regional development.

The conference will feature discussions on current trends, significant challenges, and the importance of innovation and sustainability in shaping the industry's path forward. It provides a setting for professionals to exchange ideas, collaborate, and share knowledge. Attendees will include decision-makers, colleagues, and suppliers, creating an environment for valuable interactions. The goal is to offer perspectives that can inform business strategies and foster new relationships within the EMEA market.

events.name: Finnovex Middle East 2026
events.description:
Dubai is set to host Finnovex Middle East 2026 on 10-11 November, bringing together the region's financial elite for Chapter 43 of the esteemed global series. This gathering will focus on 'Global Fintech Hub: Innovation, Regulation & Collaboration for the Future of Finance,' exploring subjects such as AI-governed trust, open finance, and advancements in digital banking.

Senior executives, decision-makers, and leaders from financial institutions, fintech companies, and regulatory bodies will be present to share perspectives. They will have opportunities to discuss ideas, including the '10X Challenge' for emerging fintech startups, and participate in 'Private Roundtables' designed for in-depth C-level discussions.

The event provides a setting where banks, fintech firms, regulators, and innovators can connect and work towards shaping the financial landscape of tomorrow.

events.name: Utah Business Forward 2026

location.venue: Salt Lake Marriott Downtown at City Creek

events.description:
Elevate your enterprise and leadership acumen at Utah Business Forward 2026, Utah's premier business conference, taking place on November 10, 2026, at the Salt Lake Marriott Downtown at City Creek. This full-day event is for business leaders and professionals who want to improve their skills, foster innovation, and achieve meaningful growth in Utah's evolving economy.

Attendees will hear from top leaders and over 20 experts across various industries, including keynote speakers. The program offers five breakout tracks—LEAD, GROW, INNOVATE, IMPACT, and a hands-on AI workshop—allowing participants to focus on areas most relevant to them. Those who register early will also have the chance to attend a "Breakfast With an Expert."

The conference aims to provide practical strategies, opportunities to connect with peers, and current insights that can help businesses advance.

events.name: TOC Asia 2026
events.description:
The future of the APAC port and supply chain will be reimagined at TOC Asia 2026, convening on 10-11 November at Marina Bay Sands, Singapore. This year's event is expected to be the largest TOC Asia yet, bringing together over 2000 professionals from across the globe, including more than 500 individuals from port, terminal, and shipping sectors.

The exhibition floor will feature over 110 companies presenting port technology, equipment, and services. These displays will highlight advancements in automation, digitalization, and efficiency relevant to terminal operations. Additionally, more than 60 speakers will contribute to two distinct conference streams. TECH TOC is designed for technical and operations professionals, while CSC Live serves as a forum for senior leaders to discuss policy, sustainability, and emerging opportunities for port executives.

Over these two days, participants will have opportunities for knowledge exchange and professional networking. The discussions and interactions aim to contribute to the ongoing evolution of container supply chains.

events.name: International Cruise Summit 2026
events.description:
Prepare to navigate the future of the global cruise industry at the International Cruise Summit 2026, taking place in Madrid, Spain, on November 10 & 11. This one-and-a-half-day event brings together industry leaders, innovators, and key decision-makers from around the world.

Participants will find themselves in panel discussions, keynote presentations, and interactive sessions. These are structured to help everyone gain a deeper understanding and contribute to informed discussions. The agenda covers emerging trends, sustainability strategies, technological advancements, and new market opportunities that are currently shaping the cruise sector.

Beyond the formal sessions, there will be opportunities to connect with peers and colleagues during social events. This setting allows for the exchange of ideas, the expansion of knowledge, and the strengthening of professional relationships within the international cruise business.

events.name: Data + AI World Tour Atlanta 2026
events.description:
Prepare to unlock the next era of innovation at the Data + AI World Tour Atlanta 2026, taking place on November 10, 2026, at the Atlanta Marriott Marquis. This one-day event gathers data professionals, AI enthusiasts, and business leaders. The day focuses on understanding the significant impact of data and artificial intelligence.

Participants will examine recent advancements, gain strategic insights, and learn about practical applications within big data technologies, such as Apache Spark. The program will also cover how AI can be used to improve decision-making and operational efficiency. A specific feature of the event is the Executive Roundtable, which provides senior leaders with a forum for high-level discussions and opportunities to connect with peers.

The event offers a chance to engage with industry leaders, contribute to discussions on future strategies, and enhance understanding in the evolving fields of data and AI.

events.name: SFNet Annual Convention 2026
events.description:
Chicago will host the secured finance industry's most anticipated event, the 82nd SFNet Annual Convention 2026, from November 10-11. This year's convention will take place at the Marriott Marquis, focusing on the theme "Harnessing the Winds of Change." It offers professionals a chance to gain valuable perspectives from key figures in the industry.

The event is designed for both emerging and established secured finance professionals. It provides a setting to connect with peers, potential collaborators, and experts from across the financial services sector. Participants can explore new strategies that are influencing the future of financial services, helping them navigate a constantly evolving market.

This gathering offers an important opportunity to engage with the industry's direction. Registration for the convention begins in July 2026.

events.name: WT Middle East 2026
events.description:

This gathering, known as WT Middle East 2026, will take place alongside the World Vape Show and World Cigar Show. It is expected to draw over 12,000 professionals from more than 60 countries, creating a comprehensive platform for the industry.

Over two days, the event offers an opportunity for buyers, distributors, and decision-makers (attendees must be 21 or older) to explore offerings from more than 250 exhibitors. These displays will feature advancements in tobacco processing, next-generation products, and premium cigars. Attendees can also participate in sessions led by industry experts, covering topics such as manufacturing innovations, regulatory updates, and commercial strategies. It also offers a setting to observe cutting-edge machinery and to establish valuable business connections, fostering interactions that contribute to the market's ongoing development.

events.name: NSGC Annual Conference 2026
events.description:
The National Society of Genetic Counselors (NSGC) proudly presents its 45th Annual Conference, a pivotal event for the entire genetic counseling community. This year's conference takes place from November 10-14 in Baltimore, Maryland, offering a valuable space for learning, connecting with peers, and gaining new perspectives.

Attendees, whether students, recent graduates, or experienced professionals, will have the opportunity to explore emerging research, gather practical insights, and discover innovative ideas that are influencing the profession's direction. It's a place where colleagues can connect, new collaborations can begin, and everyone can feel part of a community committed to moving genetic counseling forward. The event offers a chance to acknowledge shared achievements and contribute to the continued development of this important field.

events.name: Family Office Forum Zurich 2026
events.description:
The Family Office Forum Zurich 2026, an exclusive two-day global gathering, will convene on November 10th-11th at the breathtaking Dolder Grand Hotel in Zurich. Attendees will engage in discussions that delve into crucial subjects, such as sound governance practices and advanced investment approaches. The agenda covers a wide range of topics, from managing multi-asset portfolios and understanding venture capital in areas like quantum technologies and AI, to sustainable finance and planning for family succession.

Throughout the two days, there will be ample time for networking and participating in insightful panel discussions. This environment is carefully maintained to be free of sales pitches, fostering genuine peer-to-peer learning and strategic collaboration among participants.

events.name: Tax Technology Conference 2026
events.description:
The future of tax is here, and it's rocking! The Tax Technology Conference 2026, taking place November 10-11 in Frankfurt am Main, is expected to gather over 500 professionals. This leading German-speaking event examines how Artificial Intelligence, automation, and data are fundamentally reshaping tax departments, consulting, and financial administration.

The agenda includes critical topics ranging from AI-driven transformation and the future of AI Audit to leadership in the AI age and practical AI tools for daily work. Discussions will also cover future skills, rethinking customs with technology, and fostering collaboration within hybrid teams.

Attendees can also participate in distinctive parallel sessions, some even held in a "Stretch-Limousine." The program aims to provide actionable insights for navigating the evolving tax landscape and offers opportunities to engage with industry leaders.

events.name: VNTR Global Investor Summit 2026

The day's agenda includes strategic discussions, thematic roundtables, and opportunities for direct engagement. These sessions are structured to help foster significant partnerships and inform future investment approaches.

events.name: Luxury Law Summit New York 2026
events.description:

This gathering takes place at the Metropolitan Club in New York City, bringing together CEOs, general counsel, and legal experts from prominent global brands.

Participants will delve into the unique characteristics that define American luxury, gaining insights into the critical legal and business challenges inherent in this sector. Discussions will cover key areas such as litigation, mass arbitrations, ESG laws, and the latest class action trends, ensuring attendees are well-informed on current developments.

Beyond the structured sessions, the summit provides a setting for professionals to connect and exchange ideas in a refined atmosphere. Business attire is expected. The event is designed to help those in the luxury sector navigate its complexities and maintain leadership in a constantly evolving market.

events.name: BF SHOW Fall 2026
events.description:
The premier showcase for Brazilian footwear, BF SHOW Fall 2026, invites you to São Paulo's Distrito Anhembi from May 18-20. This 6th edition is Brazil's largest footwear fair, connecting national retailers and international buyers with the 'made in Brazil' industry. Attendees will explore diverse Fall/Winter and Spring/Summer collections, spanning women's, men's, children's, and sports segments.

The event features the Arena BFSHOW, offering content focused on footwear sales. A dedicated Buyer Program is in place to help facilitate connections among participants. Here, new products and business opportunities are presented, showcasing the industry's dedication to design, quality, technology, diversity, and sustainability. BF SHOW Fall 2026 serves as a key meeting point for the footwear sector.

events.name: DenAI Summit 2026
events.description:
Returning for its third groundbreaking year, DenAI Summit 2026 invites leaders to Denver, Colorado, on November 10th, under the pivotal theme, "Governing in the Age of AI." A key focus of the summit is the practical applications and insights from current AI use in city government. It moves beyond theoretical discussions to examine what's truly happening on the ground. Attendees, including those working in areas like permitting, transit, housing, workforce development, and infrastructure, will explore practical approaches for using AI to improve efficiency and services for residents.

events.name: Women at the Top Summit 2026

events.name: AEM Annual Conference 2026

events.name: Education Investment MENA 2026

events.name: SIGMA Annual Conference 2026
events.description:

events.name: CHIME Fall Forum 2026
events.description:

events.name: Retail Forum 2026

The retail landscape is rapidly evolving, and Retail Forum 2026 offers an unparalleled opportunity to navigate its complexities and seize new growth avenues. events.name: Milken Institute Future of Health Summit 2026
events.description:

Participants will engage in important discussions, form strategic collaborations, and explore new approaches to improve health globally, aiming for a healthier future for everyone.

events.name: Retail Supply Chain & Logistics Expo London 2026
events.description:
Set to redefine the future of retail operations, the Retail Supply Chain & Logistics Expo London 2026 convenes on 11th & 12th November at Excel London. events.name: Going Global Live London 2026
events.description:
For ambitious business leaders ready to conquer international markets, Going Global Live London 2026 is the essential event. This gathering, held on November 11th and 12th, 2026, at ExCeL London, focuses on supporting small and medium-sized enterprises looking to expand their reach globally.

Attendees can expect to explore key areas of international trade, from understanding cross-border logistics and legal requirements to developing cultural intelligence and strategies for acquiring customers worldwide. The event features over 100 companies showcasing their services and 50 educational sessions, including seminars and masterclasses. It's an opportunity to connect with peers and learn from professionals who have navigated global markets. Speakers from organizations like Revolut, LinkedIn, Meta, and TikTok will share their experiences, offering perspectives that can help businesses grow internationally.

events.name: MoneyLive Payments Europe 2026
events.description:

Discussions will explore critical areas such as innovation in Ecommerce and Point-of-Sale, the practical application of instant and open banking, advanced strategies for countering fraud, and developments in digital identity and central bank digital currencies. The two-day event provides opportunities for participants to connect with peers. Through AI-powered matchmaking and dedicated networking sessions, attendees can build relationships and exchange ideas about the future trajectory of payments.

events.name: Cloudfest USA 2026
events.description:
Prepare for an unparalleled dive into the future of cloud innovation at Cloudfest USA 2026, taking place November 11-12, 2026, at Miami's historic Ice Palace Studios. events.name: White Label World Expo London 2026
events.description:

events.name: Ragan's Future of Communications Conference 2026

events.name: HECC Conference 2026

events.name: Future-Law Legal Tech Conference 2026

events.name: Going Global Live Los Angeles 2026

events.name: Sparkle of Hope Gala 2026
events.description:

events.name: Ecommerce Packaging & Labelling Expo London 2026
events.description:

The expo provides a setting to understand current industry trends, discover practical business solutions, and connect with influential figures in the e-commerce sector.

events.name: Baker Tilly Executive Health Care Conference 2026
events.description:

events.name: Solar & Storage Live Indonesia 2026

The gathering offers a setting for professionals to connect and explore potential collaborations within the industry.

events.name: ROME Museum Exhibition 2026

The event aims to provide insights into current developments and contribute to the ongoing advancement of our shared heritage.

events.name: Drontech Asia 2026
events.description:

events.name: PCI SSC Community Meeting Asia Pacific 2026

events.name: Education People Show 2026
