events.name: Skift Travel Commerce Summit 2026
events.description:
The Skift Travel Commerce Summit 2026, a focused one-day event on November 11 in New York City, will dissect the profound shifts rewiring the travel industry. Held at Apella by Alexandria, the summit explores the key challenges and opportunities shaping the future of travel commerce.

The event brings together VP-level and above decision-makers from airlines, hotels, online travel agencies, and global distribution systems. Discussions, informed by Skift Research, will delve into topics such as the evolving booking journey, AI's influence on customer relationships, payment infrastructure, and the regulatory changes impacting distribution.

This limited-attendance event, with a strong focus on industry operators, offers insights into how discovery, distribution, payments, and loyalty are converging. It aims to provide leaders with a clearer understanding of the evolving commerce landscape, helping them navigate its complexities strategically.

events.name: Audit and Risk 2026
events.description:
Designed for professionals committed to strengthening the housing association sector, Audit and Risk 2026 provides an essential two-day deep dive into robust governance.

This gathering takes place on 11-12 November 2026 at The Eastside Rooms in Birmingham. It offers a chance to explore how to build resilience through discussions led by experts, interactive group sessions, and opportunities for collaboration. Those attending, such as Audit and Risk Chairs, Board Members, and Heads of Risk and Assurance, will examine key areas in audit, risk management, quality governance, and assurance. The program is designed to provide practical insights and strategies, helping participants navigate complex regulatory environments and strengthen their organizations.

events.name: The New Era of Taxation 2026
events.description:
Delve into the evolving landscape of global taxation at a premier event hosted by the IBA Taxes Committee. Professionals will gather at The Westin Georgetown in Washington DC from November 11 to 13, 2026, to discuss "The New Era of Taxation." The program will explore current trends and recent developments in the field.

The agenda includes interactive roundtables and panel sessions led by experts. This event is designed for members of the International Bar Association and other taxation professionals, offering a setting for learning, engaging with colleagues, and gaining valuable perspectives on the direction of tax policy.

An early registration discount is available until October 2, 2026.

events.name: QUANTUM COMPUTING EXPO TOKYO 2026
events.description:
The forefront of computational innovation converges at QUANTUM COMPUTING EXPO TOKYO 2026, scheduled for November 11-13, 2026, at Makuhari Messe in Chiba, Japan. This specialized trade show, part of NexTech Week TOKYO 2026 Autumn, focuses on the latest advancements in quantum computing.

Professionals and leaders across manufacturing, energy, IT, medical, and government will examine new quantum technologies, their applications, hardware developments, and available consulting services. The event offers technology providers a chance to present their solutions to audiences in Japan and across Asia, encouraging new partnerships and improvements in efficiency.

Attendees can learn how quantum computing is shaping new approaches to problem-solving and expanding possibilities in various industries. Visitor registration is available at no cost, with VIP access offered to managers and those in higher positions.

events.name: Amsterdam CIO Evening Gathering Fall 2026
events.description:
Amsterdam's leading IT executives and CIOs are invited to an exclusive evening of strategic insight and unparalleled networking at the Amsterdam CIO Evening Gathering Fall 2026. GBI Impact will host this gathering on November 11, 2026, from 5:30 PM to 9:45 PM. This event is intended for a select group of professionals and their teams.

The evening will feature discussions on key trends in technology, process, and leadership, exploring strategies to gain a competitive edge. It will offer a combination of insights from industry leaders and shared best practices, fostering the development of relationships within the local IT community.

The aim is to provide a setting for expanding professional networks and refining strategic thinking, within an environment designed for meaningful connections.

events.name: TTLA Annual Meeting and CLE Seminar 2026
events.description:
Elevate your practice and champion civil justice at the TTLA Annual Meeting and CLE Seminar 2026, held November 11-13 at the Renaissance Dallas Hotel. This gathering is for Texas trial lawyers, paralegals, and new members who are committed to excelling in the courtroom. The event features a CLE Seminar designed to provide practical insights and strategies crucial for success in plaintiff's practice.

Participants will explore key topics through the seminar sessions. It's also an opportunity to connect with other TTLA members, LEAD Academy participants, and Fellowship members, building professional relationships. A TTLA Board Meeting is also planned during this time.

A discounted hotel rate is available, but the opportunity to secure this special pricing ends on October 23rd. The meeting provides a chance to enhance your skills and reinforce your dedication to protecting Texas families.

events.name: Retail Media Summit Japan 2026
events.description:
Prepare to redefine the future of retail engagement at the Retail Media Summit Japan 2026, held on November 11-12 at Bellesalle Shinjuku Grand. This event will explore the significant influence of Generative AI on consumer purchasing behavior, with discussions centered around the theme "Beyond Marketing and Commerce."

Attendees will learn how to move past traditional organizational barriers to develop better customer experiences through new retail media approaches and advanced data utilization. The summit will highlight practical AI applications and encourage genuine collaboration between manufacturers and retailers.

Admission is free with pre-registration. The event is designed for up to 1,200 attendees daily, offering an opportunity to hear from industry leaders and connect with professionals who are influencing Japan's retail sector.

events.name: Horex Kazakhstan 2026
events.description:
The 21st Kazakhstan International HOREX & CleanExpo Exhibitions, Horex Kazakhstan 2026, is set to transform the hospitality and cleaning industries in Central Asia.

This event will be held at the "Atakent" IEC in Almaty, Kazakhstan. It serves as a central gathering point for professionals interested in the latest developments and growth opportunities within these sectors.

Horex Kazakhstan 2026 will present a range of equipment, services, and solutions for hotels, restaurants, and supermarkets. Running alongside it, CleanExpo will highlight progress in professional cleaning, covering everything from detergents and laundry machines to specialized equipment. Industry professionals, including restaurateurs and hoteliers, will attend to examine new trends, take part in a forum, and connect with peers. The exhibitions are organized by ITECA and ICA Group, offering a comprehensive look at current market advancements across both the hospitality and cleaning fields.

events.name: Rio Grande Valley Birding Festival 2026
events.description:
The Rio Grande Valley Birding Festival 2026 offers an unparalleled avian adventure in southernmost Texas. Headquartered at the Harlingen Convention Center, the festival provides an opportunity for birding enthusiasts to experience the region's rich natural diversity. Participants can observe a wide variety of wintering birds and local specialties, many showing a tropical influence, within diverse habitats such as thornscrub, riverside riparian areas, mudflats, and open water.

The program includes field trips led by experts, educational seminars, and a Birder's Bazaar. Additionally, a Post Trip Photo Workshop has been introduced, offering a chance to refine photography skills. Both experienced birders and those new to the hobby will find opportunities for memorable observations and a closer appreciation of the natural world.

events.name: RISC-V Day Tokyo Autumn 2026

location.venue: The University of Tokyo, Hongo Campus

events.description:
Dive deep into the future of open-source hardware at RISC-V Day Tokyo Autumn 2026, hosted by the University of Tokyo's Hongo Campus on November 11. Organized by the RISC-V Alliance Japan, this gathering typically brings together around 400 professionals and enthusiasts. Their shared interests include RISC-V implementation, semiconductor chip prototyping, embedded systems, and AI.

The day begins with practical morning tutorials focused on digital or analog chip design, covering the process from RTL to GDS creation. In the afternoon, attendees can expect technical lectures exploring open-source EDA, AI accelerators, and AI-driven RISC-V CPU design. A main stage program will also feature international speakers.

Special exhibitions, including Google TPU v3 and a Chip Museum, will be available for exploration. It's an opportunity to connect with individuals who are influencing the future of computing.

events.name: South Central CISO & AI Transformation Assembly Dallas 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendar for November 11, 2026, as the South Central CISO & AI Transformation Assembly convenes in Dallas, Texas. This gathering brings together technology leaders and C-suite executives from leading companies. The agenda will cover current trends, new developments, and the challenges facing cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, and digital transformation.

Discussions, led by experts, will examine how AI is influencing IT and security, effective strategies for managing evolving threats, and approaches to leadership that foster growth through innovation. Participants can expect to gain a deeper understanding of building trust, navigating organizational change, and adapting to the evolving digital landscape.

The assembly provides a setting for professionals to connect with peers, collaborate on ideas, and earn CPE credits. It's an occasion to engage with others who are influencing the future of technology.

events.name: South Central CIO & AI Transformation Assembly Dallas 2026
events.description:
On November 11, 2026, the South Central CIO & AI Transformation Assembly Dallas 2026 will convene the region's most visionary technology leaders. This assembly is intended for senior technology executives, including CIOs, CDOs, and CISOs from Fortune 500 and Global 2000 companies, as they navigate the complexities of enterprise transformation.

The program features executive-led discussions exploring critical areas such as AI's impact on leadership, advanced cybersecurity strategies for 2025, and the future of tech talent. The aim is for participants to leave with practical insights into disruptive technologies and digital transformation, cultivating an environment that encourages trust and innovation.

This is an opportunity to connect with a select group of peers, share perspectives, and collaborate on solutions. CPE credits will be available. The insights and collaborations from this event will help shape the technological future of the South Central business landscape.

events.name: Dallas Post Assembly Private Dinner 2026
events.description:
Following the South Central Transformation Assembly, an exclusive gathering awaits at the Dallas Post-Assembly Private Dinner on November 11, 2026. From 6:00 PM to 9:30 PM, C-suite executives and leaders from Fortune 500 and Global 2000 companies will gather in Dallas, Texas.

This 5-star gourmet dinner offers a chance for intimate conversations among peers. Attendees, including top technology and cybersecurity professionals, will discuss current trends, innovations, and pressing challenges within the IT, Cybersecurity, and Data fields. The evening provides an environment for collaboration, strengthening professional connections, and exchanging insights that help move business technology forward.

events.name: XR ＆ Metaverse Fair Tokyo [Autumn] 2026
events.description:
Step into the future of industrial innovation at the XR ＆ Metaverse Fair Tokyo [Autumn] 2026, officially known as INDUSTRIAL XR APPLICATIONS EXPO TOKYO. This event takes place from November 11 to 13, 2026, at Makuhari Messe, as part of NexTech Week TOKYO. It focuses on how XR solutions can advance digital transformation, bringing together virtual and physical environments for industrial use.

Attendees will see the newest XR devices and immersive content designed for VR training, knowledge transfer, and safety education. The fair also highlights XR combined with AI solutions and spatial computing. These technologies are transforming design, simulation, and on-site operations in sectors such as manufacturing, construction, and logistics.

The event provides a setting to observe how innovators are applying these tools to enhance efficiency and foster new approaches within various enterprises.

events.name: Dental Expo Samara 2026
events.description:
Set to illuminate the future of oral healthcare, Dental Expo Samara 2026 invites dental professionals to its 29th Interregional Specialized Exhibition-Forum from November 11-13, 2026. This exhibition takes place at EC "Expo-Volga" in Samara and is recognized as the leading event for dentistry throughout the Volga Federal District. It receives official support from the Ministry of Health of the Samara region and partners with organizations such as the Russian Dental Association.

The forum provides a setting for professionals to engage with new ideas and developments. Participants will find the latest advancements, innovative solutions, and emerging technologies that are important for the region's evolving dental industry. This event offers a chance for clinics to improve their services, adopt new practices, and build relationships within the professional community.

events.name: Brand Week Istanbul 2026
events.description:
Prepare to redefine your understanding of the future at Brand Week Istanbul 2026, taking place in November in the vibrant city of Istanbul, Turkey. The event centers on the "Brand New World" theme, exploring significant shifts across technology, culture, health, economy, and business models. Participants will gain a clearer understanding of how to navigate this evolving landscape.

Experts from around the world will share their perspectives on trends shaping the future. Across various sessions, from the Inspiration Hall to the Master Hall, attendees can explore new ideas and connect with peers.

Brand Week Istanbul 2026 offers a perspective for those looking to understand and adapt to a fast-evolving global landscape.

events.name: Business of Apps Berlin 2026
events.description:
The app economy's premier gathering, Business of Apps Berlin 2026, is set to ignite growth strategies on November 12, 2026, at Berlin's Estrel. This event, previously known as App Promotion Summit, focuses on app development by bringing together professionals in app marketing, growth, product, CRM, and revenue.

Participants will explore key topics such as integrating AI into app marketing, enhancing retention strategies, fostering product-led growth, and understanding privacy-focused User Acquisition 2.0. With plans for a larger venue and an expanded marketplace, the day offers opportunities for networking, practical knowledge from various presentations, and a look at new tools.

Over 700 industry professionals are expected to attend, with the aim of helping them refine their app strategies and grow their operations.

events.name: Houston Cybersecurity Summit 2026
events.description:
Prepare for a day of unparalleled insights at the 8th Annual Houston Cybersecurity Summit 2026. This full-day event, hosted by CyberRisk Alliance, is designed for cybersecurity, IT, and information security practitioners, including CISOs and senior leaders. Discussions will cover key topics like AI and emerging technology risks, strengthening supply chain defenses, and integrating security with business objectives.

The program includes strategic discussions, interactive panels, and solution showcases, all within a professional hotel environment. Attendees will have opportunities to connect with hundreds of fellow professionals, hear from expert speakers sharing practical insights, and earn CEU/CPE credits. The goal is to help organizations enhance their resilience, mitigate risks, and achieve strategic business outcomes.

events.name: NAPABA Convention 2026
events.description:
The NAPABA Convention 2026 invites legal professionals to Los Angeles, California, from November 12 to 15. This year's gathering is expected to be the largest in its history, bringing together attorneys, judges, law professors, and students from across the Asian Pacific American legal community.

Held at the JW Marriott LA Live and Hotel Indigo Los Angeles Downtown, the convention offers a significant opportunity for professional development and community engagement. Attendees will have the chance to explore meaningful insights, build connections, and gain new perspectives on the evolving legal landscape.

The four days will feature discussions, strategic connections, and a celebration of the legal profession.

events.name: Beyond Activ Americas 2026
events.description:
Uniting leaders, investors, and innovators across the Health, Active Lifestyle, and Outdoors (HALO) industry, Beyond Activ Americas 2026 offers an unparalleled experience at the Hilton Anatole Dallas from November 12-13.

This gathering is for owners, managers, and investors involved with health, wellness, fitness, and sports brands, bringing together an anticipated 1,500 executives. Discussions will cover essential subjects such as company investment strategies, evolving consumer behaviors, the practical uses of AI, and emerging business models. Attendees will also consider the direction of preventative health and hospitality focused on well-being.

The event's structure, designed like a festival, incorporates specialized summits, presentations from over 100 speakers, and an exhibition area. There will be more than 10 hours dedicated to networking, including opportunities for one-on-one discussions. The program also features an Awards Reception to acknowledge achievements within the industry. Participants can identify new investment areas in fitness, as well as prospects related to longevity and recovery.

events.name: Guru Conference 2026
events.description:
Unlock the full potential of your email marketing strategies at Guru Conference 2026, the globe's premier virtual event for marketers. Constant Contact presents this complimentary two-day conference on November 12-13, 2026, an event that typically draws over 29,000 professionals.

The agenda covers a wide range of topics, including AI, ChatGPT, email deliverability, data analysis, metrics, and current trends in copy and design. Professionals working in B2B, B2C, or e-commerce will find practical guidance. The sessions aim to help attendees explore new platforms and refine their strategies for improved campaign results.

The conference offers insights into the evolving landscape of digital communication. It provides an opportunity to understand current developments and maintain a competitive edge.

events.name: Mif Expo 2026
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the heart of French excellence at the premier event celebrating "Made in France" manufacturing. From November 12 to 15, 2026, Paris – Porte de Versailles will be the location for Mif Expo, an event that highlights French craftsmanship and innovation.

This four-day exhibition gathers 1,000 exhibitors, providing a chance to discover and purchase French-made products. The range of items covers many areas, including fashion, beauty, home decor, gourmet food, technology, and tourism. With an anticipated attendance of over 110,000 people, Mif Expo 2026 offers a comprehensive look at the quality and creativity found within French industry.

events.name: Africa Stablecoin Summit 2026
events.description:
Driving Africa's economic resilience through digital innovation, the Africa Stablecoin Summit 2026 convenes on November 12-13. This executive gathering brings together C-suite leaders, central bankers, regulators, stablecoin issuers, and finance professionals from across Africa and other regions.

Discussions will center on "Harnessing Stablecoins for Africa’s Economic Resilience." The summit will foster thoughtful policy conversations, highlight African innovations, and present practical applications of stablecoins in areas like payments, treasury management, and cross-border trade. Participants will engage in keynote presentations, private regulatory roundtables, and insights from select startups.

The event seeks to build high-level public-private partnerships, aiming to accelerate the adoption of trusted digital currencies and contribute to shaping Africa's digital finance future.

events.name: Paris Photo 2026
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the world's premier celebration of photography as Paris Photo 2026 returns to the iconic Grand Palais from November 12 to 15. This significant international art fair brings together leading galleries, publishers, and artists from around the world.

Attendees will encounter a wide range of photographic art, from established works in the Main sector to new digital creations and the work of emerging artists.

The program features thoughtful 'Conversations,' the 'Elles × Paris Photo' initiative, and the PhotoBook Awards. These elements collectively present a dynamic view of photography, addressing contemporary themes, celebrating diverse expressions, and exploring new artistic frontiers.

events.name: SpiceWorld 2026

location.venue: AT&T Executive Education and Conference Center

events.description:
Austin, Texas, will host the premier gathering for IT professionals this November. SpiceWorld 2026 will take place on November 12–13 at the AT&T Center. This two-day conference offers a focused environment for IT professionals to enhance their expertise. Discussions will cover critical areas such as AI & Emerging Tech, Cloud & Infrastructure, Security, Software & OS, and both Organizational and Human Intelligence.

Attendees will have opportunities to engage with peers and industry leaders, gaining new perspectives and exploring practical solutions. The event is structured to provide essential IT knowledge that can be applied to improve operations and support professional growth. It's a chance to interact with experts from leading tech brands and establish valuable connections within the IT community.

events.name: German Nursing Day 2026
events.description:
Germany's premier gathering for nursing professionals, the German Nursing Day 2026, invites you to hub27 for an unparalleled exploration of the sector's future. This congress aims to provide current perspectives and facilitate networking among professionals.

The program will focus on "Digitale Pflege" (Digital Nursing), exploring innovations that are changing patient care and improving efficiency. A separate "Care Culture Congress" will discuss approaches for creating supportive and effective care settings. An online program will also be available, allowing participants to customize their experience.

The event offers an opportunity to connect with leaders in the field, learn about new practices, and contribute to the ongoing development of nursing in Germany.

events.name: Global AI Show 2026
events.description:
Prepare for the Middle East's most powerful AI event as the Global AI Show 2026 descends upon Abu Dhabi's Space42 Arena from November 18-19. This two-day summit is for over 6,000 enterprise leaders, founders, investors, and government representatives who are focused on implementing AI solutions at scale.

Participants will explore the full spectrum of AI, from advanced infrastructure and generative systems to critical discussions on ethical AI, cybersecurity, and energy applications. The event will feature insights from over 150 expert speakers and demonstrations from more than 100 exhibitors.

In addition to the main program, AI-powered matchmaking will be available, alongside an exclusive afterparty at a palace. These elements are designed to create meaningful connections and discussions that can influence the direction of artificial intelligence.

events.name: NewYorkCISO ORBIE Awards 2026
events.description:
New York's premier recognition program for C-suite leaders, the NewYorkCISO ORBIE Awards 2026, is set to celebrate the region's most impactful Chief Information Security Officers. The awards acknowledge Chief Information Security Officers who show remarkable innovation, build competitive advantage, motivate their teams, and use technology strategically to meet business objectives.

The recognition process begins with the ORBIE Leadership Reception on July 23 at ICONIQ, where all nominees are recognized. Finalists are then invited to a reception and dinner on October 7 at Sunset Terrace, a gathering that provides an opportunity to connect with the leading candidates.

The program concludes with an Awards Ceremony on November 12 at the Ziegfeld Ballroom. This event brings together C-suite leaders, senior technology executives, and trusted partners, offering a setting for connection, shared learning, and celebrating the visionaries who are shaping the future of New York's leading organizations.

events.name: CISO Atlanta Summit November 2026
events.description:
Addressing the escalating stakes in cybersecurity, the CISO Atlanta Summit convenes on November 12, 2026, in Atlanta, Georgia. This one-day event brings together senior security leaders, CISOs, and other key decision-makers. It's a chance for them to connect and share insights with peers.

The day centers around the theme "Transforming Security: Insight and Resilience for a New Era." Discussions will cover practical approaches to defending against evolving threats, securing global supply chains, and navigating complex regulations. Participants will explore new technologies and strategies for building strong, resilient teams, drawing on the experiences of leaders and industry experts.

The summit provides focused discussions and opportunities for direct interaction. The content is designed to offer immediate, actionable insights that executives can use to protect important assets and encourage innovation. The day concludes with a reception, allowing for continued informal conversations among attendees.

events.name: EXPOMANT 2026
events.description:
Prepare to advance your maintenance strategies at EXPOMANT 2026, the leading technology fair dedicated to industrial and mining maintenance solutions. The fair will take place alongside the 25th Peruvian Congress of Maintenance Engineering and the 2nd International Congress of Mining Maintenance.

Visitors can explore over 90 exhibits featuring new technologies and participate in more than 150 conferences. Discussions will cover critical areas such as Predictive Maintenance, Digital Transformation, Maintenance 4.0, Asset Management, and Reliability Engineering.

The event expects over 1450 participants from more than 15 countries. Held at the Centro de Exposiciones Jockey, it offers an opportunity to connect with peers, hear from industry experts, and understand emerging trends in operational efficiency.

events.name: Minnesota’s Tekne Awards 2026
events.description:
The Minnesota Technology Association (MnTech) invites the community to celebrate groundbreaking achievements at the Tekne Awards 2026, the state's premier recognition of technological excellence and innovation. This year, the awards introduce new categories: Innovation Advocacy Leadership, Tech Accessibility Leadership, and Tech Team or Company of the Year. These additions aim to recognize individuals and organizations making a substantial impact and fostering ethical progress within Minnesota's technology community.

Nominations will be accepted starting June 2nd and conclude on September 13th, followed by a thorough selection process. Those recognized will receive personalized award presentations, which will be documented and shared online. The awards will culminate in a special recognition ceremony at the annual MnTech Elevate event on November 12, 2026. The Tekne Awards highlight the individuals and teams who are driving innovation and progress in Minnesota's technology landscape.

events.name: ADZINE CONNECT VIDEO 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendar for ADZINE CONNECT VIDEO 2026, the leading specialist conference for digital video and (C)TV advertising in the German-speaking market. On November 12, the event will take place in Hamburg, where industry experts will gather to explore the future of video.

The agenda will examine key themes such as the attention economy, advanced cross-media measurement, and CTV targeting enhanced by AI. Discussions will cover strategies for programmatic advertising in CTV, methods for addressing ad fraud, and approaches to optimizing video content across linear TV, streaming, and DOOH.

This conference brings together marketing decision-makers, media professionals, and technology specialists. It provides opportunities for professional exchange and allows attendees to engage with leaders who are influencing the evolving video landscape.

events.name: NODES 2026
events.description:
Prepare for a full day of innovation as NODES 2026, the free 24-hour global virtual conference, convenes on November 12. The conference, hosted by Neo4j, focuses on "Engineering Better Intelligence" and gathers developers, data professionals, architects, and AI engineers from around the globe.

Attendees can participate in live sessions, lightning talks, and interactive Q&As, with content scheduled to accommodate all major time zones. The program explores AI engineering, including generative AI, RAG, and multi-agent systems. Discussions will also cover building modern applications across various tech stacks and using knowledge graphs to provide deeper context for data.

Content is designed for various experience levels, encouraging connections and shared learning among a global community.

events.name: THE Campus Live UK & IE 2026
events.description:
Prepare for a forward-looking exploration into the future of higher education at THE Campus Live UK & IE 2026. University leaders, academics, and professionals from across the UK and Ireland will gather, creating opportunities for collaboration and shared understanding.

Discussions will focus on key areas such as student success, new teaching methods, and how data can inform institutional strategies. This gathering offers a chance to share effective practices, identify new developments, and build connections within the higher education community. The aim is to collectively shape the next era of learning and student experience.

Further details, including specific dates, location, and the full agenda, will be shared soon.

events.name: ADWEEK House Commerce Summit 2026
events.description:
Step into the future of retail and digital engagement at the ADWEEK House Commerce Summit 2026, convening on November 12 in Los Angeles, CA. The summit examines how technology is reshaping commerce and social media. It will explore the impact of rapid innovation on consumer behavior and market dynamics, providing a clearer understanding of what's ahead for 2027.

The event brings together marketers, creators, retailers, platforms, and technology innovators. Participants will hear from industry leaders, learn about new strategies, and connect with peers who are shaping the future of digital commerce. The ADWEEK House Commerce Summit offers a space to understand current trends and prepare for changes in the digital landscape.

events.name: Houston Ballet Nutcracker Market 2026
events.description:
Prepare for the enchanting return of the Houston Ballet Nutcracker Market in November 2026, transforming NRG Center into a vibrant holiday shopping destination! This annual tradition welcomes over 100,000 people, providing an occasion to discover unique gifts and festive items from a carefully chosen selection of merchants.

Every purchase directly supports the Houston Ballet's artistic and educational programs. Beyond the main shopping floor, visitors can enhance their experience with special events such as the Preview Party and fashion show luncheons.

The market brings together thousands of dedicated volunteers and enthusiastic shoppers, marking a memorable start to the holiday season and celebrating community and the arts.

events.name: CRN Channel Awards UK 2026
events.description:
The UK IT channel's most prestigious night returns on 12 November 2026, as the CRN Channel Awards UK celebrates its 33rd year at the iconic Battersea Evolution, London. This evening acknowledges the significant contributions and innovative work from vendors, resellers, and distributors nationwide.

Industry experts serve as independent judges, identifying companies that are truly advancing the field—whether through AI-powered cybersecurity solutions or pioneering sustainability initiatives. Beyond the recognition, the evening also offers live entertainment, dinner, and engaging activities like games and dodgems.

This gathering provides a setting for the channel community to connect and celebrate the year's accomplishments.

events.name: China International Pet and Aquarium Exhibition 2026

location.venue: China lmport and Export Fair Complex

events.description:
The 30th China International Pet Show (CIPS 2026) invites global pet and aquatic industry professionals to Guangzhou, China, from November 12-15, 2026. This gathering takes place at Area B, China Import and Export Fair Complex. It serves as a significant meeting point for those looking to source products and understand the evolving landscape of the Asian market.

Participants can expect to see the newest developments across pet grooming, aquatic life, and e-commerce. The program includes the PANGOL Cup Global Grooming Conference, which brings together leading professionals in the field. There will also be Aquatic Industry Conventions offering in-depth discussions, alongside the Global Pet Industry E-commerce Conference, where omnichannel strategies will be a key topic. Additionally, the International Aquascaping Contest will showcase creative talent.

The event provides a setting for professionals to connect, share insights, and explore avenues for business development within the industry.

events.name: ACAAI Annual Scientific Meeting 2026
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the forefront of allergy, asthma, and immunology at the ACAAI Annual Scientific Meeting 2026, taking place November 12-16 in vibrant Phoenix, Arizona. The theme, "Building Bridges for the Future," will guide a program focused on education and scientific advancements that directly impact clinical practice.

Attendees will have the opportunity to explore new and varied approaches to practice, gaining insights that could influence the future of the field. It's a chance to engage with leading experts, learn about the latest research, and connect with colleagues who are committed to improving patient outcomes.

Registration for this meeting opens in Summer 2026.

events.name: Digital Government Summit Washington 2026
events.description:
Public sector leaders seeking to drive transformative change are invited to the Digital Government Summit Washington 2026, taking place on November 12, 2026, at the Greater Tacoma Convention Center. This gathering is exclusively for state and local government professionals, offering a dedicated space to explore new technologies and discuss strategies for modernizing operations.

Discussions will cover critical areas including cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, data governance, and digital service delivery. Participants can connect with peers, engage in collaborative discussions, and gain practical insights to address current challenges.

Eligible public sector participants can register for free, gaining access to perspectives from industry leaders and partners focused on digital government advancements.

events.name: TCI Expo 2026
events.description:
From November 11-14, 2026, Ft. Lauderdale, Florida, will host TCI Expo, the tree care industry's premier gathering. Thousands of professionals, arborists, and business owners will gather to explore new educational opportunities, see the latest equipment, and connect with colleagues. The program includes 29 education sessions, 46 demonstrations on the trade show floor, and 3 pre-conference workshops, with expanded opportunities for Spanish-language content.

A significant part of the experience is the TCI EXPODemo, an outdoor space with views of the Intracoastal Waterway. Here, attendees can observe live demonstrations and engage in hands-on learning. Safety is a key focus, reinforced by updated standards and exhibitor audits. This environment allows individuals to explore new innovations that can help their businesses grow and support career development. It's an opportunity to connect with peers, exchange ideas, and gain insights from those influencing the future of tree care.

events.name: Product Marketing Summit Toronto 2026

location.venue: Marriott Downtown at CF Toronto Eaton Centre

events.description:
Elevate your product marketing strategy at the Product Marketing Summit Toronto 2026, set for November 12 & 13. Over two days, more than 150 senior product marketing decision-makers and innovators will convene to explore the evolving landscape of product marketing.

Attendees will examine strategies for leveraging AI and automation, refining go-to-market playbooks, and enhancing cross-functional collaboration. The program includes insights from over 25 expert speakers and opportunities to participate in practical workshops. These sessions cover topics ranging from building custom GPTs to developing scalable content strategies.

There will be opportunities to connect with peers and acquire practical insights. These discussions and learnings aim to help demonstrate product marketing's impact and support market entry strategies. The event provides a forum for professionals to consider new approaches and refine existing strategies within product marketing.

events.name: Simed 2026

location.venue: Palacio de Ferias y Congresos de Malaga

events.description:
From November 12th to 14th, 2026, the FYCMA – Palacio de Ferias y Congresos de Málaga will host Simed 2026, the essential gathering for anyone interested in the Spanish real estate market. This event brings together more than 9,000 new and second-hand properties from Málaga and across Spain, all in one location, offering a straightforward way to explore a wide range of real estate options.

Attendees will find it easy to move between the sales offices of many different developers and real estate companies, simplifying their search for a property. events.name: Solarplaza Summit Finland 2026

These discussions will occur in executive roundtables, general sessions, and smaller group discussions. The day offers practical tools and training, an opportunity to share effective approaches, and a chance to build professional connections. These elements are intended to help enhance an organization's strategic capabilities, fostering learning, connection, and innovation within the supply chain field.

events.name: North America CloudAxis Cloud Infrastructure & Platform Hosted in Dallas 2026
events.description:
An invitation-only gathering for North America's senior technology leaders, the CloudAxis Cloud Infrastructure & Platform event takes place in Dallas on November 12, 2026. It's a day for CIOs, CTOs, and VPs of Infrastructure & Operations to come together, share strategic insights, and collaborate with their peers.

The discussions will center on critical topics shaping the future of enterprise technology. These include building AI-ready cloud infrastructure, mastering hybrid and multi-cloud strategies, and modernizing through platform engineering and automation. Conversations will also address Cloud FinOps, intelligent infrastructure operations with AIOps, and robust cloud security.

Attendees will have opportunities to learn from leading experts and connect with others in similar roles. The day offers a space to explore how new approaches and solutions can drive innovation within their organizations.

events.name: NASCUS Legal Symposium 2026
events.description:
Set against the vibrant backdrop of New Orleans, the NASCUS Legal Symposium 2026 offers a vital forum for legal minds shaping the credit union system. This 1½-day in-person symposium will take place at The Royal Sonesta New Orleans from November 12–13, 2026. It is designed for agency general counsel, credit union counsel, and private practitioners.

The program will explore important subjects such as cyber insurance, developments in stablecoins, updates to the Uniform Commercial Code, and current litigation trends. Participants can expect to gain practical insights through focused sessions and opportunities for peer exchange. It also provides a valuable setting for connecting with regulatory agencies and credit unions, sharing different viewpoints, and fostering professional relationships.

Given the limited capacity, registration for this event closes on November 11. Attending offers a chance to engage in meaningful discussions and further one's professional development.

events.name: Dickens Christmas Show & Festivals 2026
events.description:
Prepare for an enchanting holiday experience at the Dickens Christmas Show & Festivals 2026, a national award-winning Shopper's Marketplace set to captivate Myrtle Beach, South Carolina.

This annual event brings a festive atmosphere to the city, where visitors can explore a wide range of items and engage with holiday traditions. The marketplace gathers numerous businesses, artists, makers, and specialty shops, offering a diverse selection of goods suitable for holiday preparations and gifts.

A distinctive feature is the 'Vendor Mall in the Sky,' an online space where people can preview exhibitors from previous years and those joining for 2026. Leisure Time Unlimited, Inc. owns and operates this festival, which offers a chance to experience the holiday season and find a variety of goods.

events.name: Board Development and Responsibilities Conference 2026
events.description:
Elevate your leadership and strategic impact within the credit union sector at the Board Development and Responsibilities Conference 2026. The conference will be held from November 12 to 15 in Scottsdale, Arizona, at the Kimpton Miralina Resort & Villas. It is designed for credit union board members, executives, and emerging leaders who are focused on strengthening their governance knowledge.

Organized by CU Conferences, the event will offer specific insights and practical strategies to help navigate the changing responsibilities within the credit union sector. Participants can expect to acquire tools that will assist them in better serving members, building institutional resilience, and fostering sustainable growth.

This important conference will feature discussions focused on the future and sessions led by experts, designed to help leaders operate with increased confidence and effectiveness. A detailed agenda will be shared in due course.

events.name: North America DataAxis CDAO & AI Assembly Hosted in Dallas 2026
events.description:
An exclusive, invitation-only gathering for North America's leading Chief Data & Analytics Officers, AI executives, and senior cybersecurity leaders will convene in Dallas on November 12, 2026. This full-day assembly will feature interactive sessions, where participants can delve into critical challenges and innovative solutions shaping the current data and AI landscape.

The discussions will cover essential topics, including securing enterprise AI, building trusted AI governance, modernizing cloud security, and strengthening cyber resilience. This event offers top-tier executives—such as CIOs, CSOs, and CROs—an opportunity to connect with their peers, exchange perspectives, and collectively advance their approaches to business transformation through data and AI strategies.

events.name: Elite CIO/CISO Toronto 2026
events.description:
Toronto hosts this edition of Elite B2B Events' CIO/CISO series on 12 November 2026, aimed at technology leadership from large enterprises — CIOs, CISOs, CTOs and VP or director-level executives.

Elite builds these evenings around conversation rather than content. There are no panels or keynote presentations. The standard shape of the night is cocktails and hors d'oeuvres, then timed networking rounds pairing attendees with participating technology partners, then a prize giveaway and dinner, wrapping up around 9:00pm.

Capacity is limited by design, and the organizer positions the guest list as exclusively senior technology decision-makers. Participating vendors are not published ahead of the event. Venue details for the Toronto edition have not been announced.

events.name: USA Family Office Conference 2026
events.description:
An unparalleled gathering for the global family office community awaits at the USA Family Office Conference 2026, taking place on Thursday, November 12, in luxurious Beverly Hills, USA. The Global Family Office Community (GFOC) is hosting this full-day event, primarily for its members. Single Family Offices from Asia, Europe, California, and the broader USA are also welcome, with attendance subject to approval.

The agenda, developed with input from family offices themselves, will feature presentations and discussions led by experts and partner specialists. Attendees can expect opportunities for peer-to-peer learning, knowledge sharing, and connecting with others.

The conference aims to foster community and address the unique challenges and opportunities within the family office landscape. The goal is for attendees to leave with practical insights and expanded professional connections.

events.name: Circular Valley Forum 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for the Circular Valley Forum 2026, a crucial gathering dedicated to advancing the global Circular Economy. The Circular Valley Foundation will host this event on November 13, 2026. It will bring together leading minds from various sectors, including decision-makers and experts from industry, science, politics, and civil society, alongside innovative startups from the Circular Valley Accelerator program.

The forum is designed to encourage meaningful interactions and direct discussions among participants. Attendees will examine key challenges and explore new opportunities within the Circular Economy, with the goal of developing practical solutions. This environment aims to foster collaboration across different countries and industries.

Ultimately, the forum helps participants contribute to a more sustainable and resource-efficient future. It is particularly relevant for individuals committed to accelerating the transition to circularity.

events.name: NewYorkCIO ORBIE Awards 2026
events.description:
New York's premier recognition program for C-suite technology leaders culminates at the NewYorkCIO ORBIE Awards 2026. On November 13, 2026, at 8:15 AM, the Ziegfeld Ballroom will host the awards ceremony. This event honors Chief Information Officers who demonstrate exceptional innovation, create competitive advantages, inspire their teams, and strategically use technology to drive business success.

This gathering brings together CIOs, executive leaders, and senior technology professionals from New York's leading organizations. Those attending will experience the live announcement of the 2026 ORBIE Award winners, connect with influential industry figures, and acknowledge significant achievements in technology leadership.

Leading up to the main event, an intimate Finalist Reception and Dinner is scheduled for October 8. This evening offers a refined dining experience and provides a setting for meaningful connections among the region's top technology talent.

events.name: Digital Assets Forum New York 2026
events.description:
The institutional digital assets landscape is rapidly evolving, and the premier event to navigate its complexities is fast approaching. On November 13, 2026, the Digital Assets Forum New York will bring together industry leaders in New York City. This forum is intended for fund managers, allocators, and professionals representing major financial institutions and digital asset firms.

Participants can expect to gain insights from over 50 sessions presented across two stages. Speakers include Anthony Scaramucci (SkyBridge Capital), Sandy Kaul (Franklin Templeton), Adam Back (Blockstream), Kathleen Wrynn (Invesco), and Nikhil Sharma (BlackRock). Beyond the discussions, the forum provides opportunities for connection, such as through an AI-powered application, scheduled one-on-one meetings, and a VIP evening. An exhibition area will showcase various solutions, and there will be occasions to connect with peers who are influencing the direction of digital finance.

events.name: WiTWA Tech [+] Awards 2026
events.description:
An evening of unparalleled celebration awaits at the WiTWA Tech [+] Awards 2026!

On November 13, 2026, beginning at 6:00 PM, the Western Australian tech community will gather to recognize the exceptional women and their allies who are leading innovation and progress within the sector.

The five-hour evening includes a seated dinner, beverages, and a Welcome to Country. A central part of the night will be the presentation of the WiTWA Tech [+] Awards across all categories. Guests are invited to dress elegantly for an evening designed for connection, enjoyment, and dancing with a DJ.

This gathering brings together emerging leaders, established industry figures, and a diverse group of individuals within an inclusive and inspiring setting. The focus remains on celebrating the achievements in Western Australia's technology sector.

events.name: Franchise Expo West 2026

location.venue: Renaissance Phoenix Glendale Hotel & Conference Center

events.description:
Aspiring entrepreneurs and prospective business owners are invited to explore a world of opportunity at Franchise Expo West 2026. This gathering brings together over 150 franchise brands from various industries, offering a direct way to meet with franchisors.

Individuals attending can explore different business models and current trends. They will have the chance to learn the core principles of successful franchise ownership through a series of seminars and workshops, and receive guidance from experts on establishing an independent business.

Whether someone is considering a smaller initial investment or a larger growth-oriented enterprise, Franchise Expo West 2026 provides resources and connections to support their entrepreneurial aspirations.

events.name: World Strategic Forum 2026
events.description:
The 15th Edition of the World Strategic Forum 2026, presented by the International Economic Forum of the Americas (IEFA), invites global decision-makers to a crucial two-day summit. The forum will be held on November 16-17, 2026, at the Loews Coral Gables Hotel in Coral Gables, Florida. It brings together leaders in diplomacy, business, and innovation.

Representatives from government, business, and civil society will gather for high-level discussions. The agenda focuses on critical challenges and opportunities influencing the global economy's future, particularly within the Americas. Attendees can expect to gain valuable insights, form strategic partnerships, and contribute to practical solutions for a changing world.

events.name: Classic Motor Show 2026
events.description:
Prepare for the UK's ultimate classic motoring celebration at the Classic Motor Show 2026, spanning seven NEC halls in Birmingham from November 13-15.

The event brings together over 3,000 classic cars and bikes, ranging from pre-war vehicles to 1990s icons. These are presented by 310 dedicated motoring clubs, each sharing their passion for automotive history and preservation.

Visitors can explore offerings from more than 450 specialist traders and browse the UK’s largest AutoJumble. For those interested in acquiring a classic, over 600 vehicles will be available for sale, including those featured in Iconic Auctioneers' Super Auction. The show also introduces new areas such as the Military Vehicle Showcase and the Modified Masters display. Attendees will have opportunities to interact with experts at the Meet the Experts Theatre, enjoy activities suitable for families, and see appearances by Richard Hammond and Mike Brewer. It is an occasion for those who appreciate and wish to engage with the rich legacy of motoring.

events.name: Women in Finance Summit 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for the Women in Finance Summit 2026, taking place on Friday, 13 November at the Hyatt Regency, Sydney.

This event gathers professionals from banking, broking, financial advice, fintech, and the wider financial services industry. The program is structured around four core themes: Resilience, Leadership, Growth, and Partnership. Attendees will find practical insights and opportunities for open conversations about navigating industry challenges and advancing their careers. A key element is the Business Exchange Network, a structured session designed to help participants build connections and identify new opportunities.

Running alongside the summit are the Women in Finance Awards, which acknowledge achievements and innovation in the sector. Whether someone is early in their career or holds a senior executive role, the summit provides a setting to connect with peers and gain knowledge relevant to their professional journey.

events.name: APTA Pediatrics Annual Conference 2026
events.description:
Elevate your practice and connect with leaders in pediatric physical therapy at the APTA Pediatrics Annual Conference 2026. From November 13-15, 2026, St. Louis, MO, will host this essential gathering for pediatric physical therapists, professionals, and students dedicated to advancing excellence in the field.

The conference offers a space to share new research, discuss innovative clinical approaches, and gain valuable educational perspectives. Those attending will participate in educational sessions, review a variety of poster presentations, and learn from platform abstracts. Professionals also have the opportunity to contribute by submitting proposals for educational sessions by April 27, 2026; abstract submissions will open in Spring 2026.

This gathering provides a chance for colleagues to collaborate, refine their skills, and collectively influence the future direction of pediatric physical therapy.

events.name: Wellington Property People Awards 2026
events.description:
Prepare for an evening of unparalleled recognition and celebration as the Wellington Property People Awards 2026 returns to the Tākina Convention & Exhibition Centre on Friday 13 November. Property Council New Zealand hosts this event, which highlights the talent, dedication, and leadership shaping the region's property sector.

The evening begins at 6:30 pm, focusing on recognizing exceptional individuals and project teams. These honorees represent various disciplines, including development, design, engineering, and property management. With Colliers as Principal Partner, the ceremony will acknowledge achievements in categories like Young Achiever, Sustainability Champion, and the Supreme Excellence Award.

This gathering offers a chance to connect with colleagues, acknowledge industry pioneers, and celebrate the innovation that defines Wellington's built environment.

events.name: Omnissa ONE APJ 2026
events.description:
Omnissa ONE APJ 2026 invites End-User Computing leaders and the broader EUC community to Tokyo on November 13 for a day of unparalleled insight and innovation. As part of a global series, this gathering will focus on the significant changes happening in how we manage endpoints, use AI, and keep digital work secure.

Those attending can expect to gain new insights and hear directly from customers about their experiences. The discussions will delve into innovations that are reshaping the autonomous workspace. There will be breakout sessions led by experts, opportunities to develop practical skills in instructor-led labs, and live demonstrations showcasing real-world applications.

This event offers a chance to connect with industry leaders, peers, and partners, fostering collaboration and helping to shape the future of End-User Computing.

events.name: Queen City Conference 2026
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the world of cybersecurity at the Queen City Conference 2026, taking place from November 13th to 15th in Cincinnati, Ohio. This three-day conference, hosted by Cannon Fodder Security Inc., is for professionals, students, and enthusiasts across information security, ethical hacking, and IT.

Attendees can expect a program featuring insights from expert speakers, practical hands-on workshops, and focused breakout sessions. The event will also include specialized areas, referred to as "villages." One such area is dedicated to career development, offering assistance with resumes and providing mock interviews.

Opportunities for connecting with others include themed networking spaces, social gatherings, and Capture The Flag competitions. The Queen City Conference 2026 aims to create an inclusive setting where individuals can learn, develop professionally, and build relationships within the information security community.

events.name: DevOpsDays Barcelona 2026

location.venue: BAU · College of Arts & Design Barcelona

events.description:
Dive into the heart of DevOps innovation at DevOpsDays Barcelona 2026, taking place November 13-14 at BAU, Centre Universitari d'Arts i Disseny. This two-day gathering brings together professionals at every stage of their career, creating a space for both local and international communities to share insights on improving IT practices.

Participants will explore current developments in automation, cloud technology, security, and organizational change. The program includes keynote presentations from industry leaders, alongside "Open Spaces" where attendees can lead discussions on topics important to them. Dedicated time is also available for connecting with peers.

The aim is for participants to leave with fresh perspectives on tools, new ideas, and collaborative strategies that can enhance their work and contribute to the broader DevOps community.

events.name: AASCU Annual Conference for Presidents and Chancellors 2026
events.description:
Higher education leaders are invited to convene at the AASCU Annual Conference for Presidents and Chancellors 2026, set for November 13-16 in picturesque Savannah, GA. The conference will explore 'Beacons of Hope: Regional Public Universities Delivering America’s Promise,' examining how these institutions drive social mobility, align with workforce needs, and contribute to economic strength.

Participants will have opportunities to discuss national trends, exchange ideas on leadership challenges, and build professional connections. The program includes plenary sessions with speakers such as Laura J. Richardson and Charles L. Welch, complemented by sessions designed for thoughtful reflection.

Beyond the formal discussions, there will be chances for informal networking, including a sunset riverboat cruise and tours of historic Savannah. This gathering offers a significant opportunity to contribute to the ongoing development of public higher education.

events.name: Food & Drinks by Detrop 2026
events.description:
Set to ignite the culinary and hospitality sectors, Food & Drinks by Detrop 2026 invites professionals to the Thessaloniki International Exhibition & Congress Center from November 13-15. This event, held alongside Philoxenia – Hotelia, brings together the tourism, food service, and hospitality industries, creating a central point for professionals to connect and discuss developments.

Visitors can explore various dedicated areas. These include "All About Café," offering insights into coffee, "The Pairing Bar," the "Food Experts’ Awards – FEA," and the "Gastronomy Experience." These features provide a comprehensive look at current trends and innovations.

The gathering allows professionals to observe emerging trends, meet others in their field, and understand new possibilities within the market.

events.name: International Conference on Cardiology 2026
events.description:
The 6th International Conference on Cardiology 2026 is set to convene at the Grand Mercure Bangkok Atrium in Bangkok, Thailand, on November 13, 2026. Focused on 'Exploring New Horizons in Cardiology and Research,' the conference brings together global experts to discuss recent advancements and future paths in cardiovascular science.

The scientific program will offer a broad range of topics, with contributions from an Organizing Committee made up of leading professionals from international institutions. Researchers and clinicians are invited to submit abstracts and register, providing a chance to share their current findings and build collaborations. This gathering is intended for cardiologists, academics, and industry professionals who are committed to advancing cardiac care and research.

events.name: Crypto & Digital Assets Conference 2026
events.description:
Explore the evolving frontier of digital finance at the Crypto & Digital Assets Conference on Friday 13 November 2026, held at the prestigious Chartered Accountants' Hall. ICAEW organizes this conference, bringing together accountants, auditors, legal, and banking professionals who advise on or work with digital assets.

The program offers insights into managing complex digital asset transactions, understanding regulatory frameworks, meeting audit requirements, and applying financial reporting standards, with a particular emphasis on stablecoins. The conference will also explore the UK government's perspective on digital asset innovation.

Participants can earn up to 7.5 hours of verifiable CPD. The agenda includes presentations from speakers such as Professor Sarah Green, Lord Ranger of Northwood, and Dion Seymour, formerly of HMRC. Attendees will have opportunities to contribute to discussions through interactive roundtables focused on the sector's future.

events.name: Venture Capital World Summit Lisbon 2026
events.description:
On Friday, 13 November 2026, Lisbon will become the epicenter of innovation and investment as the Venture Capital World Summit convenes at Spaces Oriente. This gathering aims to connect Portugal's growing startup community with capital from Europe and around the world, facilitating new collaborations and investment opportunities.

Attendees will include startup founders, CEOs, venture capitalists, angel investors, and corporate innovation leaders. The agenda features startup pitches, investor panel discussions, and explorations of emerging technologies in areas like AI, FinTech, ClimateTech, HealthTech, and DeepTech. Participants can also consider Lisbon's position as a hub for international expansion and examine current trends influencing venture capital within Portugal and globally. The event provides a setting for individuals interested in investing in or growing new ventures.

events.name: Taiwan International Coffee Show 2026
events.description:
Taipei is set to become the vibrant epicenter for coffee culture and innovation at the Taiwan International Coffee Show 2026. From November 13 to 16, the Taipei Nangang Exhibition Center Hall 1 will host a comprehensive showcase of the latest in coffee equipment, specialty beans, and innovative brewing techniques.

The coffee show takes place alongside the Taiwan Int'l Tea Expo, Taiwan Int′l Food Industry Show, and Taipei Int'l Wine & Spirits Festival, providing a broad look at the food and beverage industry. Organized by the Taiwan Coffee Association and Chan Chao Int’l Co. Ltd., the event will feature cutting-edge technology, including AI coffee sorting machines and premium espresso equipment, alongside a wide selection of gourmet ingredients.

Visitors will have the opportunity to explore new trends and connect with leading exhibitors, gaining insights into the innovations shaping the future of coffee.

events.name: ArtePadova 2026
events.description:
Padova, Italy, will once again become a vibrant hub for art enthusiasts and collectors as ArtePadova celebrates its 36th edition from 13 to 16 November 2026. This four-day exhibition focuses on Modern and Contemporary Art, bringing together over 300 exhibitors across 28,000 square meters. Visitors can expect to see more than 15,000 artworks on display.

A significant part of the event is the Contemporary Art Talent Show (C.A.T.S.). This section is dedicated to showcasing emerging artists and making art more accessible, with many works available for under 5000 euros. Within C.A.T.S., the Premio C.A.T. and Premio Banca Mediolanum awards acknowledge notable talent.

ArtePadova typically draws around 26,000 visitors. It provides a setting for people to explore new artistic expressions and observe current trends in the art market.

events.name: Babini Munich 2026
events.description:
Prepare for the ultimate family event at Babini Munich 2026, taking place from November 13-15 at MOC München.

This event is for expectant parents, new mothers and fathers, and families with young children. Visitors can explore a wide selection of brands, providing a chance to test, compare, and buy strollers, car seats, and other essential baby products directly from manufacturers. The program also features expert-led talks and workshops covering important topics such as baby sleep, nutrition, parental allowance, and first aid for children.

The fair will also include a Start-Up Area to discover new products, a dedicated track for testing strollers, and opportunities for personalized advice on car safety. For family comfort, there are lounges for nursing, changing, and relaxation. Baby carriers and kids' wagons are also available for complimentary rental.

events.name: Hamilton Woodworking Show 2026
events.description:
Step into a world of craftsmanship and creativity at the Hamilton Woodworking Show 2026, hosted at the Caledonia Fairgrounds. This gathering focuses on everything related to wood, providing a chance for both hobbyists and experienced craftspeople to refine their abilities and learn new methods.

Attendees can take part in hands-on workshops, which cover a range of skills from power carving and marquetry to pyrography and even wand making. There will also be live demonstrations by experts such as Vic Tesolin and Holly Tallman, who will share their knowledge in areas like bandsaw techniques, woodturning, and furniture making. Visitors can browse displays from various exhibitors, including Sienci Labs and EcoPoxy, showcasing current tools, lumber, and new materials.

This is an opportunity to connect with fellow woodworkers, observe competitions, and gather ideas for future projects. Children 12 and under are admitted free, making it an accessible outing for families interested in exploring the craft of woodworking.

events.name: Adelaide Auto Expo 2026
events.description:
Prepare for an automotive spectacle as the Adelaide Auto Expo 2026 rolls into the Adelaide Showgrounds! This event offers a comprehensive look at car culture, featuring a diverse collection of custom, classic, and performance vehicles. Attendees will find displays such as the Extreme Auto Expo, the Adelaide Import Salon showcasing sleek designs, and the Hot Rod Show alongside the Aussie & Muscle Car Cruise, highlighting timeless machines.

Beyond the static displays, the expo presents a dynamic program of activities. Visitors can experience the intensity of the 1000 Horsepower Club, enjoy the community spirit of Cars N Coffee, and observe the King of Car Clubs competition. Traders Alley offers a place to explore the latest automotive gear, while the U-PULL-IT Junior Time Attack provides a different kind of excitement. A notable feature will be the "Low Standards" Modified Vehicle Giveaway.

The Adelaide Auto Expo aims to provide a comprehensive experience for anyone with an interest in cars, offering diverse attractions to suit various preferences.

events.name: Arizona Optometric Association Fall Congress 2026
events.description:
Elevate your practice and expand your expertise at the Arizona Optometric Association Fall Congress 2026. From November 13-15, the Hilton Sedona Resort & Spa in Sedona, Arizona, will host this gathering for optometry professionals. The Arizona Optometric Association organizes this three-day event, which focuses on learning and professional connection.

Participants will explore current ophthalmic innovations and clinical best practices. They will have opportunities to engage with experts and contribute to discussions, learning about emerging technologies.

The congress offers a chance to acquire new skills and strengthen professional ties. Attendees can connect with colleagues and gain insights that support advancements in patient care, all within the setting of Sedona.

events.name: InterGem Jewelry Show Timonium 2026
events.description:
Prepare to discover a dazzling array of treasures at the InterGem Jewelry Show, returning to the Maryland State Fairgrounds in Timonium from November 13-15, 2026. As America's longest-running direct-to-consumer jewelry event, it offers a unique chance to purchase items directly from wholesalers, manufacturers, and designers.

The show presents a wide selection of fine jewelry, loose gemstones, beads, and handcrafted pieces. Visitors can explore a diverse range of items, whether they are looking for a distinctive gift or something new for their own collection. The direct access to creators and suppliers means items are available at prices reflecting their origin.

Information regarding admission is available. A discount is offered for tickets purchased in advance, and active and veteran military members receive complimentary entry.

events.name: Coconut Grove Jewelry & Watch Show 2026
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in a world of timeless elegance at the Coconut Grove Jewelry & Watch Show 2026. The Hangar at Regatta Harbour in Miami will host the event from November 13-15, with a special preview evening on November 12, from 5-8 PM.

Collectors, enthusiasts, and those seeking unique items will find a curated selection of antique, vintage, and estate merchandise from around the globe. The collection features unique items from the Edwardian period through to Mid-Century Modern designs. Among the items on display will be selections from established houses such as Tiffany & Co, Cartier, Van Cleef & Arpels, and Rolex.

For trade professionals, it presents a chance to source distinct inventory. Private clients may find a special piece they have been seeking.

events.name: At the Vineyards! Le Mans 2026

location.venue: Exhibition Centre, 1 Avenue du Parc des Expositions

events.description:
Prepare your palate for a grand celebration as At the Vineyards! Le Mans returns for its 20th edition from November 13-15, 2026, at the Centre des Expositions. This year, the event brings together 100 artisans and producers from across France, providing an occasion to explore the country's diverse culinary traditions.

Attendees will find a wide array of products, from Bordeaux reds and Alsatian whites to artisanal cheeses and fine chocolates. These items are available directly from their creators, often at producer prices. It's an opportunity to speak with the individuals behind these products, learn about their craft, and acquire authentic French selections for one's home.

For convenience, on-site catering and free parking will be available. Please note that an INAO tasting glass is required for participation, available for 2€. The gathering is designed for individuals interested in French food and wine.

events.name: Dungog Show 2026
events.description:
Get ready for a vibrant celebration of rural life at the Dungog Show 2026, taking place on November 13th and 14th at Abelard Street, Dungog NSW. This annual gathering highlights the agricultural heritage, local produce, and varied talents from the Dungog district.

The program offers entertainment and educational experiences for people of all ages. Attendees can look forward to events such as the Camel Races, the Dachshund Dash, Wood Chopping competitions, and the Grand Parade. There will also be opportunities to learn about agricultural innovations, watch cattle and horse events, and browse local crafts in the Ladies Pavilion.

A significant part of the show focuses on youth, aiming to inform the next generation about agriculture's important role and its future. It's an occasion for community connection and learning.

events.name: Team Communication Workshop Fall 2026
events.description:
Elevate your dental practice's potential at the Team Communication Workshop, scheduled for November 13, 2026, at the Nash Institute for Dental Learning in Huntersville, NC. Instructor Debra Engelhardt-Nash leads this one-day program, which is designed for every member of a dental office team. This includes dentists, office managers, spouses, and individuals aspiring to own a practice.

Participants will learn how to create a distinct customer service culture and improve communication with both patients and colleagues. The program also covers strategies for presenting treatment options effectively, aiming for successful patient acceptance.

Additionally, the workshop explores important aspects such as understanding a practice's key performance indicators, running productive team meetings, and enhancing the overall patient experience. The aim is to provide teams with the practical understanding needed to build, grow, and maintain a successful and harmonious dental practice.

events.name: Neuroscience 2026
events.description:
The global neuroscience community will converge in Washington, D.C., for Neuroscience 2026, taking place from Saturday, November 14, to Wednesday, November 18. The Society for Neuroscience organizes this gathering at the Walter E. Washington Convention Center, where the focus will be on deepening our collective understanding of the brain and nervous system.

Researchers, professionals, and students will have the chance to explore new findings, discuss emerging trends, and build connections that can shape the future of the field. It's a setting for scientific exchange and the development of new collaborations.

A significant part of the event's development involves an open Call for Proposals for sessions and events, allowing SfN members to contribute directly to the program's content. The deadline for these proposals is January 21 at 5 p.m. EST.

events.name: AARC Congress 2026
events.description:
Respiratory therapists from across the country and around the world are invited to AARC Congress 2026, taking place November 14–17 in New Orleans, LA. This gathering provides a valuable experience focused on education, networking, and professional development.

Attendees will hear from leading experts, discussing the latest advancements in respiratory care through a series of insightful lectures. The exhibit hall at the New Orleans Convention Center will feature new products and services, offering a chance to experience future technologies firsthand. The Sputum Bowl competition will be a highlight, alongside opportunities to connect with peers and experts.

Early bird registration is available until September 2.

events.name: Snowbound Expo 2026
events.description:
The ultimate winter sports celebration returns as Snowbound Expo 2026 ignites the season on November 14-15 at Mohegan Sun in Uncasville, Connecticut. This event marks the unofficial start of the 2026/27 snow sports season, bringing together skiers, riders, and outdoor enthusiasts from across New England.

Attendees can explore the newest gear, technology, and apparel. The Inspiration Stage will feature talks from notable figures such as Travis Rice, Jessie Diggins, and Kimmy Fasani. Interactive experiences include the Epic Pass Winter Arcade, a Trampoline Show, and a new Ice Bar. There will also be opportunities to meet winter sports personalities and even try learning to ski. It's a gathering designed for anyone who shares a passion for the mountains.

events.name: Texas Book Festival 2026
events.description:
Get ready to immerse yourself in a world of stories and ideas as the Texas Book Festival lights up downtown Austin on November 14–15, 2026. This annual literary gathering is free and open to everyone, typically drawing over 45,000 book lovers who come to celebrate the written word.

Visitors will find a wide range of literary voices, with opportunities to hear from and meet more than 250 authors. The program covers various genres, from children's and young adult fiction to adult nonfiction. The festival also highlights Texas's literary heritage, recognizing David Bowles as the 2026 Texas Writer Awardee and featuring the artistry of Temi Coker, this year's Festival Poster Artist.

Beyond the weekend event, the festival's commitment to literacy continues throughout the year, supporting programs across the state.

events.name: Pharmacy U Vancouver 2026
events.description:
Celebrating 15 years of dedicated service to the profession, Pharmacy U Vancouver 2026 invites over 1,000 pharmacy owners, pharmacists, technicians, executives, and students to the JW Marriott Vancouver on November 14, 2026. This one-day conference focuses on the practical business aspects of the industry, offering content designed to be immediately useful.

Attendees can participate in over 20 expert-led sessions and connect with more than 30 sponsors. events.name: International Fraud Awareness Week 2026
events.description:

Ultimately, the week encourages a collective effort to foster a culture of integrity within organizations, helping to protect assets from financial deception.

events.name: Family Wealth Report Family Office Investment Summit 2026

events.name: ISS World North America 2026
events.description:
