The program will delve into lawful interception, cybercrime investigation, and data retention strategies, offering valuable perspectives on these critical areas. Attendees can expect to explore new solutions and participate in training sessions led by experts.

This gathering also provides a setting for building important relationships within the global intelligence community. Discussions will center on the latest advancements and collaborative methods necessary for navigating the intricate world of digital security.

events.name: MNCPA Tax Conference 2026
events.description:
Prepare for the future of taxation at the MNCPA Tax Conference 2026, held November 16-17 in Minneapolis, MN, and virtually online. This two-day gathering is for CPAs, accounting professionals, attorneys, and financial decision-makers who want to understand and navigate the changing tax landscape.

The conference features over 30 sessions led by experts such as Leah Donti, Paul Neiffer, and Ed Zollars. These sessions will address key federal, Minnesota, and estate tax issues, provide IRS updates, and discuss how Artificial Intelligence is reshaping accounting practices. Participants can earn up to 16 CPE credits, including ethics.

A Young Professionals Track is available, offering specific insights for those early in their tax careers who are moving into advisory roles. The event also provides an opportunity to engage with tax, technology, and business vendors, and to meet other professionals in the field.

events.name: Field Service Management Summit Europe 2026
events.description:

The agenda covers advanced subjects such as Agentic AI for autonomous deployment, IoT-based predictive service, strategies for service monetization, and methods for enhancing the workforce experience.

This gathering provides a setting for professionals in Field Service, Operations, and Digitalization to connect and share insights. The aim is to equip leaders with knowledge and connections that can lead to significant improvements in service quality and operational efficiency.

events.name: APCO Canada 2026
events.description:
The future of public safety communications takes center stage in Halifax, Nova Scotia, as APCO Canada hosts its annual conference from November 16-19, 2026. This gathering brings together public safety professionals from across Canada, including those working in 9-1-1, police, fire, EMS, emergency management, and federal search and rescue.

Attendees will explore key developments in Emergency Communications Systems, with particular attention given to how Next Generation 9-1-1 (NG9-1-1) is shaping the field. The event offers opportunities for professional growth, encouraging collaboration, the exchange of best practices, and the discovery of new solutions.

Professionals can connect with industry leaders and colleagues, working together to strengthen emergency response and contribute to safer communities across the country.

events.name: REITworld: Annual Conference 2026

Attendees will explore current and future trends influencing real estate and capital markets. The conference provides opportunities to connect with peers and leaders, facilitating one-on-one meetings and supporting business development. It's a setting designed for discussing innovative strategies and understanding the competitive landscape within the REIT sector.

events.name: Social Media for Government Summit Australia 2026
events.description:
Public sector communication professionals are invited to master the evolving digital landscape at the Social Media for Government Summit Australia 2026. The summit runs for three days, from November 10-12, 2026, at Melbourne's Rendezvous Hotel. It provides a focused environment for social media teams looking to strengthen their presence, build trust, and improve their overall impact.

Participants will examine practical approaches to counter misinformation, utilize artificial intelligence to streamline operations, and foster genuine connections with audiences who may be skeptical. More than 30 public sector social media experts will lead conversations across two distinct streams: 'ENGAGE,' which focuses on building connections with audiences, and 'TRANSFORM,' dedicated to enhancing team capabilities.

The program includes practical insights and real-world case studies, helping attendees understand how to measure their true organizational impact. The aim is to support government communications in maintaining transparency and effectiveness in a constantly evolving environment.

events.name: RBJ Attorney of The Year 2026
events.description:
Prepare to celebrate the pinnacle of legal excellence in Western New York! The RBJ Attorney of The Year 2026 awards ceremony will be held on Monday, November 16, 2026, from 11:30 AM to 1:30 PM EST/EDT at the Rochester Riverside Convention Center.

This event, presented in partnership with The Daily Record, recognizes legal professionals across six categories: Civil Legal Services, In House Counsel, Leaders in Law, Lifetime Achievement, Pro Bono Excellence, and Up and Coming Lawyers. It highlights individuals who have made meaningful contributions to the community within Monroe, Ontario, Genesee, Livingston, Orleans, and/or Wayne counties.

Nominations are open, with an application deadline of August 21, 2026. This provides an opportunity to acknowledge colleagues for their professional work and achievements. Attendance is limited, with priority given to honorees and sponsors, bringing together many members of the region's legal community.

events.name: IFN Türkiye Dialogues 2026
events.description:
The exclusive IFN Türkiye Dialogues 2026 will convene on November 26, 2026, at the Sheraton Grand Istanbul Atasehir. Sessions led by specialists will examine the future of Shariah asset management, tokenised products, and emerging asset classes. This setting allows institutional investors, financial service providers, regulators, and wealth managers to engage in open dialogue, gain strategic perspectives, and help shape the future of Islamic finance in Türkiye.

events.name: IPIA Convention & Tradeshow 2026

events.name: Paper Arabia 2026

Given Dubai's role as a global trade hub and center for innovation, Paper Arabia 2026 provides significant opportunities for people to connect. Attendees can grow their businesses, share knowledge, and build important relationships within a rapidly evolving market.

events.name: Atlanta CIO Pre-Assembly Private Dinner 2026

events.name: Cross Tech World 2026

events.name: Milwaukee CIO Community Executive Summit 2026

Milwaukee's top IT decision-makers are invited to sharpen their strategic edge at the Milwaukee CIO Community Executive Summit 2026. The summit provides a setting for connecting with colleagues and discovering practical strategies. It aims to equip Milwaukee's leading IT executives with the knowledge to foster innovation and confidently approach future challenges.

events.name: Louisiana IT Symposium 2026

Elevate your strategic vision at the Louisiana IT Symposium 2026, a premier one-day event meticulously crafted for the IT executive community. events.name: Hotel Technology Forum 2026
events.description:
The Hotel Technology Forum 2026, set at Red Rock, is the premier gathering for senior-level hotel executives and technology leaders shaping hospitality's future. The forum concludes with the Hotel Visionary Awards, recognizing leading innovation within the industry. The aim is to foster discussions and insights that help build adaptable, lasting systems and strategies for the hospitality landscape of tomorrow.

events.name: AASHTO Annual Meeting 2026
events.description:
From November 15-18, 2026, Louisville, KY will host the AASHTO Annual Meeting, bringing together the nation's top transportation leaders and innovators.

The meeting serves as a forum for state Department of Transportation executives, engineers, and policymakers. Here, they can collaborate on the significant issues that will shape America's transportation future. Those attending will explore new innovations, discuss important policy developments, and exchange successful approaches across all transportation modes.

It also provides a chance to connect with peers, build partnerships, and collectively address the ongoing challenges and opportunities in creating a safer, more resilient, and sustainable transportation network. This is an opportunity to engage with key figures in the field and contribute to shaping the next generation of transportation solutions nationwide.

events.name: WFE General Assembly & Annual Meeting 2026
events.description:

For three days, attendees will engage in important discussions about the future of global exchanges and market infrastructure. The program will cover current financial industry topics, providing perspectives on regulatory changes, technological advancements, and sustainable market practices.

This meeting offers a forum for leaders and innovators to connect, exchange knowledge, and build relationships within the international financial community.

events.name: FedTalks 2026
events.description:
On November 17, 2026, Washington, D.C. will become the epicenter for federal technology innovation as FedTalks 2026 convenes. This event, presented by AISCOOP and hosted by FedScoop, will bring together over 1,000 influential C-level executives, leaders, and innovators from both government and the technology sector. It offers a space for these key figures to discuss how technology and people are fundamentally transforming government and the nation.

Discussions will explore the federal government's ongoing evolution, particularly its adoption of modern commercial technologies to enhance efficiency in service delivery and mission success. The agenda includes critical areas such as federal AI adoption, commercial software acquisition, fostering innovation, progress in zero-trust security, and the development of 21st-century digital services. There will also be a focus on data as a foundational element for emerging technologies like quantum computing and advanced cloud security. Participants can earn valuable CPE credits, making this a significant gathering for those involved in shaping the direction of federal technology.

events.name: Parks Associates Future of Video 2026
events.description:
Explore the cutting edge of the streaming industry at Parks Associates Future of Video 2026: Business of Streaming. This event takes place November 17-18, 2026, at the Marina del Rey Marriott, offering a chance to understand and navigate the evolving video market.

Industry leaders will gather to discuss key developments in video delivery, AI-driven personalization, dynamic ad insertion, and new content monetization strategies. The agenda explores topics ranging from live television streaming and metaverse development to CTV partner growth and creator-led networks.

Those who attend can expect valuable networking, opportunities for visibility, and strategic insights. Participation is available through in-person sessions, virtual access, and research workshops.

events.name: SBJ Media Innovators 2026
events.description:
The dynamic landscape of sports media takes center stage at SBJ Media Innovators 2026, convening on November 17 in New York City at the New York Marriott Marquis. The event will examine the significant shifts in how sports content reaches its audience, from the widespread move towards streaming to the increasing variety of platforms people use, including traditional broadcast, cable, and direct-to-consumer services.

Senior executives representing media companies, sports leagues, teams, and digital properties will gather to discuss strategies. These conversations will address managing the rising value of media rights, exploring new content delivery models, and building stronger connections with fans. Topics will span content creation, monetization approaches, current trends in sports consumption, and the future direction of media rights, including the growing interest in alternative broadcasts and the influence of creators.

The discussions aim to offer a comprehensive view of how the industry can adapt and evolve in a period marked by continuous innovation and changing fan preferences.

events.name: NexGen Banking Summit USA New York Fall 2026
events.description:
The NexGen Banking Summit USA New York Fall 2026, on November 17-18, marks its 5th edition as the premier gathering for banking leaders. This year's summit is the first dedicated solely to Generative AI in banking, a technology expected to influence an $85 billion market by 2030. The event brings together CXOs, VPs, and specialists from leading US financial institutions in New York City.

The agenda includes discussions on how AI can enhance customer experience, fraud management, and risk compliance. The program features keynotes and executive panels, alongside interactive roundtables that will delve into topics such as responsible AI governance, quantum-resistant banking, and operational resilience. Attendees will have opportunities to connect with industry leaders and learn about new solutions.

The summit aims to provide perspectives on the future of banking, particularly as it relates to AI and automation. Complimentary passes are offered to banks and financial institutions.

events.name: AI for Marketers Summit Fall 2026
events.description:
For senior marketing leaders ready to transform AI curiosity into tangible, measurable impact, the AI for Marketers Summit Fall 2026 is your essential event. The summit takes place over two days, November 18–19, with pre-summit workshops available on November 17. The focus is on operationalizing artificial intelligence at scale.

The program is designed for top brand marketers and decision-makers, providing in-depth exploration of real-world case studies and best practices. Attendees will explore how to build a structured content foundation, master brand voice with AI, automate their analytics loop, and develop an AI-ready Go-To-Market intelligence engine.

Insights come directly from pioneers at companies such as Microsoft, PayPal, Unilever, and Intuit. These sessions offer practical strategies to move beyond initial AI pilots and achieve significant production successes within the rapidly evolving search and marketing landscape.

events.name: Lab Asset & Facility Management Summit 2026
events.description:
Unlock peak operational efficiency and resilience for your research environments at the Lab Asset & Facility Management Summit 2026. The summit takes place November 10-12 at The Westin Boston Seaport District, bringing together leaders in lab operations, facilities, and asset management from pharmaceutical and biotech sectors. The program explores practical strategies designed to free up time for scientific research and foster more efficient, adaptable lab environments.

The program includes over 28 real-world case studies and interactive sessions, structured into two tracks: Running the Lab and Running the Site. A new feature, the LAFM Exchange, allows participants to shape the agenda for important operational discussions.

Ahead of the main summit, the R&D Operations Action Day offers pre-conference workshops. These hands-on sessions use a playbook approach to provide practical frameworks and opportunities for peer benchmarking.

events.name: European Automotive Intelligent Cockpit and Smart Driving Summit 2026
events.description:
The European Automotive Intelligent Cockpit and Smart Driving Summit 2026, taking place on November 17-18 in Stuttgart, Germany, and via live broadcast, is set to be a landmark event for the automotive industry. This two-day summit will examine how smart cockpits and driving technology are evolving, particularly with the rise of the Software-Defined Vehicle (SDV) era.

The agenda includes a focus on key advancements. Participants will explore the application of large AI models in smart cockpits, next-generation E/E architectures, and innovative Human-Machine Interface (HMI) and User Experience (UX) design. Other topics will cover connected car technology, augmented reality HUDs, cloud connectivity, and the integration of Large Language Models into in-vehicle voice assistants.

This event is intended for C-level executives, VPs, and technical experts from OEMs, Tier 1/2 suppliers, and AI firms. It provides a forum for gaining valuable insights and connecting with peers to discuss and influence the direction of automotive intelligence.

events.name: TomorrowX Summit 2026
events.description:

This gathering focuses on the future of investment research, FinX insights, and the entire AI stack—from foundational labs and silicon to power infrastructure and capital flows.

Over two days, participants will connect with CEOs, investors, and operators who are shaping the TMT landscape. The program includes keynotes where public-company CEOs are interviewed by their investors, discussions on emerging trends in private markets, and presentations of original research. The summit facilitates direct connections between influential financial contributors from X and management teams, providing opportunities for networking and strategic insights for TMT professionals.

events.name: CISO Inspired Summit UK Fall 2026
events.description:
Empowering cybersecurity leaders to fortify their defenses, the CISO Inspired Summit UK Fall 2026 convenes on November 17, 2026, at the prestigious Syon Park in London. This event is for CISOs, CIOs, and other senior IT security executives, focusing on "Building Resilience" in today's complex security environment.

Participants will hear from experts in sessions and workshops, discussing topics such as AI's role in cybersecurity, advanced threat intelligence, and effective risk management. It's also an opportunity to see new technologies and connect with various solution providers.

The summit offers a chance to network with peers, share experiences, and gather practical ideas to strengthen digital defenses and help secure organizations for the long term. The aim is to provide insights that can help shape future cybersecurity strategies.

events.name: Tech Talent North West 2026
events.description:
Designed specifically for Canada's senior People & Culture leaders in tech, Tech Talent North West 2026 offers an essential one-day deep dive into the evolving landscape of HR. These sessions will address building trust, leading through uncertainty, and aligning people strategies directly with business outcomes, exploring how to effectively evolve, scale, and respond to change within tech organizations.

events.name: SemIsrael Expo 2026
events.description:

Attendees can gain insights into current trends, interact with industry leaders, and establish valuable connections within Israel's semiconductor community.

events.name: Milwaukee CISO Community Executive Summit 2026
events.description:

The day's format includes interactive keynote sessions, focused breakout discussions, and opportunities for peer-to-peer networking.

events.name: Shared Services & Outsourcing Woche 2026
events.description:

events.name: CIO Inspired Summit UK Fall 2026
events.description:

events.name: Transformational CHRO Assembly 2026

Through partnerships with SHRM and Villanova, the assembly provides a valuable setting for face-to-face discussions on current industry trends and challenges, contributing to the future direction of human capital.

events.name: Billington Critical Infrastructure CyberSecurity Summit 2026
events.description:

Participants will engage in a cross-sector tabletop exercise, analyze real-world attack case studies, and draw crucial lessons from significant breaches such as Volt and Salt Typhoon. The summit, held in San Antonio, a city recognized for its cybersecurity community, aims to provide clear understanding of how to defend interdependent infrastructure as a unified system.

Leading experts, including CISA's Acting Director and the FBI's Assistant Director, will contribute to two days of focused discussions and collaborative efforts to counter evolving cyber threats. The goal is to foster a shared understanding and strengthen collective resilience among professionals from the U.S. and allied nations who are responsible for these vital systems.

events.name: The King's Fund Annual Conference 2026
events.description:

Discussions will also explore reimagining the welfare state, developing strategies to reduce widening health inequalities, and the critical shift towards community-led 'neighbourhood health.' events.name: SIFMA's Market Structure Conference 2026

The event offers opportunities for networking, learning, and business development. The tradeshow provides exhibitors with an opportunity to present their products and services directly to commercial aviation operators and procurement personnel. With support from organizations such as Boeing, CAE, and NAV CANADA, the conference is structured to encourage collaboration, advance innovation, and contribute to the future of Canadian aviation.

events.name: First Nations Housing & Infrastructure East 2026
events.description:
The 10th Annual First Nations Housing & Infrastructure East 2026 forum, taking place November 17–18 at the Novotel Toronto North York Hotel, is Canada's leading event dedicated to building sustainable solutions for First Nation communities. This gathering will bring together more than 600 individuals representing over 120 First Nations, Tribal Councils, and Indigenous organizations, alongside partners from government and industry.

Attendees will engage in discussions covering key areas such as accelerating housing projects, navigating funding and financing, strengthening climate-resilient infrastructure, and advancing Nation governance and community safety. A pre-conference Think Tank on November 16 will further explore community safety, justice, and nation governance, co-chaired by Chief Margaret Sault.

The forum offers an opportunity for Chiefs, Councillors, and professionals in housing, finance, and public works to collaborate, share insights, and contribute to meaningful progress in community development.

events.name: Fierce Biotech at London Life Sciences Week 2026
events.description:
Making its highly anticipated UK debut, Fierce Biotech at London Life Sciences Week 2026 presents a high-impact, one-day forum on Tuesday 17 November at The Savoy, London. This gathering brings together senior biotech executives, pharma leaders, investors, and business development professionals from the global life sciences community.

Attendees can expect focused discussions to explore scientific innovation, drug development strategies, and current investment trends. The agenda is designed to facilitate meaningful conversations, foster potential collaborations, and offer opportunities to connect with peers. It's a chance to understand the market dynamics and emerging technologies shaping the future of biotech.

events.name: World Business Forum Madrid 2026
events.description:
Set to redefine the future of business, the World Business Forum Madrid 2026 will convene on November 17 & 18 at the Palacio Municipal de IFEMA. The forum's theme, 'Trascender,' encourages executives and managers to think about creating organizations that not only endure but truly flourish, pushing past traditional limits.

Participants will hear from influential global figures such as Daniel Goleman, Rita McGrath, and Zack Kass. Their discussions will explore key topics including AI strategy, emotional intelligence, innovation, and what it takes to lead high-performing teams.

The event expects to bring together over 2,000 professionals from various industries, naturally creating opportunities for connecting with peers. The aim is for attendees to leave with fresh perspectives and practical ideas that can be applied to foster innovation and help their organizations navigate the future effectively.

events.name: Copay, Reimbursement and Access Congress 2026
events.description:
Navigating the intricate landscape of patient access and affordability is crucial for pharmaceutical and biotechnology professionals. The Patient Pathways: The Copay and Patient Services Congress 2026 will take place from November 17-20 in Philadelphia, PA. This four-day gathering, which combines the Copay, Reimbursement and Access Congress, is expected to bring together over 500 leaders from across the industry.

The program delves into understanding copay challenges, improving patient support, and addressing significant affordability issues for specialty drugs. Participants can expect practical solutions from dedicated sessions focused on copay (November 17-18) and patient services (November 19-20), with guidance from Chairperson Chris Dowd. Networking opportunities and year-long on-demand access to content will offer ongoing insights for market access professionals.

events.name: Future Labs, Automation & Technology West 2026
events.description:
Accelerate discovery and elevate laboratory performance at Future Labs, Automation & Technology West 2026, taking place on November 17, 2026, at the Handlery Hotel in San Diego, CA. This gathering is designed for VPs, Directors, and Scientists in AI/ML, Lab R&D, and Informatics, focusing on how to leverage AI, automation, and connected data within the laboratory environment.

Attendees will gain practical approaches for integrating advanced technologies into existing infrastructure, aligning data, engineering, and scientific teams, and scaling solutions effectively. The agenda addresses key challenges, from balancing innovation with operational and budget considerations to understanding the true potential of automation.

The aim is for participants to leave better equipped to navigate integration complexities, develop data-driven insights, optimize workflows, ensure regulatory compliance, and utilize automation for improved accuracy and cost efficiencies. This environment encourages shared learning and collaboration, supporting advancements in science.

events.name: Reinventing HR Summit 2026
events.description:
London's Bentley Hotel will host the Reinventing HR Summit 2026, a pivotal three-day event from 17-19 November dedicated to revolutionising the human resources landscape. This summit brings together HR professionals, leaders, and those driving change who are keen to enhance employee experience and shape the evolving world of work.

Discussions will cover essential topics such as the influence of AI and technology in HR, effective strategies for employee experience and retention, cultivating inclusive workplace cultures, and aligning HR initiatives with broader business goals. Attendees can participate in workshops, review practical case studies, and engage in meaningful conversations with others in the field.

The event offers a chance to acquire practical insights, consider new viewpoints, and connect with colleagues. The aim is for participants to leave with ideas and tools that can help their organizations adapt and thrive.

events.name: Frankfurt School Forum Future of Work 2026
events.description:
Explore the evolving landscape of employment at the 10th Annual Frankfurt School Forum Future of Work on November 17, 2026, at the Frankfurt School of Finance & Management. This event, focused on "Designing Work for AI, Transformation, Talent & Competitiveness," brings together over 150 leaders from business, politics, and science.

Discussions will cover strategic workforce transformation, how AI can enhance productivity, and developing robust talent pipelines with essential future skills. A specific Indo-German Business Hub will also be present, examining global talent markets and international growth strategies to encourage economic collaboration. With more than 15 sessions and over 20 expert speakers, participants, ranging from board members to HR professionals, can expect to find practical insights for fostering sustainable growth and long-term competitiveness. The full-day program also provides opportunities for professional exchange across different industries.

events.name: AgriVoltaics Europe 2026
events.description:
Explore the cutting-edge synergy of agriculture and solar energy at the 5th Annual AgriVoltaics Europe, a hybrid event taking place from November 17th to 19th, 2026, at the Mövenpick Hotel Stuttgart, Germany. This gathering brings together over 250 professionals – industry leaders, farmers, researchers, and policymakers – all focused on advancing sustainable land use and climate solutions.

Discussions will cover key areas including how to co-optimize energy and agricultural yields, innovative system design, soil protection, and economic feasibility. The agenda offers perspectives on advanced technologies, policy frameworks, and real-world project developments. Attendees can also experience an on-site exhibition and a site visit.

Over 35 expert speakers will share their knowledge. The program also includes dedicated opportunities for connection, such as a matchmaking app, allowing participants to build valuable relationships and contribute to shaping the future of agrivoltaics.

events.name: Director Leadership Conference 2026
events.description:
From November 17–19, 2026, the Omni Fort Lauderdale in Ft Lauderdale, FL, will host a pivotal gathering for top-tier leadership.

The Director Leadership Conference 2026 brings together Board Directors, Audit Committee Members, CFOs, CEOs, and Internal Auditors. It provides a forum to explore the evolving landscape of governance, with a particular emphasis on 'New Possibilities,' 'New Thinking,' and 'New Vision.' Participants will delve into innovative strategies for navigating digital disruption and building organizational resilience.

Attendees will engage with leading experts, including Sylandi Brown and Ryan Gray, in sessions designed to challenge traditional approaches and help craft visionary strategies. The conference also offers a valuable opportunity to connect with other system leaders and peers, fostering a space for sharing perspectives and gaining insights that support strategic decision-making and long-term organizational health. This collective experience aims to advance governance practices and intelligence.

events.name: Women in Insurance Tech Conference 2026

location.venue: DoubleTree Suites by Hilton Hotel Boston - Cambridge

events.description:
The forefront of insurance technology will converge in Boston - Cambridge on November 17 & 18, 2026, for the Women in Insurance Tech Conference.

This two-day gathering focuses on the leadership and innovation of women who are shaping the future of digital insurance. Participants will delve into topics such as GenAI applications, next-generation underwriting, autonomous claims, and cybersecurity. Discussions will also cover strategies for core modernization, digital transformation, and building workforce resilience within an AI-powered ecosystem.

The conference provides an opportunity to engage with over 250 female CIOs, CTOs, founders, and executives. Sessions will include keynotes, real-world case studies, and interactive workshops, offering a setting for networking, acquiring practical insights, and contributing to industry advancements.

events.name: ASCP Annual Meeting 2026
events.description:
Prepare to elevate your impact in laboratory medicine at the ASCP Annual Meeting 2026, co-hosted with the Canadian Association of Pathologists (CAP-ACP). From November 17-20, 2026, the Palais des congrès de Montréal will bring together pathologists and medical laboratory professionals from across the United States and Canada for four days focused on learning and collaboration.

The meeting's program aims to provide essential knowledge, helping professionals stay current in their field. Participants can explore recent innovations, exchange insights, and identify approaches to improve patient care and advance laboratory science.

An optional on-demand package is available for those interested in continued learning. This package provides six months of access to all recorded sessions, allowing individuals to earn credits at their own pace and support their professional growth.

events.name: California Mortgage Expo Pasadena 2026
events.description:
Elevate your mortgage business at the California Mortgage Expo Pasadena 2026, taking place on Tuesday, November 17, in Pasadena, CA. This gathering, organized by Originator Connect Network, focuses on the needs of loan origination professionals. It brings together executives, independent mortgage brokers, loan officers, and lending officers from banks and credit unions.

Attendees can expect a full day dedicated to learning and connecting. The agenda includes educational sessions led by experienced speakers, offering insights that can be applied to business growth and market understanding. It's an opportunity to expand professional networks among peers in the mortgage sector.

The event aims to provide a setting where professionals can explore new approaches, establish beneficial relationships, and maintain their competitive edge.

events.name: Beverage Innovation 2026
events.description:
Discover the cutting-edge trends and future directions of the beverage industry at Beverage Innovation 2026.

The event explores the evolving world of drinks, from new colours and fruit-forward tastes to the expanding market for functional beverages. Discussions will cover the innovative ingredients, formats, and concepts that are driving significant growth across the sector, with a focus on identifying innovations that will endure and redefine the global beverages market.

Insights will come from leading figures such as Alex Beckett, Principal Strategist at Mintel Food & Drink; Robert Browne from Danone; Dr Caroline Withers of Carlsberg Group; and Huib van Bockel, Founder & CEO of TENZING Natural Energy. Journalist Emma Eversham will also share her perspective.

events.name: AI & IP Europe 2026
events.description:
The rapid evolution of Artificial Intelligence is fundamentally reshaping intellectual property landscapes. On November 17, 2026, professionals will convene at AI & IP Europe 2026, an event hosted by World IP Review at the Brussels Marriott Hotel Grand Place. The day is designed to help participants understand and respond to these changes.

The agenda includes more than 20 presentations and interactive discussions. Participants will explore the implications of the EU AI Act, address questions of ownership for works created by AI, and consider approaches to maintaining a competitive edge. The program also covers regulatory frameworks for autonomous AI and an assessment of advanced AI tools that are changing IP practice, from patent searching to trademark monitoring.

This gathering is intended for in-house IP counsel, private practice attorneys, and AI service providers. It will feature contributions from experienced professionals, including Carola Lempke from AstraZeneca and Douglas Gordon from Leonardo UK. The aim is to help attendees understand legal frameworks, improve AI governance, and prepare their IP strategies for an AI-driven future.

events.name: The Future of Media Paris 2026
events.description:
Prepare to navigate the evolving landscape of media and communication at The Future of Media Paris 2026, taking place on November 17, 2026, at the prestigious PATHÉ PALACE. This full-day event brings together 700 professionals to examine cross-media and omnichannel strategies. The discussions will be guided by the central theme: "One Market. All Media."

Attendees will engage with over 50 industry leaders, gaining insights from interviews, data-driven studies, and practical examples. The agenda explores significant transformations across various dedicated areas, including retail media, audio, DOOH/OOH, video, social media, and publishing.

The day concludes with The Media Leader's 20th-anniversary "Hall of Fame" ceremony, which will honor 20 influential figures. A reception will follow the ceremony.

events.name: Government at the Speed of Trust 2026
events.description:
Set for November 17, 2026, from 9:00 AM - 1:00 PM EST at Ottawa's Bayview Yards, Government at the Speed of Trust 2026 invites senior leaders from the Government of Canada to explore the transformative power of data and AI. This event, organized by Public Sector Network in partnership with SAS, supports ongoing efforts to strengthen integrity, build public confidence, and deliver services that truly meet citizens' needs.

Discussions will bring together peers to address key strategies for preventing fraud, improving program oversight, and developing sound AI governance. Attendees will have the chance to work with colleagues and experts, exploring how to implement responsible AI through practical safeguards and innovation guided by risk awareness. The aim is to collectively refine approaches for better citizen outcomes and service delivery, informed by data.

Attendance is complimentary for government personnel.

events.name: WBA Compliance Forum Membership & Session 2 2026
events.description:
Essential for Wisconsin's banking compliance professionals and legal counsel, the WBA Compliance Forum Membership & Session 2 2026 offers critical insights and unparalleled networking opportunities. events.name: North America DigitalAxis CIO & AI Assembly Atlanta 2026
events.description:
On November 17, 2026, Atlanta hosts the North America DigitalAxis CIO & AI Assembly, an exclusive Apex Assembly event for visionary technology leaders. This gathering is designed for C-suite executives—CIOs, CDOs, CISOs—and IT professionals from Fortune 500 and Global 2000 companies, offering a space for professional connections, shared learning, and the opportunity to earn valuable CPE credits.

Attendees will participate in discussions led by executives and engage in focused think tanks. These sessions will explore important topics like C-Suite leadership in disruptive technology, the changing responsibilities of CISOs, how AI is reshaping digital strategy, and what's next for tech talent. The event aims to provide strategic ideas and practical insights, drawn directly from peers and industry experts, to help address current trends and challenges in enterprise transformation and cybersecurity.

events.name: North America CyberAxis CISO Transformation Assembly Atlanta 2026
events.description:
Prepare for the future of cybersecurity leadership at the North America CyberAxis CISO Transformation Assembly, convening in Atlanta on November 17, 2026. Participants will also explore the impact of artificial intelligence on leadership and consider strategies for developing future tech talent.

events.name: Atlanta CIO Post-Assembly Private Dinner 2026

This intimate setting provides a valuable opportunity for leaders to exchange ideas, build connections, and gain insights from their peers. It serves as a continuation of the impactful conversations initiated during the preceding DigitalAxis CIO & AI Transformation Assembly.

events.name: Atlanta CISO Pre-Assembly Private Dinner 2026
events.description:
Atlanta's most influential cybersecurity leaders are invited to an exclusive private dinner on November 17, 2026, from 5:00 PM to 9:30 PM. Attendees will have the opportunity to discuss current cybersecurity trends, new technologies, and enterprise solutions that are shaping the future of the industry. It's a chance to meet new colleagues and exchange ideas that advance business technology, all within an environment that supports meaningful, high-level dialogue.

events.name: The AI Summit Cape Town 2026
events.description:
Set to ignite innovation across the continent, The AI Summit Cape Town 2026 will convene from November 17-19 at the Cape Town International Convention Centre. Individuals attending, from telecom operators and hyperscalers to investors and enterprise leaders, will explore key topics such as developing strong AI infrastructure, maintaining cybersecurity, and advancing digital transformation. The program includes discussions with speakers such as Hon. Solly Malatsi and Yasser Shaker.

It offers an opportunity to connect with decision-makers from Africa, Europe, and the Middle East, fostering conversations that could influence the future of technology and support the continent's entrepreneurial landscape.

events.name: THE Innovation & Impact Summit 2026
events.description:

The summit anticipates bringing together over 300 university leaders, founders, investors, and industry innovators. Participants will have the opportunity to explore strategies for scaling innovation and accelerating technology transfer. The agenda includes discussions, practical workshops, and presentations addressing key fields such as AI, biotechnology, climate technology, and advanced manufacturing.

This event seeks to highlight the role universities play in fostering entrepreneurship within a rapidly evolving technological landscape.

events.name: OBL Community Bankers for Compliance Program Session 4 Virtual 2026

Community bankers seeking to navigate the ever-evolving regulatory landscape are invited to OBL Community Bankers for Compliance Program Session 4 Virtual 2026. events.name: MBA FDIC Directors College 2026

Completing the workshop earns an advanced certificate, which acknowledges your expertise in financial integrity and supports your professional development within a continually evolving regulatory landscape.

events.name: BCAC Loan Servicing 2026
events.description:

events.name: Australian Liability Conference 2026

events.name: IBR Leaders in Law Awards 2026

events.name: IPBC Asia 2026

events.name: The Movers & Storers Show 2026

events.name: Idaho Business Review Excellence in Finance Awards 2026

events.name: Food Tech Expo 2026

events.name: International Hotel Technology Forum Asia Pacific 2026
