events.description:
The Singapore Fintech Festival 2026 is set to be the definitive global platform for shaping the future of financial services. As the world's largest FinTech gathering, the festival brings together over 70,000 participants, including central banks, regulators, and industry leaders from 142 countries.

The agenda explores cutting-edge trends such as AI, digital assets, sustainability, and quantum finance, presented across multiple stages. Attendees can utilize the SFF MeetUp program for targeted one-on-one connections and explore groundbreaking innovations during the Innovation Lab Crawl. The festival also features emerging talent at the Global FinTech Hackcelerator and facilitates high-level discussions, serving as a significant convergence point for policy, finance, and technology.

events.name: Slush 2026
events.description:
Igniting the next wave of world-changing ventures, Slush 2026 descends upon Helsinki, Finland, from November 18–19. This event brings together founders, operators, and venture capitalists from over 70 countries. They come with a shared goal: to build and grow early-stage tech companies that can make a significant impact.

Slush is known for its practical approach, offering direct advice on company building through its stage program. People attending can use the Meeting Tool to set up one-on-one conversations. They will also experience Investor Day, which is recognized as the largest gathering for venture capital worldwide. For startups in areas like SaaS, healthtech, AI, or deeptech, Slush 2026 offers a place to find support for growth, secure funding, and meet key individuals within the tech ecosystem.

events.name: Tech Show Paris 2026
events.description:
Prepare for an unparalleled exploration of digital innovation at Tech Show Paris 2026, convening on November 18-19 at Paris Expo Porte de Versailles. This gathering brings together five distinct areas: Cloud & AI Infrastructure, DevOps Live, Cloud & Cyber Security Expo, Data & AI Leaders Summit, and Data Centre World. It offers a comprehensive perspective on the evolving landscape of technology.

The event features more than 150 conference sessions and interactive workshops. Specific initiatives, such as the Espace Start-Up and Women & Diversity in Tech, are also part of the program. Those attending will find insights into hybrid cloud, cybersecurity, applied AI, and DevSecOps. Over 7,900 tech professionals and more than 310 exhibitors are expected to be present, fostering discussions around current trends and opportunities for collaboration among industry leaders.

Admission is free for end-user professionals.

events.name: IFMA World Workplace USA 2026
events.description:
Anaheim, California, will become the epicenter of facility management innovation from November 18-20, 2026, as the Anaheim Convention Center hosts IFMA World Workplace USA 2026. This gathering provides a focused environment for professionals in facility management, workplace strategy, and business innovation to advance their knowledge and careers.

Participants will find opportunities for significant learning, with discussions and presentations covering global perspectives, effective strategies, and emerging trends that are shaping the future of modern facilities. The event includes a comprehensive expo where new products, technologies, and solutions can be seen in action through live demonstrations. It also offers a chance to engage directly with industry leaders.

Throughout the event, there will be various ways to connect with colleagues from different regions, from structured networking sessions to more informal gatherings. The content is designed to be valuable for both experienced professionals and those newer to the field, offering insights and practical knowledge to help shape facility management practices.

events.name: B2B Marketing Live 2026
events.description:
Elevate your B2B marketing strategies at B2B Marketing Live 2026, the UK's premier event for industry professionals. This two-day gathering takes place on 18-19 November at Excel London, offering opportunities to advance your skills and explore new ideas.

Attendees will connect with thousands of marketing leaders, including CMOs, Marketing Directors, Digital Marketing Specialists, and Founders. The event features a program of seminars led by experienced speakers, covering current trends, the integration of AI, and ways to improve operational efficiency.

You can also explore products from a wide range of suppliers and find new solutions within the dedicated Discovery Zone. The event aims to foster new ideas, inspire impactful campaigns, and ultimately help improve marketing practices, providing valuable insights and connections for business growth.

events.name: Cloud & Cyber Security Expo Paris 2026
events.description:
Prepare to navigate the evolving landscape of digital defense at Cloud & Cyber Security Expo Paris 2026. This event takes place on 5 - 6 November at PARIS EXPO PORTE DE VERSAILLES. As part of Tech Show Paris, it brings together over 7,900 IT decision-makers, CISOs, and cybersecurity experts.

Participants can expect to hear from over 320 speakers across 170 sessions. These discussions will explore critical themes such as cloud security, data protection, digital sovereignty, and infrastructure resilience. The program is designed to offer insights into current challenges and future directions in digital defense.

Beyond the main sessions, the Startup Zone will feature new solutions from emerging companies. Innovation in the field will be acknowledged through the Cybersecurity Awards, and there will be opportunities to engage with the Women & Diversity in Tech initiative. The two-day gathering aims to help professionals refine their cyber strategies, foresee potential threats, and update information systems with practical, forward-looking approaches.

events.name: Small Business Expo Phoenix 2026
events.description:
Phoenix's premier event for entrepreneurs and small business owners, the Small Business Expo Phoenix 2025, is set to ignite growth on September 12 at the Phoenix Convention Center. This free event allows attendees to connect with industry experts, potential clients, and partners.

Attendees can explore a trade show showcasing B2B products and services, and attend workshops covering topics such as digital marketing, tax strategies, and AI. Keynote speakers Dave Charest and Tami Cannizzaro will also share their insights.

Networking is facilitated through the Dotted® badge system, Speed Networking sessions, and specialized Industry Meet-Up Sessions. The event aims to provide knowledge and foster connections for those looking to grow their businesses in the Phoenix area.

events.name: Finance & Accounting Technology Expo 2026
events.description:
Set to redefine the future of financial operations, the Finance & Accounting Technology Expo 2026 convenes on November 18-19 at the Javits Convention Center in New York City. This gathering is for finance leaders and senior decision-makers, offering perspectives on digital transformation, AI, and automation.

Participants can find guidance in Learning Theaters, see practical solutions demonstrated in Stack Hacks, and explore emerging innovations on the Pitch Stage. The Exhibit Hall will feature new technologies for evaluation, and there will be opportunities to connect with colleagues.

Keynote speakers Barbara Corcoran, Jamie Hess, and Evy Poumpouras will share insights relevant to technology purchasing decisions, scalability challenges, and improving operational efficiency.

events.name: Call & Contact Centre Expo 2026
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the forefront of customer contact innovation at the Call & Contact Centre Expo 2026. This event takes place at ExCeL London on November 18-19, 2026. Co-located with the Customer Experience Expo, these two days are an opportunity to explore the future of customer engagement.

Visitors will find solutions across key areas like AI, omnichannel communication, staffing, and unified communications. The program includes training workshops, structured one-on-one meetings through the CONNECT program, and opportunities to connect with other professionals. It's a chance to see the newest contact center software, hardware, and strategies that help improve operations and customer interactions.

events.name: FTE APEX Asia Expo 2026
events.description:
Prepare for the aviation industry's most significant gathering as the world converges in Singapore on 18-19 November 2026. This gathering, a result of combining APEX Global EXPO with FTE’s established APAC presence, will be the largest global exhibition focused on the entire passenger experience and innovation. It will bring together airports, airlines, vendors, startups, OEMs, and government agencies from around the world.

Attendees will explore new solutions and strategies that address digital transformation, commercial growth, operational efficiency, and sustainability. They can connect with industry leaders, discover emerging technologies, and participate in conference sessions, expo floor briefings, and the FTE APAC Pioneer Awards.

This event provides a platform to influence the future of air transport and enhance the passenger journey.

events.name: Sales Innovation Expo London 2026
events.description:
Prepare to redefine your sales strategy at the Sales Innovation Expo London 2026. This event will present the latest technologies and approaches shaping the future of sales. Attendees can explore tools ranging from advanced AI and automation to next-generation CRM solutions, all aimed at improving efficiency and increasing revenue.

It's a place to connect with industry leaders, explore practical insights, and strengthen one's competitive position in a rapidly evolving market. The expo offers opportunities to meet with other sales leaders, professionals, and solution providers. For those looking to refine their sales processes, improve team performance, or simply understand emerging trends, the Sales Innovation Expo London 2026 provides a valuable environment for learning and development.

events.name: London EV Show 2026
events.description:
Accelerating the global shift towards sustainable transport, the 5th Edition of the London EV Show 2026 will convene at ExCeL London. This event serves as a significant international gathering for the electric mobility sector, bringing together original equipment manufacturers, suppliers, policymakers, and investors to create a central point for industry discussions.

The exhibition floor will feature the latest electric vehicles, advancements in battery technology, innovations in connected and autonomous systems, and developments in charging infrastructure. Alongside this, a conference program will facilitate discussions, offer practical workshops, and provide opportunities for sharing insights.

Attendees can engage through dedicated networking sessions, a Hosted Buyer Programme, and the Global EV Awards. These elements aim to support the formation of commercial partnerships, encourage dialogue on policy, and contribute to the growth and adoption of electric vehicle technology.

events.name: Handelskongress Deutschland 2026
events.description:
Shape the future of German trade at Handelskongress Deutschland 2026, taking place on November 18 & 19 at the JW Marriott Berlin. This two-day event, organized by HDE and EHI, brings together key individuals from German trade, the consumer goods industry, and political spheres.

Participants will engage in discussions focused on current challenges and new developments, exchanging knowledge to help form future solutions. The congress also features the Verleihung des Deutschen Handelspreises, an award recognizing achievements in innovation and sustainable business practices. The program provides insights into digitalization, artificial intelligence, and modern technologies, offering a setting for professionals to connect and discuss the direction of retail in Germany.

events.name: BME Symposium 2026
events.description:
The 61st BME Symposium 2026, themed PRO:CONNECT26, invites specialists and executives to redefine the future of procurement and supply chain management. This gathering will take place on November 18-19 at STATION Berlin, Germany, offering a dedicated environment for discussing central developments and fostering lasting professional connections. Participants will explore critical topics like digitalization, automation, and artificial intelligence, examining how these forces are shaping a more digital, interconnected, and human future for the sector.

The program includes inspiring keynotes, exclusive Executive Circles, and thematic deep-dive sessions. It aims to offer practical insights and facilitate meaningful discussions, making it an important occasion for the BME community and industry leaders looking for new ideas and fresh perspectives on upcoming challenges and opportunities.

events.name: Connect Winter Marketplace 2026
events.description:
Elevate your event strategy and forge invaluable connections at Connect Winter Marketplace 2026, the premier three-day gathering for corporate and association event professionals in the nation's capital. This event provides a focused environment for professionals to connect, learn, and find solutions relevant to the meetings, incentives, conferences, and exhibitions (MICE) industry.

Attendees will participate in one-on-one appointments, meeting directly with decision-makers and identifying suppliers for conferences, tradeshows, meetings, and sports events. Beyond these meetings, the program includes over four hours of educational content. This learning component features insights from industry leaders, presented through case studies, panel discussions, and keynote addresses. Opportunities for networking are also built into the schedule, allowing for the exchange of ideas and the development of new professional relationships that can support future initiatives.

events.name: Dealbook Summit 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for the Dealbook Summit 2026, an essential gathering returning to New York City on November 18. This year marks 25 years of DealBook, offering a day of significant discussions and fresh perspectives.

The program will feature individuals who are actively influencing the global landscape in business, finance, and technology. Participants can expect to hear directly from these leaders, gaining insights designed to challenge conventional thinking and suggest new paths forward. The conversations will explore the forces shaping tomorrow's world.

The summit is presented by Premier Sponsor Accenture, alongside Associate Sponsors USBank, Vanguard, CapitalOne, and Genentech.

events.name: HR EXPO 2026
events.description:
Set to redefine the landscape of people and team management, HR EXPO 2026 invites industry professionals to IFEMA MADRID, Spain, on November 18-19. This gathering focuses on advancing the Human Resources field, presenting developments in technology, talent management, employee well-being, and professional development.

Those attending will encounter a range of practical solutions, from software for managing teams and AI applications in HR to platforms supporting occupational health and strategies for flexible pay. There will be opportunities to learn from experts in various sessions, see live product demonstrations, and connect with peers and leaders throughout the HR community.

The aim is for participants to discover fresh perspectives and feel more prepared for the evolving demands of HR. Entry is complimentary for all professionals working in human resources, talent management, and business management roles.

events.name: European Pharmacovigilance Congress 2026
events.description:
Celebrating its 10th anniversary, the European Pharmacovigilance Congress 2026 offers a comprehensive exploration of the evolving PV landscape. The event unfolds in two parts: virtual sessions will take place on November 18-19, followed by in-person discussions and workshops at the NH Milan Congress Centre in Assago, Milan, on December 3-4.

Professionals at every career stage, from VPs to those new to pharmacovigilance, will find the program addresses critical areas. Discussions will cover subjects such as AI-driven modeling, real-world evidence, gene therapies, and the latest global regulatory updates.

Individuals working in pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, medical devices, and regulatory bodies can expect to participate in 27 distinct topics, 24 round tables, and specialized workshops. These sessions are designed to help participants refine their operational approaches and gain new strategic perspectives, serving as a valuable forum for those contributing to the future of drug safety.

events.name: MEDevice Silicon Valley 2026
events.description:
MEDevice Silicon Valley 2026, set for November 18-19 at the Santa Clara Convention Center, is the definitive gathering for MedTech innovation. It brings together over 1,100 medical device professionals, from engineers to C-suite executives, with more than 150 leading suppliers and strategic partners.

The program includes over 20 hours of educational content, offering practical insights through hands-on workshops and fireside chats. These sessions will explore topics such as AI/IoT convergence and the evolving medical device supply chain. On the expo floor, attendees can explore cutting-edge components and manufacturing services, and engage with over 30 thought leaders from prominent OEMs.

Structured networking opportunities are available to foster meaningful collaborations. This event provides a setting for professionals to discuss and shape the future of healthcare technology.

events.name: HR FORUM - People & Culture 2026
events.description:
Prepare to amplify the 'People Voice' at the 18th HR FORUM - People & Culture 2026, convening in Milan, Italy, on November 18-19. This gathering brings together more than 3,000 HR Directors, C-Level Executives, and senior managers. The focus will be on understanding and responding to the significant social, technological, and organizational changes that are currently reshaping how we work.

Over two days, with themes centered on Talent & Innovation and Talent & Wellbeing, participants will hear from more than 400 speakers. Discussions will cover strategies for using AI effectively, building skill-focused organizations, improving employee wellbeing, and adapting to global changes.

The Forum offers various ways to participate, whether in person, digitally, or through a hybrid 'phygital' experience. It provides an opportunity for learning, connecting with peers, and working together to shape people and culture strategies for 2026 and the years that follow.

events.name: North American Blockchain Summit 2026
events.description:
Set for November 18th-19th, 2026, the North American Blockchain Summit will gather in Texas, under the esteemed host, the Texas Blockchain Council. This gathering, centered around the theme "Blueprints," brings together C-suite executives, policymakers, and leading innovators. They will work towards establishing the technical, energy, and regulatory frameworks crucial for North America's leadership in digital assets.

The summit provides a setting to advance the secure development of future infrastructure. Participants will refine industry plans, strengthen key partnerships, and collaborate on building a resilient digital future. This work aims to foster global growth and leadership within the blockchain ecosystem.

events.name: Broadband Nation Expo 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for Broadband Nation Expo 2026, the definitive event for advancing end-to-end broadband deployment and innovation. From November 18-20, the Hilton Riverside New Orleans will host over 1,000 tech leaders, policymakers, and internet providers, including more than 200 CSPs and ISPs, alongside government representatives. The primary focus of this gathering is to collaboratively close America's digital divide.

Discussions will cover critical areas such as the future of fiber, advancements in wireless technology, workforce development, and practical strategies for achieving digital equity. Attendees will have over 20 hours of dedicated networking opportunities, including exclusive curated meetings facilitated by Broadband Nation Connect. They can also explore solutions presented by more than 100 exhibitors. This event, a partnership between Questex and TIA, is designed for individuals and organizations dedicated to expanding internet access across the country.

events.name: SVIN Annual Meeting 2026
events.description:
Prepare for an unparalleled gathering at the SVIN Annual Meeting 2026, taking place November 18-20 at Resorts World Las Vegas. This event commemorates 20 years of the Society of Vascular and Interventional Neurology, drawing together leading experts, researchers, and practitioners in the field. Participants will explore the latest advancements in stroke and neurointervention, examining current research and innovative techniques that continue to evolve the standard of care, particularly in "pulling clots, restoring flow."

The meeting will include a range of engaging sessions, impactful discussions, keynote lectures, and interactive workshops. It offers a chance to connect with colleagues, collaborate on new ideas, and acknowledge two decades of progress. The environment supports new discoveries and professional development.

events.name: European Pizza Show 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for the European Pizza Show 2026, Europe's leading event dedicated to the vibrant world of pizza. This gathering takes place on 18-19 November at ExCeL London, designed for professionals across the UK and European catering sectors, pizza businesses, and anyone with pizza on their menu.

Attendees will find over 300 international exhibitors showcasing ingredients, innovative products, professional equipment, and technological solutions. It's an opportunity to explore what's new and effective in the industry.

The event also features the European Pizza Forum, where industry leaders will share insights. You can watch the European Pizza Chef Competition, highlighting 42 emerging talents, and acknowledge achievements at the 50 Top World Artisan Pizza Chains ceremony. It's a chance to understand current trends and sustainable practices influencing the pizza and hospitality industry.

events.name: AbilityNet TechShare Pro 2026
events.description:
Celebrating its 10th anniversary, AbilityNet TechShare Pro 2026 is set to be Europe's largest gathering for the accessibility and disability inclusion community. The event will be held on 18 and 19 November, offering an in-person experience at The Drum Wembley, London, alongside free virtual access.

Over these two days, the conference will explore important subjects including AI, accessibility and trust, financial inclusion, responsible AI, culture change, and Tech4Good showcases. Participants can expect to hear from industry and policy leaders, engage in breakout sessions focused on innovation and tech policy, and connect with others in the field. HSBC and Microsoft are supporting the event as platinum sponsors.

All attendees will receive access to three months of post-event recordings. For those attending in person, the experience also includes an evening reception and access to the exhibition. The gathering serves to further progress in digital inclusion.

events.name: Sales Enablement Summit Chicago 2026
events.description:
Unlock the future of sales enablement at the Sales Enablement Summit Chicago 2026, taking place on November 18 & 19. This summit is designed for enablement leaders and senior decision-makers interested in applying AI-driven strategies and automation to improve operational efficiency.

Attendees will explore established approaches for connecting enablement efforts directly to business goals, assessing return on investment, and using data to make decisions that enhance sales representative performance. The event brings together more than 30 experienced speakers and a network of over 150 senior management professionals from leading organizations, encouraging collaboration among sales, marketing, and RevOps teams.

Participants can refine their current strategies, learn how to expand programs effectively for growth, and improve their go-to-market processes. It offers an opportunity to understand current industry directions and enhance the effectiveness of enablement initiatives.

events.name: Breakbulk Asia 2026
events.description:
The global project cargo and breakbulk industry converges in Singapore for Breakbulk Asia 2026, taking place on 18-19 November at the Sands Expo and Convention Centre, Marina Bay Sands. This event marks its return to the region after fifteen years, bringing together over 3,000 industry professionals from more than 50 countries.

Attendees will have the opportunity to meet with over 100 exhibitors and hear from more than 60 expert speakers. The discussions will offer a deeper understanding of Asia's energy and infrastructure sectors. The conference program will explore topics such as large-scale renewable energy projects, project cargo financing, and the evolving demands shaping logistics and transportation.

This gathering provides a setting for individuals to connect with cargo owners, EPCs, and specialized transporters. It offers a chance to discuss potential collaborations and understand the strategic importance of Singapore as a financial and maritime hub in Asia.

events.name: Personalized Medicine Conference 2026
events.description:
Set to redefine the landscape of patient care, the Personalized Medicine Conference 2026 convenes on November 18-19 at the Hyatt Regency Boston/Cambridge in Cambridge, MA.

This two-day event will gather professionals from biopharmaceuticals, clinical practice, policy-making, and technology development. It brings together these diverse experts to share their perspectives and collective knowledge regarding the future of personalized medicine.

Attendees will engage in discussions exploring new ideas and practical approaches. The agenda facilitates conversations around current research, innovative solutions, and the challenges involved in transforming patient care. It's a setting where individuals can connect with peers, learn from those at the forefront of scientific discovery, and explore potential collaborations that could influence the future of healthcare.

events.name: Sustainable Agriculture Summit 2026
events.description:
The collective future of the U.S. food system takes center stage at the Sustainable Agriculture Summit 2026. On November 18 and 19, 2026, the Fort Worth Convention Center in Fort Worth, Texas, will bring together farmers, suppliers, processors, brands, academics, conservation groups, and public sector leaders.

This gathering aims to connect everyone involved in the food and agriculture value chain, encouraging shared learning and progress. Those attending can participate in breakout sessions, workshops, and roundtable discussions. These activities are structured to help develop a common understanding and path toward a sustainable and resilient U.S. food system.

With support from partners such as NestlePurina, COBK, and McDonald's, the summit provides a setting for people to connect, share new ideas, and work together on the future of agricultural practices.

events.name: Future of Work APAC 2026
events.description:
Discover the strategies shaping tomorrow's workplaces at Future of Work APAC 2026, convening on 18-19 November 2026 at Marina Bay Sands, Singapore. This gathering is intended for leaders in HR, People, Talent, L&D, and Employee Experience from across the Asia-Pacific region.

Discussions will center on critical themes such as evolving workplace structures, creating resilient organizations, and fostering environments where people feel engaged, included, and supported. To facilitate deeper exploration, the event is structured around three distinct tracks: Change & Transformation, People & Experience, and Learning & Leadership. These tracks will provide opportunities to delve into how AI, smart technology, and developing future-ready skills can help organizations realize their full capabilities.

It's an occasion to connect with senior leaders, share perspectives, and acquire practical approaches for navigating the dynamic landscape of modern work.

events.name: Asset Performance International Conference 2026
events.description:
The Asset Performance International Conference 2026, powered by BEMAS, stands as Europe's leading forum for digital transformation in Maintenance and Asset Management. The conference will take place at the Flanders Meeting & Convention Center Antwerp, bringing together reliability engineers, maintenance managers, and digitization professionals from across Europe.

Attendees can expect to explore ways to improve equipment reliability, manage costs more effectively, and build stronger, more sustainable operations. Discussions will cover the latest advancements, including AI systems, Asset Management 5.0, Predictive and Prescriptive Maintenance, and the Industrial Internet of Things.

It offers a chance to exchange knowledge, share experiences, and connect with industry leaders who are shaping the future of asset performance.

events.name: Data Centre World Paris 2026
events.description:
Prepare for the next era of digital infrastructure at Data Centre World Paris 2026, taking place November 18–19 at PARIS EXPO PORTE DE VERSAILLES. This gathering focuses on shaping the future of data centers, addressing key challenges such as AI integration, energy efficiency, and operational resilience.

Attendees will find solutions in areas like liquid cooling, infrastructure designed for AI, and physical security, presented by more than 310 exhibitors. It's an opportunity to connect with decision-makers, experts, and suppliers, discussing ways to enhance performance, manage costs, and plan for future capacity needs. A new feature for 2026 is the Immersive Hub Data Center, providing practical scenarios to evaluate resilience strategies.

An event pass also includes access to co-located Tech Show Paris events, broadening perspectives across cloud technologies, AI, and cybersecurity. This allows for a comprehensive understanding of the evolving digital landscape.

events.name: Deutsche Bank Global Space Summit 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for a pivotal gathering in the burgeoning space economy. The Deutsche Bank Global Space Summit 2026, taking place in New York, NY, on November 18, brings together key figures from across the space sector. This event provides C-suite executives, forward-thinking companies, and investors a unique opportunity to delve into the latest developments shaping the industry.

Those attending will hear directly from leading voices and participate in focused one-on-one discussions, facilitating direct conversations between financial resources and innovative projects. It's a chance to understand emerging trends, identify investment possibilities, and build relationships that will advance the future of space exploration and commercialization.

This summit serves as an important forum for individuals driving innovation and exploring the significant opportunities within the global space economy.

events.name: Brand Insider Summit CPG Fall 2026
events.description:
For CPG brand leaders seeking unparalleled insights and connections, the Brand Insider Summit CPG Fall 2026 offers an essential gathering.

This event brings together brand marketers, agency professionals, and industry partners from the Consumer Packaged Goods sector. It takes place from November 18-21, 2026, in Santa Barbara, CA, providing a setting for focused discussions on the challenges and opportunities facing CPG brands.

The agenda features formal presentations and strategic meetings, complemented by informal networking and group activities. These sessions are structured to facilitate an exchange of perspectives on current trends and pressing issues within the CPG industry, allowing professionals to connect with their peers.

events.name: Agentic + Generative AI for Insurance USA 2026

location.venue: The Westin New York at Times Square

events.description:
Elevate your insurance enterprise with the transformative power of Agentic and Generative AI at this premier USA summit. The event will be held on November 18-19, 2026, at The Westin New York at Times Square, bringing together over 200 senior AI experts and decision-makers. Attendees will explore strategies for scaling AI from initial pilot projects to comprehensive, enterprise-wide applications, with a focus on achieving measurable returns across key areas like underwriting, claims processing, and operational workflows.

The program features more than 30 C-level speakers, presenting across two distinct tracks. These sessions will delve into real-world use cases and practical strategies for implementing AI. Discussions will also cover establishing robust data foundations, developing effective governance frameworks, and building testing capabilities crucial for responsible AI adoption.

The gathering offers a setting for connecting with leading innovators, considering new approaches to customer experiences, and exploring how intelligent automation can contribute to profitable growth.

events.name: Data + AI World Tour Los Angeles 2026
events.description:
The Data + AI World Tour arrives in Southern California on November 18, 2026, at the Anaheim Marriott, bringing global insights to the local data and AI community. This one-day gathering is designed for data professionals, engineers, and AI enthusiasts interested in the latest developments. Participants will explore recent advancements, such as practical applications of Apache Spark, and discuss approaches to improve their data projects.

The event offers opportunities to hear from leading experts and connect with colleagues. Senior leaders will also have a specific Executive Roundtable for strategic discussions. The aim is for attendees to leave with a clearer understanding of the evolving data and AI landscape.

events.name: AI in Healthcare & Pharma Summit 2026
events.description:
The AI in Healthcare & Pharma Summit 2026, set for November 18-19 in Boston, offers a deep dive into the transformative power of artificial intelligence in medicine. The summit explores how artificial intelligence and machine learning can enhance clinical practice and improve patient care. Discussions will cover advancements in personalized medicine, sophisticated diagnostics, direct patient care applications, robotics, natural language processing, and medical imaging.

Participants will hear from leading figures like Ellie Norris of Merck and Ramya Palacholla from EVINOVA. The program also includes insights from Maithra Raghu of Google Brain and Brendan Frey of Deep Genomics.

The event provides an opportunity for data scientists, researchers, and directors to understand practical AI applications within the industry and consider future directions in health.

events.name: ESCAIDE 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for ESCAIDE 2026, the premier European Scientific Conference on Applied Infectious Disease Epidemiology, taking place from November 18-20. This hybrid event brings together professionals and researchers, both in Stockholm and online, to discuss current progress and ongoing challenges in infectious disease control.

The preliminary programme will feature research findings, presentations, and opportunities for discussion. Individuals attending in person have the option of a pre-conference workshop on November 17th, which will offer practical learning.

Registration is free for all participants. The conference facilitates knowledge exchange and networking among those working in public health epidemiology.

events.name: New York CISO Community Executive Summit Winter 2026
events.description:
New York's leading cybersecurity executives will converge on November 18, 2026, at Convene at 30 Hudson Yards for the New York CISO Community Executive Summit Winter 2026. This one-day program, developed by CISOs for their peers, is intended for C-level and senior security leaders from organizations with over $500M in revenue.

The agenda includes interactive sessions and discussions where participants can address current challenges. Topics will cover strengthening security against unpredictable threats, improving cyber resilience for critical operations, and managing the complexities of GenAI innovation through practical governance. Attendees will also explore emerging attack vectors, such as deepfakes, and hear strategic perspectives from global thought leaders.

The summit, facilitated by Evanta, a Gartner company, aims to create an environment for meaningful connections among security leaders. It offers an opportunity to exchange ideas and develop practical strategies for navigating the evolving digital environment.

events.name: Smart Technology Expo 2026
events.description:
Set to redefine Mexico's industrial landscape, the Smart Technology Expo 2026 will converge at EXPO GUADALAJARA from November 18 to 20. This gathering represents a key moment for Industry 4.0 in Mexico, focusing on how to speed up industrial progress and build the country's capacity for technological innovation. Professionals from various industries will attend, looking for the latest smart technologies and solutions that can truly make a difference.

The expo provides a space for businesses to grow their reach, build important connections, and strengthen their identity among a diverse group of industry players. Attendees can explore innovations that are shaping the future of industry, connect with experts, and find new avenues for growth and working together. This is a place where the future direction of Mexican industry becomes clearer.

events.name: SiGraDi 2026
events.description:
The Ibero-American Society of Digital Graphics (SIGraDi) proudly presents its 30th international congress, SiGraDi 2026, returning to the Universidad de Chile in Santiago from November 18-20. Hosted by the Facultad de Arquitectura y Urbanismo, this year's congress will explore the theme "Beyond AI_ded Design: Looking Forward, Looking Backward." It will consider how algorithmic structures, intelligent environments, and AI-mediated autonomous systems are influencing design, architecture, and urbanism.

Participants from academic, professional, and creative communities will explore topics such as generative design, digital fabrication, extended reality, and smart cities. Discussions will also address the critical environmental and ethical considerations inherent in computational architecture.

The congress will encourage conversations about new forms of cognition, agency, and distributed processes, considering how these shape project-based practices with a necessary focus on technological ethics.

events.name: Concordance Club November 2026
events.description:
Prepare for an unparalleled gathering of digital and cybersecurity leaders at the Concordance Club November 2026 convention, held from November 18-20 at the exquisite Hôtel Carlton in Cannes. This three-day event will convene over 200 senior decision-makers, including CISOs, CIOs, CTOs, and AI/Cloud/Data Directors, for focused discussions on key industry topics.

The program includes insightful conferences, curated one-on-one meetings, and interactive workshops. These sessions are structured to encourage collective reflection on the evolving landscape of cybersecurity and digital transformation.

Overlooking the sea, the convention provides a setting for meaningful business interactions and connections. The design of the event supports open dialogue and the exchange of perspectives, allowing for valuable insights to emerge without rigid constraints.

events.name: Agentic and Generative AI for Insurance 2026
events.description:
Prepare to explore the cutting edge of insurance innovation at Agentic and Generative AI for Insurance 2026, returning to New York City on November 18.

The event typically brings together over 200 professionals, with a significant majority (80%) holding senior management positions. This gathering offers an opportunity to engage with peers and leaders, fostering discussions that can help shape future strategies and leadership within the field.

events.name: NexGen Retail Summit Amsterdam 2026
events.description:
Prepare to redefine the future of retail at the NexGen Retail Summit Amsterdam 2026, held on November 18-19 at the Mövenpick Hotel. This gathering brings together Europe’s key executives in retail, technology, and infrastructure to examine how AI, automation, and data intelligence are transforming the industry.

Across two days, participants will hear from over 30 global industry leaders, including specialists from companies like L'Oréal and IKEA. Discussions will delve into topics such as agentic commerce, AI-powered supply chains, and the changing payments landscape. There will also be conversations around hyper-personalisation, how retail media can be monetised, and understanding EU regulations, including the AI Act.

Opportunities for connecting with peers are built into the schedule, including a reception by the canal. This event is designed for senior leaders focused on driving change within the retail sector.

events.name: HR Innovators Summit New York Fall 2026
events.description:
On Wednesday, November 18, 2026, the HR Innovators Summit arrives in New York, gathering the brightest minds in human resources. This event is for senior HR leaders and professionals from leading organizations who are focused on redefining the future of work.

Participants will explore current strategies, emerging technologies, and new approaches influencing talent management, employee experience, and organizational culture. The program offers insights from experienced professionals, opportunities for in-depth discussions, and a chance to connect with peers dedicated to advancing HR practices. This setting allows leaders to gain understanding and build relationships that support their efforts in fostering innovation and preparing their organizations for what lies ahead.

events.name: Saudi Trade Finance Summit 2026
events.description:
The 14th Annual Saudi Trade Finance Summit 2026, scheduled for November 18-19 in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, is set to be a landmark event for the region's financial landscape. This two-day summit will bring together over 400 senior leaders and 300 high-level decision-makers, including CFOs, CEOs, and Heads of Treasury, from government, public, and private sectors.

Those attending will gain valuable insights into trade finance's critical role in advancing Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 and its economic diversification efforts. The agenda includes presentations on current topics, engaging panel discussions, and a CEO Roundtable designed to address challenges and explore innovative solutions.

The event will also feature a pitch contest showcasing digital pioneers in trade finance and will recognize industry excellence at the STF Awards. Participants will have the chance to build strategic relationships, share ideas, and consider the future directions of trade, capital, technology, and risk management.

events.name: Ras Al Khaimah Investment & Business Summit 2026
events.description:
"Bridging Markets, Building Alliances" defines the essence of the 3rd Annual Ras Al Khaimah Investment & Business Summit 2026. The event will be held on 11-12 November at the RAK Exhibition Center, UAE. It provides an opportunity to understand Ras Al Khaimah's ongoing evolution into a global investment and development hub.

Attendees can engage with leaders who influence policy and capital flows during the conference. The exhibition will showcase innovative, investment-ready projects, and opportunities exist to form strategic partnerships through dedicated networking and a Buyer Programme. The summit brings together a varied international and regional audience, including sovereign wealth funds, real estate developers, tech innovators, sustainable energy pioneers, and tourism operators. Discussions will cover critical themes such as AI, green economy, smart cities, and infrastructure development, all relevant to growth within this market.

events.name: DataCentres Ireland 2026
events.description:
Ireland's digital infrastructure future will take centre stage at DataCentres Ireland 2026, held on 18-19 November at the RDS in Dublin. This two-day gathering brings together professionals from Ireland's data centre sector. It provides a space for people to explore new technologies, exchange ideas, and contribute to the industry's direction.

Those attending will find an exhibition, free to enter, displaying a wide range of products and services relevant to data centres. Alongside this, a conference with multiple tracks will offer in-depth discussions and perspectives. The event is designed for decision-makers, operators, service providers, and innovators to meet, share knowledge, and advance the industry. It receives support from organizations such as Cloud Infrastructure Ireland and the Data Centre Alliance.

events.name: Elite CIO/CISO NYC 2026

location.venue: JW Marriott Essex House New York

events.description:
An unparalleled evening of strategic connection awaits at the Elite CIO/CISO NYC 2026. On November 18th, 2026, from 5:30 PM to 9:30 PM, senior technology executives will gather at the J.W. Marriott Essex House in New York City for an invite-only event. This intimate gathering is designed specifically for Chief Information Officers and Chief Information Security Officers, including those from global organizations such as Nike, Coca-Cola, and Volvo.

The evening begins with cocktails and hors d'oeuvres, leading into a focused networking session where attendees can connect with various partners. A dinner follows, providing an opportunity for peer-to-peer collaboration and discussions on the future of IT leadership and cybersecurity. Attendance is limited to maintain an environment conducive to meaningful conversations and building professional relationships.

events.name: AI in Financial Services Summit USA 2026
events.description:
The future of finance, powered by artificial intelligence, takes center stage on November 18, 2026, at Convene, One Liberty Plaza, New York City. This first-ever AI in Financial Services Summit USA 2026 brings together over 200 senior leaders from major financial institutions, insurers, and wealth management firms. Nearly 40% of those attending hold a Director-level position or higher. The discussions will center on practical AI strategies and how they can deliver measurable returns.

Over 44 expert speakers, including Stephanie Richard from Ally Financial and Hariom Tatsat from Barclays, will share insights. Their presentations will cover advanced applications of Generative AI, Agentic AI, responsible AI development, and navigating regulatory compliance. Participants can expect to gain practical frameworks and roadmaps to advance their AI projects. The event also provides opportunities to connect with senior decision-makers and observe AI applications firsthand through demonstrations from over 24 exhibitors.

The goal is for attendees to leave with concrete ideas that can shape their organization's approach to AI.

events.name: CADEK Digital Marketing Conference 2026
events.description:
Unlock the future of digital marketing at the CADEK Digital Marketing Conference 2026, a premier two-day event held on 11 & 12 November at Cape Town's iconic Mount Nelson Hotel. This gathering is for professionals and teams keen to understand and navigate the evolving digital landscape, offering practical approaches and fresh ideas.

Discussions will explore key areas, from digital marketing strategy and content creation to data analytics, search engine optimization, and marketing automation. The aim is for participants to leave with concrete strategies they can apply to improve marketing effectiveness, generate more leads, increase sales, and spark new ideas within their organizations.

The ticket covers full access to both days of the conference, along with refreshments, lunch, and parking. This arrangement is designed to ensure a smooth and focused experience, allowing attendees to concentrate on learning and applying new knowledge for their professional growth and business success.

events.name: Corporate Tax Strategies & Experiences 2026
events.description:
The global tax landscape is undergoing unprecedented transformation, and the 14th Corporate Tax Strategies & Experiences Forum 2026 offers a critical platform to address these shifts. Professionals will convene at the Radisson Blu Centre, Rusland 17, to explore the most pressing challenges and innovations across corporate, transfer pricing, and international tax.

Discussions will feature perspectives from leading tax authorities and global heads of tax representing multinational corporations such as Mercedes-Benz, Microsoft, Uber, and H&M. The program will cover key topics including the implementation of Pillar 1 & 2, strategies for leveraging AI and automation to enhance tax efficiency, M&A tax structuring, and effective tax risk management.

Participants will also examine approaches to tax function transformation, achieving operational excellence, and fostering successful cooperation with tax authorities. The forum provides a setting for senior tax professionals to enhance their expertise, share experiences, and build valuable connections within a rapidly evolving regulatory landscape.

events.name: Regulatory Compliance for Financial Institutions 2026
events.description:
Navigating the complex and ever-evolving landscape of financial regulations is critical for institutional success. On November 18–19, 2026, Toronto's One King West Hotel & Residence will host Regulatory Compliance for Financial Institutions 2026, a program designed to provide essential guidance for Chief Compliance Officers, CROs, CAMLOs, and senior compliance professionals across Canada.

This two-day program brings together 37 expert speakers across 18 key sessions. The discussions will explore risk mitigation, innovation in compliance practices, and strategies for updating operations to enhance clarity and build trust with customers. Participants can expect to gain practical knowledge to anticipate changes in standards and strengthen their compliance frameworks.

The agenda includes interactive roundtable discussions, a simulated regulatory exam, and demonstrations of financial technologies. Professionals attending will also have the opportunity to earn CPD & CIRO credits and connect with colleagues from prominent Canadian financial institutions.

events.name: World Business Forum Milano 2026
events.description:
Prepare to redefine organizational potential at the World Business Forum Milano 2026, taking place on November 18 & 19 at Allianz MiCo Milano Congressi.

This two-day event, themed "Transcend: how to build limitless organizations," brings together 3,000 executives and professionals. It offers a dedicated space to explore how organizations can thrive amidst continuous change.

The program features insights from speakers like Justin Trudeau, discussing leadership; Rita McGrath, focusing on growth strategy; and Zack Kass, who will delve into AI. Through a series of keynotes and practical sessions, participants will uncover actionable strategies for innovation, talent development, creativity, and high performance. The goal is to equip organizations to move beyond simply enduring challenges, enabling them to truly flourish. The forum also provides avenues for professional interaction and continued learning.

events.name: NYSADA Convention and Business Meeting 2026
events.description:
New York State's top automobile dealers are invited to the 103rd Annual NYSADA Convention and Business Meeting 2026, set for November 18–22 at the exquisite JW Marriott Marco Island Beach Resort. This gathering brings together important business discussions with opportunities for professional development. Those attending can expect to participate in key discussions, exchange industry insights, and build connections with colleagues from across the state.

Beyond the scheduled sessions, the convention also allows for time to relax and foster relationships in a beachfront environment. The five days are dedicated to business advancement, complemented by the available amenities, and supported by Diamond Sponsors Snyads Inc. and Zurich. It's an opportunity to enhance expertise and expand professional networks.

events.name: Maryland Travel & Tourism Summit 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for a landmark occasion as the Maryland Travel & Tourism Summit 2026 convenes in Baltimore City. Celebrating its 45th anniversary, this annual conference brings together over 300 professionals from Maryland's hospitality and tourism sectors. Attendees, including those from business and public sectors, will explore strategies for advancing the state's tourism economy.

The program includes keynote sessions, interactive breakout discussions, and the annual MTTS Awards Banquet. Attendees will also find the Maryland Tourism Coalition Annual Meeting and a Welcome Reception, providing opportunities for connection. The event offers a chance to explore current industry trends, participate in professional development, and collaborate with peers on the future direction of Maryland tourism.

events.name: National Conference on Student Life 2026
events.description:
Prepare to elevate campus experiences and empower student voices at the National Conference on Student Life 2026. This virtual event, scheduled for November 18-19, 2026, will gather student leaders and student affairs professionals from across the country. Participants will explore practical strategies designed to strengthen student engagement, foster collaboration, and enhance the overall student experience.

The program includes four keynote presentations and 24 interactive workshops. These sessions will address key topics such as developing effective student leadership, leveraging AI in student life, and expanding engagement to all student populations. Participants can also connect with peers through live networking opportunities.

For continued learning, all sessions will be available on-demand until February 28, 2027. This allows attendees to revisit content and deepen their understanding.

events.name: CISO New Zealand 2026
events.description:
New Zealand's premier information security leaders will gather on 18-19 November 2026 for a critical two-day summit. This event brings together over 350 senior decision-makers, including CISOs, CIOs, and Heads of Cyber Security from across Aotearoa, to address the challenges of an evolving threat landscape.

Discussions will explore key areas such as governing AI, managing complex SaaS environments, fostering secure behaviors, and leading teams effectively under sustained resource pressure. Over 30 expert speakers, including Alastair Miller from Genesis Energy and Catherine Buhler from Fonterra, will share their insights, providing practical approaches to strengthening an organization's cyber defenses.

The summit provides an environment for professionals to engage in peer-led conversations, compare current practices, and connect with others within New Zealand's information security community. It's an opportunity to exchange ideas and build professional relationships.

events.name: Southwest Ideas Conference 2026
events.description:
Exclusively tailored for the discerning investment community, the Southwest Ideas Conference 2026 is set to unfold at The Westin Irving Convention Center Las Colinas in Irving, Texas. This invitation-only gathering brings together leading investors and more than 75 innovative companies ready to share their latest developments.

Conceived by investors for investors, the conference provides a focused environment to discover promising ventures and build strategic relationships. Those attending will participate in company presentations and engage in structured one-on-one meetings, allowing for direct and detailed discussions.

The aim is to connect capital with innovative ideas, supporting future growth and identifying meaningful investment prospects.

events.name: The 50 Best Vineyards 2026
events.description:
Prepare to uncork the world's most exceptional wine destinations with the highly anticipated release of The 50 Best Vineyards 2026. This annual ranking highlights vineyards worldwide, acknowledging their exceptional wine production, memorable visitor experiences, and dedication to quality.

The ranking will reveal the top 50 and 51-100 vineyards, along with special recognitions such as 'Highest New Entry' and 'Best in Region' awards. It offers guidance for wine professionals, enthusiasts, and travelers, encouraging exploration and influencing how people experience wine travel. The list points to places leading the way in quality, innovation, and sustainable practices.

events.name: WIPR Trade Secrets Europe 2026
events.description:
WIPR Trade Secrets Europe 2026, taking place on November 18 in Brussels, Belgium, offers an essential forum for in-house counsel and senior decision-makers navigating the complex world of confidential assets. Participants will gain practical, cross-border perspectives on identifying, protecting, and defending trade secrets. This is especially relevant given the evolving global regulations and increasing cyber threats. The discussions will delve into the intersection of AI, policy, and strategy, offering approaches to cross-border litigation and effective responses to breaches.

The event is structured to foster meaningful connections, with a balanced representation of in-house counsel and other senior decision-makers. This environment allows for direct conversations with leading IP experts. For those interested in a broader understanding of AI's influence on intellectual property strategy, a related event, AI & IP Europe, takes place on November 17 at the same location.

events.name: Supercrowd Happy Hour November 2026
events.description:
Discover the latest in impact crowdfunding this November with a special edition of SuperCrowdHour. Devin Thorpe will host this free, insightful hour on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, focusing on purpose-driven investment. The online event is for individuals interested in using capital to create social good.

The broadcast will be available live online and through various media channels. Expert guests will share practical tactics and insights, followed by a live Q&A session. This gathering offers a chance to connect with others who are committed to making a difference through crowdfunding. The Super Crowd, Inc. produces this monthly gathering.

events.name: eTourism Marketplace 2026
events.description:
Prepare to redefine the future of travel at eTourism Marketplace 2026, the premier event for destination marketers, held this November in Palm Beach, Florida. The event focuses on innovation in destination marketing, exploring how digital tools can transform travel experiences.

Attendees will hear from industry leaders in education sessions, sharing strategies relevant to tourism marketers. A key feature involves one-on-one business meetings, facilitated by AI, which arrange up to 35 connections in a speed-dating format between DMO leaders and industry suppliers. This approach helps participants connect with relevant partners and build targeted relationships.

Fifty hosted destination marketers will receive complimentary travel and accommodation, allowing them to focus fully on the discussions and collaborations that will influence the future of tourism.

events.name: IDC CIO Summit 2026
events.description:
Anticipate a pivotal gathering for technology leaders at the IDC CIO Summit 2026. This forum brings together Chief Information Officers and senior IT decision-makers, offering them the insights and strategies necessary to navigate the evolving digital landscape.

Participants will delve into emerging technologies and key market trends. Discussions will focus on accelerating digital transformation, optimizing IT infrastructure, and leveraging data and AI for strategic advantage.

It's an occasion for CIOs to exchange ideas with peers, share best practices, and discover solutions that foster business growth and resilience. The summit provides IDC's expert analysis and a community of leaders, supporting efforts to shape an organization's technological future.

events.name: Work Style Reform EXPO Osaka 2026
events.description:
Work Style Reform EXPO Osaka 2026 offers a crucial platform for businesses seeking to revolutionize their operations. Organized by RX Japan, it is designed for professionals in General Affairs, HR, Management, and DX/IT Promotion, many of whom hold executive decision-making roles.

Attendees will discover the latest in AI agents, RPA, remote work support, and data analysis tools. This setting allows for direct discussions with solution providers and efficient information gathering.

events.name: Employee Benefits EXPO Osaka 2026
events.description:

This event is designed for professionals in General Affairs, HR, and Management who are looking to improve employee satisfaction, strengthen their recruitment efforts, and streamline operational processes.

Attendees will find a wide range of services, including comprehensive benefit outsourcing, office catering, engaging leisure programs, and support for asset formation. events.name: Sustainability Management Week Osaka 2026
events.description:
Sustainability Management Week Osaka 2026, formerly GREEN TRANSFORMATION WEEK, is set to drive global carbon neutrality from INTEX Osaka, Japan, from November 18-20. Recognized as Japan's largest exhibition dedicated to environmental management and sustainable resource utilization, it offers valuable insights for managers, sustainability professionals, and supply chain personnel.

Participants can explore innovative solutions for reducing corporate carbon emissions, fostering a circular economy, and optimizing supply chain management. The program is expected to feature 80 conference sessions and 230 exhibitors. Key components include the DECARBONISATION EXPO, which features "Industrial Heat Decarbonisation World," alongside concurrent SMART ENERGY WEEK shows such as PV EXPO and BATTERY JAPAN. This year also introduces I-TEX Japan [Osaka] 1st Thermal Energy Expo, focusing on industrial and commercial decarbonization.

With an anticipated 12,000 participants, the event provides an opportunity to explore strategies and engage with peers, contributing to an organization's sustainable future.

events.name: SNS & Influencer Utilization EXPO Osaka 2026
events.description:
Unlock the full potential of your digital presence at the SNS & Influencer Utilization EXPO Osaka 2026, taking place from November 18 to 20, 2026, at Intex Osaka. This exhibition focuses on how businesses can effectively share information and build customer connections using social media.

The event showcases various approaches to social media management, from creating short videos and using advanced analytical tools to developing effective influencer marketing plans. As part of the larger Marketing Week, it offers a chance to see different social media solutions, learn from recent successes, and pick up practical skills.

Marketing managers and PR professionals attending will find useful perspectives and opportunities to connect with others, helping them improve how their brands communicate and achieve better outcomes on social media. The broader Marketing Week brings together nine distinct shows, providing a wide range of marketing insights all in one location.

events.name: Sales Support EXPO Osaka 2026
events.description:
Transform your sales operations and drive unprecedented growth at Sales Support EXPO Osaka 2026, held from November 18-20 at Intex Osaka. Attendees will find a wide range of solutions, from core SFA, MA, and CRM platforms to advanced sales DX tools and support for inside sales. The event also highlights new AI services designed for negotiation, predicting opportunities, and automating reports. The focus is on practical approaches that can boost efficiency, reduce dependence on individual performance, and help create consistent, repeatable results across a sales team.

It offers an opportunity to see what leading providers are developing and to understand how to better generate leads, streamline online discussions, and use sales data effectively for ongoing success.

events.name: Promotional Goods Expo Osaka 2026

This area will explore unique fan engagement goods, character IP, and community support services. Marketing managers and practitioners looking to enhance their promotional strategies and adapt to changing consumer behaviors can find valuable resources and connect with peers.

events.name: Office Disaster Prevention Expo Osaka 2026

events.name: Marketing Strategy Planning EXPO Osaka 2026
events.description:

events.name: HR EXPO Osaka 2026

Visitors can gather information, discuss potential collaborations, and learn about current trends and practical examples that contribute to organizational growth.

events.name: Health Management Expo Osaka 2026
events.description:
Discover the future of corporate well-being and productivity at the Health Management Expo Osaka 2026, taking place from November 18-20, 2026, at Intex Osaka. The event showcases a wide range of products and services across health management systems, mental care, physical well-being, and online medical consultations. Attendees will find solutions addressing areas from stress checks and sleep improvement to exercise support applications and industrial physician services, all designed to support a healthy workplace. It provides an opportunity for efficient information gathering and direct discussions with providers.

events.name: Food Factory Automation & Digital Technology Expo Tokyo 2026

events.name: EC Sales Boost EXPO Osaka 2026
events.description:
Elevate your e-commerce strategy and drive unprecedented sales growth at EC Sales Boost EXPO Osaka 2026. This important gathering, part of the 7th Marketing Week series, will be held from November 18-20, 2026, at Intex Osaka, and is designed for EC managers and operations staff.

events.name: Brand Strategy & PR EXPO 2026

events.name: NHBA Fall Compliance Workshop 2026
events.description:
