Elevate your strategic understanding of the banking sector at the KBA FDIC Chicago Regional Office 2026, also known as the FDIC Directors College. This program, organized by the Kentucky Bankers Association and hosted by executive staff from the FDIC Chicago Regional Office, will be held on November 18, 2026, from 9:00 AM to 2:30 PM EST at the Embassy Suites in Lexington, KY. It is designed for bank directors, CEOs, and senior management, offering perspectives on the evolving financial landscape.

Participants will explore today's commercial real estate market, discuss emerging compliance topics such as electronic fund transfers and third-party oversight, and review current strategies for mitigating check and payment fraud. The program will also cover national and local economic conditions.

A significant part of the program is the Regulatory Panel. This session allows for direct engagement with FDIC Chicago Regional management and state authorities on current industry issues. The event aims to support professional development and facilitate connections among banking professionals.

events.name: ROBOT X @ METALEX 2026

location.venue: Bangkok International Trade and Exhibition Centre (BITEC)

events.description:
Celebrating its 40th anniversary, ROBOT X @ METALEX 2026 invites over 100,000 metalworking professionals to BITEC, Bangkok, from November 18-21, 2026. This event will explore the future of manufacturing, presenting new innovations and solutions across industrial technology and factory operations.

Professionals attending will encounter technologies from more than 3,000 international brands. These offerings are designed to help foster valuable connections, streamline procurement, and enhance productivity. A dedicated "Future Tech" area will highlight advancements that are shaping tomorrow's factories, from robotics to smart manufacturing solutions. The program also includes conferences and opportunities to connect with industry leaders.

This gathering provides an opportunity for those in the trade to consider how they might evolve their operations and maintain a competitive edge in the dynamic ASEAN market.

events.name: Franchise EXPO 2026
events.description:
Unlock your entrepreneurial potential or expand your corporate portfolio at Franchise EXPO 2026 (FRAX). This event takes place in Osaka from November 18-20, 2026, at Intex Osaka, Hall 6. It serves as a central meeting point for the franchise industry, offering a chance to explore various business models across food & beverage, retail, and service sectors. Participants can gain practical understanding for starting or growing a franchise.

Individuals looking to start a business, corporate executives, and teams exploring new ventures will find a range of exhibitors available for direct consultation. The program includes seminars led by industry figures, discussing current trends and future directions in franchising. FRAX is part of RX Japan's "New Business Week," contributing to a broader discussion on business development. A separate exhibition is planned for Tokyo in May 2027.

events.name: Business Expansion Support EXPO Osaka 2026
events.description:
Prepare for unparalleled growth at the Business Expansion Support EXPO Osaka 2026, taking place from November 18-20 at Intex Osaka, Hall 6. This exhibition is designed to help businesses navigate the complexities of launching and scaling new ventures.

As a key part of New Business Week [Osaka], the event brings together four specialized areas: New Business Support, M&A & Business Alliance, Franchise, and New Business HR Support. Company leaders, including Presidents, Executives, and those overseeing New Business Departments, will have the chance to engage directly with various service providers. They can compare different support options and gain insights from established business figures through a series of seminars and consultations.

The expo offers a setting to explore potential strategic partnerships, examine innovative solutions, and receive expert guidance. It provides an opportunity to refine expansion strategies and understand new possibilities within Japan's evolving market.

events.name: New Business Week Osaka 2026
events.description:
New Business Week Osaka 2026, scheduled for November 18 to 20 at Intex Osaka, Hall 6, Japan, offers an unparalleled platform for accelerating new venture success. The exhibition is designed to help businesses address the various challenges involved in launching and growing a venture.

Executives and department heads attending the event will explore four specialized expos: New Business Support, M&A & Business Alliance, Franchise, and New Business HR Support. These areas provide access to strategies, market insights, and support services. Participants can engage with consultants, examine M&A possibilities, discover established franchise models, and address key human resources issues.

The event also features seminars with prominent speakers and programs specifically developed for executives. It provides a setting for comparing different solutions, acquiring specialized knowledge, and forming partnerships that can contribute to business development.

events.name: Administration Service Expo Autumn 2026
events.description:
Elevate your back-office operations at the Administration Service Expo Autumn 2026, taking place from September 16-18 at Tokyo Big Sight. This event is designed for professionals in General Affairs, Human Resources, Management, and IT who are looking for practical solutions to improve efficiency and manage costs within administrative functions.

Attendees will find an extensive exhibition featuring various products and services, alongside opportunities for direct discussions with providers. Over 90 seminars, led by experts, will cover subjects from AI-driven digital transformation and strategic general affairs to crisis management and the design of future workspaces.

The expo also includes nine co-located events and specialized forums for discussion, such as those exploring generative AI. This structure offers a chance to connect with peers, gather new information, and consider ways to evolve an organization's administrative processes.

events.name: IFN KSA Dialogues 2026
events.description:
Set against the backdrop of Saudi Arabia's ambitious Vision 2030, IFN KSA Dialogues 2026 offers an exclusive deep dive into the Kingdom's pivotal role in global Islamic finance. On November 22nd, at the Hyatt Place Riyadh Al Sulaimania, this gathering will bring together prominent regulators and industry leaders for in-depth, round-table discussions.

Discussions will cover essential topics such as the digital evolution within Islamic finance, the prospects for Sukuk and capital markets, and how to expand Shariah-compliant financing for sustainable and green initiatives. The agenda also includes exploring new investment approaches, including Waqf-based and tokenised assets, alongside aligning with strategic policy directions.

Senior professionals attending will have the chance to gain significant understanding and connect with key individuals who are influencing the future of Islamic banking, investments, and the Halal economy.

events.name: International Communication Engineering and Cloud Computing Conference 2026
events.description:
Barcelona, Spain, will host a pivotal gathering for digital innovation: the International Communication Engineering and Cloud Computing Conference 2026 (CECCC), from November 18-20 at the Fira de Barcelona - Montjuic Venue. With the support of the University of Cantabria, this conference provides a setting for experts, researchers, and authors to share insights and advance both fundamental and applied research.

The agenda will cover key areas such as SDN, NFV, Fog Computing, Communication Optimization for AI, and Edge Intelligence. Participants can expect to hear from keynote speakers and engage in specialized sessions throughout the event.

Papers accepted for presentation will be published in IEEE Xplore and indexed in Ei Compendex and Scopus, ensuring broad dissemination of findings. The conference also features awards, including the Young Researcher and Best Paper, designed to encourage collaboration and acknowledge significant contributions within these evolving fields.

events.name: Expo4Seniors Wilmington 2026
events.description:
Wilmington's senior community is invited to Expo4Seniors Wilmington 2026, a comprehensive event dedicated to senior lifestyle, health, and home. This event will take place on Wednesday, November 18, 2026, from 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM at the Nir Family YMCA. Admission and parking are free for all seniors.

Visitors can explore resources covering independent living options, in-home care, and professional services like elder law and financial guidance. Representatives from organizations such as Brunswick Cove Living Center, Devoted Health, AAA, and Humana will be available, offering insights into supporting seniors who choose to age in place.

The day also includes opportunities for free health screenings and immunizations. Food will be available, and various giveaways are planned. The aim of this event is to provide valuable information and support for seniors in the community, promoting their well-being and access to necessary services.

events.name: Motor Trader Industry Awards 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendar for Wednesday 18 November 2026, as the Motor Trader Industry Awards 2026 returns to the iconic Grosvenor House Hotel, Park Lane, London. This event serves as a significant gathering for the automotive sector, dedicated to recognizing dealerships, teams, and individuals who have demonstrated notable excellence and innovation.

The evening will bring together leading professionals and the year's finalists for a time of celebration and recognition. Beyond the announcement of the awards, attendees will find opportunities to connect with leaders and peers who are influencing the direction of motor retail.

Supported by industry partners, this night underscores the energy and achievements within the UK motor trade. It is an occasion to acknowledge accomplishments and inspire future development.

events.name: French Congress of Urology 2026
events.description:
The 120th French Congress of Urology invites "chères consœurs, chers confrères, chers amis" to a landmark event for the urological community. From November 18 to 21, 2026, the Palais des Congrès de Paris will host four days dedicated to in-depth discussions and professional growth within the field.

The program will explore new training pathways and recent developments in urology. Beyond the scientific sessions, there will be social gatherings, such as the Members' dinner and a special Génération AFU evening, designed to encourage connections among colleagues.

The congress concludes with the Novemb'Run on November 22, an event supporting men's health.

events.name: SheInspires Awards 2026
events.description:
The SheInspires Awards 2026 stands as a beacon for women's economic empowerment across the UK. This significant event is central to the She Inspires organization's mission: to acknowledge and uplift women who are making substantial contributions in their professional fields and communities. Through a thorough judging process, the awards highlight exceptional achievements, aiming to enhance visibility, reinforce leadership skills, and encourage greater financial independence.

Beyond the recognition, the awards offer a valuable space for individuals to forge meaningful connections and discover new avenues for growth. This initiative is an integral part of a wider framework that includes the RISE Conference & Expo and the Marketplace. Together, these components are designed to cultivate self-assurance, foster leadership qualities, and ultimately strengthen women's economic standing. It is an occasion to celebrate those who lead by example and draw inspiration from the collective drive for positive change.

events.name: Benefits Canada Investment Innovation Conference 2026
events.description:
Navigate the evolving landscape of institutional investment at the Benefits Canada Investment Innovation Conference 2026. The invitation-only gathering takes place November 18-20 at the Pillar and Post Inn & Spa in Niagara-on-the-Lake, Ontario. It brings together senior Canadian pension plan decision-makers, academics, and money managers to explore innovative investment strategies.

The agenda will delve into how global shifts, economic uncertainty, and rapid technological advancements are reshaping capital markets and investment theory. Participants will discuss approaches to navigate these challenges and opportunities.

Benefits Canada and Canadian Investment Review organize this event, in partnership with Ivey Business School. DB plan sponsors attend without charge. The conference offers a forum for understanding and responding to the complexities of today's investment environment.

events.name: Virginia Governor's Housing Conference 2026
events.description:
Set to shape the future of housing across the Commonwealth, the Virginia Governor's Housing Conference 2026 will convene November 18-20 at the Hampton Roads Convention Center in Hampton. As Virginia’s largest housing event, this gathering brings together professionals from nonprofits, development firms, local governments, financial institutions, and community organizations.

Participants will have the opportunity to engage in meaningful conversations, exchange practical strategies, and build connections to address Virginia's housing challenges. The event also includes the annual Housing Awards, which recognize significant achievements and positive contributions within the housing sector.

The conference aims to provide a platform for leaders and practitioners to share knowledge and expand their professional networks, ultimately contributing to a more equitable housing landscape for all Virginians.

events.name: FISD Toronto Fall 2026
events.description:
On November 18, 2026, from 2:30 p.m. to 7:00 p.m., the TMX Market Center in Toronto will host a crucial discussion on the intersection of AI and market data compliance. This afternoon event will address the challenges traditional regulatory frameworks encounter as AI models transform how data is used. The discussion will focus on the complexities arising from indirect data use and the need for greater transparency in an evolving landscape.

The program features a panel discussion titled "AI in the Age of Compliance: Controlling Data as Models Grow Smarter." Participants will also hear from BMO's Manon Amyot-Lake during a fireside chat. TMX is hosting the event, with a welcome provided by BMO.

The afternoon concludes with a reception at Elephant & Castle. This gathering offers financial professionals a chance to connect and discuss strategies for navigating data governance in an AI-driven environment. Due to limited space, the event aims for a focused exchange among participants.

events.name: Swiss Oncology & Hematology Congress 2026
events.description:
Dedicated to advancing the frontiers of cancer and blood disorder treatment, the Swiss Oncology & Hematology Congress 2026 offers a vital platform for medical professionals. The congress will bring together leading experts, researchers, and clinicians to share significant scientific findings and work together on new approaches in oncology and hematology.

The program is designed to explore the latest research, clinical practices, and therapeutic strategies. Participants can expect discussions, insights into emerging trends, and opportunities to connect with colleagues from Switzerland and internationally. Beyond the scientific sessions, a social program will also be available, providing chances to build professional relationships.

This gathering aims to contribute to the ongoing development of patient care in these critical fields. Further details regarding the program and location will be made available.

events.name: IEEE WinTechCon 2026
events.description:
The 7th IEEE International Women in Technology Conference, IEEE WinTechCon 2026, is set to ignite innovation in Bengaluru, India, from November 18-19. The conference will take place at the Radisson Blu, Marathahalli, focusing on the theme "Empowering Innovation: From Intelligent Silicon to Global Ecosystems."

This gathering provides an opportunity for women leaders and professionals from both industry and academia to share their research and developments in areas such as VLSI, embedded systems, and software. Participants can expect to hear from a variety of perspectives, delve into new technical areas through presentations, demonstrations, instructional sessions, and poster displays, and contribute to discussions on inclusive leadership.

Organized by the IEEE Bangalore Section, CAS, and WIE Council, WinTechCon 2026 aims to bring together new developments and collaborative efforts within the technology sector.

events.name: WealthBriefing MENA Awards for Excellence 2026
events.description:
The pinnacle of achievement in the Middle East's wealth management and family office communities will be celebrated at the WealthBriefing MENA Awards for Excellence 2026. The celebration will include a gala dinner on Wednesday, 18th November 2026, at the Address Sky View in Downtown Dubai.

These awards recognize firms and individuals who demonstrate significant innovation and service within the region's private client sector. A panel of experienced judges, made up of professionals from banks, family offices, and advisory firms, carefully reviews submissions across various categories, from private banking and technology to specialist services.

The evening provides an opportunity to connect with industry peers, witness the announcement of winners, and acknowledge the achievements that are shaping the future of wealth management in the MENA region.

events.name: Accountex Spain 2026
events.description:
Accountex Spain 2026, the definitive event for the accounting, advisory, and business management sectors, is set to convene at IFEMA Madrid. This gathering offers professional offices, advisors, and company finance departments a chance to explore solutions from over 100 leading providers, featuring the latest software and tools driving digitalization.

The program includes a comprehensive training component, where specialized professionals will share insights into current trends and future advancements shaping the profession. Participants will have opportunities to connect with colleagues, share ideas, and learn about innovative strategies. The event also incorporates the co-located HR Expo 2026, which presents current HR solutions.

events.name: OHS Leaders Summit New Zealand 2026
events.description:
The OHS Leaders Summit New Zealand 2026 offers a crucial platform for senior OHS professionals and decision-makers across New Zealand. This gathering provides a space for leaders to collaborate, share insights, and collectively address the evolving landscape of workplace health and safety. It's an occasion to explore new strategies and advance the understanding of OHS practices nationwide.

Attendees will engage with key topics such as proactive risk management, mental well-being initiatives, technological advancements in safety, and cultivating a robust safety culture. The summit allows participants to gain practical knowledge, benchmark their current approaches against leading industry practices, and expand their professional connections with peers dedicated to elevating OHS standards. This collective engagement aims to contribute to the future direction of safety in New Zealand.

events.name: Silmo Istanbul 2026
events.description:
The global optical industry will converge at the Istanbul Expo Center from November 18-21, 2026, for Silmo Istanbul 2026. This four-day international fair, held across Halls 5, 6, and 7, serves as a central gathering point for professionals, academics, and students interested in the future of eyewear. Attendees can explore the latest innovations and trends shaping the industry; visitor registration is complimentary.

The event will feature the Silmo Award Istanbul, recognizing pioneering projects and forward-thinking approaches. Industry directions will be discussed at Silmo Trend, while Silmo Istanbul Akademik offers a platform for knowledge exchange, bringing together diverse perspectives on the optical world's evolution. It provides an opportunity to connect with peers and understand upcoming developments in the sector.

events.name: METALEX 2026
events.description:
Celebrating its 40th anniversary, METALEX 2026 invites over 100,000 metalworking professionals to BITEC, Bangkok, Thailand, from November 18-21. The event will present manufacturing solutions and new technologies from more than 3,000 international brands.

Attendees can explore the "Future Tech" showcase, which highlights innovations shaping the industry's direction. It offers a chance to connect with leading experts, see advanced machinery firsthand, and gain insights into optimizing production processes.

METALEX 2026 serves as a significant gathering for the ASEAN metalworking sector, providing opportunities for professionals to network and learn, ultimately helping them enhance their manufacturing capabilities.

events.name: Latin America Wholesale Congress 2026
events.description:
Prepare for the premier gathering of the wholesale telecom industry at the Latin America Wholesale Congress 2026. This gathering serves as a key forum for executives across the industry, including Tier 1, 2, and 3 carriers, mobile operators, ISPs, VoIP providers, and technology partners.

Those attending will have the opportunity to delve into current innovations and market trends. Discussions will cover areas such as voice, data, SMS, eSIM, satellite, sub-sea, and fixed-line services.

The Congress provides a setting for networking among peers. It's a place where professionals can connect, discuss new solutions, and work with others to influence the direction of wholesale telecommunications in Latin America.

events.name: North American Family Office Forum 2026
events.description:
Prepare for an unparalleled gathering of ultra-high net worth families and wealth holders at the North American Family Office Forum 2026. This marks Campden Wealth's 21st annual forum, taking place in-person on November 18-19 in Palm Beach, Florida. It is designed to bring together qualified attendees for direct peer-to-peer engagement.

The discussions will cover the many aspects of family office management, from daily operations, governance, and succession planning to investment structuring and tax considerations. The agenda includes strategies for preserving wealth, managing transitions, and understanding the significant role the next generation plays in ensuring a stable future. Conversations will also address responsible ownership and sustainable investing.

The forum coincides with the annual release of the Global Family Office Report. Its purpose is to offer practical insights and facilitate relationships that support long-term resilience and growth for family wealth.

events.name: SMX Next 2026
events.description:
Unlock the future of search marketing with SMX Next 2026, the essential virtual gathering for professionals eager to master the evolving digital landscape. This online event will examine key areas in SEO, PPC, and AI, with a particular emphasis on AI-driven search, generative AI, and Google's shift towards an assistant-first approach.

Participants will have the opportunity to explore upcoming 2026 trends, strategies for AI profitability, modern targeting methods, and the application of AI in PPC. The program also covers technical SEO, LLM analytics, entity optimization, and how to navigate algorithm changes. The event offers expert-led sessions, live question-and-answer periods, interactive discussions, and product demonstrations. There will also be opportunities to connect with other professionals during dedicated Coffee Talks.

Free registration for the event becomes available on September 9, and the full program details will be released on October 13.

events.name: Train Communications Systems Conference 2026
events.description:
Gathering at London's historic Royal Horseguards Hotel, the Train Communications Systems Conference 2026 offers an unparalleled deep dive into the future of wireless communications on passenger rail. This annual conference brings together train companies, rail administrators, and technology specialists from around the world. They will address the challenges involved in delivering reliable on-board WiFi and robust track-side networks.

Discussions will cover current innovations, such as the influence of LEO and Starlink satellite services, the integration of 5G, and approaches to improving mobile system connections. Participants can expect to hear direct experiences from leading train operators, engage in important conversations, and identify practical solutions. These discussions aim to help reduce costs, gain a competitive edge, and enhance the passenger experience.

The event serves as a global meeting point for professionals to exchange insights, share effective practices, and contribute to the development of the next generation of train connectivity.

events.name: WHEDA Conference 2026

location.venue: Monona Terrace Community and Convention Center

events.description:

This one-and-a-half-day event brings together developers, property managers, financial specialists, lenders, advocates, and government officials who are all working to expand safe, affordable housing throughout Wisconsin.

Those attending will have opportunities to explore new ideas and approaches during breakout sessions, hear from keynote speakers, and participate in interactive workshops. The program includes tracks covering Multifamily Development and Finance, Community Engagement, Property Management and Compliance, and Single Family Development.

There will also be a Vendor Marketplace and a Networking Reception, providing space for people to connect and share resources.

events.name: Connecticut Marine Dealer Trade Show 2026

events.name: Elex Show Surrey 2026

To enhance the experience, entry and parking are complimentary. Attendees will also receive a Professional Electrician & Installer T-shirt and a bacon roll.

Supported by the IET, the show facilitates networking, learning, and helps professionals prepare for future industry developments.

events.name: Mid-Atlantic Design-2-Part Show 2026

events.name: Middle East Family Office Investment Summit 2026
events.description:
The 13th Middle East Family Office Investment Summit, convening on 14-15 December 2026 at the Mandarin Oriental Downtown Hotel in Dubai, UAE, offers an unparalleled platform for the region's most influential family offices. Participants can expect to explore key investment strategies, covering topics from preserving generational wealth and establishing strong family office governance to understanding new opportunities across Saudi Arabia, North Africa, and Kuwait. Conversations will also address private equity, venture capital, real estate, and how to adapt investment portfolios in a changing global landscape.

The intention is to create an environment where significant connections can be made and potential collaborations can emerge. The program includes a dedicated networking dinner and a traditional Dewaniya, offering further opportunities for interaction.

events.name: Institutional Fall Retreat 2026

Participants will explore essential subjects, including asset allocation for 2025 and beyond, a fresh look at fixed income, how institutions use ETFs, and the increasing role of private credit. The discussions aim to provide clarity for navigating economic shifts, strengthening investment portfolios, and developing sound judgment in uncertain periods.

events.name: Cyberriskalliance Government Security Summit 2026
events.description:
The Cyberriskalliance Government Security Summit 2026 stands as a critical forum dedicated to fortifying the nation's digital defenses against an ever-evolving threat landscape. Attendees can expect to gain valuable perspectives from discussions led by experts, covering topics such as strategic threat intelligence, secure cloud architectures, supply chain resilience, and navigating complex regulatory compliance. The summit provides an environment that encourages collaborative learning, peer networking, and the discovery of advanced technologies essential for safeguarding critical government infrastructure. Through these interactions, participants can enhance their strategies and contribute to a more secure future for national operations.

events.name: Bahrain International Airshow 2026

events.name: Fintech Nerdcon San Diego 2026

events.name: Data + AI World Tour New York 2026

The day offers a chance to connect with industry leaders and learn from expert-led sessions.

events.name: American Speech Language Hearing Association Convention 2026

events.name: The Digital Transformation Conference London Fall 2026

events.name: REBA Future Forum 2026
events.description:
Reward and benefits leaders, mark your calendars for the REBA Future Forum 2026, a pivotal event taking place on Thursday, 19 November 2026, at Convene Sancroft, St. Paul’s, London. This full-day forum is designed for leaders to connect with peers and share insights, focusing on providing fresh perspectives and practical strategies.

Discussions will explore key topics such as using AI and data for personalized benefits, navigating changes in regulations, and improving financial wellbeing strategies. The agenda includes keynotes, interactive sessions, and real-world case studies. An exhibition will also feature leading providers showcasing solutions for upcoming challenges.

The forum offers an opportunity to engage with fellow leaders, rethink current benefits strategies for a workforce ready for the future, and explore how to enhance effectiveness and address equity gaps.

events.name: DefCamp 2026
events.description:
Prepare for DefCamp 2026, Central and Eastern Europe's premier cybersecurity conference, set to unfold at the iconic Palace of the Parliament in Bucharest, Romania. The main conference days are November 19-20, following intensive workshops from November 16-18. During this time, thousands of cybersecurity professionals, researchers, and decision-makers are expected to gather.

The event offers a setting to explore advancements in cyber resilience. Attendees can hear from leading keynote speakers, take part in practical workshops, and test their abilities in the Hacking Village, which is hosted on CyberEDU. Discussions will cover critical subjects like AI threats, supply chain security, cloud security, and ransomware, presented through expert-led panels.

DefCamp 2026 serves as a significant occasion for individuals in the cybersecurity field to connect with peers and discuss new ideas.

events.name: Advertising Hall of Achievement 2026
events.description:
On November 19, 2026, the Advertising Hall of Achievement will host its prestigious Induction Ceremonies & Gala Dinner at Pier Sixty in New York City. This evening is dedicated to recognizing individuals under 40 who have made significant contributions across the advertising, entertainment, and media industries.

The ceremony will acknowledge exceptional leaders whose innovative work is shaping the industry's future. Their contributions span a wide range, from redefining beauty standards to pioneering advancements in fintech, retail media, and AI in B2B marketing. Inductees become part of a community of over 200 influential alumni.

It's a chance to gather with colleagues and acknowledge those leading the way. Nominations for the 2026 class are now being accepted, with a deadline of May 8, 2026. This is an opportunity for the industry to recognize its future leaders.

events.name: National League of Cities City Summit 2026
events.description:
Local leaders, elected officials, and dedicated government advocates are invited to converge in Nashville, Tennessee, for the National League of Cities City Summit 2026. This annual gathering brings together professionals to connect with colleagues, hear directly from NLC leadership, and participate in important discussions that influence the direction of communities across the country.

Attendees will develop leadership capabilities, explore effective strategies, and consider new approaches to address current local challenges. Taking place in Nashville, a city known for its rich cultural scene, the summit provides a setting for collaboration, professional development, and sharing insights. This environment helps participants develop the tools to create meaningful change in their cities and towns.

The summit is designed for individuals dedicated to strengthening local government and fostering thriving communities.

events.name: MIT Sloan CFO Summit 2026
events.description:
The 24th annual MIT Sloan CFO Summit, set for Thursday, November 19, 2026, offers an unparalleled opportunity for financial leaders to navigate the complexities of today's economic landscape.

This event brings together over 400 financial executives and prominent academics. It serves as a forum for in-depth discussions on practical challenges and strategic solutions, allowing participants to explore approaches for guiding and managing change within their organizations.

Attendees will engage with keynotes, participate in breakout panels, and connect during networking sessions. This gathering provides a chance to gain new perspectives and build valuable connections that may influence the direction of finance.

events.name: Mediterranean Dialogues 2026
events.description:
Rethinking traditional approaches to the Mediterranean region takes center stage at the Mediterranean Dialogues 2026. This gathering, organized by the Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation and ISPI, seeks to cultivate fresh perspectives and proposals. The aim is to build a "positive agenda" that addresses the region's intricate security and socio-economic issues through shared understanding.

The event brings together leaders from economic sectors, business communities, and civil society. Discussions will focus on five core areas: Shared Security, Shared Prosperity, the Human Dimension, the Power of Narratives, and Culture for Peace. Participants will work together to find new solutions, enhance regional collaboration, and contribute to a more stable and prosperous future for the Mediterranean. The discussions aim to foster meaningful dialogue and practical strategies for the region's evolution.

events.name: 100 CPO Summit 2026
events.description:
Chief Procurement Officers and leading industry figures will converge in Dubai on November 19th, 2026, for the highly anticipated 100 CPO Summit. This gathering, centered on 'Procurement 2030: Pioneering Resilience and Value Creation,' will explore the future of procurement.

The summit brings together senior procurement executives, offering a forum for strategic discussions, the exchange of current insights, and collaboration on new solutions. Participants will explore strategies to navigate the changing global supply chain, build strong, value-driven procurement models, and foster resilience within their organizations.

This event is for leaders who are shaping the strategic direction of the industry for the coming decade.

events.name: NCTE Annual Convention 2026
events.description:
The future of English Language Arts education will converge in Philadelphia from November 19–22, 2026, at the NCTE Annual Convention. This event gathers thousands of educators, from preK through graduate levels, alongside authors and literacy leaders. It provides a forum to explore new ideas, acknowledge diverse perspectives, and contribute to the ongoing direction of English Language Arts.

Participants will examine a broad range of subjects within English, language, writing, and literacy studies, acquiring practical insights and strategies for their teaching environments. The convention features a large exhibit hall and presentations from more than 250 authors. It offers a setting for professional development, connecting with peers, and finding inspiration to support future readers and writers.

events.name: Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix 2026
events.description:
The world's most exhilarating motorsport descends upon the iconic Las Vegas Strip for the Formula 1 Las Vegas Grand Prix 2026, set to electrify fans from November 19-21.

The event offers three days of high-speed racing, with the world's fastest cars competing under the bright lights of Las Vegas. Beyond the competition on the track, attendees can explore the Grand Prix Plaza. This area, described as North America's largest F1 attraction, has been expanded to provide a comprehensive fan experience.

Whether attending with a General Admission ticket or through exclusive Hospitality, the official F1 Las Vegas App will serve as a helpful guide. It is designed to assist guests throughout their time at the event. This occasion marks a significant moment as Formula 1 establishes itself within the entertainment landscape of the city.

events.name: COA Symposium and Bravo Business Awards 2026
events.description:
Bringing together over 500 senior business and government leaders, entrepreneurs, and industry pioneers, the COA Symposium and 31st BRAVO Business Awards will converge in Miami on November 19, 2026. This gathering marks the conclusion of a year-long series of BRAVO Leadership Forums, which recognize outstanding Latin American business leaders and social innovators.

The symposium program includes discussions and panels led by experts. These sessions aim to facilitate the sharing of perspectives on important topics relevant to the Western Hemisphere, such as digital transformation, artificial intelligence, and sustainability.

For C-suite executives and corporate stakeholders, the event offers a setting to build important connections and contribute to discussions that influence Latin America's evolving business environment.

events.name: SIA Awards Dinner 2026
events.description:
On November 19, 2026, the Signia by Hilton San Jose will host the Semiconductor Industry Association's annual Awards Dinner, a premier event celebrating excellence and innovation.

This evening brings together leaders and professionals from across the semiconductor industry. It offers an opportunity to connect with peers and acknowledge significant contributions within the field.

The program begins with an SIA Reception at 5:00 pm, providing time for attendees to meet and converse. Dinner and the awards presentations are scheduled for 6:30 pm, which will include a keynote address from a leading industry figure. Following the main program, an After-Dinner Reception starts at 8:30 pm, allowing for continued discussion and interaction.

events.name: Machaon Florida Technology Summit 2026
events.description:
Strategically accelerate your business at the Machaon Florida Technology Summit 2026, convening on November 19 at the Hilton St. Petersburg Carillon Park. This one-day conference offers IT and Security professionals a chance to explore current technologies and practical methods for addressing industry challenges.

Participants will have opportunities to connect with colleagues, discover solutions from various vendors in the exhibit hall, and hear perspectives from experienced leaders. The event also provides 6 CPE Credits, alongside time to expand professional networks and build connections within the IT community.

The summit aims to help attendees find new ways to strengthen their organization's IT and information security, supporting their ability to adapt within the evolving digital environment.

events.name: HBJ C-Suite and Lifetime Achievement Awards 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendar for the prestigious HBJ C-Suite and Lifetime Achievement Awards 2026, a premier event celebrating Connecticut's most impactful business leaders. The evening will take place on November 19, 2026, from 5:00 pm to 8:00 pm, at Farmington Gardens in Farmington, CT. This gathering is dedicated to acknowledging the achievements of top-performing C-suite executives.

Organized by the Hartford Business Journal, this event recognizes leaders from for-profit, non-profit, and governmental sectors. These individuals are honored for their exceptional growth, ethical leadership, robust reporting, and significant community involvement. Awards are presented across several categories, including CEO, CFO, COO, CTO/CIO/CISO, CMO, CHRO/CDO, and the esteemed Lifetime Achievement Award. Honorees will also be featured in the Hartford Business Journal's October 19, 2026 issue.

Nominations for these awards close on August 7, 2026.

events.name: Investment Management Forum 2026

location.venue: Chancellerie Auditorium of BNP Paribas Fortis

events.description:
Addressing the critical challenges and opportunities shaping the financial landscape, the Investment Management Forum 2026 will convene in Brussels. This gathering brings together key figures from the financial sector, including industry leaders, policymakers, regulators, and supervisors, for crucial conversations about the future of European capital markets. Participants will explore how to navigate current geopolitical complexities, enhance the EU’s strategic autonomy, and improve overall competitiveness.

Discussions will also cover strategies for growing pension assets, empowering retail investors, and fostering stable, efficient, integrated, and competitive European capital markets. The forum will be held at the Chancellerie Auditorium of BNP Paribas Fortis, providing a setting for gaining insights, engaging in collaborative dialogue, and connecting with peers. These interactions are aimed at advancing the industry and supporting a strong financial ecosystem.

events.name: Global EPC Contract & Project Management Summit 2026
events.description:
Industry leaders and senior professionals in the Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) sector are invited to converge at the Global EPC Contract & Project Management Summit 2026. This two-day conference takes place on November 19-20 in Lisboa, Portugal, at the Hotel Holiday Inn Lisboa, offering a significant forum for advancing enterprise capabilities within the sector.

Attendees, including top owners, EPCs, engineers, and consultants, will explore best practices in project management, innovative technologies, and expert strategies for minimizing cost, schedule, and risk. The program includes in-depth discussions on EPC contract negotiation, dispute resolution, and navigating dynamic market factors and supply chain constraints. Participants can expect interactive sessions, real-world case studies, and insights from industry experts.

A full pass provides access to master classes, a cocktail reception, and post-event documentation. These elements are designed to facilitate valuable connections and knowledge exchange, contributing to the future direction of EPC projects.

events.name: Growth, Resilience, Inspiration & Tenacity 2026
events.description:
Designed to empower healthcare professionals, clinicians, and leaders, Growth, Resilience, Inspiration & Tenacity 2026 (GRIT in Medicine) offers crucial strategies for navigating today's demanding medical landscape. This event, presented by the Mayo Clinic School of Continuous Professional Development, will be held from November 19-21, 2026, at The Broadmoor in Colorado Springs. Participants can attend in person or virtually via livestream.

Course Directors Anjali Bhagra, M.D., M.B.A., and Susan M. Moeschler, M.D., will guide attendees through a series of instructional and interactive sessions. The program emphasizes evidence-based methods to address clinician burnout, improve personal well-being, and cultivate inclusive leadership. Attendees will explore practical strategies to overcome healthcare barriers and biases, ultimately enhancing patient care and outcomes.

events.name: RailTrends 2026
events.description:
For senior leaders shaping the future of rail, RailTrends 2026 stands as the essential intelligence summit. This gathering will take place on November 19-20, 2026, at the New York Marriott Downtown in Lower Manhattan. *Progressive Railroading* presents the event, which was established by Tony Hatch of ABH Consulting.

Over two days, the program aims to provide strategic insights that go beyond typical industry updates, offering fresh perspectives on emerging trends. It brings together professionals from finance, operations, government, and investment for important discussions and opportunities to connect with peers.

The emphasis is on the value of being there in person; sessions will not be livestreamed or recorded. This approach ensures a focused, forward-looking environment for those at the forefront of the industry's evolution.

events.name: IT Leadership Forum Texas 2026
events.description:
On November 19, 2026, the Austin Marriott Downtown will host the IT Leadership Forum Texas, an exclusive, invitation-only gathering for public sector IT executives and emerging leaders. This forum offers a space for open discussions about the future of digital government, with a focus on leadership development, innovation, and strategic approaches.

Participants will examine the people, policies, and technologies that influence the public sector, aiming to gain deeper understanding and forge important connections. With support from organizations such as Tanium, Docusign, Dell Technologies, and Google Cloud, the program helps participants develop the capabilities to guide their organizations and communities toward a technologically advanced future. The agenda includes opportunities for peer exchange and practical sessions, designed to support leaders in public-sector technology.

events.name: The London Vet Show 2026
events.description:
The London Vet Show 2026, returning to ExCeL London on 19–20 November, is set to welcome over 7,000 veterinary professionals. Over two days, attendees will find 17 hours of CPD-accredited learning and more than 300 hours of educational content, designed to expand their understanding across diverse veterinary fields. The program includes sessions with over 450 experienced speakers, opportunities for hands-on learning in Wet Labs, and collaborative discussions in Community Masterminds.

Attendees can also visit Europe’s largest veterinary exhibition, where more than 425 exhibitors will display innovations in diagnostics, imaging, and surgical precision. This environment offers a chance to meet innovators, discover new tools, and network with colleagues from various specializations, including small animal, large animal, exotics, farm, and equine practices. It serves as a valuable opportunity to keep informed about developments in the veterinary profession.

events.name: Fortinet Cybersecurity Summit Toronto 2026
events.description:
Prepare to elevate your organization's cyber resilience at the Fortinet Cybersecurity Summit Toronto 2026, Fortinet Canada's flagship annual event. On Thursday, November 19, 2026, senior cybersecurity leaders, IT decision-makers, and business executives will gather at the Metro Toronto Convention Centre for a day focused on strategic insights.

The discussions will cover critical topics like safeguarding sensitive data in an era of increasing AI adoption, optimizing SASE strategies for distributed environments, and navigating the evolving threat landscape, including AI-enabled attacks and ransomware. The day will feature keynotes, executive discussions, real-world customer stories, and practical demonstrations of Fortinet’s Security Fabric.

This event offers an opportunity to connect with industry experts, Fortinet specialists, and peers. Participants can gain practical knowledge to help secure their digital future.

events.name: KCD Porto 2026
events.description:
Prepare for an immersive dive into the future of cloud-native technology at KCD Porto 2026, taking place on November 19-20 at the iconic SuperBock Arena in Porto, Portugal. This two-day event, supported by the Cloud Native Computing Foundation (CNCF) and in collaboration with DevOps Days Portugal, anticipates bringing together over 500 engineers, developers, and cloud experts.

Those attending will have the chance to explore current trends in Kubernetes and the wider cloud-native ecosystem. The program includes keynotes, in-depth technical sessions, and parallel talks designed to foster understanding and discussion. It's a setting where individuals can learn from experienced professionals, exchange ideas, and build connections with others in the cloud-native field.

The event also provides an environment for discovering new approaches and collaborating with peers on challenges and innovations within the technology landscape.

events.name: FX Markets Europe 2026
events.description:
London will once again host the definitive gathering for the foreign exchange community at FX Markets Europe 2026. On November 19, 2026, from 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, professionals from leading banks, buy-side organizations, regulatory bodies, and market-making firms will convene in the UK capital.

This gathering will explore the future of FX trading, examining critical challenges and highlighting key innovations. Those attending can expect to gain a deeper understanding of market dynamics, evolving regulatory frameworks, and the technological advancements currently shaping the global foreign exchange landscape.

The event provides a setting for strategic discussions and for connecting with influential peers. It aims to help participants navigate and plan for success within the constantly changing foreign exchange market.

events.name: FutureCon Cybersecurity Conference Boston 2026
events.description:
Elevate your digital defense strategies at the FutureCon Cybersecurity Conference Boston 2026, a premier hybrid event scheduled for Thursday, November 19, 2026, at the Boston Marriott Burlington. This gathering is tailored for C-suite executives, CISOs, and security leaders who are navigating the complexities of current cyber threats.

Participants can earn up to 10 CPE credits. The program includes high-level training sessions and opportunities to explore new technologies through live demonstrations. Attendees will also engage in a C-level executive panel discussion focused on mitigating cyber attacks, alongside networking with peers and industry experts. The agenda delves into critical areas, ranging from endpoint and cloud security to data breach defense and strategic security practices.

The day concludes with a wrap-up cocktail happy hour. There will also be an opportunity for individuals to be recognized with an "Award of Excellence."

events.name: Marketing Innovation Summit Las Vegas 2026
events.description:
Prepare for an unparalleled convergence of speed and strategy at the Marketing Innovation Summit Las Vegas 2026. On November 19, as Las Vegas hosts Race Week, Brand Innovators brings together marketing leaders to explore the future of brand engagement.

The summit will delve into strategies for enhancing marketing impact. Topics include leveraging major global events, developing data-driven campaigns, and crafting immersive brand experiences. The aim is to provide insights for driving innovation in a rapidly evolving landscape.

Professionals attending will have opportunities to connect with industry peers and gain new perspectives. The event offers a focused environment to consider fresh approaches and insights, all within the dynamic backdrop of Las Vegas.

events.name: MarTech Retreat 2026
events.description:
The MarTech Retreat 2026, held on 19–20 November at the stunning RACV Cape Schanck Resort in Victoria's Mornington Peninsula, offers an exclusive, invite-only experience for 80+ senior marketing and MarTech leaders.

This gathering is designed for genuine connection and strategic collaboration, moving away from the typical distractions of larger conferences. Senior leaders, including CDOs, CMOs, and Heads of Digital, will come together for keynotes and open fireside chats. Discussions will center on how artificial intelligence is shaping connected customer experiences and translating marketing technology into tangible commercial value.

Without exhibition stands, the environment encourages sharing insights, tackling common challenges, and forming meaningful relationships. This happens through dedicated social experiences, such as extended dinners and local activities. The retreat provides a focused setting for Victoria's MarTech community to develop strategies and foster innovation.

events.name: LiMA Day Lietuva 2026
events.description:
Navigating the intricate web of modern marketing demands a deep understanding of trust. LiMA Day Lietuva 2026, held at LITEXPO in Vilnius, addresses this challenge with its theme, "TRUST TRAP." The event offers marketing professionals strategies to discern truth within big data, bridge the gap between CMOs, CFOs, and CEOs regarding ROI, and cultivate creativity alongside AI.

Across two parallel stages, attendees can explore brand authenticity, the nuances of digital advertising, and the impact of strategic communication. Industry leaders will share insights, and discussions will cover topics ranging from influencer scrutiny and sound branding to longevity marketing. The conference aims to help redefine trust in the future of brands.

events.name: American Towman Exposition 2026
events.description:
American Towman Exposition 2026 is set to be the definitive event for professionals across the towing, recovery, and automotive services sectors. This gathering brings together the newest innovations in equipment, technology, and operational best practices. Attendees, whether independent operators or large fleet managers, will encounter cutting-edge vehicles, advanced tools, and critical services designed to enhance efficiency and safety.

The exposition offers a chance to connect with industry leaders and participate in educational sessions covering regulatory updates and strategies for business growth. It's also a place to expand professional networks. Here, individuals can gain crucial insights and source new solutions, helping their businesses remain competitive and forward-thinking.

The aim is to support professionals in enhancing their expertise and navigating future success within a rapidly evolving industry.

events.name: Insurday 2026
events.description:
Celebrating its fifth edition, Insurday 2026 is poised to redefine the future of insurance on November 19 at HOTEL LE MAROIS. This gathering, organized by Finance Innovation in collaboration with FrenchTech, expects around 870 participants, 95 expert speakers, and 58 partners and exhibitors. Discussions will explore significant InsurTech and FinTech advancements, with a focus on AI and fraud detection, featuring innovators such as Letxbe and Finovox.

The day's activities will take place across several areas: Salon Washington for plenary sessions, Salon Bolivar for business insights, Salon Lafayette, known as 'L'Observatoire,' for forward-looking discussions, and Salon Montcalm for the exhibitors' area. The event provides a setting for exploring innovations that are influencing the future of insurance, offering opportunities to connect with industry leaders and gain strategic perspectives on ongoing changes.

events.name: MRG Annual Conference 2026
events.description:
Embark on "The Pursuit of Truth" at the MRG Annual Conference 2026, taking place on Thursday, November 19th, from 9:00 am to 5:00 pm. The conference will be held at the Vue Cinema London - West End in Leicester Square. It is intended for media research professionals navigating an increasingly complex landscape and seeking deeper understanding.

Attendees can expect to encounter fresh perspectives and research findings. The program includes presentations based on accepted papers, which will also be published after the event. The day offers a chance to examine current evidence and consider the ongoing evolution of the media landscape.

Attendance costs £495 for members and £560 for non-members. The non-member fee includes a full year of MRG membership.

events.name: Regional Fiber Connect Vancouver 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for November 19, 2026, as Regional Fiber Connect Vancouver 2026 arrives in Vancouver, B.C. This event brings together industry and community leaders focused on expanding fiber broadband access. Participants can expect to learn about deploying fiber in communities and explore recent developments where AI intersects with telecommunications.

The gathering offers a setting for face-to-face networking, fostering connections among peers and innovators. It's a chance to explore new strategies and build collaborations that will influence how we connect in the future. The event also includes opportunities for exhibitors and sponsors to present their work.

events.name: C-Level Technology Leadership Summit Houston 2026
events.description:
An exclusive gathering for the pinnacle of technology leadership awaits top CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, and CEOs. On November 19, 2026, from 7:30 AM to 4:00 PM CT, the Houston Country Club will host a full day focused on "ICONIC LEADERSHIP: How to Lead Like a CEO and Why the Future Demands Authentic and Visionary Leaders."

This event is designed to enhance strategic vision and executive presence. Participants will explore how to lead with enterprise-wide influence, strengthen resilience for high-stakes decisions, and foster authentic leadership that inspires teams. Discussions will cover forward-looking insights on AI disruption, advanced cybersecurity strategies, and modernizing legacy environments to meet future business demands.

The day offers opportunities to connect with fellow C-level peers. It also provides a space to consider personal effectiveness for enhanced clarity in leadership, and to contribute to shaping the future direction of technology leadership.

events.name: Chile Private Markets Meeting 2026
events.description:
An exclusive, invitation-only gathering for the institutional investment community, the Chile Private Markets Meeting 2026 is set to convene in November at the prestigious W Hotel Santiago, Chile. Carmo Companies organizes this event, which is intended for private equity funds, family offices, and institutional investors interested in building important relationships.

Participants will hear from industry leaders, discussing strategies for linking investment vehicles with global capital sources. The meeting offers a setting for connecting with peers, exploring potential partnerships, and identifying new opportunities within the evolving private markets.

events.name: Metropolitan Philadelphia HFMA Revenue Cycle Seminar 2026

location.venue: DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Philadelphia Center City

events.description:
Embrace "The Philadelphia Formula: Grit, Growth and Revenue Cycle Innovation" at the Metropolitan Philadelphia HFMA Revenue Cycle Seminar 2026. The full-day event, co-hosted with Philadelphia AAHAM, will take place on November 19, 2026, from 7:30 am to 4:30 pm ET at the DoubleTree by Hilton Hotel Philadelphia Center City.

This seminar is for revenue cycle professionals and members of both organizations, addressing important subjects influencing healthcare finance. Regional and national experts will discuss the Revenue Cycle Leadership Development Program, the evolution of our nation's health insurance system, and AI's impact on the Mid-Revenue Cycle. Panel discussions will also explore the collaboration between CFOs and the Revenue Cycle.

The day concludes with a reception, providing an opportunity for attendees to meet and converse with colleagues.

events.name: AMATYC Annual Conference 2026
events.description:
Mathematics educators from two-year colleges across the nation are invited to the 52nd AMATYC Annual Conference, taking place November 19-22, 2026, in historic Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. This gathering provides a space for educators to develop professionally, work together, and share new teaching approaches.

Participants can expect to delve into topics central to current mathematics education. Discussions will cover fostering equity and inclusivity, using technology and e-learning effectively, creating successful academic paths for both STEM and non-STEM students, and improving strategies for student achievement.

It's a chance to connect with colleagues, learn about recent research, and gather practical ideas to apply in the classroom. This event offers a valuable opportunity to meet with leaders in the field and contribute to the ongoing development of mathematics education at two-year colleges.

events.name: Gramercy Financial Marketers' Forum Chicago 2026
events.description:
On Wednesday, November 18, 2026, the Gramercy Financial Marketers' Forum Chicago 2026 will convene, offering a vital platform for industry professionals. The forum will focus on the key theme: "Financial Marketing 2027: Managing Change in a Changing World." Attendees will gain a deeper understanding of the evolving strategies, technologies, and consumer behaviors that are shaping the financial sector's future.

The day's agenda includes expert-led discussions, practical case studies, and interactive sessions. These are designed to help participants develop actionable strategies for navigating market volatility, utilizing new tools, and adapting campaigns for sustained growth. It also offers a chance to connect with peers, exchange best practices, and build professional relationships, preparing individuals to guide their organizations in the evolving landscape of financial marketing.

events.name: Marketing Automative @ LA Auto Show 2026
events.description:
Experience the dynamic convergence of automotive innovation and marketing excellence at Marketing Automative @ LA Auto Show 2026. This event, held as part of the LA Auto Show, is designed for professionals seeking to understand the latest in marketing automation for the auto industry.

The program will explore strategies across digital media, interactive advertising, and personalized customer engagement. It will also highlight how automation tools are reshaping the way car brands connect with consumers, from their initial interest to building post-purchase loyalty.

Participants will gain practical insights and examine the future trends driving success in automotive marketing. The event also provides a setting to connect with industry leaders and peers. The aim is to help professionals enhance their brand's digital presence and overall marketing effectiveness.

events.name: Vancouver Cybersecurity Summit 2026
events.description:
Elevate your enterprise's defenses and strategic vision at the Vancouver Cybersecurity Summit 2026.

This in-person summit, taking place on Thursday, November 19, 2026, at the JW Marriott Parq Vancouver, is for active cybersecurity, IT, and information security practitioners. It brings together hundreds of pre-screened CISOs, senior leaders, and experts, offering a day of insights and opportunities for professional connection.

Discussions will cover critical topics such as AI and emerging technologies at the security frontline, securing extended ecosystems, and aligning security with business outcomes. Attendees can participate in interactive panels and review solutions from providers like DigiCert and Ping Identity. The full-day experience includes catered meals, a closing reception, and the opportunity to earn CPE/CEU credits.

events.name: Digit Expo 2026
events.description:
Scotland's premier technology showcase, Digit Expo 2026, returns to the EICC Edinburgh on 19 November. This gathering is for over 1700 IT and Digital professionals and tech leaders. The agenda explores the future of technology, with discussions covering AI, digital transformation, cloud computing, and cybersecurity. These topics will be presented through keynote talks and interactive breakout sessions.

Insights will be shared by representatives from global brands like Met Office, IBM, Adobe, and Skyscanner. The event also features Scotland's largest tech exhibition, showcasing over 60 solutions providers. Attendees will have opportunities to connect with peers, learn about the latest advancements, and earn 8 hours of certificated CPD credits. Access to the event, including these credits, is provided with a complimentary ticket.

events.name: RegTech Summit New York 2026
events.description:
Marking its tenth anniversary, the RegTech Summit New York returns on November 19, 2026, at @Ease, 605 Third Avenue, to address the evolving landscape of compliance transformation. The summit gathers senior leaders in compliance, risk, and technology from the North American capital markets financial industry.

The agenda will offer practical insights into using AI, data, and emerging technologies. These discussions aim to strengthen governance, improve surveillance, and enhance financial crime controls. Topics will also include scaling AI across various functions and navigating regulators' increasing focus on operational resilience and risk management.

Operating under Chatham House Rules, the event encourages open discussion. This framework supports conversations around building scalable, future-ready compliance operating models within today's complex regulatory landscape.

events.name: CIO Toronto Summit 2026
events.description:
The CIO Toronto Summit 2026, taking place on Thursday, November 19th, in Toronto, offers senior IT leaders a vital one-day forum. Focused on "Unlocking What’s Next: Insight and Innovation for a Transformational Era," the summit creates a space for CIOs to have genuine discussions about the significant challenges they face today. Those attending will explore critical topics such as demonstrating AI's value, managing multi-cloud environments, updating legacy systems, and developing talent.

An agenda, shaped by a CIO Advisory Board, offers practical insights and actionable strategies to help leaders drive transformation and build resilience. The smaller setting encourages leaders to connect with their peers, engage directly with solution providers offering new technologies, and participate in collaborative discussions. The day concludes with a reception, providing another opportunity for connection. It is a key gathering for those guiding the future of enterprise technology.

events.name: DevOpsDays Portugal 2026
events.description:
Prepare for an unparalleled convergence of technology and community as DevOpsDays Portugal 2026 joins forces with KCD Porto 2026. The event will be held on November 19-20, 2026, at the Super Bock Arena in Porto, Portugal. It will bring together professionals from the DevOps and Cloud Native communities.

Participants can explore current trends in DevOps, Kubernetes, Platform Engineering, Cloud Native technologies, and AI. The program includes keynotes, practical sessions, and in-depth technical discussions led by experienced professionals.

This joint event offers a broader platform for engineers, developers, SREs, and tech leaders. It provides opportunities to gain current knowledge and connect with peers, supporting their professional development and projects.

events.name: IT Security USA 2026
events.description:
San Francisco becomes the epicenter of cybersecurity innovation on November 19th, 2026, with IT Security USA 2026. This one-day conference is designed for senior IT security professionals, CISOs, and decision-makers representing sectors like banking, healthcare, retail, and government.

Participants can expect to gain practical strategies and current insights from experienced speakers and industry leaders, covering various facets of IT security implementation. Discussions will cover key areas including Cloud Security, AI in Security, Threat & Risk Management, DevSecOps, and Ransomware Protection.

The program includes in-depth discussions, analysis of recent case studies, and opportunities to connect with professionals from around the world. The event provides a platform for participants to stay informed about evolving threats and strengthen their organization's security posture.

events.name: CASBO CBO Symposium 2026
events.description:
The CASBO CBO Symposium 2026, an exclusive, invitation-only experience, convenes California's Chief Business Officials and senior school business leaders. This gathering takes place on November 19-20 at The Langham, Pasadena, and is designed for those who make key decisions about the financial and operational health of TK–14 institutions.

Discussions will address California’s fiscal outlook, legislative changes, and trends in collective bargaining. events.name: Conf42 MLOps 2026
events.description:
Prepare to elevate your Machine Learning Operations expertise at Conf42 MLOps 2026, a premier online conference scheduled for November 19, 2026. Starting at 5:00 PM GMT, the event will delve into the latest tools, established practices, and upcoming developments that are influencing the MLOps field.

Attendees will have access to all content, which supports continuous learning and connection among technology professionals. This is a chance to learn from industry leaders and share your own perspectives; the Call for Papers is currently open.

With support from Diamond Sponsors Harness and LLMDay, Conf42 MLOps 2026 offers insights for those focused on deploying and managing machine learning models effectively at scale.

events.name: Pacific Marine Expo 2026
events.description:
Anchoring in Seattle from November 19-21, 2026, the Pacific Marine Expo is the West Coast's largest commercial marine tradeshow, presented by National Fisherman. Held at the Seattle Convention Center Arch Building, the expo serves as a gathering point for commercial mariners spanning the entire West Coast, from Alaska down to California.

Those attending, including fishermen, vessel owners, shipyard personnel, and port officials, will find a comprehensive display of the newest products, essential gear, and engine technologies. The event showcases advancements across commercial fishing, vessel operations, and shipbuilding, offering a look at current developments and future directions.

It provides a setting for connecting with industry professionals and exploring practical solutions. Conversations and presentations offer insights into the evolving marine landscape, helping participants understand current challenges and opportunities. The aim is to foster an environment where individuals can gain knowledge and broaden their professional connections.

events.name: World Art Dubai 2026
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the vibrant world of contemporary art at World Art Dubai 2026, the MENA region's largest fair. From November 19-22, the Dubai World Trade Centre's Za’abeel Halls 2 & 3 will display more than 10,000 artworks. Visitors can explore pieces from over 400 exhibitors, a group that includes 275 solo artists and 120 galleries from more than 65 countries. Artworks will be available, with prices starting at $100.

Key features of the event include the Emerging Artist Prize, a dedicated Textile Hub, and PhotoWAD. Attendees will have opportunities to engage with featured artists such as wildlife photographer Minkie Du Toit and painter Farzin Allana. The event also presents a chance to explore spaces like Russia's Shrainer Gallery. World Art Dubai 2026 provides a significant occasion for art enthusiasts and collectors to connect with creative works from around the world.

events.name: Tissue World Istanbul 2026
events.description:
The global tissue industry converges in Istanbul for Tissue World Istanbul 2026, a pivotal event connecting EurAsia with the burgeoning MENA market. This gathering takes place on November 18-19, 2026, at the Hilton Istanbul Bosphorus in Türkiye. This year's focus underscores Türkiye's significant position as a global leader in tissue production.

Participants can expect to engage with discussions on market analysis, production efficiency, and sustainable solutions, presented across more than 20 expert-led sessions. The event also features an exhibition floor where over 45 companies will showcase advancements in machinery, automation, and other innovative technologies.

The event brings together over 120 delegates and 500 visitors from more than 30 countries. This diverse group of manufacturers, suppliers, and buyers will have the chance to connect, build relationships, and hear perspectives from industry leaders such as Alp Öğücü and Maen Tabari. The aim is to collectively explore the evolving landscape of tissue production and its sustainable future.

events.name: Scottsdale Cybersecurity Summit 2026
events.description:
Elevate your enterprise's defense at the 8th Annual Scottsdale Cybersecurity Summit 2026, an exclusive in-person gathering on October 1st in Scottsdale, AZ. This event is for CISOs and senior cybersecurity practitioners seeking to strengthen their organization's resilience, reduce risk, and ensure security efforts align with core business objectives.

The agenda includes discussions on critical areas like the impact of AI and emerging technologies on security, protecting extended digital environments, and building smarter, more diverse teams. Through interactive panels, participants will take away practical strategies, discover new solutions, and connect with industry colleagues and C-suite leaders. Attendees can also earn CEU/CPE credits while learning how to navigate the evolving threat landscape and achieve measurable security outcomes.

events.name: Crypto Fest 2026
events.description:
The 8th edition of Africa's premier Web3 gathering, Crypto Fest 2026, returns to vibrant Cape Town, South Africa, on November 20th. Hosted by Bitcoin Events, this event will bring together more than 30 global innovators and thought leaders. They will discuss the latest developments in cryptocurrency, blockchain, DeFi, and the Metaverse.

Those attending can expect to gain valuable insights into current market trends, effective investment strategies, and the newest platforms influencing the digital asset world. The event will feature exhibition booths showcasing prominent crypto projects, licensed Crypto Asset Service Providers (CASPs), and various fintech solutions. There will also be opportunities to connect with industry leaders, investors, and developers.

It offers a chance to understand Sub-Saharan Africa's significant role in the crypto space and to meet with many individuals who are actively shaping the Web3 ecosystem.

events.name: Global Digital Health Summit 2026
events.description:
The Global Digital Health Summit 2026, taking place on November 20-21 at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi, is poised to redefine the future of healthcare. The summit's theme, "Digital Health is the 21st Century Healthcare," will guide discussions on how innovation can transform global health systems.

Participants will hear from a diverse group of experts, including internet pioneers, UN officials, government ministers, and prominent healthcare leaders. They will explore how digital solutions are changing patient care, improving operational efficiency, and influencing public health strategies. This event brings together policymakers, innovators, and practitioners interested in understanding and contributing to the next phase of health.

events.name: ITMA ASIA + CITME 2026
events.description:
Prepare to witness the forefront of textile innovation at ITMA ASIA + CITME 2026, taking place from 20 to 24 November at the National Exhibition and Convention Center (NECC) in Shanghai, China.

This event serves as a significant gathering for textile machinery professionals across Asia, influencing the direction of the industry. Visitors will find expanded product areas, including a new section on composites, which focuses on high-performance fibers for aerospace and automotive applications. Additionally, an enhanced software and automation sector will feature industrial robots, intelligent sensing systems, and digital twin production lines.

The emphasis remains on advanced technologies, sustainable processes, and digital transformation. This environment allows individuals to explore current trends, establish professional connections, and understand how new solutions can be applied throughout the textile and garment manufacturing process.

events.name: Conversion Hotel 2026
events.description:
Conversion Hotel 2026 invites passionate digital optimizers, experimenters, and professionals in Product, UX, Marketing, and Data to an exclusive three-day retreat on Texel, the Netherlands, from November 20-22. With attendance capped at 220 people, this gathering at Grand Hotel Opduin and nearby accommodations provides an in-depth exploration of evidence-based growth, advanced experimentation, AI & CRO, and cross-channel optimization.

Attendees will engage with content ranging from keynote presentations to interactive unconference sessions, all designed to offer practical insights and enhance professional capabilities. The experience extends beyond formal learning, including enjoyable evenings, thoughtfully prepared meals, and comfortable lodging, all covered within the event.

This structure encourages genuine networking and collaboration among professionals in the field. It creates an environment where individuals can connect, share ideas, and contribute to discussions that help shape the direction of digital growth.

events.name: Halifax International Security Forum 2026
events.description:
Scheduled for November 20-22, 2026, in Nova Scotia, Canada, the Halifax International Security Forum 2026 is poised to be the premier international gathering in the immediate aftermath of the US midterm elections.

This invitation-only event will bring together 300 leaders – decision-makers, entrepreneurs, writers, and individuals dedicated to freedom – united by their shared commitment to democracy. The forum's central theme, "Democracies Demand Decency," provides a platform for important discussions. Attendees will work together to consider strategies for building a more secure international environment, reflecting on global challenges like the conflict in Ukraine.

The forum aims to strengthen strategic cooperation among democracies worldwide, emphasizing democracy's essential role in fostering global security, economic opportunity, and lasting peace.

events.name: GeorgiaCISO ORBIE Awards 2026
events.description:
The GeorgiaCISO ORBIE Awards 2026 is a premier series of events dedicated to recognizing the transformative power of cybersecurity leadership across the state. The series begins with the ORBIE Leadership Reception on August 11 at Cox Communications, an evening dedicated to acknowledging this year's nominees. Following this, a Finalist Reception & Dinner will take place on October 28 at Capital City Club Brookhaven, providing an occasion to meet the finalists.

The main event, the GeorgiaCISO ORBIE Awards, is scheduled for November 20 at The Starling, where the winners will be announced live. This multi-stage program honors executive leaders who are driving innovation and strengthening the security of Georgia's prominent organizations. It provides a setting for CISOs, other executive leaders, and partners to connect, share perspectives, and recognize individuals who are influencing the direction of information security.
