events.name: CRSA Worldwide Congress 2026
events.description:
The CRSA 16th Worldwide Congress, themed "The Present and Future of Robotic Surgery," will gather leading minds from November 20-22, 2025, at The Waterfront Beach Resort in Huntington Beach, CA. This gathering is for surgeons, residents, fellows, and allied healthcare professionals focused on advancing robotic and minimally invasive surgery.

Attendees will engage with current research, examine new technologies, and discuss the evolving impact of AI, automation, and remote surgery across general and specialized surgical fields. The congress also offers opportunities to connect and collaborate among clinicians and scientists.

Participants will have the opportunity to earn 5.5 *AMA PRA Category 1 Credits*™ while gaining insights into the safe integration of robotic platforms and navigating challenges in patient care.

events.name: Patient Support Services Congress 2026
events.description:
Uniting two vital industry events, Patient Pathways: The Copay and Patient Services Congress 2026 arrives in Philadelphia from November 17-20. This four-day congress, which includes the Patient Support Services Congress, brings together over 500 pharmaceutical and biotechnology professionals. It offers a focused environment for managers, directors, and program heads working in patient support, access, reimbursement, and compliance to discuss current approaches and challenges.

The agenda is structured to dedicate specific time to key areas: copay strategy will be the focus on November 17-18, followed by patient services strategy from November 19-20. This allows for in-depth discussions within each domain. The program features executive panels, case studies on AI-powered hub services, and sessions that delve into program impact and return on investment through data analysis.

Attendees will have opportunities for interactive benchmarking and "Ask the Experts" segments, providing direct engagement with peers and specialists. There will also be ample time for networking. These elements are designed to help professionals refine their strategies for improving patient access, affordability, and overall support services.

events.name: CABE/CAPSS Convention 2026
events.description:
Elevate your leadership and shape the future of education at the CABE/CAPSS Convention 2026, taking place November 20-21 at the Mystic Marriott Hotel & Spa in Groton. This event, organized by the Connecticut Association of Boards of Education (CABE) and the Connecticut Association of Public School Superintendents (CAPSS), brings together board members, superintendents, and school leaders from Connecticut and across New England.

The convention aims to provide participants with knowledge and perspectives essential for preparing students for success in the 21st century. Discussions will cover important subjects such as the role of AI in schools, recent legislative updates, strategies for crisis communication, school safety protocols, and methods for empowering multilingual learners.

The program includes general sessions, practical workshops, and opportunities for professional exchange. Student performances will also be featured, offering a look at the talents of Connecticut's young people. The goal is to support educational excellence and contribute to student growth.

events.name: IEEE IPCCC 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for the 45th IEEE International Performance Computing and Communications Conference (IPCCC 2026), a pivotal event for researchers and professionals in the field. The conference will be held in Austin, Texas, USA, from November 20-22, 2026. A virtual component is also planned for November 14 or 15, providing a flexible experience for participants. The IEEE Computer Society sponsors IPCCC 2026, bringing together experts from around the world to present and discuss new developments in performance computing and communications.

The program includes peer-reviewed research papers and interactive workshops. These sessions will explore recent innovations, current challenges, and future directions in the field. This offers academics, engineers, and industry experts a chance to share their work, gain new insights, and build collaborations that can influence future technology.

events.name: Esomar Connect New Delhi 2026
events.description:
Prepare to connect, learn, and innovate as Esomar Connect New Delhi 2026 brings together the vibrant data, research, and insights community. This in-person event will take place in New Delhi on 20 November 2026, from 08:30 to 13:30 IST. It offers a space where local professionals, industry leaders, and innovators can meet and exchange ideas.

Participants will have opportunities for discussion, sharing knowledge about emerging trends, and exploring regional market research challenges. Speakers, including Priya Lobo and Sandeep Singh, will offer their perspectives. The event will also highlight Esomar’s global work and local opportunities.

It's a chance to expand professional networks and connect with both experienced individuals and those newer to the field. This half-day event, supported by InQognito, aims to encourage growth and contribute to the future of insights in the region.

events.name: Northern New England HFMA Women in Leadership Conference 2026
events.description:
Set your sights on professional advancement at the Northern New England HFMA Women in Leadership Conference 2026. On Friday, November 20, 2026, the SNHU Millyard in Manchester, NH, will bring together women from Maine, New Hampshire, and Vermont who are influencing the direction of healthcare finance.

The conference focuses on providing leaders with strategic insights, helping them develop new skills, and building a strong network among colleagues. Attendees will participate in discussions exploring industry complexities, sharing their experiences, and advocating for new ideas. The goal is to help individuals strengthen their leadership and contribute to meaningful change within the evolving world of healthcare finance.

events.name: BitBlockMine 2026
events.description:
The future of Bitcoin mining is set to unfold at BitBlockMine 2026, a premier event for enthusiasts and professionals alike. This inaugural mining-focused gathering from the BitBlockBoom team will take place on November 20–21, 2026, at the historic Fort Worth Stockyard Station in Fort Worth, TX. It aims to bring together the Bitcoin mining community for a focused exploration of the industry's direction.

The program is designed for everyone, from experienced miners to those new to the field. Participants can expect deep conversations, sessions led by experts, and practical discussions. The agenda includes exploring current strategies and innovations, featuring insights from speakers such as Kent Halliburton and Hodl Tarantula.

The event concludes with the BitBlockMine Casino Night, an opportunity for attendees to connect with fellow builders and innovators in a relaxed setting. The gathering provides a platform for learning, networking, and contributing to the ongoing development of Bitcoin mining.

events.name: InterGem Jewelry Show Seattle 2026
events.description:
America's longest-running direct-to-consumer jewelry show, InterGem, returns to Seattle from November 20-22, 2026, at the Seattle Center Exhibition Hall. This event provides an opportunity for the public to shop directly from wholesalers, manufacturers, and designers. Visitors can expect to find a diverse selection of fine jewelry, gemstones, beads, and unique items.

These pieces are available at competitive prices, often comparable to trade-level rates. Licensed business owners have access to exclusive "Wholesale Only" sections for their specific sourcing needs. Complimentary admission is extended to active and veteran military members and their immediate families.

events.name: International Conference on Renewable Energy and Conservation 2026
events.description:
Set against the historic backdrop of Rome, the 11th International Conference on Renewable Energy and Conservation (ICREC 2026) offers a pivotal forum from November 20-22, 2026, dedicated to advancing sustainable energy solutions. The conference will explore key topics such as renewable energy grid infrastructure, new technologies, engineering design, and practical approaches to industrial challenges. Conversations will cover energy generation, transmission, storage, electrification, and security within energy systems.

Attendees will encounter recent research, and selected papers presented at the conference may be published in the Springer Book Series: Green Energy and Technology (indexed by Ei Compendex, Scopus). Additionally, extended versions of some papers could be considered for the International Journal of Green Energy (indexed by SCIE, Scopus). ICREC 2026 brings together individuals focused on the future of renewable energy and conservation.

events.name: International Symposium on Hydrogen Energy and Energy Technologies 2026
events.description:
Join the global hydrogen energy community in Osaka, Japan, from November 21-23, 2026, for the 9th International Symposium on Hydrogen Energy and Energy Technologies (HEET 2026). This gathering brings together academic scientists, researchers, practitioners, and engineers from around the world to share insights and encourage collaboration.

Attendees will explore recent innovations, current trends, and practical challenges across key areas. These include hydrogen production, storage, fuel cells, system integration, and other related energy technologies.

Papers that are accepted and registered will be published in the Journal of Physics: Conference Series (IOP Publishing). This publication is indexed by Ei Compendex, Scopus, and Web of Science.

events.name: JOBMEDI Berlin 2026
events.description:
Charting a course for professional success in the vital health, care, and social sectors, JOBMEDI Berlin 2026 opens its doors on November 20-21 at Messe Berlin, Eingang Süd. This event provides clear direction and insights for students, those beginning their careers, individuals looking to change paths, and experienced professionals in these fields.

Attendees can discover a wide range of possibilities, including apprenticeships, dual study programs, further education, and options for re-entering the workforce. There is also a dedicated focus on opportunities for individuals aged 50 and above. It's an opportunity to connect directly with social institutions, clinics, and vocational schools.

The program includes interactive workshops, presentations from experts, and a complimentary application portfolio review. The event operates under the patronage of Dr. Ina Czyborra, Senator for Science, Health, and Care. Admission is free.

events.name: India Art Festival New Delhi 2026
events.description:
New Delhi is set to host a dynamic convergence of art and commerce at the India Art Festival 2026. This contemporary art fair serves as a broad platform, bringing together emerging, independent, and established artists alongside mid-level and major galleries. It offers a chance for art dealers, buyers, interior designers, architects, and connoisseurs to encounter more than 15,000 artworks and build meaningful connections.

Attendees can engage with artists, gallerists, and cultural organizers through 'IAF | Conversations,' a program of panel discussions. The festival will feature a range of exhibitions, opportunities for artists to showcase their work individually or in groups, and the presentation of the IAF Awards.

The event includes an open call for participation and offers exclusive VIP previews. It functions as a central point for professional networking and the exchange of art, contributing to the ongoing story of Indian art.

events.name: At the Vineyards! Angers 2026

location.venue: Parc des Expositions, Route de Paris

events.description:
Prepare your palate for an exquisite journey at At the Vineyards! Angers 2026, marking its 32nd edition from November 20 to 22 at the Parc des Expositions. This gathering offers an opportunity to delve into the breadth of French wines and gastronomy.

Over 135 artisans and producers from across France will be present, offering their products directly and sharing insights into their craft. Attendees can sample everything from Bordeaux reds and Alsatian whites to artisanal chocolates and regional cheeses, gaining a direct appreciation for the diverse French terroirs. The event includes direct pricing from producers, along with on-site catering and complimentary parking. A tasting glass, required for sampling, can be purchased for 2€.

Information regarding exhibitors and their products will be available to help visitors plan their experience.

events.name: Auckland Property People Awards 2026
events.description:
A night of unparalleled recognition awaits the Auckland property community at the prestigious Auckland Property People Awards 2026. Property Council New Zealand hosts this event on Friday 20 November 2026, from 6:30 pm at the Hilton Auckland. It's an occasion to celebrate the exceptional talent, innovation, and leadership driving the region's property industry.

The evening brings together professionals from development, architecture, engineering, and property management. It's a chance to honour outstanding individuals and high-performing teams. Awards will highlight emerging achievers, dedicated professionals, sustainability champions, and those who are shaping Auckland's future. This gathering offers an opportunity for connection, inspiration, and appreciation for those contributing to the city's development.

The awards ceremony culminates with the presentation of the Barker & Associates Supreme Excellence Award.

events.name: Super Stay Live 2026
events.description:
For owners, investors, and professionals in the booming holiday property sector, Super Stay Live 2026 in Augsburg is the essential industry meeting point for Southern Germany. This gathering will be held from November 20-22, 2026, at Messe Augsburg, Halle 1. Its focus is on the thoughtful planning, furnishing, and efficient operation of holiday accommodations.

Those attending can expect to see new developments in furniture, kitchens, bathrooms, and accessories. There will also be important services on display, such as booking portals, marketing strategies, and Smart Home solutions. Technology will be a key area, with discussions and displays covering everything from billing and locking systems to E-charging stations.

The three-day program offers a range of activities, including talks from experts on market trends, practical workshops focused on furnishing and enhancing the guest experience, and sessions for project advice. Opportunities for connecting with others are also built into the schedule, through formats like round tables and speed dating, allowing for conversations with speakers and industry colleagues.

events.name: At the Vineyards! Limoges 2026
events.description:
Prepare your palate for an exquisite journey through France's finest! At the Vineyards! Limoges 2026 takes place at the Parc des Expositions from November 20-22. This 13th annual event welcomes anyone interested in French food and wine, gathering 65 artisans and producers from across the country.

Visitors will find a wide array of wines, from Bordeaux to Alsace, including organic and AOC selections. Alongside the wines, there will be a variety of gourmet items such as artisanal chocolates, charcuterie, and cheeses. This is an opportunity to speak directly with the producers, gain insights into their craft, and purchase unique products at direct prices. Admission is 5€, which provides access for the entire weekend, offering a chance to experience the breadth of French winemaking and culinary traditions.

events.name: India NBFC Summit & Awards 2026
events.description:
Set to redefine the future of India's credit ecosystem, the India NBFC Summit & Awards 2026 convenes on November 25 at Hotel The Lalit, Mumbai. Operating under the theme "Riding over Digital Lending," this invite-only event gathers over 500 decision-makers and 50 industry experts. Participants, including CEOs, MDs, and key functional heads, will explore more than ten sessions focused on future trends. These discussions will cover digital lending, artificial intelligence, data utilization, and the role of agentic AI in developing intelligent NBFCs and refining credit underwriting processes.

The summit will feature panel discussions and keynote addresses from leaders such as Ram Kishan Kolli and Ashish Mehrotra, alongside opportunities for professional connection. A significant part of the event is the India NBFC Awards 2026, which recognizes achievements in innovation and digital transformation within the sector. The gathering aims to foster a deeper understanding of the factors contributing to sustainable growth and to collectively consider the direction of India's NBFC sector for the coming decade.

events.name: AIBC Conference 2026
events.description:
The 7th International Artificial Intelligence and Blockchain Conference (AIBC Conference 2026) will convene from November 20-22, 2026, at Ritsumeikan University in Osaka, Japan. This gathering will bring together researchers and industry professionals from around the world. The aim is to explore the connection between artificial intelligence and blockchain technologies, understanding how they influence the creation of intelligent systems and efficient processes across various fields.

The conference program includes a range of technical sessions and presentations from keynote speakers. These sessions are designed to encourage discussions on recent advancements and address important open questions in the field. For authors, there is an opportunity to publish accepted papers in ACM Proceedings, which are indexed by Scopus and Ei Compendex.

Participants can expect to engage with a wide array of subjects. These include the design of intelligent system architectures and the specific applications of blockchain in areas like healthcare and travel. The conference provides a setting for those interested in contributing new research or gaining deeper insights into these evolving technologies.

events.name: ACTFL Annual Convention and World Languages Expo 2026
events.description:
The ACTFL Annual Convention and World Languages Expo 2026 invites thousands of educators, administrators, and language leaders to San Antonio, TX, from November 19-22 at the Henry B. González Convention Center.

The gathering provides extensive opportunities for professional growth, featuring more than 600 educational sessions and an exhibit hall showcasing over 200 companies. Participants can explore new resources in specialized areas such as the AI Corner Classroom and the Digital Learning Lounge, both designed to support the success of multilingual learners.

The program includes presentations from keynote speakers Debbie Allen and Mychal-Bella Rayne Bowman. It also offers a chance to connect with a wide network of colleagues and find practical approaches to influence the direction of language education. The event aims to foster innovation and professional development for educators at all career stages.

events.name: Product (Un)Conference 2026
events.description:
Step "Into the Future" at Product (Un)Conference 2026, a premier in-person gathering on November 21 in Bengaluru, India. The Product Folks are organizing this event, with support from industry leaders like Anthropic and Google Cloud. Its focus is on exploring and shaping the future of AI in India.

Attendees can expect over 10 hours of insights across more than 20 curated sessions. These sessions will deliver practical strategies and actionable playbooks from over 50 experienced Product Leaders and Founders. It's an opportunity to connect with more than 350 product pioneers, founders, and senior leaders who share an interest in product development, technology, design, and growth.

For those with a VIP pass, there is exclusive access to a roundtable discussion and an UnConf afterparty. Food, drinks, and a swag bag are also provided. The conference aims to contribute to the ongoing innovation within India's evolving AI landscape.

events.name: Motorcycle Live 2026
events.description:
The UK's largest biking show, Motorcycle Live 2026, ignites the NEC Birmingham from November 21-29, promising nine days of unparalleled two-wheeled excitement. This event welcomes everyone with an interest in two wheels, whether they are passionate about modern or classic motorcycles, enjoy off-road adventures, or are just starting out.

Visitors will find the latest motorcycles, advancements in technology, and essential safety equipment from over 250 companies. The show will feature three new displays, mark the 30th anniversary of the British Superbike Championship, and include a special section celebrating Indian Motorcycle's 125th year.

For those new to riding, the Learn2Ride Zone offers a complimentary introduction. A new Show & Shine competition provides an opportunity for attendees to present their own cherished bikes. There will also be a chance to win a Honda CB650R.

events.name: Eurasia Window Fair 2026
events.description:
Prepare to connect with the global construction industry at Eurasia Window Fair 2026, taking place from November 21-24 at the TÜYAP Fair and Congress Center in Istanbul, Türkiye. Held alongside the Eurasia Door and Eurasia Glass Fairs, this gathering stands as the largest trade event in the Eurasia Region and the second largest worldwide for these related industries.

Visitors can expect to see the latest innovations in PVC and aluminum profile systems, window accessories, shading solutions, insulation materials, and advanced production machinery. The fair anticipates welcoming 700 exhibitors and more than 66,000 visitors from 165 countries, creating a significant environment for professional interaction and business discussions. It brings together leading manufacturers and buyers from various international markets, including Africa, Europe, the Middle East, and the Americas.

The event serves as a key gathering for construction professionals worldwide interested in exploring new solutions and industry developments. The MyTüyap digital platform will also be available to support participants during the event.

events.name: Eurasia Glass Fair 2026
events.description:
From November 21-24, 2026, the TÜYAP Fair and Congress Center in Istanbul, Türkiye, will host Eurasia Glass Fair 2026, a pivotal event for the global glass industry. This gathering is recognized as one of the largest trade events in Eurasia and the second biggest globally within its sector, offering significant insights and opportunities for business connections. Held alongside the Eurasia Window and Eurasia Door Fairs, it allows for a comprehensive exploration of solutions for building and interior design.

Visitors can expect to see a wide range of new developments, including glass processing machinery, various glass products, specialized chemicals, insulation materials, and accessories. Manufacturers and buyers from diverse international markets, such as Russia, Iran, the Balkans, and Central Asia, will attend. They will have the chance to discuss current trends, establish new collaborations, and contribute to the industry's progress. The event provides a valuable setting for professionals to connect and understand upcoming developments in glass, window, and door technologies.

events.name: Eurasia Door Fair 2026
events.description:
Opening its doors from November 21 to 24, 2026, the Eurasia Door Fair, co-located with the Eurasia Window and Glass Fairs, offers an unparalleled platform at the TÜYAP Fair and Congress Center in İstanbul, Türkiye. This gathering is recognized as the largest trade event in the Eurasia Region and the second largest worldwide for these industries. It serves as a key meeting point for the construction industry, bringing together more than 700 manufacturers from 25 countries and a significant number of international buyers.

Attendees will find the newest developments in interior, steel, automatic, and fire doors, as well as advanced security and automation systems. The MyTüyap digital fair application is available to support business connections and networking, helping participants engage with a wide range of global markets, spanning from the Far East to the Americas.

events.name: Maker Faire Rochester 2026
events.description:
Prepare to be inspired at Maker Faire Rochester 2026, a vibrant showcase of invention and creativity! On Saturday, November 21st, the RIT Gordon Field House will host what's known as "the Greatest Show (& Tell) on Earth." Families and the general public can explore projects from engineers, artists, scientists, and crafters. Attendees will encounter hands-on experiments, clever gadgets, and original creations designed to spark new ideas.

The event begins a day earlier, on Friday, November 20th, with the Student S.T.E.A.M. Fest, an experience tailored for younger participants. This family-friendly gathering highlights resourcefulness and innovation, giving young minds an opportunity to see what's possible and be inspired by human creativity.

events.name: Virtual Reality Day 2026
events.description:
Get ready to immerse yourself in the cutting-edge world of virtual reality! The 10th Annual Virtual Reality Day takes place on Saturday, November 21st, 2026, commemorating ten years of significant advancements in virtual reality. This global observance is structured around a decentralized model, encouraging individuals, communities, and organizations across the world to organize their own local events.

Whether someone is a seasoned developer, an aspiring creator, or simply curious about the metaverse, Virtual Reality Day provides an opportunity to explore, experience, and acknowledge the profound impact of VR. Participants can engage with hands-on demonstrations, join insightful discussions, or present their own immersive projects.

This occasion offers a chance to connect with the global VR community, exchange knowledge, and contribute to the future of spatial computing.

events.name: EURASIA WINDOW & DOOR FAIR 2026
events.description:
Set to redefine industry standards, the EURASIA WINDOW & DOOR FAIR 2026, co-located with the EURASIA GLASS FAIR, opens its doors from November 21-24 at the Tüyap Fair and Congress Center in İstanbul, Türkiye. This event is recognized as the largest trade fair in the Eurasia Region and the second largest globally for these industries.

The fair brings together comprehensive solutions for the interconnected window, door, and glass sectors, serving as a significant gathering point for the global construction industry. Participants can explore the latest in PVC and aluminum profile systems, advanced window and door accessories, shading, insulation, various door types, and innovative production machinery.

It provides a setting where manufacturers can connect with an international network of buyers from Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and other regions. This environment facilitates discussions and potential collaborations among businesses within these specialized fields.

events.name: Beauty Macedonia Winter 2026
events.description:
Beauty Macedonia Winter 2026 opens its doors to beauty and wellness professionals at HELEXPO - Building 13 in Thessaloniki, Greece, from November 21-23, 2026. This three-day exhibition and international congress serves as a key gathering point for professionals in aesthetics, makeup, hairdressing, spa, tattoo, aesthetic medicine, and related fields.

The event spans 7,000 sq.m. of exhibition space, where the latest products, devices, and techniques across various categories will be presented. Attendees can participate in live demonstrations, masterclasses, and informative sessions held at the dedicated MEETING POINT, featuring perspectives from both Greek and international speakers.

Professionals will have the chance to observe emerging trends, explore potential trade agreements with exhibitor discounts, and build their professional connections. For certified my BEAUTY GR members, entry is free, providing access to new developments and opportunities for professional growth within the COSMOPROF Network.

events.name: Funky Finds Holiday Shopping Experience 2026
events.description:
Get ready for a festive journey with a 'mod, retro flair' at the 17th Annual Funky Finds Holiday Shopping Experience 2026! This event takes place at the Will Rogers Memorial Center in Fort Worth, TX, on Saturday, November 21st from 10 AM to 5 PM, and Sunday, November 22nd from 11 AM to 4 PM. Visitors will find over 150 local makers and pickers showcasing handmade, vintage, and upcycled items, offering a wide selection of unique gifts for the holiday season.

Beyond shopping, there are several activities to enjoy. Attendees can participate in the Funky Finds STAMPede to collect special mascot merchandise. Food and drink will be available, and opportunities to take photos with Santa are offered in exchange for a charitable donation. Leashed pets are welcome, and Saving Hope Animal Rescue will be on-site to facilitate animal adoptions. A raffle will also be held, with proceeds benefiting Tarrant County Toys for Tots.

Admission to the event is free.

events.name: Brussels Design Market 2026
events.description:
Europe's largest celebration of vintage design, the Brussels Design Market 2026, invites enthusiasts and collectors alike to Gare Maritime at Tour & Taxis on November 21-22. Within the 8,000 square meter Gare Maritime, 185 dealers from across Europe will present their collections.

Visitors will find a broad selection of 20th-century design, ranging from Scandinavian minimalism to Italian modernism and American classics. Pieces by legendary designers such as Le Corbusier, Jacobsen, and Bertoia will be available, alongside other distinctive items. With over 10,000 visitors expected, the market offers an occasion to explore significant design pieces. It's an event for both seasoned collectors and those simply looking for inspiration, providing a comprehensive look into design history.

events.name: WePlay Expo 2026

location.venue: Shanghai World Expo Exhibition and Convention Center

events.description:
Shanghai, China, will once again become the epicenter of gaming and subculture at WePlay Expo 2026. As China's largest independent game exhibition, the event provides an in-person experience for those interested in interactive entertainment. Attendees can explore over 300 games from around the globe, featuring independent titles, major studio releases, and innovative student-developed projects across console, PC, and mobile platforms.

Beyond the games, the expo presents a range of cultural content, from contemporary art and board games to unique merchandise and live performances. WePlay Expo 2026 also functions as a significant gathering point for creative developers and industry professionals, facilitating business-to-business connections and hosting the annual IndiePlay Awards. The event showcases current trends and future directions in interactive entertainment and cultural expression.

events.name: Noorat Show 2026
events.description:
On Saturday, 21 November 2026, the Noorat Recreation Reserve will once again host the beloved Noorat Show, opening its gates at 9:00 AM for a day brimming with family fun and country tradition. This annual event, which has celebrated agriculture and community since 1932, offers a diverse experience for all ages.

Visitors will find a broad range of competitions, including the Junior Show Person and Dog High Jump, alongside displays of Livestock, Horses, Produce, and Crafts. The popular Show & Shine will also be featured. Throughout the day, there will be various trade sites to explore and ongoing entertainment to enjoy. While traditional poultry exhibitions are paused this year, creative "poultry fun" alternatives are planned.

The Noorat & District Agricultural & Pastoral Society Inc. presents this event as a way to acknowledge rural heritage and strengthen community bonds. It's an occasion for people to connect with local traditions and enjoy a day out.

events.name: Rethink! HR Tech Europe 2026
events.description:
The forefront of HR innovation converges in Berlin for Rethink! HR Tech Europe 2026, taking place from November 23-24 at Hotel Titanic Chaussee. This 2.5-day program is developed for CHROs and HR decision-makers, exploring how to shape the future of work and technology. A single ticket provides entry to co-located events, including Talent Management Reloaded and HR Analytics & AI Europe.

The program features over 131 expert-led sessions, 72 industry case studies, and 59 interactive workshops. These sessions delve into areas such as GenAI, predictive analytics, and next-generation Human Capital Management. Participants will also have opportunities to connect with more than 661 peers and industry leaders through over 192 targeted one-on-one meetings, allowing for discussions on new services and products. The focus throughout is on empowering people and leading the future with human-centric, AI-driven strategies.

events.name: NYSCATE Annual Conference 2026
events.description:
Elevate your educational practice at the NYSCATE Annual Conference 2026, a premier three-day event dedicated to the future of technology in learning. The conference runs from November 22-24 at the Turning Stone Resort and Conference Center in Verona, New York. It typically brings together over 1,500 educators and innovators.

Organized by the New York State Association for Computers and Technologies in Education, the program features over 200 presentations led by teachers and technology experts. There will also be more than 200 exhibitors demonstrating educational applications. Attendees can expect sessions with keynote speakers, Spotlight Speakers, interactive Playgrounds, NYSCATE Talks '26, and various after-hour activities.

These opportunities for learning and connection aim to provide insights that can inform and enhance classroom practices.

events.name: GPCA Forum 2026
events.description:
From November 22-24, 2026, the GPCA Forum will celebrate its 20th anniversary in Dubai, UAE, bringing together the global chemical industry's most influential minds.

The forum's 20th anniversary will explore the theme 'Persistence with Purpose: Built to Endure.' Discussions will focus on strategies for building resilience, improving competitiveness, and ensuring lasting impact within the industry. Global CEOs, policymakers, and other industry leaders will gather to consider the path forward.

Attendees will encounter several dedicated initiatives. The GPCA Sustainability Pavilion will highlight intelligent and efficient operational practices. The Startup Nexus provides a space for innovators to connect with investors, aiming to develop scalable solutions. Additionally, the event supports future talent through its Youth Forum and Exhibition, and acknowledges significant contributions with the GPCA Legacy Awards. These elements collectively underscore the forum's commitment to guiding the industry toward a sustainable future.

events.name: QS Higher Ed Summit: Middle East 2026
events.description:
Set against the vibrant backdrop of Abu Dhabi, the QS Higher Ed Summit: Middle East 2026, hosted by Khalifa University, will convene higher education leaders, policymakers, and innovators from November 22-24 at The Ritz-Carlton Abu Dhabi, Grand Canal.

This gathering brings together individuals for important conversations about the future of education, focusing on skills and innovation across the region and globally. Participants will examine significant trends, opportunities, and challenges influencing the sector, gaining a deeper understanding of areas like institutional performance, student recruitment, and new technologies.

The summit provides an environment for connecting with prominent figures in education, industry, and technology, encouraging important partnerships and broadening professional connections worldwide. The insights and collaborations formed here are intended to contribute to meaningful developments and influence the direction of higher education globally.

events.name: The Founders Table: Foundersgiving 2026
events.description:
Prepare for an evening of profound connection and shared vision at The Founders Table: Foundersgiving 2026. This intimate dinner and conversation series brings together founders, creatives, and visionaries. While the specific agenda for this 2026 gathering is still taking shape, guests can expect an evening focused on gratitude, reflecting on their entrepreneurial journeys, and considering future directions.

The aim is to cultivate meaningful connections and fresh perspectives, bringing together individuals with diverse insights and a shared curiosity. Participation is by application, which helps maintain an intimate setting where leaders can genuinely connect and inspire each other.

events.name: CEL Annual Convention 2026
events.description:
From November 22–24, 2026, the CEL Annual Convention in Philadelphia, PA, will convene a diverse group of educators and leaders under the theme, "Integrated Leadership: Bridging Literacy and English." Organized by the Conference on English Leadership, this event will explore how leadership intersects with, and sometimes challenges, the integration of literacy and English education.

Those attending will have opportunities to consider approaches for bringing instruction into better alignment, fostering collaborative environments, and directing efforts that enhance learning amidst the complexities of today's educational landscape. The convention is intended for literacy leaders, teachers, curriculum designers, and instructional leaders across all levels. It will include presentations from Tricia Ebarvia and Jenelle Williams.

The program offers concurrent sessions, facilitated dinners, and workshops designed to encourage collaboration. These activities will focus on addressing common challenges and fostering connections between literacy and English.

events.name: ClickBid Mexico 2026
events.description:
Prepare for an unparalleled evening at the 5th Anniversary of ClickBid Meetup Mexico 2026, taking place on November 22nd from 5 PM to 8 PM.

The SUPRA ROMA Rooftop Bar in Mexico City will serve as the venue, offering expansive skyline views. This gathering brings together leaders in the affiliate marketing industry. Attendees will include affiliate marketers, agency founders, traffic buyers, and AI innovators from various regions. The event aims to facilitate meaningful connections and discussions, creating opportunities for global business development within an open-air setting.

Guests can expect welcome drinks, an open bar, and light refreshments. This occasion is recognized as a significant gathering for affiliate professionals in Latin America. Attendance is managed through a VIP boarding pass system, with a limited number available.

events.name: CPHI & P-Mec India 2026
events.description:
Experience the future of pharmaceutical innovation at CPHI & P-Mec India 2026, running from November 23-26. Informa Markets is presenting this event in a new format, utilizing two specialized venues. CPHI India, located at IICC, Yashobhoomi, Dwarka, Delhi, will concentrate on pharmaceutical ingredients, linking India's manufacturing capabilities with global healthcare demands. Concurrently, PMEC India, taking place at IEML, Greater Noida, Delhi, will feature recent advancements in pharmaceutical machinery and technology.

This structure provides an extended experience, including a two-day overlap and convenient shuttle services between the locations. Attendees can expect improved navigation, interactions tailored to specific professional profiles, and more focused, productive meetings.

events.name: Big 5 Global 2026
events.description:
From November 23 to 26, 2026, the Dubai World Trade Centre will host Big 5 Global 2026, the definitive event for shaping the future of construction and urban development. This gathering brings together over 85,000 leaders, innovators, and policymakers from more than 165 countries. They come to discuss and advance key areas like supply chain efficiency, new technologies, sustainable practices, and talent development within the industry.

Attendees will have the opportunity to explore specialized areas such as Digital Construction World and Start-up City. The event also includes co-located exhibitions like Heavy, Totally Concrete, and HVACR World. Throughout these spaces, participants can see new developments firsthand, ranging from AI applications and advanced robotics to sustainable building materials and smart city solutions.

The event serves as an important forum for professionals to connect, share insights, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of the built environment. It's a place where ideas are exchanged and collaborations can form, influencing how our cities and infrastructure will develop in the years ahead.

events.name: International Conference on Public Health in Africa 2026
events.description:
The 5th International Conference on Public Health in Africa (CPHIA 2026) is set to convene in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, from 23–27 November 2026. Organized by Africa CDC, this significant event will bring together leaders, public health experts, and communities from across the continent and beyond.

CPHIA 2026 focuses on building stronger, self-reliant health systems and rethinking health financing strategies for Africa. Participants will engage in important discussions and collaborative work to ensure Africa's health security. This effort is guided by local leadership, innovative solutions, and strong partnerships.

The conference provides a forum for sharing knowledge, developing strategies, and taking collective action to shape a healthier future for the continent.

events.name: AusRAIL PLUS 2026
events.description:
The Asia-Pacific rail industry's premier event, AusRAIL PLUS 2026, will converge at the Brisbane Convention & Exhibition Centre from November 23-25. This conference and exhibition brings together over 7,000 rail professionals from Australia, New Zealand, and other regions, fostering discussions and connections within the industry.

Participants can explore the latest innovations, hear from leading speakers, and examine critical industry trends through a detailed program. The AusRAIL Exhibition provides a space to see new solutions and connect with key figures across passenger, freight, and heavy haul sectors.

Beyond the main sessions, there are opportunities for professional interaction, including the Women in Rail Forum, the new South Bank Sundowners, pre-conference workshops, and site tours. This gathering serves as a significant opportunity for those involved in rail to share insights and contribute to the industry's future direction.

events.name: BEYOND 2026
events.description:
BEYOND 2026 invites an international community of thinkers, makers, investors, and researchers to MediaCity, Salford, Manchester, UK, from November 23-25. The gathering focuses on the pioneering research and innovation that is shaping the future of creative industries.

Those attending will find discussions on innovation, strategy, and emerging trends. The program includes talks and practical workshops designed to show how applied research and development can benefit businesses. There will also be showcases presenting new projects and prototypes.

It offers an opportunity to connect with peers, collaborators, partners, and funders from across the globe. BEYOND 2026 aims to bring together culture, research, and new technology, influencing the development of future products and services.

events.name: COHO Expo 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for COHO Expo 2026, Europe's premier coffee and hospitality event, taking place from 23-25 November at the JW Marriott, Berlin. This three-day event offers a different approach to traditional trade shows. It features a dedicated program designed to connect established and emerging brands with 2,500 key decision-makers. These pre-arranged one-on-one meetings aim to foster meaningful connections, representing a collective purchasing influence exceeding €6 billion.

Attendees will have opportunities to see the newest product developments and explore a curated selection of European coffees at The Roaster Villages, supported by La Marzocco. The Cupping Exchange provides a space to establish new collaborations. Beyond these interactions, the event includes summits where industry leaders will discuss current procurement challenges, significant market trends, and approaches to growing businesses within the coffee and hospitality sectors. This gathering is for professionals interested in understanding current trends, exploring new ideas, and building connections across the coffee and hospitality industries.

events.name: Airports Innovate 2026
events.description:
The global aviation community will converge in Barcelona, Spain, for Airports Innovate 2026, from 23-25 November. This gathering serves as a central point for exploring significant advancements within the aviation ecosystem, focusing on how innovation is shaping the future of airports.

Participants will examine current strategies, new technologies, and leadership approaches that are influencing airport development. The event is intended for industry professionals, decision-makers, and those interested in the evolving landscape of aviation innovation. It is organized by ACI EUROPE, ACI Asia-Pacific & Middle East, and ACI World, with Aena serving as the host, fostering a space for shared ideas and collective advancement.

Discussions will center on improving operational efficiency, refining the passenger journey, and fostering long-term sustainable development within the industry.

events.name: Move Riyadh 2026
events.description:
The future of mobility is set to be re-imagined at Move Riyadh 2026, the Kingdom's premier auto tech event. From November 23 to 25, 2026, the Riyadh Front Exhibition Centre will host discussions and displays centered on innovation, collaboration, and significant advancements within the global mobility sector.

This gathering will bring together more than 1500 C-Suite executives, industry leaders, and key decision-makers from government and private organizations. An exhibition, open to all at no cost, will feature over 250 exhibitors and several country pavilions, presenting solutions across the mobility spectrum. The conference program will include over 200 speakers, sharing their insights and providing opportunities for attendees to connect and discuss the evolving landscape of mobility.

events.name: Sustainable Aviation Futures APAC Congress 2026
events.description:
Set to redefine the trajectory of aviation sustainability across the Asia-Pacific, the Sustainable Aviation Futures APAC Congress 2026 convenes in Singapore from November 23-25. Over three days, under the theme 'Powering Partnerships to Scale SAF and eFuels in APAC,' the congress will bring together leaders, policymakers, and innovators from across the aviation and energy sectors.

Conversations will focus on key areas such as feedstock pathways, policy alignment, investment strategies, and infrastructure development. The aim is to advance the commercial use of Sustainable Aviation Fuel and eFuels.

To encourage collaboration and practical solutions, the event offers carefully planned sessions, a dedicated Networking Exhibition Zone, and AI-Matchmaking. These elements are designed to help participants build meaningful connections and long-term partnerships, which are crucial for a more sustainable aviation future.

events.name: Specialist Lender Finance UK 2026
events.description:
On 23 November 2026, the Royal Lancaster, London, will host Specialist Lender Finance UK 2026, the essential event for navigating the rapidly expanding specialist lending market, projected to reach USD 20 trillion. This fifth-annual conference offers an in-depth understanding of key funding considerations for specialty lenders, covering everything from initial setup to M&A or public ABS deals. Discussions will also examine a wide range of financed assets, including traditional, securitized consumer and commercial loans, alongside emerging esoteric categories such as litigation funding and digital infrastructure.

The event provides a focused environment for investors to meet non-bank financial institutions that present compelling yield and risk profiles. It also allows funds to highlight their growing lending capabilities. Structured networking opportunities, including a PCC Members-Only Lounge and an Investor & Borrower Reception, are designed to bring together senior private credit professionals for meaningful interactions.

events.name: iGaming Club Conference Cancun 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for the iGaming Club Conference Cancun 2026, a pivotal event set to redefine the LatAm iGaming landscape. From November 23-25, 2026, Cancun, Mexico, will host the region's first iGaming conference, distinguished by its strong focus on the affiliate community.

Over two days, more than 400 attendees are expected, bringing together affiliates, operators, and B2B providers. This gathering offers an opportunity for professionals to connect and build relationships. Participants can attend panel discussions, engage in dedicated speed-dating sessions, and hear from industry experts in the speaker area. The event also features an exhibition where new solutions can be discovered, alongside the AffPapa iGaming Awards.

The conference aims to facilitate connections and foster development within the Latin American iGaming sector.

events.name: IDSc Annual Congress 2026
events.description:
The IDSc Annual Congress 2026 is set to be a pivotal gathering for professionals at the forefront of decontamination sciences. Organized by The Institute of Decontamination Sciences, the UK's leading professional body for medical device reprocessing, this congress provides a crucial opportunity for medical professionals dedicated to reducing infection risks and enhancing patient safety.

Participants will explore the latest advancements, examine innovative solutions, and discuss the complex technical and operational challenges involved in medical device decontamination. This gathering creates a unique space for sharing knowledge, encouraging collaboration, and supporting the ongoing development of this vital field.

Here, individuals can connect with leading experts and colleagues, gaining fresh perspectives and contributing to the evolution of medical device reprocessing standards.

events.name: Total Rewards Reloaded 2026
events.description:
Total Rewards Reloaded 2026 offers a pivotal opportunity to redefine compensation and benefits, inspiring people and advancing total rewards strategies. Over 660 leading rewards innovators and decision-makers from more than 360 companies across Europe will convene for two days, November 23-24, at Titanic Chaussee Berlin.

The agenda includes over 130 expert-led sessions, more than 70 industry case studies, and over 50 interactive workshops. The program explores the future of rewards, combining data-driven insights with human-centric design principles. Discussions will address critical topics such as AI in compensation, pay transparency, personalized benefits, and employee well-being.

Attendees will also have access to co-located events, including Talent Management Reloaded, Rethink! HR Tech, and HR Analytics & AI Europe, alongside dedicated one-on-one meetings. The event is designed to facilitate the evaluation of new services and technologies, a stated goal for 88% of past participants. It serves as a key gathering for those focused on strategic reinvention within total rewards.

events.name: DevOpsDays Warsaw 2026
events.description:
DevOpsDays Warsaw 2026, scheduled for November 23-24 at the Sound Garden Hotel, offers a dynamic two-day immersion into the evolving world of DevOps. The Polish edition of this international conference series brings together professionals from development, IT operations, QA, and management to discuss current trends and solutions in the field.

The program features talks and discussions where participants can share knowledge and experiences on delivering technology projects efficiently. Key areas of focus include automation, testing, security, and fostering a robust organizational culture.

Beyond the scheduled sessions, there will be opportunities to connect with peers. This allows for interaction among those dedicated to advancing internet service development and operational excellence.

events.name: PharmaLab Congress 2026
events.description:
Elevate your pharmaceutical laboratory expertise at PharmaLab Congress 2026, a comprehensive four-day event running from November 23-26, 2026. The congress begins at Darmstadtium in Darmstadt, bringing together professionals in Analytics, Bioanalytics, and Microbiology. Attendees will find three specialized tracks running concurrently, covering subjects such as AI in laboratories, Analytical Procedure Lifecycle Management (APLM), Cell & Gene Therapies, and rapid microbiological methods.

The event concludes on November 26 with a Pharma Innovations Day at Merck. This day includes live demonstrations, guided tours of the facility, and practical sessions focused on emerging pharmaceutical solutions. Throughout the congress, participants can connect with colleagues and explore an exhibition featuring the latest innovations. The program also offers opportunities to learn about GMP compliance and laboratory optimization.

A reduced registration rate is available for those who register by August 31, 2026. The event takes place near Frankfurt International Airport.

events.name: Connect CFO Leadership Summit Autumn UK Online 2026
events.description:
Commencing the week of 23 November, 2026, the Connect CFO Leadership Summit Autumn UK Online 2026 provides a vital virtual forum for senior finance leaders. This gathering helps CFOs and CROs address economic shifts, drive digital transformation, and optimize financial performance. It explores practical solutions and proven strategies relevant to today's financial landscape.

Participants can expect a highly tailored agenda. This includes one-on-one meetings with leading solution providers such as Tipalti, Sage, and ADP, designed to address specific project needs in areas like AI, automation, and financial systems. The program also offers insights from on-demand content featuring top finance executives, including Sarah Watson (Make a Wish) and Michael Goerz (Siemens Energy). Attendees will have opportunities to connect with peers, share best practices, and build valuable professional relationships. For invited executives, attendance is complimentary, made possible by supporting sponsors.

events.name: IP Service World 2026
events.description:
Redefine the future of intellectual property at IP Service World 2026, taking place in Munich from November 23-25. This 16th gathering, themed "IP connecting people," brings together more than 1400 professionals from over 55 countries. Participants will discuss current strategies and new developments in the field.

The program includes dedicated Patent & IP Strategy Days on November 23-24, which will focus on using AI, improving IP portfolios, and integrating intellectual property as a central business element. A new Trademark & Brand Protection Day on November 25 will cover topics such as global enforcement, protecting digital brands, and AI-powered workflows.

Over 100 expert speakers and 100 exhibitors will be present, alongside more than 30 hours dedicated to networking. Those attending will learn about generative AI, automation, and data-driven methods. The event offers a setting for legal, operational, and technological experts to contribute to how intellectual property's strategic value is defined.

events.name: Handelsblatt Change Congress 2026
events.description:
From November 23 to 24, 2026, the Handelsblatt Change Congress 2026 will convene at the Grand Hall Zeche Zollverein in Essen, Germany, under the compelling theme: "HARD TIMES, HARD CHANGE – Mutig entscheiden in Zeiten ohne Blaupause."

This two-day event is designed for change professionals focused on developing future visions and making effective organizational decisions. Participants will explore transformation challenges through open discussions, drawing on perspectives from business, science, and society. The aim is to provide practical insights that encourage bold decision-making.

The program includes contributions from leaders such as Ben Alka (Deutsche Bank) and Dr. Thelse Godewerth (Rolls-Royce Power Systems). Attendees can expect thought-provoking discussions, practical strategies, and opportunities to connect with peers during various sessions and dedicated networking times. The event concludes with a guided tour and an evening gathering.

events.name: GeoWorld 2026
events.description:
Uncover the cutting-edge of geospatial innovation at GeoWorld 2026, convening from November 23-26 at the Dubai World Trade Centre. This four-day event brings together more than 10,000 people from over 110 countries, including GIS specialists, surveyors, and government authorities, to explore how geospatial technologies are changing our world.

Participants can hear from over 20 industry speakers, sharing insights on leadership and strategy. The GeoWorld Exhibition will feature new product launches and live demonstrations. There will also be practical technical sessions focused on applying geospatial tools effectively. The event highlights in-demand technologies such as sensors, scanners, and earth observation equipment.

It's an opportunity to connect with peers, build new partnerships, and reach a wider audience, especially with co-located events like Big 5 Global. The event offers a setting for professionals in GIS, surveying, and earth observation to deepen their understanding and capabilities.

events.name: Pharma TRACKTS! 2026
events.description:
Uniting global pharma leaders and technology pioneers, Pharma TRACKTS! 2026 will converge in Frankfurt from November 23-24, 2026. This gathering focuses on advancing serialization, traceability, and digital supply-chain excellence within the pharmaceutical industry. Participants will explore strategic approaches that go beyond basic operational compliance, addressing the increasing global regulations and the growing need for transparency, security, and speed in supply chains.

The two-day program offers a comprehensive agenda, including over 124 expert-led sessions, more than 68 case studies, and over 56 interactive workshops. These discussions will cover innovations such as advanced serialization frameworks, RFID, connected packaging, and achieving end-to-end visibility. The event typically draws over 476 professionals from more than 264 companies, including organizations like Pfizer and Merck, providing a setting for connecting with peers and evaluating emerging technologies. Access to co-located summits on Pharma Packaging & Labeling, Logistics & SCM, and Cold Chain is also included.

events.name: HERA industry Days 2026
events.description:
HERA industry Days 2026, the flagship annual event for Europe's Health Emergency Preparedness and Response Authority, is set to convene on November 23-24, 2026.

Over these two days, the event will gather industry leaders, EU institutions, researchers, innovators, start-ups, and public authorities. Individuals from the healthcare, biotech, and medtech sectors will come together to discuss ways to strengthen Europe’s health preparedness and response capabilities.

The agenda will include discussions on medical countermeasures, funding opportunities, and how public and private organizations can work together to address future health security priorities. Attendees will have opportunities to meet and connect with others, aiming to build relationships that can contribute to a more secure health environment across Europe.

events.name: CEE Property Forum & Awards Gala 2026

location.venue: Palais Niederosterreich and Andaz Vienna Am Belvedere

events.description:
Set to redefine the Central and Eastern European real estate landscape, the CEE Property Forum & Awards Gala 2026 convenes in Vienna, Austria, from November 23rd to 24th. This gathering, held across the Palais Niederösterreich and Hyatt Regency Vienna, brings together leading investors, developers, and decision-makers from the region.

Participants will explore key topics such as real estate finance, capital markets, industrial and office agency, European investments, and real estate accessibility. The program includes an Investor Day, an Awards Gala followed by a Networking Party, and a full-day Forum.

The event provides an environment for professionals to connect, exchange perspectives, and discuss the evolving landscape of CEE real estate.

events.name: EPIC Online Technology Meeting on Photonics for Quantum Industry Fall 2026
events.description:
Discover the pivotal role of photonic technologies in advancing the quantum industry at the EPIC Online Technology Meeting on Photonics for Quantum Industry Fall 2026. This free virtual event, on November 23, 2026, from 15:00 - 17:00 CET, will explore how photonics is moving quantum systems from lab demonstrations to industrial-scale platforms.

Discussions will delve into key areas such as integrated photonic circuits, single-photon sources, low-loss components, and scalable manufacturing. Experts will examine critical considerations like performance reproducibility, system integration, reliability, and cost.

This session is intended for technology developers, system builders, and end users. It aims to facilitate the exchange of insights, support collaborative efforts, and contribute to the industrialization of quantum technologies, ultimately influencing the future quantum supply chain.

events.name: CLA Sustainable Finance Summit 2026
events.description:
Addressing the urgent need for institutional readiness in the energy transition, the CLA Sustainable Finance Summit 2026 will gather Canada's top financial leaders on November 23 at Toronto's EY Tower. This gathering is for over 500 C-Suite and senior executives representing major banks, insurers, pension funds, and investment firms. The discussions will focus on key areas: risk management, investment strategy, and ESG compliance.

Attendees will explore practical, actionable strategies for navigating the energy transition. This includes methods for climate risk stress testing, integrating ESG data effectively, and leveraging AI in risk analytics. The program also covers how to maximize sustainable investment opportunities, secure regulatory compliance, and align investment portfolios with net-zero ambitions. Participants will have the chance to connect with policymakers and industry pioneers, aiming to build long-term financial resilience across the sector.

events.name: Highways KSA 2026
events.description:
Saudi Arabia's ambitious road infrastructure transformation takes centre stage at Highways KSA 2026, scheduled for November 23-25 at Riyadh Front. This event convenes the full supply chain to discuss the Kingdom's long-term strategic vision and the projects defining its future.

The program includes a two-day conference where over 200 industry leaders and senior executives will share their insights. Among the speakers are Miska Daredia from Qiddiya and Shahid Tanvir from The Royal Commission for Riyadh City. Additionally, an exhibition, accessible to all, will feature solutions from more than 250 exhibitors representing various countries.

Held concurrently with MOVE, Highways KSA 2026 provides a setting for professionals to connect and exchange ideas within Saudi Arabia's highway sector.

events.name: Climatech 2026
events.description:
Shaping the future of climate control and building management, Climatech 2026 invites HVAC, cooling, heating, and ventilation professionals to Riyadh from November 23-25. This event will take place at the Riyadh Front Exhibition & Conference Centre, focusing on the theme 'Heat. Ventilate. Cool. Automate.' It is expected to draw over 12,000 attendees, including more than 1,000 VIPs.

Attendees will find technologies and sustainable innovations from over 450 exhibitors. The program includes insights from more than 200 expert speakers, presented across three tracks. These sessions will feature keynote presentations, practical case studies, and interactive workshops.

This three-day gathering provides opportunities for professional connections and is held alongside Solar Show KSA. The combined events aim to support the advancement of energy-efficient solutions and encourage industry collaboration within Saudi Arabia.

events.name: Solar & Storage Live Riyadh 2026
events.description:
Prepare to witness the future of energy at Solar & Storage Live Riyadh 2026, taking place from November 23-25, 2026, at Riyadh Front, Saudi Arabia. This three-day event serves as the Kingdom's largest gathering focused on solar, storage, and advanced energy technologies, supporting Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030.

The event brings together over 450 exhibitors presenting solutions in solar energy, utility-scale storage, EV charging infrastructure, and intelligent energy management. A conference, open to all, will host more than 200 speakers across three distinct tracks. These sessions will explore project development, market trends, and technological innovation within the energy sector.

With an expected attendance of over 12,000 individuals, including more than 1,000 VIPs, the event offers an opportunity for professionals to connect. Decision-makers from utilities, finance, government, and various industries will be present, fostering discussions and potential collaborations that can influence the region's energy landscape.

events.name: 121 Mining Investment London 2026
events.description:
Connecting the global mining industry's innovators with leading capital, 121 Mining Investment London 2026 returns on 23-24 November at Convene, 133 Houndsditch. This two-day gathering is designed to facilitate over 2,540 pre-arranged one-on-one meetings, bringing together more than 145 mining companies with over 430 qualified investors.

Senior executives, institutional investors, and family offices attending will find opportunities to explore high-potential mining projects and engage in strategic discussions. The program also features 35 expert speakers who will share insights into key market trends, addressing current challenges such as lower commodity prices and cautious investor sentiment.

This event serves as a significant forum for understanding and shaping the future of mining finance, covering the entire spectrum from early-stage exploration to full-scale production.

events.name: Fleet Summit London 2026

location.venue: Radisson Hotel & Conference Centre London Heathrow

events.description:
Prepare for the future of fleet management at Fleet Summit London 2026, taking place on 23rd & 24th November at the Radisson Hotel & Conference Centre London Heathrow. This gathering brings together senior fleet buyers, transport directors, and other key decision-makers with leading service providers and technology innovators in the UK.

Participants can expect a focused environment for business-to-business interactions, including pre-arranged one-to-one meetings, expert-led seminars, and engaging discussion panels. The agenda is designed to offer insights into critical areas such as the Net Zero transition, strategies for managing EV charging costs, improving fleet safety and compliance, and exploring the latest telematics and mobility solutions. It's an opportunity to find new operational approaches, develop professional relationships, and stay current with developments in the transport sector.

events.name: Totally Concrete Dubai 2026
events.description:
Prepare to explore the cutting edge of concrete innovation at Totally Concrete Dubai 2026, held from 23 to 26 November at the Dubai World Trade Centre. This gathering brings together over 12,000 attendees and more than 240 exhibitors from over 20 countries, including contractors, developers, engineers, and manufacturers. It's a place for industry professionals to connect and share insights.

The event focuses on precast, cement, and structural materials, showcasing innovations and advanced concrete technologies designed to improve durability and performance. Attendees can explore sustainable solutions for concrete production and infrastructure projects, see product launches demonstrated live, and gain insights from experts during the Big 5 Talks. Leadership Summits will also host discussions on regional development strategies, providing a comprehensive view of the sector's future.

events.name: INREV Autumn Conference 2026
events.description:
Unlocking new avenues for growth and resilience in the non-listed real estate industry is the central focus of the INREV Autumn Conference 2026. This gathering will take place on 23 and 24 November at Villa Copenhagen, bringing together mid- to senior-level professionals. The event will delve into "New sources of value: investment, enterprise and European resilience."

Participants can expect to hear from leading voices in the field. Edmund Shing will analyze the major trends influencing investment, while Mike Soutar will share perspectives on fostering an entrepreneurial mindset. Wolfgang Münchau will offer an assessment of Europe's competitive standing. Additionally, a panel titled "New kids on the block" will explore the practicalities of launching new ventures in today's market.

The conference provides an opportunity to engage in discussions about market liquidity and how to enhance the appeal of real estate as an asset class. Attendees will also have a chance to connect with peers during the welcome dinner, contributing to ongoing conversations that help shape the future direction of the sector.

events.name: JASFGG 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for the 46th edition of the Journées Annuelles de la Société Française de Gériatrie et Gérontologie (JASFGG), taking place from November 23-25, 2026, at CNIT FOREST in Paris La Défense. This gathering, organized by SFGG, brings together professionals in geriatrics and gerontology to discuss clinical, therapeutic, and organizational advancements, emphasizing a transdisciplinary approach.

The scientific program includes 10 Qualiopi-certified Clinical Good Practices sessions and 12 scientific sessions. Attendees can also participate in the second version of the 'Gériathlon' and an interactive clinical case session. These activities are designed to support learning, update professional knowledge, and facilitate the exchange of best practices.

JASFGG 2026 provides a setting for geriatricians, gerontologists, and all professionals dedicated to elderly care to connect, explore new topics, and engage with educational innovations.

events.name: IME 2026
events.description:
Under the unifying theme of #buildingbridges, the 11th Investment Management Exhibition (IME) 2026 invites global leaders to Frankfurt am Main, Germany, on November 23-24, 2026. This gathering provides a central space for cities, regions, and countries to connect with investors and companies looking to expand internationally. It's a place where conversations often lead to new collaborations and contribute to economic growth.

IME 2026 typically draws professionals from Investment Promotion Agencies, Economic Development Organizations, corporations, and family offices. Those who attend come to explore new markets, build strategic partnerships, and understand the current trends in foreign direct investment and cross-border ventures. The event usually brings together over 350 individuals from 54 countries, all playing a part in the future of global economic development.

events.name: DMWF Europe 2026
events.description:
The future of marketing technology and strategy converges at DMWF Europe 2026, the definitive event for senior leaders. On November 24-25, Amsterdam's RAI will welcome over 2000 professionals, with 56% holding Director-level positions or above. These two days offer a focused environment for in-depth discussions.

Participants can explore more than ten conference tracks, covering key areas such as AI & Marketing, Data & CRM, Social Media, Omnichannel approaches, and Customer Experience. Over 150 speakers will share their expertise, alongside more than 70 companies presenting their latest solutions. The aim is to provide marketers with actionable insights.

The discussions will address current challenges, explore new technologies, and outline approaches for creating effective campaigns within the evolving digital landscape.

events.name: Smart Production Solutions Nuremberg 2026
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the forefront of industrial transformation at Smart Production Solutions Nuremberg 2026, taking place from 24 – 26 November in Nuremberg, Germany. Recognized as a leading event for the automation sector, SPS 2026 offers a comprehensive look at smart and digital automation.

The event will feature tangible solutions, current digital trends, and practical innovations that are shaping manufacturing's future. It will cover a range of topics, from intelligent control systems to fully connected industrial environments, illustrating current capabilities and future possibilities. With more than 1,000 exhibitors and a diverse international audience, visitors can expect to find valuable perspectives and opportunities to connect with peers, relevant for navigating an increasingly automated industrial landscape.

events.name: Finance Magnates London Summit 2026
events.description:
Prepare for two days of unparalleled strategic engagement at the Finance Magnates London Summit 2026, taking place on November 23-24.

The summit begins on November 23rd with a Networking Blitz at The Folly. This initial gathering is designed for senior professionals to make early connections with industry leaders. The following day, November 24th, Old Billingsgate will be the venue for the main Summit Day. Attendees can expect discussions led by experts, in-depth market insights, and structured Business Connect Roundtables.

The summit is intended for senior decision-makers working in trading, fintech, payments, and digital assets. Discussions will cover critical areas like AI-driven workflows, tokenization, and embedded banking. A key focus of the summit is fostering meaningful interactions, creating opportunities for relationship-building and commercial discussions within a focused setting.

events.name: Salone Dei Pagamenti 2026
events.description:
Anticipate the future of finance at Salone Dei Pagamenti 2026, set to return to Allianz MiCo in Milan. Building on a decade of innovation, this leading international gathering serves as a key forum for exploring developments in payments. Discussions will cover digital transformation, the influence of AI on finance, embedded solutions, and evolving regulatory landscapes.

Thousands of professionals attend, including industry leaders, fintech innovators, businesses, and students. This gathering provides significant opportunities for networking and sharing insights. The program features more than 400 speakers and a range of workshops, offering perspectives on new solutions and strategies. The event takes place in late October 2026, providing a chance to understand the evolving payment landscape.

events.name: BIM World Munich 2026
events.description:
Discover the forefront of digitalization for the construction, real estate, and facility management industries at BIM World Munich 2026. This international event, focusing on innovation, will take place at the ICM Munich, Germany, from November 24-25. Discussions will cover themes such as BIM 4 Circular, which supports sustainable transitions; BIM 4 NETZERO, addressing ESG factors and CO2 shadow prices; and BIM 4 Infrastructure, relevant for operating critical assets.

The program features a comprehensive Congress, along with focused breakout sessions, practical workshops, and presentations from expert speakers. Attendees will have opportunities to connect with industry leaders, speakers, and exhibitors, learning about advancements in smart facility management, autonomous systems, and data-driven real estate strategies. This gathering is intended for professionals who are shaping the future of the built environment.

events.name: Investir Day 2026
events.description:
On November 24, 2026, the Salles Carrousel du Louvre in Paris will host the 8th edition of Investir Day, a pivotal event dedicated to empowering individual investors. This gathering focuses on making savings management more accessible, providing a broad spectrum of investment opportunities and practical education on effective wealth strategies. It's designed to help individuals, from those just starting their investment journey to seasoned shareholders, better understand and navigate the financial world.

The day expects to welcome around 8,000 participants, offering over 120 conferences and workshops led by 150 expert speakers. Attendees will have the opportunity to engage directly with directors of listed companies, bankers, real estate and crypto professionals, and wealth management advisors. Discussions will cover important topics such as Fininfluence, Responsible Investment, Private Equity, and Fintech. Additionally, sixty partners from the wealth management sector will be on hand to showcase innovative solutions, creating a comprehensive environment for learning and making valuable connections across all investor profiles.

events.name: Offshore Energy Exhibition & Conference 2026
events.description:
Dedicated to "Securing Energy, Sustaining the Future," the Offshore Energy Exhibition & Conference 2026 will unite industry leaders in Amsterdam on 24 & 25 November.

This annual event is recognized as a key gathering for offshore wind, oil & gas, and sustainable maritime solutions in Europe, providing a central point for new ideas and discussions. Attendees can expect 55 hours of insights from over 80 speakers, delving into the complexities and prospects of the energy transition, particularly within Northwest Europe.

The exhibition floor brings together operators, developers, and policymakers, fostering direct conversations. A structured matchmaking program is available to facilitate specific connections, and the event also includes the Offshore Energy Awards, recognizing advancements in the field. The aim is for participants to encounter new solutions and establish collaborations that contribute to the future direction of offshore energy.

events.name: Genera 2026
events.description:
The forefront of energy innovation and environmental sustainability converges at IFEMA MADRID from November 24 to 26, 2026, for Genera 2026. Professionals gather here to advance electrification and decarbonization. The event brings together over 500 exhibitors and draws 43,000 visitors, all focused on creating a cleaner, more efficient energy system.

Genera 2026 is part of the "International Week of Electrification and Decarbonisation," running alongside MATELEC. This combined approach offers a comprehensive view of the sector. The joint Innovation Gallery showcases new products and projects in renewable energy and energy efficiency.
