Attendees can participate in over 100 meetings and conferences, discussing technological advancements and sustainability. It's a significant event for those leading the way in energy.

events.name: CHRO Awards South Africa 2026
events.description:
The CHRO Awards South Africa 2026, scheduled for 24 November at the elegant Polo Room in Inanda, Johannesburg, is set to be the premier event celebrating HR excellence. This annual gala, often referred to as the "Oscars of HR," acknowledges South Africa's leading Chief Human Resources Officers for their significant contributions and forward-thinking leadership.

The event brings together approximately 250 senior HR leaders, key executives, and business partners from major listed companies, large corporations, and government institutions. Organized by CHRO South Africa, the evening will feature a refined gala dinner, engaging entertainment, and opportunities for meaningful connections. The suggested dress code is Black Tie or Traditional Chic.

This gathering is dedicated to recognizing those who shape human capital strategy and represent the highest standards in South African HR.

events.name: Future of Asset Management Europe 2026
events.description:
The Future of Asset Management Europe 2026 is set to be the definitive two-day gathering for senior leaders shaping the continent's financial landscape. This summit will offer a clear perspective on the evolving economics of asset and wealth management. It brings together leading CEOs from Europe’s top firms, alternative platforms, and regulatory bodies.

Participants, whether attending in person or online, will examine new developments in areas like AI, tokenisation, and active ETFs. They can also compare their strategies with others on important subjects such as M&A, private market access, and sustainability. The program includes panels, off-the-record roundtables, and keynote interviews. These sessions are designed to help participants gain a deeper understanding of their strategic direction, the development of private markets, and the influence of policy and geopolitics. It's an opportunity to connect with influential decision-makers and discuss how to shape the future of European asset management.

events.name: Civo Navigate India 2026

location.venue: Sheraton Grand Bengaluru Whitefield Hotel & Convention Center

events.description:
Prepare to dive deep into the future of cloud technology at Civo Navigate India 2026, the "Sovereignty and AI Edition," taking place on Tuesday, November 24th, 2026. This significant gathering will be held at the Sheraton Grand Bengaluru Whitefield Hotel & Convention Center, bringing together over 1,000 tech leaders, builders, engineers, and C-level executives from across India.

Attendees will explore new ideas and practical solutions, with a focus on Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Sovereignty, and Cloud Native Transformation. The one-day agenda includes more than 20 expert-led sessions, hands-on workshops, and main stage presentations, all designed to offer actionable advice and valuable insights.

This is an opportunity to connect with industry leaders, share experiences, and build professional relationships, while also understanding the latest developments shaping the future of cloud. Attendance includes access to all sessions, networking opportunities, meals, refreshments, and exclusive Civo merchandise.

events.name: Mexico Business Summit 2026
events.description:
Mexico City is set to become the epicenter of strategic business dialogue and investment on November 24-25, 2026, as it hosts the Mexico Business Summit. This gathering will bring together over 1,500 C-level executives, political leaders, and global investors, creating a significant forum for discussing growth and fostering collaboration.

Attendees will hear from over 150 speakers across 60 panels, offering insights into eight key industry areas such as Energy, Automotive, Aerospace, and Cybersecurity. An AI-powered matchmaking system will also be available to help connect individuals and organizations with complementary business interests, facilitating strategic partnerships.

The summit provides a context for understanding Mexico's evolving economic landscape and exploring potential collaborations. It offers a clear perspective on opportunities within the country's various sectors.

events.name: International Banking Forum 2026
events.description:
Prepare to explore the future of finance at the International Banking Forum 2026, taking place on November 24-25 at the prestigious Baku Marriott Boulevard Hotel in Azerbaijan. This two-day event centers on the theme "Reliable, Safe, and Sustainable Banking." It is expected to bring together over 1500 individuals from the financial sector, including Bank CEOs, regulators, fintech leaders, and global influencers.

Fifty expert speakers will share their perspectives across nine discussion panels. An exhibition area will also be available. Participants, whether attending in person or virtually, will have opportunities to connect with representatives from 270 companies.

Mastercard is supporting the forum as its Main Partner. The conversations and insights shared are intended to help attendees understand and contribute to the evolving landscape of banking worldwide.

events.name: Handelsblatt Insurance Summit 2026

location.venue: Town Hall of the Handelsblatt Media Group

events.description:
Addressing the profound pressures facing the industry, the Handelsblatt Insurance Summit 2026 convenes on November 24-25 at the Handelsblatt Media Group Townhall in Düsseldorf. The event's theme, "Insurers under pressure: What now determines successful change," will guide discussions on critical issues. These include geopolitical tensions, cyber risks, the integration of AI, and evolving regulatory landscapes such as DORA and the EU AI Act.

Key figures from the insurance industry will be present, with a significant representation of executives. The program features exclusive insights from board members (Vorstandsperspektiven), executive interviews, and engaging panel discussions that explore various viewpoints. Participants can expect to gain strategic perspectives and practical understanding. Opportunities for professional exchange will also be available, including an evening gathering.

The summit aims to help attendees consider how to build resilience, foster growth, and leverage AI to create sustainable value within an increasingly unpredictable environment.

events.name: Bitkom Digital Health Conference 2026
events.description:
Shaping the future of healthcare through digital innovation takes center stage at the Bitkom Digital Health Conference 2026. On November 24th, leaders and experts from various parts of the healthcare system will come together at KOSMOS Berlin.

The event features 100 expert speakers, among them Prof. Dr. med. Karl Broich and Stefanie Kemp, who will lead discussions on crucial topics such as 'Digital First' strategies, the European Health Data Space, and how AI is profoundly influencing personalized therapies. Those attending will explore ways to strengthen cybersecurity, ensure data sovereignty, and discuss strategies for optimizing 'Time to Care' through advanced digital solutions.

The discussions aim to accelerate digitalization, enhance patient experiences, and contribute to a more resilient and efficient healthcare landscape.

events.name: AKJ e-Crime & Cybersecurity Benelux Summit Netherlands 2026
events.description:
The AKJ e-Crime & Cybersecurity Benelux Summit 2026, scheduled for November 24th in Amsterdam, Netherlands, offers a vital platform for cybersecurity leaders and professionals. The event will address critical e-crime and cybersecurity challenges, providing practical insights into current and emerging threats. Discussions will cover effective strategies for mitigating risks across information security, cyber risk, and IT audit.

The summit gathers VPs, Directors, and Heads of Information Security and Cyber Risk. Participants will hear from experts, engage in focused breakout seminars, and connect with colleagues and technology providers. The agenda will cover key topics in a clear, concise format, designed to help participants strengthen their organization's defenses against an evolving threat landscape.

events.name: IT for Insurance Trade Fair Congress 2026
events.description:
On November 24-25, 2026, the Congress Center Leipzig will host the essential IT for Insurance Trade Fair Congress, a pivotal event for the sector's digital future. The two-day congress will bring together approximately 600 IT managers, specialists, and strategists to explore key topics including AI, Cloud Computing, Cybersecurity, and Agile Methods.

More than 85 expert speakers will lead discussions across various specialist forums, covering areas like application landscapes, IT operations, management, and development. Attendees will also have the opportunity to discover innovations from over 55 exhibitors and connect with peers at an evening gathering on November 24th at FELIX.

The gathering provides a setting for participants to gain insights, discuss emerging trends, and establish connections that contribute to the technological evolution of the insurance industry.

events.name: Horizons Clean Energy Expansion Week 2026
events.description:
Horizons Clean Energy Expansion Week 2026, held from 24 – 27 November at Copenhagen's Bella Center, is the essential global gathering for accelerating the clean energy transition. This four-day event, growing from World Hydrogen Week, will bring together over 1,000 professionals from more than 80 countries and 900 companies. It offers a space for industry leaders, policymakers, and technology pioneers to explore important subjects.

Discussions will span four key tracks: Hydrogen, Power-to-X & End-Use, CCUS, and Grid Resilience. The program includes contributions from over 250 speakers, 12 workshops, and opportunities for site visits, providing more than 60 hours of content.

The gathering aims to foster collaboration across the entire low-carbon value chain. Through these interactions, the intention is to advance innovation, strengthen energy security, and support the development of resilient infrastructure for a sustainable future.

events.name: Institutional Investor Summit Netherlands 2026
events.description:
Exclusively for asset owners across the Benelux region, the Institutional Investor Summit Netherlands 2026 convenes on November 24th-25th in The Hague.

Developed in collaboration with MN, this invitation-only gathering provides a private setting where participants can openly discuss the evolving landscape of institutional investing, guided by the Chatham House Rule. The agenda is structured to cover a broad spectrum of investment topics. The first day will focus on traditional asset classes, public markets, and broader macroeconomic trends. The second day shifts attention to private markets and alternative investments, such as private equity, real estate, and infrastructure.

Attendees will participate in various formats, including table discussions, smaller breakout groups, and case studies. These sessions are designed to allow for a thorough examination of investment strategies, portfolio construction approaches, and the impact of regulatory changes. The summit offers a valuable environment for gaining new perspectives and building meaningful professional relationships.

events.name: Large Scale Solar Central Eastern Europe 2026
events.description:
Rebranded as SolarPLUS Central & Eastern Europe, this premier event (formerly Large Scale Solar CEE) will convene on 24-25 November 2026 at the Warsaw Presidential Hotel in Warsaw, Poland. This gathering provides an opportunity to explore the evolving landscape of utility-scale solar and energy storage across the region.

The program delves into topics beyond traditional solar, including integrated hybrid projects, advanced grid strategies, and new commercial frameworks. Attendees will examine how to address grid constraints, improve the economics of hybrid projects, and adapt financing models to market volatility. Detailed discussions will focus on key CEE markets such as Ukraine, Romania, Czech Republic, and Bulgaria. Conversations will also cover Corporate PPAs and supply chain security.

The event is designed for senior developers, investors, and industry leaders who are instrumental in the Central and Eastern European energy transition.

events.name: Local Government Partnership Network South 2026
events.description:
Senior leaders from local government across the UK are invited to the Local Government Partnership Network South 2026, held on 24-25 November at the Radisson Blu Edwardian Hotel, Heathrow. This two-day event brings together over 100 CIOs, Chief Digital Officers, and other key decision-makers who are leading digital transformation efforts.

The discussions are directly informed by the pressing challenges participants encounter. The program features real-world case studies and strategies developed by peers to help navigate the pressures within the sector. Participants will engage in presentations in the main hall and smaller breakout sessions, encouraging learning from one another and building professional relationships.

Individual meetings are arranged with relevant solution providers to facilitate focused discussions. The gathering offers a space to explore innovative solutions and move forward with digital initiatives in local government.

events.name: Future Battery Forum 2026
events.description:
From November 23 to 25, 2026, the Future Battery Forum will converge at ECC Berlin, charting the course for Europe's battery future. The forum gathers industry leaders, policymakers, and innovators to discuss advancements in battery technology, production methods, and market approaches.

Those attending can expect to learn about new battery materials, the expansion of large-scale production facilities, establishing sustainable supply chains, and funding options for Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and electric vehicles. Perspectives will be shared by keynote speakers from organizations such as the European Commission, CATL, Volvo Trucks, and Siemens. Discussions will also cover the rapid pace of EV technology development and battery regulation.

Before and after the main program, opportunities exist to visit the Tesla Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg and explore theion GmbH's crystal battery technology. This event serves as a key meeting point for those involved in shaping the future of batteries.

events.name: Biotech Outsourcing Strategies Manchester 2026
events.description:
Biotech Outsourcing Strategies Manchester 2026 provides a crucial forum for advancing R&D partnerships within the dynamic biopharmaceutical sector. The event takes place in Manchester, UK, bringing together professionals from across the outsourcing landscape. It connects those seeking specialized expertise with contract research and manufacturing organizations ready to discuss their services. Discussions will cover development stage CMC outsourcing, including Small Molecules, Biologics, and Novel Therapeutic Entities.

A structured program, dedicated meetings, and an exhibition area offer participants opportunities to share experiences, reinforce current collaborations, and establish new professional connections. The event provides a look at solutions in areas such as contract pharmaceutical packaging and clinical supply services, offering insights and connections relevant to ongoing projects.

events.name: ALL4PACK Emballage Paris 2026
events.description:
From November 24-26, 2026, Paris Nord Villepinte will host ALL4PACK Emballage Paris 2026, gathering 24,000 professionals from across Europe. This three-day event will focus on the evolving world of packaging, examining innovation, decarbonization, and the significant new regulatory environment.

A significant part of the discussion will center on the Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) scheme for industrial and commercial packaging, which takes effect in 2026. This includes a close look at eco-design, repair, and reuse. Attendees can also expect to see a range of multi-industry packaging machinery, advanced logistics equipment, and sustainable solutions across various material types.

The ALLFORPACK INNOVATIONS area will feature new products. The event also facilitates business discussions and recruitment opportunities, aiming to provide a comprehensive overview for those involved in shaping the future of packaging.

events.name: Alliance Digitale Forum 2026
events.description:
Exploring the dynamic intersection of technology and human ingenuity, the Alliance Digitale Forum 2026 is poised to redefine the future of digital marketing.

The event will be held at Le 28 George V in the heart of Paris. It will focus on "Tomorrow's Marketing: The Machine & the Human," examining how Artificial Intelligence is transforming data optimization, personalized experiences, and process automation across all channels.

Leaders and experts from the industry will share their perspectives through keynote presentations, roundtable discussions, and masterclasses. Participants can expect to learn practical strategies for using AI responsibly and effectively, always keeping the human element central to innovation. The forum also provides a setting for digital marketing and data professionals to connect with peers, helping them navigate the changing landscape and develop their approaches.

events.name: dbAccess Business Services, Leisure and Transport Conference 2026
events.description:
Gain unparalleled insights into the future of key industries at the dbAccess Business Services, Leisure and Transport Conference 2026. Deutsche Bank will host this one-day event on Tuesday, November 24, 2026, at their London headquarters on 21 Moorfields, bringing together investors and companies.

Those attending will have the opportunity to explore the evolving landscapes of the Business Services, Leisure, and Transport sectors. While the full agenda and keynote speakers will be announced at a later date, the program will feature strategic discussions, in-depth market analysis, and opportunities for connection. It provides a setting to engage with industry leaders, identify emerging trends, and understand investment prospects that are shaping these important sectors of the economy.

events.name: EUROPEAN BIOMANUFACTURING SUMMIT 2026
events.description:
The 5th Annual EUROPEAN BIOMANUFACTURING SUMMIT 2026 will gather over 250 senior-level executives in Düsseldorf, Germany, from 24-25 November at the Maritim Hotel. This invitation-only event brings together C-Suite, VPs, and Directors from leading biotech and biopharma companies, with discussions centered on manufacturing, supply chain, and operations.

Attendees will explore key developments in bioreactor engineering, automation, process integration, and supply chain resilience. The agenda also covers topics such as data integrity, Quality-by-Design, and cold chain logistics. Through case studies and pre-arranged one-on-one meetings, participants can connect and collaborate with other industry leaders. The aim is to identify practical approaches that address current challenges and future directions in biomanufacturing.

events.name: NoVacancy Asia 2026
events.description:
The brightest minds in Asia's hotel and accommodation sector will converge at NoVacancy Asia 2026, taking place on 24-25 November 2026 at the Queen Sirikit National Convention Centre in Bangkok. This two-day event expects to bring together over 3,000 professionals, ranging from hotel leaders to those across the entire supply chain. It offers a significant opportunity for individuals to connect with peers and explore potential collaborations.

The program includes more than 170 expert speakers presenting across eight distinct content streams. Discussions will delve into key areas such as technology, commerce, design, and guest experience. Attendees can gain insights into strategies for enhancing guest experiences, identifying new revenue opportunities, and improving operational efficiency.

Additionally, an exhibition floor will host over 150 sponsors and exhibitors. They will present advancements in fields like AI, automation, sustainable solutions, and advanced revenue management. These presentations aim to provide a comprehensive view of the evolving landscape and future directions for accommodation in Asia.

events.name: Hyperscale Live 2026
events.description:
Set to redefine Europe's AI infrastructure landscape, Hyperscale Live, originally planned for 2026, has been strategically postponed to 2027. This adjustment allows the event's agenda to fully reflect the rapid evolution of the AI market, ensuring discussions are as relevant and insightful as possible. Held in Lisbon, Portugal, this gathering will bring together senior leaders from technology, infrastructure, investment, and policy sectors.

Participants will examine the readiness of hyperscale infrastructure for AI's demands, exploring the crucial influence of investment, policy, and technological innovation on the development of next-generation data centers. Discussions will cover solutions for sustainable, high-performance AI infrastructure, offer perspectives on regulation and emerging technologies, and facilitate direct interaction with policymakers and industry leaders. The event aims to foster critical conversations that will help shape Europe's trajectory in AI leadership.

events.name: AltPrivateWealth 2026
events.description:
Redefine your approach to private markets at AltPrivateWealth 2026, held on 24-25 November at the prestigious Hurlingham Club, London.

This two-day event focuses on "Unlocking & Scaling Private Markets for Private Wealth." It will explore strategies for building resilient portfolios, refining allocation, and achieving consistent performance in today's demanding investment landscape. The gathering brings together over 310 senior private wealth investors, general partners, and regulators. Discussions will cover critical themes such as advanced portfolio construction, liquidity solutions, evolving valuation methods, and how technology can support informed decision-making.

Over 60 expert speakers, including leaders from Rothschild & Co and J.P. Morgan, will contribute through interactive panels, peer-led debates, and Chatham House workshops. The format encourages direct problem-solving and fosters connections, aiming to help participants navigate private markets with greater precision and resilience.

events.name: Asturfranquicia 2026
events.description:
The XV Edition of Asturfranquicia 2026 will convene on November 24, 2026, at the "Edificio Cristasa" in Gijón Impulsa, Asturias.

This event is recognized as Northern Spain's primary franchise fair, creating significant business opportunities for those exhibiting. It also serves as an important gathering for entrepreneurs exploring self-employment or new job prospects. Small businesses and freelancers can find new ways to grow and develop their ventures here.

Those attending will have the chance to explore various new business models and learn about current market trends within the evolving franchise system. The event is organized by Working Comunicación, with support from Gijón Impulsa and AFYEPA, allowing for direct connections with franchise chains.

events.name: IMPA Singapore 2026
events.description:
Charting the course for maritime excellence, IMPA Singapore 2026 invites procurement and supply chain professionals to Suntec, Singapore, on November 24-25. This two-day gathering aims to build understanding and strengthen connections between suppliers and purchasers across the Asia Pacific region.

Participants will find an exhibition showcasing the latest innovations, including digital solutions that are changing procurement practices. Important discussions will focus on key themes like sustainability, highlighted by the 'Sustainability Run,' and a dedicated 'Crew Welfare Day,' developed in association with The Nautical Institute, which underscores the industry's commitment to responsible operations. The event offers a setting for buyers and suppliers to connect, share insights, and contribute to the future direction of the maritime supply chain.

events.name: Beauty West Africa 2026
events.description:
The vibrant pulse of Africa's accelerating beauty market converges at Beauty West Africa 2026, taking place from November 24th to 26th at the Landmark Centre in Lagos, Nigeria. As Africa's largest beauty trade show, it brings together more than 7,000 attendees and over 400 companies showcasing their products across six exhibition halls.

Professionals in the beauty industry, including importers, distributors, wholesalers, and salon owners, will find a wide range of new developments in perfumes, hair care, skincare, and wellness. The event facilitates connections among over 380 hosted buyers from more than 20 African countries, with a significant emphasis on import and distribution.

This environment supports the development of new business relationships and opportunities for brand growth, particularly within Nigeria's substantial $1.1 billion cosmetics import market. It serves as a meeting point for key decision-makers and innovators, contributing to the evolution of the African beauty sector.

events.name: Cityscape Bahrain 2026
events.description:
Explore the future of property and lifestyle at Cityscape Bahrain 2026, the Kingdom's premier real estate event. From November 24 to 28, 2026, Exhibition World Bahrain will welcome over 12,000 visitors, creating a valuable platform for homebuyers, investors, and real estate professionals. Attendees can explore more than 65 new projects and receive expert guidance on mortgages, legal processes, and investment benefits.

Over 100 industry leaders will participate in sessions, including Cityscape Talks, where market insights will be shared to help inform strategic decisions. The event will also highlight the work of 'Architects of Tomorrow' and offer a chance to connect with the 'Women in Real Estate' community. Attendees will also have access to Jewellery Arabia and Scent Arabia, which are running concurrently. The event maintains a strong commitment to sustainable practices and serves as a significant gathering for those shaping the future of real estate in Bahrain.

events.name: LiveableCitiesX 2026
events.description:
Set for 24 November 2026 at the Al Multaqua Ballroom in the UAE, LiveableCitiesX 2026 is the essential gathering for urban innovators. This event brings together policymakers, city authorities, developers, planners, financiers, and technology leaders to collectively address the complex challenges of modern urban development. The discussions will center on how to transform rapid urban growth into environments that are resilient, sustainable, and genuinely enhance the quality of life for residents, while also fostering economic prosperity.

Participants will delve into critical themes such as strategic planning for lasting value, more effective urban governance, and designing cities with people at their core. The discussions will cover practical approaches to balancing housing needs, infrastructure development, and environmental sustainability. This gathering offers an opportunity for professionals to connect and explore collaborative ways to improve urban living.

events.name: GROWTECH ANTALYA 2026
events.description:
Agriculture professionals worldwide are invited to GROWTECH ANTALYA 2026, taking place from November 24-27, 2026, in the vibrant city of Antalya, Türkiye. This gathering, organized by Informa Markets, acts as a central meeting point for the global agricultural sector.

Over these four days, those who attend will find opportunities to expand their professional connections, build new business relationships, and gain insights into the future of farming. Participants can deepen their understanding, explore new approaches, and find ways to foster growth within their organizations. This event offers a valuable occasion for anyone dedicated to improving agriculture and promoting sustainable practices.

events.name: Congrès de l'ADF 2026
events.description:
The pinnacle of dental innovation and scientific exchange returns to Paris for Congrès de l'ADF 2026, scheduled from November 24-28 at the prestigious Palais des Congrès de Paris – Porte Maillot. As Europe's largest and most esteemed dental congress, this gathering typically draws around 28,000 professionals interested in the latest developments in the field.

The Scientific Programme includes more than one hundred sessions, guided by 400 expert speakers. Alongside this, an International Exhibition covers 12,830 square meters across four levels, presenting products and services from exhibitors worldwide. Together, these components provide a setting for learning, professional connections, and exploring what's next in dentistry.

events.name: Jewellery Arabia 2026
events.description:
Prepare to be captivated at Jewellery Arabia 2026, the world's largest jewellery and watch shopping event, held under the esteemed patronage of HRH Prince Salman bin Hamad Al Khalifa. From November 24 to 28, 2026, Exhibition World Bahrain will dedicate seven halls to showcasing luxury and craftsmanship.

The event gathers over 700 jewellery and watch brands from 29 countries, each presenting unique creations, exclusive collections, and new designs. Attendees will have the chance to compare various styles, meet the artisans behind the pieces, and discover something truly special.

In addition to the main exhibition, a single pass grants entry to Scent Arabia and Cityscape Bahrain. The event is also committed to sustainable practices, and organizers expect to welcome over 56,000 visitors.

events.name: Forum Solar PLUS 2026
events.description:
Illuminating the future of renewable energy, Forum Solar PLUS 2026 will gather Germany's solar economy leaders on November 24-25, 2026, at the bcc Berlin Congress Center in Berlin. As Germany's largest PV business conference, it brings together innovative companies and key figures from across the entire solar value chain.

Those attending, including decision-makers from politics, finance, utilities, and the industry, can expect to explore market developments, regulatory changes such as Solarpaket 1, and effective business models. Conversations will cover essential subjects, including investment strategies, dynamic tariffs, storage solutions, digitalization in solar, and advanced PV-PLUS applications like Agri-PV and Floating-PV.

A dedicated session, 'Start-Up meets Forum,' will highlight new innovations. The event offers a chance for participants to connect with peers and contribute to the ongoing development of sustainable energy.

events.name: Electronics of Russia 2026
events.description:
Electronics of Russia 2026, taking place from November 24-26 at Moscow's Crocus Expo, Pavilion 2, is poised to be a pivotal event for the nation's electronic industry. The event's theme, "Together we create the future of Russian electronics!", reflects its focus on advancing industry development.

The exhibition will gather over 150 Russian manufacturers and more than 6,000 industry professionals. Participants will have the opportunity to explore potential collaborations and highlight the capabilities of domestic production.

A comprehensive business program includes over 15 sessions and roundtables. An Intersectoral Forum will also be held, featuring more than 90 speakers and drawing participation from executive authorities and significant market players. These discussions and exhibits will cover key industry sectors, aiming to address market demands and support domestic manufacturing, contributing to the ongoing development of Russian electronics.

events.name: Salon Des Maires Et Des Collectivites Locales 2026
events.description:
From November 24 to 26, 2026, Paris Expo Porte de Versailles (Pavillon 7) will host the Salon Des Maires Et Des Collectivites Locales, the essential gathering for France's local governance. This year's theme, "L’audace est locale," highlights the event's focus on assisting mayors, elected officials, and territorial executives, especially those newly elected, as they address current challenges.

Participants can explore practical solutions and new approaches for a wide range of territorial issues. These include urban planning, mobility, environmental concerns, digital transformation, and social innovation. With 1,380 exhibitors and 448 speaking engagements, the event encourages discussions and collaborations among professionals.

Held alongside the Salon des Sports & Parasports and the Salon de la Biodiversité et du Génie écologique, the Salon Des Maires provides a broader context for developing and executing sustainable and innovative local projects.

events.name: Pharmtech & Ingredients 2026
events.description:
Scheduled for November 24-27, 2026, at Crocus Expo in Moscow, Pharmtech & Ingredients 2026 stands as Eurasia's premier event for pharmaceutical manufacturing. For four days, the exhibition brings together over 10,000 pharma professionals from more than 28 countries with over 530 exhibitors, creating opportunities for direct engagement between industry leaders and decision-makers.

Attendees, including procurement, R&D, and production teams, will have the opportunity to explore a wide range of equipment, ingredients, packaging, and production technologies. The program includes 20 conference sessions featuring 108 speakers, facilitating technical discussions, live demonstrations, and negotiations that can lead to new collaborations. Participants can expect to see advancements in APIs, nutraceuticals, and cosmetic raw materials. Pharmtech Connect is also available to help individuals connect with relevant contacts.

The gathering addresses important industry objectives, such as enhancing production capabilities, adapting to evolving standards, and reducing supply chain dependency risks. These discussions and showcases occur within the context of the $31.4 billion Eurasian pharma market.

events.name: Industrie & Maintainance Namur 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for Tuesday, November 24, 2026, as Industrie & Maintainance Namur 2026 transforms Namur Expo into the central hub for French-speaking Belgium's process industry and industrial maintenance. This one-day gathering offers a chance to explore new technological solutions and understand current trends, especially as digitalization continues to reshape industries.

The event brings together four specialized areas – Pumps & Valves, M+R, Maintenance, and Solids – providing insights into industrial fluid, gas, measurement, regulation, and bulk product technologies. It is designed for professionals across various roles, from CEOs to technical managers and engineers. The agenda includes a series of conferences, complimentary technical training sessions, and the 'Journée de l’eau,' organized with partners SPGE and SWDE.

The day concludes with opportunities for networking and a cocktail reception, allowing attendees to connect with peers and discuss new developments.

events.name: Bauma China 2026
events.description:
Get ready to experience the future of construction and mining at Bauma China 2026, Asia's premier international trade fair. This year, the event will be held across two venues in Pudong, Shanghai: the Shanghai New International Expo Centre (SNIEC) and the Shanghai World Expo Exhibition & Convention Center (SWEECC). From November 23 to 27, 2026, more than 4,000 exhibitors from 30 countries are expected to participate.

The exhibition will cover 400,000 square meters, showcasing a comprehensive range of construction machinery, building material machines, mining machines, and construction vehicles. A significant focus will be placed on Next-Gen and Green Technologies. Attendees can also expect to see live demonstrations and engage in industry forums. This gathering offers a chance to observe new developments and connect with professionals from the global industry.

events.name: London Build Expo 2026
events.description:
The UK's largest construction show, London Build Expo 2026, is set to transform ExCeL London on November 25th and 26th. This gathering will bring together over 45,000 industry professionals, 650+ exhibitors, and 900+ speakers, providing valuable perspectives on the UK construction industry.

The program includes 17 CPD stages, focusing on important topics such as Skyscraper & Tall Buildings, UK Housing, Modern Methods of Construction, Sustainability, AI & Digital Construction, and Diversity in Construction. There will also be over 40 networking events, including the well-regarded Meet the Buyers program. Additionally, the Festival of Construction will offer celebrity guests and live entertainment.

London Build Expo 2026 serves as a significant opportunity for professionals from across the industry, including contractors, developers, architects, and civil engineers, to connect, share ideas, and contribute to the future of the built environment.

events.name: Doers Summit Dubai 2026
events.description:
Uniting over 5,000 founders, investors, operators, and corporate decision-makers from across Europe, the GCC, Asia, and the Global South, the Doers Summit Dubai 2026 is set to redefine global collaboration. From November 25-26, participants will gather at Dubai Silicon Oasis for an event designed to foster active involvement rather than passive observation.

The agenda features workshops, roundtables, and structured networking opportunities across two stages. Discussions will center on practical applications and scaling strategies within key areas such as AI, Deeptech, Climate, Fintech, and Longevity. The aim is to create an environment where meaningful connections can form, potentially leading to new partnerships, investment opportunities, and accelerated company development.

To support these interactions, the Doers United app provides intelligent networking tools and real-time updates. This digital companion helps participants connect effectively and stay informed throughout the summit.

events.name: Structured Finance 2026
events.description:
Germany's premier gathering for corporate finance decision-makers, Structured Finance 2026, will convene on November 25-26 at ICS, Messe Stuttgart. This congress fair brings together a significant number of the nation's finance leaders, serving as a key forum for modern corporate finance.

The event's theme, "Klug finanzieren in einer neuen Welt" (Smart financing in a new world), will guide discussions on strategic approaches in a changing global environment. CFOs, Treasurers, Investors, and Bankers will participate in focused conversations and opportunities to connect with peers. The program will delve into current practices in corporate finance, featuring roundtables that address a range of contemporary issues. Organized by FINANCE Magazin, the event aims to provide insights that help shape the direction of corporate finance.

events.name: CIO Awards South Africa 2026
events.description:
Prepare for an evening of unparalleled recognition at the CIO Awards South Africa 2026, taking place on 25 November at The Polo Room in Inanda, Johannesburg. CIO South Africa hosts this annual gala dinner and awards ceremony, an occasion dedicated to acknowledging the exceptional performance and visionary leadership of Chief Information Officers.

The gathering will include leading CIOs, key stakeholders, and business partners representing listed companies, large corporations, state-owned entities, and government institutions. Attendees can expect an evening featuring quality cuisine, entertainment, and opportunities for meaningful connections.

A central part of the evening will be the presentation of the CIO Top Awards, recognizing individuals who are significantly influencing the future of information technology in South Africa.

events.name: Asobancaria SAFE Congress 2026
events.description:
Asobancaria SAFE Congress 2026 is set to convene influential leaders from the financial, real, and governmental sectors for an unparalleled exploration of Seguridad, Amenazas Cibernéticas, Fraude y Experiencia.

Known for its strong academic foundation and innovative themes, the congress will bring together international experts to share their latest findings. Attendees will engage in important discussions about the changing nature of security, cyber threats, and fraud prevention. They will also explore strategies to improve both customer and operational experiences within the financial sector.

The event is designed to deepen understanding, help the financial sector prepare for new challenges, and connect leaders and innovators across the industry.

events.name: Digital NSW Showcase 2026
events.description:
Public servants driving the digital future of New South Wales are invited to a pivotal gathering on November 25, 2026, at Sydney's Royal Randwick Racecourse. The Digital NSW Showcase 2026 is designed to move beyond theoretical discussions, focusing instead on the practical application of digital government initiatives. The day will feature a full plenary program alongside four dedicated tracks.

Attendees will hear from leading experts, including Laura Christie and Ranil Boteju, engaging in discussions that cover critical areas such as AI, cyber security, data governance, and designing services with people at the forefront. This free event offers government professionals a chance for practical exchanges and to gain insights into innovative solutions. Contributions from partners like Lenovo, Salesforce, and AWS will highlight strategies for creating inclusive services, enhancing productivity, establishing trusted infrastructure, and building a public service prepared for what's next.

events.name: Big Data Conference Europe 2026
events.description:
The Big Data Conference Europe 2026, celebrating its 10th anniversary as the AI, Cloud and Data Conference, offers four days of intensive learning and networking from November 24-27 in Vilnius, Lithuania, and online.

The conference anticipates over 700 attendees, drawing data engineers, scientists, architects, and AI practitioners from more than 35 countries. The program includes over 60 talks across four distinct tracks and more than 5 hands-on workshops. Discussions will cover current and emerging topics such as Generative AI, Quantum Computing, Data Governance, Ethical AI, and Multimodal AI.

Attendees can expect to gain practical insights into real-world architectures, modern data platforms, MLOps, and analytics at scale. This experience supports professional development and facilitates connections among peers.

events.name: EMEX The Energy Management & Smart Buildings Expo 2026
events.description:
Accelerate your journey towards net zero at EMEX The Energy Management & Smart Buildings Expo 2026, the UK’s leading event for sustainability and energy professionals.

This event, held at Excel London on November 25-26, 2026, is free to attend. It brings together over 3,500 senior decision-makers and more than 100 innovative exhibitors. Attendees can discover new technologies, smart building solutions, and equipment focused on energy savings. These offerings aim to significantly reduce energy consumption, lessen environmental impact, and generate substantial cost savings.

A comprehensive conference program, also free to attend, runs across four dedicated theatres. It includes expert panels, keynote speeches, practical training sessions, and opportunities to connect with peers. EMEX serves as a key platform for advancing energy efficiency and smart building strategies within organisations.

events.name: Future of Biogas Europe 2026
events.description:
Set to convene in Amsterdam on November 25th-26th, Future of Biogas Europe 2026 offers a crucial platform for senior decision-makers across the biogas and renewable gas value chain. Over two days, the summit will address the industry's most pressing challenges. Discussions will explore how to achieve regulatory clarity, accelerate project delivery, and secure the investment needed to expand Europe's biogas sector.

The agenda also includes sessions on maximizing feedstock potential, developing robust biomethane infrastructure, and understanding biomethane's strategic importance for future energy security and grid stability. Beyond the formal sessions, more than five hours are set aside for face-to-face interactions, including a pre-event introduction and social gatherings, allowing participants to build meaningful relationships with their peers.

The gathering will bring together industry leaders, technology providers, and government representatives. The aim is to foster collaboration and advance Europe's biomethane scale-up, contributing to the achievement of 2030 energy goals.

events.name: AFSA Annual Meeting 2026
events.description:
The AFSA Annual Meeting 2026, set against the stunning backdrop of The Breakers in Palm Beach, Florida, from October 25-28, is the essential event for finance industry executives and AFSA members. This four-day gathering provides a setting for professional growth, building connections, and understanding upcoming industry changes.

Participants will hear from expert speakers and engage with current topics, discussing practical approaches to enhance financial services and exploring how consumer credit generates opportunities. The meeting also includes concurrent sessions for groups such as the Women's Leadership Council, Vehicle Finance Board, and various committees. This structure encourages interaction and collaboration among professionals from across the financial services sector.

Attendees can expect to gain valuable insights, establish new partnerships, and contribute to discussions that help shape the future of finance.

events.name: Digitalisation & Ai in Mining Australia Conference 2026
events.description:
Set to redefine the future of the mining industry, the Digitalisation & Ai in Mining Australia Conference 2026 will convene in Perth, WA, on 25-26 November. It serves as Australia's primary forum for professionals focused on integrating digital technologies and Artificial Intelligence into mining operations.

More than 200 senior decision-makers, with over 70% from mining executive roles, will engage with technology providers, government representatives, and investors. The program features 16 sessions, led by over 40 industry experts, exploring advancements in operational efficiency, safety, and sustainability.

Over six hours are set aside for networking, allowing participants to build relationships and explore new solutions that are driving the industry's digital shift.

events.name: The Business Show Australia 2026
events.description:
Australia's leading event for ambitious SME founders and business leaders, The Business Show Australia 2026, takes place on November 25th and 26th at the iconic ICC Sydney. This two-day event is designed for decision-makers focused on growing their companies beyond $2 million, or those building businesses aiming for $10 million and more. It typically draws around 8,000 attendees.

The program includes 150 CPD-accredited seminars and masterclasses. Attendees will hear from over 15 keynote speakers, including Naomi Simson OAM and Tony J. Hughes, who will share insights on various topics. Discussions will cover current strategies in areas like AI, marketing, financing, and B2B solutions. The event also features 300 exhibitors, opportunities for speed networking, and expert panel discussions.

The gathering provides a setting for business leaders to explore new ideas, connect with peers, and consider strategies that can help advance their companies within Australia's SME landscape.

events.name: FACTS 2026
events.description:
Australia's premier convergence for the business travel ecosystem, FACTS 2026, is set to unfold over two powerful days at ICC Sydney. Each year, this summit gathers more than 2,000 professionals, including over 600 buyers, to discuss developments in corporate travel, meetings, events, payments, and aviation.

Participants will find six specialized summits, all in one location. These sessions will examine key aspects of airline strategy, the increasing need for business events, and upcoming shifts in corporate travel payments and loyalty programs.

Professionals ranging from strategic procurement leaders to event planners and aviation executives will find opportunities for gaining new perspectives, developing practical skills, and making valuable connections. The event brings together those who are developing new ideas with individuals who make significant decisions, contributing to the industry's direction.

events.name: WeAreDevelopers Conference India 2026
events.description:
Prepare to shape the future of software at the WeAreDevelopers Conference India 2026, taking place on November 25-26 in Bengaluru. This two-day event brings together developers, AI builders, and tech leaders who are working with the challenges of building, shipping, and running software in the age of AI.

Attendees will hear from industry leaders such as Thomas Dohmke (CEO, GitHub) and Lakshmi Devi Prakash (VP, JPMorgan Chase) during tech talks, hands-on workshops, and live coding sessions. Discussions will cover key topics like AI-assisted development, agentic systems, cloud platforms, robust security, and developer productivity.

The conference offers an opportunity to compare current practices, evaluate different architectures, and find practical solutions for engineering challenges. It's a chance to connect with founders, maintainers, and other professionals, fostering discussions around upcoming technological innovations and supporting individual skill development.

events.name: Cyber Security in Financial Services Summit 2026
events.description:
Navigate the evolving landscape of financial cyber threats at the Cyber Security in Financial Services Summit 2026. On November 25, 2026, at The Minster Building in London, senior executives from banking, insurance, and investment sectors will gather to discuss strategies for addressing these challenges.

The summit will examine critical areas, including how artificial intelligence can be leveraged for defense, understanding regulatory compliance requirements such as FCA and DORA, and mitigating sophisticated threats like deepfakes and supply chain vulnerabilities. Attendees will hear from industry leaders through presentations and discussions.

This setting provides an opportunity to explore innovative solutions, exchange insights on best practices, and build meaningful connections. The aim is to help institutions strengthen their defenses against future security challenges.

events.name: MeOut Summit 2026
events.description:
Strengthening Europe's innovation ecosystem takes center stage at MeOut Summit 2026, scheduled for November 25-26 at Akvárium, Budapest. This two-day gathering brings together more than 1,000 startups, investors, corporate leaders, and policymakers. Their collective aim is to improve Central Europe's competitive standing in the global innovation landscape.

Participants will explore topics such as startup development, deep-tech investment, and advanced AI solutions, including the BizHack AI program. More than 50 speakers, among them Prezi co-founder Adam Somlai-Fischer and OTB Ventures' Marcin Hejka, will offer their perspectives on various sectors, from fintech and HR tech to smart waste management. The summit will also host the Grand Finale of the Central European Startup Awards.

The event provides an environment for individuals to connect, identify new possibilities, and work together on shaping Europe's future in innovation.

events.name: BPM Summit Europe Fall 2026
events.description:
Unlock unparalleled insights into Business Process Management at the BPM Summit DACH 2026, taking place from November 25-27 at the Maritim proArte Hotel in Berlin. This three-day gathering brings together over 588 decision-makers from Germany, Austria, and Switzerland, providing a focused environment for exploring new services, technologies, and products relevant to business process management.

Attendees will hear from more than 124 expert speakers, participating in over 68 practical case studies and 56 interactive sessions. The agenda explores core themes such as strategic process alignment, process mining, AI and automation, and cost optimization, all aimed at enhancing operational efficiency and strengthening competitive positions.

The program facilitates over 144 targeted one-on-one meetings and offers ample opportunities for professional networking. A single ticket also includes entry to the co-located OpEX Reloaded Summit and Intelligent Automation Summit, broadening the scope for learning and professional connections.

events.name: SMART FACTORY Expo NAGOYA 2026
events.description:
Prepare to revolutionize manufacturing at SMART FACTORY Expo NAGOYA 2026, a pivotal event within Factory Innovation Week Nagoya. The exhibition runs from November 25-27, 2026, at Aichi Sky Expo C~F in Japan, highlighting significant advancements in industrial innovation.

Those attending will find the latest manufacturing Digital Transformation (DX) technologies, IoT, AI, and other advanced solutions. These developments aim to optimize production processes and enhance efficiency, reflecting the core principles of Industry 4.0 and the ongoing digital transformation within factories.

As a central part of the broader Factory Innovation Week, SMART FACTORY Expo offers insights into smart factory technologies. It connects visitors with 620 exhibitors and an anticipated 34,000 industry professionals.

events.name: Occupational Therapy Show 2026
events.description:
Elevate your practice and connect with the heart of the occupational therapy community at the Occupational Therapy Show 2026. This gathering will be held on 25-26 November at the NEC Birmingham, UK, bringing together occupational therapists and other professionals dedicated to promoting independence.

Attendees can access more than 100 hours of professional development sessions, featuring insights from organizations such as the NHS, RCOT, and IRCM. An exhibition area will also be available, where over 200 suppliers will present products and services designed to support diverse needs.

Over these two days, there will be opportunities to meet colleagues, exchange knowledge, and learn about new developments that could influence the future of occupational therapy. The event is designed for everyone, from those beginning their careers to experienced clinical leads, offering insights and practical approaches to support their professional journey.

events.name: AFC Cytometry 2026
events.description:
Prepare for a landmark event in cellular analysis as AFC Cytometry 2026, the inaugural 1st Mediterranean Meeting on Flow Cytometry, convenes from November 25th to 27th, 2026, in beautiful Granada, Spain. This meeting brings together the French Cytometry Association (AFC) and the Iberian Society of Cytometry (SIC) to present the latest developments in the field.

The program is designed for both young cytometrists and established experts from across the Mediterranean region. Participants will explore current topics such as high-content cytometry, the role of AI in data analysis, and nanocytometry. The agenda includes presentations from national and international speakers, along with six specialized workshops focusing on spectral and imaging cytometry. An accompanying commercial exhibition will also be part of the event.

Attendees will have opportunities to connect with peers, share their recent discoveries, and engage in discussions about clinical implications relevant to hematology, immunology, and cell therapy. This gathering offers a valuable forum for those interested in the evolving landscape of cytometry.

events.name: Therapy Show 2026
events.description:
Discover the cutting-edge of therapy and rehabilitation at Therapy Show 2026, taking place on 25-26 November at NEC Birmingham, UK.

This two-day event is for over 3,000 therapy and rehabilitation professionals, including clinicians, business owners, neurophysiotherapists, and sports therapists. Attendees will find more than 150 accredited sessions, offering evidence-led professional development, practical workshops, and hands-on learning. These sessions explore current approaches across MSK, rehabilitation, performance, women's health, and pain management.

Over 180 exhibitors will be present, displaying new products and technologies for assessment, treatment, and recovery. The event also provides an opportunity to connect with colleagues, hear from influential speakers, and contribute to discussions that influence clinical practice.

events.name: Factory Innovation Week Nagoya 2026
events.description:
Prepare to explore the forefront of manufacturing innovation at Factory Innovation Week Nagoya 2026, taking place in Nagoya, Japan. This gathering brings together four distinct exhibitions, each offering perspectives on the future of factory technologies. These include the SMART FACTORY Expo, focusing on manufacturing DX solutions; RoboDEX, for advancements in robotics and automation; GREEN FACTORY Expo, addressing carbon neutrality and energy-saving technologies; and the Manufacturing Industry's HR Expo, which looks at workforce challenges.

A new addition this year is "Generative AI World," a dedicated area presenting AI solutions specifically for factory automation. The event anticipates welcoming 33,000 visitors and 600 exhibitors. It aims to provide a platform for professionals interested in advancing digital transformation, improving operational efficiency, and promoting sustainable practices within manufacturing.

events.name: PlanX Conference 2026
events.description:
Set against the vibrant backdrop of Dubai, PlanX Conference 2026 invites modern founders, crypto natives, and remote entrepreneurs to its 'Freedom Without Borders' conference on November 25-26.

The conference will take place at the Grand Hyatt Dubai during Crypto Week. It aims to provide insights into the evolving landscape of global business for those looking to operate with greater flexibility and independence.

Attendees can expect discussions and sessions covering offshore strategies, options for second citizenship, and smart investing approaches. The agenda includes opportunities to understand how to manage taxes more effectively, establish robust contingency plans, and cultivate wealth outside conventional financial structures. Topics will also delve into zero-tax jurisdictions, advanced remote operations using Web3 and AI, and various alternative investment avenues. The event will also feature opportunities for participants to connect with peers and experts through workshops and one-on-one clinics, offering practical knowledge and connections that support individuals in designing more autonomous and globally integrated lives.

events.name: BlockCon 2026
events.description:
Prepare for an unparalleled Web3 experience at BlockCon 2026, a high-end business retreat set against the stunning backdrop of Punta Cana, Dominican Republic, from November 25-28. This all-inclusive event, held at Barceló Bávaro Beach, brings together over 1,000 decision-makers, with half being C-Level executives from more than 65 countries. For four days, these leaders will engage in focused discussions and explore strategic opportunities.

Participants will examine critical areas such as Fintech, iGaming, Real-World Assets, and global regulation. These conversations will be shaped by insights from over 50 industry leaders, including figures like Shaikh Ali Sultan Al Nuaimi and Senator Mario Ishii. Beyond the formal sessions, BlockCon provides various settings for connection, from golf tournaments and casino nights to polo, creating an environment where professional relationships can develop.

This event serves as a significant forum for individuals who are actively influencing the future of digital finance and infrastructure.

events.name: C-Move São Paulo 2026
events.description:
Brazil's premier event for electric mobility, smart cities, and innovation, C-Move São Paulo 2026, is set to transform the São Paulo Expo from November 25 to 27. This year marks the 20th anniversary of E-MOB, bringing together the latest in electric vehicles—from bikes and scooters to cars, buses, and trucks—alongside new approaches for creating more sustainable urban spaces.

Those attending will find opportunities to connect with key buyers from both public and private sectors, fostering discussions and potential collaborations. The gathering serves as a meeting point for government, private companies, and academic institutions, offering a space to explore technological advancements and work together on the direction of sustainable transportation in Brazil. It's a significant occasion for individuals and organizations contributing to the progress of electromobility.

events.name: AutoSens China 2026
events.description:
Prepare to shape the future of vehicle perception and autonomous driving at AutoSens China 2026, held November 25-26 at the Intercontinental Hefei. This gathering brings together over 400 specialists in ADAS and AV to discuss the newest developments in automotive imaging and sensor technology.

The program spans two tracks, offering detailed discussions on RADAR, LiDAR, camera innovations, and the journey towards full autonomy. Participants will find an InCabin experience, roundtables led by experts, vehicle demonstrations, and a comprehensive exhibition. Technical sessions will be available with dual translation.

The event provides an opportunity to hear from leaders such as those from BMW and TechInsights. It also serves as a forum for engineers across China who are advancing automotive innovation to meet and share ideas.

events.name: Data Center Nation Zurich 2026
events.description:
Data Center Nation Zurich 2026 will reinforce Switzerland's significance in the European data center landscape, bringing together over 800 key decision-makers daily from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM at Messe Zürich. The program for this event is extensive, with over 60 industry leaders sharing their perspectives across more than 25 focused sessions.

Professionals attending, many of whom are in senior roles with final decision-making authority, will delve into important advancements concerning sustainable energy procurement, the development of AI sovereign data centers, and the evolving landscape of cloud and hybrid IT models. Discussions will also highlight Switzerland's distinct advantages in sustainability, robust connectivity, and a secure power supply. These conversations are intended to illuminate the innovations driving the market's projected growth to USD 2.78 billion by 2027, and to provide insights into strategies for building resilient data infrastructure for the future.

events.name: Interpoma Congress 2026
events.description:
The global apple industry will converge in Bolzano, Italy, Europe's largest apple-growing region, for the Interpoma Congress 2026, held from November 26-27 within the main Interpoma trade show (November 25-27). This event brings together approximately 16,000 apple professionals from 60 countries and more than 400 leading companies. Participants will have the chance to discuss and learn about the newest developments in apple cultivation, storage, and marketing practices.

The congress program will delve into specific topics, including "Spraying technology & Latin America." An accompanying exhibition, "The Orchard of the Future," will display recent advancements in spraying techniques. Beyond the main sessions, participants can take part in Interpoma Tours to observe regional apple cultivation methods firsthand and acknowledge sustainable innovation through the Interpoma Award. This gathering provides a significant forum for apple professionals to network, share knowledge, and contribute to the ongoing development of the industry.

events.name: Western Australia HR Leadership Summit 2026
events.description:
The Western Australia HR Leadership Summit 2026, held on November 25th and 26th at The Westin, Perth, invites HR leaders to redefine their strategic roadmap. The event's theme, "Forward Motion – Harnessing collective strength to shape change," focuses on empowering professionals to drive organizational growth and realize human potential.

Discussions will cover essential areas such as the responsible use of AI in HR, developing long-term people strategies, and fostering a workforce that is prepared for the future and spans multiple generations. Attendees will also examine how to manage psychosocial risks, integrate diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB) effectively, and refine data-driven HR practices to support better decision-making.

It offers a setting for HR leaders to connect with colleagues and experts, exchanging perspectives and exploring ideas that can contribute to significant organizational change.

events.name: Stuttgart Knowledge Management Days 2026
events.description:
The Stuttgart Knowledge Management Days 2026, scheduled for November 25 & 26, offers a deep dive into the evolving landscape of digitalization and knowledge management. The conference's theme, "Mensch. Maschine. Mindset: Wissen intelligent nutzen" (Human. Machine. Mindset: Intelligently utilize knowledge), will guide discussions on how organizations can effectively use knowledge as a strategic asset.

The program brings together specialists, decision-makers, and practitioners to discuss key topics. These include the practical application of Generative AI, intelligent Enterprise Search, Digital Workplace strategies, and the importance of mindset in cultivating a robust knowledge culture.

Over two days, the event offers practical experience reports, concrete use cases, and thoughtful discussions, encouraging active knowledge exchange among participants. The gathering aims to address how knowledge can remain effective and influential in a landscape marked by rapid technological and organizational changes.

events.name: Tech Summit London 2026
events.description:
Prepare for a day of unparalleled innovation and strategic insight at Tech Summit London 2026, taking place on 3rd December at Regents Events, Regent's University London. This recognized conference brings together hundreds of industry leaders, emerging companies, and leading technology professionals. The aim is to explore the next wave of technological advancements.

Participants will discover valuable perspectives through a series of talks, expert-led workshops, and panel discussions. These sessions will feature insights from figures such as Chris Day (Tesco) and Alexandra Tsoy (Paysend). Discussions will delve into key areas including AI, Cloud, Cybersecurity, Data, and Digital Transformation, offering practical approaches for professional development and organizational evolution.

The event also provides an opportunity to connect with peers and engage in discussions that will help shape the future of technology.

events.name: IBD Nordic Conference 2026
events.description:
The IBD Nordic Conference 2026 offers a pivotal gathering for healthcare professionals and researchers dedicated to advancing the understanding and treatment of inflammatory bowel disease. The conference, held from Wednesday, November 25 to Friday, November 27, 2026, at the Quality Hotel View in Malmö, Sweden, aims to foster discussions that will help shape the future of IBD care.

Attendees will explore the latest scientific breakthroughs and their clinical implications, connecting research findings directly to practical patient impact. The program features sessions led by experts, encouraging dialogue on innovative diagnostics, therapeutic strategies, and patient management.

This event provides a setting for professionals to connect with peers and specialists, exchange knowledge, and collaborate on improving outcomes for IBD patients across the Nordic region and beyond. The insights shared and collaborations formed here are intended to contribute to advancements in IBD.

events.name: Baking Industry Awards 2026
events.description:
The pinnacle of recognition for the UK's vibrant baking sector, the 39th annual Baking Industry Awards 2026 returns on Wednesday 25 November to the prestigious London Hilton on Park Lane. This event celebrates the people, products, and businesses that shape British baking.

It's where a year of dedication and creativity culminates, as finalists are revealed and awards go to those who have truly excelled. The awards highlight the unique qualities, high standards, and fresh ideas in bakery products, recognizing both individual accomplishments and business successes over the last year. It brings together craft bakeries and larger operations, offering a chance to connect with peers and acknowledge the best work in this evolving industry.

The evening itself is a celebration of these achievements, marking a significant moment for everyone involved in British baking.

events.name: NEPCON NAGOYA 2026
events.description:
Japan's leading exhibition for electronics R&D and manufacturing, NEPCON NAGOYA 2026, will open its doors from November 25 to 27, 2026, at Aichi Sky Expo C~F. Nagoya, a key hub for Japan's manufacturing industry, serves as the backdrop for this event.

Supported by the Aichi Prefectural Government, NEPCON NAGOYA anticipates welcoming over 34,000 visitors and 620 exhibitors. Those attending can explore recent developments in mounters, testing equipment, electronic components, materials, and PCBs. The conference program, alongside presentations from exhibitors, offers a platform to understand new trends and connect with others in the field.

events.name: CAR-MECHA JAPAN NAGOYA 2026
events.description:
Set to redefine automotive manufacturing, CAR-MECHA JAPAN NAGOYA 2026 will convene from November 25-27, 2026, at Aichi Sky Expo, Japan. This event focuses on the newest processing technologies vital for creating automotive components and the machinery used to make them.

Automotive manufacturers (OEMs) and their primary suppliers will find the latest innovations in areas like press work, casting, forging, cutting, grinding, sheet-metal, resin fabrication, and surface finishing. It's an opportunity for professionals in design, procurement, R&D, manufacturing, and production management to explore new solutions.

Attendees can connect directly with leading manufacturers of processing equipment and suppliers of processed parts. This interaction helps improve efficiency, simplify production processes, and contribute to developing future vehicles.

events.name: CAR-ELE JAPAN Nagoya 2026
events.description:
Set to unfold in November 2026 in Nagoya, Japan, CAR-ELE JAPAN Nagoya 2026 is the world's foremost exhibition dedicated to automotive electronics. The exhibition brings together a wide range of advanced technologies, covering everything from core components and in-vehicle systems to sophisticated software development and testing methods. Attendees can expect to see innovations in areas such as ADAS/autonomous driving, thermal management, EMC/noise reduction, and ECU manufacturing.

This gathering serves as an important opportunity for automotive OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers, including major companies like Toyota, Bosch, and Denso, to understand and interact with the latest industry developments. It offers a chance to learn about new materials, establish connections with important partners, and deepen understanding of the field. As part of the AUTOMOTIVE WORLD series, CAR-ELE JAPAN Nagoya 2026 plays a role in defining the direction of automotive technology.

events.name: Offshore Support Journal Conference Middle East 2026
events.description:
Dive deep into the evolving landscape of the Middle East's offshore support vessel sector at the Offshore Support Journal Conference Middle East 2026.

The event will be held on December 10-11, 2026, at the Shangri-La Dubai. This two-day gathering brings together key figures from the region, including vessel owners, charterers, oil and gas companies, and technology providers.

Discussions will cover critical market drivers, innovative vessel financing strategies, and advanced fuel technologies like hybrid propulsion, which aims to reduce emissions. A significant focus will be on addressing regional needs, ranging from the design of shallow-draft vessels to strategies for extending the operational life of existing fleets.

An exhibition area will allow participants to connect directly with suppliers. The event also provides opportunities for networking, encouraging collaboration among OSV owners, operators, and other offshore energy stakeholders. The overall goal is to facilitate a deeper understanding of the market's challenges and opportunities.

events.name: World Communication Awards 2026
events.description:
The global telecoms industry's most prestigious evening awaits at the World Communication Awards 2026, set for 25 November at London's elegant Grand Connaught Rooms. This black-tie gala dinner and awards ceremony recognizes significant innovation and outstanding achievements within the sector.

The awards acknowledge developments across various areas, from 5G, AI, and Digital Transformation to efforts in Sustainability and Customer Experience, highlighting the ideas that are truly shaping the telecom landscape today. Professionals from across the globe, including decision-makers, industry influencers, and leading brands, will be present.

It's an evening where those recognized as the best in the business will receive the iconic sail trophy. Attendees will have the chance to hear about key developments and engage with peers who are shaping the future of connectivity.

events.name: BEGE 2026
events.description:
Set to illuminate the gaming and entertainment landscape, BEGE 2026 will convene at the Inter Expo Center in Sofia on November 25-26, 2026. Industry professionals from across the Balkans will gather to explore recent innovations and emerging trends.

Attendees can also participate in the co-located East European Gaming Summit, an opportunity to hear from experts and gain new perspectives. The BEGE Awards 2026 will acknowledge significant accomplishments within the industry, recognizing work across various categories.

With a substantial exhibition area, the event provides a setting for professionals to connect, discover new technologies, and discuss the direction of the gaming and entertainment sector in the region.

events.name: Testing United Conference 2026
events.description:
Unite human ingenuity with machine intelligence at the Testing United Conference 2026, held November 25-26 in vibrant Copenhagen, Denmark.

The conference, centered on 'United Intelligence: Harmonizing Humans & Machines,' brings together over 300 software testing and quality engineering professionals. It offers a space to explore the future of their work, focusing on how AI can be integrated into quality practices to improve efficiency while maintaining essential human judgment and innovation.

Day one of the two-day event includes six practical, hands-on workshops, concluding with an evening networking opportunity. The second day presents talks and real-world case studies from 18 international speakers, addressing topics from test automation to modern quality assurance. The content aims to provide insights and practical skills. Participants will also have access to recorded sessions, supporting their efforts to develop smarter, more trustworthy software.

events.name: 24ORE Eventi Healthcare Summit 2026
events.description:
The 24ORE Eventi Healthcare Summit 2026, a crucial hybrid gathering, is set for Wednesday, November 25, from 09:00 to 16:00. Attendees can participate online or in person at Rome's Museo dell'Ara Pacis. The event will feature high-level discussions, interactive workshops, and round tables. Leading experts will speak, and Il Sole 24 Ore journalists Marzio Bartoloni and Barbara Gobbi will moderate the sessions.

The program will cover important subjects such as digital advancement, artificial intelligence, and new models of prevention and care. A key focus will be on the right to health, system sustainability, and the strategic role of innovation and clinical research. Organized by Il Sole 24 Ore, 24 Ore Salute, and Radiocor, this free event offers a chance to gain new insights, exchange ideas, and build connections, all aimed at shaping the future of both public and private healthcare.

events.name: Hotel Interior Experience 2026
events.description:
Discover the forefront of hospitality design at Hotel Interior Experience 2026 (HIX Europe), Europe's essential gathering for leading designers, operators, and developers. On 25-26 November at Excel London, this free, two-day event examines the world of hotel interiors, architecture, and development. Attendees will explore how atmosphere takes shape, how environments evolve, and the interplay between technology and touch in contemporary hospitality.

HIX Europe features insightful talks, creative installations, and the return of the Kindling design competition with its 'sanctuary' theme. Co-located with AHEAD Europe at MAGAZINE London, the event creates a unified experience across both venues, showcasing leading design brands and encouraging connections among professionals in the European hospitality community.

events.name: Floodex 2026
events.description:
The UK's premier event for flood and water level management, Floodex 2026, returns to ExCeL London on 25th & 26th November. This event is held alongside the National Drainage Show, Waterways Management Show, National Civils Show, and London Build Expo, bringing together various aspects of construction and environmental innovation.

Over two days, the exhibition and conference provides flood management professionals, civil engineers, contractors, and local authorities with insights into surface water runoff, catchment areas, and property flood resilience. Participants can expect to discuss current challenges, exchange knowledge, and discover new approaches for water level management. Access to all co-located events allows for broader engagement and understanding of how to protect communities and infrastructure.

events.name: UKHMA Autumn Conference 2026
events.description:
Set to convene on Wednesday, November 25, 2026, the UKHMA Autumn Conference offers an essential platform for the United Kingdom Harbour Masters' Association members and invited guests. The conference will take place at London's Victory Services Club. It focuses on important conversations about harbour management, maritime operations, and port services.

Those attending will explore the changing environment of UK ports, looking at current challenges and future possibilities. It provides an opportunity for professionals to share best practices, connect with colleagues, and help shape industry standards for maritime safety and efficiency.

Information about the agenda and specific sessions will be shared directly with members. The day is designed for meaningful discussions and professional development.

events.name: Lean Productivity & Continuous Improvement MSC West 2026
events.description:
Discover the forefront of operational excellence at a pivotal one-day event dedicated to Lean Productivity & Continuous Improvement, co-located with Manufacturing & Supply Chain West.
