The event is scheduled for November 25, 2026, at the University of Limerick's UL Arena in Limerick, Ireland. It brings together industry leaders, innovators, and decision-makers from the manufacturing and supply chain sectors.

Participants can expect to gain valuable insights from over 75 expert speakers, engage in interactive panels and workshops, and discover innovations showcased by more than 200 exhibitors. This provides an occasion to examine new technologies, exchange ideas with colleagues, and build new professional connections. The program emphasizes strategies that enhance efficiency and foster continuous improvement, supporting those operating within a dynamic and competitive environment.

events.name: FOOD & LIFE Autumn 2026
events.description:
Prepare your palate for an extraordinary culinary journey as Munich, Germany, welcomes a vibrant festival of taste from March 4 to 8, 2026. This five-day event, running daily from 09:30 a.m. to 06:00 p.m., offers an engaging experience for food enthusiasts in the Munich metropolitan region.

Attendees will have the chance to explore new trends in the food industry and gather fresh ideas for home cooking. A diverse selection of delicacies will be available for tasting. The event showcases the craftsmanship behind gourmet products, spirits, health foods, and dairy specialties. From new kitchen approaches to unique flavors, the culinary offerings aim to satisfy various tastes and provide inspiration for future explorations.

events.name: Women of the Future Awards Southeast Asia 2026
events.description:
The Women of the Future Awards Southeast Asia 2026 invites you to an inspiring celebration of leadership and innovation. This event, planned for Singapore, recognizes outstanding women leaders aged 35 and under from across the region.

The awards aim to identify and celebrate women who challenge stereotypes, break boundaries, and drive positive change in various industries. Those attending will have the opportunity to connect with inspiring nominees, dedicated mentors, and a supportive network focused on developing women's leadership.

The event highlights remarkable achievements, encourages valuable connections, and amplifies the stories of women who are shaping Southeast Asia's future.

events.name: Personal Injury Awards 2026
events.description:
The Personal Injury Awards 2026 stands as the definitive celebration of excellence within the personal injury sector. This event acknowledges the significant contributions of individuals and organizations who maintain high standards and drive new ideas in their practice. It offers a platform for professionals, practitioners, and key service providers to highlight their work.

Submissions for the 2026 awards will open shortly, with a deadline of September 11, 2026. An independent panel of industry experts will review all entries. The shortlist will be announced in October.

The year culminates with the awards ceremony on November 26, 2026, where the sector's most impactful work will be recognized.

events.name: Travolution Awards 2026
events.description:
The Travolution Awards 2026, set to illuminate London on November 26th, 2026, stands as the definitive celebration of excellence in travel technology. Industry insiders often refer to it as 'The best night in Travel Tech,' an occasion that brings together influential professionals and visionary leaders. The evening focuses on acknowledging the significant innovations, strategic successes, and pioneering solutions that are shaping the global travel landscape.

Those attending will find an environment where achievements are recognized, connect with colleagues, and draw inspiration from the advancements moving the sector forward. It's an occasion for networking, celebrating accomplishments, and collectively considering the future of travel innovation.

events.name: CFO Awards South Africa 2026
events.description:
South Africa's premier finance event, the CFO Awards 2026, will illuminate The Polo Room in Inanda, Johannesburg, on 26 November. This annual gala, often called the 'Oscars of Finance,' acknowledges exceptional financial leadership and innovation across the country. Approximately 350 chief financial officers and senior executives from various organizations are expected to attend.

The awards recognize excellence in key areas such as strategic implementation, finance transformation, environmental, social, and governance initiatives, and technology integration. The evening will feature a formal dinner, culminating in the presentation of the CFO Top Awards. Afterwards, guests will have the opportunity to connect with peers and leaders within the finance sector.

events.name: Dutch Life Sciences Conference 2026
events.description:
The Dutch Life Sciences Conference 2026, scheduled for 26 November, stands as the premier gathering for professionals driving innovation within the Netherlands' dynamic life sciences sector.

The conference offers a setting to explore new advancements, build strategic partnerships, and identify business opportunities. An exhibition will showcase various developments, critical insights are shared at the Investors Forum, and new ideas emerge from the Venture Challenge.

Specialized classes will delve into key industry topics, and speakers, including Ilan Ganot (Alesta Therapeutics) and Dr. Stefanie Meeuwis (Tilburg University), will share their expertise. The event brings together a diverse network of industry leaders, researchers, and investors, fostering discussions that help shape the future of life sciences.

events.name: Property Claims Conference 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for the Property Claims Conference 2026, an essential gathering designed to equip industry professionals with the insights needed for tomorrow's challenges. The conference will explore recent advancements, shifts in regulations, and effective practices currently influencing the property claims sector. Attendees will examine innovative technologies, strategies for managing complex claims, and approaches to enhancing customer satisfaction.

This event provides an opportunity to connect with peers, share experiences, and gain practical knowledge from leading experts. Discussions will address emerging risks, the application of data analytics, and methods for streamlining operations, offering a forward-looking perspective on the evolving landscape of property claims.

events.name: IDC CIO Summit Italy 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendar for the IDC CIO Summit Italy, a crucial event for IT leaders and executive peers, held on Thursday, November 27, 2025, at Milan's Magna Pars Event Space.

The event will explore 'The CIO Playbook: Balancing Innovation and Pragmatism in Modern IT Strategy,' offering practical perspectives for navigating today's intricate digital environment.

Participants will gain insights into AI, digital business, and cloud strategies through keynotes delivered by experts such as Roberta Bigliani and Andrea Siviero. Nine parallel IDC Connect sessions will cover topics including Generative AI, cybersecurity, and ESG, designed to encourage meaningful conversations and connections among peers. This complimentary event for eligible professionals aims to provide CIOs with resources for strategic development and innovation.

events.name: Intelligent Automation Summit 2026
events.description:
Prepare for the future of operational excellence at the Intelligent Automation Summit 2026, taking place November 26-27 at Berlin's Maritim proArte Hotel.

This gathering will explore the evolution of process management, examining how intelligent, AI-supported processes contribute to real-time decision-making and operational transformation. Discussions will cover the integration of RPA, AI Agents, Workflow Orchestration, and Process Intelligence, looking at how these elements work together to manage processes across different systems and accelerate data-driven choices. The agenda includes practical applications and current developments in AI-driven process automation, from GenAI to Hyperautomation.

A single registration provides entry to four conferences: the Intelligent Automation Summit, OpEX Reloaded, BPM, and GBS. Attendees will have opportunities to connect with 588 decision-makers from 327 companies. The program features 68 case studies, interactive sessions, and one-on-one meetings.

events.name: HIMSS Eurasia 2026
events.description:
Eurasia’s largest health technology gathering, HIMSS Eurasia 2026, will convene from November 26-28 at the Sueno Hotel in Belek – Antalya, Türkiye.

This three-day event serves as a significant forum for health system executives, clinical leaders, and innovators in digital health from around the globe. The program will open with remarks from Türkiye's Minister of Health and HIMSS President & CEO Hal Wolf. The agenda will focus on how digital technology can enhance patient care and streamline operations, exploring practical applications and future directions.

A dedicated track will explore the practical application of AI in healthcare, moving from theoretical concepts to real-world deployment. This includes discussions on national screening programs and AI's role in clinical decision support. Additionally, the Start-Up Arena provides a space for emerging companies to connect with potential collaborators and investors. The gathering is expected to bring together over 1,300 participants from 45 countries, all contributing to conversations about the future of global health innovation.

events.name: China Hi-Tech Fair 2026

location.venue: Shenzhen International Convention and Exhibition Center

events.description:
Shenzhen, China, will host the 28th China Hi-Tech Fair in November 2026, an unparalleled global platform for technological innovation. The event will bring together over 5,000 leading enterprises and international organizations from more than 100 countries. Spanning 400,000 square meters, the fair will present significant technological advancements, with over 90% of the exhibits being physical displays. More than 20% of these are expected to be global or national debuts.

The fair will welcome over 400,000 professional visitors, including global buyers, academicians, and industry leaders, fostering an environment for collaboration. Over 200 forums will explore diverse topics such as AI, robotics, the low-altitude economy, life sciences, and new materials. These sessions aim to highlight innovative solutions, support their practical application in various industries, and contribute to the evolution of productive capabilities.

events.name: Républik Galas des Achats 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendar for the 14th edition of Républik Galas des Achats 2026, an exclusive gathering set for November 26, 2026, at the elegant Le Pré Catelan in Paris.

This gathering convenes 150 leading Purchasing Directors from French and international companies across industrial, tertiary, and public sectors. It is structured for confidential, off-the-record discussions, providing a setting to review the year's procurement landscape and consider what lies ahead for 2027.

The evening will unfold like a radio show, guided by a professional journalist. It will include a "débat brûlant" featuring director pitches, presentations of new barometers, and insights from key experts. Throughout the welcome cocktail, dinner, and closing cocktail, there will be opportunities for high-level networking, encouraging strategic thinking. Innovative solution providers can also find a setting to connect with these influential decision-makers.

events.name: Next IT Security DACH Fall 2026
events.description:
On November 26, 2026, Frankfurt will host Next IT Security DACH Fall 2026, an exclusive C-level cybersecurity conference designed for top executives.

This gathering is specifically designed for C-suite executives, particularly those who qualify for "The C-Suite Edition" program. It provides a focused setting for strategic conversations and meaningful connections among peers, addressing critical cybersecurity topics.

With attendance capped at 150 leaders, the event fosters an intimate environment. This allows for focused collaboration and a deep exchange of knowledge on the most pressing IT security challenges. Standard registration is 990 €. However, qualifying C-suite professionals have the option to apply for "The C-Suite Edition" to receive a complimentary pass, which requires a specific promo code.

events.name: SymfonyCon 2026
events.description:
The Symfony community is set to converge in Warsaw, Poland, from November 24-28, 2026, marking a significant return to the city that hosted the very first SymfonyCon in 2013. The event begins with two days of workshops on November 24-25, offering focused learning on important subjects.

After the workshops, November 26-27 brings two days of talks across various tracks. Participants will hear about the newest developments in Symfony, discuss best practices, and gain insights into quality PHP development from experts such as Rob Allen and Alexander M. Turek. This gathering offers insights and chances to connect with others, whether someone is an experienced Symfony developer, new to PHP, or an IT professional.

The week concludes with a Hackday on November 28, open to all who wish to participate.

events.name: MATPN South 2026
events.description:
MATPN South 2026 offers a unique, peer-led forum for senior leaders across Multi Academy Trusts, convening on 26 - 27 November at the Radisson Blu Edwardian Hotel, Heathrow. This invitation-only gathering focuses on the real challenges and strategic priorities within MATs, covering areas such as digital transformation, human resources, SEND provision, and operational excellence.

The event is structured for genuine conversation rather than formal presentations, with the agenda shaped by the leaders themselves. Senior figures, including CEOs, CFOs, and Directors of Education, will participate in peer discussions and pre-arranged one-to-one meetings with relevant solution providers. This environment is designed to facilitate the exchange of effective strategies and practical insights, fostering connections among participants.

A complimentary delegate pass, which includes an overnight stay, is available for eligible attendees. This arrangement supports a focused experience, aiming to provide tangible benefits and actionable outcomes for their respective trusts.

events.name: GITEX VIETNAM 2026
events.description:
On October 1-2, 2026, Hanoi, Vietnam will become Southeast Asia's premier nexus for global VC investment and innovation as it hosts GITEX VIETNAM 2026. This event, supported by Government Alignment and GITEX GLOBAL, is anticipated to bring together over 250 institutional investors and 750 startups, alongside leaders from enterprises and the public sector.

Attendees will have the opportunity to explore the latest developments in AI, Cybersecurity, Data Centres, Fintech, and Quantum technologies. The program features specific events such as the Vietnam AI & Chips Summit, the AI 100 startup showcase, and the Supernova Pitch Competition, which includes a SGD 60K prize pool. Discussions with leading CISOs will take place in designated areas, and the Crystal Ball forum will offer various perspectives on future trends.

The gathering aims to foster connections and facilitate discussions that contribute to the evolution of Southeast Asia's digital landscape and support Vietnam's role in the global technology arena.

events.name: Manufacturing & Engineering North East 2026
events.description:
On 26 November 2026, the Vertu Arena in Newcastle upon Tyne will host Manufacturing & Engineering North East, the region's essential one-day event for industrial innovation. This exhibition, which is free to attend, offers the North East's manufacturing and engineering community a chance to see new designs, emerging technologies, and current solutions that are shaping the sector's growth.

More than 100 suppliers will present their advancements, complemented by live product demonstrations. Individuals can also pursue professional growth through sessions led by experts at the Advanced Manufacturing Forum's Conference Theatre and look into career paths at the dedicated Careers Corner.

The gathering creates an environment where professionals can meet industry leaders and learn about new solutions, fostering connections within the community.

events.name: AIforce World Tour Amsterdam 2026
events.description:
Unlock the power of Enterprise AI at AIforce World Tour Amsterdam 2026, a pivotal event designed for organizations navigating the complexities of artificial intelligence. Salesforce hosts this full-day event at RAI Amsterdam on 26 November 2026. There is no attendance fee, and the day focuses on practical strategies for integrating AI into business operations.

The main keynote, "Hey AI, meet the #1 CRM," will explore the Agentic Enterprise, a model where humans and AI work together for unparalleled customer success. Those attending will see live demonstrations of AIforce, Agentforce, Data 360, and Slack, illustrating how agentic AI functions in real-world production environments. Local organizations such as De Bijenkorf, The Ocean Cleanup, and Philips will share their experiences with AI implementations in their own operations.

Participants can engage in sessions led by experts, hands-on learning opportunities, and networking. The aim is to help develop clear, actionable AI strategies, while also addressing challenges related to return on investment and governance.

events.name: AI Innovation Asia 2026
events.description:
Unlock the true potential of artificial intelligence at AI Innovation Asia 2026, returning for its third annual edition on November 26th at the Grand Hyatt Singapore. This in-person summit is designed for C-suite and director-level executives who are shaping AI strategy within Asia's largest organizations. The central theme, "closing the AI value gap," focuses on moving beyond the initial excitement to achieve measurable business results and a lasting competitive advantage.

The event features insights from leaders such as Tom Standage of The Economist and Taiwan's Minister of Digital Affairs, Yi-Jing Lin. Discussions will cover topics like expanding successful AI projects, governing autonomous AI systems, and developing organizations that truly integrate AI into their core operations.

Through expert-led discussions and real-world case studies, participants will acquire practical approaches to using their own data, sovereign AI solutions, and advanced infrastructure effectively. It provides a setting for an international network of peers to discuss and influence the future of AI-driven transformation.

events.name: Nordic Banking Forum 2026
events.description:
Prepare to redefine the future of finance at the Nordic Banking Forum 2026, taking place on November 25-26 in Helsinki, Finland. Fintech Farm and Digital Banking Academy are organizing this forum, which will bring together over 500 decision-makers from the Nordic and Baltic banking sectors. Focusing on the theme 'Who Writes the rules. nordic banking rewritten.', the discussions will explore the intersection of strategy, technology, and regulation.

The two days begin with a pre-conference Strategy Talk Day on November 25, offering sessions led by experts and roundtables by invitation. The main conference on November 26 will feature discussions on strategic leadership, keynotes from global banking leaders, and an exhibition area with over 20 exhibitors presenting new developments.

Attendees can expect opportunities for over 2000 facilitated meetings and networking, including an After Work Mingle and Helsinki karaoke. The forum is designed for bank executives, regulators, and fintech professionals who are influencing the industry's future.

events.name: Les Journées de l'AFTE 2026
events.description:
Les Journées de l'AFTE 2026 marks a significant milestone, coinciding with the Association Française des Trésoriers d'Entreprise's 50th anniversary. This year's event brings together finance professionals focused on treasury management, financing, and financial risks. Participants will explore current industry advancements, with particular attention given to how Artificial Intelligence is reshaping treasury operations. The program includes discussions on AI-driven automation, intelligent assistance for treasurers, and practical applications.

This special edition offers an opportunity to expand professional networks and hear from experts. It also serves as an occasion to acknowledge AFTE's fifty years of leadership. The discussions aim to help participants consider the future of corporate treasury and navigate the evolving financial landscape.

events.name: CIO/CISO DACH Summit 2026
events.description:
The CIO/CISO DACH Summit 2026, taking place in Munich, Germany, on Thursday, 26 November, is an essential gathering for senior technology and security leaders.

This one-day event focuses on the theme "Accelerating Impact: Shaping the Future of Technology and Security." It offers CIOs and CISOs from across the DACH region a forum for meaningful connections and shared insights among peers. Participants will engage in strategic discussions covering critical challenges, including delivering enterprise value from AI, orchestrating complex multi-cloud ecosystems, and defending against sophisticated cyberattacks.

The agenda is designed to offer practical perspectives and explore emerging technologies that can strengthen an organization's resilience and drive its evolution. The format encourages collaborative problem-solving and direct interaction with key solution providers, aiming to equip leaders with the understanding and relationships needed to navigate complex landscapes and prepare their organizations for the future.

events.name: CDO/CAIO DACH Summit 2026
events.description:
"Future Forward: Charting the Course for Data and AI Excellence" sets the stage for the CDO/CAIO DACH Summit 2026, a pivotal one-day event on Thursday, 26 November in Munich, Germany.

This summit is designed for Chief Data Officers, Chief AI Officers, and other senior leaders in data and AI. It moves beyond traditional presentations, introducing formats such as "The Great Debate," "Strategy Sprints," and "Leadership Labs." These sessions are crafted to encourage genuine discussions and practical problem-solving among peers.

Attendees will acquire practical insights and leadership approaches to navigate critical industry challenges, ranging from data privacy concerns to aligning AI strategies. The smaller group size facilitates meaningful peer-to-peer connections, allowing leaders to share experiences and develop strategies for advancing their organizations in data and AI.

events.name: Service Desk & Service Management World 2026
events.description:
Prepare to explore the evolving landscape of Enterprise Service Management at Service Desk & Service Management World 2026. The event, taking place November 26-27 in Düsseldorf, Germany, and online, will explore the theme: "Automate everything? The new balance in Enterprise Service Management."

Participants will examine the fast-changing world of IT and business, considering how AI and automation can be strategically integrated without losing the vital human element. The program offers practical insights into end-to-end digitalization, enhancing customer experience, and fortifying Service Desk security against new threats. Discussions with leading experts and peers will help define the future roles of AI agents and guide teams through this dynamic shift.

The content is particularly relevant for IT and Service Desk leaders who are shaping modern service delivery.

events.name: 121 Mining Investment Dubai 2026
events.description:
Connecting capital with opportunity, 121 Mining Investment Dubai 2026 is set to convene on 26-27 November in the heart of Dubai, UAE. This two-day summit is structured to host over 1000 pre-arranged, private 1-2-1 meetings, bringing together more than 60 senior mining executives with over 210 qualified investors.

Participants, including institutional funds, private equity groups, and family offices, will explore investment opportunities. The focus areas include critical minerals essential for the energy transition, alongside battery, critical, and precious metals. A conference program will feature over 25 expert speakers, offering market intelligence and economic outlooks.

Dubai's strategic location provides access to a diverse group of Middle Eastern, African, and international investors. The event is intended for professionals in mining investment.

events.name: Celebration of Investment Awards 2026

location.venue: The Hyatt Regency London - The Churchil

events.description:
Marking its 31st year, the Celebration of Investment Awards 2026 will spotlight excellence within the UK private investment sector. On November 26, 2026, professionals from across the industry will gather at The Hyatt Regency London - The Churchill. The evening is dedicated to acknowledging those who have made significant contributions.

These awards, organized by FT Live and Investors' Chronicle, recognize companies, funds, platforms, and brokers that empower UK private investors to succeed. The focus is on organizations demonstrating strong performance, a commitment to ethical practices, and exceptional customer service.

UK companies can be considered for these awards through both public votes and self-submissions. This annual event serves as a reflection of the innovation and dedication that shapes the investment landscape, ultimately fostering trust and success for investors nationwide.

events.name: The North West Expo 2026
events.description:
A pivotal date for the North West business community, The North West Expo 2026 is set to ignite growth and collaboration on 1st December at Manchester's iconic Etihad Stadium.

This event is designed for small business owners, entrepreneurs, and ambitious SMEs aiming to grow. With over 1,000 businesses and more than 120 exhibitors, participants can build valuable relationships, find new opportunities, and explore the latest products and services.

The day includes presentations from keynote speakers such as Stewart Messruther, who will discuss entrepreneurial resilience, and Andrew Horkan, addressing critical cyber risks. Practical workshops will also be available, covering topics like direct marketing and effective LinkedIn strategies for lead generation. Attendees can explore new ideas and enhance their business presence within a professional setting focused on development.

events.name: Scientific Conference Methodology & Archaeometry 2026

location.venue: Faculty of humanities and social sciences

events.description:
The 14th iteration of the MetArh Conference, Scientific Conference Methodology & Archaeometry 2026, invites archaeologists and interdisciplinary researchers to Zagreb, Croatia, on November 26th-27th. Hosted in-person at the University of Zagreb's Faculty of Humanities and Social Sciences, the event provides a valuable opportunity to engage in critical thinking, share new insights, and explore innovative theoretical frameworks within contemporary archaeological science.

The program is structured around two main sections: Methodology and Archaeometry. The Methodology discussions will address recent trends in data collection and interpretation, the potential of AI in archaeology, experimental practices, and new technologies in underwater archaeology. The Archaeometry section will cover integrating excavation strategies with scientific analysis, multi-proxy studies, and advanced statistical methods.

Students are encouraged to present their research, and a sponsored prize will be awarded for the best contribution. The conference aims to facilitate the exchange of ideas and foster advancements in the field.

events.name: Ideal Home Show Christmas 2026
events.description:
The festive season officially begins at the Ideal Home Show Christmas 2026, transforming Olympia, London, into a winter wonderland from 26 to 29 November. Visitors will discover a wide range of Christmas shopping opportunities, a variety of seasonal food, and ideas for home décor.

This year introduces several new features, including Santa's Grotto for families and hands-on Festive Workshops where attendees can learn wreath making or cocktail crafting. More than 400 brands will be present across areas such as the Entertainment Hub and Personalisation Pavilion. Guests can experience the Festive Food Hall, watch live demonstrations on the Festive Food Stage, or unwind with live music at Santa's Speakeasy.

The event also offers expert advice, and the Eat & Drink Festival will be running at the same time. It provides an opportunity to gather ideas and items for Christmas preparations.

events.name: Women In Tech Excellence Awards 2026
events.description:
On November 26, 2026, the Women In Tech Excellence Awards 2026 will culminate in a grand celebration of the trailblazing women shaping the technology landscape. The awards, organized by Computing, highlight significant contributions across various technical IT fields, including AI, cybersecurity, cloud computing, and climate-focused projects. The aim is to inspire future diverse talent and help address the gender imbalance within the industry.

This year introduces a new 'Advocate/Educator of the Year' award. It acknowledges individuals, regardless of gender, who actively champion greater female representation in technology. The shortlist has already been announced, building anticipation for an evening dedicated to recognizing those who drive innovation and cultivate a more inclusive future for technology.

events.name: Green Building Congress 2026
events.description:
The global movement towards sustainable built environments converges at the Green Building Congress 2026, set for November 26–28 at the Jio World Convention Centre in Mumbai, India. This three-day gathering is recognized as a leading event in Asia and globally, focused on Green and Net Zero Built Environments, aiming to advance net zero practices in buildings.

Attendees can explore solutions covering key areas: Net Zero Buildings, Materials & Circularity, Cooling & HVAC, Energy Efficiency, and Smart Buildings. The conference includes sessions led by experts, discussing policy and real-world case studies, alongside an expo presenting innovations in interiors, exteriors, and building technology.

It offers opportunities to connect with leaders, policymakers, and pioneers from the industry, and learn about future-focused strategies. Associated events, such as the IGBC Green Design Competition, also aim to inspire sustainable innovation. This makes it a significant gathering for those involved in the built environment sector.

events.name: Transporter Tage Berlin 2026
events.description:
Explore the cutting edge of transport and individual mobility at Transporter Tage Berlin 2026, taking place from November 26-29 at Messegelände Berlin. This four-day event, a significant part of Europe's largest Mobility Fair, delves into modern transporters, innovative vehicle conversions, and specialized mobility solutions.

Across 110,000 m² and 19 halls, visitors can examine the latest commercial vehicles, creative campervan designs, and essential accessories. It serves as a gathering point for vehicle manufacturers, converters, craft businesses, and those with a keen interest in mobility. Whether someone is looking for professional work vehicles, adaptable solutions, or ideas for custom campervans, Transporter Tage offers insights into these areas.

A single admission provides entry to all co-located fairs, including Auto Camping Caravan and BOOT & FUN. This arrangement creates a broad experience, typically drawing around 80,000 visitors.

events.name: Auto Camping Caravan 2026
events.description:
Explore the future of mobile travel at Auto Camping Caravan 2026, from November 26th to 29th at Messegelände Berlin. This four-day event runs daily from 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM. It is a significant gathering, drawing an estimated 80,000 visitors across 19 halls, where the latest developments in motorhomes, caravans, camper conversions, and essential camping accessories will be on display.

Attendees will find a wide array of new products and current trends, presented by manufacturers and industry experts. Auto Camping Caravan 2026 is a key component of the "Mobilitätsmesse," recognized as Europe's largest mobility fair. A single admission ticket provides entry to all events happening concurrently, including BOOT & FUN.

Whether someone is an industry professional or simply passionate about mobile travel, the event provides a comprehensive look at the world of caravaning. It's a chance to see what's new and to engage with others who share an interest in this lifestyle.

events.name: BioCultura Madrid 2026
events.description:
The 42nd edition of BioCultura Madrid, taking place from November 26 to 29, 2026, at Feria de Madrid-Ifema, invites you to immerse yourself in the world of ecological products and responsible consumption.

This gathering anticipates welcoming over 55,000 visitors and will host 400 exhibitors, presenting developments in sustainable living. The exhibition covers diverse areas, from ecological food and certified eco-natural cosmetics to healthy home solutions, sustainable fashion, and holistic wellness.

Beyond the exhibition, over 300 parallel activities are planned, featuring speakers and a full program. These sessions offer opportunities to explore innovative trends and gain insights into sustainable living. BioCultura Madrid 2026 serves as a significant event for both professionals and consumers interested in contributing to a healthier planet.

events.name: The Cake & Bake Show 2026
events.description:
Baking enthusiasts and sweet-toothed visitors, mark your calendars! The Cake & Bake Show 2026 returns to Olympia, London, from November 26-29 for four days dedicated to the art of baking. This year introduces new experiences for hobby bakers, cake decorators, and families.

Attendees can observe live demonstrations at The Home Bake Kitchen, where well-known bakers and creators will share their techniques and recipes. There will be opportunities for practical learning in expert-led workshops, covering skills from detailed piping to chocolate work. The event also features the live final of "Home Baker of The Year," a challenge called "Cake Or Fake," and a creative space at the "Sprinkles Library."

Visitors will find a wide selection of exhibitors showcasing new products, ingredients, and artisan treats. The show offers a chance to develop baking skills, gather new ideas, and enjoy the diverse world of baking.

events.name: Cairo WoodShow 2026
events.description:
Set to redefine industry standards, Cairo WoodShow 2026 will open its doors at the Cairo International Convention Centre from November 26-29. This four-day business-to-business exhibition brings together professionals from the Wood, Furniture, and Woodworking Machinery Industry throughout the MENA Region. Held alongside IFAC Cairo, it provides a central meeting point for manufacturers, importers, distributors, and specifiers focused on the North African, Gulf, and Indian markets.

Attendees can explore a wide range of products, including raw timber, engineered wood, machinery, tools, and finishes. The event will feature 337 exhibitors and 7 country pavilions, with an anticipated 13,595 visitors. This scale naturally fosters extensive networking and business discussions among participants.

The WoodShow Conference will offer perspectives on market outlooks and sustainable practices. Additionally, a Buyer Networking Reception is planned to facilitate connections among attendees.

events.name: Arab Cochlear Implant Conference 2026
events.description:
Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, will host the 4th Arab Cochlear Implant Conference from November 26–28, 2026, bringing together leading minds in ENT and Cochlear Implantation. The conference focuses on the progress of technology that significantly improves the lives of individuals with hearing impairments.

The scientific program offers a comprehensive look at the field, with sessions designed to deepen understanding and discuss new developments and complex requirements. Experts, including scientists, specialists, therapists, and academics, will gather from the Middle East and around the world. This gathering provides an opportunity for sharing insights and fostering professional development.

Participants will have the chance to learn about recent innovations, interact with international experts, and build connections with colleagues who are committed to improving hearing outcomes.

events.name: ICELL 2026
events.description:
Join educators, academics, and researchers at ICELL 2026, the 3rd International Conference on Education and Language Learning in a Post-COVID World. Scheduled for August 21-23, 2026, at the Airport Honolulu Hotel Conference Center in Honolulu, Hawaii, this conference continues an ongoing conversation about how education is changing.

The International Education for Sustainable Development Alliance (INTESDA) organizes this event, which is co-located with ICOHS2026. It offers an international, peer-reviewed space for discussion, where participants will explore innovative approaches and solutions for current challenges in teaching, learning, and assessment.

Key areas of focus include student engagement, ensuring access, and the evolving relationship between teachers and learners. The event aims to highlight resilience and innovation as education adapts to new models.

events.name: Worksafe Namur 2026
events.description:
On November 26, 2026, Namur Expo in Belgium will open its doors for Worksafe Namur 2026, the essential one-day event dedicated to health, safety, and well-being at work. This fifth edition is specifically for prevention advisors and ergonomists across Belgium, providing a space for professional growth and connecting with peers.

The program includes the well-regarded ARCoP Colloquium and a series of professional conferences, where participants can learn about the latest regulations and effective practices. Attendees will also see new solutions demonstrated live in the "Zones démos" and explore recent innovations during the Innovation Tour and Award ceremony.

With more than 80 expert exhibitors, Worksafe Namur offers a chance to meet with professionals, share knowledge, and build working relationships. This event is held in partnership with ARCoP, Febelsafe, and FOD Werk.

events.name: Greater New York Dental Meeting 2026
events.description:
Prepare to advance your dental practice and connect with peers at the Greater New York Dental Meeting 2026. Organized by the New York County and Second District Dental Societies, the event runs from November 27th to December 1st at the Jacob K. Javits Convention Center in New York City. The exhibit hall will be accessible from November 29th through December 1st.

Dental professionals from various backgrounds will gather to explore new developments in the field. Attendees can participate in a range of educational sessions that provide valuable CE credits, and engage in discussions and activities designed for professional connection. It's a chance to see the latest technologies, sharpen existing skills, and consider the evolving landscape of dentistry. The meeting provides a setting to deepen your knowledge and grow your professional relationships within New York.

events.name: Product Management Festival 2026
events.description:
The Product Management Festival 2026, an independent, community-driven event, invites over 300 dedicated product builders to Technopark, Zürich, on November 27th. Building on a decade of supporting the European product community, this year's festival offers a full day dedicated to honest conversations and practical insights. It is designed to be free of sales pitches, sponsor booths, or "inspiration theatre."

Participants will engage with three distinct, community-curated tracks. The first, "The Shift is Happening," explores the evolving responsibilities and dynamics within product management. A second track, "Show me the Skills," focuses on practical applications of AI and new tools for product builders. The final track, "Burst the Bubble," brings in unfiltered external perspectives from VCs, founders, and engineers, discussing the future of the Product Manager role. The day will feature practitioner-led case studies and demos, encouraging genuine learning and connection among attendees.

events.name: DevFest Paris 2026
events.description:
Prepare for an immersive day of technological exploration at DevFest Paris 2026, taking place on 27 Novembre 2026. La Fabrique de la Connaissance, a modern industrial space in Nanterre-Université, will host this independent, non-profit event. Its purpose is to offer a valuable experience for developers.

Around 450 participants are anticipated, ranging from students to experienced professionals. DevFest Paris will feature five distinct tracks. Attendees can explore current topics in Frontend, Backend, Cloud, Mobile, Data & AI, Sustainable Technologies, and architectural best practices. The program includes conferences, hands-on workshops, and quick talks.

This is an opportunity to learn from industry leaders, connect with peers, and build relationships within the tech community.

events.name: The DIGIs 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for The DIGIs 2026, Australia's premier digital economy awards, taking place on November 27th at the elegant Doltone House in Sydney. The Digital Economy Council of Australia (DECA) organizes this recognition, which highlights individuals, companies, and projects making significant strides in areas like digital finance, AI, blockchain, cybersecurity, and essential digital infrastructure.

The evening brings together industry leaders and professionals, focusing on recognizing excellence, fostering connections, and acknowledging those who are shaping Australia's technological future. The event concludes with an Award Ceremony and an Afterparty, providing opportunities for further interaction.

Nominations open on July 27, 2026, allowing the digital community to put forward contributions that have made a real impact. The awards aim to champion responsible growth and highlight real-world impact within Australia's evolving digital landscape.

events.name: Indonesia Maternity, Baby & Kids Expo 2026
events.description:
Families across Indonesia are invited to the Indonesia Maternity, Baby & Kids Expo 2026, taking place from November 27 to 29 at JICC GBK Senayan. The expo runs daily from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM, offering a central gathering point for discussions and discoveries related to parenting, motherhood, and children's growth.

Attendees can explore new developments in baby essentials and children's products, presented by various brands. There will be sessions led by experts, addressing topics such as selecting appropriate toys, children's skincare, and fostering healthy emotional connections. The event also includes family-friendly activities and stage performances.

This gathering is intended for parents, expectant mothers, and their children, providing opportunities to gain understanding and connect with others who share an interest in supporting healthy, happy family life.

events.name: Data + AI World Tour Tokyo 2026
events.description:
Discover how to build AI you can truly trust at the Data + AI World Tour Tokyo 2026, a pivotal one-day event hosted by Databricks. This in-person event takes place in Tokyo on November 27, 2026, and is offered at no cost. It is designed for business and technical leaders, data engineers, scientists, and developers. The day will explore methods for grounding AI models within enterprise data and business contexts, aiming for tangible results.

Participants can expect a program that includes general sessions, in-depth breakout discussions, and practical workshops, all centered around Databricks technologies. The agenda will highlight innovations such as Genie One for business analysis, Genie Agents for generating trusted insights, and Lakebase, a new OLTP database compatible with Postgres. Attendees will also explore strategies for deploying AI with control, governance, and flexibility at scale, which can help improve productivity, foster innovation, and refine customer experiences.

events.name: IPCC Tehran 2026
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the future of the Paint, Resin, Coatings, Composites, and Plating Industries at IPCC Tehran 2026.

The event runs from November 27-30, 2026, at the Tehran Permanent International Fairground. This 26th gathering occupies 40,000 square meters across several halls. Historically, it has attracted over 340 direct exhibitors and more than 2,000 companies from 21 countries, alongside a consistently expanding number of visitors.

This year, a particular focus will be placed on startups and innovation. Innovation conferences are planned to present emerging technologies, new ideas, and future trends, providing perspectives on how the market is evolving. Those attending will find avenues for B2B meetings, networking, and exploring recent advancements that are influencing the sector. Banian Omid Co. organizes IPCC Tehran 2026.

events.name: Mumbai Cloud & Datacenter Convention & Awards 2026
events.description:
The future of digital infrastructure takes center stage in Mumbai at the highly anticipated Cloud & Datacenter Convention & Awards 2026. This gathering brings together leaders, innovators, and decision-makers from the industry. It's an opportunity to examine the latest advancements, strategies, and challenges that are currently shaping the cloud and datacenter landscape.

Participants will find in-depth explorations of cutting-edge technologies, alongside discussions covering hybrid cloud, AI integration, sustainability, and robust security solutions. In addition to these focused sessions, an awards ceremony will acknowledge significant achievements and contributions within the sector.

While the specific venue details are still being finalized, the event offers a chance to connect with peers and contribute to the ongoing evolution of enterprise technology. The focus remains on fostering connections and understanding the direction of the industry in 2026.

events.name: Studie Keuze Beurs 2026
events.description:
Embark on your 'Expeditie Studiekeuze' at Studiekeuzebeurs Midden 2026, your essential guide to educational and career paths. The event takes place on November 27-28, 2026, at Jaarbeurs Utrecht, offering valuable perspectives for students, parents, and mentors.

Attendees can explore offerings from over 150 educational institutions and companies, participate in more than 100 presentations and workshops, and receive personalized one-on-one study choice coaching. A single admission provides entry to co-located events: De BuitenlandBeurs and the Master Fair, which present opportunities for international studies and advanced degrees.

The fair covers programs at all levels, from vocational training to university degrees, and includes options for gap years. Visitors can speak directly with counselors. Specific areas like the 'Ambacht in Beeld Opleidingenplein' offer practical experiences, and 'Sterke Punten Workshops' are available to help individuals identify their strengths.

events.name: DreamHack Stockholm 2026
events.description:
Get ready for an electrifying three-day celebration of gaming culture as DreamHack Stockholm 2026 takes over Stockholmsmässan from November 27-29. The festival brings together digital experiences and competitive gaming, offering something for every enthusiast.

Attendees can observe world-class esports, including the SNK World Championship 2026 with its $4.2 million prize pool, and experience the energy of The Finals – The Grand Major 2026. Opportunities exist to engage with creators at the dedicated Creator Hub, explore new titles in the Indie Playground, or participate in Cosplay Competitions.

Further activities include the interactive, Cyberpunk-inspired DreamHack Quest, PC Freeplay, and the chance to discover unique art in the Artist Alley. The event also features over 100 exhibitors and a lively TCG & Tabletop zone, providing a comprehensive experience for gamers, fans, and creators.

events.name: Australian Crypto Convention 2026
events.description:
Prepare for the Southern Hemisphere's premier crypto gathering! The Australian Crypto Convention 2026 will be held at Sydney's International Convention Centre from November 28-29. This gathering expects to bring together over 10,000 attendees, 1,000 companies, and more than 150 global industry leaders across five stages. It offers a significant opportunity for investors, innovators, and enthusiasts interested in connecting, exploring new developments, and collaborating.

Those attending can expect to explore the latest insights, interact with representatives from over 120 sponsors, and observe the Whale Lab Competition, which offers a chance to secure $1 Million in venture capital funding. The convention concludes with an after-party on a super yacht on Sydney Harbour, providing food, drinks, and entertainment. The aim is to support education, innovation, and meaningful connections that contribute to the future of blockchain technology.

events.name: Essen Motor Show 2026
events.description:
The ultimate celebration of automotive passion returns to Essen, Germany, from November 28 to December 6, 2026, with an exclusive Preview Day on November 27.

This year, the event will fill its halls, bringing together various facets of the automotive world. Visitors will find themselves among displays dedicated to performance and racing, modern tuning and lifestyle trends, motorsport, and classic cars.

Attendees will encounter a new Show Area and a specific Sales mile for accessories within the Galeria. Hall 1A will host a new Car Market. With around 500 exhibitors, the event will showcase recent innovations, alongside the return of the tuningXperience. The displays will cover everything from specialized components to distinctive custom vehicles, offering a comprehensive look at the automotive landscape.

events.name: NZ Tattoo & Art Festival 2026
events.description:
Prepare for an immersive celebration of skin art and creativity at the NZ Tattoo & Art Festival 2026, taking place on November 28th and 29th at TSB Stadium in New Plymouth, New Zealand.

The festival gathers more than 250 accomplished tattoo artists from around the world. Visitors will have the opportunity to observe artists at work and can also arrange to get tattooed, with options for both advance bookings and on-the-day appointments.

Beyond the tattooing, the weekend includes three FMX & BMX shows each day, alongside tattoo competitions and live performances, featuring artists like Kozo Kaos. Attendees can browse a selection of retail vendors and enjoy food from various trucks. The event offers a full weekend for those interested in tattoo culture and art, as well as for general visitors. Children aged 14 and under receive free entry when accompanied by a paying adult.

events.name: Effing‑Con 2026
events.description:
Prepare for a day packed with fandom and fun as Effing-Con 2026 descends upon the Thelma Keller Convention Center in Effingham, Illinois, on November 28, 2026. From 9 AM to 7 PM, this pop culture convention offers a full day dedicated to exploring imagination and shared interests.

Visitors will have the opportunity to express their creativity in the cosplay showcase, meet celebrity guests, and explore offerings from various vendors. Whether someone is a long-time attendee or new to conventions, Effing-Con provides an opportunity to connect with fellow fans and celebrate pop culture.

events.name: RSNA Scientific Assembly and Annual Meeting 2026
events.description:
The global radiology community is set to converge at the RSNA Scientific Assembly and Annual Meeting 2026, held from November 29 to December 3 at McCormick Place in Chicago, Illinois. This annual meeting serves as a central point for sharing new research, offering advanced education, and introducing the latest developments in medical imaging.

Participants can explore a wide range of scientific sessions, covering all areas of radiology. They will also connect with leading experts and learn about significant progress that is influencing the future of patient care and diagnostic imaging. The technical exhibits, which conclude on December 2, will display new technologies and practical solutions.

The gathering provides a setting for professionals from around the world to learn, network, and collaborate on the latest in radiological science.

events.name: UKISUG Connect 2026
events.description:
The UK & Ireland's largest annual gathering for SAP professionals, UKISUG Connect 2026, is set to unfold at the ICC Birmingham from November 29 to December 1. This three-day event brings together over 1,000 SAP customers, experts, and partners, offering an opportunity to explore the latest developments within the SAP ecosystem.

The agenda includes 120 sessions, providing over 90 hours of learning. These range from keynotes and practical breakout sessions to technical workshops. The content aims to help attendees build their understanding and enhance their skills.

In the exhibition hall, over 90 SAP partners will be present. This space allows attendees to connect with peers, discover new solutions, and keep pace with changes in the SAP landscape.

events.name: MRS Fall Meeting & Exhibit 2026
events.description:
Discover the future of materials research at the MRS Fall Meeting & Exhibit 2026, set to ignite innovation in Boston, Massachusetts, from November 29 to December 4.

The event will take place at the Hynes Convention Center and Sheraton Boston Hotel. It brings together the worldwide materials research community, from students to experienced professionals. The program will delve into current progress across various fields, including quantum materials, energy, and sustainability. It also covers fundamental research areas such as materials design, synthesis, and characterization.

Attendees can expect significant presentations, interactive exhibits, and engaging discussions. A key aim of this meeting is to encourage global collaborations and spark new ideas, providing valuable chances to connect with prominent researchers, present your own work, and learn about the technologies that are influencing the future.

events.name: SAMS USA 2026
events.description:
The Marriott Marquis Chicago will host SAMS USA 2026, co-located with IT Procurement USA 2026, from November 29 to December 02. This event brings together over 258 professionals, including SAM, Software License, and IT Vendor Managers from more than 143 companies, for a 2.5-day program.

The program features a range of learning opportunities, including over 62 expert-led sessions, more than 34 industry case studies, and over 28 interactive workshops. Discussions will center on key areas such as increasing transparency, reducing software costs, mastering cloud services, and leveraging AI for license tracking and compliance.

Attendees often come looking for new approaches and solutions. The event provides a setting for connecting with peers and engaging in detailed conversations aimed at advancing SAM practices and optimizing software spending. A single ticket grants access to both conferences, allowing for a comprehensive understanding of both vendor management and IT procurement strategies.

events.name: JobNimbus Solution Summit 2026
events.description:
Elevate your contracting business to new heights at the JobNimbus Solution Summit 2026, an exclusive all-inclusive experience from November 29 to December 2 at the Hard Rock Los Cabos in Cabo San Lucas.

This event is for business owners, office managers, and project leaders. It provides an opportunity to deepen your understanding of JobNimbus systems and workflows, with the aim of helping participants apply these tools more effectively within their operations.

Attendees can expect sessions, hands-on training, and opportunities to exchange strategies with peers. There will be direct access to JobNimbus product leaders and personalized Jenius Bar coaching to help refine automations and workflows. Participants will also learn about future roadmap developments and receive practical training on upcoming tools, allowing them to implement immediate improvements that can lead to more efficient operations, quicker response times, and better cash flow management.

events.name: Travel South International Showcase 2026
events.description:
Designed as a boutique-style conference exclusively for the travel trade, the Travel South International Showcase 2026 invites international buyers, suppliers, and U.S. receptive operators to Nashville, Tennessee, from November 29 to December 3. Over four days, the event provides an opportunity to cultivate business connections and explore the diverse offerings of the Southern USA.

Attendees can expect a structured marketplace with scheduled appointments, alongside various opportunities for networking. The program also includes city tours and specialized Super Fam Tours, allowing participants to experience the region firsthand.

With support from partners like Visit the USA and Delta Air Lines, the Showcase aims to facilitate new collaborations and support the growth of travel businesses. Registration is scheduled to open in May 2026.

events.name: Interpom 2026
events.description:
Interpom 2026, the leading international trade fair for the entire potato sector, returns to Kortrijk Xpo, Belgium, from November 29 to December 1, 2026.

Organized by Belgapom, the fair serves as a key meeting point for professionals involved in potato cultivation, trade, and processing. Visitors can expect to see a wide range of exhibitors presenting new innovations and products throughout Halls 1-6 and the Rambla. A dedicated Innovation Tour will also be available, designed to showcase emerging trends and solutions within the sector. The event provides a valuable setting for industry leaders and experts to connect and exchange ideas.

Those interested in attending can gain valuable insights into the industry. Details regarding ticket sales will be released starting July 15, 2026.

events.name: AWS Re:Invent 2026
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the future of cloud computing at AWS Re:Invent 2026, taking place in Las Vegas, NV, from November 30 to December 4.

This week-long gathering brings together people from the global cloud community, whether they are just starting out or have years of experience. Attendees can expect significant keynote announcements and participate in over 1,000 technical sessions. These sessions cover essential subjects, from cloud migration strategies to the newest developments in generative AI.

Beyond learning from experts and getting hands-on experience with AWS services, Re:Invent provides chances to connect with others. This includes social events like the re:Play party. It's an environment where individuals can advance their understanding of cloud technology, develop new skills, and meet others who are working on innovative solutions.

events.name: Tech For Retail 2026
events.description:
The forefront of retail innovation converges in Paris for Tech For Retail 2026. Taking place from November 30 to December 1 at Paris Expo, Porte de Versailles, this European event explores the technological advancements shaping retail. It provides insights into digital tools and eco-responsible innovations that affect all aspects of retail operations, from optimizing the supply chain to building customer loyalty.

Attendees can discover solutions in areas like IT, e-commerce, AI, and payment methods, connecting with over 420 exhibitors and 75 startups. The two-day event will host over 200 conferences and present awards recognizing significant advancements, such as the Innovation, Startup, Gen AI, and Customer Experience Awards.

Over 15,000 industry professionals are expected to attend, exploring the strategies and technologies that are shaping the future of retail.

events.name: ILTM Cannes 2026
events.description:
The global luxury travel industry converges at ILTM Cannes 2026, taking place from 30 November to 3 December at the iconic Palais des Festivals et des Congrès in Cannes, France. This gathering serves as a central point for discussing and influencing the direction of high-end travel, bringing together influential figures, leading brands, and carefully selected buyers who shape extraordinary experiences for discerning travelers.

During these four days, attendees will participate in pre-scheduled meetings, educational sessions, and opportunities for professional connection. The event provides a setting to explore new developments in luxury cruising, hospitality, and unique destination experiences. It is a place where business discussions occur, professional relationships are established, and new concepts for personalized travel emerge.

events.name: I/ITSEC 2026
events.description:
The global hub for innovation in simulation, training, and education convenes at I/ITSEC 2026, from November 30 to December 3 in Orlando, FL. The event's theme, "Beyond the Battlefield: Training Readiness and Lethality for All-Domain Dominance!", guides discussions and exhibits, highlighting progress in STEM, Modeling and Simulation, and Medical Simulation.

Those attending will find opportunities to explore new developments and connect with a diverse community of experts, ranging from international leaders to new professionals in the field. Specific features include the Congressional M&S Caucus, the Serious Games Showcase & Challenge, and the Discovery Den.

Professional development workshops, in-depth tutorials, and a dedicated career fair are available, all designed to support individual growth and foster collaboration. The event is sponsored by NTSA and partnered with NDIA.

events.name: GenerationAI Paris 2026
events.description:
Paris, Europe's vibrant AI capital, is set to host GenerationAI Paris 2026 from December 1-3 at CNIT Forest. This three-day event brings together over 4,000 developers, product leads, founders, and innovators focused on advancing their understanding of Generative AI and Agent Experience.

Over 150 experts will lead more than 40 sessions, where participants can explore technical details, product development choices, and practical approaches for implementing GenAI on a large scale. The discussions will move past theoretical concepts to examine actual systems, architectural advice, and business strategies that are transforming various sectors.

Attendees will have opportunities to connect with colleagues, gain insights into future directions, and identify the necessary tools to foster innovation and make a difference in the quickly changing AI field.

events.name: Saudi Intermobility Expo 2026
events.description:
Charting the course for a smarter, safer future, the Saudi Intermobility Expo 2026 convenes in Riyadh, bringing together over 7,000 industry leaders and professionals. This gathering focuses on progress within Saudi Arabia's road, mobility, and transport sectors, supporting the goals of Saudi Vision 2030.

Individuals attending will have the opportunity to see the latest advancements from more than 200 companies, covering areas like intelligent transport systems, smart parking, and road safety. A key component is the World Future Roads Forum, which is open to all attendees and will offer important discussions on emerging trends and strategic developments.

The expo provides opportunities for interaction with government officials and technology providers, facilitating new partnerships. Attendees can also obtain a CPD certificate, contributing to the future direction of intermobility in Saudi Arabia.

events.name: ANZMAC 2026
events.description:
Tāmaki Makaurau, Auckland, Aotearoa, New Zealand, will be the vibrant setting for ANZMAC 2026, running from November 27 to December 2. This conference gathers academics, researchers, and professionals to critically examine "Marketing in the Age of Plenty?" Participants will explore the profound impact of AI, robotics, and information abundance on the discipline, considering how marketing orchestrates and contextualizes these technological shifts.

The event schedule includes a dedicated Doctoral Colloquium at Massey University, the main conference proceedings at the Cordis Hotel, and a Gala Dinner. It offers a valuable forum for presenting current research, engaging in insightful discussions, and fostering professional collaborations. The conversations aim to contribute to understanding shared prosperity, trustworthiness, and sustainability within the evolving marketing landscape.

events.name: UPCEA MEMS! 2026
events.description:
Higher education professionals seeking to elevate their strategies in marketing, enrollment management, and student success should mark their calendars for the UPCEA MEMS! 2026 conference. This event will take place from November 30 to December 2, 2026, at Disney's Coronado Springs Resort in Orlando, FL.

The conference brings together new and mid-level professionals alongside high-level leaders. It offers a chance to connect with colleagues, share experiences, and explore current practices. Participants can expect to gain practical knowledge and develop skills important for today's higher education environment.

Focusing on professional development and career growth, MEMS! 2026 provides a setting to discover new approaches that can help institutions thrive. UPCEA members also receive special registration rates.

events.name: ERTC 2026
events.description:
The European Refining Technology Conference (ERTC) returns for its landmark 30th edition in Madrid, Spain, from November 30 to December 3, 2026. This four-day event brings together over 1,200 senior executives, technologists, and regulators, including more than 400 refiners, to address the central theme of "FUTURE-PROOFING REFINING'S ROLE IN THE ENERGY MIX."

Participants will hear from over 100 expert speakers, exploring practical solutions for decarbonisation, innovation, and digitalisation within the downstream refining and petrochemical sectors. The agenda also includes discussions on geopolitical shifts and policy changes, with an emphasis on fostering collaboration to help secure the industry's future.

The conference will also include the ERTC Awards, recognizing outstanding achievements and leadership within the sector. Senior figures from companies such as TotalEnergies, Shell, and ExxonMobil are expected to attend, contributing to conversations that will help define the future of energy.

events.name: Health-ISAC Fall Americas Summit 2026
events.description:
Prepare to fortify the global health sector's resilience at the Health-ISAC Fall Americas Summit 2026, taking place from November 30 to December 04 in Tucson, AZ.

Over five days, this event brings together Health-ISAC members, non-members, and sponsors. Their shared purpose is to enhance cybersecurity and facilitate critical information exchange within healthcare. The program features Grand Round Sessions, interactive roundtable discussions, focused working groups, and practical workshops, with some content available exclusively to members.

Beyond the formal sessions, attendees will find opportunities to connect with peers during a welcome reception, evening events, and dedicated networking breaks. This setting encourages collaboration on strategies and provides practical insights to help protect and strengthen the global health sector against the threats it faces. An optional tour is planned for Friday.

events.name: Car.HMI USA 2026
events.description:
Set to redefine the automotive user experience, Car.HMI USA 2026 invites you to explore the forefront of intuitive vehicles and next-generation HMI. From November 30 to December 02, 2026, at The Henry in Detroit, this 2.5-day event will bring together more than 350 industry experts and decision-makers from leading OEMs, suppliers, and software companies.

The program includes over 111 sessions led by experts, featuring case studies, interactive workshops, and panels. These discussions will explore key topics such as AI-driven UX, immersive technologies, autonomous driving HMI, and human factors. Additionally, over 141 scheduled one-on-one meetings offer a chance to evaluate new services, technologies, and products.

A single registration also provides entry to the co-located InCabin.Sensing USA and Tech.AD USA 2026, offering a broader view of the smart mobility ecosystem.

events.name: Hacking APIS Conference Paris 2026
events.description:
Uncover the critical frontier of digital defense at the Hacking APIS Conference Paris 2026, held from 1-3 December at CNIT Forest. The conference focuses on the practical aspects of API security, addressing where vulnerabilities typically arise. It explores how this impacts innovation in areas like mobility, energy, public services, and artificial intelligence.

Participants will observe live demonstrations of exploits and engage in hands-on labs to test various tools. There will be opportunities to learn from candid accounts of past security incidents. The content is structured to provide hackers, defenders, security teams, and engineers with practical tactics and frameworks they can apply right away.

The gathering brings together over 500 professionals from more than 300 companies, including experts from organizations like GitHub and Google Cloud. This environment fosters discussions and shared efforts aimed at enhancing the overall API security landscape.

events.name: InCabin.Sensing USA 2026
events.description:
Set to redefine the automotive interior experience, InCabin.Sensing USA 2026 convenes from November 30 to December 02, 2026, at The Henry in Detroit. This 2.5-day program focuses on advancements in in-cabin monitoring and intelligent interior systems. It takes place alongside CAR.HMI USA and Tech.AD USA, with a single ticket providing access to all three events.

The gathering brings together executives, technical leaders, and advanced engineers from prominent American automotive companies. Discussions will explore important subjects such as Driver Monitoring Systems, emotion detection, gesture control, and data privacy. Attendees can expect a program featuring over 111 expert-led sessions, more than 61 industry case studies, and upwards of 50 interactive workshops.

This environment offers an opportunity to connect with over 584 individuals representing more than 391 companies. Participants will have the chance to evaluate new technologies and contribute to shaping the future of vehicle interiors, with a focus on human-centric design.

events.name: USTOA Annual Conference & Marketplace 2026
events.description:
Experience unparalleled access and business opportunities at the USTOA Annual Conference & Marketplace 2026. From November 30 to December 4, 2026, the San Francisco Marriott Marquis will welcome around 800 travel professionals for this member-only gathering.

Active Members will have the chance to discover new destinations and services. Meanwhile, Associate Members can connect directly with leading tour operator executives during one-on-one sessions designed for buying and selling. The program also includes speaker sessions, expert panels, and case studies, providing perspectives on global travel trends and the North American market.

The event encourages extensive networking in a business casual setting. Attendees will find opportunities to connect directly with industry decision-makers, which can lead to important partnerships and help expand their global reach.

events.name: Tech.AD USA 2026
events.description:
Dive into the future of autonomous driving at Tech.AD USA 2026, from November 30 to December 02, 2026, in Detroit and Dearborn, Michigan. This 2.5-day program brings together nearly 600 professionals, including OEMs and T1s, who are working to advance L2+ autonomous technologies.

Attendees will find over 110 expert-led sessions, more than 60 industry case studies, and over 50 interactive workshops. These discussions will cover key areas such as ADAS, testing and validation, sensor fusion, and AI for perception.

The event places a strong emphasis on networking, with over 140 facilitated one-on-one meetings designed for participants to discuss new services and build professional relationships. Attendance also includes access to the co-located InCabin.Sensing USA 2026 and CAR.HMI USA 2026, which broadens the perspective on the AD, UX, and In-Vehicle ecosystem.

events.name: Fierce Health Payer Summit 2026
events.description:
Navigating the dynamic health payer landscape requires foresight and innovation. The Fierce Health Payer Summit 2026, presented by the editors of Fierce Healthcare, will examine how to transform challenges into opportunities. Discussions will focus on key topics such as member engagement, digital transformation, prior authorization reform, population health, and behavioral health.

The event anticipates over 300 industry leaders, with 76% at Director level and above, and 66% representing payers and providers. The program features over 15 in-depth sessions, including insights from keynote speaker Katherine Hempstead of the Robert Wood Johnson Foundation.

A Health Payer Connect program is available to facilitate curated one-on-one meetings with solution providers. The event takes place at the Gaylord Opryland Resort, offering attendees a setting to acquire practical strategies and form partnerships that contribute to innovation in healthcare.

events.name: Continuous Delivery & Automation 2026
events.description:
Unlock the future of software delivery at Continuous Delivery & Automation 2026, taking place from November 30 to December 01, 2026, at Berlin's exclusive Maritim proArte Hotel.

The event is co-located with the Enterprise DevOps Summit. Over two days, it brings together more than 400 software developers, DevOps experts, and decision-makers from the German-speaking region. Discussions will cover key areas such as AI-native applications, pipeline-native AI automation, modernizing legacy systems, and platform thinking for CI/CD.

Attendees will have opportunities to connect with industry leaders and peers. The program includes tailored one-on-one discussions, networking dinners, and interactive world cafés, supported by AI-powered meeting management. The aim is for participants to explore new ideas, find solutions, and advance their organization's automation strategies.

events.name: AI Dev NYC 2026
events.description:
For AI engineers and builders seeking to truly advance their craft, AI Dev NYC 2026 offers an unparalleled opportunity. DeepLearning.AI is organizing this two-day technical conference, with Andrew Ng among the contributors. It will be held from November 30 to December 1, 2026, at Chelsea Piers in New York City. The conference is intended for 2,500 working engineers and practitioners, focusing on practical application rather than product pitches.

Participants will engage with over 50 hands-on labs, talks, and workshops spread across four stages. This setup allows for direct learning from practitioners who will share insights from their actual work. The aim is for attendees to acquire skills applicable across various technology stacks and to leave with something concrete they've built.

Registration covers access to the full program, workshops, networking opportunities, and an afterparty. This offers a complete experience for individuals focused on serious AI development.

events.name: North American Gas Forum 2026
events.description:
From November 30 to December 2, 2026, Washington D.C. will host the North American Gas Forum 2026, a pivotal event for shaping the continent's energy future. This forum provides a setting for practical, solution-oriented discussions on how to navigate a lower-carbon energy path through genuine collaboration. Senior executives, regulators, policymakers, investors, and environmental stakeholders will come together to address critical issues facing the industry.

Conversations will cover topics such as infrastructure development, permitting reform, emissions reduction, and the evolving role of U.S. natural gas and LNG in global energy security. Participants will explore post-election energy outlooks, the impact of AI on energy infrastructure, and strategies for an integrated North American gas approach. The program includes keynotes, fireside chats, and Champagne Roundtables, structured to encourage partnerships and innovation across the gas value chain.

events.name: DevOpsCon Munich 2026
events.description:
Unlock the next level of software delivery and operations at DevOpsCon Munich 2026, taking place from November 30 to December 4.

This five-day event offers a hybrid experience, allowing participation either in person at the Holiday Inn Munich – City Centre or remotely online. It's designed for professionals like operations engineers, software architects, developers, and IT leaders globally.

Discussions will cover current topics such as CI/CD, Kubernetes, and DevSecOps, with a particular emphasis on Platform Engineering. More than 40 experts from around the world will present their knowledge through keynotes, sessions, and practical workshops, including specialized summits for Platform Engineering and DevSecOps.

Participants can expect to acquire practical strategies aimed at simplifying complex processes, enhancing agility, and speeding up innovation. The goal is to support the development of secure and scalable applications.

events.name: Counter UAS Technology USA Conference 2026
events.description:
Addressing the escalating challenges posed by unmanned aerial systems, the Counter UAS Technology USA Conference 2026, presented by SAE Media Group, offers a vital platform for defence and security stakeholders. This gathering brings together leading experts, policymakers, and industry innovators to explore the latest advancements in C-UAS, discuss effective strategies, and consider their operational implications.

Participants will gain valuable insights into emerging threats and examine advanced detection and mitigation technologies. The conference provides an opportunity for critical discussions that will help shape the future of national security, fostering collaboration, the sharing of best practices, and the formation of partnerships essential for safeguarding against evolving aerial threats across the USA.

events.name: Global Airports Forum 2026
events.description:
Powering the next era of aviation, the Global Airports Forum 2026 will convene in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, from November 30 to December 1.

This two-day event at the Riyadh Front Exhibition & Conference Center brings together aviation leaders, international exhibitors, and key decision-makers. The forum will address the future of airport growth and connectivity.

Attendees will explore innovative approaches, including AI, biometrics, and sustainable infrastructure, all essential for advancing global air travel.
