Co-located conferences, such as the Future Aviation Investment Conference and the Women in Aviation General Assembly, will provide significant perspectives on strategic challenges, investment opportunities, and supporting diverse talent within the industry.

Conversations with industry experts will highlight how Saudi Arabia's Vision 2030 is shaping the region's role as a global aviation hub.

events.name: Forbes Middle East Women’s Summit 2026
events.description:
Set to empower and inspire, the Forbes Middle East Women’s Summit 2026 will convene trailblazing leaders and visionaries in Riyadh. This gathering, anticipated for early December 2026, will focus on 'Limitless Inspiration,' bringing together women from various industries to connect and collaborate.

Participants will engage in discussions and networking sessions that delve into key areas such as leadership, entrepreneurship, financial empowerment, and the growing influence of women in STEM, wellness, and the creative economy. These conversations will highlight the stories and strategies shaping a more inclusive and empowered future.

This event is designed for professionals interested in gaining deeper understanding and making meaningful connections within the region's evolving landscape.

events.name: Enterprise DevOps Summit 2026
events.description:
Europe's leading minds in software engineering and DevOps will converge at the Enterprise DevOps Summit 2026. The event takes place from November 30 to December 01, 2026, at Berlin's Maritim proArte Hotel. This two-day gathering runs concurrently with the Enterprise Continuous Delivery & Automation, Software Testing & QA, and DevSecOps Summits, with access to all included in a single ticket.

The program offers over 68 hands-on case studies, more than 56 interactive workshops, and live product demonstrations. Participants can also arrange nearly 200 dedicated one-on-one meetings. Discussions will delve into significant areas such as AI-driven DevOps transformation, Platform Engineering, and secure agentic governance.

This summit is designed for over 500 decision-makers representing more than 280 companies. It provides a forum to address challenges related to accelerating delivery, optimizing costs, and embedding security across enterprise-grade cloud-native architectures.

events.name: CCBSA Annual Conference 2026

location.venue: Gaylord Pacific Resort and Convention Center

events.description:
Set against the vibrant backdrop of San Diego, California, the CCBSA Annual Conference 2026 will take place from November 30 to December 4 at the Chula Vista Gaylord Pacific Resort and Convention Center. This five-day event is held in conjunction with the California State Association of Counties (CSAC) annual meeting. It brings together members of the California Clerk of the Board of Supervisors Association and other professionals in the Clerk of the Board field.

The conference program features a detailed schedule designed to support professional development. It includes discussions led by experts, practical workshops addressing current issues, and opportunities to connect with colleagues. Participants will find a space to stay informed about legislative updates, share effective strategies, and collectively navigate the evolving landscape of county government, ultimately enhancing their expertise and contributing to the future of California's public administration.

events.name: Tax & Finance 2026
events.description:
Gain critical insights into the evolving landscape of financial taxation at Tax & Finance 2026, held from November 30 to December 1, 2026, at the Sofitel Frankfurt Opera in Germany. This two-day event is designed for tax and finance professionals working in banks, insurance companies, and other financial service providers.

The program will cover important regulatory changes, such as the EU Tax Omnibus and ATAD, along with current topics in tax criminal law, VAT, and transfer pricing. A key session will explore the role of Artificial Intelligence within the tax sector, examining both its practical applications and current limitations.

Discussions will be led by experts, focusing on audit areas and developments at both national and international levels. An evening gathering provides an opportunity for participants to connect with industry colleagues and leading specialists.

events.name: Digital Leadership Day British Columbia 2026
events.description:
Prepare for the future of public service at Digital Leadership Day British Columbia 2026, a pivotal full-day conference on November 30 at the Victoria Conference Centre.

This event gathers senior public sector leaders, innovators, and government professionals to delve into British Columbia's evolution from Government 2.0 to a more intelligent and proactive Government 3.0. The day will explore strategies for leading transformational change, anticipating citizen needs, and thoughtfully implementing emerging technologies such as generative AI.

Through keynotes, case studies, and expert panel discussions, participants will gain practical guidance on strengthening ethical governance and fostering innovation. It offers an opportunity to connect with peers, collaborate on shared approaches, and leave with strategic insights to deliver adaptive, citizen-centric services that provide measurable value for British Columbians.

events.name: Bank Management Conference 2026

location.venue: Megaron Athens Concert Hall - Banquet Hall

events.description:
On Monday, 30 November 2026, the Megaron Athens Concert Hall will host the Bank Management Conference 2026, a pivotal gathering for banking's elite. The conference brings together C-level officers and senior executives from retail, digital, IT, risk, and compliance sectors. Its central theme, "Reinventing Banking: Intelligent Growth, Customer Precision & High-Tech Resilience," will guide the conversations.

Attendees will examine strategies for transformation, front-end excellence, and high-tech banking. The program includes discussions on AI-powered decision-making, automation, customer-centric models, Open Banking, cybersecurity, and navigating regulatory changes such as the AI Act and DORA.

The event provides a forum for international thought leaders and prominent banking figures to share perspectives and contribute to developing responsive, resilient banking models, ready for the digital euro and the AI economy.

events.name: Latin America's 50 Best Restaurants 2026
events.description:
Prepare for a vibrant celebration of culinary artistry as Latin America's 50 Best Restaurants 2026 descends upon Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico. This event, hosted by the Jalisco Ministry of Tourism and supported by S.Pellegrino & Acqua Panna, will highlight the region's rich culinary landscape.

On November 30, the 50 Best Talks will bring together leading figures to discuss the industry's most pressing topics. The Awards Ceremony follows on December 1, where Latin America's top culinary talents will be recognized for their innovation and dedication.

Around these main dates, 50 Best Signature Sessions will be available to the public. These ticketed pop-ups feature collaborations between acclaimed chefs. The program provides an opportunity for chefs, restaurateurs, and food enthusiasts to engage with the culinary scene and experience the excellence that defines Latin American cuisine.

events.name: #50BestTalks Latin America's 50 Best Restaurants 2026
events.description:
Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico, will become the vibrant epicenter of Latin American gastronomy as it hosts the prestigious Latin America's 50 Best Restaurants 2026. The program culminates in an awards ceremony on December 1, 2026, recognizing the region's most accomplished chefs and restaurateurs. Before this, on November 30, the #50BestTalks series brings together influential voices to explore current challenges and ideas within the industry.

There will also be unique 50 Best Signature Sessions. These ticketed pop-up events pair local Guadalajara restaurants with chefs from Latin America's 50 Best, creating special dining opportunities for the public. S.Pellegrino & Acqua Panna support the event, which is hosted by the Jalisco Ministry of Tourism. It offers a deep look into the evolving landscape of Latin American cuisine.

events.name: AACUL Winter Conference 2026
events.description:
Prepare for a dynamic gathering of credit union leaders and professionals at the AACUL Winter Conference 2026 in Nashville, TN. This event unites professionals from across the Credit Union League System to advance innovation driven by their core mission, ensuring credit unions can effectively serve their members.

Participants will encounter new solutions and engage in discussions stemming from a recent Call for Speakers. These conversations will offer perspectives on the industry's most critical challenges and opportunities.

The conference also serves as a setting to acknowledge exceptional leadership, reflecting the spirit of awards such as the Eugene H. Farley League Leadership Award and the Credit Union House Hall of Leaders inductions. It's a place where colleagues can connect, develop shared strategies, and collectively shape the future direction of the credit union movement.

events.name: MoneyShow Masters Symposium Sarasota 2026
events.description:
Serious investors seeking unparalleled insights into the future of profitability are invited to the MoneyShow Masters Symposium Sarasota 2026. This three-day event will take place from November 30 to December 2, 2026, at the Ritz-Carlton Sarasota. Its central theme, "Record Margins, Real Returns: Inside the New Era of American Profitability," will guide discussions throughout the program.

Participants will have the opportunity to hear directly from respected market figures such as Steve Forbes and Dr. Edward Yardeni. The agenda covers a range of important subjects, including private market opportunities, the influence of AI, advanced trading strategies, and alternative investments. With a focus on a smaller group of attendees, the symposium aims to foster meaningful discussions and provide an environment for focused learning.

The program also includes opportunities for informal interaction, such as cocktail receptions and refreshments. These elements, alongside unique Signature Experiences, are intended to support the development of investment knowledge and facilitate connections among high-net-worth investors within a professional environment.

events.name: ISPIM Connects Winter 2026
events.description:
Set against the backdrop of Sendai, Japan – the "Green City of Innovation" – ISPIM Connects Winter 2026 offers three days of unparalleled insights into "Innovating for a Resilient Future." From November 30 to December 2, 2026, this gathering will bring together around 250 innovation professionals from 30 countries. These individuals represent various fields, including academia, industry, consulting, and the public sector.

Attendees will explore over 150 presentations, interactive workshops, and panel discussions focused on solutions for pressing global challenges. They will hear from keynote speakers such as Peter Fatelnig, Stanley Boots, and Gijs van Wulfen. Opportunities exist to explore Sendai's innovation landscape through six unique tours, including visits to NanoTerasu and the International Research Institute of Disaster Science (IRIDeS).

Each day will conclude with opportunities for connection at various venues, encouraging new collaborations. For those unable to attend in person, a virtual track is available, ensuring broader participation.

events.name: FPTA Conference and Trade Show 2026
events.description:
The FPTA & MSTPA Joint Conference and Trade Show 2026, held from November 30 to December 3 at The Baytowne Conference Center in Miramar Beach, FL, is the premier gathering for parking and mobility professionals. Bringing together the Florida and Mid-South Parking & Transportation Associations, this event provides a significant opportunity for learning and connection.

Attendees, including municipal leaders, university officials, and technology providers, will participate in educational sessions that explore current solutions and advancements in transportation technology, sustainability, and community building. The event also features a trade show where participants can see new developments firsthand.

Beyond the formal sessions, there will be ample opportunities for networking, special events, and an awards program to acknowledge achievements within the industry. The insights and discussions from this conference aim to contribute to the ongoing development of mobility across cities, campuses, and various organizations.

events.name: WBWE Amsterdam 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for WBWE Amsterdam 2026, the world's leading event for bulk wine and spirits. From November 30 to December 1, Amsterdam RAI, Hall 5, will serve as a central meeting point for producers, buyers, and industry experts. Here, the full spectrum of bulk wine and spirits – including PDO, fortified, organic, and top-range varieties – is showcased.

Attendees can explore new market trends, diversify their product selections, and build connections within a global network. WBWE Amsterdam has a reputation for encouraging new brands and business models. The event includes the International Bulk Wine Competition, dedicated tasting sessions, and opportunities for industry professionals to connect.

The gathering typically draws thousands of trade visitors and hundreds of exhibitors, all contributing to the ongoing evolution of the bulk wine and spirits industry.

events.name: India Essen Welding & Cutting 2026
events.description:
Poised to be South East Asia's most significant exhibition for joining, cutting, and surfacing technology, India Essen Welding & Cutting 2026 offers an unparalleled platform for innovation. Organized by Messe Düsseldorf India, this biennial event functions as India's largest integrated platform for welding, tubes, metallurgy, and wire technologies when it runs concurrently with METEC India, Tube India, and Wire India.

The event anticipates drawing over 21,000 visitors and more than 530 exhibitors, showcasing the latest advancements in manual and machine welding, coating, robotics, and automation across 38,000 square meters. The program includes three technical conferences, opportunities to observe the AWPM Welding Competition, and a chance to explore innovative manufacturing and engineering products. This environment encourages industry connections and knowledge exchange.

events.name: Black Hat MEA 2026
events.description:
Prepare for the definitive cybersecurity event of the year as Black Hat MEA 2026 descends upon Riyadh, KSA, from December 1-3. This gathering will bring together over 40,000 cybersecurity professionals, including more than 500 CISOs, alongside over 500 leading companies, all focused on the future of digital defense.

Attendees can expect to hear from over 300 experts who will share insights into current strategies, emerging solutions, and specialized tactics. There will also be practical experiences available, ranging from competitive hackathons and live hacking stations to opportunities for earning industry-recognized certifications.

The event provides a setting for professionals to connect with colleagues, develop practical skills, and stay informed about the latest tools and knowledge shaping the cybersecurity landscape.

events.name: MJBizCon 2026
events.description:
Prepare to cultivate success at MJBizCon 2026, the world's largest B2B cannabis industry event, returning to the Las Vegas Convention Center from December 1-4.

This gathering brings together entrepreneurs, retailers, and investors from across the globe. They will focus on strategies for scaling businesses, making informed decisions, and understanding emerging market trends. The event's "Flower Power" theme guides discussions, emphasizing harmony, connection, and the normalization of cannabis, with the goal of fostering an environment for new opportunities.

Attendees can explore four distinct expo hall pavilions: Cultivation, Processing, Retail, and Business Services, which will feature current technology and automation. The three-day program includes expert-led conference sessions and networking opportunities, designed to provide practical insights and facilitate professional relationships.

events.name: Fintech Connect Europe 2026
events.description:
Fintech Connect Europe 2026 invites over 5,000 global innovators to London's Excel on December 1-2 for an immersive exploration of digital finance's cutting edge. Over these two days, discussions will cover recent developments in AI, Web3, payments, and the ongoing shift in digital banking.

The agenda includes seven distinct conference tracks, alongside opportunities to learn from over 100 solution providers. This setting allows for interactions with leaders from financial institutions, fintech startups, investors, and regulators. Participants can explore new technologies, develop collaborations, and deepen their understanding of how the fintech landscape is changing.

An AI-powered networking app will be available to help facilitate relevant connections among attendees.

events.name: TFEST 2026
events.description:
The future of supply chain excellence converges in Berlin at TFEST 2026, the premier Value Chain Transformation Summit. From December 1-2, 2026, at the historic Colosseum Berlin, this two-day event is expected to bring together nearly 1,000 global supply chain leaders.

The agenda will focus on critical themes such as harnessing AI's potential across the entire value chain and building resilience in the face of trade wars and geopolitical turbulence. Discussions will also cover essential digital, sustainable, and cross-functional transformations crucial for organizations moving forward. Over 80 expert speakers will present more than 50 practitioner keynotes, alongside interactive workshops and roundtables across three stages, designed to provide practical insights.

Opportunities for meaningful networking will be available, and attendees can explore solutions from over 30 technology providers. Exclusive pre-event tours are also planned. Aimed at senior supply chain leaders, academics, and professionals from leading brands, TFEST 2026 serves as a platform for collaboration, innovation, and shaping future value chain strategies.

events.name: Celosphere 2026
events.description:
Prepare to unlock the future of business transformation at Celosphere 2026, where the power of Process Intelligence meets Enterprise AI.

The event takes place from December 1-3, 2026, at Messe München in Germany. Industry leaders will gather to explore the theme "There’s no AI without PI." Participants will see Celonis' latest innovations, such as the Celonis Data Core, designed for smooth data integration, and the Orchestration Engine, which coordinates processes across different technology systems in real time.

Four global keynote speakers are scheduled to offer perspectives on optimizing processes for the benefit of individuals, organizations, and the environment. The Celonis platform's ability to unify data, manage end-to-end processes, and enhance the return on investment from Enterprise AI will be demonstrated, illustrating its role in achieving significant business value. A 2-hour livestream on November 4 provides a virtual introduction to the event.

events.name: SIGGRAPH Asia 2026
events.description:
Prepare to witness a new era for computer graphics and interactive techniques as SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 makes its historic debut in Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia. The event runs from December 1-4, with the exhibition open from December 2-4 at KLCC. This significant gathering aims to broaden its reach across the region, bringing together new ideas and helping people form valuable connections within the industry.

Organized by Koelnmesse and sponsored by ACM SIGGRAPH, participants will have the opportunity to explore pioneering research, advanced technologies, and creative artistic expressions. Under the leadership of Conference Chair Frank Guan, SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 will offer a distinctive experience for professionals, researchers, and enthusiasts, contributing to the ongoing evolution of digital creativity and innovation.

events.name: Apidays Paris 2026
events.description:
Prepare for a transformative four days at CNIT Forest, Paris, from November 30 to December 3, 2026, as Apidays Paris 2026 convenes the global API and AI community. This gathering is expected to bring together more than 4,000 individuals from over 1,500 companies, with a program featuring more than 300 sessions and speakers.

The event delves into the intersection of APIs and AI, exploring themes such as innovation, security, sovereignty, and sustainability. Attendees will find four distinct conferences taking place concurrently: Apidays Paris, Hacking APIs Conference, GenerationAI Paris, and Green IO Paris. The agenda is designed to offer practical insights into API design, management, and the challenges of real-world implementation.

It provides an opportunity to engage with industry leaders, developers, and thought-provokers. The discussions and presentations aim to contribute to ongoing developments in digital transformation and sustainable technology.

events.name: Festival of DAM 2026
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in a global celebration of Digital Asset Management at the Festival of DAM 2026. This online gathering takes place on December 1, 2026, from 10:30 AM – 2:30 PM EST, offering an opportunity to learn and connect with the worldwide DAM community.

The program features live case studies and a panel discussion, drawing insights from leading organizations, all presented from a practical user perspective. Attendees can engage in live Q&A sessions and online chats with experts and fellow participants, fostering meaningful exchanges among those working with DAM.

The event explores how current DAM technology and workflows can enhance organizational practices. For convenience, all sessions will be recorded and made available on demand.

events.name: InCyber Forum Canada 2026
events.description:
Prepare for a critical exploration of digital security at InCyber Forum Canada 2026, taking place from December 1-3 in Ottawa-Gatineau. The forum brings together experts, innovators, and decision-makers to examine the evolving landscape of cyber threats and potential solutions.

Attendees will find discussions across several thematic stages, offering insights into current challenges and strategic approaches. Emerging talent will be recognized through the Startup Awards. The event also provides opportunities to connect with peers and leaders, including an evening reception.

The agenda is currently being developed through a Call for Submissions, aiming to create a relevant and forward-looking program for those focused on the future of digital security.

events.name: SaaStr Europa 2026
events.description:
SaaStr Europa 2026, also known as SaaStr AI London, is poised to be Europe's biggest AI + B2B event, taking place December 1-2, 2026, at the Park Plaza Westminster Bridge in London. This event brings together over 2,500 AI-focused founders, B2B executives, and more than 300 venture capitalists. A significant portion of attendees, 61%, hold C-level positions.

The program includes over 75 sessions and more than 20 practical workshops focusing on AI and go-to-market strategies. These will be led by over 100 individuals recognized as AI pioneers and successful European company builders. Participants can explore current strategies for integrating AI across various business functions, including sales, marketing, and customer success. The aim is to help attendees understand how to succeed in an AI-driven B2B environment, manage the shift towards AI, and acquire practical knowledge. Additionally, there will be a live recording of the 20VC podcast, alongside opportunities to connect with other professionals.

events.name: Supply Chain Event 2026
events.description:
Driving the evolution of global logistics, Supply Chain Event 2026 is set to empower professionals with cutting-edge strategies and solutions. This annual event, organized by RX, gathers supply chain decision-makers and experts for two days of valuable discussions. It features an exhibition where over 130 solution providers will present their work, alongside opportunities for more than 1000 focused business meetings.

The program includes over 40 conferences, with content developed in collaboration with Supply Chain Magazine. These sessions will address the central theme: "A digital SC ready for all Scenarios," covering areas such as Visibility & Flow Management, Intralogistics & Robotics, Forecasting & Planning, and Risk Management. The event also features the Digital Supply Chain Awards, which acknowledge significant advancements in the field. This gathering is relevant for professionals focused on digitalizing their operations and addressing the complexities of tomorrow's supply chain.

events.name: Trustech 2026
events.description:
The global nexus for innovative payments and identification solutions returns as Trustech 2026 convenes from December 1-3 at Paris Expo Porte de Versailles – Pavilion 5.2. This annual gathering addresses the changing landscape of digital payments, biometrics, card, mobile, data, crypto, and digital currencies. It examines the essential identification, authentication, and authorization technologies that form the backbone of digital identity in the online economy.

The event expects around 8,000 participants and will host over 200 exhibitors. A conference program includes 100 international speakers, discussing current trends and presenting new products and concepts on the Innovation Stage. This setting allows for a deeper understanding of new developments and fosters connections among those involved in trust technology.

events.name: Asia TV Forum & Market 2026
events.description:
The vibrant heart of Asia's entertainment content industry beats strong at Asia TV Forum & Market 2026, taking place from 1 to 4 December at Marina Bay Sands, Singapore. The gathering starts with the exclusive ATF Leaders Dialogue, followed by three days dedicated to market activities and conferences.

Those attending will explore the latest content trends, see exclusive series premieres, and participate in important press conferences. The forum offers chances for trading, collaboration, and innovation, including the "In-Development: Lab & Pitches" designed to support new talent and projects.

Thoughtfully arranged networking events and focused business matchmaking help create valuable connections among content leaders, business visionaries, and decision-makers. This event serves as a place to support the next generation of Asian content and understand the changing media landscape.

events.name: Global Banking Summit 2026
events.description:
From December 1-3, 2026, the Global Banking Summit will gather over 1000 senior figures, policymakers, and technologists, both in-person at Convene Sancroft, London, and digitally. Over three days, 150 speakers will lead 75 sessions across 9 stages, addressing the significant shifts in global finance, including market volatility, competitive pressures, and structural transformations.

Discussions will delve into how the industry is responding to uneven economic growth, geopolitical complexities, and the far-reaching impact of AI and digital infrastructure on banking. The agenda includes CEO interviews, high-level policy conversations, and dedicated sessions focused on improving performance and navigating organizational change.

The summit aims to provide a platform for understanding emerging trends and developing approaches to the evolving financial landscape. It offers a setting for leaders to connect and discuss the path forward for the industry.

events.name: Pollutec 2026
events.description:
Accelerating the ecological transition and fostering new markets takes center stage at Pollutec 2026 in Lyon. This event brings together environmental professionals to explore leading solutions across eleven key areas, such as decarbonization, the bioeconomy, health, and scientific advancements. With over 51,000 professionals attending from more than 100 countries, Pollutec provides an opportunity to grasp current market trends, interpret evolving regulations, and exchange effective strategies.

Participants can engage with more than 350 conferences, observe significant innovations recognized at the Pollutec Innovation Awards, and establish valuable professional relationships during structured business meetings. It serves as a key meeting point for individuals and organizations from both public and private sectors who are dedicated to advancing a sustainable future.

events.name: Blockchain Life 2026
events.description:
Dubai's Festival Arena will host Blockchain Life 2026, the 17th International Forum on Web3, Cryptocurrencies, and Mining, on December 1-2. This gathering is expected to bring together influential figures in the crypto world, drawing over 15,000 participants from more than 130 countries. The forum will feature over 200 speakers and 200 exhibitors showcasing new developments.

Attendees can expect to gain practical knowledge from market analysis and expert perspectives presented across various stages. Key activities include a Startup Pitch, the Blockchain Life Trading Tournament, and opportunities for networking, facilitated by a dedicated smart app and VIP lounge access. The forum concludes with an Official AfterParty on December 2.

Given Dubai's supportive environment for cryptocurrency, Blockchain Life 2026 serves as a significant forum for individuals involved in the evolution of decentralized technology.

events.name: SuperReturn Africa 2026
events.description:
From December 1-3, 2026, The Westin, Cape Town, will become the epicentre of African private capital as it hosts SuperReturn South Africa 2026. This three-day conference stands as Africa's largest and most senior gathering for private markets, bringing together over 700 participants, among them more than 200 LPs managing $1.5 trillion in assets and over 350 prominent GPs.

Attendees can expect to hear from over 175 experts, sharing their perspectives across focused sessions covering Private Credit, Culture & Creatives, Fundraising, and Infrastructure. The program is structured to facilitate significant networking, with more than 13,000 meetings arranged, alongside closed-door discussions and the SuperReturn Africa Awards.

This CPD-certified event is intended for senior decision-makers interested in exploring investment opportunities and contributing to the future direction of African private markets.

events.name: Sports Tech Nation 2026
events.description:
The global sports tech community converges in Munich, Germany, for Sports Tech Nation 2026 on December 1–2. This two-day summit, themed "Where the future of sports is built," offers a comprehensive exploration of innovation in the field.

The first day is dedicated to exclusive, invite-only gatherings, including the Club Executive Seminar, Founders Gathering, and Investors Circle. It concludes with an International Welcome Cocktail held at Munich’s historic Old Town Hall. Day two opens with a Startup Exhibition, presenting more than 100 new technologies. Additionally, a Main Stage will host discussions across four key areas: Women’s Sports, New Formats, and Performance & Health.

The gathering expects 180 investors and 250 sports clubs among its attendees, representing over 30 countries. This environment is designed to facilitate more than 1,000 business-to-business meetings, connecting participants and fostering the discovery and application of the next wave of sports technology.

events.name: The Running Event 2026
events.description:
The running and outdoor specialty retail community will converge in San Antonio, TX, from December 1-3, 2026, for The Running Event 2026. This gathering at the Henry B. González Convention Center brings together retailers, event management professionals, and exhibitors. It's a place for them to connect, share ideas, and work together on what's next for the industry.

Those attending can expect a comprehensive education program, opportunities to find new products, and practical solutions for their businesses. The event also features the Best Running Stores Awards Program, specific networking opportunities, and Switchback at TRE, which runs concurrently.

Recognized by Clusivity as an inclusive event, TRE 2026 provides a space for professionals across the industry to come together, learn from one another, and contribute to the ongoing development of running and outdoor retail.

events.name: Reuters NEXT 2026
events.description:
On December 1-2, 2026, Reuters NEXT 2026 will gather an exclusive, invitation-only assembly of senior policymakers, global business leaders, and pioneering innovators in New York. The summit, broadcast globally, will explore the significant shifts shaping our collective future.

Participants, primarily C-level and VP executives representing a wide range of industries and countries, will engage with critical subjects such as geopolitics, global markets, the impact of AI, and sustainable development.

The program includes interviews on the World Stage, panel discussions focusing on Finance & Markets and Technology & AI, and smaller, focused roundtables. These sessions are designed to offer deep understanding, encourage new connections, and help shape approaches to the challenges ahead.

events.name: Construction Super Conference 2026
events.description:
Elevate your expertise in construction law and commercial construction at the Construction Super Conference 2026, held December 1-3 at the Hyatt Regency in Huntington Beach, CA. This event brings together mid- to senior-level attorneys, engineers, consultants, and other industry professionals for three days focused on professional growth and connecting with peers.

Organized by Emerald X, LLC, the conference features 35 sessions, allowing attendees to earn up to 25 MCLE credits. Discussions will cover significant topics, including clarifying common misconceptions in construction defect disputes, the ethical considerations of Artificial Intelligence, and the impact of the U.S. DOT’s IFR on DBEs.

Attendees can expect to connect with approximately 500 colleagues and leaders, offering an opportunity to understand the latest legal, business, and economic developments influencing the construction industry.

events.name: Pollutec Paris 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for Pollutec Paris 2026, the essential two-day exhibition driving ecological transition. The event takes place on 1-2 December at Paris Expo Porte de Versailles. It aims to foster environmental and energy solutions and operates under the high patronage of the French President.

Around 8,600 attendees and 300 exhibitors from various sectors are expected to gather. They will have the chance to explore new developments, participate in important discussions, and establish professional relationships. The agenda includes opportunities to learn about new regulations, exchange best practices, and connect with key public and private stakeholders.

Features like the Startups Village and dedicated business meeting programs are part of the event. These elements provide settings for networking and professional development, contributing to progress in sustainable development.

events.name: Handelsblatt BankingTech 2026
events.description:
Shaping the future of the financial sector, Handelsblatt BankingTech 2026 invites industry leaders and innovators to Frankfurt am Main. The event will take place on December 1st and 2nd at the Hilton Frankfurt City Centre, where participants will explore critical themes. Discussions will cover digital operational resilience (DORA), the impact of AI and Real World Assets (RWA), and changes in the regulatory environment.

Further topics include cybersecurity, API infrastructure, and how to meet evolving customer expectations within the fast-paced banking world. Attendees will have opportunities to connect with colleagues and discuss strategies for navigating the future of the industry.

events.name: ProcureCon Marketing Connect 2026
events.description:
Elevate your marketing procurement strategies at ProcureCon Marketing Connect 2026, an exclusive gathering taking place on 1-2 December at the historic Ashridge House in Hertfordshire, UK. This event brings together over 70 senior marketing procurement leaders from Europe’s top brands and Fortune 500 companies, representing 19 countries.

Participants will engage in more than 25 focused sessions. These are structured in small-group formats, including boardrooms, roundtables, and workshops, designed to foster in-depth discussion and collaboration. The agenda explores new operating models, helps navigate the evolving agency landscape, and delves into data-driven approaches for creating value.

Specific discussions include an Oxford Style Debate on whether "AI will make traditional agency remuneration models obsolete," a Keynote Soapbox addressing how to attract and retain top marketing procurement talent, and Drill Down Roundtables focused on producing effective content at scale without compromising quality. The aim is for attendees to connect with senior peers and contribute to the ongoing evolution of marketing procurement practices.

events.name: Future Branches Austin 2026
events.description:
Rethink, rebuild, and move forward in the evolving retail banking landscape at Future Branches Austin 2026. The event takes place December 1-3, 2026, at the Hilton Austin, TX. It brings together over 400 branch innovators and senior retail banking executives, representing more than 250 banks and credit unions. This gathering aims to provide leaders with practical strategies for navigating economic pressures, evolving customer expectations, and continuous change across both digital and physical channels.

Attendees can discover new branch transformation partners and emerging technologies within the Innovation Hub. The program includes more than 30 interactive sessions, exclusive branch tours, and over 15 hours of dedicated networking time. This environment encourages peer-to-peer learning and candid discussions. The goal is to provide insights that help optimize network strategy and improve customer engagement, positioning institutions for success in the evolving banking landscape.

events.name: Future of Software Technologies 2026
events.description:
Scheduled for December 1-3, 2026, at CNIT Forest in Paris, the Future of Software Technologies 2026 is the essential gathering for navigating the 'Agentic Era.'

This three-day event brings together more than 10,000 professionals from over 3,000 companies, including key figures in API development, AI innovation, and sustainability. A central focus will be on establishing a 'Sovereign autonomous API Stack,' addressing concerns such as 'Black Box Dependency' by emphasizing local infrastructure, data residency, and continuous operations.

Participants can expect a comprehensive program featuring over 300 speakers and 300 sessions. They will also have access to 24 co-located partner events, such as GenerationAI and Green IO. Discussions will cover topics like API monetization, security protocols, AI-driven automation, and cloud-native strategies. The aim is for attendees to acquire practical knowledge, pursue certifications, and engage with leaders who are influencing the future of software.

events.name: Green IO Paris 2026
events.description:
Pioneering the future of sustainable technology, Green IO Paris 2026 invites over 800 responsible technologists to CNIT Forest - La Défense from December 1 to 3. This three-day European summit, part of the Future Of Software Technologies conferences, focuses on the significant sustainability challenges facing IT, particularly with the growth of generative AI and changing climate policies.

Leaders, practitioners, and academics in IT and technology will discuss key areas like green software engineering, low-carbon cloud operations, and responsible AI. Those attending will gain current insights, learn from practical use cases, and have opportunities for meaningful discussions with colleagues.

The event will feature the finals of the Sustainable Digital Challenge. Participants can also connect with corporate partners and NGOs in the Green IO village, creating opportunities for collaboration.

events.name: CLO Summit USA 2026
events.description:
Prepare to delve deep into the evolving landscape of the Collateralized Loan Obligation (CLO) market at the CLO Summit USA 2026, taking place December 1-3, 2026. This gathering at the Waldorf Astoria Monarch Beach in Dana Point, CA, brings together investors, issuers, underwriters, rating agencies, lawyers, and accountants who navigate the complexities of asset-backed finance.

The summit will explore how to manage regulation, ratings, and risk, offering perspectives on maximizing returns and mitigating exposure. Attendees will examine current techniques, recent regulatory changes, rating agency methodologies, and key legal, tax, and structural considerations. An additional ABS & Fintech Forum is also available for the first 100 qualifying registrants.

This event provides an opportunity to stay current with developments in the CLO sector.

events.name: Generative AI Summit London 2026

location.venue: InterContinental London - the O2 by IHG

events.description:
Scheduled for December 01, 2026, in London, the Generative AI Summit offers a highly focused environment for engineers, builders, and technical executives. This event, held concurrently with the Agentic AI and Chief AI Officer Summits, is dedicated to the practical application, debugging, and large-scale deployment of Generative AI.

Attendees will explore strategies for overcoming common challenges related to infrastructure, data layers, and optimization. The discussions will cover how to build, test, and deploy pioneering AI applications. Key technical areas include optimizing large language models, advancing infrastructure for multimodal AI, and designing robust agent architectures.

The summit brings together over 400 professionals from more than 350 companies. Without a vast expo hall, the setting encourages direct engagement, allowing individuals to connect with peers, exchange actionable insights, and collectively drive responsible, cost-effective AI innovation.

events.name: Glotel Awards 2026
events.description:
The Glotel Awards 2026 offers a distinguished platform to celebrate unparalleled innovation and significant achievements within the global telecoms industry. These awards are designed to honor organizations that are truly shaping the future of telecommunications worldwide.

The evening will feature an awards ceremony and a gala dinner, providing an opportunity to connect with influential figures and thought leaders from across the sector. It represents a significant acknowledgment of excellence, offering a chance to understand current industry standards and foster discussions that contribute to future progress.

Organizations interested in showcasing their pioneering work are encouraged to submit their entries. The initial submission period concludes on July 24th.

events.name: GTR US 2026
events.description:
Dive deep into the evolving landscape of US trade and working capital financing at GTR US 2026, taking place on December 1, 2026, at the Marriott Marquis Times Square in New York City. This one-day gathering will bring together over 500 professionals from various parts of the market, including local and international banks, multinational corporations, fintechs, and insurers.

More than 50 experts will share their insights, offering participants opportunities for engaging discussions and practical perspectives on current market trends and emerging opportunities. The day includes over three hours specifically for connecting with peers, and attendees can explore exhibits from more than 40 organizations.

The event provides an occasion to discuss key issues, build new relationships, and stay informed about developments in trade finance. The day concludes with an evening reception.

events.name: FIA Asia Derivatives Conference 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for the FIA Asia Derivatives Conference 2026, a pivotal event for professionals navigating the region's rapidly expanding derivatives markets. From December 1-3, 2026, the conference offers an opportunity to meet professionals from leading firms and discuss the developments influencing the Asia-Pacific landscape. Attendees will gain a clearer understanding of regulatory changes, technological advancements, and new trading strategies that are shaping the future of derivatives in Asia.

The event provides a setting for conversations with industry leaders and a chance to build professional relationships. It's a forum to gather insights that can help professionals navigate new opportunities within the sector. Those looking to understand and contribute to the direction of Asia's derivatives market will find this gathering relevant.

events.name: Advancing Data Center Construction 2026
events.description:
Addressing the unprecedented demands of AI-driven infrastructure, Advancing Data Center Construction 2026 convenes in Atlanta, GA, from December 1-3. This three-day event focuses on addressing significant challenges facing the Eastern U.S. data center industry, including utility strain, supply chain delays, and the scarcity of skilled labor.

Bringing together over 1,200 industry leaders, including hyperscalers, colocators, and contractors, participants can explore practical insights through more than 15 sessions and workshops, with 80% of these being interactive. The program features five dedicated tracks that cover the entire project lifecycle, from initial planning and procurement to MEP integration. Held concurrently with Advancing Data Center Retrofits, the event provides over 25 hours for connecting with peers. The discussions will center on developing high-performing, energy-efficient, and AI-ready facilities, helping to ensure projects are prepared for future demands.

events.name: IAPP ANZ Summit 2026
events.description:
The future of digital responsibility and data protection will converge in Sydney this December. The IAPP ANZ Summit 2026 will be held from December 1-4 at the Hyatt Regency Sydney, bringing together professionals in privacy, AI governance, and cybersecurity law. This four-day event is structured to offer practical insights for navigating the complexities of evolving regulations and rapid technological advancements.

Participants can expect to examine current trends in digital responsibility, acquire strategies for common challenges, and understand the innovations influencing the industry's direction. The summit provides a setting for professionals and experts to collaborate on advancing these crucial fields. Discussions will focus on strengthening data protection and ensuring ethical AI practices, with relevance for the ANZ region and beyond.

events.name: Shutdowns Turnarounds Superconference 2026
events.description:
Elevate your operational excellence at the 25th Annual Shutdowns Turnarounds Superconference 2026, taking place December 1-2 in Calgary, AB. This two-day conference brings together professionals from the Shutdowns & Turnaround community across Canada. More than 400 individuals, representing sectors like oil & gas, mining, and power generation, will attend to share insights, compare practices, and build professional relationships. The focus is on practical strategies to improve shutdown and turnaround operations.

The program includes over 35 sessions, case studies, and interactive panels. These discussions aim to provide actionable insights on managing costs, controlling project scope, improving safety, and integrating digital tools. Attendees can also explore new solutions from over 80 exhibiting companies and earn Continuing Professional Development (CPD) credits. It's also a chance to connect with colleagues and expand professional networks.

events.name: Travel Tech API Conference Paris 2026
events.description:
Shape the future of global travel at the Travel Tech API Conference Paris 2026, taking place from December 1 to 3 at CNIT FOREST in Puteaux, France. This conference will explore the pivotal role of APIs in advancing travel technology, aiming to create more integrated experiences for travelers globally.

The event brings together travel product and tech leaders, developers, and API enthusiasts from airlines, ground transportation, accommodations, and online travel agencies. The program includes hands-on workshops, analysis of real-world case studies, and opportunities to discover practical API solutions. These sessions are designed to address current challenges, foster a more connected ecosystem, and encourage collaboration among industry professionals to collectively design innovative solutions that can shape the future of travel.

events.name: CXFS Connect 2026

location.venue: JW Marriott Orlando Bonnet Creek Resort & Spa

events.description:
CXFS Connect 2026 offers an unparalleled, invitation-only experience for senior financial services leaders. From December 1-2, at the JW Marriott Orlando Bonnet Creek Resort & Spa, this gathering brings together C-level, SVP, VP, and Director-level executives from banks, credit unions, insurers, and asset managers, all representing institutions with over $1 billion in assets under management. The program is designed to explore how to reimagine the customer journey and shape the future of financial services CX.

Participants can expect intimate, closed-door discussions and insights from leaders such as Ginny Couvillon (UBS) and Vamsi Rao (JP Morgan Chase). There will also be opportunities to build connections with peers and engage in pre-scheduled one-on-one meetings with technology partners, offering practical perspectives to help drive innovation and support business growth.

events.name: The API Economy Summit Paris 2026
events.description:
The API Economy Summit Paris 2026 is set to explore the cutting edge of digital transformation, focusing on APIs, AI, and robust ecosystems. The summit will explore how APIs move beyond just technology, becoming essential business interfaces that help organizations of all sizes succeed.

Participants will gain insights into aligning API strategies with business objectives, managing and scaling digital business models, and adopting the agile practices common in 'digital native' organizations.

The event will feature an interactive format, including facilitated round tables and meaningful conversations. This approach encourages learning and provides opportunities to connect with industry peers and experts. For those working in commercial, digital, or technical roles, the summit will explore the strategies, culture, and tools essential for transforming products into platforms and platforms into thriving ecosystems.

events.name: Gartner Chicago CIO Community Executive Summit Winter 2026
events.description:
Chicago's top CIOs and C-level peers are invited to an exclusive, one-day program on December 1, 2026, at Convene in the iconic Willis Tower. This event, the Chicago CIO Community Executive Summit Winter 2026, is built "By CIOs, For CIOs®," ensuring the conversations directly address the most important challenges and opportunities facing leaders today.

Participation is by invitation, creating an environment where leaders can truly connect and share insights with their peers. The day will explore significant subjects, including how to build strategic agility, evaluate the financial returns of AI investments, and manage complex risks and regulations, particularly through geostrategic sourcing.

The program features a mix of engaging keynote presentations, focused boardroom discussions, and private one-on-one meetings. These formats are designed to offer practical perspectives and foster stronger connections within Chicago's CIO community.

events.name: Piper Sandler Healthcare Conference 2026
events.description:
Prepare for an unparalleled exploration of the healthcare landscape at the Piper Sandler Healthcare Conference 2026. This invitation-only gathering, organized by Piper Sandler, will take place in New York, NY, from December 1 to 3, 2026. It is designed for key industry executives, investors, and Piper Sandler professionals, providing a setting for strategic dialogue and collaboration.

Attendees will have the opportunity to explore critical trends, consider multiple perspectives, and identify leading innovators and disruptors in the market. The conference aims to facilitate high-level discussions, help shape future strategies, and connect influential figures in healthcare, contributing to the industry's ongoing evolution.

events.name: Furniture Today Leadership Conference 2026

location.venue: JW Marriott Miami Turnberry Resort & Spa

events.description:
The home furnishings industry's leading executives and decision-makers are invited to the Furniture Today Leadership Conference 2026, taking place December 1–3 at the luxurious JW Marriott Miami Turnberry Resort & Spa. This three-day gathering will bring together more than 100 retailers, who collectively represent $20.5 billion in retail buying power, to share insights and build professional relationships. Participants will have opportunities for meaningful conversations, gaining fresh perspectives and building valuable connections, all guided by the overarching theme, "Powering the Future of Furniture."

The program will delve into themes under "From Disruption to Direction," examining what lies ahead for the industry. A key focus will be the transformative impact of AI and next-generation technology on furniture retail and manufacturing. The discussions are intended to help leaders refine their strategies and contribute to shaping the future direction of their businesses and the industry as a whole.

events.name: Apartment Development & Affordable Housing 2026
events.description:
Addressing Canada's surging demand for rental housing, Apartment Development & Affordable Housing 2026 is set to convene on December 1, 2026, at the Metro Toronto Convention Centre, South Building. This gathering will explore the anticipated "apartment boom," examining the entire development lifecycle from financial viability and initial projections to feasibility, design considerations, and long-term ownership strategies. Discussions will encompass critical areas such as private equity, joint ventures, and the strategic shift from condominium to rental development.

The event brings together over 250 senior-level professionals, including more than 100 building owners, developers, and investors. It provides an environment for significant networking, allowing attendees to engage with institutional developers, lenders, municipalities, and financiers. Opportunities for collaboration and partnership building are facilitated through dedicated sessions, as well as during breakfast and lunch. Insights will be shared through expert keynotes, real-world case studies, and timely market updates, featuring confirmed speakers such as Stefania Parnanzone, Steven Gross, and Adrian Rocca.

events.name: Digiday Programmatic Marketing Summit Winter 2026
events.description:
The Digiday Programmatic Marketing Summit Winter 2026 offers a deep dive into the future of advertising. From December 1-3, 2026, at the W Nashville in Nashville, TN, programmatic specialists, marketing executives, and leaders from agencies and brands will gather to explore the key trends and strategies that are reshaping the industry.

Over three days, the summit will provide insights into topics such as agentic ad-buying, AI-powered attribution, and how automation is transforming internal workflows. Beyond the discussions, there will be opportunities to connect with others through meals, cocktail receptions, and dedicated one-on-one meetings with industry peers.

The event offers a chance to deepen understanding and engage with leaders who are shaping programmatic innovation.

events.name: Government Innovation Showcase British Columbia 2026
events.description:
Set for December 1, 2026, in Victoria, British Columbia, the Government Innovation Showcase British Columbia 2026 invites the province's top public sector leaders, technology innovators, and policymakers. This gathering aims to shape British Columbia's digital future, with a focus on making public services more sustainable, efficient, and centered around citizens. Discussions will cover critical areas such as healthcare, housing, and emergency management.

Participants will have the opportunity to examine BC's Digital Plan and Digital Code of Practice. The agenda includes discussions on IT modernization, the integration of artificial intelligence, cybersecurity measures, and how data can be used for better decision-making. The event will feature presentations from leading BC government officials and panel discussions designed to encourage effective collaboration between agencies.

Public sector professionals are welcome to attend without charge, contributing to the development of a more intelligent and robust public sector.

events.name: Private Equity Latin America Forum 2026
events.description:
Set to convene in São Paulo, Brazil, on December 1-2, 2026, the 17th Private Equity Latin America Forum is the region's premier gathering for the private equity community. This event brings together over 300 Limited Partners and leading financial professionals, creating an environment for meaningful connections and shared understanding within the industry.

Participants will engage in discussions led by experienced speakers, exploring topics such as advanced liquidity strategies, the potential of Latin America's natural resources, and opportunities within global infrastructure. Sessions will also address the growing private debt market, the strategic role of corporate investments, and how development banks support regional growth.

The forum's aim is to offer perspectives that can inform investment approaches, refine industry practices, and contribute to sustainable development across Latin America.

events.name: Seattle CISO Community Executive Summit Winter 2026
events.description:
Designed exclusively for Seattle's top CISOs and C-level executives, the Seattle CISO Community Executive Summit Winter 2026 offers a focused, one-day program on December 1, 2026, at the Grand Hyatt Seattle. The event, organized by Evanta (Gartner), is shaped by CISOs for their peers, ensuring discussions are directly relevant to their experiences. Attendees, representing organizations with over $500M in revenue, will participate in interactive keynotes, breakout sessions, and private peer-to-peer meetings.

The agenda explores important topics like adapting for strategic agility in a changing global landscape, understanding the financial implications of AI investments, and managing risk and regulation through geostrategic sourcing. These discussions are designed to address current challenges and future directions in cybersecurity.

The summit provides a setting for C-level peers to connect, discuss common challenges, and work together on ideas that will influence the future of cybersecurity leadership.

events.name: Valve World Expo 2026
events.description:
The global valve industry will converge in Düsseldorf, Germany, for Valve World Expo 2026, the premier international trade fair dedicated to industrial valve technology. The expo provides an opportunity to see advancements in valves, components, actuators, and various engineering solutions. Participants can engage in discussions covering important topics such as global energy, process industries, safety, digitalization, and changes within the valve value chain.

In addition to the exhibition, the event includes the Valve World Conference, an Expo Forum, and the VALVE Stars Awards. This gathering brings together trade visitors and exhibitors from sectors like oil, gas, petrochemical, marine, water, and power. It offers opportunities for connections and discussions that can influence the industry's direction.

Exhibitor registration begins on December 3, 2024.

events.name: Chief Customer Officer Summit London 2026
events.description:
Designed for an exclusive network of 75+ C-suite customer leaders, the Chief Customer Officer Summit London 2026 convenes on December 01 in London. This day brings together senior management from over 50 companies for focused discussions and learning, aiming to advance customer-centric strategies.

Participants will delve into how AI can enhance team capabilities and elevate the customer function's strategic importance across an organization. Conversations will cover accelerating growth by improving customer satisfaction, finding the right balance between automation and human-focused approaches, and ensuring optimal value is achieved.

The summit is held alongside four other leadership events. This arrangement offers additional avenues for gaining insights from different functions and connecting with a broader network of peers.

events.name: European Manufacturing Summit 2026
events.description:
The 4th Annual European Manufacturing Summit 2026, an exclusive, invitation-only gathering, convenes senior manufacturing leaders in Düsseldorf, Germany, from 1–2 December. The event brings together C-Suite executives, VPs, and Directors from diverse sectors, including life sciences, automotive, and aerospace. The agenda will explore critical themes such as Industry 4.0, AI in manufacturing, sustainable lean culture, and smart factory solutions. Speakers, all C-Suite and VP-level, will share practical insights.

Participants will find opportunities for direct engagement, including over 100 pre-arranged one-on-one business meetings with approximately 20 specialized solution providers in automation, digital transformation, and operational excellence. The program aims to provide executives with strategies to enhance efficiency, drive innovation, and build resilient operations.

events.name: Data + AI World Tour - Government Washington D.C. 2026
events.description:
Government leaders and data professionals are invited to unlock the transformative power of data and AI at the Data + AI World Tour – Government Washington D.C. 2026. This event, held on December 1, 2026, at the Walter E. Washington Convention Center, is specifically tailored for individuals working within the public sector.

Participants will explore current advancements in data analytics and artificial intelligence. The discussions will center on understanding how these technologies can be applied to enhance public services, improve operational efficiency, and support more informed decision-making. Executive Roundtables are also scheduled, providing a forum for high-level discussions and strategic insights shared among peers and experts.

The gathering offers a chance to connect with other government innovators, discover practical applications, and contribute to the development of public service through intelligent data strategies.

events.name: VoiceAI Space Paris 2026
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the cutting edge of conversational technology at VoiceAI Space Paris 2026. This event features a dedicated 'One Day of Voice AI,' scheduled for December 1-3, 2026, at the CNIT FOREST in Puteaux. This day offers a focused exploration of the changing world of Voice AI.

As a track within the FOST conference, the day's agenda includes expert talks, live demonstrations of new developments, and practical workshops. Participants can learn about recent advancements, consider future trends, and engage with leaders in the field. The gathering is primarily for speakers, moderators, and partners, and aims to provide valuable perspectives for individuals leading Voice AI development.

A regular ticket costs €499. The event contributes to ongoing discussions about the future of voice-powered interactions.

events.name: Chief Product Officer Summit London 2026
events.description:
On December 2, 2026, London's Intercontinental - The O2 will host the Chief Product Officer Summit, an exclusive, hand-selected gathering for C-suite product leaders. This event offers a setting for Chief Product Officers and senior management to engage in peer-level conversations and explore strategic connections.

Participants will explore forward-thinking strategies and gain insights to develop leading products, build effective teams, and create lasting impact. The discussions will cover key areas, including designing data-driven growth models, innovating with AI and new technologies, and expanding product organizations globally.

events.name: Future Labs, Automation & Technology Europe 2026
events.description:
Prepare to explore the forefront of scientific advancement at Future Labs, Automation & Technology Europe 2026. This event, organized by AMG World, takes place in London on December 1, 2026. It will convene innovators and leaders to discuss how automation and advanced technologies are reshaping the future of laboratories.

Those attending will learn about optimizing lab operations, strengthening research capabilities, and improving efficiency through advanced solutions. The discussions will highlight developments in areas such as AI, robotics, data analytics, and smart lab infrastructure, all contributing to the advancement of scientific discovery.
