This online event, taking place in December 2026, is for compliance professionals looking to deepen their understanding of the Home Mortgage Disclosure Act. Attendees will learn about current regulations, new developments, and practical approaches to help ensure compliance and manage risk in their organizations.

The exact date in December and the full agenda, including speakers and specific topics, will be shared shortly. This webinar will provide valuable insights for keeping up with changes in HMDA.

events.name: Polymer Engineering for Energy 2026
events.description:
Delve into the critical role of advanced polymer solutions at Polymer Engineering for Energy 2026, taking place over two days in London, UK. The event brings together industry leaders, operators, and experts to explore the latest advancements in non-metallic materials, relevant to oil, gas, and the global energy transition.

Participants can expect to hear from expert speakers, including members of the Industry Expert Advisory Board from companies such as Petrobras and ExxonMobil. Discussions will cover optimizing material performance in harsh environments and addressing the shift towards renewable energy sources.

An exhibition will showcase new products and technologies. It also provides an opportunity to connect with peers and colleagues from across the energy supply chain. This gathering is for professionals focused on diversifying energy solutions and improving material performance within the changing energy sector.

events.name: Secura Algeria 2026
events.description:
Secura Algeria 2026, taking place from December 1-3 at SAFEX (Palestine Hall) in Algiers, stands as the region's leading International Fire, Safety, Security, and Emergency Exhibition. This three-day event is expected to gather approximately 5,000 professionals and key figures from industrial, commercial, and homeland security, occupational safety, firefighting, cybersecurity, and emergency response.

The program includes a comprehensive conference where industry experts will discuss innovation, new technologies, and Algeria's strategic vision. A new feature, 'Lighting & Intelligent building,' will highlight smart automation and energy-efficient solutions. To support attendees, a dedicated mobile app will be available, designed to facilitate networking and help manage individual schedules.

Secura Algeria 2026 is co-located with SINAA Expo Industries and Empack Algeria. This arrangement provides a broader context for learning, collaboration, and professional development across these important sectors.

events.name: STEP 2026

location.venue: Paris Expo Porte de Versailles – Hall 1

events.description:
Mark your calendars for STEP 2026, the premier European Ecological Transformation Exhibition by Pollutec, taking place on 1-2 December 2026 at Paris Expo Porte de Versailles – Hall 1.

Under the High Patronage of Monsieur Emmanuel Macron, President of the French Republic, the event will explore Decarbonization and the Circular Economy, themes considered essential for industrial performance and territorial resilience. The exhibition anticipates 9,000 professional participants and 200 exhibitors, including industrialists, eco-industrialists, local authorities, and investors, all contributing to the ecological transition.

Over two days, the program will feature 35 plenary conferences designed to explore key trends. Attendees can also engage in workshops and discover innovations presented in the Startups and Recycling Villages. With over 750 business meetings expected, the exhibition provides a setting for exchanging insights with experts, fostering crucial networks, and enhancing efficiency and competitiveness within French and Northern European markets.

events.name: Microgrid and Energy Storage Innovation Forum 2026
events.description:
The 21st Microgrid and Energy Storage Innovation Forum 2026, set for December 1-2 in Chicago, is the essential gathering for global leaders driving the future of energy. This forum will examine how new revenue streams and business models, such as Energy-as-a-Service, can be developed. It will also address the crucial need for resilience and faster progress towards decarbonization, aiming for continuous clean power.

Discussions will cover the integration of advanced technologies, including AI for energy management, long-duration storage solutions, and sophisticated distributed energy resource (DER) orchestration. Participants will also explore strategies for rapid, intelligent scaling, understanding evolving policy landscapes, and the significant electrification growth driven by data centers.

The forum provides an opportunity to connect directly with executives, developers, utility representatives, and innovators. These interactions are designed to foster new partnerships and share practical knowledge that will contribute to the development of sustainable energy systems.

events.name: Gartner IT Infrastructure, Operations & Cloud Strategies Conference Tokyo 2026
events.description:
Elevate your IT infrastructure, operations, and cloud strategies at the Gartner IT Infrastructure, Operations & Cloud Strategies Conference Tokyo 2026, taking place December 1-3 at The Westin Tokyo.

The conference is intended for leaders focused on transforming their organizations and developing resilient, forward-thinking teams.

Attendees will have opportunities to gain insights from 17 Gartner analysts, including personalized one-on-one discussions. The agenda covers current research in areas such as Agentic AI, cloud platform transformation, and infrastructure modernization. The event also provides a setting to connect with over 740 peers and explore solutions from more than 35 providers in the Exhibit Showcase. Discussions and presentations aim to help organizations address cost optimization, enhance security measures, and prepare for future disruptions, contributing to long-term readiness.

events.name: Clinical Trials in Oncology Europe 2026
events.description:
Clinical Trials in Oncology and Rare Diseases Europe 2026 offers a critical two-day forum for C-Suite and Director-level executives in clinical operations. Taking place on 1-2 December at the Munich Marriott Hotel City West, the discussions will address key operational challenges and innovative approaches in developing oncology and rare disease treatments.

The program includes parallel sessions, allowing attendees to explore specific areas such as AI integration, the role of biomarkers, and navigating complex regulatory environments, including the MHRA's proposed rare disease framework. Over 20 expert speakers, including Harald Enzmann from BfArM, will contribute to these discussions. Participants can expect to gain practical insights into patient recruitment, adaptive trial designs, and resource optimization.

events.name: EXPONAVAL 2026
events.description:
The premier international exhibition for the naval and maritime-port industries, EXPONAVAL 2026, returns to Espacio Riesco, Santiago - Chile, from December 1 to 3. This event gathers leading experts and companies to discuss the future of maritime and naval security, strategic autonomy, and shipbuilding plans.

The International Congress will feature Sir Tony Radakin, former Chief of the Defence Staff of the United Kingdom, who will share his perspective on global challenges. Attendees will find opportunities for networking, presenting new technologies, and engaging in focused meetings with national and international official delegations. The exhibition floor will showcase recent innovations in unmanned technologies and defense solutions, facilitating connections with over 100 exhibiting companies and thousands of professional visitors from 43 countries.

events.name: SINAA Expo Industries 2026
events.description:
The 5th International Industry show in Algeria, SINAA Expo Industries 2026, is set to be the definitive gathering for industrial innovation from December 01 to 03, 2026. The event will take place at SAFEX (Palestine Hall) and the Algiers Exhibition Centre in Algiers. It is expected to bring together more than 6,000 visitors and over 100 exhibitors.

The show aims to be a central point, offering "All solutions for factory productivity" and meeting the varied requirements of Algerian manufacturers and investors. Held alongside Secura Algeria and Empack Algeria, the expo presents a broad scope across 15 industrial sectors, ranging from traditional manufacturing to digital factory concepts.

A three-day conference program will allow participants to hear from experts on topics such as innovation, new technologies, and project financing. The event provides an opportunity to see new solutions, make professional connections, and gather information that supports industrial development.

events.name: Small Business Expo Houston 2026
events.description:
Prepare to elevate your business at the Small Business Expo Houston 2026, scheduled for December 2, 2026, at the NRG Convention Center. Small business owners, startup founders, and professionals looking to expand their network and find practical strategies for growth will find value in attending.

The event offers various ways to connect with others, including speed networking sessions and the "Get Dotted®" badge system for making industry-specific connections. Experts will lead interactive seminars and workshops, covering essential topics such as marketing insights, financial planning, AI-powered tools, and e-commerce.

Attendees can explore the exhibitor hall to discover new vendors and services. Keynote speakers, including Dave Charest of Constant Contact and and Max Chacon from Amazon Seller Relations, will share their perspectives. The goal is to help businesses increase revenue, operate more efficiently, and maintain a competitive edge. General admission is free.

events.name: Health Tech Forward 2026
events.description:
Chart the course for the next decade of health and wellness at Health Tech Forward 2026, Europe's premier gathering for innovation and investment. On December 2-3, the Palau de Congressos de Barcelona will bring together health tech entrepreneurs, investors, and industry leaders for two days of focused interaction.

Participants can expect over 3,000 pre-arranged one-on-one meetings, designed to build meaningful connections that support business development. The program includes keynote presentations, panel discussions, fireside chats, and startup pitch battles, offering a look at emerging companies.

Attendees will explore current market trends and technologies shaping the future of health. There will also be opportunities to experience Barcelona's atmosphere during evening gatherings. The event serves as a forum for those involved in advancing health technology.

events.name: Insurtech Insights Asia 2026
events.description:
Hong Kong is gearing up to host Asia's largest insurance conference, Insurtech Insights Asia 2026, from December 2-3 at the Kerry Hotel. The conference expects to bring together over 5,000 industry leaders. Attendees will hear from more than 300 speakers and participate in thousands of discussions and connections.

This gathering is for insurers, insurtech companies, and investors, exploring key areas like Artificial Intelligence, intelligent underwriting, customer engagement strategies, and digital transformation. Participants can expect to find new ideas, form valuable collaborations, and examine the latest innovations shaping the insurance sector in Asia and globally.

The event also includes a trade exhibition. With support from InvestHK, it serves as a significant forum for industry development.

events.name: Educatech Expo 2026
events.description:
The future of learning unfolds at Educatech Expo 2026, a pivotal event for digital educational innovation.

From December 2nd to 4th, Paris Expo Porte de Versailles will be the gathering point for teachers, school leaders, local authorities, and EdTech innovators. Those attending can examine technological solutions, connected equipment, and collaborative approaches that are shaping education and lifelong learning.

The event's program features plenary conferences, an Innovation Hub, and the Agora EdTech France. These components collectively explore the integration of human, collective, and artificial intelligences within learning environments. Participants will have opportunities to hear from experts and observe new tools. An Afterwork event on December 2nd provides a setting for informal conversations among attendees, all contributing to discussions about the future of education.

events.name: OEB Conference 2026
events.description:
From 2-4 December 2026, the InterContinental Berlin, Germany, will host the 32nd annual OEB Conference, a global, cross-sector exhibition dedicated to digital learning.

The focus this year is 'Humanity in the Intelligent Age: Empathy, Responsibility, and the Duty of Care.' This theme brings together individuals from education, technology, and learning across six continents to examine how AI and automation are reshaping our world. Discussions will center on guiding the future of learning, ensuring technology remains a tool for human benefit, and prioritizing people in all advancements.

Participants will engage with new ideas and approaches that broaden what's possible in learning, improve educational experiences, and help navigate both the complexities and potential of our increasingly intelligent era.

events.name: International Workboat Show 2026

location.venue: New Orleans Ernest N. Morial Convention Center

events.description:
New Orleans will once again host the International Workboat Show, docking at the Morial Convention Center from December 2-4, 2026. This three-day event typically brings together over 13,000 maritime professionals, including commercial vessel owners, engineers, shipbuilders, and government officials.

The expo floor will feature over 1,000 exhibitors presenting developments in marine technology, from uncrewed vessels to advanced patrol craft. A conference program will offer insights into topics like offshore energy, shipbuilding, and vessel operations. Discussions will also take place at the Women in Maritime Summit, alongside updates on U.S. shipbuilding and opportunities to meet with decision-makers during Government Maritime Acquisition Day.

events.name: ACTE's CareerTech VISION 2026
events.description:
Join the nation's leading Career and Technical Education (CTE) professionals at ACTE's CareerTech VISION 2026, from December 2-5, 2026, at the Ernest N. Morial Convention Center in New Orleans, LA. This year, the event also serves as ACTE's Centennial Celebration, marking a significant milestone in the history of career and technical education.

Participants will find a wide range of sessions, offering insights from presenters on current CTE advancements and effective practices. The accompanying Expo allows for the discovery of new tools and resources, alongside opportunities to engage with professionals from various industry sectors.

This gathering provides a setting for professional development and connecting with peers. It's a chance to reflect on the progress of career and technical education over the past hundred years and contribute to its ongoing evolution.

events.name: Holiday Showcase 2026
events.description:
Prepare to redefine the future of association leadership at Holiday Showcase 2026, hosted by Association Forum on December 3-4. This two-day gathering brings together hundreds of association professionals and industry partners, providing opportunities for learning, networking, and exploring an exhibit hall.

The event's theme, 'ICONIC: Redefining Association Leadership in 2026,' guides participants through discussions on innovation, inclusivity, and influence in key areas. The program explores actionable strategies in timeless leadership, transformative technology, limitless education, reinvented revenue streams, and reimagined membership models.

Attendees can earn up to 9.16 CEUs, connect with peers, and gather new ideas to support their organization's mission. This annual event offers a chance to reflect, recharge, and consider how to lead with greater impact.

events.name: Business Book of The Year Award 2026
events.description:
Celebrating the most impactful business literature of our time, the 22nd edition of the Business Book of The Year Award, presented by the Financial Times and Standard Chartered, reaches its pinnacle in December 2026. This award highlights exceptional writing that provides fresh insights into today's critical economic and business challenges. A panel of global leaders, including Roula Khalaf and Mohamed El-Erian, will carefully select the winning title.

The path to the final announcement begins with the longlist reveal on August 17, followed by a livestreamed shortlist announcement on October 6. The author of the winning book, who will receive £30,000, will be announced at an invitation-only dinner in London on December 2. Each author whose book makes the shortlist also receives £10,000.

This year also marks the return of the Bracken Prize for Young Authors, an initiative focused on supporting the next generation of business thinkers.

events.name: The Buildings Show 2026
events.description:
Step into the future of the built environment at The Buildings Show 2026, North America's largest event for the industry.

Attendees can expect to find hundreds of product and service providers, learn about new solutions, and meet experts in various fields. The program also includes more than 120 accredited educational sessions and workshops, offering a chance to deepen professional understanding.

This 2.5-day gathering provides a setting for people to connect, share insights, and consider how to move forward in property management, design, construction, and renovation.

events.name: ITW Asia 2026

Attendees will include more than 1500 leaders from around the world, representing carriers, hyperscalers, cloud solution providers, investors, and regulatory bodies. The event is held alongside Datacloud Asia and infraXchange Asia, offering a space for professionals to engage in discussions, explore new business opportunities, and contribute to the ongoing development of connectivity throughout the Asia-Pacific region.

events.name: Barron’s Advisor Women Summit 2026
events.description:
The Barron’s Advisor Women Summit 2026, taking place from December 2-4 at The Breakers in Palm Beach, FL, is an exclusive, invitation-only gathering for 700 of the nation's most successful female financial advisors. These women collectively manage around $1 trillion in assets, representing a significant force in wealth management and demonstrating exceptional leadership.

The program will feature insights from leading industry professionals, CEOs, and founders. Discussions will explore key areas such as business development, client service, investment strategies, and leadership. Attendees can expect candid conversations, panel discussions, and breakout sessions, with many opportunities to earn CE credits.

The summit aims to create an environment where participants can learn from their peers, build valuable connections, and support their strategic growth. It offers a space for sharing ideas and insights that will help shape the future of the financial advisory profession.

events.name: Cruise Ship Interiors Design Expo Europe 2026

Visitors can explore more than 300 design studios, outfitters, and interior suppliers, seeing the latest innovations and creative solutions for ocean, river, and expedition cruise projects. events.name: NGPX 2026
events.description:

Attendees will explore fresh perspectives and practical approaches to foster innovation and enhance patient well-being. It's an opportunity to connect with a diverse group of patient experience leaders, discuss current industry challenges, and examine emerging technologies.

Participants will explore how to streamline buying journeys, maximize customer value, and leverage Agentic AI to boost productivity and personalization. The gathering offers a chance for benchmarking, networking, and acquiring actionable strategies aimed at reducing costs and accelerating growth.

events.name: Chicago CISO Community Executive Summit Winter 2026
events.description:

events.name: MIPIM Asia Summit 2026
events.description:

events.name: SportsPro Media summit Madrid 2026

Through thoughtfully planned sessions and insights from prominent figures, participants will have the opportunity to connect with peers, explore new ideas, and contribute to the ongoing development of sports content worldwide.

events.name: SuperReturn Japan 2026

events.name: Toronto CISO Community Executive Summit Winter 2026

events.name: Sales Enablement Summit London 2026

events.name: LOUPE South China 2026

events.name: Customer Marketing Summit London 2026

events.name: Product Operations Summit London 2026

events.name: NHLA Technology Conference 2026

This DC Finance event brings together more than 150 high net worth individuals and family office executives to connect and engage with high-quality discussions.

Taking place during Art Basel Week, the conference combines discussions on wealth management and family business with opportunities to experience luxury art and lifestyle. Attendees will hear from notable speakers, including former 7-Eleven CEO James W. Keyes and Miami Mayor Francis Suarez, who will discuss topics such as entrepreneurship, AI, and philanthropy.

The week's activities also include private dinners, visits to art fairs, and yacht parties. These events offer a setting for both professional development and social engagement.

events.name: ALFI Roadshow to Paris 2026
events.description:
Prepare to delve into the evolving landscape of European and Luxembourg fund markets at the ALFI Roadshow to Paris in December 2026. This half-day, in-person seminar takes place in a major financial hub and is intended for professionals throughout the asset management and investment fund value chain.

Attendees can expect to receive important updates on industry developments. The event also provides opportunities for networking and fostering cooperation, offering a chance to explore new business avenues and strategize on enhancing market access for Luxembourg funds. Sessions will be conducted in English or French.

Priority registration is extended to local fund professionals and sponsors. This approach helps ensure a focused environment for high-level discussions and strategic connections among participants.

events.name: Digital Resilience Day 2026
events.description:
Prepare to shape the future of European technology at Digital Resilience Day 2026, hosted by FOST in Paris on December 2-3. This event, held at CNIT FOREST, brings together tech decision-makers and practitioners around the call to "Stop Renting Europe's future. Build it." The focus is on constructing a robust EU Future Stack, exploring strategies for digital autonomy and resilience.

Over two days, participants will find opportunities for collaboration, innovation, and strategic discussions. It's a significant gathering for anyone dedicated to strengthening Europe's technology against emerging challenges, working towards a secure and independent digital future. The aim is to foster discussions that lead to practical understanding and advance the continent's digital independence.

events.name: TechLeader Summit 2026
events.description:
An exclusive gathering for software engineering and technical leaders, the TechLeader Summit 2026, presented by No Fluff Just Stuff, offers a masterclass in organizational leverage. This event takes place from December 2-4, 2026, at the Opal Sands Resort in Clearwater, FL. It aims to move beyond superficial discussions, focusing instead on the critical leadership challenges faced in an AI-first world. The summit is designed for a select group of leaders, with attendance kept small to foster focused interaction.

The program centers on practical approaches to architecting change, sharpening leadership instincts, and developing strategies for high-performing engineering cultures. Attendees will delve into actionable solutions concerning AI adoption, talent retention, and agile methodologies across thirty in-depth sessions led by experienced professionals. To ensure an environment dedicated solely to learning, the summit operates as a "Vendor Free Zone," meaning no sales pitches will interrupt the educational focus.

Participants will also receive 15 Virtual Workshop Credits, intended to support their ongoing professional development.

events.name: Building Material & Housing Equipment Expo Tokyo 2026
events.description:
Discover the forefront of construction and housing innovation at the Building Material & Housing Equipment Expo Tokyo 2026. The expo takes place from December 2 to 4, 2026, at Tokyo Big Sight, as a key part of JAPAN BUILD – International Building & Home Week. Recognized as a significant gathering for Japan's building and housing industries, the event brings together 11 specialized shows.

Visitors can expect to see a wide range of innovations, from advanced building materials, smart home technologies, and green building solutions to housing DX, digital construction, and real estate technology.

It's an opportunity to meet with many industry professionals, including architects, developers, contractors, and real estate experts. This setting allows for discussions on current trends, finding new products, and developing collaborations. Organized by RX Japan, the event serves as a significant point of reference for those involved in the future of the built environment.

events.name: Commodities Asia Summit 2026
events.description:
Navigating the complexities of a rapidly evolving global landscape, the Financial Times Live presents the seventh annual Commodities Asia Summit 2026 in Singapore this December. This gathering will bring together more than 350 senior executives, investors, and policymakers. Their focus will be on understanding how war, economic shocks, and geopolitical tensions are reshaping global commodity markets.

Attendees will explore approaches to strengthening supply chains, managing new risks, and defining Asia’s significant role within a fragmented global economy. Discussions will cover key areas, ranging from energy security and the competition for critical minerals to the influence of AI trading tools and the shift towards renewables as a means to reduce import dependency. The summit aims to facilitate strategic conversations for a resilient and sustainable future.

events.name: ASGSR Conference 2026
events.description:
Prepare to explore the frontiers of discovery at the ASGSR Conference 2026, set to convene in Crystal City, VA. This annual gathering brings together members of the American Society for Gravitational and Space Research, students, and the broader space research community to share and discuss ideas.

The program includes a range of oral and poster presentations, and abstract submissions are currently open. Beyond the presentations, the conference also offers pre-conference workshops and an art competition, encouraging both creative expression and scientific thought.

With a focus on supporting students in STEAM fields, the event provides opportunities for networking, collaboration, and furthering our understanding of space and gravitational phenomena. It's an occasion for individuals to connect with peers, share significant research, and contribute to inspiring future innovators.

events.name: Customer Success Summit London 2026
events.description:
The Customer Success Summit London 2026, held on December 02 & 03 at the InterContinental - The O2, offers an unparalleled opportunity to redefine your customer success approach. Attendees will include over 150 customer success leaders and experienced professionals from more than 120 organizations. The discussions will center on practical strategies for improving customer retention, encouraging growth, and reducing churn.

Participants will explore how to use AI and predictive analytics to enhance customer interactions, personalize experiences more broadly, and ensure customers consistently find value throughout their journey. The program features insights from over 30 industry experts. They will discuss topics such as finding the right balance between automation and personal customer support, refining the onboarding process, and building stronger collaboration across teams.

This is an opportunity to refine skills, gain new insights, and connect with peers. The aim is to help professionals strengthen their approach to customer success and highlight its importance within their organizations.

events.name: IPE Conference & Awards 2026

location.venue: Royal College of Physicians & Natural History Museum

events.description:
Mark your calendar for the IPE Conference & Awards 2026, Europe's largest annual gathering of pension funds, taking place on Wednesday 2 December in London.

This event brings together 300 executives and decision-makers from Europe's diverse pensions industry. Attendees will convene at two distinct venues: the Royal College of Physicians and the Natural History Museum. The conference program features in-depth discussions, keynote presentations, and practical panels.

Topics explored will include AI and innovation, impact investing, risk management, carbon and net zero strategies, active and passive management, and private markets. The day concludes with the IPE European Pension Fund Awards, a ceremony that recognizes significant achievements and sets new standards for excellence within Europe's pension landscape.

events.name: Building Renovation Expo Tokyo 2026
events.description:
Explore the forefront of property enhancement at the Building Renovation Expo Tokyo 2026, held from December 2 to 4 at Tokyo Big Sight. As part of the larger JAPAN BUILD exhibition, this event focuses on advanced solutions for renovating buildings and commercial facilities. It brings together professionals, including general contractors, architectural design offices, developers, and facility management companies, who are looking for the latest trends and technologies.

The expo will feature discussions and displays on innovative renovation design and construction, modern approaches to water supply and drainage pipe repair, and drone-based exterior wall inspections. Attendees can also see new decorative building materials and security robots. These advancements contribute to improving property value and operational efficiency. The event offers a chance to meet with industry leaders and understand future directions in renovation practices.

events.name: VdS-FireSafety Cologne 2026
events.description:
The global hub for preventive fire protection, VdS-FireSafety Cologne 2026, opens its doors on December 02-03 at Koelnmesse, Hall 10.2. This international trade fair and conference brings together professionals interested in the newest developments in fire safety. Visitors can explore new technologies and solutions presented by over 180 exhibitors, and connect with specialists from more than 30 countries.

Across the two days, six VdS specialist conferences will offer more than 100 expert talks covering system, structural, and organizational fire protection. Attendees can participate in discussions at the VdS-FireSafety Talk, learn about upcoming trends at the Future Forum Fire Protection, and see new technologies demonstrated live.

The event provides an environment for sharing knowledge, building professional connections, and supporting career growth within the fire protection industry.

events.name: Cyberriskalliance Cloud Security Cybersecurity Summit 2026
events.description:
Cloud security takes the agenda for this one-day virtual summit on 2 December 2026, part of CyberRisk Alliance's Official Cybersecurity Summit series. Sessions run 11:00 to 16:00 Eastern, with admission at $95 and CPE/CEU credits available to anyone who completes the full day and confirms attendance.

Discussion covers multi-cloud security governance, cloud security posture management, identity and data protection, workload security, threat detection, and reducing risk across distributed cloud environments.

Attendance is restricted to active cybersecurity, IT and information security practitioners defending their own organizations; students, educators and sales or marketing roles are not eligible, and every registration is reviewed in advance to keep the group small enough for genuine peer exchange. V. Venesulia Carr of Vicar Group moderates. Google Cloud, Wiz, Datadog and Veeam appear among the sponsors.

events.name: Oh My Hack 2026
events.description:
Elevate your cybersecurity expertise at Oh My Hack 2026, returning for its 8th edition on December 2, 2026, at PGE Narodowy in Warsaw, Poland. The day brings together professionals and enthusiasts from ICT, security, finance, and administration, offering practical knowledge relevant to their fields.

Adam Haertle from Zaufana Trzecia Strona has shaped the program, ensuring its depth. Speakers will share real-world examples and practical perspectives. Attendees will have opportunities to engage with experts, explore red and blue team concepts, and refine skills crucial for professional growth. It's also a setting to connect with many industry peers, build new professional relationships, and receive a certificate of attendance.

events.name: MSGBC Oil, Gas & Power Conference 2026

location.venue: CICAD - Centre International de Conférences Abdou Diouf

events.description:
Set in Dakar, Senegal, the MSGBC Oil, Gas & Power Conference 2026 offers unparalleled access to West Africa's dynamic energy landscape. This event brings together industry leaders, investors, and government representatives from the Mauritania, Senegal, The Gambia, Guinea-Bissau, and Guinea-Conakry basin.

Discussions will explore a range of investment prospects. These include innovative gas pipeline projects aimed at Europe, ambitious green hydrogen initiatives, and substantial downstream ventures such as the planned Urea Plant and the SAR 2 Refinery Program. The agenda also covers solar energy developments and efforts to enhance maritime capabilities within the region.

Those attending will have the chance to build collaborations, gain a deeper understanding of regional integration efforts, and contribute to conversations about the MSGBC region's potential as a global gas hub. The conference aims to help shape the future direction of the continent's energy sector.

events.name: Data Management Insight Awards Europe 2026
events.description:
The search for Europe's most impactful data management innovators is officially underway with the 5th annual Data Management Insight Awards Europe 2026. A-Team Insight organizes these awards to recognize leading providers of solutions, services, and consultancy. These are the organizations making a significant impact on capital markets across the continent.

The awards offer an opportunity to acknowledge excellence, from established industry leaders to innovative new entrants. Individuals can vote to highlight those driving data innovation within Europe's financial sector. Voting concludes on Friday, October 2nd, 2026, at 5:00 PM UK time.

The winners will be announced on Wednesday, December 2nd, 2026, during a live event in London. This occasion will recognize the individuals and companies shaping the future of data management.

events.name: Insurance Investor Live North America 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for December 2nd and 3rd, 2026, as the North American insurance investment community converges in New York City. Insurance Investor Live North America 2026 brings together professionals who manage insurance investments, capital, and the associated risks and operations. Held at Well& by Durst, this two-day event provides a forum for senior leaders to share perspectives and engage in strategic conversations.

Participants will explore current market trends, regulatory changes, and new approaches to managing portfolios and mitigating risk. The event concludes on December 3rd with The Insurance Investor | North American Awards 2026, recognizing achievements in the industry. It's an opportunity to connect with colleagues and contribute to discussions about the direction of insurance asset management.

events.name: Health 2.0 Conference Singapore 2026
events.description:
From December 02 to 04, 2026, Singapore will host the Health 2.0 Conference, a pivotal three-day summit themed "The Heart Of Healing In A High-Tech World." This event gathers innovators, clinicians, policymakers, and health tech experts to discuss how technology and empathy meet to improve patient care and influence the future of healthcare worldwide.

The program includes discussions and presentations on subjects like AI for affordability and diagnostics, mental health challenges, advances in women's health, and the future of longevity. The focus is on innovation, collaboration, and compassion, providing a setting for diverse healthcare and wellness professionals to connect, share ideas, and explore potential collaborations.

events.name: CSO 360 Global Congress 2026
events.description:
The CSO 360 Global Congress 2026, taking place in Copenhagen, Denmark, from December 2-4, 2026, is an essential gathering for global leaders in corporate security, resilience, and investigations. This event offers a focused opportunity to explore the complex and ever-changing landscape of threats, addressing both current priorities and new challenges emerging throughout the year.

Discussions will delve into crucial areas such as proactive threat mitigation, understanding geopolitical risks, and developing strategies to build resilience against civil unrest and terrorism. The agenda also includes climate and crisis management, ensuring the safety of global operations through effective supply chain risk management, and examining how physical, reputational, and digital incidents increasingly converge.

Through practical sessions like Case Stories and Playbook Tables, participants will have the chance to connect with their peers, sharpen their strategic decision-making skills, and strengthen their organizations' ability to withstand future threats.

events.name: Africa Bitcoin Conference 2026
events.description:
Africa's largest convergence of Bitcoin enthusiasts, innovators, and decision-makers will take place in Blantyre, Malawi, from December 2nd to 5th, 2026. This four-day event will explore how Bitcoin can support fundamental freedoms, strengthen economic autonomy, and foster lasting sovereignty across the continent.

Participants will connect with activists, influential thinkers, and pioneering entrepreneurs, all working to ensure Africa's voice is heard within the global Bitcoin discussion. The conference will feature many insightful speakers, alongside opportunities for organizations to host panels, workshops, and related events. It provides a setting to connect, learn, and collectively shape Africa's Bitcoin future, encouraging innovation and economic progress.

events.name: GlobeSt. Healthcare Real Estate 2026
events.description:
The future of healthcare real estate takes center stage at GlobeSt. Healthcare Real Estate 2026, held December 2-3, 2026, at the Grand Hyatt Scottsdale Resort in Scottsdale, AZ. This two-day event brings together owners, investors, developers, lenders, and healthcare systems to discuss the rapid changes happening in the sector.

Discussions will delve into key areas such as capital markets, emerging technology, the expansion of outpatient services, and new models for delivering care. These topics will be explored across two mainstage panels, three specialized tracks, and six executive breakout sessions. Given the sector's projected 6.2% annual growth and record occupancy in medical office buildings, participants can expect to learn about current design trends and effective investment strategies.

The event offers opportunities to connect with senior decision-makers and industry leaders. Conversations will focus on navigating cost inflation and understanding how to best utilize new technologies, helping participants make informed decisions in a changing market.

events.name: Real Estate Forum Toronto 2026
events.description:
Dubbed the "Super Bowl of Canadian commercial real estate," the Real Estate Forum Toronto 2026 is set to be the industry's most significant gathering. The forum, held in Toronto from December 1-4, 2026, as part of Canadian Real Estate and Construction Week, brings together more than 2,800 senior executives, owners, developers, and investors. Among those attending are over 1,300 C-level and V-level executives, who will find opportunities to clarify strategic directions and build valuable relationships.

Sarah Esler and Rob Kumer, both recognized industry leaders, co-chair the forum. Their agenda covers more than 20 key topics, ranging from market shifts and investment strategies to the impact of emerging technologies. Beyond the main sessions, participants can also visit co-located events such as The Buildings Show and Data Center World Canada.

The forum provides a setting for senior decision-makers to consider new insights, helping them make informed choices and anticipate future trends within the Canadian commercial real estate sector.

events.name: IASR International Conference on Forensic Science 2026
events.description:
The 7th International Forensic & 17th IASR Conference – FORENSIC NEXGEN SUMMIT 2026 invites you to New Delhi, India, from December 7th to 9th, 2026.

The conference will be hosted at the Vallabhbhai Patel Chest Institute, University of Delhi. Its central theme, "Shaping the Future of Global Investigation Standards," underscores the event's focus on advancing forensic practices worldwide. This gathering is intended for forensic professionals, researchers, and students globally, offering a space to explore new developments and share insights across diverse disciplines.

The summit's scope includes critical areas such as Cyber & Digital Forensics, Forensic Medicine, Anthropology, and Crime Scene Investigation. Attendees have the opportunity to present their research through papers and posters, with accepted works slated for publication in IASR journals, including the Academic Journal of Forensic Science. The event facilitates engagement with prominent figures in the field and supports contributions to the evolution of global forensic methodologies.

events.name: Build Stuff Software Development conference 2026
events.description:
Prepare for the future of software development at Build Stuff Software Development conference 2026, happening December 2–4 in Vilnius, Lithuania, with comprehensive online access. The conference theme, "THE AGE OF AGENCY: Build Intelligence. Keep Human Agency," will explore the essential balance between autonomous software and human judgment.

The program features 84 speakers presenting 103 sessions across six stages. These sessions emphasize practical outcomes, working code, and live demonstrations. Discussions will bring together developers, architects, and tech leaders from around the world, covering topics such as AI-Native Development, Software Architecture, Cybersecurity, and Engineering Leadership.

Beyond the formal sessions, attendees will find opportunities for networking, social activities, and the well-known Build Stuff party. The aim is to provide insights into building intelligent systems responsibly and contributing to the evolution of software development.

events.name: New York Forum on Economic Sanctions 2026
events.description:
Navigating the complexities of global economic sanctions and export controls is paramount for today's compliance professionals. The New York Forum on Economic Sanctions 2026 will gather senior leaders in sanctions, legal, and financial crime from December 1-3 at the New York City Bar. Discussions will focus on enforcement priorities, policy developments, and the geopolitical risks that are shaping the landscape for 2027.

The program offers perspectives on managing regulatory divergence, combating illicit finance, and integrating AI into compliance programs. Key jurisdictions will be explored, alongside specific topics such as digital assets, including the GENIUS Act, and issues related to China, including the COINS Act. Pre-conference workshops are also part of the schedule.

Attendees will have opportunities to engage with government officials and industry experts, facilitating peer-to-peer discussions. Continuing Legal Education (CLE) credits will be available.

events.name: KPMG Finance & Accounting Executive Symposium 2026
events.description:
Prepare to elevate your expertise at the 36th Annual KPMG Finance & Accounting Executive Symposium, taking place December 2-3, 2026, at the Fontainebleau Las Vegas, NV.

KPMG hosts this two-day event, designed for finance and accounting executives who are navigating today's complex business landscape. It brings together over 1200 professionals to discuss current challenges and future directions in the field.

Attendees can earn up to 15 Accounting CPE credits. The program explores recent developments, innovative ideas, and practical strategies, with discussions covering Generative AI for finance, SEC reporting, private company accounting, cybersecurity, and current financial accounting and reporting issues. The symposium provides an occasion to deepen understanding, expand professional connections, and gather practical advice for organizational growth.

events.name: Business Travel Hall of Fame 2026
events.description:
The business travel industry's most distinguished leaders will converge on December 2, 2026, at The Plaza Hotel in New York City for the 15th Annual Business Travel Hall of Fame induction ceremony. Organized by The BTN Group, this event honors five executives whose leadership and contributions have significantly influenced the modern business travel landscape. It's an occasion to acknowledge their achievements and the lasting impact they've had on how we approach corporate travel today.

The gathering also provides a setting for attendees to connect with colleagues and acknowledge the individuals who have driven innovation and excellence in the field. It's a chance to reflect on the progress made and to be inspired by those who continue to shape the future of business travel.

events.name: Elite CIO/CISO Boston 2026
events.description:
An exclusive evening awaits Boston's most influential technology executives at Elite CIO/CISO Boston 2026. On December 2, 2026, between 5:30 PM and 9:00 PM, the Boston Harbor Hotel will welcome an invitation-only group. This gathering is for CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, and VP/Director-level leaders from major enterprises.

The evening is structured to foster genuine peer-to-peer connection, moving away from formal panels or presentations. Guests will begin with cocktails and hors d'oeuvres, followed by structured networking sessions with partners. A relaxed dinner will conclude the event, featuring some friendly competition and prizes.

This provides senior IT leaders across retail, financial services, and other sectors a chance to build meaningful relationships and engage in high-level discussions. It's an evening designed for connection among peers in a private setting.

events.name: EMERGE Financial Health Europe 2026
events.description:
Senior leaders from across Europe's financial services, fintech, policy, and innovation sectors are invited to an exclusive, curated gathering on December 2, 2026. This event, EMERGE Financial Health Europe 2026, takes place at the KIT Royal Tropical Institute in Amsterdam. It is a focused discussion for influential decision-makers committed to advancing financial well-being.

The agenda will explore key areas: how financial health outcomes are defined and measured, the deliberate integration of financial health principles into product design and policy, and the responsible application of AI for innovation. Discussions will also cover strategies for public-private collaboration to expand solutions and ways to enhance financial resilience for households.

This gathering offers an environment for European and global leaders to connect, share insights, and contribute to the future direction of financial health.

events.name: Design X Architecture Summit 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendar for the Design X Architecture Summit 2026, the premier gathering for leading designers, architects, and developers.

The summit takes place on December 1, 2026, at 1 American Dream Way, East Rutherford, NJ. This full-day event, running from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM, is designed for exploring new ideas and fostering professional relationships. Attendees can participate in expert-led discussions on current trends and explore new products and technologies from exhibitors, including House Of Granite and Madera.

The day also features structured networking sessions, including a cocktail hour and dinner, allowing for direct connections with peers, potential collaborators, and industry leaders. The summit aims to provide a platform for professionals to enhance their understanding of the field, build meaningful connections, and remain informed about advancements in design and architecture.

events.name: Manufacturing Indonesia 2026
events.description:
Southeast Asia's premier manufacturing expo, Manufacturing Indonesia 2026, is set to return to JIEXPO KEMAYORAN from December 2-5, 2026. Over these four days, the event will feature cutting-edge products and technologies essential for the industry. Visitors can explore innovations in machinery, industrial automation, and production logistics.

The expo will also include co-located shows such as Machine Tool Indonesia and Tools & Hardware Indonesia. For 2026, new dedicated segments for Fastener Indonesia and Industrial Paint & Coatings Indonesia are being introduced, expanding the event's focus.

Manufacturing Indonesia 2026 will provide live demonstrations, expert insights, and opportunities for networking. The event also emphasizes sustainable business practices, aiming to contribute to the future of manufacturing.

events.name: WavEC Annual Seminar 2026
events.description:
On December 2nd, 2026, the WavEC Annual Seminar will gather the offshore renewable energy community at Lisbon's Museu do Oriente. This event, organized in partnership with the British Embassy Lisbon, focuses on advancing Floating Offshore Wind, providing a forum for knowledge exchange and collaboration.

Discussions will cover policy ambitions, project development, and innovations within the supply chain. Participants will draw on the UK's experience to inform Portugal's deployment strategies. The seminar will also explore floating wind's contribution to industrial capacity, skilled employment, and energy security, alongside technological advancements aimed at accelerating deployment and reducing associated risks.

The gathering offers an opportunity for professionals, researchers, and policymakers to connect and foster cooperation between Portugal and the UK. This seminar precedes the Nature+ Conference 2026, which will be held at the same location.

events.name: Pharma Outsourcing 2026
events.description:
Discover unparalleled opportunities in drug development at Pharma Outsourcing 2026, the 12th annual international partnering event. On December 2, 2026, Ahouse Hagastaden in Stockholm, a key location for life sciences, will welcome researchers, start-ups, biotech and pharma companies, and investment managers.

The event explores effective outsourcing strategies, supports collaborations, and helps move products from preclinical work through clinical trials. Participants can use the *Meeting Mojo* platform to arrange specific one-on-one meetings with service providers and potential partners.

The day concludes with an Annual Christmas Reception, providing an opportunity for further discussion and connection over traditional Swedish treats. Attendees can learn about innovative projects and best practices, and establish connections that support their work in the changing pharmaceutical landscape.

events.name: WealthBriefing Channel Islands Awards 2026
events.description:
Celebrating top-tier performance and groundbreaking innovation, the WealthBriefing Channel Islands Awards 2026 spotlights the leading firms and individuals within the wealth management, private client, and family office sectors across the Channel Islands. The annual program concludes with a cocktail reception and awards presentation on Wednesday, 2nd December 2026, at The Royal Yacht Hotel in St Helier, Jersey.

An independent panel of industry experts carefully evaluates submissions. This process ensures that exceptional achievements in client experience, technology, and leadership are recognized. Firms and professionals have the opportunity to highlight their work, with recognized contributions featured in the 'Annual Acclaim magazine' and across WealthBriefing's platforms.

events.name: ICCX Eurasia 2026
events.description:
Set to unfold on December 2-3, 2026, at the Royal Tulip Almaty in Kazakhstan, ICCX Eurasia 2026 stands as the essential platform for the concrete and precast concrete industry across Central Asia and Russian-speaking markets. This two-day gathering will bring together decision-makers, manufacturers, and suppliers to explore new developments and future directions within the sector.

The program includes discussions on topics such as 3D Concrete Printing, sustainable materials like Natural Zeolite, and advancements in industrialized precast concrete construction. Participants will also receive updates on Autoclaved Aerated Concrete (AAC) manufacturing and recent changes to construction laws in Kazakhstan.

The event features a trade exhibition, a conference with presentations from experts, and opportunities for professionals to connect. It provides a forum for industry leaders to exchange ideas and discuss the future of concrete and precast concrete.

events.name: TTI IZMIR 2026
events.description:
Set to unfold in the vibrant city of İzmir, TTI IZMIR 2026 will host its landmark 20th edition from December 2-4 at Fuarizmir. This International Tourism Trade Fair and Congress, recognized as Türkiye's largest tourism platform, brings together tourism professionals from around the world.

Participants will have the opportunity to explore the future of the sector through discussions held on the TTI STAGE. These conversations will focus on important topics such as sustainable tourism, the potential of health tourism, and new development strategies. The event typically gathers over 380 exhibitors and 12,500 visitors from more than 60 countries.

This environment encourages communication, helps establish business connections, and supports new collaborations. It's a place to discover the latest trends and contribute to İzmir's ambition to be an international tourism hub, helping to shape a sustainable future for the industry.

events.name: Smart Maintenance Expo Fukuoka 2026
events.description:
Set to revolutionize industrial efficiency, the Smart Maintenance Expo Fukuoka 2026 will convene from December 2-4, 2026, at Marine Messe Fukuoka, Japan. This event focuses on optimizing factory and equipment maintenance operations, aiming to significantly improve reliability, efficiency, and productivity across the manufacturing sector.

Professionals involved in factory management, maintenance, production engineering, and DX promotion will find opportunities to explore advanced solutions. The exhibits span a broad spectrum, from sophisticated facility management software and condition monitoring technology to inspection robots, non-destructive testing equipment, and vital maintenance parts and services.

Visitors can engage in direct discussions, facilitating introductions to new technologies, technical consultations, and arrangements for pricing and delivery. Additionally, expert-led conferences will offer deeper insights into the latest industry trends and innovations.

events.name: Mechanical Components & Technology Expo Fukuoka 2026
events.description:
Explore the forefront of industrial innovation at the Mechanical Components & Technology Expo Fukuoka 2026, held from December 2-4 at Marine Messe Fukuoka. This event focuses on developments in mechanical components, processing, and surface technologies. Attendees will find opportunities for business discussions, covering new technology introductions, pricing considerations, and technical consultations.

The expo features the "Production Innovation: Machine Tools & Cutting Tools Fair," showcasing the latest machining solutions. Additionally, "Semiconductor World Fukuoka" makes its debut, offering a dedicated platform for those working with semiconductor equipment development, smart factory solutions, and fab operations.

This gathering provides professionals in design, development, production, and procurement a chance to connect and gain insights into current industry advancements.

events.name: Measure/Test/Sensor Expo Fukuoka 2026
events.description:
From December 2-4, 2026, Marine Messe Fukuoka will host a pivotal event for the manufacturing sector: the Measure/Test/Sensor Expo Fukuoka 2026. This three-day exhibition explores advancements in precision and quality that shape modern manufacturing.

Visitors can explore recent innovations in measuring instruments, analysis tools, testing equipment, weighing solutions, and advanced sensors, along with cameras and industrial microscopes. The expo brings together companies showcasing these technologies with professionals from manufacturing, production engineering, quality assurance, maintenance, research, and design & development.

It provides a setting for introducing new technologies, demonstrating products, and discussing potential collaborations. The aim is to support ongoing improvements in operations and technological development within the industry.

events.name: JAPAN BUILD TOKYO 2026
events.description:
Experience the pinnacle of innovation for Japan's building and housing sectors at JAPAN BUILD TOKYO 2026, taking place December 2-4, 2026, at Tokyo Big Sight.

The event brings together 12 specialized exhibitions, providing a comprehensive look at what's next for the industry. Visitors can explore significant developments in areas like Smart Home technology, Housing DX, Green Building practices, and Construction Site Innovation. They will find the newest AI/IoT solutions, BIM technologies, sustainable materials, and advanced renovation techniques.

This gathering is designed for housing manufacturers, architects, developers, and real estate professionals. It offers an opportunity to find new solutions, understand market trends, and connect with peers.

events.name: Industrial ODM/EMS Expo Fukuoka 2026
events.description:
Accelerate your product development and manufacturing strategies at Industrial ODM/EMS Expo Fukuoka 2026, taking place from December 2-4 at Marine Messe Fukuoka. This three-day event serves as a meeting point for professionals in design, production engineering, procurement, and R&D to connect with leading Original Design Manufacturing (ODM) and Electronics Manufacturing Services (EMS) providers. It facilitates discussions and collaborations among these key industry players.

Attendees will find solutions across contract manufacturing, assembly, inspection, and consulting. The expo offers direct engagement with exhibitors, allowing for discussions on new technologies, technical consultations, and the finalization of pricing and delivery arrangements. A notable feature is its co-location with Semiconductor World Fukuoka, which hosts dedicated expos on Semiconductor Equipment Development and Smart Semiconductor Fab Operations. This combined event provides a comprehensive view for those aiming to optimize both product realization and advanced semiconductor manufacturing processes.

events.name: Hospitality Tech EXPO Tokyo 2026
events.description:
Pioneering the future of guest experiences, Hospitality Tech EXPO Tokyo 2026 debuts from December 2nd to 4th at Ariake GYM-EX. This new event is designed for management and staff in hotels, ryokans, restaurants, and DMOs, focusing on transforming the tourism and food & beverage industries. Those attending will explore solutions in AI, DX, and Robotics that can help address labor shortages, increase revenue, and improve how operations run.

The program will include lectures, exhibitor seminars, and case study presentations. Visitors can find specific areas dedicated to Tourism DX, Accommodation DX, and Food & Beverage DX, each focusing on how technology can support the human element of 'omotenashi'.

Advance registration is necessary to experience these advancements in hospitality.

events.name: Factory Facilities & Equipment Expo Fukuoka 2026
events.description:
From December 2-4, 2026, Marine Messe Fukuoka will host the Factory Facilities & Equipment Expo, a pivotal event for advancing manufacturing excellence.

This expo is a component of the broader "Manufacturing World" series, focusing on innovations that enhance factory safety, environmental performance, energy efficiency, and overall productivity. Attendees can explore the latest advancements in factory equipment, energy-saving solutions, logistics, maintenance strategies, and safety technologies.

The event runs concurrently with the new Semiconductor World Fukuoka, offering specialized insights into semiconductor manufacturing materials, processing, and smart factory operations. This arrangement provides a comprehensive experience for professionals in factory management, production, maintenance, and procurement who are looking to improve their industrial processes.

events.name: SwissITminds 2026
events.description:
Prepare for an exclusive executive exchange at SwissITminds 2026, taking place December 2–3 at The Dolder Grand Zurich. This two-day gathering is intended for CIOs, CISOs, IT Directors, and Information Security Executives from Swiss end-user organizations. Participation is complimentary for those who qualify.

The event moves beyond typical trade show formats, prioritizing genuine peer interaction and strategic conversations. Attendees will explore current challenges and advancements across IT, AI, and Cyber Security. The program includes keynotes from industry leaders, interactive Open Mind Space sessions, expert talks, and masterclasses.

Beyond the structured sessions, the agenda features a Gala Dinner and dedicated time for executive networking. These elements are designed to facilitate connections and provide opportunities to discuss strategies for strengthening an organization's digital resilience and innovation.

events.name: CBME Türkiye 2026
events.description:
Connecting the global children, baby, and maternity industry, CBME Türkiye 2026 returns to the Istanbul Expo Center from November 11-13, 2026.

This event, organized by Informa, is recognized as the region's largest and longest-running gathering for the industry. It typically brings together more than 20,000 international buyers and 12,000 professionals.

Visitors can expect to see the Spring/Summer 2027 collections from over 500 exhibiting brands, featuring more than 65,000 models across categories like newborn fashion, baby care, furniture, and toys. The event offers opportunities for business-to-business connections and networking, allowing participants to find products and learn about Türkiye's capabilities in ready-made clothing production. Given its location, CBME Türkiye serves as a key point of access for sourcing within the Middle East, North Africa, Balkans, and CIS regions, providing insights into new trends and supporting business development.

events.name: Aqua Art Miami 2026
events.description:
Immerse yourself in the vibrant world of contemporary art at Aqua Art Miami 2026, returning to a classic South Beach hotel. The event provides art enthusiasts a chance to discover and acquire compelling works from young, emerging, and mid-career artists. Galleries from around the world will convert the hotel's intimate exhibition rooms and courtyard into distinct displays, offering a unique atmosphere for viewing art.

The event is known for its relaxed yet lively atmosphere, making it a fitting place for collectors and enthusiasts interested in fresh perspectives and groundbreaking talent. Access to VIP experiences is available through an application process, allowing for a more focused experience with the next generation of artistic talent.

events.name: Strategy Summit B2B Service Management 2026
events.description:
Scheduled for December 2-3, 2026, at the Riu Plaza Hotel Berlin, the Strategy Summit B2B Service Management 2026 is the essential gathering for leaders in service. This two-day event brings together managers from corporate groups and medium-sized companies, including those leading Service Management, Customer Service, and After Sales. The discussions will center on rethinking current service approaches and exploring new directions for strategy.

Attendees will explore evolving business models, aftermarket strategies, and the integration of smart services. Key areas of focus include the future of customer experience, the impact of IoT, and advancements in predictive maintenance. Twenty-five expert speakers, including executives from prominent companies, will share their experiences and offer practical perspectives on transforming service operations. An exclusive Networking Dinner at Umspannwerk Ost offers a chance to connect with colleagues and industry innovators.

The summit's content is further enriched through contributions from partners such as SAP CX and Axians, alongside industry associations KVD and the Association for Service Management International. Their involvement helps shape a program designed for strategic development and collaborative learning.

events.name: TTA 2026
events.description:
As The Transformer Association (TTA) continues its vital work in 2026, prepare to connect with the forefront of electromagnetic device innovation. Specific dates and locations for TTA's 2026 gatherings will be announced. Members can expect the association's twice-yearly meetings to provide valuable opportunities for industry leaders, suppliers, educators, and safety agencies.

These gatherings offer in-depth discussions on topics relevant to the industry, drawing on insights from partners like the National Association of Manufacturers and Bundy Group, alongside important market data. The meetings are structured to facilitate networking, collaborative problem-solving, and collective efforts to shape the future of transformer and inductor technology. Participants will find themselves among a community committed to excellence and innovation throughout 2026.

events.name: Undersea Defence Technology Australia 2026
events.description:
Undersea Defence Technology Australia 2026 invites defence leaders, industry experts, and researchers to Adelaide, South Australia, from December 2 to 4. This three-day gathering, focused on "Engineering the Undersea Future," expects to bring together 1,500 to 2,000 delegates from the Indo-Pacific and global community. The aim is to advance innovation and apply new technologies for operational undersea capabilities.

Participants will explore developments in areas like autonomous platforms and AI-enabled systems. This will happen through an extensive two-day expo and conference, alongside a one-day program of industry visits. For the first time in the UDT series, a Newcomer Zone will feature Australian start-ups and small to medium enterprises, providing live product demonstrations and networking opportunities. The event seeks to strengthen national capabilities, encourage collaboration, and help shape future undersea defence operations.

events.name: Thailand International Motor Expo 2026
events.description:
Gear up for the Thailand International Motor Expo 2026, an electrifying showcase of automotive excellence from December 2 to 13 at IMPACT Challenger 1-3, Muang Thong Thani.

This event brings together a wide array of vehicles, covering various car segments, the newest motorcycles, and even boats. Visitors can expect to see significant innovations, from advanced electric vehicles, such as GWM's EV 3.5 compliant models, to the much-anticipated 2026 Harley-Davidson lineup.

Attendees will find interactive exhibits and a dedicated Test Drive Area. There are also activities like the F1 in Schools Thailand “STEM Challenge.” To assist with planning, the Motor Expo Application provides tools for comparing vehicles and calculating loan options. The focus is on providing an opportunity to explore the current state and future directions of mobility.

events.name: COMNEXT 2026
events.description:
Discover the future of connectivity at COMNEXT 2026, Japan's leading expo for advanced communication solutions. The event will be held from December 2-4, 2026, at Tokyo Big Sight. It continues the legacy of the Fiber Optics Expo (FOE), an event with over two decades of history, now expanded to cover both wireless and optical communication technologies comprehensively.

The expo is structured around six specialized areas, such as Photonics-Electronics Convergence, Optical Communication, and Private 5G. Visitors can expect to see the latest developments in areas like 5G/6G systems, optical transceivers, high-frequency components, and O-RAN products.

This gathering serves as a central point for professionals in the communication industry. It provides a setting to observe Japan's innovative contributions, understand emerging solutions, and establish connections within the field of next-generation communication.

events.name: ADOPT AI 2026
events.description:
Prepare for the definitive global AI summit, ADOPT AI 2026, taking place on December 3-4, 2026, at the iconic Grand Palais in Paris, France. Under the High Patronage of Mr. Emmanuel Macron, President of the French Republic, this international gathering is widely recognized as the 'Davos of AI'.

The summit brings together over 20,000 CEOs and C-level executives from CAC40 corporations, dynamic startups, unicorns, and global tech partners. More than 600 speakers will share insights across 10 dedicated stages, exploring critical AI applications in areas such as Finance, Health, Industry, and Luxury.

The event is designed to be business-focused and high-impact, providing a platform for unparalleled insights, the formation of strategic partnerships, and discussions that will shape the future of artificial intelligence.

events.name: AI for Health Summit 2026
events.description:
The AI for Health Summit 2026, a cornerstone of the prestigious Adopt AI Grand Palais 2026, will gather global leaders in Paris from December 3-4.

This summit is a pivotal gathering for artificial intelligence, dedicated to advancing its transformative potential across the healthcare sector. It is expected to attract over 20,000 participants, including more than 2,000 CEOs, innovators, and policymakers. Attendees will explore significant advancements and strategic applications of AI in medicine, patient care, and public health.

The program will feature over 600 expert speakers, fostering an environment for exchanging ideas and building connections among a diverse network actively shaping the future of health technology. This event provides a setting for collaboration, sharing insights, and driving the next phase of AI adoption in health.

events.name: AML & FinCrime Tech Forum UK 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendar for the AML & FinCrime Tech Forum UK 2026, scheduled for 3 December 2026 at 1 Basinghall Avenue, London. This forum brings together senior decision-makers from financial institutions with innovative tech founders in the financial crime sector. Participants will explore the newest developments in Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and financial crime technology, aiming to address evolving threats.

FinTech Global, recognized for its contributions to financial technology, organizes this forum. It provides an environment for meaningful connections and sharing insights. Attendees can expect to gain valuable perspectives on strengthening their financial crime prevention strategies, encouraging collaboration, and advancing new ideas throughout the industry. This gathering is for anyone dedicated to staying informed and effective in the ongoing effort against financial crime.

events.name: Agentforce World Tour NYC Winter 2026
events.description:
Prepare to redefine the future of business at the Agentforce World Tour NYC in Winter 2026. This Salesforce event brings together industry leaders and experts in New York City to explore how AI agents can work alongside human intelligence. The discussions will cover recent advancements in applications, data management, and agentic AI, all designed to enhance customer success and foster significant progress across different industries.

The event offers perspectives on developing an 'Agentic Enterprise,' focusing on how humans, AI agents, and platforms can work together to create effective solutions for tomorrow's challenges. Participants can discuss new strategies, network with colleagues, and consider the tools that can help their organizations adapt and succeed in an AI-driven environment.

events.name: Economic Crime Congress 2026
events.description:
Prepare to confront the evolving landscape of financial threats at the Economic Crime Congress 2026. This gathering, taking place on Thursday, 03 December, at London's QEII Conference Centre, brings together more than 550 senior figures and experts from financial crime compliance, law enforcement, banking, and technology sectors.

The congress will examine the real-world damage and societal effects of economic crime, prompting conversations about how to build safer communities, both within the country and internationally. Participants will hear from prominent speakers and policymakers, discussing collaborative approaches for sharing intelligence, preventing fraud, ensuring sanctions compliance, and disrupting criminal operations. The event aims to facilitate new collaborations, strengthen the industry's ability to withstand challenges, and identify practical ways to counter persistent criminal activities.

events.name: Nosh Live 2026
events.description:
Prepare for two days of unparalleled insights and connections at Nosh Live 2026, the essential event for growth-minded brands in the CPG and packaged food industry. BevNET.com, Inc. brings this summit to Los Angeles, CA, on December 3-4. It's designed to bring people together for meaningful discussions and to build genuine connections within the industry.

The event welcomes individuals across the CPG and packaged food sector – from startup founders and established brand leaders to retailers looking for new products and investors searching for promising ventures. Attendees can expect discussions covering key areas like operations, fundraising, packaging, and product strategy, alongside explorations of the latest innovations and consumer trends.

The program includes editorial-led conversations, the Pitch Slam competition, a Startup Boot Camp, and opportunities to sample new products. The aim is to help attendees refine their business plans for 2026 and accelerate their growth.

events.name: Product Marketing Summit London 2026

location.venue: InterContinental London - the O2 by IHG

events.description:
Redefine your impact and accelerate your career at the Product Marketing Summit London 2026, a premier gathering for senior product marketing leaders. On December 03 & 04, at London's InterContinental at the O2, over 300 senior decision-makers from companies like Amazon, Netflix, and Google will attend.

The summit is structured around the innovative 8 PMM Archetypes framework, offering insights to help you understand your unique strengths, align with your teams, and demonstrate your strategic value. Discussions will cover current topics such as AI, PLG, cross-functional leadership, and advanced go-to-market strategies.

You will have the opportunity to hear from over 30 industry-leading speakers and participate in live workshops. There will also be time to connect with peers and expand your professional network. The aim is for attendees to leave with practical tools to demonstrate value, secure stakeholder buy-in, and support their career growth.

events.name: Forbes Healthcare Summit 2026
events.description:
Prepare to shape the future of medicine and patient care at the Forbes Healthcare Summit 2026. This event, taking place on December 3, 2026, in New York, NY, with a virtual option, convenes the world’s most influential healthcare leaders.

Attendees will explore key topics and emerging trends, ranging from biotech advancements and digital health innovation to patient advocacy and longevity research. Insights will be shared through panels, fireside chats, and breakout sessions, featuring prominent speakers including C-suite executives and global influencers.

The summit provides opportunities to connect with industry leaders and colleagues, fostering discussions that can inform and advance the next era of healthcare.

events.name: WIN Expo 2026
events.description:
The North Coast wine industry's premier annual gathering, WIN Expo 2026, returns to the Sonoma County Fairgrounds on Thursday, December 3. This 14th annual Trade Show and Conference serves as a key meeting point for over 3,000 wine professionals, providing insights into the latest products, services, and trends that will shape the industry in 2027.

Visitors can discover nearly 300 exhibitors presenting new developments across the Hall of Flowers, Grace Pavilion, and various outdoor displays. The educational conference offers four specialized tracks: Winemaking & Production, Sales & Marketing, Strategy & Leadership, and Vineyard & Growers. Here, industry experts will lead discussions on important topics.

A special feature, 'ExpoDeals,' provides a one-day window for winery purchasing teams and decision-makers to access end-of-year discounts. Recognized as the second largest wine industry show in North America, WIN Expo 2026 helps define the path forward for the wine industry in Napa, Sonoma, Mendocino, and Lake counties.

events.name: CSBA Annual Education Conference & Trade Show 2026
events.description:
The CSBA Annual Education Conference & Trade Show 2026 invites education leaders to San Diego for a transformative experience from December 3-5 at the San Diego Convention Center.

This gathering brings together approximately 3,000 new and experienced board members, superintendents, and other education professionals. The aim is to collectively address the most pressing issues facing public education today.

Attendees will find over 100 sessions designed to offer focused insights, alongside opportunities to learn about new approaches from more than 150 exhibitors. The program explores topics such as supporting students in a digital environment, building strong community ties, promoting health and well-being, and developing paths for college and careers. Discussions will also cover strategic governance, financial stability, and current challenges like the integration of AI, student mental health, and workforce development. This is a place for professionals to connect with colleagues and experts, sharing ideas that can lead to improvements in student achievement throughout California.

events.name: Datacenter Forum Stockholm 2026
events.description:
