Datacenter Forum Stockholm 2026, scheduled for December 3rd at Stockholmsmässan, is the essential event for over 700 data center professionals across Sweden and the Nordics. The forum will focus on the intersection of innovation, artificial intelligence, and sustainable energy solutions, exploring how these elements are shaping the future of digital infrastructure.

The program includes keynote speeches and a live talk show, "Datacenter Changemakers Sweden," which will feature futurist Liselotte Lyngsø. Conversations will cover important subjects such as investments in AI infrastructure, ESG and regulatory compliance, Sweden's energy landscape, the reuse of waste heat, and Arctic connectivity.

This gathering offers a setting for sharing knowledge, building professional connections, and examining the latest developments and challenges within the industry. Registration is available for eligible professionals.

events.name: Ad Council Public Service Award Dinner 2026
events.description:
Prepare for an inspiring evening as the Ad Council Public Service Award Dinner 2026 takes place on Thursday, December 3, 2026. Each year, this gathering brings together leaders and professionals from the advertising, media, and public service industries. It acknowledges the progress made through collaboration and the significant impact achieved when people work with a common goal.

The evening recognizes important contributions to social change, highlighting individuals and initiatives that use communication effectively to benefit society. Those present will have the opportunity to connect with colleagues, acknowledge innovative public service efforts, and renew their dedication to fostering positive change.

This event serves as a moment to reflect on the lasting influence of public service advertising and its essential contribution to building a better future.

events.name: Global Innovation and GenAI Summit New York 2026

location.venue: The Yale Club of New York City

events.description:
On December 3, 2026, C-level technology leaders will converge at The Yale Club of New York City for the Global Innovation and GenAI Summit New York 2026. This full-day HMG Strategy event brings together chief information officers, chief information security officers, chief technology officers, and chief executive officers. The central theme, "ICONIC LEADERSHIP: How to Lead Like a CEO and Why the Future Demands Authentic and Visionary Leaders," will shape the day's agenda.

Participants will have the opportunity to connect with fellow leaders, contributing to conversations that influence global innovation and the evolving landscape of GenAI. Discussions will explore cybersecurity as a strategic advantage, approaches to modernizing enterprise systems, and practical shifts in architecture.

The day offers a chance to gain clarity on emerging trends, strengthen decision-making capabilities for complex situations, and cultivate an authentic executive presence, all aimed at leading with greater purpose and vision.

events.name: New York Winter Data Summit 2026
events.description:
On December 3, 2026, the investment industry's leading minds will converge at Convene, Brookfield Place, for the New York Winter Data Summit 2026. From 9am to 5pm ET, this summit will bring together the investment sector's largest assembly focused on alternative data. More than 650 professionals in data strategy and quantitative research are expected to attend.

The day is designed for participants to review 2026 achievements, plan for the year ahead, and explore impactful data sources. Attendees will gain insights into emerging industry trends. A dedicated AltDating program will facilitate connections between data buyers and sellers, and discussions will include perspectives from buyside data strategists, key vendors, and Neudata’s research team. Throughout the day, there will be opportunities for attendees to connect with one another.

events.name: Houston CIO Community Executive Summit 2026
events.description:
Houston's premier gathering for IT leadership, the CIO Community Executive Summit 2026, convenes on December 3rd at the Hyatt Regency Houston West. This one-day program, built by CIOs for their peers, brings together Houston's leading Chief Information Officers, C-level colleagues, and influential thinkers.

Attendees will explore key topics identified by the IT leadership community. These discussions will cover adapting for strategic agility in a changing world, evaluating the financial returns of AI investments, and managing complex risks and regulations through strategic sourcing.

The summit includes keynote presentations, interactive breakout sessions, boardroom discussions, and focused peer-to-peer meetings. This structure allows for genuine connections and shared problem-solving among IT executives.

events.name: Boston CISO Community Executive Summit Fall 2026
events.description:
On December 3, 2026, Boston's leading cybersecurity executives will gather at the Renaissance Boston Seaport District for the highly exclusive Boston CISO Community Executive Summit Fall 2026. This one-day program, which requires an application to attend, is facilitated by Gartner and designed by CISOs for CISOs. Its purpose is to address the most pressing priorities facing C-level security leaders today.

Participants, a select group of top CISOs and their C-level colleagues, will engage in strategic keynotes, interactive breakout sessions, and private peer discussions. The day's discussions will focus on strengthening security against evolving threats, building cyber resilience for critical operations, and approaching GenAI innovation with practical governance strategies.

This gathering offers a unique opportunity for participants to gain insights and connect with a community dedicated to advancing enterprise security.

events.name: American Aerospace & Defense Summit 2026

location.venue: Renaissance Phoenix Glendale Hotel & Conference Center

events.description:
The 12th Annual American Aerospace & Defense Summit 2026 offers an exclusive, invitation-only forum for C-suite executives and senior leaders driving the industry forward. This gathering will take place on December 4–5, 2026, at the Renaissance Glendale in Glendale, AZ, bringing together around 200 leading professionals from aerospace and defense.

Participants will hear from over 50 expert speakers, who will share insights on accelerating manufacturing, strengthening supply chain resilience, and improving quality. Discussions will delve into areas such as advanced manufacturing, AI-driven transformation, cybersecurity, and space security.

The summit provides opportunities for meaningful connections through networking sessions and pre-arranged one-on-one meetings. These interactions, alongside focused discussions, aim to spark new ideas and support strategic growth within the industry as it continues to evolve globally.

events.name: Revenue Operations Summit London 2026
events.description:
Prepare to transform your Go-to-Market strategy at the Revenue Operations Summit London 2026, taking place on December 03 & 04. This two-day event will bring together over 100 senior RevOps decision-makers from more than 50 innovative companies, all focused on addressing shared revenue challenges.

The program features insights from over 25 industry leaders, who will share practical strategies and established methods for leveraging AI, automation, and analytics to achieve predictable growth. Participants can expect to gain valuable perspectives on managing key performance indicators, refining forecasting processes, and building robust RevOps architecture. The summit includes interactive sessions and examinations of real-world case studies, alongside opportunities to connect with peers.

The learning experience is designed to help professionals convert Go-to-Market obstacles into efficient, profitable operations. The overall aim is to support measurable returns and consistent success within revenue operations.

events.name: Optometric Management Symposium 2026
events.description:
Elevate your expertise and practice performance at the Optometric Management Symposium 2026, held December 3-6 at Disney's Yacht & Beach Club. The symposium is designed for eye care professionals looking to deepen their clinical understanding and sharpen their practice management approaches. Participants will explore a thorough curriculum, structured to offer practical insights that support professional development.

Attendees can earn continuing education credits, connect with colleagues, and explore new ways to enhance patient care and improve practice operations. The Disney location provides a unique setting for learning and connecting with others.

Details about keynote speakers and specific sessions, which will address key developments in optometry, will be shared soon.

events.name: NYBC Industry Recognition Gala 2026
events.description:
The New York Building Congress invites you to celebrate excellence at the NYBC Industry Recognition Gala 2026 on Thursday, December 3. The New York Hilton Midtown will host this gathering of leading professionals from the building and construction industry. The event serves as an occasion to acknowledge significant achievements and contributions within New York City, fostering community and forward-looking collaboration.

The evening begins with a reception at 6:00 pm, followed by dinner and a program at 7:00 pm in the Third Floor Grand Ballroom. This provides a chance to connect with colleagues, build new relationships, and recognize the individuals who are shaping our urban landscape.

Following the main program, a Young Professionals After-Party will begin at 9:00 pm, offering a setting for emerging leaders.

events.name: Innovative Schools Summit San Antonio 2026
events.description:
Prepare to transform K-12 education at the Innovative Schools Summit San Antonio 2026, taking place December 3-6 at the San Antonio Marriott Rivercenter. AccuTrain Corp. presents an event that brings together five distinct conferences under one roof. Attendees can tailor their learning by focusing on areas such as At-Risk Students, Innovative Teaching, School Leadership, Trauma-Informed Practices, and School Climate & Culture.

This gathering offers thousands of teachers, administrators, counselors, and support staff an opportunity to acquire research-backed insights and practical ideas they can apply right away. Participants will hear from respected speakers like Dr. Todd Whitaker and Brian Mendler, connect with colleagues, and can earn up to 21 Contact Hours. The event provides a space to explore new tools and methods that support positive school environments and improve student outcomes at every level.

events.name: PackPlus South 2026
events.description:
Driving the evolution of packaging and printing, PackPlus South 2026 is poised to be a pivotal event for the industry in Southern India. The event is scheduled for December at the Bangalore International Exhibition Centre. It will present a comprehensive display of solutions and machinery, allowing professionals to explore new developments in packaging technologies, materials, and processing methods.

With over 200 leading brands exhibiting, the event provides an opportunity for key decision-makers, buyers, and industry experts to connect directly with manufacturers, suppliers, and potential business partners. These interactions can foster collaboration and contribute to the industry's future growth.

events.name: MARINTEC INNOVATION 2026
events.description:
Charting the course for a sustainable maritime future, MARINTEC INNOVATION 2026 gathers global leaders in Shanghai on December 3-4.

The focus of this gathering is to accelerate the industry's energy transition. Discussions will center on achieving net-zero emissions and meeting the IMO's decarbonization targets. Participants will explore innovative solutions for immediate, mid-term, and long-range needs.

The agenda includes examining human-AI collaboration, digital twins, and autonomous systems to enhance operational efficiency. The event will also highlight flexible ship architectures designed for various energy carriers and consider the practical path for commercial nuclear propulsion. Policymakers, innovators, and senior decision-makers will be present, aiming to develop collaborative strategies and advance actionable commitments towards a greener maritime ecosystem.

events.name: Portland Leadership Exchange 2026

location.venue: Hyatt Regency Portland At The Oregon Convention Center

events.description:
Mark your calendars for Monday, November 2, 2026, as the Portland Leadership Exchange 2026 arrives in Portland, OR. This important gathering, a collaboration between the Portland Leadership Board and CyberRisk Collaborative, is for trusted CISOs and emerging cybersecurity executives.

The theme, "Responsible by Design: Security Leadership for an AI-Driven Era," will guide discussions on how to embed strong security practices across AI, automation, and highly connected digital environments. Attendees will explore practical ways to manage risk while fostering innovation, enhancing national security, and building resilience in critical infrastructure. The agenda includes intimate CISO-only boardroom discussions, engaging keynote presentations, and interactive breakouts developed by the community.

This event, shaped by peers, encourages knowledge sharing, leadership growth, and the development of accountable security cultures. It aims to provide attendees with strategies to navigate the changing threat landscape.

events.name: TAMS Legislative Conference 2026
events.description:
The TAMS Legislative Conference 2026 provides a crucial forum for leaders and stakeholders from Texas's midsize schools to navigate the dynamic legislative environment. Organized by the Texas Association of Midsize Schools (TAMS), this event focuses on helping participants understand policy changes that directly affect their institutions and students.

Attendees will examine the latest legislative updates, discuss effective advocacy strategies, and collaborate on shaping the future of education across Texas. This gathering offers an opportunity to connect with fellow school administrators, share insights, and collectively address the specific challenges faced by midsize schools.

The conference aims to provide a platform for informed discussion and collective action, helping schools stay current and address their particular needs. TAMS will announce further details regarding specific dates and the location in due course.

events.name: Toronto CHRO Community Executive Summit 2026

location.venue: Marriott Downtown at CF Toronto Eaton Centre

events.description:
Designed exclusively for Chief Human Resources Officers and C-level executives, the Toronto CHRO Community Executive Summit 2026 offers a unique, peer-driven forum for strategic collaboration. On December 3, 2026, the Marriott Downtown at CF Toronto Eaton Centre will host this Gartner-partnered event, providing attendees with data-driven insights and opportunities for meaningful connections.

The agenda will cover critical themes such as empowering leaders, transforming HR through AI and technology, and cultivating agile, inclusive cultures. Innovation consultant Noah Scalin and IESO's Sue Gagne are scheduled to speak, discussing the return on investment for creativity and strategies for building the workforce of tomorrow. Sessions will also address future skills, leveraging generational advantages, and adapting work for an AI-powered world.

Access to this summit is by application. It aims to foster a high-quality network, supporting significant professional development among its participants.

events.name: Technology Executive Summit Boston 2026
events.description:
Technology decision-makers and top experts are invited to an exclusive evening at the Technology Executive Summit Boston 2026, presented by TechTalk Summits. On December 3, 2026, from 6:00 PM - 9:00 PM ET, professionals will convene in Boston, MA, for in-depth conversations centered on Data & Analytics.

Participants will examine approaches to using both established and new technologies, developing a clearer understanding of how to manage the intricate technology landscape. There will be opportunities to interact with prominent solution providers and engage in question-and-answer sessions with experts.

The evening concludes with dinner, providing a setting for attendees to build professional relationships and discuss current trends in the fast-changing business world.

events.name: W3N 2026
events.description:
Discover the intersection of technology, culture, and impact at W3N 2026, the Emerging Tech Festival, held December 3-4 in Narva, Estonia. This event takes place at Vaba Lava Narva, a symbolic meeting point between East and West, bringing together an international group of builders, creators, founders, and operators. Over two days, attendees can engage with talks and panels featuring Web3 and emerging tech leaders, with discussions centered on real use cases, systems, and tangible impact.

Beyond the main stage, the festival offers digital art, performances, and music. There will also be a community gathering, complete with a sauna, providing a relaxed setting for interaction. W3N 2026 emphasizes honest conversation and collaboration, valuing "momentum" over "hype" within a comfortable, human-scale environment. It's an opportunity to connect with forward-thinkers, explore additional experiences, and contribute to shaping the future of technology.

events.name: Playtopia 2026
events.description:
Playtopia 2026, Africa's leading annual destination for Indie Games and Immersive Arts, is set to ignite creativity at the Homecoming Centre in Cape Town from December 3-5.

This festival and conference brings together South African and global creators and players. It celebrates the distinct African creative landscape and encourages connections across continents. Those attending can explore a curated selection of games that are often surprising, beautiful, and thought-provoking, ranging from narrative adventures and experimental mechanics to visually stunning designs.

Playtopia highlights bold ideas, honest stories, and creative exploration within games, design, and interactive art. Individuals interested in contributing can respond to open calls for speakers, game submissions, and volunteers.

events.name: IT Procurement & Sourcing Summit USA 2026
events.description:
Unlock the future of IT procurement and sourcing at the IT Procurement & Sourcing Summit USA 2026, taking place December 03-04, 2026, at the Marriott Marquis Chicago. This two-day program, held alongside SAMS USA, provides a forum for IT procurement decision-makers to gain strategic insights and connect with peers.

Attendees will explore key areas such as AI-enabled procurement, advanced sourcing strategies, negotiation techniques, and effective vendor management. The agenda includes over 60 expert-led sessions, more than 30 case studies, and numerous targeted one-on-one meetings. These opportunities are designed to help participants develop actionable strategies, assess new technologies, and enhance procurement's impact on business results.

events.name: K-12 AI Leadership Conference Maryland 2026

location.venue: College Park Marriott Hotel & Conference Center

events.description:
Maryland's K-12 executive leaders are invited to a pivotal one-day conference on December 3, 2026, at the College Park Marriott Hotel & Conference Center. This gathering is for Superintendents, CIOs, CAOs, and cabinet-level members, and will explore how AI can reshape education.

Participants will examine real-world AI applications, discuss ethical considerations, and address policy challenges that affect K-12 classrooms and school operations. Keynote speakers and hands-on workshops will provide practical strategies for integrating AI confidently and supporting student success.

This complimentary event offers a chance to connect with colleagues, generate new ideas, and work together to shape the future of AI in Maryland schools.

events.name: Digital Government Summit Wisconsin 2026

location.venue: Monona Terrace Community and Convention Center

events.description:
Public sector innovators are invited to the Digital Government Summit Wisconsin 2026, a pivotal event scheduled for Thursday, December 3, at the Monona Terrace Community and Convention Center in Madison. This full-day summit brings together state, local, and tribal government leaders who are focused on modernizing operations and improving how public services are delivered.

The agenda covers essential areas such as cybersecurity, the practical application and policy implications of AI, data governance, and ensuring digital equity. Phil Hansen, an artist and innovator, will deliver a keynote address, offering insights on how to turn limitations into new possibilities. Throughout the day, concurrent sessions will delve into topics like future IT skillsets, effective technology procurement, and strategies for fraud prevention.

It's an opportunity to connect with colleagues and experts, sharing ideas and exploring new approaches that can enhance efficiency and support digital transformation efforts throughout Wisconsin. Public sector professionals who meet the eligibility criteria can register at no cost.

events.name: IFSEC India 2026
events.description:
South Asia's premier platform for commercial security and surveillance innovation, IFSEC India 2026, invites you to Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi, from December 3rd to 5th.

The event brings together over 14,000 security professionals, corporate leaders, and government representatives, alongside more than 350 key suppliers. It offers a space for exploring the newest developments across various security domains, including CCTV, AI-powered solutions, access control, fire safety, drone surveillance, and integrated smart building technologies.

Attendees will find opportunities to see live product demonstrations and speak directly with technical experts. Additionally, the two-day IFSEC India Conference features carefully planned panel discussions and leadership conversations. These sessions aim to bridge the gap between new ideas and practical, reliable security solutions. Participants will also have the chance to broaden their professional network and acquire valuable insights into emerging trends and shifts in regulations, helping them remain informed and prepared within a rapidly changing industry.

events.name: CIO CISO UK Summit 2026
events.description:
The CIO CISO UK Summit 2026, themed "Accelerating Impact: Shaping the Future of Technology and Security," offers an essential one-day gathering for senior technology and security leaders. This event takes place on Thursday, 3 December in London, providing CIOs and CISOs a focused opportunity for strategic discussions, peer benchmarking, and connecting with colleagues.

Participants will explore key topics such as generating business value from AI while managing its risks, defending against advanced cyber threats, navigating complex multi-cloud environments, and strengthening operational resilience. Sessions led by experts will offer practical insights and new perspectives, helping leaders stay informed about industry trends and engage with leading technology providers to address current challenges and plan for the future.

events.name: Korea Investors Forum 2026
events.description:
Set against the dynamic backdrop of Seoul, the Korea Investors Forum 2026 convenes on December 3rd at The Westin, Josun Seoul, bringing together Korea’s leading institutional investors. This gathering is for CIOs, investment officers, and trustees interested in understanding and responding to the complexities of today's financial landscape.

Participants will engage in discussions on topics such as investing through structural shifts in interest rates, managing liquidity in private markets, and the impact of AI on the next investment cycle. The program features insights from speakers like Jang Huh, CIO of POBA, and Sean K. Lee, Deputy CIO of KIC, offering strategies for building robust portfolios and identifying opportunities beyond market concentration. It's an occasion for peers to exchange strategic insights and connect with others in the field.

events.name: GTM & CMO UK Summit 2026
events.description:
The GTM & CMO UK Summit 2026, set for Thursday, 3 December in London, offers a pivotal opportunity for senior CMOs, GTM, Revenue, Customer, and Commercial leaders. This one-day gathering is designed to help B2B and B2C enterprise decision-makers develop effective strategies for growth in 2027.

Discussions will explore how AI, evolving customer behaviors, and new technologies are influencing business growth. The summit agenda includes keynotes, interactive roundtables, and hands-on workshops. These sessions aim to enhance marketing's commercial impact, improve alignment across departments, and demonstrate how data and AI can deliver measurable outcomes.

Participants will have opportunities to connect with influential colleagues in a focused environment, including a cocktail reception. The day provides insights into leading technologies and offers practical strategies, valuable connections, and a clear direction for achieving sustained growth.

events.name: YOW! Melbourne 2026
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the cutting edge of software development at YOW! Melbourne 2026. From December 3-4, with masterclasses on December 2, over 700 software professionals will gather at the Pullman Albert Park. The event will feature leading experts like Lu Wilson and Tim Berglund, who will share insights into emerging technologies and best practices, prioritizing technical depth over commercial messaging.

The program includes sessions on AI-assisted development, Java performance, event sourcing, Rust in the age of agents, and architectural decisions. This content is designed for developers, architects, and tech leaders looking to broaden their understanding and refine their abilities. Attendees will also have the chance to connect with colleagues from over 140 organizations.

events.name: Journee Du Metal 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for November 24, 2026, as Namur Expo hosts Journee Du Metal 2026, the premier gathering for the French-speaking metallurgy sector. This day explores the entire metal processing value chain, from initial design to surface treatment. It will highlight the latest advancements in areas like welding, cutting, 3D printing, and robotics.

Participants can learn from two expert seminars led by IBS and VOM. There will be opportunities to connect with peers during a drink sponsored by Métaltech, and to engage with the interactive "Mur des Soudures." Over 70 exhibitors will be present, giving professionals a chance to see new machines, understand current trends, and explore applications, including those relevant to the Defense sector. The event also welcomes schools, aiming to inspire future talent within this evolving industry.

events.name: Fortune Brainstorm Tech International 2026
events.description:
Translating groundbreaking technological potential into tangible economic and societal value is the core mission of Fortune Brainstorm Tech International 2026. This event will be held on December 3, 2026, at the MGM Macau, bringing together leaders to explore the theme "FROM PROMISE TO PROGRESS."

Discussions will center on emerging technologies such as AI, robotics, green energy, and personalized healthcare. Attendees will hear from innovators who are successfully bringing these advancements to scale. The agenda also addresses the practical challenges of integrating new technologies, including navigating uncertain returns, managing talent constraints, and aligning with regulatory demands.

The gathering provides an environment to connect with influential business leaders, gain insights into the rapidly evolving technological landscape, and understand the practical applications of transformative technologies.

events.name: HERDI South 2026
events.description:
Gain unparalleled insights and direct feedback at HERDI South 2026, held December 3-5 in Houston, TX. The event brings together community college chancellors, presidents, and senior leaders with client partners in panel sessions designed for direct, candid evaluation. Companies focused on student success and institutional relevance will present their innovations, receiving real-time feedback from at least five college leaders per session. This process offers a focused opportunity for research and development, helping to refine offerings to be effective and persuasive.

Beyond the panel discussions, client partners will have opportunities to connect with over thirty HERDI Advisory Board members during dedicated receptions and banquets. These interactions help build important relationships. Attendees also receive up to twelve months of follow-up access to their panel members, which supports ongoing strategic development and helps maximize the impact of the insights gained.

events.name: OCN Mortgage Holiday Party 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for the OCN Mortgage Holiday Party 2026, a premier event for the mortgage origination community on Thursday, December 3, at the Atrium Hotel in Irvine, CA.

This gathering combines a festive celebration with opportunities for professional development. NMLS licensed brokers and originators attending will hear from industry leaders such as John Wise, who will discuss economic trends, and Suresh Choudhary, who will explore the future of AI in mortgage. The agenda also includes sessions covering non-QM loans, reverse mortgages, and strategies for business expansion using AI and social media.

The day concludes with a Holiday Networking Party, providing a setting to connect with colleagues and sponsors. Attendees can also complete their NMLS-approved Continuing Education requirements at no cost. This event offers a moment to acknowledge the year's achievements and consider strategies for the upcoming year.

events.name: ICIS Pan American Base Oils and Lubricants Conference 2026
events.description:
Prepare for critical insights and unparalleled networking at the 20th ICIS Pan American Base Oils and Lubricants Conference 2026, taking place December 3-4 at The Westin Hotel in Jersey City. This conference typically draws over 400 professionals, including producers, blenders, additive companies, and traders, from across the Americas.

The agenda explores key topics such as reassessing supply strategies, navigating Group III market dynamics, and leveraging AI for commercial advantage and financial resilience. Before the main conference, a comprehensive ICIS Base Oils Training Course Series is offered on December 1-2.

The two days of the conference will feature expert-led sessions, providing practical commercial insights and significant opportunities for collaboration and business discussions within the evolving base oils and lubricants landscape.

events.name: SupplyPlus South 2026
events.description:
From December 3-5, 2026, the Bangalore International Exhibition Centre will host SupplyPlus South 2026, a crucial gathering for professionals driving the industrial supply chain. Co-located with PackPlus South and organized by RX, this event offers a focused environment to explore advancements in materials management, procurement, and logistics.

Those attending can discover the latest solutions and technologies that help improve operational efficiency across the packaging, processing, and converting sectors. It provides a setting to connect with industry experts, interact with key suppliers, and develop important collaborations. Participants can also gain insights into upcoming trends, supporting their business growth within South India's active market.

events.name: IEEE/WIC International Conference on Web Intelligence and Intelligent Agent Technology 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for the 25th IEEE/WIC International Conference on Web Intelligence and Intelligent Agent Technology (WI-IAT'26), a landmark hybrid event taking place from December 3-6, 2026, in Brisbane, Queensland, Australia. This year, as AI marks its 70th anniversary, the conference will explore the theme "Web Intelligence = AI in the Connected World."

We encourage researchers and practitioners to share their original findings and discuss new insights in key areas like the Web of People, Data, Things, and Agents. Dedicated tracks will also delve into current topics such as FAccT, LLM, and AIGC. The event will feature a Turing Keynote from Professor Gilles Brassard, alongside other respected speakers. It provides an international setting for engaging with leading experts, building collaborations, and contributing to the future direction of Web intelligence.

events.name: CDO & CAIO Summit UK 2026
events.description:
Elevate your data and AI leadership at the CDO & CAIO Summit UK 2026, a premier one-day event designed for Chief Data Officers, Chief AI Officers, and senior analytics leaders. This summit takes place on December 3rd in London. It offers an experience centered on genuine discussions and practical leadership approaches, moving beyond typical presentations.

Attendees will explore ways to address data privacy concerns, align strategic goals, and navigate the evolving AI environment. The day includes dynamic formats such as 'The Great Debate' for exploring diverse viewpoints, 'Strategy Sprints' for focused problem-solving, and 'Leadership Labs' designed to refine essential human skills.

The event provides a setting for peer-to-peer exchange, offering practical insights and direct interaction with technology providers. This environment supports leaders in advancing their organizational objectives.

events.name: Q4 Convenience Strategy Forum 2026
events.description:
Prepare for the year ahead by gaining unparalleled strategic insights at the Q4 Convenience Strategy Forum 2026. Lumina Intelligence is organizing this morning conference, which takes place on Thursday, 03 December 2026, at the Everyman Cinema, Broadgate, London.

Between 9:30 AM and 12:00 PM, professionals from the industry will discuss key issues influencing the convenience sector. These discussions will cover changes in consumer behaviour, the dynamics of market competition, and new approaches to bringing food and drink products to market. The event provides a chance to review strategic approaches and understand upcoming trends.

There is no charge to attend, though each company can register up to two individuals. This arrangement helps create an environment conducive to strategic conversations and connecting with peers.

events.name: SIG ONE-DAY Toronto 2026
events.description:
Elevate your strategic sourcing capabilities and expand your professional network at SIG ONE-DAY Toronto 2026.
In December, buy-side practitioners will gather at Vantage Venues in Toronto. The day offers a setting for sharing insights, building connections, and comparing approaches with peers who understand similar challenges.

The agenda includes general session speakers who will share practical tools and training. There will also be presentations from CPOs and opportunities for in-depth conversations during executive and roundtable breakout sessions.

Attendees will have the chance to meet industry leaders such as Pierre Beaulieu, Cécile Coude-Blond, and Libby Sestak. These interactions can help address current procurement challenges and refine strategic thinking.

events.name: CDCE International Data Center & Cloud Computing Industry Expo 2026

location.venue: Shanghai New International Expo Centre, 2345 Longyang Road, Pudong

events.description:
The CDCE International Data Center & Cloud Computing Industry Expo 2026, taking place December 3-5 at the Shanghai New International Expo Center, is poised to be a pivotal gathering for the global digital infrastructure sector. The event brings together four distinct exhibitions focusing on computing power, electric power, energy storage, and hydrogen energy.

Attendees, expected to number over 22,000 professionals, will have the opportunity to examine developments in intelligent computing infrastructure, advanced liquid cooling, and the synergy between computing and electricity. With more than 200 exhibitors and over 15 themed forums, the expo facilitates technical exchange, business cooperation, and discussions on strategic overseas market expansion.

The gathering allows for interaction with industry leaders, an understanding of integrated source-grid-load-storage systems, and a comprehensive view of the intelligent computing industry chain. This environment supports innovation and the formation of global partnerships.

events.name: HFMA and KHA All Payers Workshop 2026

location.venue: Hilton Garden Inn & Convention Center Manhattan

events.description:
The HFMA and KHA All Payers Workshop 2026 presents a vital opportunity for healthcare finance professionals to master the complexities of payer interactions and reimbursement strategies. This collaborative event, organized by the Healthcare Financial Management Association (Sunflower Chapter) and the Kansas Hospital Association, will be held on December 3-4, 2026, at the Hilton Garden Inn & Convention Center in Manhattan.

The program will cover essential topics, including managing diverse payer relationships, optimizing revenue cycles, and adapting to the evolving regulatory environment. It is designed to provide practical tools and actionable insights, helping professionals enhance financial performance and ensure the sustainability of healthcare services. Attendees will have the chance to engage with industry experts and peers, fostering discussions to navigate challenges and discover innovative solutions in today's dynamic healthcare landscape.

events.name: Banking Tech Awards 2026
events.description:
The Banking Tech Awards 2026 will once again shine a spotlight on the groundbreaking innovations transforming the financial sector. Since 1999, these awards, presented by FinTech Futures and Informa Connect, have consistently recognized outstanding achievements across fintech, regtech, paytech, AI, and traditional banking.

Hundreds of entries arrive from around the world, each hoping for acknowledgment. These submissions are carefully evaluated by a panel of over 60 industry experts from prominent institutions, including Wells Fargo, HSBC, and Citi.

The event serves as a gathering point for industry leaders to recognize the most impactful technologies and the individuals who conceived them. It's an opportunity to honor the pioneers shaping the future of banking technology.

events.name: Law.com Leadership in Law UK 2026
events.description:
Prepare to navigate the evolving legal landscape at Law.com Leadership in Law UK 2026, convening on Thursday 3 December at the Intercontinental Park Lane, London. This one-day gathering brings together senior legal leaders to explore pressing issues across AI, geopolitics, regulation, and talent management.

The program features interactive sessions like live polling, roundtables, and workshops, all designed to foster peer discussion and practical skill-building. A new addition for 2026 is the "Perfect Your Pitch" session, offering next-generation leaders direct feedback from experienced general counsel. The event also includes a Leadership Forum, presented with Global Leaders in Law and Lexology, which concludes with an awards ceremony recognizing leaders in the legal field.

The aim is to equip UK and European law firm leaders, partners, and general counsel with the confidence and insights needed for future decision-making, all within an inclusive setting.

events.name: Silver Christmas Days 2026
events.description:
Step into the enchanting world of Silver Christmas Days 2026, transforming PVA EXPO PRAHA in Prague into a festive wonderland from December 3 to 6. Guests can expect to find a diverse selection of gifts, decorations, and essential items for the holiday season. It's a place to explore new products from various exhibitors and gather inspiration for festive preparations.

Beyond the displays, an accompanying program offers activities and entertainment to enhance the seasonal atmosphere. Whether you are looking for specific presents or simply want to immerse yourself in the holiday mood, this event provides a comprehensive way to prepare for Christmas.

events.name: Paris Vascular Insights Course 2026

location.venue: Les salles du Carrousel du Louvre

events.description:
Vascular and endovascular professionals worldwide are invited to converge in Paris for the highly anticipated Paris Vascular Insights Course 2026. This three-day event takes place from December 3-5, 2026, at the Carrousel du Louvre, focusing on practical advancements that can enhance patient care.

The program includes hands-on learning sessions, detailed discussions of complex cases, and presentations on recent trial findings. Participants will delve into key areas such as managing resistant hypertension, the newest developments in drug-coated balloons, ongoing debates around carotid interventions, and progress in complex aortic surgery and deep venous challenges.

This course offers an opportunity to share knowledge, refine techniques, and connect with colleagues. CME credits will be available.

events.name: Silicon Valley Expo & Tech Forum 2026
events.description:
The Silicon Valley Expo & Tech Forum 2026 is set to be a pivotal gathering for the electronics manufacturing industry, bringing global technology to a local level. This one-day event will be held on Thursday, December 3, 2026, from 9:30 AM to 4:00 PM at the Fremont Marriott Silicon Valley. It offers significant opportunities for professionals, including Process Engineers, Production Managers, CEOs, and local engineers.

Attendees will have free access to a comprehensive expo and can participate in technical sessions. There will also be a chance to network with leading industry suppliers. A complimentary lunch is provided, encouraging further connections among participants. The forum aims to educate, foster connections, and showcase the innovations shaping the future of technology within Silicon Valley.

events.name: Vietnam Expo Ho Chi Minh City 2026
events.description:
Discover the future of diverse industries at Vietnam Expo Ho Chi Minh City 2026, taking place from December 3rd to 5th at the Saigon Exhibition & Convention Center (SECC). This three-day international exhibition is expected to host approximately 1,200 exhibitors, occupying 1,600 booths, and representing 20 countries and territories.

The event will showcase developments across six key areas: International pavilions, Food & eco-living, Home - garden & Lighting, Machinery & electronics, Hardware & hand tools, and Elevators & accessories. With an anticipated 15,000 visitors, the expo provides a setting for exploring market trends and establishing new business relationships. Exhibitors will have the chance to present their work and receive feedback, while those attending can explore new products, broaden their professional connections, and identify potential collaborators.

events.name: CUNY IT Conference 2026

location.venue: John Jay College of Criminal Justice

events.description:
Prepare to delve into the transformative power of Artificial Intelligence at the CUNY IT Conference 2026, held December 3 and 4 at John Jay College of Criminal Justice in New York. This invitation-only gathering, intended for the CUNY community and its partners, focuses on "AI Disruption and Opportunities" within higher education.

Participants will examine how AI is influencing teaching, learning, research, and institutional operations. Conversations will address critical challenges, such as authorship, assessment, and privacy, while also exploring avenues to improve student support, encourage creativity, and simplify processes.

CUNY Vice Chancellor and CIO, Eusebio Formoso, will deliver a keynote address, discussing AI's role in fostering innovation and collaboration. The conference aims to be a forum for sharing insights, experiments, and strategies for harnessing AI's potential throughout academia.

events.name: Florida Private Markets Meeting 2026
events.description:
Navigating the evolving landscape of private markets requires foresight and strategic connections. On December 3, 2026, the Florida Private Markets Meeting 2026 will take place at the East Miami Hotel in Miami, Florida, bringing together senior institutional investors and alternative investment professionals.

This in-person gathering is intended for more than 150 allocator groups, including public and corporate pensions, endowments, and family offices, as they examine the significant shifts within the sector. Participants will discuss increasing volatility in traditional asset classes, the strategic move towards alternative investments for portfolio diversification, and the pursuit of strong risk-adjusted returns.

The meeting provides an occasion to connect with industry leaders, share perspectives, and identify new investment possibilities in a changing market.

events.name: Defined Benefit Investment Forum 2026
events.description:
On December 3, 2026, Canada's premier Defined Benefit Investment Forum will convene at Vantage Venues in Toronto. This invitation-only gathering, hosted by Benefits Canada and Canadian Investment Review, brings together senior decision-makers, experienced investment professionals, and experts from the DB pension plan community.

The agenda centers on "Forecasting 2027 in unpredictable times." Participants will explore the economic shifts of 2026, share their perspectives, and collectively consider the challenges and opportunities that lie ahead. The discussions aim to help attendees navigate complex capital markets and refine their investment strategies for the coming year.

This event provides a focused environment for reflection and strategic planning. It is complimentary for eligible DB plan sponsors.

events.name: Medical Expo India Fall 2026
events.description:
India's premier B2B platform for hospital needs, diagnostics, and laboratory solutions returns with Medical Expo India Fall 2026. The 18th edition of the expo will take place from December 18-20, 2026, at Indira Gandhi Pratishthan, Lucknow. It will feature over 200 exhibitors displaying more than 1,000 brands from over 10 countries.

Expected to draw over 15,000 trade visitors, the event offers a platform for live product demonstrations, new product introductions, and important B2B networking. Attendees can participate in one-to-one business meetings and gather valuable insights from the accompanying Medicon Healthcare Conference, which aims to facilitate industry discussions and knowledge sharing.

The exhibition will highlight the latest advancements in medical equipment, critical care, diagnostics, and healthcare IT, reflecting ongoing developments across the Indian healthcare ecosystem.

events.name: Sussex Business Awards 2026
events.description:
The Sussex Business Awards 2026 marks its 38th year of celebrating the region's most outstanding enterprises and individuals. The awards will conclude with a ceremony on Thursday, December 3rd, at The Grand Brighton, serving as a significant occasion to acknowledge innovation, notable contributions, and exceptional achievements across Sussex's diverse business landscape.

Businesses of all sizes and sectors are invited to submit their entries by September 18th, with finalists scheduled for announcement on October 21st. Shortlisted companies gain considerable visibility through public relations, marketing, social media initiatives, and features in Platinum Business Magazine. Supported by leading sponsors like HSBC and DMH Stallard, the awards offer opportunities to connect with peers and leaders, and to highlight success within the Sussex business community.

events.name: India Packaging Show 2026
events.description:
Explore the forefront of packaging and printing innovation at the India Packaging Show 2026, hosted from December 3-5 at the Bangalore International Exhibition Centre. Organized by RX Global, this event brings together over 200 leading brands, establishing itself as a key gathering for the packaging sector in South India.

Visitors will find new packaging and processing solutions, modern machinery, and innovative materials. It offers a setting for decision-makers, buyers, and industry professionals to meet, exchange ideas, and advance their work.

Held concurrently with Print Fair and Supply Plus, the show allows attendees to explore the latest technologies, engage with experts, and build professional relationships.

events.name: EP Shanghai 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for EP Shanghai 2026, China's premier electric power and electrical expo, taking place from December 3-5, 2026, at the Shanghai New International Expo Centre. This 33rd edition, held alongside ES Shanghai 2026, will occupy 86,000 square meters across seven halls. It is expected to feature over 2,200 leading exhibitors and draw more than 75,000 trade professionals from around the world.

The event provides a comprehensive look at the entire power industry, covering everything from electric power transmission and smart energy to advanced energy storage and automation. Attendees will see innovations in renewable energy integration, strategies for decarbonizing high energy-consuming factories, and significant technological advancements coming from China's power sector.

Opportunities will be available to interact with key figures in the industry and utilize dedicated business matching services. An online exhibition will also be accessible, offering additional avenues for sourcing. The gathering serves as a significant forum for power supply companies, grid corporations, and industrial end-users to connect, share knowledge, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of energy.

events.name: From Day One New York 2026
events.description:
The future of customer connection in the AI era takes center stage at From Day One New York 2026. On Thursday, December 3, 2026, at Convene 237 Park, leaders in marketing, sales, advertising, market research, and customer experience will gather to discuss "Navigating the AI Era: Find and Keep Your Customers in the New Battle for Attention."

This full-day conference, running from 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM ET, will examine how to blend advanced technology with essential human empathy. Participants can expect to learn practical approaches for scaling personalization, using data ethically, and developing storytelling that genuinely connects with customers. The day will also cover strategies for enhancing brand authenticity, understanding the complexities of marketing technology, and creating multi-channel strategies that build stronger customer relationships as market sentiments shift.

The aim is to equip leaders to adapt, innovate, and guide their organizations effectively within the evolving landscape of customer engagement.

events.name: Paperex South India 2026
events.description:
The future of the paper industry will unfold at Paperex South India 2026, taking place from December 3-5, 2026, at the Chennai Trade Centre in Nandambakkam. Organized by Informa Markets, this event offers professionals an opportunity to explore the newest innovations and trends in paper manufacturing and technology.

The program includes a conference, open seminar sessions, and the Industry Awards. It provides an environment for connecting with others in the field, learning about new solutions, and understanding developments that influence growth and sustainability within the South Indian and global paper sector.

events.name: Art Basel Miami Beach 2026
events.description:
Prepare for an unparalleled celebration of global artistry as Art Basel Miami Beach returns to Florida's vibrant shores. From December 4 to 6, 2026, Miami Beach will host a gathering of the international art world, featuring prominent galleries from five continents.

The exhibition will present significant works by modern and contemporary masters, alongside pieces from emerging artists. Different sections, including Galleries, Nova, Positions, and Meridians, will guide visitors through various facets of the art market. Beyond the main exhibition, Miami and South Florida offer a rich array of world-class museums, private collections, and galleries for exploration.

The event draws collectors, enthusiasts, and the general public. Global Lead Partner UBS supports the event.

events.name: Abu Dhabi Grand Prix 2026
events.description:
Prepare for the ultimate motorsport spectacle as the FORMULA 1 ETIHAD AIRWAYS ABU DHABI GRAND PRIX 2026 descends upon Yas Marina Circuit from December 4-6. The season's final race, held on Yas Island in Abu Dhabi, will offer three days of intense competition. Spectators will see the world's top F1 drivers and teams compete on the Hermann Tilke-designed 5.281km track, known for its challenging corner sequences and a thrilling 1.2km straight.

Beyond the racing, Yas Island provides a range of experiences, including luxury hotels, Ferrari World, a water park, and various entertainment options. Specific viewing areas like the West Grandstand offer excellent vantage points for overtaking maneuvers, while the Main Grandstand provides a direct view of the start-finish line and accompanying displays. This event marks the thrilling conclusion of the 2026 Formula 1 season.

events.name: ESMO Asia Congress 2026
events.description:
The ESMO Asia Congress 2026, a pivotal gathering for oncology professionals, is set to illuminate the future of cancer care and research across the Asia-Pacific region. From December 4 to 6, 2026, professionals from across the oncology field will gather at the Suntec Singapore Convention & Exhibition Centre. This event brings together experts, researchers, and healthcare providers focused on advancing innovative therapies and practices that can transform patient care.

The program will feature current scientific advancements, plenary sessions, and interactive Multidisciplinary Tumour Boards. Specific sessions include "Meet the Expert" discussions, along with ESMO Pan-Asian Guidelines Adaptation (PAGA) discussions designed for the Asian context, and a program specifically for Young Oncologists. The congress provides a setting for learning, networking, and collaboration, all aimed at improving patient outcomes across the region.

events.name: Endeavor Gala 2026
events.description:
An unparalleled evening of connection and celebration awaits at The Glasshouse in New York City on December 4, 2026. The Endeavor Gala 2026 brings together leading entrepreneurs, investors, and business figures, alongside Endeavor's more than 2,900 High-Impact Entrepreneurs representing over 50 countries.

It's an occasion intended to cultivate significant collaborations, present investors with fresh prospects, and link experienced mentors with emerging industry leaders. Those present will have the opportunity to reflect on a year of notable advancements in global venture capital and entrepreneurship, while also considering what lies ahead in innovation.

A core purpose of the Gala is to raise essential funds, supporting the ongoing success of High-Impact Entrepreneurs who are propelling innovation and growth across the globe. This evening celebrates the visionaries who are shaping tomorrow's global economy.

events.name: PAX Unplugged 2026
events.description:
Philadelphia, PA is set to become the ultimate tabletop gaming destination as PAX Unplugged celebrates its 10th edition from December 4-6, 2026, at the Pennsylvania Convention Center.

Attendees can spend three days engaging with board games, card games, and role-playing games. The Expo Hall will showcase new releases from established publishers alongside independent titles featured in the PAX Rising Showcase. A large Tabletop Freeplay area will be available for discovering new games and playing with others.

The event includes various tournaments for those who enjoy competitive play. There will also be opportunities to get an early look at upcoming game titles. Gaming hours extend until midnight on Friday and Saturday, offering more time for play. Additionally, unique events such as the Omegathon are planned, and there will be chances to encounter special guests.

events.name: MichiganCIO ORBIE Awards 2026
events.description:
Michigan's premier technology leaders will gather at The Henry in Dearborn on Friday, December 4, 2026, for the highly anticipated MichiganCIO ORBIE Awards. Running from 8:15 AM to 11:15 AM, this gathering will recognize Chief Information Officers who are making significant impacts, moving beyond technology management to actively shape their industries.

The ORBIE Awards program highlights leadership stories, celebrating CIOs for their innovation, their ability to create competitive advantage, inspire teams, and strategically implement technology to achieve key business objectives. Those attending will have the opportunity to observe the impact of strong IT leadership and connect with a network of influential colleagues. The event is made possible with support from underwriters such as Fortinet and Google Cloud.

events.name: AES Annual Meeting 2026
events.description:
Prepare to advance the understanding and treatment of epilepsy at the AES Annual Meeting 2026, taking place in Denver, Colorado, from December 4-8. This meeting brings together professionals, researchers, residents, and fellows who are committed to advancing clinical care, exploring new research, and enhancing education in epilepsy.

Participants will have the opportunity to delve into recent developments in treatments, strategies for self-management, and monitoring technologies. This exploration happens through abstract presentations, specialized courses such as the Resident EEG and Epilepsy Surgery programs, and interactive workshops. The event provides a setting to connect with peers, build collaborations, and learn from leading experts in the field.

Additionally, specific programs are available for skill development, including the AES Fellows Program and in-person HOBSCOTCH Coach Training. The goal is to offer a comprehensive experience for everyone involved.

events.name: Abilities Expo Dallas 2026
events.description:
Discover a world of innovation and empowerment at Abilities Expo Dallas 2026, co-located with the Abilities International Accessibility Conference. From December 4-6, 2026, the Dallas Market Hall will host a showcase of products, technologies, and resources focused on improving accessibility and daily life. There is no admission fee for attendees.

Attendees can find solutions from various vendors, participate in adaptive activities such as sports and an accessible climbing wall, and attend workshops. These sessions will cover subjects ranging from self-advocacy to accessible travel. On Sunday, December 6, an Early Access Hour will provide a quiet, sensory-friendly environment. The event aims to connect individuals with disabilities, their families, and professionals, fostering a supportive community and sharing the latest advancements.

events.name: Psych Congress PA Institute 2026
events.description:
Physician assistants specializing in psychiatry and mental health are invited to elevate their expertise at the Psych Congress PA Institute 2026. This three-day institute, the official psychiatry meeting of the American Academy of Physician Associates (AAPA), is held in Orlando, FL, from December 4-6. It offers a significant opportunity for professional development.

The program focuses on practical, patient-centered education, designed to sharpen diagnostic skills and refine treatment approaches. The curriculum explores essential aspects of pharmacotherapy, psychotherapy, and diagnostics within psychiatric care.

Beyond the core learning, the institute encourages connection through dedicated PA meetups and interactive faculty Q&A sessions, facilitating networking and collaborative discussions. It is a valuable experience for PAs dedicated to advancing their practice and providing high-quality mental healthcare.

events.name: FRMC 2026
events.description:
The forefront of fertility and reproductive research will converge in New York, New York, for The Foundation for Reproductive Medicine Conference (FRMC 2026), taking place December 4-6, 2026. Over three days, physicians can earn up to 20 AMA PRA Category 1 Credits™, and nurses are eligible for 20 CBRN-approved CE credits, as the conference is approved for both CME and CEU.

FRMC 2026 brings together Reproductive Endocrinologists, Laboratory Directors, and other specialists from around the world, continuing its tradition of drawing professionals from over 30 countries. Participants will engage with leading experts through lectures, roundtables, and Q&A sessions. These discussions will delve into the latest studies, practical applications, and regulatory considerations in infertility, addressing a comprehensive range of topics.

This gathering provides a significant chance to deepen understanding and encourage collaboration among professionals worldwide.

events.name: AOTA Children & Youth Specialty Conference 2026
events.description:
Prepare to advance your practice at the AOTA Children & Youth Specialty Conference 2026, taking place in vibrant New Orleans, LA, from December 3-5, 2026. This in-person gathering is for pediatric clinicians and educators in occupational therapy. Over 350 professionals are expected to attend for three days of learning and networking.

The main conference runs from December 4-5, with pre-conference sessions scheduled for December 3. While the full agenda and keynote speakers will be announced later, attendees can anticipate exploring current innovations and evidence-based strategies in children and youth occupational therapy.

Exhibition and sponsorship opportunities are available for those looking to connect with this community.

events.name: CMC-North Annual Conference 2026
events.description:
Dedicated to advancing excellence in mathematics education, the CMC-North Annual Conference 2026 will convene at the picturesque Asilomar, CA, from December 4-6.

The conference centers on the theme of 'Fostering Mathematical Curiosity.' Educators and professionals will have an opportunity to explore innovative teaching strategies and discuss recent developments in education. Participants can discover new approaches to inspire students, deepen their own understanding, and cultivate an engaging learning environment.

It offers a collaborative space for sharing effective methods, connecting with colleagues, and gathering practical ideas to improve classroom engagement and student learning. The three days will include informative sessions, stimulating discussions, and an opportunity to rekindle enthusiasm for mathematics education.

events.name: OPTIC 2026
events.description:
The forefront of optical and photonic innovation will converge at OPTIC 2026, taking place from December 4-6, 2026, at National Tsing Hua University in Hsinchu City, Taiwan. This international conference brings together leading researchers, academics, and industry professionals from around the world.

Participants will explore the latest advancements across 11 parallel tracks, covering diverse fields like Nanophotonic Materials, Quantum Photonics, Biophotonics, and Silicon Photonics. The program includes presentations from Plenary and Invited Speakers, offering opportunities for networking and collaboration among attendees.

To support emerging talent, student participation is encouraged with dedicated paper awards. This initiative helps foster the next generation of innovators. The event facilitates discussions on groundbreaking technologies, contributing to the future of light science.

events.name: CPMA Annual Symposium 2026
events.description:
Prepare for an immersive two-day experience at the CPMA Annual Symposium 2026, taking place December 4-5 at the picturesque Water's Edge Resort & Spa in Westbrook, CT. The symposium brings together clinicians, educators, and thought leaders from across Connecticut and the broader podiatric community.

Participants will explore current topics and emerging trends that are shaping the future of podiatric medicine, gaining practical knowledge and insights. The symposium provides opportunities for collaboration, engaging discussions, and connecting with leading suppliers in the Exhibitor Hall. A welcoming reception will also be held.

Attendees can earn CME credits, connect with colleagues, and discover innovations that can enhance their practice and foster professional development.

events.name: Alzheimer’s Disease & Cognitive Disorders Symposium 2026
events.description:
The Alzheimer’s Disease & Cognitive Disorders Symposium 2026 invites healthcare professionals to a crucial in-person gathering from December 4–6 at the Hyatt Regency Grand Cypress in Orlando, Florida. This three-day event, co-chaired by Drs. Marwan N. Sabbagh, Marc E. Agronin, and W. Clay Jackson, focuses on improving Alzheimer's and dementia care by sharing the latest knowledge.

The symposium is for neurologists, psychiatrists, primary care providers, geriatricians, nurse practitioners, physician associates, and nurses. It offers an opportunity for these professionals to connect with peers and collaborate.

Building on the experience of previous virtual events, this symposium provides a space to discuss new developments and approaches in neurologic and cognitive disorders. Leading experts will share insights aimed at enhancing patient care and contributing to the advancement of this important field.

events.name: Riptide Dermatology Conference 2026

location.venue: The Westin Cape Coral Resort at Marina Village

events.description:
Dive into the latest advancements in dermatological care at the Riptide Dermatology Conference 2026, hosted by the Florida Society of Dermatology PAs (FSDPA). This event will be held December 4th-5th, 2026, at The Westin Cape Coral Resort at Marina Village in Cape Coral, FL. It is intended for a broad group of professionals, including PAs, ARNPs, DDS, RNs, physicians, and students, as well as members, non-members, and industry affiliates.

Attendees will explore important topics in dermatology. The program includes sessions on emerging treatments and best practices, with a specific focus on areas such as Atopic Dermatitis. This gathering offers a chance for networking, sharing knowledge, and enhancing clinical skills, helping participants stay current with dermatological developments over two days of learning.

events.name: UACRS Las Vegas 2026
events.description:
Join leading urology professionals in Las Vegas for the UACRS 2026 Advanced Coding and Reimbursement Seminar, taking place December 4-5.

This two-day seminar is for urologists, APPs, coders, and administrators looking to better manage the complexities of urology revenue cycle management. Participants will explore important updates on Medicare and private payer trends, understand how AI is changing documentation and billing, and learn to code for new urology technologies and optimize telehealth services.

Experienced professionals Mark Painter, Dr. John Lin, and Marianne Desciose will lead practical workshops and share actionable strategies. Those attending will earn 14 AAPC CEUs and receive six months of access to the PRS Helpdesk.

events.name: Singapore Comic Con 2026
events.description:
Prepare for Southeast Asia's ultimate celebration of Western and Asian pop culture as Singapore Comic Con 2026 takes over Sands Expo & Convention Centre from December 4-6. The event begins with an exclusive Ultimate Preview Night on December 4th, from 5:00 PM to 9:00 PM. This special evening allows limited ticket holders to experience unique stage segments, engage with guests, and have early access to event exclusives.

The main convention runs on December 5th and 6th, from 10:30 AM to 8:00 PM. Across Levels 1 and Basement 2, attendees will find a wide array of comics, toys, cosplay activities, gaming zones, and food options. With support from the Singapore Tourism Board, SGCC 2026 aims to present a comprehensive experience, offering something for diverse interests within pop culture.

events.name: InterGem Jewelry Show Pasadena 2026
events.description:
Discover an unparalleled world of sparkle and value at the InterGem Jewelry Show Pasadena 2026, held from December 4-6 at the Pasadena Convention Center (Hall B). This event is recognized as America's longest-running direct-to-consumer jewelry gathering, providing an opportunity to engage directly with wholesalers, manufacturers, and designers.

Attendees will find a wide array of fine jewelry, gemstones, unique beads, and individual pieces. These items are available at prices often seen only within the trade. The event welcomes both individuals looking for unique items and licensed business owners interested in wholesale purchases, with specific sections set aside for trade transactions. Admission is complimentary for active and veteran military members and their immediate families.

events.name: Ignite the Culture 2026
events.description:
During the vibrant Art Basel weekend, Ignite the Culture 2026 will transform Broward County, South Florida, into a hub of empowerment and community unity from December 4-6, 2026. This multi-day event welcomes thousands, with no admission fee. The program includes a Celebrity Basketball Game featuring professional athletes and influencers, a National Music Talent Search designed to spotlight emerging artists, and a Live Music Festival.

The schedule also incorporates panels dedicated to mental health, aiming to support wellness and education. The initiative's core purpose is to empower young people and foster community connections. It promotes a positive cultural standard through entertainment that is meaningful and free from negative themes.

Ignite the Culture 2026 illustrates how culture can serve a greater purpose, supporting creators and helping to develop future leaders.

events.name: Swahili Fashion Week 2026
events.description:
Experience the vibrant pulse of African creativity at Swahili Fashion Week 2026, a premier event celebrating the continent's dynamic fashion landscape. This year, attention turns to new talent through the Washington Benbella Emerging Designers Competition. Its theme, "Beyond the Pitch: Fashion in Motion," highlights innovative perspectives from up-and-coming designers.

The event also features the Tanzania Fashion Forum, which facilitates important conversations about how fashion can drive business, innovation, and national development. Visitors, whether from the public or within the industry, will find a Pop Up Shop with distinctive items and can observe the runway shows.

Swahili Fashion Week 2026 provides a setting to explore the evolving landscape of fashion, connect with creative minds, and acknowledge cultural heritage.

events.name: St. Paul Ice Fishing & Winter Sports Show 2026
events.description:
Prepare to dive into the heart of winter sports at the St. Paul Ice Fishing & Winter Sports Show 2026, taking place from December 4-6 at the St. Paul RiverCentre. Attendees will find over 190 exhibits dedicated to ice fishing and other winter sports.

The show features the newest developments in fish houses, augers, underwater cameras, and digital fish finders, alongside a range of essential winter apparel. Products from various brands and retailers will be on display. Throughout the event, professionals will lead seminars, sharing insights and practical advice for the upcoming season.

Whether someone is an experienced angler or new to ice fishing, they can explore a wide selection of gear. There will also be opportunities to win various prizes, including the "Ultimate Ice Fishing Giveaway."

events.name: National Conference on Student Activities 2026
events.description:
Prepare to unlock your full potential at the National Conference on Student Activities 2026, taking place December 4-6 in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. The Pennsylvania Association of Student Councils hosts this year's conference, which explores the theme 'UnstopPAble Leadership.' The program is designed for advocates, advisors, administrators, and allies of student activities.

Attendees will hear from nationally recognized speakers, including Kate Garnes, Chris Collins, and Ryan Rydzewski and Gregg Behr, authors of 'When You Wonder, You’re Learning.' The schedule also includes a variety of breakout workshops and interactive table talks. These sessions offer practical strategies to help foster student leadership, well-being, and academic success. There will be opportunities to connect with peers, exchange best practices, and acknowledge achievements through an awards program. Attendees also have the option to earn one graduate credit.

events.name: At the Vineyards! Cherbourg 2026
events.description:
Embark on a delightful journey into the heart of French gastronomic and viticultural craftsmanship at At the Vineyards! Cherbourg 2026. For its 21st edition, this event will be held from December 4th to 6th at La Cité de la Mer in Cherbourg. Seventy artisans and producers from all over France will be present, sharing their expertise and products.

Visitors will find a wide selection of wines, ranging from those of Bordeaux, Burgundy, and Champagne to organic and appellation choices. Beyond wine, there will be a variety of specialty foods, including artisanal chocolates, fine teas, charcuterie, and cheeses.

This gathering offers an opportunity to speak directly with the producers, receive their insights, and purchase items at direct pricing. Whether someone is deeply knowledgeable about French gastronomy or simply curious, the event provides an engaging experience.

events.name: Cambodia International Construction Industry Expo 2026
events.description:
The Cambodia International Construction Industry Expo 2026 is poised to be a landmark event for the region's dynamic building sector. This three-day expo, organized by the Cambodia Constructors Association (CCA), will run from December 4th to 6th. The event will be opened by H.E Say Sam Al, Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of the Ministry of Land Management Urban Planning and Construction, underscoring its national importance.

The expo offers a setting for professionals to explore the latest construction products and services, from sustainable building solutions to advanced materials. Supported by national ministries and international bodies like IFAWPCA and ACF, it brings together industry leaders, professionals, and investors. They can connect, understand market trends, and contribute to the sector's future. Interest in the event is already strong, with 50% of exhibition booths secured.

events.name: Salon Saveurs Des Plaisirs Gourmands Winter 2026
events.description:
Prepare your senses for an unparalleled culinary journey as Salon Saveurs Des Plaisirs Gourmands returns to Paris in Winter 2026. This Parisian event for those who appreciate good food will feature 250 exhibitors, presenting a wide selection of local products, specialty groceries, and French wines. It offers an opportunity to find distinctive Christmas gifts and items for holiday celebrations.

Known as a key event for those passionate about gastronomy, the salon provides a welcoming environment where attendees can explore selections from France and other regions. The event will also feature 'Les Trophées Saveurs', an awards program recognizing culinary excellence. This gathering is supported by the Ministry of Agriculture, Agri-food and Food Sovereignty.

events.name: Anime Frontier 2026
events.description:
Prepare to dive into the vibrant world of Japanese animation and comics at Anime Frontier 2026, set to electrify the Fort Worth Convention Center from December 4-6.

Over three days, the event will offer a range of experiences, from exhibits and exclusive premieres to various special events. Attendees can expect appearances by prominent guests from the anime and manga communities. The program begins Friday at 1 PM and concludes Sunday at 4 PM, with panels scheduled to run late into Friday and Saturday evenings.

This gathering provides an opportunity to explore new series, connect with fellow enthusiasts, and celebrate beloved franchises.

events.name: Paperworld China 2026

location.venue: Shanghai World Expo Exhibition and Convention Center

events.description:
Set to unfold in Shanghai, China's dynamic business hub, Paperworld China 2026 will host Asia's premier exhibition for stationery, office supplies, and hobby & crafts from December 4th to 6th.

This three-day event brings together professional buyers, design-focused consumers, and industry experts, offering a valuable opportunity to discover quality products and current trends. The exhibition features a diverse range of items, from traditional "Culture" stationery and art materials to innovative "Trend" items like digital devices and cultural accessories, all designed with the user in mind.

The event is thoughtfully organized to influence consumption trends, encourage new business models, and create valuable networking opportunities. It also brings together East and West cultural influences within its product displays.

events.name: Antigua Charter Yacht Show 2026
events.description:
Set against the breathtaking backdrop of Falmouth Harbour and English Harbour, including the historic Nelson’s Dockyard, the Antigua Charter Yacht Show 2026 invites industry professionals from December 4 to 9.

This trade-only gathering provides a unique opportunity for brokers and central agents to engage deeply with the luxury yacht charter market. Professionals can tour a diverse fleet of motor and sailing yachts, meeting directly with captains and crew. This allows for discussions on Caribbean itineraries, onboard amenities, and insights into the latest refits and new builds.

Beyond the yacht tours, the event also includes the Chef’s Competition and Tablescaping Competitions. These elements offer another way to experience the level of service and design found on the yachts operating in the Caribbean.

events.name: NAEYC Annual Conference 2026
events.description:
Early childhood educators and advocates are invited to gather in Washington, DC for the NAEYC Annual Conference 2026, taking place from December 5-8. This gathering provides a significant opportunity for those who shape the early learning experiences of children.

Participants will explore current research, discuss effective teaching methods, and discover practical approaches that can be applied directly to their daily work. It's also a chance to connect with colleagues from various backgrounds, exchange ideas, and build relationships that support the growth of early childhood education.

Attendees often leave with fresh perspectives and renewed energy for their important work. Whether someone is just starting out or has years of experience, this conference offers valuable insights for individual professional development and contributes to the broader progress of the field.

events.name: New Zealand Cloud & Datacenter Convention 2026
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the future of digital infrastructure at the New Zealand Cloud & Datacenter Convention 2026.
