The Pullman Auckland Hotel & Apartments will host a full day on November 5th, focusing on the latest advancements in cloud and datacenter technologies. Between 8:00 AM and 6:00 PM, professionals in cloud and datacenter fields can expect to gain insights from a Plenary Session and various expert-led discussions.

The convention provides an opportunity to connect with peers, explore innovative solutions, and understand emerging trends that are shaping New Zealand's digital landscape. Support for the event comes from industry leaders such as Platinum Sponsor Legrand and Gold Sponsor Schneider Electric ANZ. It serves as an important gathering for those involved in technological progress.

events.name: DevOpsDays Salvador 2026
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the forefront of IT innovation at DevOpsDays Salvador 2026. This community conference takes place on Saturday, December 5, at the Auditório da UCSAL in Pituaçu, Salvador. It brings together professionals interested in exploring current trends, tools, and best practices within DevOps.

The day will feature a series of talks, interactive open space discussions, and opportunities to connect with peers and industry leaders. Whether someone is an experienced professional or new to the DevOps movement, the event provides a space for learning and collaboration.

The organizers are currently accepting proposals for talks from the community. Organizations interested in supporting the event can find information about sponsorship.

events.name: Indio International Tamale Festival 2026
events.description:
Prepare your taste buds for an unforgettable culinary journey as Indio comes alive with the vibrant flavors and festive spirit of the Indio International Tamale Festival 2026! This annual event celebrates the rich heritage and incredible versatility of the tamale. The tamale selection ranges from traditional recipes, some passed down through generations, to innovative new creations, covering both sweet and savory options. Local and international vendors will present this wide array.

Beyond the food, the festival offers a spirited atmosphere. Attendees can expect live music, traditional dance performances, artisan crafts, and entertainment suitable for families. The event highlights Indio's community spirit and cultural traditions.

events.name: Manga Barcelona 2026
events.description:
The 32nd edition of Manga Barcelona invites enthusiasts to a spectacular four-day celebration of Japanese pop culture, taking place from December 5 to 8, 2026, at Fira Barcelona Gran Via. This gathering offers a comprehensive look into manga, anime, cosplay, gaming, and traditional Japanese arts.

The program includes a wide range of activities, such as exhibitions, hands-on workshops, and competitions. For 2026, the event will feature notable guests like music artist Reol, acclaimed mangaka Junji Ito, renowned cosplayer Yaya Han, and anime creator Shoji Kawamori.

Attendees can also explore areas focused on Japanese cuisine, language, and sports. The schedule includes presentations from publishers and film screenings, providing various ways for people to engage with their interests.

events.name: Kapiti Food Fair 2026
events.description:
Prepare your taste buds for an unforgettable culinary journey at the Kapiti Food Fair 2026, taking place on Saturday, December 5th, from 10 AM to 5 PM at Mazengarb Reserve in Paraparaumu. The Kāpiti Coast will host over 250 vendors, offering a wide selection of packaged goods and delicious ready-to-eat food.

Visitors can explore various areas, from the Licenced Bar and Main Stage to the Kāpiti Ice Cream Dining Room. Buskers will perform in the ZEAL Zone, adding to the atmosphere. Culinary demonstrations will be held at the Seriously Pickled Kāpiti Kitchen Stage. For those looking to relax, a shady picnic area will be available, while younger guests can enjoy the Kids Zone with face painting.

The event is designed for all ages and welcomes crowd-friendly dogs on lead. Information regarding tickets will be available, and children under 12 enter free.

events.name: Massachusetts Independent Comics Expo 2026
events.description:
The Massachusetts Independent Comics Expo (MICE 2026) invites enthusiasts of all ages to immerse themselves in the dynamic world of visual storytelling. From December 5-6, 2026, the Fuller Building at Boston University will host hundreds of independent comics artists and small press publishers.

Visitors will have the opportunity to discover new graphic novels, take part in hands-on workshops, and engage in panel discussions. This year's featured guest is Scott McCloud.

Entry is free for everyone, and ASL interpretation will generally be provided. For everyone's safety, masking will be required. This measure helps create a welcoming and accessible environment.

events.name: Bachelor Education Fair Hamburg 2026
events.description:
Your gateway to global education awaits at the Bachelor Education Fair Hamburg 2026. The event takes place on 5 December 2026, from 10:00 to 16:00, at the Edel Optics Arena in Hamburg. We expect to welcome up to 3,000 students and their parents. This fair is for high school seniors, secondary school graduates, and gap-year students who are considering international bachelor programs.

Visitors can explore a broad range of English-taught degrees, including STEM, business, and design, offered by universities worldwide. This is a chance to speak directly with university representatives about admissions, tuition fees, and scholarship opportunities. The fair also features expert-led seminars on studying abroad and personalized consultations covering student life, accommodation, and visa processes. It's an occasion to consider various academic paths and the international career possibilities they might open.

events.name: SACSCOC Annual Meeting 2026
events.description:
Higher education leaders and accreditation professionals are invited to the SACSCOC Annual Meeting 2026, set for December 5-8 in Houston, Texas. The meeting's theme, "Exploring New Frontiers in Accreditation," will guide discussions on the evolving landscape of higher education. Participants will examine shifts in educational models, the impact of emerging technologies, and changing expectations from students and the workforce.

The program features a range of sessions, including plenary talks, concurrent discussions, and poster presentations. These will be led by colleagues from various institutions and Commission staff. A significant part of the meeting is President's Day, which will cover federal policy updates, and the College Delegate Assembly Business Meeting, where votes will be cast on the *Principles of Accreditation*. Additionally, specialized workshops, such as Evaluator Training and Leadership Orientation, are available for focused professional growth.

This in-person gathering offers a chance to connect with peers and share insights. It provides a forum for strengthening accreditation approaches across institutions through shared learning and collaboration.

events.name: Textile Asia Karachi 2026
events.description:
The Karachi Expo Centre will host the highly anticipated Textile Asia Karachi 2026 from December 5th to 7th. This three-day event serves as a platform for advancing Pakistan's textile industry, aiming to improve quality and productivity across the sector. Those attending will see the newest developments in textile and garment machinery, along with a wide range of clothing accessories, raw materials, and dyes.

The exhibition offers a chance for local and international industrialists, investors, and decision-makers to discover new ideas and technologies. Companies showcasing their products can connect directly with a varied audience, increasing their reach. For all participants, it's an environment where industry connections are made, and discussions around potential business opportunities take place.

events.name: NeurIPS 2026
events.description:
The global forefront of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning research will converge in Sydney, Australia, from December 6-12, 2026, for NeurIPS 2026. This annual gathering brings together diverse fields to facilitate the sharing of significant new research. The agenda includes invited talks, live demonstrations, symposia, and numerous oral and poster presentations of peer-reviewed papers.

Beyond the academic discussions, a professional exposition will showcase machine learning in practice, providing insights into its real-world applications. The program also features focused tutorials and workshops, creating opportunities for collaboration and idea exchange among those working to advance AI.

events.name: LDI Show 2026
events.description:
The LDI Show 2026, taking place from December 2-8 at the Las Vegas Convention Center – West Hall, is the premier global event for live entertainment, design, and technology professionals. Attendees can explore new equipment, participate in hands-on training, and connect with others in the industry. With more than 360 exhibitors and 215 speakers, the event showcases developments across lighting, audio, staging, and visual technologies.

Workshops at the LDInstitute™ and sessions at the LDInnovation™ Conference offer specific learning opportunities for designers, audio professionals, riggers, and XR creators. Beyond the main sessions, there are LDI After Dark events for networking, a Battle of the Busk competition, and the LDI Awards recognizing industry achievements.

events.name: ASHP MidYear Clinical Meeting & Exhibition 2026

location.venue: Orange County Convention Center – West Complex

events.description:
Pharmacy professionals from across the nation will converge in Orlando, FL, for the ASHP MidYear Clinical Meeting & Exhibition 2026, taking place December 6-9.

The meeting offers an experience for health-system pharmacists, residents, and students dedicated to improving patient care. Participants can explore new clinical advancements and discover solutions that are shaping pharmacy practice. An exhibition will feature current products, services, and technologies, while the Residency Showcase provides opportunities for pharmacists seeking residency programs.

The event also facilitates connections among peers, allowing for professional networking and the exchange of knowledge to support high standards in health-system pharmacy.

events.name: Digital CPA Conference 2026
events.description:
Redefine the future of accounting at the Digital CPA Conference 2026, a premier hybrid event taking place from December 6-9. Participants can attend in San Diego or online, exploring the latest innovations shaping the profession. This conference offers practitioners practical strategies and in-depth discussions on emerging technologies like AI, Client Advisory Services, Audit, and Tax.

Industry leaders, including keynote speakers Mark Koziel and Erik Asgeirsson, will share their insights. The event also provides opportunities to connect with peers who are shaping the future of accounting. For those attending virtually, full access to the content is provided, with specific options like the 'Pack 8' designed for focused learning.

Group discounts are offered. The conference is relevant for AICPA members, auditors, and anyone navigating the digital transformation in accounting.

events.name: QS Reimagine Education Awards & Conference 2026
events.description:
Set to redefine the landscape of higher education, the QS Reimagine Education Awards & Conference 2026 convenes in London from December 6-8. QS hosts this global gathering at the InterContinental London - The O2, bringing together educators, EdTech innovators, and university leaders from around the world.

Over three days, attendees will explore transformative teaching methods and new technologies, examining how learning and work are changing for future generations. The conference concludes with the QS Reimagine Education Awards, recognizing the most impactful innovations in education globally.

This setting provides an opportunity for individuals to connect with influential thinkers, establish new partnerships, and collectively contribute to the ongoing development of educational excellence.

events.name: IHI Forum 2026
events.description:
The global healthcare community will converge in Phoenix, AZ, from December 6-9, 2026, for the highly anticipated IHI Forum. Over these four days, the conference serves as a meeting point for healthcare leaders, improvement professionals, and new entrants to the field, all sharing a dedication to enhancing quality.

Participants will examine key strategies for quality improvement, looking at new ways to address the most significant challenges facing healthcare today. Sessions led by experts and opportunities for collaborative discussion will cover important subjects, including patient and workforce safety, health equity, climate change, and the evolving impact of artificial intelligence.

Attendees can expect to gain new perspectives, work together on solutions, and connect with peers who are dedicated to improving healthcare globally.

events.name: Learning Forward Annual Conference 2026
events.description:
Dedicated to fostering profound professional growth, the Learning Forward Annual Conference 2026 invites educators to "Unite for Learning" from December 6-9 in Dallas, TX. Each year, this gathering brings together over 2,700 central office administrators, principals, teacher leaders, and policymakers from various parts of the world.

Participants will engage with professional learning that is both evidence-supported and aligned with the Standards for Professional Learning. The focus is on effective strategies designed to enhance educator practice and improve outcomes for students. Sessions are peer-reviewed and structured for deep engagement and direct application, moving beyond the format of a traditional exhibit hall.

The conference provides opportunities to connect with colleagues and explore new approaches. The aim is to support educators in finding innovative ways to achieve shared success for themselves and their students.

events.name: Single Family Rental Awards 2026
events.description:
The pinnacle of achievement in the single-family rental industry will be celebrated at the Single Family Rental Awards 2026. On December 6, 2026, the Fairmont Scottsdale Princess in Scottsdale, AZ, will host the annual gathering where the SFR and Build-to-Rent (BTR) sectors honor their leading figures and innovators.

This event acknowledges excellence within institutional single-family rental, with winners named across 25 categories. These include SFR/BTR Operator of the Year, Woman Operator of the Year, and AI Application of the Year. Industry leaders, including operators, investors, lenders, and technology providers, will attend. They will have opportunities to connect, build relationships, and learn from those shaping the industry, all focused on advancing the single-family rental sector.

events.name: CoMotion Global 2026
events.description:
Prepare to redefine the future of urban mobility as CoMotion Global 2026 convenes in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, from December 6-8. This gathering will unite over 2500 public and private sector leaders from more than 75 countries at the KAFD Conference Center. Participants will explore the next significant steps in urban transformation, with discussions centered on topics like autonomy, vertiports, smart infrastructure, and sustainable fuels.

The program features over 200 speakers across more than 50 sessions. These sessions will offer insights into policy innovation, emerging technologies, and public-private partnerships.

The event aims to connect individuals who are shaping the multimodal future of cities globally. It provides a setting for collaboration and the development of solutions that contribute to a more connected and sustainable urban landscape.

events.name: MediaPost's Email Insider Summit Winter 2026
events.description:
Prepare to revolutionize your email marketing strategies at MediaPost's Email Insider Summit Winter 2026, taking place December 6-9 in the exclusive setting of Deer Valley, UT. This intimate gathering brings together senior marketing and advertising professionals, including CMOs and Directors, from companies such as Amazon, HP.com, and Fidelity Investments.

Participants will explore current industry trends, discuss common challenges, and identify best practices to enhance their email marketing. The program combines structured presentations with opportunities for informal discussions and connecting with a focused group of peers, encouraging the exchange of new ideas and valuable perspectives.

events.name: CLO Exchange Fall 2026
events.description:
North America's premier gathering for senior Learning & Development executives, CLO Exchange Fall 2026, takes place in Miami, FL, from December 6-8. This event brings together experienced L&D leaders for focused discussions and strategic planning. It is known for its "Real Leaders. Real Talk." approach, fostering an environment where senior professionals can connect and share insights.

Participants will engage in small group discussions and panel sessions, hearing from leaders at organizations such as Google, Amazon, and Microsoft. The agenda explores how to prepare organizations for future challenges, covering areas like AI's role in learning, using data and analytics for strategic impact, and developing talent through skills-based approaches. The aim is to provide practical understanding and perspectives that help leaders navigate and influence the evolving corporate learning environment.

events.name: IEEE-RAS International Conference on Humanoid Robots 2026
events.description:
Prepare to witness the future of robotics at the 25th IEEE-RAS International Conference on Humanoid Robots, taking place December 6-9, 2026, in Silicon Valley, California. This gathering is expected to bring together over 1200 leading researchers, engineers, and industry innovators from around the world. A central theme of the conference will be the progression of humanoid technologies, moving from laboratory research into practical applications in the real world.

The program includes presentations from notable figures such as RJ Scaringe (Rivian, Mind Robotics), Jerry Pratt (Persona AI), Moritz Bächer (Disney Research), and Rong Xiong (Zhejiang University). Discussions will cover areas like design, control, AI, and how humans interact with humanoids, presented through 12 workshops, 3 special summits, and 50 exhibitor showcases. Attendees will also have the opportunity to participate in the NIST challenge and engage with others who are shaping the direction of human-centered robotics.

events.name: VSTE Annual Conference 2026
events.description:
Prepare to redefine the landscape of learning at the VSTE Annual Conference 2026. This event brings together educators, innovators, sponsors, and exhibitors, all focused on the future of education and technology. It offers an in-person experience dedicated to exploring new ideas and connections.

Attendees can expect a program that includes speakers, various sessions, and special events, such as the "Kid Talks" presentations. It's an opportunity to explore new tools, exchange practices, and connect with a community committed to advancing educational technology.

Information about the full agenda and speaker lineup will be shared with those who register.

events.name: CUES Directors Conference 2026

location.venue: Hyatt Regency Hill Country Resort & Spa

events.description:
Prepare your credit union for tomorrow's landscape at the CUES Directors Conference 2026, held December 6-9 at the Hyatt Regency Hill Country Resort & Spa in San Antonio, TX. This conference is designed for credit union directors, board chairs, and CEOs who want to enhance their leadership, governance, and strategic foresight.

The program includes presentations from futurists and leadership experts such as Nancy Giordano and Erik Qualman. Sessions will cover critical areas like future-proofing strategies, the role of AI and data analytics, cybersecurity, and regulatory updates.

Attendees will also explore board succession planning, the economic advantages of the credit union model, and new approaches to member engagement. The conference offers opportunities to connect with peers, a pre-conference workshop, and the chance to earn CPE credits. These components are designed to help boards address future challenges and support their credit union's growth.

events.name: IHEEP Conference 2026
events.description:
The 67th Annual IHEEP Conference 2026 invites highway engineering professionals to Austin, Texas, from December 6-10 for a pivotal gathering.

This conference focuses on advancing highway infrastructure, bringing together professionals, innovators, and leaders from around the country. It is a dedicated space for those working to shape the future of transportation.

Participants will examine current trends, explore new technologies, and discuss best practices. There will be opportunities for meaningful discussions, to connect with colleagues, and to understand key challenges and new opportunities. The event serves as a place for collaborative learning and professional growth, helping attendees develop the knowledge and strategies needed to advance highway engineering.

events.name: Grand Strand Gift & Resort Merchandise Show 2026
events.description:
The premier destination for coastal souvenir and resort retailers, the Grand Strand Gift & Resort Merchandise Show 2026, opens its doors at the Myrtle Beach Convention Center from December 6-9. As the nation's largest coastal souvenir trade show, this four-day event offers qualified buyers a comprehensive opportunity to explore a wide selection of merchandise.

Attendees can expect to find everything from established, top-selling brands to unique local designs, all suitable for retail inventory. Marking over 35 years, the show remains a key forum for professionals to connect, share insights, and source products.

The event also features Goody Bag Giveaways for early arrivals and daily $100 Cash Prize Giveaways. An evening Show Party is planned, aiming to foster a relaxed atmosphere for industry interaction.

events.name: Southern Surgical Association Annual Meeting 2026
events.description:
The Southern Surgical Association is proud to host its 138th Annual Meeting from December 6-9, 2026, at the distinguished Breakers in Palm Beach, Florida. This gathering brings together surgical professionals to advance the field through scientific discussion and shared knowledge. It's a place where the science and art of surgery are explored in depth, fostering collaboration among peers.

The program will feature current research and clinical innovations, with presentations selected from open abstract submissions. This approach helps ensure the agenda reflects the newest techniques, ongoing challenges, and significant advancements in surgery. Attendees will find a comprehensive overview of the field's evolving landscape.

The meeting provides an environment for members and invited physician guests to connect with colleagues, exchange ideas, and build professional relationships within the surgical community. Dr. Nicholas Namias is overseeing the Local Arrangements, with the aim of creating a well-organized and valuable experience for everyone.

events.name: GeekDays Lille 2026
events.description:
Prepare for an extraordinary celebration as GeekDays Lille 2026 marks its 10th anniversary on November 21-22 at Lille Grand Palais, France. This special edition will explore the breadth of pop and geek culture, covering everything from video games and manga to cinema, series, and cosplay.

Visitors can expect to discover new releases, engaging activities, and special guests. There will be opportunities to meet well-known personalities such as Hélène Rollès, Kayane, and Valouzz. These interactions will take place on three artist stages, providing chances for autographs and personal greetings. The event will also feature various themed areas, interesting exhibitions, and informative conferences, catering to a wide range of interests.

Whether someone has been a fan for years or is just beginning to explore these worlds, GeekDays Lille 2026 aims to provide memorable experiences for everyone.

events.name: SME Arizona Conference 2026
events.description:
The SME Arizona Conference 2026 invites mining professionals to Tucson, AZ, on December 6-7 for a comprehensive professional development meeting. This gathering will explore the newest developments, emerging trends, and innovations relevant to the mining industry in the Southwest United States and Northern Mexico. Participants will examine key topics, including mining operations, geology, environmental practices, new project insights, geotechnical engineering, and mineral processing.

The program includes presentations from industry experts, detailed technical sessions, and practical workshops and short courses aimed at expanding professional skills and knowledge. Beyond individual professional development, there will be opportunities to connect with peers and engage with the next generation of talent. This includes dedicated student events such as a poster session, a Shark Pit competition, and a golf tournament.

events.name: Destination Southwest 2026
events.description:
For meeting and incentive professionals looking to book programs across the vibrant Southwest U.S., Destination Southwest 2026 offers an unparalleled opportunity. Taking place from December 6-8, 2026, at the El Paso Convention Center in El Paso, Texas, this hosted-buyer event brings together professionals to build direct business connections.

Meeting and incentive buyers, who are actively looking for destinations in Colorado, Arizona, New Mexico, Nevada, and Texas, will have their attendance fully covered by Northstar Meetings Group. This arrangement aims to make their experience productive and straightforward. Attendees will have pre-scheduled one-on-one appointments with leading hotels, convention and visitor bureaus (CVBs), destination management companies (DMCs), and venues from across the region. Beyond the scheduled business meetings, the event also includes educational sessions and networking receptions, some of which are sponsored by Destination El Paso.

events.name: Gitex Global 2026
events.description:
Gitex Global 2026 is poised to once again host the world's most influential technology ecosystem. It will be a place where global innovators, industry leaders, and tech enthusiasts come together to explore the forefront of digital transformation. The event will feature significant advancements across AI, sustainable technology, future mobility, and smart cities.

This gathering offers an opportunity to discover emerging trends, build connections, and hear from speakers who are influencing the future. The experience aims to spark new ideas and help drive progress in the rapidly changing world of technology.

Ultimately, Gitex Global 2026 will be a significant event for the global digital economy.

events.name: Black Hat Europe 2026
events.description:
Prepare for the forefront of cybersecurity innovation at Black Hat Europe 2026, taking place from December 7-10, 2026, at Excel London, United Kingdom. This important gathering brings together professionals from the global information security community for four days of deep insights, current research, and opportunities for practical skill development.

The program covers current vulnerabilities, advanced persistent threats, and effective defense strategies through briefings led by experts and intensive training sessions. Attendees will have the chance to connect with industry leaders, learn about emerging technologies, and work together on solutions for critical security challenges.

Ultimately, this event helps security professionals, researchers, and decision-makers prepare for the evolving threat landscape.

events.name: Abu Dhabi Finance Week 2026
events.description:
From December 07-10, 2026, Abu Dhabi Finance Week 2026 will host a pivotal gathering on Al Maryah Island, positioning the emirate at the forefront of global financial discourse.

This four-day event brings together policymakers, industry leaders, investors, and innovators from around the world. Attendees will engage in strategic dialogues, explore innovative financial solutions, and examine the major trends shaping the future of capital markets.

It provides a significant opportunity for thought leadership, networking, and collaboration, offering insights into sustainable finance, digital transformation, and emerging investment landscapes. The discussions will help participants navigate the complexities and understand the opportunities within the evolving global financial ecosystem.

events.name: Giant Health Event 2026
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the future of healthcare at the Giant Health Event 2026, taking place on 7-8 December at The Business Design Centre in London. Described by the Financial Times as "The UK's largest, most valuable NHS healthcare innovation and technology event," this two-day gathering serves as a significant forum for NHS leaders, clinicians, and innovators across health, technology, and business. All NHS doctors, nurses, and hospital personnel are welcome to attend without charge.

Attendees will have the opportunity to hear from hundreds of leading speakers across more than six distinct program areas. They can also observe promising health-tech start-ups present their ideas to investors. The event is accredited for Continuing Professional Development, offering up to 8 CPD hours each day. It provides a setting for professionals to connect and collaborate, fostering advancements in digital health, artificial intelligence, and patient care.

events.name: Gartner Identity & Access Management Summit US 2026
events.description:
Elevate your enterprise's security and efficiency at the Gartner Identity & Access Management Summit US 2026, taking place at Caesars Forum in Las Vegas, NV. This gathering is for IAM leaders, architects, and cybersecurity professionals focused on addressing key challenges. The agenda covers strategies for IAM program management, automation, Identity Threat Detection and Response (ITDR), and Identity Governance and Administration (IGA).

Attendees will have opportunities to meet privately with over 30 Gartner experts, explore offerings from more than 95 providers in the exhibition area, and connect with over 2,000 colleagues. Through interactive sessions and workshops, participants can gain insights into an "identity-first business strategy," secure authentication, and API access, while also earning CPE credits.

events.name: International Maintenance Conference 2026

location.venue: JW Marriott Marco Island Beach Resort

events.description:
Prepare to redefine operational excellence at the International Maintenance Conference 2026, scheduled for December 7 to 10. The conference's theme, "The Future of Reliability ... Now," will guide discussions on "Accelerating Outcomes" by exploring how human expertise can be effectively combined with IoT and AI technologies.

The program is developed for professionals in reliability and asset management, engineering, and decision-making roles. Content will present strategies that lead to faster value realization, reduced downtime, and improved efficiency. Discussions will highlight how real-time data, predictive tools, and responsive decision-making contribute to advancements in safety and sustainability.

The event is designed for individuals interested in transforming operational processes, enhancing team skills, and utilizing data-driven insights. It also provides a setting for professionals to connect with peers and discuss shared challenges and opportunities within the global reliability field.

events.name: Advanced Automotive Battery Conference 2026
events.description:
From December 7-10, 2026, the Advanced Automotive Battery Conference 2026 will convene at the San Diego Convention Center, bringing together chief battery technologists and industry leaders. The conference provides a thorough review of current automotive battery technology, alongside insights into its future trajectory.

Attendees will delve into the technical and business issues influencing the global progress of vehicle electrification, examining both significant challenges and emerging breakthroughs. The program is structured around visionary keynotes, practical industry case studies, interactive panel discussions, and hands-on tutorials.

Sessions will cover a range of critical subjects, from battery chemistry and engineering to manufacturing, raw materials, recycling, and battery intelligence. It offers an environment for professionals to exchange ideas and collaborate on advancing electric mobility.

events.name: HARDI Annual Conference 2026
events.description:
Prepare to elevate your business strategies and forge invaluable connections at the HARDI Annual Conference 2026. This gathering for HVACR Distribution professionals takes place from December 7-10 at the Marriott Marquis San Diego Marina in San Diego, California.

The four-day event brings together a significant number of industry leaders, including hundreds of wholesalers and numerous Booth Program vendors. Participants can expect to gain insights from experts, discover new solutions within the Booth Program, and engage in discussions with peers. These interactions offer a chance to connect with distributors, manufacturers, and vendors, contributing to the ongoing evolution of the HVACR sector.

events.name: Fortune Brainstorm AI San Francisco 2026
events.description:
The future of artificial intelligence will converge in San Francisco on December 7-8, 2026, at the exclusive Fortune Brainstorm AI summit. Held at a distinguished city venue, this invitation-only event gathers current and future business leaders for discussions influencing the direction of AI.

Accenture serves as the Founding Partner for Brainstorm AI, which provides a carefully planned program to help attendees understand and adapt to a rapidly evolving landscape. Participants will examine emerging trends, strategic considerations, and how AI is reshaping various industries.

The summit offers opportunities for connection and shared understanding, aiming to prepare leaders for AI's significant influence on business and society.

events.name: IT-Tage 2026
events.description:
Prepare for an unparalleled deep dive into the future of IT at IT-Tage 2026. From December 07-10, 2026, Frankfurt am Main, a city well-connected in Europe, will host the event at its Kongresshaus Kap Europa.

The program includes approximately 270 sessions, comprising lectures, workshops, keynotes, and labs. These are guided by experienced professionals across 16 specialized sub-conferences. Topics covered span areas such as Software Development, AI, DevOps, IT-Security, Databases, and Agile Methodologies, with particular attention given to Digital Sovereignty and Open Source.

Beyond the learning opportunities, there will be an exhibition area and chances to connect with others. Catering will also be provided. The event aims to offer IT professionals a setting to learn about new developments and meet peers.

events.name: Single Family Rental Forum West 2026
events.description:
The Single Family Rental Forum West 2026, the industry's largest annual gathering, invites over 1800 SFR decision-makers and 950+ owners and operators to the Fairmont Scottsdale Princess in Scottsdale, AZ, from December 7-9.

The forum is structured to offer insights, facilitate connections, and support business development within specific areas like build-for-rent and fix-and-flip. Attendees can use the Allocate Meetings platform to make relevant connections, participate in interactive sessions with leading experts, and recognize achievements at the SFR Industry Awards.

Having been recognized as a 'Best Overseas Conference' finalist, the forum provides extensive programming and networking opportunities, designed to help individuals accomplish significant strategic discussions in a short timeframe. The event brings together investors, homebuilders, lenders, and tech providers, fostering important insights and opportunities for collaboration.

events.name: Qatar Travel Mart 2026
events.description:
Positioning Qatar as a dynamic hub for international tourism, Qatar Travel Mart 2026 invites industry leaders and innovators to explore the future of global travel. Under the patronage of H.E. The Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs, this gathering will feature the latest developments across Sports, MICE, Business, Culture, Leisure, Luxury, Medical, and Halal Tourism.

Attendees, including those participating in a dedicated Hosted Buyer Program, will have the opportunity to meet with Destination Management Companies, hotels, tour operators, and technology providers from more than 60 countries. The event typically brings together thousands of visitors and hundreds of exhibitors, offering a significant forum for building connections, exploring potential collaborations, and understanding new directions within the Arabian Gulf region.

events.name: WSJ CEO Council Summit US 2026
events.description:
Top business leaders will converge in San Francisco, California, on December 07-08, 2026, for the highly anticipated WSJ CEO Council Summit US 2026. This event is exclusively for members of the WSJ CEO Council, offering executives a chance to connect with their peers and exchange strategic ideas. The agenda has been carefully developed to explore issues critical for CEOs across diverse industries today.

Participants will gain insights from leading experts, and find practical guidance and innovative solutions during smaller, peer-to-peer discussions. This gathering provides a platform to discuss pressing business challenges, build meaningful connections, and collaborate on the future direction of global business.

events.name: NICE K12 Cybersecurity Education Conference 2026
events.description:
Dedicated to advancing K-12 cybersecurity education, the NICE K12 Cybersecurity Education Conference 2026 offers an unparalleled opportunity for educators, leaders, and stakeholders. This gathering, supported by NICE and hosted by iKeepSafe.org, brings together professionals from across the US and around the world. It's a chance to explore new approaches for teaching and learning in cybersecurity.

Attendees can expect a program rich with key presentations, thoughtful discussions, and hands-on workshops, structured across four distinct areas of focus. The event will showcase new tools and methods aimed at enhancing K-12 education, opening up various cybersecurity career paths, and encouraging students to consider roles in this vital field.

Additionally, the conference will host the National Cyber Signing Day and present the Presidential Cybersecurity Educator Award. These moments recognize outstanding contributions and encourage collective efforts to tackle pressing issues in cyber education.

events.name: RNG CONFERENCE 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for RNG CONFERENCE 2026, the premier gathering for the renewable natural gas industry, set to unfold from December 7-10 in picturesque Dana Point, California. This event brings together industry leaders, executives, and decision-makers from across the global RNG landscape. It offers a setting for professional connections and business growth.

Participants will explore strategies for meeting corporate sustainability goals, understanding intricate policy demands, and optimizing revenue in competitive environments. The agenda includes discussions on the sustainable development, deployment, and use of renewable natural gas, aiming to advance conversations around enhancing energy independence and securing domestic, clean fuel sources.

events.name: California Housing & Community Development Conference & Expo 2026
events.description:
Shaping the future of California's housing landscape, the California Housing & Community Development Conference & Expo 2026 will convene over 800 industry experts and professionals at the JW Marriott L.A. Live in Los Angeles from December 7-8. This two-day gathering will explore new approaches to housing policy, finance, and delivery, all aimed at increasing the availability of affordable and workforce housing throughout California.

Professionals from over 400 cities, counties, and public agencies are expected to attend. They will participate in discussions led by experts, hands-on workshops, and opportunities to connect with peers. The program will focus on building partnerships across different sectors, developing creative ways to finance projects, and fostering collaborations between public and private entities. The goal is to provide practical strategies and valuable perspectives for new construction, property renovation, and long-term management.

Government professionals can register without cost, encouraging wide participation in these important conversations about California's housing future.

events.name: AICPA & CIMA Construction & Real Estate Conference 2026
events.description:
Elevate your expertise in the dynamic construction and real estate sectors at the AICPA & CIMA Construction & Real Estate Conference 2026. The conference runs from December 07-09, bringing together industry leaders, CPAs, and financial professionals. Participants can attend in person at the JW Marriott Nashville or virtually through the Live Online option.

Over these three days, the event explores the intersection of construction and real estate, offering crucial perspectives on current tax and accounting developments. Participants can earn up to 16.5 CPE credits. The program delves into current data, analytics, and practical implementation strategies, with insights shared by those who shape industry guidance.

Designed for intermediate-level professionals, the conference provides flexible learning options, including an "8-Pack" session choice. It's an opportunity to connect with peers who are influencing the direction of the construction and real estate fields.

events.name: AIBD 2026
events.description:
Dedicated to "Translating Excellence into Action: The Next Era of IBD Care," AIBD 2026 invites over 2500 healthcare professionals to Orlando, Florida, from December 6-9, 2026. Marking 25 years of advancing IBD education, this gathering at the Walt Disney Swan and Dolphin Hotel offers a comprehensive program designed to enhance patient care in Inflammatory Bowel Disease.

The event begins with preconference workshops on December 6, followed by three days of practical, case-based sessions from December 7-9. Participants will learn from over 75 expert faculty members through more than 100 presentations and have the opportunity to review over 150 research abstracts. Gastroenterologists, nurses, physicians, and surgeons can expect to acquire practical knowledge, enabling them to integrate new data, therapies, and strategies directly into their daily practice.

events.name: CoNEXT 2026
events.description:
Prepare to explore the cutting edge of networking at CoNEXT 2026, the 22nd International Conference on emerging Networking EXperiments and Technologies. From December 7-10, 2026, the Jaarbeurs Convention Centre in Utrecht, The Netherlands, will bring together international researchers to discuss advancements in internetworking.

The program includes a robust technical agenda, featuring presentations on novel networking technologies and engaging poster sessions. Attendees can also participate in specialized workshops, which will explore key areas such as Emerging Multimedia Systems, P4, Inter-networking challenges for AI, and the development of a Resilient, Renewable, and Responsible Internet.

CoNEXT 2026 offers a setting for technical and social interactions among researchers, academics, and students. The conference operates under ACM's new open access publishing model.

events.name: Evolution of Psychotherapy Conference 2026

location.venue: Walt Disney World Swan And Dolphin Resort

events.description:
The Evolution of Psychotherapy Conference 2026, held December 7-9 at the Walt Disney World Swan & Dolphin Resort in Orlando, FL, offers an unparalleled experience for mental health professionals. Founded by The Milton H. Erickson Foundation, this event brings together both the foundational voices who shaped psychotherapy and the clinical innovators defining its future.

Over three days, participants will explore current research, new therapeutic approaches, and practical strategies across major disciplines. A new one-track main stage format is designed to provide a shared learning experience for the more than 750 professionals expected.

Attendees can earn over 18 CE credits. The program focuses on providing techniques that can be applied directly in practice, alongside opportunities for connecting with peers. The conference is available for in-person attendance or on-demand access through Evolution Plus.

events.name: Employee Well-Being 2026
events.description:
Senior HR, Total Rewards, and Benefits leaders are invited to Employee Well-Being 2026, a pivotal three-day interactive forum taking place December 07-09, 2026, at the Signia by Hilton Orlando Bonnet Creek in Orlando, Florida. This forum brings together leaders to address the complex factors contributing to declining workforce well-being and to identify practical solutions that show clear results.

Participants will examine effective strategies spanning emotional, physical, and financial well-being. The discussions will cover important areas including organizational well-being, empowering managers, comprehensive obesity care, mental health support, and designing benefits that truly meet employees' needs.

The event offers an opportunity to connect with peers, share insights, and explore interventions that can help cultivate a productive and thriving workforce.

events.name: Irrigation Show and Education Week 2026
events.description:
The global irrigation industry will converge in Las Vegas, Nevada, for the highly anticipated Irrigation Show and Education Week 2026. As the world's largest exhibition focused on irrigation, this gathering provides a forum to explore recent innovations, connect with leaders in the field, and develop professional knowledge.

Attendees will encounter new technologies and products. The Education Week sessions offer a structured environment for learning, designed to enhance skills and understanding. It also serves as a place for professionals to connect with colleagues and key figures in the industry.

Organized by the Irrigation Association, the event supports career development and business growth within the sector. It contributes to discussions around the future of efficient water use, allowing participants to contribute to the industry's ongoing evolution.

events.name: Women of The Channel Leadership Summit East 2026
events.description:
Set to inspire and empower, the Women of The Channel Leadership Summit East 2026 returns to New York, NY, on December 7-8. This two-day event, organized by The Channel Company, is designed for women at every career stage and organizational level in the technology channel. It provides an opportunity to develop transformational leadership skills, understand how to influence effectively, and sharpen crucial leadership techniques.

The program includes engaging keynotes, informative panel discussions, and sessions led by experts, exploring important subjects like leading without formal authority and the principles of influence. The agenda offers distinct tracks for business and personal development, along with discussions on key channel trends. Beyond the structured content, there will be opportunities for networking during receptions, dedicated CHANNEL@WORK sessions, and informal peer-to-peer interactions. These connections aim to contribute to a more robust, diverse, and effective workplace culture.

events.name: Corptax CONNECT 2026
events.description:
Prepare to redefine your tax strategies at Corptax CONNECT 2026, taking place December 7-10 (with Bootcamps starting December 6) at Resorts World in Las Vegas.

This event is for tax professionals who want to deepen their expertise, address complex challenges, and improve performance using new technology. It features over 100 sessions across 15 tracks, including State-to-Global, Analytics, and an Executive Track. Attendees will explore innovations, new features, and AI advancements that are changing tax practices.

You can connect with industry leaders, discover new ideas at the interactive Transformation Station, and see industry innovation recognized at the Tax Transformer Awards. Corptax CONNECT 2026 offers opportunities to network with peers and provides learning paths designed to help you apply new knowledge to your work.

events.name: MRS Awards Dinner 2026
events.description:
The research sector's most glittering evening, the MRS Awards Dinner 2026, returns to London on December 7th to celebrate unparalleled insight and innovation. This event recognizes the profound impact research has in driving meaningful change and delivering real-world results. It's a moment to acknowledge the individuals and teams whose work truly makes a difference.

Industry colleagues will come together to honor exceptional achievements and the expertise that shapes our understanding of the world. Finalists will be announced in early October, following a thorough judging process over the summer months.

While most award submissions have now concluded, the ASC/MRS Best Technology Innovation Award category remains open for entries until August 21st.

events.name: AICPA & CIMA Conference on Current SEC and PCAOB Developments 2026
events.description:
Navigate the complexities of financial reporting and auditing with confidence at the AICPA & CIMA Conference on Current SEC and PCAOB Developments 2026. The conference runs from December 7–9, offering participants the choice to attend in person at the Washington Hilton in Washington, DC, or virtually.

This event is intended for CFOs, CAOs, controllers, auditors, and SEC reporting teams. Attendees will hear directly from the SEC, PCAOB, and FASB, receiving current updates on accounting, auditing, and regulatory developments. The program also provides practical guidance for addressing pressing reporting challenges.

The agenda covers emerging trends and offers up to 21.5 CPE credits. It also provides opportunities to connect with regulators, standard-setters, and industry leaders. The content is designed to support professionals in maintaining compliance and developing strategic foresight.

events.name: Predict 2026
events.description:
For three days this December, the global prediction market community will converge in Midtown Manhattan for Predict 2026. From December 7–9, The Times Center will host this gathering, organized by Voliti Co and Predict Summit LLC. The event focuses on exploring prediction markets and their role as fundamental infrastructure for understanding future trends.

This conference is intended for exchanges, builders, traders, researchers, and legal professionals. It offers opportunities for discussions, making connections, and exploring potential collaborations. The agenda includes a "Year in Review" from major exchanges on December 8, followed by their "Future Outlook" for 2027 on December 9.

The event is structured to provide a neutral setting, encouraging open dialogue and cooperation. This environment supports professionals who are actively shaping the prediction market landscape in their work.

events.name: AGU 2026
events.description:
Join the global community of Earth and space science advocates and professionals at AGU 2026, convening in San Francisco this December. This annual gathering brings together thousands of individuals – including researchers, students, and educators – providing a significant opportunity to explore new discoveries and build connections across the scientific community.

Discussions will center on important topics like Open Science, Climate & Sustainability, Ethical, Diverse & Just Science, and Data Resilience. A special part of the event involves acknowledging the 2026 AGU Honorees, individuals whose work has profoundly advanced our understanding of Earth and space.

Those attending can expect to deepen their knowledge, expand their professional networks, and contribute to ongoing conversations that help shape the future of geosciences.

events.name: U.S. BankTech Summit 2026
events.description:
Prepare to redefine the future of financial services at the U.S. BankTech Summit 2026, taking place December 7th-9th in Oak Brook, IL. This gathering distinguishes itself through an "All Conversations with Zero Presentations" approach, fostering candid, executive-level discussions free from sales pitches or slide decks.

The summit is intended for senior executives from banks, credit unions, and fintech providers. It includes over 8 hours dedicated to peer-to-peer strategy sessions and 4.5 hours of discussions led by experts. Key topics explored will include AI applications, real-time payment systems, managing cyber risk, and core system modernization.

Participants will also have more than 5 hours for strategic networking, along with opportunities to earn CE credits. The U.S. BankTech Awards will also be presented. The aim is for attendees to leave with practical perspectives and strengthened professional relationships that can inform their strategies for 2027.

events.name: Build It to Sell It 2026
events.description:
Designed for the elite of the roofing and home-service industries, Build It to Sell It 2026 offers a strategic blueprint to scale, systemize, and maximize your business value.

The event will be held from December 7–9, 2026, at The Diplomat Beach Resort in Hollywood, Florida. Participants will learn directly from experienced entrepreneurs, investors, and innovators. The agenda includes discussions on business valuation, understanding the factors that influence a company's multiple, and preparing operations for a future sale.

This gathering also provides a setting to connect with other leading contractors and examine tools and solutions from various vendors. It's an opportunity to expand professional networks and gain insights for those focused on significant business growth or a strategic exit.

events.name: ArchConf 2026
events.description:
ArchConf 2026 invites software architects, engineers, and leaders to Clearwater Beach, FL, from December 7-10, for an immersive four-day experience at the Opal Sands Resort. This gathering focuses on current and future directions in software architecture, providing perspectives and practical approaches for building systems that are scalable, secure, and perform well.

The program explores subjects such as Generative AI, Microservices, Cloud Architecture, Agentic Development, and advanced design patterns. These topics are covered in 90-minute sessions designed for in-depth discussion. For those interested in a more hands-on start, optional full-day workshops are available on December 7.

Attendees will have opportunities to connect with other professionals and experts in the field. Additionally, each participant receives 25 Virtual Workshop Credits, valued at over $10,000, which can be used for ongoing professional development.

events.name: ALTSMIA 2026
events.description:
Prepare to navigate the dynamic world of alternative investments at ALTSMIA 2026, taking place December 7-8 at the stunning Eden Roc Miami Beach in Miami, Florida. This event is designed with the investor community in mind, offering a focused educational experience for those who manage, advise on, allocate to, or oversee alternative investments.

Attendees will engage in a full day of dialogue and discussion, exploring critical topics such as institutional portfolio construction, global macroeconomic trends, opportunities in private debt, and advanced hedge fund strategies. Industry leaders, including keynote speakers Peter Mintzberg of Grayscale Investments and Winston Justice of SagePoint Capital Partners, will share their expertise. Qualified investors receive complimentary registration. This gathering provides an opportunity to enhance understanding in the alternative investment space and earn valuable CPE credits.

events.name: West Tech Women 2026
events.description:
Step into a vibrant hub of innovation and connection at West Tech Women 2026, taking place on Monday, December 7, 2026, at the Pan Pacific Perth. The day begins with a networking breakfast at 8:00 AM, followed by a program from 9:00 AM – 10:30 AM. This gathering recognizes and brings together women who are shaping Western Australia’s technology landscape.

The program includes a keynote address and a fireside chat, featuring entrepreneurs, industry leaders, and changemakers such as Aaliyah Nestoridis, Stephen Dawson, and Bronte Campbell. Discussions will offer candid perspectives on navigating opportunities, addressing challenges, and understanding the unique experience of women in business.

With 350 seats available, the event aims to facilitate connections, offering opportunities to meet potential collaborators, investors, or team members. All genders are welcome to support and engage with the future of tech.

events.name: YOW! Brisbane 2026
events.description:
Prepare to elevate your software development expertise at YOW! Brisbane 2026, taking place December 7-8 at the Brisbane Convention & Exhibition Centre.

The event brings together around 500 software professionals—developers, architects, and leaders—to discuss emerging technologies and best practices, focusing on substance over commercial pitches. A significant focus will be Artificial Intelligence, featuring keynotes such as Tim Berglund's "A Brief History of AI" and various sessions exploring AI-friendly architecture and development.

Participants can expect carefully chosen, technically deep content. There will also be opportunities for informal discussions and sharing insights during meal breaks. For those looking to deepen their skills further, Allen Holub will lead a hands-on masterclass on December 9, titled "Domain-Focused Component Architecture for AI-Assisted Development." The conference aims to provide a valuable environment for professionals to refine their skills and consider the evolving landscape of software engineering.

events.name: Innovative Lawyers Awards North America 2026
events.description:
The legal industry's most prestigious recognition of pioneering talent, the Innovative Lawyers Awards North America 2026, is set to illuminate Gotham Hall, New York. On December 7, 2026, this in-person gala will honor legal professionals who are reshaping the industry. Presented by the Financial Times and RSGI, these awards recognize individuals who use their influence and creative problem-solving skills to help clients achieve effective, lasting results, while also strengthening the rule of law and promoting ethical business practices.

Often called "the Oscars of the legal world," the evening will feature a sophisticated drinks reception and a gala dinner, offering an opportunity to engage with peers. General counsel, law firm leaders, legal service providers, and business leaders will gather to celebrate innovations that benefit both business and society. The event provides a platform for attendees to gain insights into how leading companies are approaching legal innovation, fostering discussions among those who are shaping the future of law.

events.name: West Tech Fest 2026
events.description:
Prepare for a week of groundbreaking innovation as West Tech Fest 2026 unfolds from 7 – 11 December across Perth, Fremantle, and Wadjemup/Rottnest Island. This gathering serves as a central point for technology and innovation in Western Australia, bringing together local founders, investors, and technologists with their international peers to explore future developments and collaborations.

The program includes six main events, among them West Tech Women, First Nations House, and West Tech Wadjemup, which focuses on sustainability and ocean technology. Attendees will hear from speakers such as Layne Beachley AO and Harry Dixon.

Beyond these core events, various satellite gatherings take place across the city. These range from hackathons to dinners, providing spaces to encounter new ideas and establish connections within Western Australia's technology community.

events.name: World Agri-Tech Innovation Summit Dubai 2026

location.venue: The Ritz-Carlton, Dubai International Financial Centre

events.description:
While the World Agri-Tech Innovation Summit Dubai 2026, in association with AgNavigator, has been strategically paused following a review of its global events portfolio, the commitment to advancing agri-tech innovation remains unwavering. This decision stems from observing changes in the market and a desire to focus efforts on providing the most impactful experiences for the community.

The organizers continue to facilitate important conversations and build connections within the agri-food ecosystem. They do this through their established flagship summits in London, San Francisco, and Singapore, complemented by focused roundtables and online activities. These gatherings consistently unite leaders, innovators, and investors, creating opportunities to explore new technologies, sustainable methods, and long-term strategies for agriculture.

events.name: CSBS Board Meetings & Supervisors Symposium 2026

location.venue: Omni San Diego Hotel at the Ballpark

events.description:
The CSBS Board Meetings & Supervisors Symposium 2026 provides a crucial annual forum for senior state officials and regulatory leaders nationwide. From December 7-10, 2026, attendees will gather in San Diego at the Omni San Diego Hotel. For specific board and committee meetings, virtual participation will also be an option.

The symposium will address the changing environment of bank and nonbank supervision and regulation. Participants will engage in educational sessions, share insights on emerging trends, and discuss current supervisory challenges.

The agenda features specific sessions for the CSBS Board of Directors and the MMC, alongside the broader Supervisors Symposium. These discussions are designed to strengthen professional networks and enhance effective oversight within the financial services sector.

events.name: Food Africa 2026
events.description:
Food Africa 2026, the continent's largest and most influential international food and beverage trade exhibition, returns for its 11th edition from December 7-10 at the Egypt International Exhibition Center in Cairo. This four-day event connects food and beverage professionals from around the world with opportunities in one of the globe's rapidly expanding markets. It acts as a central meeting point for business discussions and market exploration.

Those attending can explore possibilities for trade, sourcing, and forming strategic partnerships across the entire agrifood sector. The exhibition is held alongside several specialized events: interpack MEA, a significant show for processing and packaging; Fresh Africa, dedicated to fresh produce; and the 7th edition of Dates Africa. This combined setting provides exhibitors with direct access to regional distributors and potential buyers. Visitors, in turn, can meet industry leaders and discover new products and innovations relevant to the evolving African and Middle Eastern food landscape.

events.name: Pacprocess MEA 2026
events.description:
Set to unfold from December 7-10, 2026, at the Egypt International Exhibition Center in Cairo, interpack MEA 2026 (formerly Pacprocess MEA) marks its 7th edition as the Middle East and Africa's premier international trade fair for processing, packaging, and printing technologies. Organized by Messe Düsseldorf, as part of the globally recognized interpack alliance, this event brings together regional manufacturers, suppliers, and technology providers with international experts and advanced solutions.

Professionals and buyers from the food, beverage, pharmaceutical, and cosmetics industries will have the opportunity to explore advancements in machinery, materials, automation, and digitalization. The exhibition runs alongside Food Africa, creating a comprehensive environment that covers the entire industry process and offers significant opportunities for business connections and networking throughout the GCC and Africa.

This gathering allows those in the industry to engage with new technologies and foster collaborations. Registration is available at no cost.

events.name: ICAS Convention 2026
events.description:
The premier gathering for air show professionals, ICAS Convention 2026, takes place December 7–10 at Paris Las Vegas. The convention offers resources and insights to help professionals develop safer, smarter, and more successful air shows.

The program features numerous education sessions, led by industry experts. These range from full-day workshops before the convention, focusing on air/ground operations, to shorter breakout sessions on marketing, safety, and logistics. The Exhibit Hall, spanning 46,000 square feet, allows attendees to connect directly with performers, support service providers, and consultants, with specific times set aside for these conversations.

Attendees can expect to leave with practical ideas, build new relationships, and gather valuable insights for their 2027 planning and future endeavors.

events.name: eCourts 2026
events.description:
Ignite your court's technological future at eCourts 2026, the essential gathering for court technology professionals. From December 7-9 in Las Vegas, Nevada, this conference provides a focused learning experience aimed at equipping attendees with new perspectives and practical approaches. The program is designed to help individuals and cross-functional teams explore innovative ideas and collaborate on solutions, particularly as courts navigate the evolving AI landscape.

Content is tailored to address diverse needs, covering everything from initial brainstorming to developing concrete solutions. For 2026, the event introduces dedicated workshops and special interest group discussions, allowing for in-depth exploration of critical topics. Keynote speaker Jay Kiew will share insights alongside a community of peers dedicated to advancing court technology.

events.name: The Global Boardroom 2026
events.description:
Prepare for critical insights as The Global Boardroom 2026 returns for its 10th edition on 8-9 December. Organized by Financial Times Live, this digital conference brings together over 100 industry leaders and more than 30 Financial Times journalists. They will explore the pressing theme of "Achieving growth in a disrupted world."

Conversations will focus on significant global challenges, including trade tensions, climate change, the impact of AI, and broader technological transformation. Drawing on the expertise of leading voices from business, finance, government, and academia, participants can expect to gain valuable perspectives and strategic understanding.

Individuals can choose from different access options. Free Inspiration Passes provide access to live talks, while Professional Passes offer more in-depth engagement, including Q&A sessions, on-demand video access, and summary reports. This allows participants to customize their experience to better understand the complexities ahead.

events.name: Energy LIVE 2026
events.description:
The future of American energy takes center stage at Energy LIVE 2026, a premier Reuters Events leadership summit held December 8-9 in Houston, TX. This two-day event, which can also be accessed through a global broadcast, brings together over 3,000 senior executives. A significant portion of these attendees, 80%, are decision-makers, with 25% holding C-suite positions.

The discussions at the summit are structured to help advance key projects, secure capital, and foster partnerships. Participants will explore pressing issues such as the rapidly growing U.S. electricity demand, the increasing energy needs of data centers, and the development of Small Modular Reactors (SMRs) and large-scale LNG projects. The agenda, developed in close collaboration with industry experts, includes candid case studies, interactive roundtables, and engaging panel discussions. These sessions will cover important topics such as grid modernization, the intersection of AI and infrastructure, nuclear energy, and broader energy strategy.

Those attending can expect to leave with practical insights, real-world examples, and clear ideas for future actions. The experience will be further enriched by live editorial coverage from Reuters. With participants involved in energy projects totaling $755 billion, Energy LIVE 2026 serves as a crucial forum for industry leaders to discuss and influence the direction of American energy.

events.name: Expand North Star 2026
events.description:
Prepare for a new era of innovation as Expand North Star 2026 makes its landmark move to Dubai Expo City. This gathering serves as a significant meeting point for founders, investors, and groundbreaking ideas from around the world. Attendees can explore a wide range of topics, including advancements in AI, climate technology, deep tech breakthroughs, corporate innovation strategies, and approaches to global market expansion.

A key feature of the event is the Supernova Challenge 2.0, recognized as the world's largest startup pitch competition. It offers a substantial prize fund of $214,000 to support promising new ventures. This is an opportunity to connect with companies poised for significant growth, build valuable partnerships, and contribute to innovation in the industries that will define tomorrow. The event brings together a broad network of investors, partners, and industry leaders who are actively shaping the future of technology and entrepreneurship on a global scale.

events.name: Gartner IT Infrastructure, Operations & Cloud Strategies Conference US 2026
events.description:
IT infrastructure, operations, and cloud leaders seeking to drive transformation and build resilient, innovative futures will converge at the Gartner IT Infrastructure, Operations & Cloud Strategies Conference US 2026. The conference takes place at The Venetian in Las Vegas. Those attending will hear from over 40 Gartner experts and have the chance to engage with more than 120 solution providers.

The agenda includes essential strategies for AI enablement, automating operations for resilience, and cloud transformation. These discussions are designed to help organizations optimize their value and manage change effectively. Attendees will also find opportunities for one-on-one meetings with Gartner experts, alongside specialized tracks for senior leadership, sourcing and vendor management, and medium-sized enterprises.

The aim is for participants to leave with the knowledge and professional connections needed to guide their IT organizations forward.

events.name: Product Camp Brazil 2026
events.description:
Prepare to shape the future of product at Product Camp Brazil 2026, Latin America's premier product event. This gathering marks its 11th year, taking place on December 8th and 9th in São Paulo at the Centro de Convenções Frei Caneca. Over two days, the in-person event anticipates bringing together more than 2,500 professionals.

The theme for this year is 'User. Builder. Thinker. Leader.' The program includes 6 simultaneous stages and over 60 talks, structured around four key tracks: Product Management, Building & Automation, Marketing & Design, and Leadership & Business. A significant part of the discussions will explore AI's evolving influence on product development.

Participants can expect to hear from industry leaders, with Mike Belsito confirmed as a keynote speaker. There will be opportunities for attendees to connect with peers and discuss ideas, including dedicated networking sessions and a happy hour. The aim is for individuals to leave with new perspectives on driving impact and developing products ready for the future.

events.name: The Future of TV Advertising Global 2026
events.description:
The Future of TV Advertising Global 2026 is the definitive international forum for professionals committed to redefining the media and advertising landscape. This event brings together leaders, innovators, and strategists from around the world to examine the key trends, new technologies, and effective strategies that are shaping the future of television advertising.

Attendees will gain a deeper understanding of the latest developments in programmatic TV, cross-platform measurement, audience engagement, and the integration of AI and data-driven solutions. The discussions will explore how to adapt to changing consumer behaviors and identify new opportunities within the evolving industry. It provides a setting for strategic conversations, sharing expert viewpoints, and building connections with peers.

events.name: AOC International Symposium & Convention 2026
events.description:
The AOC International Symposium & Convention 2026, convening in National Harbor, MD, from December 8–10, 2026, stands as the premier global gathering for the Electromagnetic Spectrum Operations (EMSO) community. This three-day event is expected to bring together nearly 2,500 professionals from over 40 countries, representing industry, military, and government sectors. These individuals share a common focus on advancing Electromagnetic Warfare (EW), Cyber Operations, and Spectrum Dominance.

The agenda features presentations from senior military commanders, alongside in-depth technical sessions and interactive breakouts. An exhibition hall will display technologies from over 100 exhibitors, providing insight into current and future EW capabilities. Opportunities for networking are planned to encourage collaboration among peers and decision-makers. The event also includes the AOC and Military Awards, which acknowledge significant contributions within the community.

events.name: Digital Summit Dallas 2026
events.description:
Prepare to elevate your digital marketing expertise at Digital Summit Dallas 2026, taking place in Dallas, TX, from December 8-9. This event brings together professionals and thought leaders from across the industry to explore the evolving landscape of digital innovation. It's a chance for attendees to connect with peers and discuss current challenges and future directions.

The program will feature discussions on strategies and trends in areas such as SEO, content marketing, social media, and analytics. Participants can expect to learn from experienced practitioners and discover new approaches to their work. Whether you're an experienced professional or looking to enhance your skills, the summit offers practical insights to help you stay informed in the dynamic digital world.

Further details regarding speakers and the complete agenda will be announced in the coming months.

events.name: Health 2.0 Conference Dubai Winter 2026
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the future of healthcare at the Health 2.0 Conference Dubai Winter 2026, held from December 8–10 at the InterContinental DFC, Dubai, UAE. The conference will focus on the theme "Transforming Care Through Collaboration!" and expects to bring together more than 300 individuals from over 45 countries.

Attendees will explore the latest developments in digital health tools, patient care strategies, and evolving policy landscapes. Policymakers, medical professionals, startups, investors, and researchers will meet to share insights, present new products and solutions, and build important collaborations.

The program features breakout sessions and presentations showcasing innovative ideas. Participants will also have opportunities to connect with industry leaders and executives. The aim is to offer fresh perspectives, discuss global healthcare challenges, and contribute to the future of smart healthcare through meaningful discussions and collaborative efforts.

events.name: Working Capital Forum Europe 2026
events.description:
Optimise your organisation's cash flow and liquidity at the Working Capital Forum Europe 2026, taking place on December 8th in Amsterdam's historic Beurs van Berlage. This single-day event brings together senior professionals who manage working capital, offering a focused environment for understanding and improving an organisation's financial health.

More than 400 corporate treasurers, procurement directors, AP leaders, and supply chain professionals from leading European companies, banks, and fintechs will attend. They will discuss current liquidity challenges and explore ways to overcome them. The agenda includes practical solutions, forward-looking discussions, technology demonstrations, and interactive workshops, all designed to offer insights that can be applied directly within treasury, procurement, and shared services functions.

Corporate attendees may be eligible for complimentary passes, which supports participation for those aiming to enhance cash availability and operational efficiency.

events.name: CDCA Eastern Defense Summit 2026
events.description:
Set to convene December 8-10, 2026, in North Charleston, SC, the CDCA Eastern Defense Summit 2026 stands as the East Coast's premier defense event. This gathering brings together over 2,300 leaders from government, military, academia, and industry. They will focus on the theme: "Collaborating on Actionable Solutions for Our Nation's Pacing Threats." Discussions will explore strategies for moving from mission need to fielded capability with speed, scale, and operational advantage.

The summit includes keynote presentations, executive panels, and technical discussions. These sessions will cover important topics like AI, supply chain resilience, and industrial capacity. Charleston's position as a defense hub makes this event valuable for fostering partnerships and bringing advanced capabilities to the Joint Force.

events.name: Data Analytics for Healthcare Summit 2026
events.description:
Elevate your expertise at the 14th Annual Data Analytics for Healthcare Summit 2026, Canada's leading hybrid event on December 8-9.

This event takes place both at the Old Mill Toronto Hotel and online, providing over 30 hours of new insights across strategic and technical areas. Discussions will cover important topics like implementing AI governance, evolving clinician leadership, and developing strong provincial data strategies.

Attendees will hear from more than 40 prominent speakers, including leaders from organizations such as CAMH and Southlake Health. The program also includes over 10 hours dedicated to structured networking, hands-on workshops, and AI-powered connections. The summit is intended for data analytics professionals, C-suite executives, and clinical leaders from hospitals, Regional Health Authorities, and related sectors. It serves as a key gathering for those focused on advancing data-driven healthcare and enhancing patient care.

events.name: SEG3 LA 2026
events.description:
Leaders from the worlds of sports, entertainment, gaming, music, technology, and lifestyle will converge at SEG3 LA 2026, taking place on December 8-9, 2026, at the United Talent Agency in Beverly Hills.
