Over these two days, discussions will center on the changing nature of fandom, intellectual property, and new forms of media. Senior leaders will examine key topics, including how fandom is commercialized, the influence of generative AI on intellectual property, and approaches to cultivating fanbases across different generations. Conversations will also cover developing intellectual property across various media, forming brand partnerships within the creator economy, and effective strategies for launching films and games.

The agenda features prominent figures from various industries. Coinciding with The Game Awards, the event provides a setting for professionals to connect and explore potential collaborations aimed at expanding their reach.

events.name: PyData Global 2026
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the forefront of data innovation at PyData Global 2026, taking place from December 08 to 10, 2026. This event brings together the global Python data community, serving as a key meeting point for data scientists, engineers, and researchers. Participants will explore recent advancements in machine learning, artificial intelligence, and data analytics, all built upon Python's capabilities.

The agenda includes talks led by experts, interactive workshops, and chances for collaborative learning. It's an opportunity to connect with others in the field, share ideas, and contribute to the open-source data landscape. Attendees can discover new tools, improve their skills, and engage with a global community of peers.

events.name: MEEBA Show 2026
events.description:
The global business aviation community converges at MEEBA Show 2026, set to unfold from December 8-10 at the DWC, Dubai Airshow Site.

Recognized as "The Hub of Business Aviation," the event anticipates 10,000 industry professionals, featuring over 165 global brands and more than 30 aircraft on its static display. Visitors will experience an expanded exhibition hall, exploring new additions like the Elevated Luxury Boulevard, a dedicated AAM Pavilion, and specialized Luxury Travel and Wellness Zones.

Discussions at BizAv Talks will feature over 60 industry thought leaders, complemented by the AI-powered MEBAA Connect tool for focused networking. MEEBA Show 2026 provides a key environment for making important connections and agreements, influencing the direction of business aviation and luxury lifestyle.

events.name: GTM New York Summit December 2026
events.description:
Elevate your Go-to-Market strategies at the GTM New York Summit, a pivotal one-day event taking place on Tuesday, December 8, 2026, in New York City.

The summit, themed "GTM Unlocked," gathers CCOs, CXOs, CMOs, and senior revenue executives. It's designed for those looking to significantly improve their growth strategies. Attendees will participate in sessions, hands-on roundtables, and interactive demonstrations, structured to connect strategic thinking with practical application. The goal is to explore ways to improve revenue, broaden market reach, and find new avenues for growth by refining teams, technology, and operational processes.

The event also provides opportunities for peer-to-peer discussions and collaborative exchanges. Private one-on-one meetings will be available with various solution providers. This environment encourages direct interaction with new ideas and perspectives, concluding with an evening cocktail reception.

events.name: HCTC 2026
events.description:
Unlock unparalleled insights and elevate your professional capabilities at HCTC 2026, presented by Harris Computer.

This event, held from December 7-10, 2026, at the Gaylord Rockies Resort in Denver, Colorado, is designed for professionals in the Public Sector, Healthcare, and Utilities.

Over three days, participants can expect focused learning opportunities aimed at expanding technical knowledge, exploring best practices, and helping them maximize their software investments. Attendees will have the chance to interact with industry experts, gain practical tools to improve productivity and efficiency, and build meaningful connections with their peers. Daily meals and evening activities are included, offering a chance for both professional development and informal networking.

events.name: Future Identity Festival North America 2026
events.description:
Prepare to redefine digital trust at the Future Identity Festival North America 2026, taking place December 8-9 at the JW Marriott Austin, Texas.

The festival, co-located with the FTT Fintech Festival, is a two-day gathering that will bring together over 450 individuals, 70% of whom are tech end-users. The aim is to explore methods for delivering secure, seamless, and trusted digital identity.

Discussions will address critical topics such as balancing security with user experience, implementing fraud-resistant identity verification, and confronting the synthetic identity crisis driven by AI. Over 100 C-level speakers and experts will share practical strategies concerning passkeys, reusable credentials, and ways to strengthen onboarding processes. Attendees can participate in live content sessions, visit a technology expo, and connect with leaders from financial services, retail, healthcare, and other sectors. The collective focus remains on reducing fraud and enhancing customer confidence.

events.name: Wind Turbine Blades Europe 2026
events.description:
Driving the future of wind energy, Wind Turbine Blades Europe 2026 returns to Germany in December for its 17th edition. This three-day conference brings together professionals from across the industry, including original equipment manufacturers, operators, and those involved in the blade supply chain.

The program spans two days of presentations, where participants will delve into strategies for improving blade reliability and sustainability. Discussions will cover advancements in manufacturing automation, the development of new materials, and practical approaches to inspection and maintenance that can reduce the levelized cost of energy. A significant portion of the agenda will be dedicated to breakthroughs in blade recycling, addressing a key challenge for the industry.

Beyond the presentations, the event includes an exhibition area where new solutions are presented. There will be opportunities for attendees to engage with speakers during Q&A sessions and to connect with peers and colleagues. The aim is to foster discussions among executives and specialists as they consider the rapid expansion of wind energy and the evolution of turbine blade technology.

events.name: Leaders In AI Summit Los Angeles 2026

location.venue: Sofitel Los Angeles at Beverly Hills

events.description:
Prepare to shape the future of artificial intelligence at the Leaders In AI Summit Los Angeles 2026, an exclusive and intimate event experience taking place December 8th-9th at the Sofitel Los Angeles at Beverly Hills. This gathering brings together leading figures in AI to engage in strategic discussions and foster collaborative innovation. Attendees will have the opportunity to connect with influential speakers, including executives from Bank of America, Zillow, and Optum, alongside Chief Data Architects and Heads of AI Governance.

The program includes a Pre-Summit Workshop, a full day of main summit sessions offering valuable perspectives, and an exclusive Think Tank Dinner. These elements are designed to facilitate meaningful connections and the development of actionable strategies. Participants will explore cutting-edge advancements, discuss robust AI governance frameworks, and collectively consider how AI's transformative power can shape the future.

events.name: Future Identity Finance North America 2026
events.description:
The future of secure and seamless financial interactions will converge in Austin, Texas, on December 8–9, 2026, at the JW Marriott. Future Identity Finance North America 2026, held alongside the FTT Fintech Festival, will bring together over 450 professionals. These individuals are focused on advancing digital transformation, preventing fraud, and streamlining customer onboarding within financial services and related industries.

The program features over 100 C-level speakers and experts who will address key challenges. Discussions will cover how to balance security with user experience, strategies for combating synthetic identity fraud, and the implementation of reusable credentials. An accompanying technology expo will showcase developments in biometrics, passkeys, and AI-powered fraud detection.

This two-day event provides opportunities for professionals to connect through a hosted meetings program and informal interactions. It offers a space for in-depth conversations about building trust, ensuring privacy, and personalizing experiences for customers.

events.name: Chicago Quantum Summit 2026
events.description:
The global quantum community will converge in Chicago from December 8-10, 2026, for the Chicago Quantum Summit, co-located with Q2B26.

This three-day event, hosted by QC Ware and Chicago Quantum Exchange, brings together leaders from industry, government, and academia. They will meet at the Marriott Marquis and McCormick Place to discuss and influence the direction of quantum technology.

Participants will explore breakthrough research, strategies for commercialization, and initiatives for workforce development, covering the entire journey from initial discovery to practical application. The program includes hands-on demonstrations showcasing the latest developments in the quantum industry, new product and initiative announcements, and presentations by Boeing Quantum Creators Prize winners. An innovation pitch competition will also feature emerging ideas. The summit offers a setting for engaging with leaders in the field and forming collaborations that contribute to the practical application of quantum technology.

events.name: CDM Media CFO New York Summit 2026
events.description:
New York will host a pivotal gathering for financial leaders at the CDM Media CFO New York Summit 2026.

This event is tailored for Chief Financial Officers and senior finance executives navigating the complexities of modern corporate finance. Participants will engage in strategic discussions, exploring current innovations and best practices in financial management. The focus will be on gaining practical insights, covering topics from optimizing financial performance to using emerging technologies for competitive advantage.

It's an opportunity to connect with peers, build valuable relationships, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of financial leadership. The discussions are designed to benefit those focused on strategic growth and operational excellence within their organizations.

events.name: National Grain & Feed Association CEC 2026
events.description:
Prepare to elevate your expertise and expand your network at the National Grain & Feed Association CEC 2026. This annual Country Elevator Conference and Trade Show brings together grain merchants, elevator operators, feed manufacturers, processors, and industry suppliers.

Attendees have opportunities to connect with colleagues, participate in educational sessions, and explore the supplier trade show. The program is built around understanding current trends and innovations that affect country elevator operations, feed manufacturing, and grain processing.

It's a place to exchange ideas, gain insights into strategic developments, and see how advancements, such as digital transformation, are shaping the grain industry.

events.name: CDM Media CIO Summit New York 2026
events.description:
For C-Suite and top-level technology executives steering the world's largest companies, the CDM Media CIO Summit New York 2026 presents two pivotal opportunities. Attendees will gather in New York on June 4th or December 8th to address their most significant enterprise technology challenges.

The summit is structured for direct, face-to-face discussions within smaller groups. This approach encourages valuable peer-to-peer learning and facilitates strategic connections with technology providers. Participants will connect with fellow CxOs and senior decision-makers, building lasting business relationships and contributing to the direction of enterprise technology.

The event offers a platform for gaining practical insights and strategic direction relevant to the evolving landscape of technology.

events.name: CHRO & CLO New York Summit 2026
events.description:
Senior HR and learning leaders are invited to the CHRO & CLO New York Summit on December 8, 2026, a pivotal one-day event in New York. The day's discussions will be guided by the theme 'Redefining People and Possibility,' fostering an intimate environment for strategic networking and peer benchmarking among attendees.

The agenda focuses on collaborative discussions designed to address critical challenges facing organizations today, including large-scale workforce reskilling, integrating AI literacy, and building resilient talent pipelines. Participants will discover practical strategies they can implement immediately, and explore cutting-edge technologies through focused one-on-one interactions. The aim is to accelerate talent transformation and strengthen organizational culture, ultimately preparing CHROs and CLOs to navigate and thrive in the evolving future of work.

The day concludes with a cocktail reception, providing an informal setting for continued conversations and connections.

events.name: CHRO Circle Think Tank Brussels Fall 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendar for December 8, 2026, as Brussels becomes the epicenter for strategic HR discussions. This fall, the CHRO Circle Think Tank will focus on "The rise of the talent factory – a new approach for the skills-first economy." It's an opportunity for CHROs and HR leaders to delve into how innovative talent factories can cultivate employee skills and experience.

Discussions will cover the foundational elements of experimentation, learning from failure, and achieving success within this framework. Participants will explore strategies for moving beyond initial ideas to build a truly skills-first organization. The agenda also includes examining how to implement effective metrics, assess the impact of talent initiatives, and cultivate agility, all with the aim of helping organizations prepare for the evolving demands of the future workforce.

events.name: CyberRisk Leadership Exchange Detroit 2026
events.description:
The CyberRisk Leadership Exchange Detroit 2026, themed "Responsible by Design: Security Leadership for an AI-Driven Era," offers an unparalleled opportunity for executive-level cybersecurity professionals. On Tuesday, December 8, 2026, at The Westin Book Cadillac Detroit, this one-day gathering connects a select group of CISOs, national security leaders, and emerging executives.

Participants will engage in executive learning led by their peers, with keynote presentations from experts such as Glenn Corn (CIA) and global CISOs. The agenda also includes CISO-only boardroom discussions and interactive breakout sessions. These conversations will focus on integrating security into AI, automation, and broader digital transformation efforts.

Attendees can expect to develop practical strategies for managing risk, improving alignment with their boards, and cultivating accountable security cultures. The environment encourages building trusted relationships and lasting peer connections.

events.name: CISO Flagship National Summit 2026
events.description:
Prepare for a pivotal gathering of cybersecurity leadership at the CISO Flagship National Summit 2026. This summit brings together Chief Information Security Officers and senior security executives who are working to protect our national cyber defenses. Participants will engage in discussions focused on strategies to address evolving threats, safeguard data, and strengthen critical infrastructure against sophisticated attacks.

It offers a chance to connect with colleagues, exchange best practices, and gain insights into regulatory changes, the geopolitical impact on cyber, and new technologies. The aim is to provide practical knowledge that helps organizations prepare for the future and contributes to the nation's overall cybersecurity resilience. This event is designed to help bridge strategic thinking with practical implementation, influencing the direction of national information security.

events.name: Ecom North Australia Summit 2026
events.description:
Get ready to elevate your online business at the highly anticipated Ecom North Australia Summit 2026. This gathering will connect e-commerce professionals from across the region, providing opportunities to learn, build connections, and advance their businesses. While specific dates and the location are still being determined, those who attend can anticipate exploring current strategies, new technologies, and practical ideas to help their online businesses progress.

The summit will address the specific challenges and opportunities within Australia's e-commerce environment. Discussions will cover topics like attracting and keeping customers, managing logistics, and expanding into new markets. It's a chance to meet industry leaders, innovative brands, and other entrepreneurs.

events.name: NISTM National Aboveground Storage Tank Conference & Trade Show 2026
events.description:
Industry professionals seeking the latest advancements in Aboveground Storage Tank (AST) management will converge at The Woodlands, Texas, for the 19th Annual NISTM National Conference & Trade Show. This event will be held from December 8-10, 2026, at The Woodlands Waterway Marriott. It brings together terminal operators, engineers, regulators, and service providers to explore current insights and practical solutions.

Attendees can visit a trade show featuring various exhibitors. Opportunities to deepen expertise are available through co-located courses, including the SPCC Short Course, Liquid Terminals 101, and Tanks 101. The conference also provides dedicated times for making connections, such as the Women in the Tank Industry (WiTI) gathering, a Welcome Reception, and a Network Mixer.

This gathering offers a valuable opportunity to stay informed about developments in AST innovation and compliance.

events.name: IIoT World AI Manufacturing & Supply Chain Day 2026
events.description:
The future of smart manufacturing and resilient supply chains takes center stage at the IIoT World AI Manufacturing & Supply Chain Day 2026, also known as the AI Manufacturing & Supply Chain Summit. This free, two-day virtual event, held on December 8-9, 2026, provides access to current thinking and developments from anywhere in the world.

Attendees can expect to explore real-world applications of technologies such as Edge Computing, Analytics, AI, ML, and AR across manufacturing processes. The program will cover areas like predictive maintenance, smart manufacturing, digital twins, and advanced supply chain optimization.

Live, interactive sessions will be available, with on-demand access provided afterward. These sessions aim to provide practical strategies for improving efficiency, fostering innovation, and building a more resilient future for businesses operating with industrial AI.

events.name: Solarplaza Summit Energy Storage Germany 2026
events.description:
Explore the dynamic future of Germany's grid-scale battery energy storage market at the Solarplaza Summit Energy Storage Germany 2026, convening on 8 December in Düsseldorf. Germany stands as Europe's leading market for battery energy storage systems, playing a central role in the 'Energiewende' with a substantial 9.5 GW project pipeline and numerous grid-connection requests. The summit will bring together more than 200 developers, investors, transmission and distribution system operators, and policymakers to address key issues.

Discussions will cover the evolving regulatory landscape, new financing approaches, sophisticated trading strategies, and the possibilities within solar-plus-storage projects, including insights into Germany's initial capacity-market tenders. These conversations aim to provide a clearer understanding of the sector's direction.

An informal networking event is scheduled for 7 December, offering an opportunity for early connections among attendees.

events.name: The AI House @ AI Summit NYC 2026
events.description:
On December 8, 2026, New York City will host an unparalleled, invitation-only gathering: The AI House @ AI Summit NYC. This full-day event, presented by KPMG and powered by Modev, is designed for C-suite and senior executives—key AI decision-makers from the financial, media, and technology sectors.

events.name: European Health Summit 2026
events.description:

Participants will work towards aligning efforts between Spain, other EU Member States, and the broader EU framework, with the goal of developing shared solutions. These discussions are intended to help shape the future of rare disease care and policy, affecting many lives.

events.name: Propulsion & Future Fuels Conference 2026
events.description:
Charting the course for a sustainable maritime future, the Propulsion & Future Fuels Conference 2026 convenes in Hamburg, Germany, from December 8-10. This three-day gathering brings together shipowners, engine designers, fuel suppliers, and regulators from over 30 countries. Their collective aim is to address the significant challenge of decarbonizing deep-sea shipping.

The program features more than 25 speakers, including Dr. Markus Münz and Lars Robert Pedersen, who will share insights on various solutions. Discussions will cover alternative fuels, wind-assisted propulsion, advanced engine efficiency, and the evolving landscape of emissions regulation. Specific sessions will focus on innovations such as retrofitted carbon capture and the potential of ammonia as a future fuel.

The format combines technical papers, moderated panels, and structured networking opportunities. A welcome dinner at BLOCKBRÄU will provide an informal setting for attendees to connect and discuss. These interactions are vital for advancing shipping's energy transition.

events.name: CDO/CAIO New York Summit December 2026

The intention is for participants to leave with practical strategies and leadership approaches applicable to the evolving data and AI landscape, helping their organizations make tangible progress.

events.name: PBM Contracting Summit 2026
events.description:

events.name: CMO New York Summit December 2026
events.description:

events.name: Fall Tax Institute Kansas City 2026

events.name: Healthcare Payers Transformation Assembly Austin 2026
events.description:
Prepare to redefine the future of healthcare insurance at the Healthcare Payers Transformation Assembly Austin 2026. events.name: International Project Financing 2026

events.name: Trade & Channel Strategies 2026
events.description:

events.name: Insurance AI Showcase 2026

events.name: Financial Services AI Security Forum 2026
events.description:
The Financial Services AI Security Forum 2026 offers a vital, full-day deep dive into securing the future of AI in finance. On Wednesday, December 9, 2026, at the New York Hilton Midtown, 300 senior leaders will gather to address the complex task of deploying AI effectively while upholding trust, resilience, and regulatory standards.

This focused, single-track event will feature 50 experts discussing five core areas: AI governance, securing machine identities, combating AI-driven fraud, operational resilience, and autonomous security operations. Professionals, including CISOs, CTOs, CROs, and fraud leaders from banking, insurance, and fintech, will explore practical strategies through expert-led sessions, open peer discussions, and presentations of new solutions.

Participants will have the opportunity to connect with colleagues and contribute to the development of strong AI security frameworks.

events.name: American Chemical Manufacturing Summit 2026
events.description:
Senior leaders in chemical manufacturing are invited to the American Chemical Manufacturing Summit 2026, an exclusive, invitation-only event taking place December 9-10 at the Royal Sonesta Houston.

This two-day gathering is for C-Suite executives, VPs, and Directors. It addresses key priorities such as improving production efficiency, maintaining high standards for quality and safety, and strengthening supply chains against disruption.

Participants will engage in peer-led sessions and examine real-world case studies, exploring innovations like advanced automation, digital twin technologies, and predictive analytics. The program includes opportunities for high-level discussions, benchmarking with industry colleagues, and forming strategic connections through scheduled one-on-one meetings and various networking events. The aim is to uncover practical solutions for managing regulatory challenges and enhancing plant operations within a collaborative setting.

events.name: Digital Pathology & AI Congress Europe 2026
events.description:
Pioneering the future of diagnostics, the Digital Pathology & AI Congress Europe 2026 convenes in London, UK, from 9-10 December. This event will gather over 500 professionals to discuss the latest advancements in digital pathology, artificial intelligence, and machine learning, particularly as they apply to primary diagnosis and clinical research.

The program is structured across five distinct tracks. Attendees can expect to gain practical insights into improving interoperability, operationalizing AI, and leveraging these technologies to enhance scalability, productivity, and collaboration. More than 60 expert speakers, including leading pathologists and researchers, will contribute their knowledge.

The congress provides a setting for professionals to connect with leaders in the field and explore how digital innovation can genuinely transform patient care.

events.name: Ensuring Success 2026
events.description: The 16th annual edition of Ensuring Success, CPA Practice Advisor's free live-streamed two-day CPE and IRS CE conference, delivering up to 14 free hours of NASBA-registered CPE with select sessions also qualifying for IRS CE.

events.name: Agentforce World Tour Essentials Atlanta 2026
events.description:
Prepare to unlock the next era of customer success at Agentforce World Tour Essentials Atlanta 2026. This Atlanta gathering is a key part of the global Agentforce World Tour, offering direct access to the latest Salesforce innovations.

Attendees will explore the significant impact of agentic AI, advanced CRM strategies, and solutions built for the future, all designed to evolve business operations. The event will illustrate how 'Humans with Agents drive customer success together,' demonstrating how AI-powered CRM tools can enhance efficiency and improve customer experiences. It's an opportunity to engage with industry leaders and experts, gather practical knowledge, and examine recent progress in applications, data management, and intelligent agents.

events.name: Family Office Super Summit 2026
events.description:
Uniting 600+ elite family offices, investors, and founders, the Family Office Super Summit 2026 is set for December 15-17 at Fort Lauderdale's Marriott Harbor Beach Resort. Over three days, this gathering focuses on fostering connections and facilitating direct investment discussions. Participants, who include significant investors, will hear from experts in rapid-fire investor talks, intimate fireside chats, and panels featuring professional athletes discussing their investment insights.

The summit also features ten dedicated networking sessions and live demonstrations of AI tools for deal-making, emphasizing the value of in-person interactions for building trust. Utilizing a specialized platform, the event aims to connect capital with opportunities directly and efficiently, avoiding extended sales pitches or promotional content. The aim is for attendees to gain practical investment strategies and establish meaningful partnerships within a focused environment.

events.name: Drug Delivery To The Lungs 2026
events.description:
Prepare to delve into the forefront of aerosol and respiratory delivery at the 37th annual Drug Delivery To The Lungs (DDL) conference in 2026. This three-day event will bring together over 1100 scientists, academics, clinicians, regulators, and industry experts from around the world.

Participants will find an exhibition showcasing 120 international companies, attend lectures from leading experts, and have opportunities to connect with peers and innovators.

The conference places a strong emphasis on supporting emerging talent. This includes free registration for students, the New Researcher Network, and significant assistance through the DDL Career Development Grant and Emerging Scientist Award.

events.name: IIC Shenzhen 2026
events.description:
The International Integrated Circuit Exhibition and Conference (IIC Shenzhen 2026), hosted by AspenCore, will illuminate the future of electronics in Shenzhen, China, from December 9-10, 2026. This gathering brings together industry leaders, engineers, and decision-makers from across the globe. They will examine the significant influence of AI on semiconductors, consumer electronics, and Industry 4.0.

Discussions will cover advancements in IC design, high-efficiency power management, wide-bandgap semiconductors, and AI server technologies. The program features the Global CEO Summit, where participants will discuss the long-term implications of AI. Another key session is the Global Distribution and Supply Chain Leaders Summit, which will explore how supply chains can adapt and remain robust.

The event also includes various forums and awards ceremonies recognizing innovation. Attendees will have opportunities to connect with peers and discuss developments that are shaping the next generation of integrated circuits and the broader supply chain.

events.name: Fortune 500 Europe: In Conversation With CEOs 2026
events.description:
In an era defined by economic uncertainty and complex challenges, European leaders seek clarity and strategic direction. Fortune 500 Europe: In Conversation With CEOs 2026 is an online session taking place on Wednesday, 9 December 2026, from 2:00 PM – 3:00 PM (GMT).

This one-hour session, titled "The Decision-Making Cortex: how Europe's CEOs navigate complexity," is designed for C-Suite executives who are navigating workforce anxiety, boardroom pressures, and competing priorities. Participants will hear from experienced leaders, including Fortune's Executive Editorial Director, Kamal Ahmed, with additional speakers to be announced.

The discussion will explore strategies for balancing immediate demands with long-term vision, strengthening leadership confidence, and charting a resilient path forward, addressing how leaders can excel in turbulent times and achieve strategic success.

events.name: Scottish Public Service Awards 2026
events.description:
The Scottish Public Service Awards 2026 will once again honour the exceptional dedication and innovation within Scotland's civic society. The awards consistently highlight the exceptional talent, steadfast commitment, and deep care evident across Scotland's public services. They acknowledge the efforts of those in the civil service, local government, health and social care, and vital Third Sector partners who are driving positive change.

The ceremony will take place on Wednesday, 9 December 2026, in the historic Garden Lobby of the Scottish Parliament in Edinburgh. Excellence and innovation will be recognised across 11 distinct categories. Rona Dougall will host the event, with judging carried out by prominent figures.

Now in its thirteenth year, the awards serve as a significant recognition of the vital work that shapes Scotland's future and encourages ongoing commitment to public service.

events.name: Web razzi Fintech 2026

location.venue: Wyndham Grand İstanbul Levent Hotel & Conference Center

events.description:
The future of finance converges on December 9, 2026, at the Wyndham Grand İstanbul Levent Hotel & Conference Center for Webrazzi Fintech 2026. This gathering brings together prominent figures from the finance sector, forward-thinking entrepreneurs, and technology leaders to discuss the evolving landscape of financial technology.

The program features in-depth discussions, with notable speakers and special sessions marking Webrazzi's 20th anniversary. Attendees will engage in workshop sessions led by experts, exploring key areas such as the impact of AI on finance, the development of payment systems, and the emergence of open finance.

It's an opportunity to connect with other participants and key players, using the Webrazzi Events app to facilitate these interactions. Discussions will cover current technologies and business models, examining the interplay between regulation and innovation, and the shifting roles of banks and fintech companies.

events.name: LBA Bank Counsel Conference 2026
events.description:
Legal professionals in the banking sector are invited to convene in New Orleans for the LBA Bank Counsel Conference 2026, running from December 9-11 at The Westin.

The conference will feature two days of focused discussions, examining recent legislative changes, significant court decisions, and the latest federal banking regulations. Participants can expect to gain a clearer understanding of the current challenges and developments influencing banking and commercial law.

A Women in Law Roundtable Discussion is scheduled for December 9th, offering a chance for meaningful conversations and professional connections. An evening reception will also allow for informal conversations among colleagues and industry experts. This event is structured for bank counsel and other legal professionals, serving as a key opportunity to stay informed within a constantly evolving legal environment.

events.name: Chief Ethics & Compliance Officer Forum Winter USA 2026
events.description:
Designed for top-tier compliance and ethics leaders, the Chief Ethics & Compliance Officer Forum Winter USA 2026 offers an unparalleled opportunity to navigate the evolving global marketplace and dynamic regulatory landscape. The event runs from December 9–11, 2026, at the Biltmore Miami in Coral Gables, FL. It is designed specifically for Heads of Corporate Compliance and Ethics, along with other senior executives in the field.

The program combines active panel discussions with smaller, focused breakout sessions. These sessions allow for in-depth exploration of current challenges and potential solutions. Participants will also take part in business meetings, general sessions, and KnowledgeBridge discussions. Opportunities for connecting with others are built into the schedule, including cocktail receptions.

The event provides a chance to hear from experienced industry professionals and to connect with peers. These interactions offer perspectives on developing ethical leadership and strong compliance programs.

events.name: Non Woven Tech Asia 2026
events.description:
Prepare to explore the cutting edge of nonwoven and hygiene technology at Non Woven Tech Asia 2026, India's premier international exhibition. This 12th edition takes place from December 9-11, 2026, in Hall No. 2 at the Bombay Exhibition Centre in Mumbai. Attendees will find the latest advancements in nonwoven materials, hygiene product manufacturing, converting technologies, and next-generation machinery.

The exhibition brings together professionals from various sectors, including baby care, feminine hygiene, medical disposables, filtration, geotextiles, and automotive interiors. It offers an environment where manufacturers, suppliers, distributors, and researchers can engage with new ideas, explore potential partnerships, and discuss industry developments.

Non Woven Tech Asia 2026 provides a comprehensive overview of the nonwoven and hygiene industry's current state and future directions. It serves as a key gathering for those looking to understand the evolving landscape of these technologies.

events.name: The GovAI Coalition Summit 2026
events.description:
Set in the heart of Silicon Valley, The GovAI Coalition Summit 2026 convenes public sector leaders from December 9-10 at the San Jose Convention Center. This event brings together representatives from over 900 local, state, and federal agencies spanning seven countries. Their collective aim is to discuss and influence the direction of AI in public service.

Discussions will cover important areas such as ethical AI governance, practical applications of AI within the public sector, and approaches to developing a workforce prepared for AI integration. Keynote speakers Khaled Tawfik and Dr. Rumman Chowdhury will share their perspectives. The summit also includes parallel sessions exploring AI's role in public safety, cybersecurity, and streamlining permit processes.

On December 11, a Public Sector Town Hall is scheduled. This session will feature brief lightning talks and an AI use case poster fair, designed to encourage discussion and the exchange of ideas.

events.name: Private Wealth Switzerland Forum 2026
events.description:
On December 9, 2026, the prestigious Dolder Grand in Zürich will convene Switzerland's leading private wealth professionals for the 10th Annual Private Wealth Switzerland Forum. This gathering brings together family offices, high net worth wealth managers, and private banks to consider the evolving financial landscape.

Discussions will cover essential areas such as asset allocation, protection strategies, and the outlook for global financial markets. The program will examine equity and fixed income in depth, alongside alternative investments like private equity, venture capital, and hedge funds. Participants will also look at the future of wealth management, with a focus on impact, ESG, and responsible investing, as well as strategies for real assets and real estate.

The forum offers an opportunity for investors and industry leaders to connect, exchange knowledge, and contribute to the ongoing development of private wealth management.

events.name: Massachusetts Conference for Women 2026
events.description:
Empowering women to thrive in their careers and lives, the Massachusetts Conference for Women 2026 returns on December 10, 2026. This gathering will take place at the Thomas M. Menino Convention & Exhibition Center in Boston, bringing together thousands of professionals interested in career and personal development.

Those attending can expect to hear from prominent leaders and participate in breakout sessions that explore topics like leadership, career progression, and personal wellbeing. The event also offers practical elements such as personalized career coaching, professional headshots, and opportunities to connect with others in the Interactive Hall.

An in-person ticket for the Massachusetts conference also provides entry to the virtual National Conference for Women on March 4, 2026, offering additional learning and connection points. The aim is to provide attendees with new perspectives and connections to support their professional paths.

events.name: ACT-IAC Imagine Nation ELC 2026
events.description:
Prepare to move beyond theoretical discussions at ACT-IAC Imagine Nation ELC 2026, taking place December 10-11, 2026, at the Gaylord National Hotel & Convention Center in Oxon Hill, MD. The theme, "Beyond the Blueprint: Turning Ideas into Impact," guides discussions away from mere possibilities and towards demonstrated successes.

This gathering brings together leaders from government and industry to explore practical strategies. Participants will examine "The Velocity of Delivery," understanding how leaders accelerate project implementation. The agenda also covers "Disruptive Implementation" tactics, offering ways to navigate established thinking and administrative challenges.

A key focus will be on "Proven Impact," showcasing real-world examples of IT initiatives that have delivered clear value to citizens. The event aims to connect innovative thinking with practical execution, helping those who drive change translate their concepts into essential results for their missions.

events.name: GSA Awards 2026
events.description:
Prepare to celebrate the pinnacle of innovation and leadership in the semiconductor industry at the 2026 GSA Annual Awards Celebration. The celebration is scheduled for December 10, from 4:00 PM to 10:00 PM PST, in Santa Clara, United States.

Hosted by the Global Semiconductor Alliance, this evening acknowledges the individuals and innovations driving progress in technology. Those attending will have the chance to connect with industry leaders, celebrate important achievements, and learn about the developments influencing the global semiconductor landscape.

events.name: PRI Show 2026
events.description:
The motorsports world converges in Indianapolis, IN, from December 10-12, 2026, for the highly anticipated PRI Show. This gathering connects motorsports professionals from over 70 countries at the Indiana Convention Center and Lucas Oil Stadium. Visitors can explore more than 750,000 square feet of exhibits, where over 1,000 companies present the latest race products, services, and simulation technologies.

The exhibition floor features precision automotive machining equipment, often with live demonstrations, found at Machinery Row in the YELLOW HALL. The SIM Racing Arena provides an interactive experience, and the show also displays a range of racing trailers and motorcoaches.

Beyond the exhibits, Race Industry Week includes conferences, such as the Race Track Business Conference, along with various seminars and networking events like the Grand Opening Breakfast. The show serves as a key resource for race teams, engine builders, fabricators, and track operators looking for advancements across all racing disciplines.

events.name: ISPE Pharma 4.0 Conference 2026
events.description:
Prepare to redefine the future of pharmaceutical manufacturing at the ISPE Pharma 4.0 Conference 2026, held on 10-11 December in Berlin, Germany, with interactive live streams for virtual attendees. This event brings together leaders, regulators, and colleagues from across the pharmaceutical world, fostering interdisciplinary exchange.

Attendees will engage in technical sessions and hear from keynote speakers, exploring new ideas and practical approaches for product development, production systems, and quality assurance. An Expo Hall will feature new technologies, alongside dedicated networking events designed for making connections. Experts will lead discussions on challenges in supply chain operations, facility design, and regulatory affairs. Additionally, professional training courses will be available to address current industry issues.

The conference aims to illustrate how Pharma 4.0 is shaping the future of pharmaceutical practices.

events.name: Global Blockchain Show 2026
events.description:
Set to redefine the future of digital assets, the Global Blockchain Show 2026 will convene in Abu Dhabi on October 29-30. This two-day gathering brings together over 10,000 professionals, including a significant representation of C-level executives, founders, and directors (nearly 80%) from leading organizations across the Middle East, Asia, Europe, and North America, all deeply involved in Web3.

Participants can expect to hear from more than 100 speakers, including figures like Sandeep Nailwal (Polygon) and H.E Justin Sun (Tron HTX). Discussions will cover key areas such as DApps, DeFi, institutional crypto, AI, and the metaverse, offering a comprehensive look at current developments and future directions.

The event provides spaces for focused interaction, including investor lounges and an extensive exhibition area. These settings are designed to facilitate connections, foster collaborations, and allow attendees to explore emerging blockchain innovations.

events.name: FutureCon Cybersecurity Conference Atlanta 2026
events.description:
Prepare to fortify your digital defenses at the FutureCon Cybersecurity Conference Atlanta 2026, a pivotal hybrid event on Thursday, December 10.

This gathering brings together C-suite executives, CISOs, and other security leaders. The discussions will center on critical issues such as identifying security blindspots, refining current risk management practices, and strengthening defenses against data breaches.

Those attending can expect presentations from experienced speakers, a keynote address, and a panel discussion titled "Securing the Future." It's an opportunity to learn about the latest technologies, connect with security professionals, and gain up to 10 CPE credits. The content ranges from practical approaches to endpoint security to developing comprehensive incident response strategies, offering perspectives on managing the evolving cyber threat landscape.

events.name: Droidcon London 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for Droidcon London 2026, the essential gathering for Android developers and tech leaders, taking place on December 10-11 at the Business Design Centre. Over two days, the conference explores the newest Android innovations, established best practices, and emerging trends.

Attendees will have access to the main conference sessions, the Techlead Summit for insights into technical leadership, and interactive Unsolved Unconference sessions designed for collaborative problem-solving. It's an opportunity to connect with peers, learn from industry experts, and refine development skills.

Early Bird tickets, which include full access and recordings of the event, are priced at £289 and can be purchased until March 31st. Student tickets are also offered. This event provides a chance to deepen your expertise and engage with the Android community.

events.name: FCPA and Global Anti-Corruption 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for the 43rd Annual FCPA and Global Anti-Corruption Conference, taking place in Washington, DC, on December 10-11, 2026. This gathering brings together over 600 professionals from the global compliance community for focused discussions on the evolving landscape of anti-corruption, ethics, compliance, and enforcement.

Attendees, including compliance officers, legal experts, and government officials, will leave with practical insights and current strategies to navigate complex challenges. The program provides opportunities to connect with peers, including a Women in FCPA Luncheon and specific industry group sessions. Professional development credits (CLE and CPE) are available, with participants learning from leading speakers from the DOJ and international enforcement bodies.

events.name: Technology Forum New York City 2026

location.venue: New York Marriott at the Brooklyn Bridge

events.description:
Public sector leaders are invited to the Technology Forum New York City 2026, a pivotal two-day event designed to empower state and local government professionals. It will take place on December 10 and 11, 2026, at the New York Marriott at the Brooklyn Bridge. Registration is complimentary for eligible attendees.

Attendees will have opportunities to connect with peers and thought leaders in government to discuss how technology can help modernize operations. The agenda includes sessions exploring critical areas such as cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, data governance, and digital service delivery, aiming to foster new ideas and collaboration.

The forum intends to provide practical guidance and facilitate valuable peer connections. The aim is to help participants address pressing challenges within their organizations and advance public service through innovation.

events.name: World Finance Forum New York 2026
events.description:
The World Finance Forum New York 2026 is poised to gather over 150 finance innovators, including 54 CFOs and FDs, for an essential exploration of the industry's future. The forum will feature insights and practical approaches from 9 speakers, among them CFOs representing Microsoft, Condé Nast, and Paramount Global.

Discussions will explore key "Finance Horizons" themes, including AI & Automation, ESG Value Perception, the evolving Finance Workforce, Strategic FP&A, and navigating Economic Volatility. Attendees will have opportunities to connect with peers and engage with four technology providers.

Participants can also earn 3 CPE Credits, which supports their professional development. This gathering is intended for finance leaders who are influencing the future of the financial sector.

events.name: Digital Government Summit Pennsylvania 2026
events.description:
Public-sector leaders from state and local government across Pennsylvania are invited to the Digital Government Summit Pennsylvania 2026, taking place on December 10 at the Penn Harris Hotel in Camp Hill. This one-day event is designed to help leaders gain new perspectives, work together more effectively, and achieve tangible improvements in public service.

Attendees will examine current strategies and technologies essential for updating operations and addressing pressing challenges. Discussions will cover key areas such as cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, data governance, and improving how digital services are delivered. The summit provides a forum for government professionals to connect, exchange ideas, and discover practical solutions to enhance public services.

Registration is free for all public sector participants, making it straightforward for those involved in digital government initiatives to attend.

events.name: CAPA Airlines Leader Summit World 2026
events.description:
Set in the dynamic city of Milan, Italy, on 10-11 December 2026, the CAPA Airlines Leader Summit World 2026 serves as the year's culminating global aviation forum. Over these two days, the event will bring together hundreds of C-suite executives, policymakers, and industry leaders from the global air transport sector, representing full-service, low-cost, and hybrid airlines.

Through keynotes, executive panels, and dedicated networking, participants will share regional insights and explore the industry's most significant challenges and emerging opportunities. Discussions will cover crucial subjects such as decarbonisation efforts, technological advancements, payment system complexities, and changing passenger expectations.

The aim is to help leaders develop forward-looking strategies, strengthen operational resilience, and foster innovation. This preparation is intended to help their organizations navigate the complexities of the global market effectively.

events.name: CIO Chicago Summit December 2026
events.description:
Prepare for a day of strategic insights and unparalleled networking at the CIO Chicago Summit on Thursday, December 10, 2026. This one-day event in Chicago is designed for senior IT leaders and C-suite executives from the world's largest companies. It offers a focused environment for those navigating complex technological landscapes.

Under the theme "Unlocking What’s Next: Insight and Innovation for a Transformational Era," the summit facilitates real conversations about critical challenges. Participants will delve into practical strategies for demonstrating AI's value, managing multi-cloud environments smoothly, updating legacy systems, and implementing lasting transformation. The setting encourages peer-to-peer collaboration and direct interaction with leading solution providers, providing access to advanced technologies.

The day concludes with a reception, offering an opportunity to build and strengthen connections with industry peers.

events.name: CISO Chicago Summit December 2026
events.description:
Elevate your cybersecurity strategy at the CISO Chicago Summit, taking place on Thursday, December 10, 2026, in Chicago, Illinois. This one-day event brings together CISOs and senior security leaders in an intimate setting, fostering direct conversations and shared learning among peers.

The summit's theme, "Transforming Security: Insight and Resilience for a New Era," guides discussions around pressing challenges. These include defending against fast-moving threats, securing global supply chains, and navigating complex regulations. Participants will explore strategies for safeguarding critical assets, enabling innovation, managing costs, and building resilient teams.

Opportunities exist to meet with technology partners in private one-to-one sessions and connect with fellow leaders during the networking reception. The discussions aim to contribute to the ongoing evolution of enterprise security.

events.name: SIM Memphis Strategy Series for Executives 2026
events.description:
Elevate your leadership vision at the SIM Memphis Strategy Series for Executives 2026, an essential gathering for top-tier leaders.

This program, developed by Executive Functions Management (EFM Events) and held in Memphis, is designed to provide executives with strategic approaches for today's evolving business landscape. Participants will explore current insights, consider innovative leadership methods, and gain practical frameworks.

The series offers an opportunity to refine strategic thinking, build connections with peers, and engage with expert perspectives on preparing organizations for future challenges. The goal is to help leaders effectively navigate complex situations and lead with greater strategic clarity.

events.name: Gramercy Financial Marketers' Forum Boston 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendar for Thursday, December 10, 2026, as the Gramercy Financial Marketers' Forum Boston 2026 takes center stage in Boston. This gathering is the Gramercy Institute’s 12th Annual Asset Management Marketing Forum & Awards, created for financial marketers navigating the asset management sector.

Attendees will explore important trends, learn about new strategies, and discuss effective practices that are shaping the future of financial marketing. It's a chance to connect with leaders in the field and exchange insights. The day concludes with an awards ceremony, recognizing notable achievements and excellent work from the past year.

events.name: InterFace Seniors Housing Northeast 2026
events.description:
The 10th annual InterFace Seniors Housing Northeast 2026 returns to the Hilton Philadelphia at Penn’s Landing on December 9-10, 2026, establishing itself once again as the region's premier gathering for seniors housing professionals. The two-day event begins with an afternoon dedicated to roundtables, a panel session, and a networking reception, followed by a full day of discussions.

Professionals including owners, operators, investors, and developers from the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic will gather to discuss key topics. The agenda includes a CEO panel and sessions led by experts. These discussions will cover investment and development opportunities, operational strategies, staffing solutions, and how technology influences care delivery and efficiency. Time is also set aside for networking, allowing attendees to connect with peers and contribute to the future direction of seniors housing.

events.name: The Assembly Caribbean 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for The Assembly Caribbean 2026, ACAMS' essential virtual summit designed for anti-financial crime professionals navigating the unique challenges of the Caribbean region. The online summit, scheduled for December 10-11, 2026, will explore the evolving challenges in preventing financial crime.

Participants will examine key areas such as FATF mutual evaluations, strategies for combating Trade-Based Money Laundering, and advancements in digital ID and e-KYC solutions. The program also addresses how to strengthen cross-border cooperation against transnational crime and covers the latest technological developments in AML.

Attendees can earn 12 ACAMS credits, take part in interactive Q&A sessions, and review all content on-demand for 90 days through the ACAMS Learning Management System. This event is designed to help C-level executives and decision-makers deepen their knowledge and reinforce regional defenses against financial crime.

events.name: MedFIT 2026
events.description:
The 10th edition of MedFIT 2026 invites innovators, investors, and senior executives to Marseille, France, on December 10th and 11th. This European gathering focuses on building innovation partnerships and securing investments across MedTech, Diagnostics, and Digital Health.

Attendees can arrange one-to-one meetings, specifically designed to connect potential project partners and facilitate funding discussions. A conference program, structured across three tracks, will offer insights and practical approaches for professionals throughout the sector. Opportunities exist to present new products or technologies during pitch sessions, including Start-up Slams, and to expand professional networks within the exhibition area.

The event provides a setting for collaboration, contributing to the ongoing development of healthcare.

events.name: BioFit 2026
events.description:
The 15th edition of BioFit 2026, Europe's leading partnering event for early-stage deals and investment in Life Sciences, convenes on December 10th & 11th in Marseille, France. The event will explore key themes such as "One Health" and "R&D Dating for Animal Health," highlighting new products and technologies in biotechnology.

Attendees, including investors, senior executives, researchers, and technology transfer professionals, can engage in dedicated one-to-one meetings to help accelerate projects and secure funding. The agenda includes a conference program spanning four tracks, an exhibition for networking, and pitch sessions where innovators can present their work to industry leaders.

This gathering provides a setting for developing new partnerships and advancing innovation in the life sciences sector.

events.name: CDO/CAIO Chicago Summit December 2026
events.description:
On December 10, 2026, the CDO/CAIO Chicago Summit convenes the nation's leading Chief Data Officers, Chief AI Officers, and senior data/AI executives in Chicago, Illinois. This single-day gathering, themed "Future Forward: Charting the Course for Data and AI Excellence," provides a space for leaders to exchange ideas, discuss challenges, and explore potential collaborations.

Participants will encounter new ways to engage, including "The Great Debate" for exploring diverse viewpoints, "Strategy Sprints" for tackling real-time issues, and "Leadership Labs" designed to refine essential human skills. The discussions will cover pressing topics such as data privacy, the evolving landscape of AI, and strategies for acquiring talent.

The day is structured to facilitate meaningful interactions among peers, culminating in a reception. Attendees will also have opportunities to learn about emerging technologies, aiming to equip them with practical approaches for advancing data and AI initiatives.

events.name: Digital Government Summit Nevada 2026

location.venue: The Westin Lake Las Vegas Resort & Spa

events.description:
Public-sector leaders and innovators are invited to the Digital Government Summit Nevada 2026, a crucial one-day event designed to shape the future of state and local government. This gathering will take place on December 10, 2026, at The Westin Lake Las Vegas Resort & Spa in Henderson, Nevada, providing a dedicated space for public-sector professionals who qualify to attend.

Those attending will explore key topics including cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, data governance, and how digital services are delivered. The discussions are structured to encourage new perspectives, build connections, and help achieve practical outcomes. This approach aims to equip leaders with insights into advanced technologies and strategies for updating their operations.

It's an opportunity to connect with colleagues, receive practical advice, and uncover fresh approaches to current challenges, all contributing to the ongoing digital evolution within government.

events.name: CFOMeet Houston 2026
events.description:
Houston's leading financial minds will converge at CFOMeet Houston 2026, taking place on December 2nd, 2025, at the Fogo de Chão Brazilian Steakhouse. This event brings together CFOs and senior financial leaders from various industries to discuss the changing role of the CFO.

The program features a central panel discussion, "What is the Future of the Office of the CFO?" Richard O'Brien, Amish Pattani, and Bob Truhlar will share their insights, moderated by TEDx Speaker Neha Negandhi. Throughout the day, sessions will explore topics such as forecasting strategies, encouraging creative problem-solving, and understanding current business trends.

Attendees will have opportunities to connect with peers, including members of "The CFO ThrivePoint," a group recognized for its forward-thinking perspectives. The day also includes collaborative sessions and a Leaders Lunch. The goal is to offer practical strategies and insights that support leaders in their professional growth, highlighting the value of resilience.

events.name: CUSO Conference 2026
events.description:
Elevate your credit union's strategic vision at the CUSO Conference 2026, set against the beautiful backdrop of St. Petersburg, Florida, from December 10-13.

This event, organized by CU Conferences, is designed for credit union and CUSO board members, CEOs, and supervisory committee members. Participants will explore how CUSOs can contribute to growth, efficiency, and expanded capabilities.

Speakers will discuss important subjects such as the evolving landscape of CUSO regulation, integrating technology trends like Decentralized Finance, developing shared infrastructure, and improving leadership effectiveness. Attendees can earn up to 10.8 CPE credits. The program also provides opportunities for discussions and connecting with peers. The conference aims to provide clarity on the role CUSOs play in developing new products and enhancing member engagement, helping institutions navigate the evolving financial landscape.

events.name: FS-ISAC UK Cyber & Resilience Exchange 2026
events.description:
The financial sector's leading cyber and resilience experts will converge in London on 10 December 2026 for the FS-ISAC UK Cyber & Resilience Exchange. This full-day gathering brings together FS-ISAC members, partners, and trusted collaborators, fostering connections among those who safeguard our financial systems.

Participants will share insights and explore practical solutions to the most pressing cyber and resilience challenges facing the financial world. The discussions will cover critical areas such as supply chain risk, geopolitical shifts, fraud, and emerging technologies, highlighting effective strategies and best practices from across the membership.

The goal is to enhance our shared understanding and collective ability to act. By turning these shared insights into tangible strategies, the event aims to reinforce the defenses that protect the global financial infrastructure.

events.name: LA RIMS Holiday Party 2026
events.description:
The LA RIMS Holiday Party 2026 invites you to an unforgettable evening of festive cheer and camaraderie! Risk management and insurance professionals will gather on December 10th, from 6:00 pm to 10:00 pm, at the Castaway in Burbank, CA. The evening will feature music, dancing, and an opportunity to connect with colleagues, marking the close of a successful year.

In the spirit of the season, attendees are encouraged to bring an unwrapped toy for Toys for Tots. Each donation will provide an entry into a raffle. Ticket options are available for members, Rising Risk Professionals, and non-members. Information on sponsor packages is also available.

events.name: The Private Wealth & Funds Forum 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendar for **The Private Wealth & Funds Forum 2026**, a pivotal one-day gathering on 10 December at the Marriott Hotel Downtown, Abu Dhabi. This event brings together over 400 senior leaders from private banks, family offices, asset managers, and tech innovators to discuss and influence the direction of wealth management.

The forum features more than 40 speakers, offering extensive discussions on key topics. These include how to build resilient portfolios, the influence of AI on wealth, transferring wealth across generations, and the changing world of digital assets. The day will include keynote speeches, panel discussions, and opportunities for focused one-to-one conversations.

Participants can expect to gain practical insights for the upcoming investment cycle, helping them prepare their portfolios for 2027 and beyond. All of this takes place in Abu Dhabi, an increasingly important global center for wealth.

events.name: Municipal Finance Institute 2026
events.description:
Cal Cities presents the Municipal Finance Institute 2026, a pivotal event for city officials and finance professionals, taking place December 10-11 at the Monterey Plaza Hotel in Monterey, CA.

Over two days, the institute offers key insights into municipal fiscal planning. Attendees will participate in educational sessions that provide important information and strategies for navigating today's financial landscape.

Beyond the structured learning, there will be opportunities to connect with colleagues and Cal Cities Partners, which can lead to new collaborations and professional development. California CPAs can also earn Continuing Professional Education (CPE) credits. This event supports professionals looking to deepen their understanding and expand their network in municipal finance.

events.name: M&A Awards 2026
events.description:
On December 10, 2026, the historic Beurs van Berlage will host the M&A Awards 2026, a prestigious black-tie gala celebrating the year's most significant achievements. The evening gathers around 1000 key figures from private equity, investment banking, corporate finance, consultancy, and the legal sector.

Attendees will be greeted with champagne, followed by a gourmet dinner and the award show. This segment acknowledges excellence across various categories, ranging from Best Deal to Best Diversity Firm. It offers a chance to reflect on the year's achievements, connect with peers, and celebrate shared successes.

The event concludes with an after-party, featuring a DJ and a special main act, fostering an atmosphere of celebration and camaraderie.

events.name: IBR Forum on The Future 2026
events.description:
Gain critical foresight into the evolving business landscape at the IBR Forum on The Future 2026. The forum takes place on December 10, 2026, from 8:00 a.m. to 10:30 a.m. It will feature leaders from four key industries: Accounting, Construction, Employment Services, and Law.

Participants will take part in a moderated panel discussion, where they will explore the trends, challenges, and opportunities shaping these interconnected sectors. The discussion aims to provide practical insights for navigating future complexities and capitalizing on emerging possibilities.

Professionals and stakeholders looking to understand future developments will find value in the discussions. There will also be opportunities to connect with industry peers and experts.

events.name: NJBIZ Business Of The Year 2026
events.description:
Join the Garden State's top business leaders at The Marigold in Somerset, NJ, on December 8, 2026, from 8:00 AM – 10:30 AM EST, for the prestigious NJBIZ Business Of The Year 2026 awards ceremony.

This in-person event celebrates companies and individuals who have demonstrated outstanding accomplishments, contributing significantly to the state's business landscape. The program acknowledges a commitment to professional excellence, business growth, and community impact. Finalists are honored, and winners are announced across various categories, including For-Profit, Non-Profit, Family Owned, Corporate Citizen, Executive, and Emerging Business of the Year.

Those recognized receive a profile in the event publication, a desktop award, and a ticket to the ceremony. This gathering, presented by Provident Bank and supported by JPMorgan Chase, brings together New Jersey's leading enterprises and executives.

events.name: PowerEx Live London 2026
events.description:
The critical power sector converges at PowerEx Live London 2026, a premier event designed for professionals across the CHP, Genset, Data Centre, and Consultancy markets. This one-day summit is scheduled for Thursday, 10th December 2026, from 09:15 to 16:00 at the Park Plaza, Westminster Bridge, London. It offers a focused environment for industry professionals.

Participants will have the opportunity to hear from speakers in two dedicated rooms, exploring current topics and the latest solutions shaping the critical power landscape. The event provides a setting for professionals to connect with peers and build new relationships within the industry.

Attendance is free upon registration. Given the limited capacity, early registration is advisable.

events.name: The St. Louis ORBIE Awards 2026

location.venue: The Chase Park Plaza Royal Sonesta Hotel

events.description:
The St. Louis ORBIE Awards 2026 will shine a spotlight on the region's most impactful technology leaders, culminating in a prestigious ceremony on December 10 at The Chase Park Plaza Royal Sonesta Hotel.

The awards program begins with the ORBIE Leadership Reception on September 10 at Maritz, where the year's nominees will be recognized. Finalists will then gather for a special dinner with wine pairings at the Missouri Athletic Club - Downtown on November 12.

The awards ceremony will celebrate CIOs and executive leaders for their innovative work and transformative impact within St. Louis's leading organizations. Presented by St. Louis CIO, the event brings together C-suite leaders, senior technology executives, and trusted partners, offering a chance to connect, acknowledge achievements, and draw inspiration from the region's technology visionaries.

events.name: Cavaliada Poznan 2026
events.description:
Prepare for an unparalleled celebration of equestrian excellence as Cavaliada Poznan 2026 gallops into Poznań, Poland. Organized by Grupa MTP, this event gathers international competitors and equestrian enthusiasts for a display of skill and horsemanship. Spectators can expect to see action across four core disciplines: show jumping, eventing, dressage, and driving, alongside various performances.

Away from the main arena, a trade fair will feature the latest equestrian equipment and accessories. The schedule also includes the Perlage CAVALIADA Future competitions, the CAVALIADA Horse Auctions, and a School Program designed to introduce young people to the world of horses.

This gathering offers something for everyone interested in horses, from experienced riders to those just beginning to explore the equestrian world.

events.name: Cosmoprof India 2026
events.description:
Mumbai's Jio World Convention Centre will become the epicenter of beauty innovation as Cosmoprof India 2026 unfolds from December 10 to 12.

This business-to-business exhibition is a key part of the worldwide Cosmoprof network, focusing specifically on India's rapidly expanding beauty sector. It will occupy over 25,000 square meters, bringing together more than 900 exhibitors and brands, and is expected to draw over 16,000 attendees.

Those attending will have the chance to explore the full spectrum of the beauty supply chain, from raw ingredients to final products. It's a place to discover current trends and discuss what drives quality in the industry. The event also includes a comprehensive schedule of educational sessions and collaborative projects, providing a setting for professionals to connect, gain new perspectives, and explore avenues for business development within the evolving beauty landscape.

events.name: Future Physicians for Change 2026
events.description:
Prepare to ignite your purpose and redefine the future of healthcare at Future Physicians for Change 2026, hosted by the American Medical Student Association (AMSA). From December 10-12 in the D.C. Metro Area, this event brings together future doctors, medical students, and pre-health students who are interested in driving change in medicine.

The agenda for these three days focuses on "POWER, POLICY, AND THE PEOPLE." Attendees will participate in an Advocacy Day, present new ideas at INNOFEST, and engage in the SIM Challenge. There will also be opportunities to connect with others and learn about different career paths at the Pre-Health and Residency + Specialty Fairs.

The aim is for participants to gain new perspectives, broaden their professional connections, and contribute to discussions about the evolving landscape of medicine. Information regarding registration is available.

events.name: ZAK Doors & Windows Expo 2026
events.description:
Step into the future of fenestration at the 22nd International ZAK Doors & Windows Expo 2026, scheduled for 10–12 December at Yashobhoomi (IICC) in New Delhi, India. This three-day trade fair is recognized as India's largest dedicated event for the door, window, and façade industry. Attendees will find a comprehensive display of machinery, systems, profiles, and cladding solutions, alongside a variety of related products.

With over 200 brands exhibiting from 25 countries, the expo provides a setting to explore new materials, understand the latest technologies, and connect with others in the field. It offers a chance to see what's emerging in the sector and to engage directly with manufacturers and innovators.

Professionals attending can gather insights to help their businesses grow and stay informed about developments in this evolving sector.

events.name: Private Wealth Southwest Forum 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendar for the 4th Annual Private Wealth Southwest Forum 2026, an exclusive, invitation-only event. The event takes place on December 10 at the W Scottsdale in Arizona, bringing together key figures from the Southwest's high net worth family wealth management community, such as RIAs, family offices, and private banks.

The forum provides opportunities for peer-to-peer learning and networking. Discussions will focus on navigating 2026 markets, building alternative investment portfolios, and exploring the future of wealth management through technology and talent. The agenda, developed with direct input from the community, aims to provide practical insights from regional leaders.

Qualified investors receive complimentary registration, contributing to an environment focused on strategic dialogue and professional development. CPE credits are available.

events.name: A4M Longevity Fest 2026
events.description:
Prepare to unlock the secrets of a longer, healthier life at the A4M Longevity Fest 2026.

The American Academy of Anti-Aging Medicine (A4M) organizes this gathering, which will be held in December at The Venetian And Palazzo Resort in Las Vegas. It anticipates bringing together over 8,000 licensed professionals, researchers, and individuals focused on wellness.

The program includes more than 200 sessions, where experts from around the world will share insights into personalized health strategies and the latest longevity science. An expo floor will also provide opportunities to interact with new wearable technology and biohacking tools. This environment fosters connections among leading figures in the field, encourages interactive learning, and highlights innovations that are influencing the future of health.

events.name: Massachusetts Association of Health Plans Annual Health Care Conference 2026
events.description:
On Friday, December 11, 2026, the Massachusetts Association of Health Plans Annual Health Care Conference will convene over 450 leading professionals for a critical exploration of "Health Care Affordability: From Challenge to Action." This sold-out conference brings together professionals to discuss critical topics influencing healthcare in Massachusetts and nationwide, fostering dialogue on pressing issues shaping the health care landscape.

Attendees will engage in discussions covering public health, system performance, crisis management, and evidence-driven policy. A key part of the program is the keynote address from Dr. Ashish K. Jha, a prominent figure in Public Health and former White House COVID-19 Response Coordinator. Dr. Jha will share his perspective on preparing for pandemics, developing robust bio-intelligence systems, and improving both the quality and affordability of care.

events.name: MedSpa Pro Meeting 2026
events.description:
The MedSpa Pro Meeting 2026 stands as the ultimate destination for medical aesthetics professionals seeking unparalleled education, vital connections, and significant growth. This gathering offers both new and experienced practitioners an opportunity to engage with the latest developments in the medspa field, helping them adapt and succeed.

Attendees will hear directly from respected figures in the industry, including Dr. Jason Pozner, Dr. Barry DiBernardo, and Dr. Joseph Russo. The program delves into a wide array of subjects, from skincare and injectables to laser technologies and regenerative medicine. Discussions will also cover advanced approaches to aesthetic management, such as considerations for GLP-1 patients and those with estrogen-deficient skin.

The insights shared aim to provide practitioners with the understanding and abilities needed to maintain their edge, broaden their professional connections, and advance their careers within medical aesthetics.

events.name: DRT Show Hong Kong 2026

location.venue: Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre

events.description:
Prepare to explore the depths of the ocean world at the DRT Show Hong Kong 2026, scheduled for 11-13 December at the Hong Kong Convention and Exhibition Centre. Recognized as Asia's largest diving expo, this event brings together divers, enthusiasts, and industry professionals.

Visitors can expect to see the newest diving equipment, advanced underwater photography gear, and a variety of offerings from resorts, liveaboards, and training organizations. It provides an opportunity for both businesses and individuals to connect and exchange ideas within the global diving, resort, and travel communities.

The show also highlights marine ecology and ocean culture, with plans for an 'Ocean Stars Underwater Photo Gallery'. It serves as a place for individuals to engage with international brands and further their interest in the underwater world.

events.name: InterGem Jewelry Show Rosemont 2026

location.venue: Donald E. Stephens Convention Center (Hall G)

events.description:
Celebrating 59 years as America's longest-running direct-to-consumer jewelry show, the InterGem Jewelry Show returns to Rosemont from December 11-13, 2026.

The show will be held at the Donald E. Stephens Convention Center in Hall G. It provides an opportunity to explore a broad selection of fine jewelry, gemstones, unique beads, and handcrafted pieces. Visitors can engage directly with wholesalers, manufacturers, and designers, which often means competitive pricing and quality items. The event is designed for individuals seeking a special gift or for business owners interested in wholesale purchases.

Active and veteran military members, along with their immediate families, receive complimentary admission. Tickets purchased online are available at a 25% discount.

events.name: ISWPT 2026
