events.description:
Set to be a pivotal gathering for environmental science, ISWPT 2026, the 9th International Symposium on Water Pollution and Treatment, will take place in Shanghai, China, from December 12-14, 2026.

This on-site conference brings together researchers, practitioners, and policymakers from around the world. It offers an opportunity to explore recent progress in water pollution control, wastewater treatment, and sustainable water management. Attendees will have the chance to examine new research findings, share insights, and build connections across various disciplines.

Supported by institutions such as Konkuk University and the National University of Singapore, the symposium serves as a significant forum for individuals dedicated to addressing global water challenges and fostering innovation in environmental protection.

events.name: Christmas Gift & Decor Show 2026
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the spirit of the season at the Christmas Gift & Decor Show 2026! From December 11-13, 2026, the Kentucky Exposition Center's West Wing in Louisville will host this annual event. It has been a Louisville tradition for over 30 years, drawing more than 25,000 visitors each year, and admission is free.

The show features over 750 exhibitor booths, offering a wide array of unique gift items and decor ideas. Visitors can explore a substantial collection of goods, making it easy to find something special. There will also be an opportunity for free pictures with Santa.

Organized by Stewart Promotions, the event also provides practical amenities such as on-site scooter rentals. The aim is to offer a comprehensive selection of items to help individuals prepare for the holiday season.

events.name: Athens International Tourism & Culture Expo 2026
events.description:
Returning for its 13th edition, the Athens International Tourism & Culture Expo 2026 is set to be Greece's premier platform for global tourism collaboration. The event takes place from December 11-13 at the Peristeri Expo Center. It brings together Greek and international tourism professionals, aiming to build strong partnerships and encourage more visitors to Greece.

The expo includes a comprehensive B2B Meetings program. This features a Hosted Buyers’ Program, which connects 130 key tour operators and MICE companies from 35 countries. The goal is to arrange 5,500 targeted business meetings. Attendees will have the chance to explore various tourism sectors, from leisure and luxury travel to MICE (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences, and Exhibitions) and alternative tourism options.

An integrated B2B Online Program supports networking efforts. This allows exhibitors to connect with potential partners and discuss agreements, all while showcasing the unique appeal and high standards of Greek tourism.

events.name: MACHMA Expo 2026
events.description:
MACHMA Expo 2026, India's leading exhibition on Machine Tools, Automation & Laser Technology, celebrates its 13th edition from December 11-14 at Parade Ground, Chandigarh. This four-day event, spanning over 25,000 sq. ft., offers professionals a complimentary pass to explore the latest innovations. Visitors can expect to see more than 10,000 new products demonstrated live and connect with over 650 prominent exhibitors.

The expo brings together over 50,000 professionals, including engineers, manufacturers, and decision-makers, representing more than 27 industry sectors and 13 countries. It's a place to build connections and gain perspective. Expert-led conferences and workshops will offer discussions on the future of industries like automotive, aerospace, electronics, and manufacturing, highlighting key business developments and technological progress.

events.name: iDAC Summit Dubai 2026
events.description:
On December 11th, 2026, the iDAC Summit Dubai will convene at the Dusit Thani, UAE, offering a dynamic half-day platform for the Architecture, Design, and Construction sectors. This gathering aims to foster collaboration, spark new ideas, and build meaningful connections among leading architects, designers, consultants, and brands.

Attendees can expect engaging sessions that delve into current industry thinking, alongside exhibits displaying the latest advancements. The summit also offers significant opportunities for networking, serving as an important precursor to the main iDAC Expo in Mumbai. It's an occasion for professionals to connect, share insights, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of the built environment.

events.name: ASH Annual Meeting and Exposition 2026
events.description:
The ASH Annual Meeting and Exposition 2026 stands as the premier global gathering for advancing hematologic science and patient care. Organized by the American Society of Hematology, this meeting brings together a diverse group of medical professionals, including practicing hematologists, oncologists, clinical researchers, and medical students. Those attending can expect to learn about significant scientific advancements, participate in high-quality educational sessions, and see the latest innovations shaping how we treat blood disorders.

The exhibit hall provides a space where companies present their newest research, products, and capabilities. Beyond the formal sessions, it's a chance to connect with colleagues, understand emerging trends, and contribute to the ongoing work of improving patient care globally.

events.name: IEEE International Electron Devices Meeting 2026
events.description:
Prepare to delve into the forefront of technological innovation at the IEEE International Electron Devices Meeting (IEDM) 2026, taking place December 12-16 at the Hilton Union Square San Francisco. This meeting, organized by IEEE and the IEEE Electron Devices Society (EDS), brings together the community to discuss the future of electron devices. It is a key gathering where new ideas and directions in the field are explored.

Participants can expect to engage with significant developments in semiconductor technology, quantum computing, AI hardware, and emerging device physics. The event provides a setting for researchers, engineers, and industry leaders from around the globe to present their latest work, exchange knowledge, and build connections. These interactions are crucial for advancing microelectronics and understanding the evolving role of electronic devices in our world.

events.name: Cell Bio 2026
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the forefront of cellular discovery at Cell Bio 2026, an ASCB|EMBO Meeting, taking place from December 12 to 16, 2026, at the San Diego Convention Center in San Diego, CA. This gathering brings together the worldwide cell biology community, from experienced scientists and researchers to those just starting their careers and important decision-makers.

It serves as a place to present significant scientific findings, inspire new thoughts, and support professional development. Participants will have the chance to explore recent research, uncover new fields of study, and interact with advanced technologies.

The Exhibit Hall provides opportunities to connect with innovators from around the world, learn about new developments, and build valuable working relationships. It's a space where discoveries are acknowledged and the future direction of cell biology can be discussed.

events.name: IEEE-EMBS International Conference on Biomedical and Health Informatics 2026

location.venue: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

events.description:
The future of personalized healthcare and intelligent medical solutions will converge at the IEEE-EMBS International Conference on Biomedical and Health Informatics (BHI’26). The conference, organized by IEEE EMBS, will take place from December 12th to 15th, 2026, in Hong Kong, China, offering a platform for groundbreaking research.

The conference explores how artificial intelligence, machine learning, and advanced informatics are used to transform complex biomedical data into actionable, individualized insights. Discussions will cover innovations in areas such as precision healthcare, digital twins, generative AI, and pervasive health monitoring. Participants, ranging from established researchers to students, will have opportunities to engage with these cutting-edge developments.

The program also includes a student data competition and visits to medical device companies in the Great-Bay Area. Recognition for outstanding contributions will be given through best paper awards. The gathering aims to foster discussions that will help shape the next generation of health informatics.

events.name: DevOpsDays Recife 2026
events.description:
Dive deep into the evolving world of DevOps at the sixth annual DevOpsDays Recife, taking place on December 12, 2026, from 8:00 AM to 6:00 PM. The event will be held at UNINASSAU Graças - Bloco B, Auditório Roque de Brito. This full-day program explores the theme "Rios, Pontes e Tecnologia" (Rivers, Bridges, and Technology), which reflects the continuous flow of DevOps work, the essential connections between teams and tools, and technology's role in driving innovation.

This event brings together professionals from development, operations, SRE, product, platform, and security roles. Participants will engage in discussions, workshops, and informal activities. These opportunities allow for sharing knowledge and exploring current developments in automation, platform, and security. The day offers a chance to gain new perspectives and build connections within the DevOps community.

events.name: Spirit Royale Marquee Championship Los Angeles 2026
events.description:
Prepare for an electrifying showcase of talent and spirit at the Spirit Royale Marquee Championship Los Angeles 2026! The Spirit Network brings this cheerleading competition to the Los Angeles Convention Center on December 12-13, 2026. Teams affiliated with USASF and IASF will gather to compete for various titles, including Grand Champs, Level Champs, and Division Champs, demonstrating their athleticism and precision.

Attendees will have the opportunity to watch the routines and cheer for their favorite teams. Details on ticketing, including discounts for youth and military personnel, will be provided. Presale for tickets begins one month before the event. This championship not only focuses on competitive excellence but also supports the #cheerkind initiative, offering a weekend of high-energy performances and spirited, positive competition.

events.name: Electrify Expo San Diego 2026
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the electrifying future of mobility at Electrify Expo San Diego 2026! This large outdoor event provides a chance to ride, drive, and experience the newest electric vehicles, e-motorcycles, and e-bikes, among other innovations, spread across more than a million square feet.

Attendees will find a range of experiences, from the new Robotics Showcase and the Aerial Mobility zone, offering a look at future commuting, to the EV Terrain Park for off-road exploration. There will also be an opportunity to test self-driving technology in the Hands Free Zone. Beyond the technology, the event will include music, food, and activities suitable for families.

While specific dates and the San Diego venue for 2026 are still being finalized, the event aims to offer a comprehensive, hands-on exploration into the world of electrification. Further details will be shared as they become available.

events.name: Antibody Engineering & Therapeutics US 2026
events.description:
The premier gathering for advancing antibody and protein engineering returns to San Diego! From December 13-16, 2026, Antibody Engineering & Therapeutics US 2026 will be held at the Marriott Marquis. This event serves as a key forum for professionals dedicated to accelerating the development of future biotherapeutics.

Over four days, participants will delve into breakthrough science across various fields, including Antibodies, Proteins, Bispecifics, Multispecifics, ADCs, AI, and computational innovations. Discussions will cover strategies for moving discoveries from the lab to clinical application more quickly, exploring novel formats, emerging disease areas, and advanced engineering techniques.

The gathering is expected to bring together over 900 international attendees and 165 expert speakers from around the world. It offers a setting for professionals to exchange ideas, build connections, and gain insights that will influence the future of antibody-based medicines.

events.name: MediaPost Performance Marketing Insider Summit Winter 2026
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the future of interactive media and performance marketing at the MediaPost Performance Marketing Insider Summit Winter 2026. From December 13-16, 2026, senior marketing leaders will gather in Deer Valley, UT. This time is dedicated to in-depth conversations and sharing strategic perspectives with peers.

This gathering is for Chief Marketing Officers, Directors, and Leads. The focus is on exploring important industry trends, addressing current challenges, and discovering better ways of working. This happens through structured presentations and open discussions among colleagues.

Those who attend can expect to leave with a clearer understanding of key issues, new connections, and refined strategies to enhance their marketing efforts in a constantly changing environment.

events.name: HEALTHTAC Food & Beverage 2026
events.description:
Dedicated to transforming the culinary landscape within aging services, HEALTHTAC Food & Beverage 2026 will convene from December 13-15, 2026, at the luxurious Hyatt Regency Coconut Point Resort in Bonita Springs, Florida. This two-day gathering provides a focused environment for sharing ideas and fostering connections among professionals.

The event brings together decision-makers from senior living facilities and professional organizations with companies that offer relevant products and services. Attendees will participate in private, pre-scheduled meetings and hear from speakers who will share insights, all with the aim of enhancing the dining experience for residents.

Discussions will center on practical ways to equip, manage, and improve culinary offerings. The focus remains on addressing the specific needs of the aging services community and contributing to advancements across the industry.

events.name: IP Forum for Life Sciences 2026
events.description:
The IP Forum for Life Sciences 2026 offers an unparalleled opportunity for top-tier IP executives and corporate leaders to shape the future of intellectual property in the life sciences sector. From December 13–15, the Biltmore Miami in Coral Gables, FL, will host this multi-day event. It is designed to address the specific challenges and opportunities related to intangible assets in the life sciences.

Attendees will participate in panel discussions and breakout sessions. These sessions will explore strategies for utilizing intellectual property, recognizing new threats, and encouraging innovation. The forum brings together Vice Presidents of IP, Chief IP Officers, and General Counsel, providing a space for them to connect, share perspectives, and work together on effective practices.

Beyond the scheduled sessions, the event includes dedicated time for business meetings and networking. This structure aims to provide a complete experience, allowing leaders to advance strategic growth and safeguard important assets within their organizations.

events.name: Leadership Forum 2026
events.description:
The Leadership Forum 2026, an exclusive, invitation-only summit, convenes senior decision-makers from the meetings, sports, and hospitality industries at the iconic Inn at Spanish Bay, Pebble Beach.

This three-day gathering, taking place from December 13-16, is organized by Northstar Meetings Group. It brings together C-Suite executives, association leaders, and DMOs, providing a setting for meaningful strategic discussions. Participants can expect engaging panel discussions focused on current trends and new approaches, alongside opportunities to connect with peers.

Beyond the structured sessions, attendees will have access to comfortable accommodations and a range of activities, including golf and fine dining. The intention behind this forum is to encourage collaboration, facilitate the exchange of best practices, and collectively contribute to the future direction of these evolving sectors.

events.name: CPHI Middle East 2026
events.description:
Riyadh is set to host the premier pharmaceutical gathering at CPHI Middle East 2026, taking place from May 11-13 at the Riyadh Exhibition and Convention Centre. This gathering will bring together over 60,000 attendees and more than 1,000 exhibiting companies from over 110 countries. It provides a significant opportunity to engage with the Middle East and Africa's largest pharmaceutical market.

Those attending can explore the full spectrum of the pharmaceutical supply chain, covering everything from active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and machinery to finished dosage forms and packaging solutions. Participants will also gain a deeper understanding of health sector reforms, generics, and biosimilars, supported by expert analysis, including findings from the IQVIA Market Report on Saudi pharma.

More than 310 speakers, including prominent industry figures such as Doaa Fathallah, are scheduled to share their insights. The event aims to facilitate collaboration and advance innovation within the global pharmaceutical community, helping to build important connections.

events.name: SVG Summit NY 2026
events.description:
Mark your calendars for the SVG Summit NY 2026, the premier annual gathering for the sports video industry, held on December 14-15 in New York, NY. This core event brings together members and sponsors to discuss and help shape the future of sports broadcasting and production.

Over two days, attendees will explore the technologies and strategies that are changing live sports content. Discussions will cover topics like remote production, IP workflows, immersive experiences, and fan engagement.

The Summit also provides an opportunity to network with leaders and experts in sports media, and build new relationships.

events.name: Aviation Forum 2026
events.description:
Aviation Forum 2026, Europe's leading aerospace management conference, will convene on December 14-15 at the Infinity Conference Center & Hotel Munich. The two-day program focuses on "Shaping aviation excellence in a dynamic world: Resilient operations, smart technologies & strategic collaboration."

The gathering brings together over 950 professionals and more than 70 expert speakers, who will explore current topics, recent innovations, and critical trends impacting the industry. Airbus CPO Benoît Schultz serves as patron for the forum, which facilitates connections among peers from leading aerospace companies and encourages discussions around potential collaborations.

Participants can also interact with over 100 sponsors and exhibitors, and hear perspectives from competence partners such as Airbus, BDLI, and Boeing. The discussions and interactions aim to foster innovation and strategic growth within the aerospace sector.

events.name: RISE Star Ratings Master Class 2026
events.description:
Master the complexities of Medicare Advantage Star ratings at the RISE Star Ratings Master Class 2026, held December 14-16 in Scottsdale, AZ. This program, developed by RISE Health, offers practical guidance for leaders in Medicare Advantage Stars, quality, and member experience whose revenue is directly tied to performance.

Participants will explore the latest regulatory changes, analyze legal impacts, and learn strategies for stabilizing HEDIS®, pharmacy, and member-experience measures during digital transitions. The program includes hands-on learning opportunities such as a Stars Math workshop, a Quality Data Deep Dive, and a Cutpoint Hackathon.

The curriculum covers field-tested approaches to anticipating cut points, protecting bonus dollars, and strengthening provider partnerships. This preparation aims to help organizations navigate future challenges and achieve sustained performance improvement.

events.name: Automated Retail & Kiosk Innovation Show 2026
events.description:
The future of commerce unfolds at the Automated Retail & Kiosk Innovation Show 2026, set to transform Miami Beach, FL, from December 14-16. Professionals from retail, restaurants, hospitality, and convenience services will find opportunities to explore the next generation of self-service and unattended retail.

Attendees can examine cutting-edge solutions, including AI-driven automation, smart vending, interactive kiosks, mobile ordering, and seamless contactless payment systems. The program offers insights into reducing operational costs, extending customer reach around the clock, and developing strong self-service strategies. It's also a chance to connect with leading experts and see innovative technologies that aim to improve efficiency and enhance the customer experience in a constantly changing market.

events.name: SANS Cyber Defense Initiative 2026
events.description:
Sharpen your defenses and master the latest cyber threats at the SANS Cyber Defense Initiative 2026. This event runs from December 14-19, offering six days of focused training for cybersecurity professionals. It is accessible both in Washington D.C. and online, catering to individuals across various skill levels.

The program features over 30 courses, ranging from foundational cybersecurity principles to advanced subjects like Applied Data Science and AI/Machine Learning for Cybersecurity. Participants will have the chance to learn directly from SANS expert instructors. The initiative also includes a complimentary NetWars Tournament and structured networking sessions, such as @Night Talks, designed for peer interaction.

The training emphasizes practical, hands-on experience, enabling individuals to deepen their understanding in critical areas like incident response and penetration testing. An optional GIAC certification is available for those seeking further professional validation.

events.name: Treatment Center Investment and Valuation Retreat West 2026
events.description:
Set for April 6-9, 2026, in vibrant Nashville, TN, the Treatment Center Investment and Valuation Retreat East 2026 is an essential gathering for the for-profit treatment sector. This event brings together owners, operators, investors, and senior executives. They will examine key investment strategies and valuation methods relevant to the industry.

The retreat provides a setting for focused discussions and building valuable relationships. Participants can connect meaningfully with industry leaders and potential partners. Attendees will gain a deeper understanding of the changing behavioral health landscape. Conversations may delve into emerging topics, such as how GLP-1s could influence addiction treatment.

events.name: Forbes Middle East Medical Tourism and Wellness Summit 2026
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the future of healthcare and well-being at the Forbes Middle East Medical Tourism and Wellness Summit 2026. This second edition takes place on December 9th and 10th at Dubai's Janat Bahar Garden, Jumeirah Beach Hotel, with the Burj Al Arab as a backdrop. The summit gathers government leaders, healthcare providers, hospitality experts, and investors.

Discussions will cover new treatments, sustainable tourism models, and recent innovations in digital health, AI, and personalized care. The agenda also includes topics on holistic patient care and the economic aspects of healthcare delivery. H.E. Abdulla Bin Touq Al Marri, UAE Minister of Economy and Tourism, will deliver a keynote address, alongside insights from other global experts. The aim is to foster international collaborations and strengthen the Middle East's position as a center for medical and wellness services.

events.name: ACM Middleware 2026
events.description:
The 27th ACM International Middleware Conference, ACM Middleware 2026, invites researchers, industry leaders, and doctoral students to Universitat Rovira i Virgili in Tarragona, Spain, from December 14th to 18th. This five-day event serves as a central gathering for discussing new ideas and progress in middleware systems.

The program includes a single technical track, featuring invited speakers, an industrial perspective, and panel discussions with experts from both academia and industry. These sessions will explore the design, implementation, and evaluation of distributed systems, platforms, and architectures for computing, storage, and communication. Key topics include AI/ML systems, cloud/edge computing, security, and sustainable middleware. Additional opportunities for learning and connecting with others are available through poster presentations, a doctoral symposium, tutorials, and workshops.

events.name: ARABLAB LIVE KSA 2026
events.description:

This two-day gathering serves as a central point for advancing lab science and industrial analytics within the Kingdom. Visitors will find an exhibition featuring over 350 international companies in the Innovation Hall, presenting recent advancements in lab technology and solutions.

A conference, free for all to attend, will take place across three Content Theatres. Here, more than 150 expert speakers, including individuals from the Saudi Food and Drug Authority and SABIC, will share insights on current trends and developments.

The event anticipates over 3,000 attendees, with 95% coming from Saudi Arabia, alongside more than 600 VIPs. This environment provides opportunities to build connections and contribute to the growth of scientific excellence in Saudi Arabia, a goal supported by the Saudi Accreditation Center.

events.name: World Summit AI Qatar 2026
events.description:
The global AI landscape converges at World Summit AI Qatar 2026, taking place December 15-16 at the Doha Exhibition & Convention Center. This event serves as a significant forum for discussing and influencing the global research, governance, and deployment of artificial intelligence. Its collaboration with Qatar's Ministry of Communications and Information Technology highlights the nation's dedication to digital advancement and its role in AI leadership.

The gathering draws a wide range of participants, from company founders and executives to policymakers, investors, and leading AI experts. They will explore current trends and future directions across enterprise AI, major technology companies, emerging startups, and the ethical dimensions of AI. The program features a variety of sessions, a startup accelerator, and valuable opportunities for connection, all aimed at fostering collaboration and advancing AI innovation globally.

events.name: INSPIRE Luxury Hospitality Conference US 2026
events.description:
For its 17th year, the INSPIRE Luxury Hospitality Conference US 2026 will convene on December 15–16, 2026, at the distinguished JW Marriott Orlando Bonnet Creek Resort & Spa. Participants engage in focused sessions and private discussions, creating opportunities to connect with peers. The aim is to foster new strategies for innovation and to build meaningful partnerships, continuing a tradition that has contributed to over $2.4 billion in cumulative deal pipeline.

events.name: New York CHRO Community Executive Summit 2026
events.description:

events.name: INSPIRE Luxury Hospitality Conference Europe 2026
events.description:

events.name: Insiders Conference 2026

The aim is for attendees to depart with a clearer direction for building and expanding their companies, along with practical strategies and valuable connections within the industry.

events.name: Myanmar International Textile & Garment Industry Exhibition 2026

The event provides a setting for industry professionals to connect, explore new solutions, and understand current trends. Please be aware that attendance is limited to individuals aged 16 and older.

events.name: Small Business Expo Atlanta 2026
events.description:

events.name: AccelerateGOV 2026
events.description:
Global Government Forum presents AccelerateGOV 2026, the essential international summit for public sector digital transformation. Attendees will engage in panel discussions and Q&A sessions covering vital areas. These include practical applications of AI, advanced data technologies, strengthening cybersecurity, and improving procurement processes. The agenda also addresses user-centered design principles to encourage public adoption of new services, effective models for hybrid work, and developing skills that foster innovation.

events.name: The Midwest Clinic 2026
events.description:

This international conference for band and orchestra professionals draws over 18,000 music educators and musicians from more than 40 countries, establishing itself as a central annual event for the music education community.

The program includes a diverse selection of clinics and performances. A large exhibit hall will also be available, showcasing new resources and instruments. This setting allows attendees to explore current industry trends and engage in discussions about the future of music education.

These components collectively offer significant avenues for professional development and building connections within the music community.

events.name: GeoSmart India 2026
events.description:

The program features developments in AI, IoT, digital twins, and drone technology, presented through various thematic tracks, masterclasses, and the India Geospatial Awards. It is a forum for exchanging ideas and contributing to India's geospatial evolution.

events.name: Blackmore Connects Virtual Conference Roadmap December 2026
events.description:
Prepare to strategically navigate the private equity landscape at the Blackmore Connects Virtual Conference Roadmap, culminating on December 16th, 2026. There will also be direct introductions to private equity firms and focused speed networking sessions conducted through Microsoft Teams. events.name: Supercrowd Happy Hour December 2026
events.description:
Dive into the heart of the impact crowdfunding movement with the Supercrowd Happy Hour on Wednesday, December 16, 2026. This monthly online gathering provides a focused hour of practical knowledge and strategies for individuals keen on using crowdfunding to create positive change.

Devin Thorpe hosts each session, bringing in expert guests to share their understanding, followed by a live question-and-answer segment. Participants can explore effective strategies, connect with others in the field, and keep up-to-date on developments in impact investing.

The event is broadcast live, and the content is also shared across various social media platforms. Produced by The Super Crowd, Inc., this free resource aims to support individuals in their crowdfunding endeavors.

events.name: Cyberriskalliance Compliance Summit 2026
events.description:
On December 16, 2026, the Cyberriskalliance Compliance Summit 2026 will convene virtually to dissect the critical intersection of artificial intelligence and regulatory adherence. This online conference focuses on 'AI's Next Generation,' examining how evolving AI technologies are reshaping governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) frameworks.

The summit is intended for CISOs, senior leadership, practitioners, and solution providers. It offers valuable insights into using AI to improve operational resilience and strategic compliance. Attendees will discuss practical approaches to manage new risks, streamline GRC processes, and prepare their organizations for an increasingly complex digital threat landscape.

The event aims to provide expert perspectives and opportunities to connect with peers, helping to inform approaches to compliance in the AI era.

events.name: Olympia The London International Horse Show 2026
events.description:
Get ready for "The Horse World’s Christmas Party" as Olympia The London International Horse Show returns to ExCeL London from Thursday 17 to Monday 21 December 2026. The show features three FEI World Cup™ Qualifiers across Jumping, Dressage, and Driving, bringing together leading equestrian athletes. Over five days, attendees can expect a full schedule of competition, including the London International Showing Series finals and masterclasses led by prominent riders.

Beyond the main arena, there will be more than 200 country and equestrian shops available, offering a wide selection for those looking for gifts or unique items. The event's schedule includes various disciplines, from 5* Jumping to the Six Bar and Grand Prix, catering to a broad interest in equestrian sport.

events.name: Money Fund University 2026
events.description:
Deepen your understanding of the dynamic world of cash investing at Money Fund University 2026, taking place December 17-18 in Greenwich, Conn.

This day-and-a-half "basic training" course is designed for those new to the field, including portfolio managers, analysts, investors, and service providers. It also serves as a useful refresher and a chance to connect with peers for more experienced professionals.

The program offers key insights into the history of money funds, interest rates, and important regulations like Rule 2a-7. You'll examine money market instruments such as commercial paper, CDs, and repo, along with practical sessions on portfolio construction and credit analysis. The curriculum also covers specialized areas like offshore money funds and ultra-short bond funds, helping you build a solid foundation in money market mutual funds and effective cash management strategies.

events.name: ABJ Williamson County Growth Summit 2026
events.description:
Gain unparalleled insights into the economic landscape of Williamson County and Central Texas at the ABJ Williamson County Growth Summit 2026. The summit facilitates interaction among decision-makers and provides knowledge to understand and contribute to the region's economic development.

events.name: Home·Table Deco Fair Seoul 2026

Attendees can expect to see a thoughtful selection of furniture, fine tableware, smart home innovations, distinctive art, and high-quality fabrics, presented by both Korean and international brands.

For individuals interested in refreshing their interiors, discovering special items, or simply engaging with contemporary design, Home·Table Deco Fair Seoul 2026 provides insights and ideas relevant to modern lifestyles.

events.name: Light + LED Expo Delhi 2026
events.description:

The event aims to advance the use of intelligent LED lighting and supports "Make in India" initiatives. The discussions and displays here contribute to understanding the evolving landscape of illumination.

events.name: Copa Toque Futsal Festival 2026
events.description:

Players across all skill levels, from those new to the sport to seasoned competitors, will find suitable challenges within the Adult, Select, Development, and Experience divisions. Each team can expect to play a minimum of three 40-minute games, all conducted according to official FIFA Futsal Rules.

Before the main competition begins, Club Directors and Coaches have an invitation to a Social Night on December 17. This gathering aims to build connections and foster a sense of community among participants. The festival offers a chance to compete, connect, and celebrate the spirit of futsal.

events.name: Ziva Exotika December 2026
events.description:

Visitors will find a collection of over 20,000 animal specimens and 5,000 plants, a diversity that exceeds many traditional zoos. The event brings together more than 700 exhibitors from over 39 countries, providing access to breeder supplies, terraria, and specialized feeds. Additionally, free veterinary consultations and expert advice will be available.

The gathering caters to experienced breeders, dedicated growers, and individuals with a general interest in exotic species. For those seeking a more focused visit, VIP entry includes exclusive access and personalized guidance.

events.name: Collect-A-Con Los Angeles 2026
events.description:

As the nation's largest trading card and pop culture convention, this two-day gathering brings together fans of anime, comics, vintage toys, video games, and a wide range of trading card games, including Pokémon, Magic: The Gathering, and Lorcana.

Attendees will find over 1000 vendor tables showcasing Funko POP!s, rare merchandise, and exclusive items. The event also offers opportunities to meet celebrity guests such as Christopher Sabat, Charles Martinet, and Waka Flocka Flame. Throughout the convention, there will be live performances and a chance to see impressive cosplay.

This event caters to collectors and pop culture enthusiasts of all interests. Children aged 7 and under receive free admission.

events.name: Devopsdays Tel Aviv 2026

events.description:
Prepare to redefine your business trajectory at the BTA Winter Summit 2027, held from January 6-9 at the stunning Renaissance Esmeralda in Palm Springs, California. This three-day event is for contractors and business owners in roofing, painting, construction, and home services who are focused on business growth. It offers a dedicated setting to develop, challenge, and finalize your annual strategic plan.

Attendees will learn from industry experts and BTA's most successful members through keynotes, specialized breakout sessions, and hands-on workshops. Beyond the planning sessions, there will be opportunities to connect with hundreds of peers and acknowledge accomplishments at the Awards Night. Participants can expect to leave with a clear plan for the coming year. Business partners and spouses are also welcome, as their presence can support broader alignment and shared understanding of business goals.

events.name: The AI House @ CES 2027
events.description:
On January 6, 2027, immerse yourself in the forefront of innovation at The AI House @ CES 2027, held at the Las Vegas Convention Center.

This full-day program, presented by Modev, brings together CES registrants, including leaders from influential brands, government, and pioneering AI executives. The discussions will cover the transformative potential of Agentic AI, ethical governance, and how AI functions as a core operating model for enterprise transformation.

Participants will engage with experts on topics such as human-centered AI, the impact of generative AI, and developing strategies for an AI-ready workforce. The program concludes with a reception, providing an opportunity for attendees to connect and fostering understanding that contributes to the future of artificial intelligence.

events.name: ORFC 2027
events.description:
In January 2027, the global community dedicated to sustainable food systems will converge at ORFC 2027, both physically in Oxford City Centre, UK, and through its accessible online platform. This annual gathering brings together around 1,800 farmers, growers, activists, policymakers, and researchers, encouraging a rich discussion of new approaches. To ensure wide participation, especially from countries in the global majority, free online tickets are available, underscoring a commitment to inclusivity.

The program is shaped by participants themselves through an open Call for Submissions, exploring topics like agroecology, regenerative agriculture, and indigenous farming systems in depth. Discussions will range from overarching questions about systemic change to the practical details of farming methods. This makes ORFC 2027 a significant gathering for those working to build a resilient and equitable food future.

events.name: Octane Aesthetics Tech Forum 2027
events.description:
The Octane Aesthetics Tech Forum 2027, scheduled for January 7-8 at VEA Newport Beach in Newport Beach, CA, is the premier gathering for the rapidly evolving aesthetics technology space. This event features new developments from emerging companies and provides valuable perspectives from leading executives, physicians, and entrepreneurs in the aesthetics field.

Attendees can expect to see new solutions from various exhibitors and hear presentations on emerging technologies. The forum is designed for physicians, industry professionals, investors, and entrepreneurs, offering a space to connect with peers, potential partners, and investors. It provides an opportunity to discuss the future of aesthetics, encourage collaborative efforts, and contribute to the industry's progress.

events.name: IIJS Bharat Signature Show 2027
events.description:
The 18th edition of the IIJS Bharat Signature Show 2027, organized by GJEPC India, is set to redefine the global gem and jewellery sourcing experience across two premier Mumbai venues. The event will run from January 7-10 at Jio World Convention Centre and January 8-11 at Bombay Exhibition Centre. This dual-venue exhibition will feature over 1,600 exhibitors displaying their collections across more than 3,300 stalls, covering 1.25 lakh square meters. It is expected to draw over 25,000 trade visitors from more than 800 Indian cities and 60 countries.

Visitors will find a diverse selection of diamond, gold, gemstone, and silver jewellery. There will also be specific areas dedicated to Lab-grown Diamonds and a high-end couture showcase at 'The Select Club'. Concurrently, IGJME Bharat - Signature 2027 at BEC will present the latest machinery for the industry.

To enhance the experience, the show will offer digital entry, a dedicated mobile app, and the Innov8 Talks series. The organizers also emphasize sustainability through their One Earth Initiative. This event aims to be a significant global gathering for the gem and jewellery community.

events.name: XBIZ Expo 2027
events.description:
The global pleasure industry converges at XBIZ Expo 2027, transforming L.A. LIVE into the ultimate arena for business and pleasure from January 7-10. Over four days, the event presents the latest innovations, emerging trends, and strategic approaches shaping this evolving market.

Professionals from various sectors, including manufacturers, distributors, e-tailers, tech providers, entrepreneurs, and influencers from around the world, will be present. They will explore new developments in the exhibition areas and participate in discussions led by prominent figures in the field. The expo facilitates connections through private meeting spaces and informal gatherings, encouraging new relationships and joint efforts.

The event concludes with the 2027 XBIZ Awards, an occasion that acknowledges achievements and highlights future directions within the industry.

events.name: FICPA International Tax Conference 2027
events.description:
The FICPA International Tax Conference 2027 offers a crucial opportunity to navigate the ever-evolving landscape of global taxation. This two-day event will be held on January 7-8, 2027, at the JW Marriott Miami. It is designed for tax professionals who aim to deepen their understanding of international tax law's complexities. Attendees can expect to gain insights into emerging regulations, cross-border compliance challenges, and strategic planning for multinational operations.

The conference also provides a setting to connect with experts and peers, allowing for meaningful discussions on the future of international tax policy and practice. The program will cover current developments, helping participants to refine their expertise within the global environment. Information regarding registration will be available soon.

events.name: ISPO Beijing 2027
events.description:
Set to unfold from January 07-09, 2027, at the China National Convention Center in Beijing, ISPO Beijing 2027 stands as Asia's leading professional sports trade platform. For three days, the event brings together established local and international brands, sports enthusiasts, and a broader consumer audience.

Visitors will encounter the latest innovations and trends across a range of categories, including outdoor sports, snowsports, running, health and fitness, and new developments in textile technology. The event also highlights emerging categories such as camping lifestyle and urban sports, reflecting the growing interest in professional training. The aim of ISPO Beijing 2027 is to encourage discussions across different sports categories, present new ways people engage with sports, and offer guidance and expert perspectives for the changing sports market.

It serves as a significant meeting point for individuals interested in influencing or understanding the future of sports in Asia.

events.name: CCN Innovate 2027
events.description:
Prepare to elevate your contracting business at CCN Innovate 2027, taking place from January 7–10, 2027, at the Hyatt Regency Grand Cypress Resort in Orlando, FL. This gathering is for owners, general managers, and key departmental leaders, offering three days dedicated to practical knowledge for enhancing operations.

Attendees will explore ways to strengthen operations and improve profitability. Discussions will cover leveraging AI, streamlining processes, and implementing current effective strategies across sales, marketing, and production. The program includes a keynote address on innovative leadership from former Disney Institute Leader Jeff Noel. Additionally, an optional pre-conference workshop will be available, focusing on practical AI integration through "Claude for Contractors."

The event provides opportunities to connect with other professionals, share insights, and participate in executive roundtables. The aim is to offer strategies that can help teams evolve and reduce the demands on business owners.

events.name: Atlanta Boat Show 2027
events.description:
Prepare to embark on a journey into the world of boating at the Atlanta Boat Show 2027! The show runs from January 7-10 at the Georgia World Congress Center, Hall B, in its new location. Visitors can explore a wide selection of the newest boats, marine accessories, and equipment from various dealers. Experts will be on hand to discuss all aspects of boating.

There will be activities for everyone, from families to seasoned boaters. Watch professional anglers give fishing demonstrations at the 5,000-gallon aquarium. The Lake Life Lounge offers a place to unwind. Whether you're an experienced owner or considering your first boat, Discover Boating resources can provide guidance for buying, owning, and operating a boat. The event offers a thorough look at the boating world for all attendees.

The program includes a wide range of technical presentations, engaging poster sessions, and hands-on workshops. An exhibition area will showcase the newest tools and technologies. The event offers a setting for scientific exchange, encouraging connections and the sharing of innovative ideas among experts in the field.

Visitors will find everything needed for a wedding, from gowns and venue choices to photographers, florists, and caterers. It’s an opportunity to meet directly with a variety of vendors, discuss options, and gather inspiration for the big day. This event is produced by American Consumer Shows, a leading organizer of bridal expos.

events.name: NRF 2027
events.description:
The global retail community will converge at the Jacob K. Javits Convention Center in NYC for NRF 2027, running from January 10-12. It's a place to explore new ideas, see what's next in technology, and discuss the future of the industry.

events.name: TRB Annual Meeting 2027
events.description:
The Transportation Research Board (TRB) invites thousands of global transportation professionals to its Annual Meeting 2027, taking place from January 10-14 in Washington D.C. At the Walter E. Washington Convention Center and Marriott Marquis, the meeting will bring together policymakers, administrators, practitioners, researchers, and representatives from government, industry, and academia.

The five-day program will feature sessions and workshops exploring all transportation modes. Discussions will address critical topics in policy, administration, practice, and research, fostering conversations around the sector's most pressing challenges and future innovations.

Participants will connect with colleagues, exchange insights, and contribute to the collective effort of advancing sustainable, efficient, and equitable transportation solutions globally.

events.name: PCMA Convening Leaders 2027
events.description:
Get ready to immerse yourself in the forefront of the business events industry at PCMA Convening Leaders 2027, set to unfold from January 10 to 13 in vibrant Miami, Florida. This event brings together leaders, offering a space to connect, innovate, and influence the future direction of events.

The program starts with pre-conference activities on January 9-10, followed by an official opening reception on Sunday evening. Main stage sessions will begin Monday morning, providing three days of significant insights and strategic discussions before the event concludes on Wednesday, January 13.

Participants will find opportunities for networking, information about potential scholarships, and details on a Hosted Buyer program. Registration and housing information, including hotel rates averaging $347 per night, will become available in August 2026.

events.name: Top Drawer S/S 2027
events.description:
The UK's premier destination for design-led retail, Top Drawer S/S 2027, invites you to Olympia, London, from 10 - 12 January. This event brings together over 10,000 retail buyers looking for the next wave of commercially viable, wholesale-ready brands. These attendees, including major names like John Lewis, Harrods, and Liberty, collectively manage an annual buying budget of £52 billion.

For brands, this is a place to present their collections across various lifestyle categories. It offers the chance to build long-term partnerships and complete sales directly at the event. The environment is designed for focused business interactions, facilitating connections with independent retailers, national accounts, and international customers from over 80 countries.

events.name: Industry Strategy Symposium 2027
events.description:
Gain unparalleled strategic foresight at the Industry Strategy Symposium (ISS) | Microelectronics Executive Insights, taking place January 10–13, 2027, at The Ritz-Carlton, Half Moon Bay, CA. This gathering brings together leaders, innovators, policymakers, and investors from the microelectronics industry.

Participants will examine the key economic trends, market drivers, and geopolitical shifts that are influencing the semiconductor landscape. The program will also address significant technological advancements and their broader impact, providing perspectives to help navigate challenges and identify new possibilities.

The symposium offers an environment for connecting with peers and experts, fostering discussions that can lead to practical strategies. The aim is for attendees to depart with clear insights to guide their organizations in a dynamic global market.

events.name: Everyday and Holiday Cosmetics, Skin, Fragrance & Bath Session 2027
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the dynamic world of beauty at the Everyday and Holiday Cosmetics, Skin, Fragrance & Bath Session 2027, taking place from January 10-13, 2027, at the Sheraton Grand Chicago in Illinois. This ECRM session brings together category buyers from all retail channels with innovative brands, ranging from new entrants to established leaders.

Attendees can explore current beauty trends and find new products and suppliers. The event offers a chance to gather ideas for year-round category planning and holiday offerings. Participants will have pre-scheduled appointments, arranged to meet specific goals. These meetings help build partnerships and expand product reach.

There will also be opportunities to connect with other beauty professionals. Educational sessions will offer perspectives to help businesses grow and adapt to market changes. The gathering provides a platform for influencing the direction of cosmetics, skin, fragrance, and bath retail.

events.name: Orthopedics Today Hawaii 2027
events.description:
The 20th anniversary of Orthopedics Today Hawaii convenes the global orthopedic community at the Grand Wailea, Maui, from January 10-14, 2027. Over five days, participants will find themselves in an interactive, table-based environment that encourages open discussions and helps build meaningful professional relationships. Under the guidance of Program Director Anthony A. Romeo, MD, and more than 50 distinguished experts, the agenda explores key topics including Knee & Sports Medicine, Shoulder & Upper Extremity, Hip & Arthroplasty, Foot/Ankle, Trauma, and Practice Management.

Surgeons, physician assistants, physical therapists, residents, and industry professionals will examine emerging data, recent surgical advancements, and innovative technologies such as robotic TKA and biologics. The program's non-concurrent schedule allows participants to earn up to 22.5 CME credits without missing valuable sessions. This design also creates opportunities for meaningful networking and discovering new developments within the exhibit hall, all within the beautiful setting of Maui.

events.name: MUSE Executive Institute 2027
events.description:
A pivotal gathering for healthcare leaders, the MUSE Executive Institute 2027 offers an unparalleled opportunity to drive sustainable high performance. This event will be held from January 10-12, 2027, at the Pelican Hill Resort in Newport Beach, CA. It is structured differently from typical conferences, emphasizing direct engagement and practical application.

The Institute is designed as a working session, centered on the essential alignment of "People, Process, and Platform." Participants will engage in executive panels, interactive workshops, and focused breakout sessions. These activities are designed to address specific challenges, such as strengthening leadership, enhancing workflow transparency, and optimizing the use of platforms like MEDITECH Expanse.

The aim is for participants to leave with actionable tools, concrete implementation plans, and clear commitments relevant to their organizations. The Institute concludes with the development of a shared executive statement and a white paper. These documents are intended to serve as a roadmap for advancing operational excellence and technology-driven transformation across the healthcare sector.

events.name: Intersec Dubai 2027
events.description:
From January 11 to 13, 2027, the Dubai World Trade Centre will host Intersec Dubai, the world's premier platform for safety, security, and fire protection. Operating under its new 'Intersec Global identity,' this three-day event brings together industry leaders, innovators, and government stakeholders.

Those attending can explore the latest technology across various exhibition spaces and international pavilions. They can also participate in conferences and workshops designed to share knowledge, alongside the unique Safety Walk. The event aims to foster discussions that contribute to global resilience and protection, offering opportunities for networking and the exchange of ideas among professionals in the sector.

events.name: J.P. Morgan Healthcare Conference 2027
events.description:
The J.P. Morgan Healthcare Conference 2027, taking place from January 11-14 in San Francisco, California, is poised to be the industry's most influential healthcare investment symposium.

This invitation-only event brings together global industry leaders, fast-growing companies, innovators in technology, and the investment community. Over four days, participants will discuss key market trends, financing activities, and the future direction of healthcare. The agenda covers biotechnology, pharmaceuticals, and medical devices, alongside how AI is influencing drug discovery and operational efficiency.

Those attending will explore topics such as dealmaking, M&A strategies, capital markets, and global innovation. The conversations aim to contribute to shaping the sector's future.

events.name: Biotech Showcase 2027
events.description:
Kicking off the new year, Biotech Showcase 2027 returns to San Francisco from January 11-13, establishing itself as the life science industry's premier investor event.

This gathering brings together over 3,200 global biopharma leaders, including 1,200 investors. Participants will engage in more than 6,000 one-on-one partnering meetings and hear from over 350 companies as they present their latest developments and insights.

The event provides a forum for exploring capital access, forming strategic partnerships, and discovering new innovations. The program also features specialized tracks, including the Seed Showcase for early-stage ventures and the TechBio Showcase, which examines the intersection of technology and biology. Through these discussions and presentations, participants will engage with industry leaders and innovators, contributing to the ongoing evolution of the biotech landscape.

events.name: AIAA SciTech Forum 2027
events.description:
The future of aerospace takes center stage in Orlando, Florida, from January 11 to 15, 2027, as the AIAA SciTech Forum convenes. This gathering is widely regarded as the largest worldwide for those involved in aerospace research, development, and technology, offering a comprehensive look at the progress being made in shaping our understanding of flight and space.

Participants will have the opportunity to examine the latest scientific discoveries, technological shifts, and policy discussions that are guiding the next phase of flight and space exploration. It serves as a significant meeting point for professionals, researchers, and innovators to connect with peers, share insights, and learn about new directions and significant breakthroughs in the field.

The forum offers a chance to interact with leading experts and contribute to the ongoing conversations that will define the path of aerospace for years ahead.

events.name: BAU 2027
events.description:
The global building and architecture community will converge in Munich, Germany, for BAU 2027, the world's leading trade fair for architecture, materials, and systems. It's a significant occasion for architects, planners, investors, and building trade professionals to explore the evolving landscape of construction.

Those who attend will encounter the newest techniques, materials, and practical applications. Discussions and exhibits will center on key topics, including resilient, climate-friendly construction, resource efficiency, and modular, cost-effective building solutions. It provides a setting for meaningful conversations, new connections, and collaborative efforts that will influence the future of our built world.

events.name: PPAI Expo 2027
events.description:
Mark your calendars for PPAI Expo 2027, the promotional products industry's most anticipated event, held at the Mandalay Bay Convention Center in Las Vegas. The four-day gathering begins on January 11 with a professional development conference. This day is dedicated to gaining strategic insights and exploring learning opportunities.

From January 12-14, the main trade show floor will be open. Recognized as the industry's largest and longest-running, it will host thousands of exhibitor booths. Those attending can expect to see a wide range of new promotional products from both domestic and international brands.

The expo provides a setting to explore current trends, connect with peers and suppliers, and identify new merchandise. It offers a chance for businesses to stay informed and competitive within the evolving promotional products market.

events.name: SpaceCom 2027
events.description:
Prepare to explore the frontiers of the global space economy at SpaceCom 2027, taking place from January 11-14 in Orlando, FL. This event focuses on the commercial space industry, with its theme "Powering the Next Space Age." It functions as a central point for sharing insights and fostering business connections.

Leaders from civil space, defense, and commercial sectors, representing over 30 countries, will come together. The aim is to foster progress by highlighting new technologies, sharing market intelligence, and encouraging collaborations between government and industry. Those attending, including agency delegations, global investors, and entrepreneurs, can participate in more than 70 sessions, attend federal briefings, and observe startup pitch competitions.

Discussions will cover developments in areas such as launch capabilities, operations in space, sustainability efforts, and human performance beyond Earth. This environment encourages new business connections and partnerships, with contributions from experts such as Bill Nye and Kathy Lueders. It serves as a significant forum for discussions that influence the future direction of space exploration and commerce.

events.name: BIO Partnering @ JPM Week 2027
events.description:
Connecting the world's leading biotech innovators and investors, BIO Partnering @ JPM Week 2027 offers an unparalleled platform for strategic collaborations in San Francisco from January 11-14. This gathering, taking place during JPM Week, aims to help participants forge important partnerships and advance business discussions within the global life sciences sector.

The event brings together over 2,500 individuals from more than 40 countries, representing over 1,600 companies. These attendees participate in thousands of one-on-one meetings, with more than 7,500 partnering discussions already scheduled. These interactions are where new opportunities are discovered, investments are secured, and the groundwork for future biotechnology advancements is laid. It's a key meeting point for those working to influence the direction of healthcare.

events.name: AO 2027
events.description:
From January 11 to 31, 2027, the global tennis community will converge on Wurundjeri Woi Wurrung Country, Melbourne, for the highly anticipated Australian Open. This Grand Slam tournament will feature three weeks of competition, bringing together the world's top athletes to compete on its renowned courts.

Those attending in person, alongside a global audience watching from afar, can expect to see compelling rallies, unexpected outcomes, and the eventual crowning of new champions. Beyond the matches, the event, supported by partners such as KIA and other global brands, creates a significant gathering for sports enthusiasts. It brings together people from around the world, offering a comprehensive experience of sport and culture.

events.name: Heckerling Institute on Estate Planning 2027
events.description:
Elevate your expertise in estate planning at the highly anticipated Heckerling Institute, taking place from January 11-15, 2027, in sunny Orlando, Florida. This event gathers estate planning professionals for five days of educational programming, designed to help them stay current with the latest industry developments.

Participants have the option to attend live at the Orlando World Center Marriott or virtually, offering flexible ways to access key insights and earn Continuing Education (CE) credits. An Exhibit Hall will be available for exploring new technologies and services. There will also be chances to connect with peers during daily breaks and at the welcome reception.

The institute provides an environment for gaining valuable knowledge, expanding professional networks, and discovering innovative approaches for practice. Registration opens in September 2026.

events.name: Punta Tech Meetup 2027
events.description:
Punta del Este, Uruguay, will once again host the premier gathering for the region's tech pioneers at the Punta Tech Meetup 2027. Taking place every January, this annual event serves as the most significant meeting point for the Latin American tech community. It brings together startups, investors, and industry leaders, facilitating valuable interactions and potential collaborations.

While details about specific innovations and speakers for 2027 will be shared closer to the date, those attending can anticipate exploring the key trends influencing technology's future in Latin America. The meetup provides an opportunity to build connections, identify new talent, and hear perspectives from leaders guiding the region's digital evolution.

events.name: ICR Conference 2027
events.description:
Kicking off the year with unparalleled insights, the 29th Annual ICR Conference convenes from January 11-13, 2027. Thousands of institutional investors, sell-side analysts, and management teams from both public and private companies come together to explore evolving consumer trends and market prospects.

Panels, led by industry experts, will address topics including ESG & Shareholder Activism, M&A, Investment Opportunities in Sports, and an IPO Bootcamp. Those attending will have opportunities to connect with peers and hear from prominent industry figures during lunch lectures.

With support from investment banking and legal sponsors, the conference serves as a key gathering for discussing the strategic direction for the year ahead.

events.name: AI in Retail Summit During NRF: Retail's Big Show 2027

On January 11, 2027, amidst NRF: Retail's Big Show in New York, the exclusive AI in Retail Summit (AiR Summit & Soirée 2027) will bring together an invite-only audience of senior brand and retail executives, visionary analysts, and technology innovators. This gathering focuses on where AI truly impacts retail, exploring its evolving role in commerce and enhancing customer experiences.

Those attending will participate in discussions through panels, keynotes, and fireside chats. Speakers like Leila Jalai from David Yurman and Heather Friedland of Poshmark are confirmed to share their perspectives. The summit is designed to offer practical insights and thoughtful conversations, concluding with the RETHINK Retail Soirée, which provides opportunities for connection.

Retailers and brands can gain access by registering through NRF. For solution providers, participation is arranged through sponsorship. This structure helps ensure a focused environment for discussing the future of AI in retail and fostering meaningful professional relationships.

events.name: Workplace Ninjas US 2027

Attendees will have opportunities to participate in expert-led sessions, engage in speed mentoring, and connect with MVPs and peers. An expo will also be available, providing a space to explore solutions and meet partners. As a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, Workplace Ninjas US is dedicated to delivering practical, high-quality technical knowledge.

events.name: MISMO Winter Summit 2027

It's a place where these individuals come together to collaborate, share ideas, and discuss insights that help advance the industry.

A key focus of the summit is the creation of essential standards. This work is fundamental to the mortgage ecosystem's digital evolution and its readiness for the future. For anyone interested in understanding, contributing to, or influencing the future of mortgage finance, it provides an environment for connecting with peers and contributing to innovation across the sector.

events.name: Transatlantic Retail Summit The Retail Party 2027

Fierce JPM Week 2027

The event features an exhibition area, a dedicated technology showcase, and conferences led by experts. These platforms are designed to help participants develop practical approaches for a sustainable future, particularly supporting the growth of renewable energy in the MENA region.

Access to all conferences and the extensive exhibition space is available without charge, offering a chance for individuals to contribute to discussions that influence the future of energy.

events.name: Future Minerals Forum 2027
