More than 18,000 individuals are expected, bringing together over 70 ministers, 1000 CEOs, and experts from 170 countries. Their collective aim is to advance discussions on mineral discovery and responsible production worldwide. Participants will engage in significant conversations, examine the latest innovations in areas like AI and electrification, and build meaningful collaborations throughout the mineral value chain.

The agenda features a Ministerial Roundtable, dedicated areas focusing on exploration and technology, and strategic conversations about critical mineral supply chains, particularly for the 'Super Region'. Ultimately, the forum plays a vital role in fostering global mineral resilience and prosperity.

events.name: PSI 2027
events.description:
Ignite your business year at PSI 2027, Europe's leading trade fair for promotional products, incentives, and merchandising. From January 12-14, 2027, the Messegelände Köln in Germany will be a central point for the industry. It's a place where new ideas, sustainable practices, and innovative solutions come together. Thousands of international professionals, including distributors, finishers, agencies, manufacturers, and importers, are expected to attend.

Attendees will find products from over 600 exhibitors and partners, offering a broad view of the market. This setting allows for direct conversations with industry leaders. It's an opportunity to observe current trends, share insights, and find new perspectives that can inform business strategies. The event serves as a significant gathering for the promotional product community, facilitating international connections as the new business year begins.

events.name: The Detroit Auto Show 2027
events.description:
Experience the cutting edge of automotive innovation and mobility solutions as The Detroit Auto Show returns to Huntington Place from January 12-24, 2027. The event offers a comprehensive look at the future of transportation, bringing together public interest with important industry discussions.

Visitors can explore the newest electric vehicles on the indoor Powering Michigan EV Experience track. They can also see ultra-luxury vehicles at The Gallery and explore new technologies at AutoMobili-D. Industry professionals have the Mobility Global Forum, a two-day executive symposium featuring C-level speakers who will discuss the evolving landscape of mobility.

With attractions ranging from Modded Detroit to the Charity Preview, the show offers something for car enthusiasts, media, and the general public, underscoring Detroit's continued role in automotive development.

events.name: The Central & Eastern European Forum 2027
events.description:
Presented by the Financial Times, The Central & Eastern European Forum 2027 convenes in Vienna, Austria, on 12–13 January. This two-day event brings together over 2,600 individuals, including finance ministers, central bank governors, leaders from banks and corporations, and global investors from more than 50 countries.

With more than 150 speakers leading over 40 sessions, the program will explore policy insights and current market intelligence. The forum aims to address the future of funding in the CEE region, focusing on developing efficient financial markets and supporting the climate transition. Attendees will also have access to the CEE Securitisation Summit, which will examine cross-jurisdictional innovation and strategies for expanding the region's financial ecosystem.

More than 10,000 on-site meetings are expected, offering opportunities for new connections and recognizing the CEE region's increasing influence globally.

events.name: CodeMash 2027
events.description:
The highly anticipated CodeMash 2027 returns from January 12-15, 2027, promising an unparalleled "everything conference" experience for the global tech community. Over four days, participants will explore a wide range of technical topics, from emerging trends to foundational concepts, fostering deep learning and collaboration.

Important dates for the event include the Call for Speakers on August 15, followed by session announcements on September 30. Tickets will become available starting October 1, with the complete schedule released on December 1. The conference provides a setting for individuals to connect with peers, enhance their skills, and contribute to the broader tech community.

events.name: Landscape Ontario Congress Trade Show & Conference 2027
events.description:
The future of the landscape and horticultural trades will take center stage at the Landscape Ontario Congress Trade Show & Conference 2027. The Toronto Congress Centre will host this gathering from January 12-14, 2027, an event put together by the Landscape Ontario Horticultural Trades Association. Professionals and exhibitors from across the industry will come together for three days focused on industry insights and new developments.

Those attending can explore a trade show floor featuring the latest products, technologies, and services. The conference program offers sessions led by experts, covering topics to enhance skills, explore new trends, and support business development. The event concludes with the Awards of Excellence, recognizing significant achievements in the green industry. It's a chance to connect with peers, learn new ideas, and see the innovations that are influencing the future of landscapes.

events.name: Atlanta Market ANDMORE Winter 2027
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the ultimate sourcing experience at Atlanta Market ANDMORE Winter 2027, returning to AmericasMart Atlanta in January. The market spans three buildings and 51 floors, presenting over 6,000 brands across gift, seasonal, home décor, and furnishings.

This event is intended for trade professionals, including gift shop owners, interior designers, and hospitality buyers. It attracts attendees from all 50 U.S. states and more than 60 countries. Visitors have opportunities to explore emerging trends through 'First Finds' displays, participate in educational seminars, and connect with others in their field. An ANDMORE Markets App is available to assist with navigating the extensive offerings.

events.name: EDGE ABA Conference 2027
events.description:
Leaders in Applied Behavior Analysis, mark your calendars for January 12, 2027! The EDGE ABA Conference 2027 takes place at the World of Blue Hotel in East Rutherford, NJ. This full day is dedicated to leadership, growth, and current industry trends.

The event is designed for ABA agency owners, executive leaders, and C-suite professionals, running from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM. Participants will hear from speakers such as Dan Dube, who will discuss "Beyond Insurance: Alternative Revenue Streams," and Dr. Ally Dube, presenting on "Resilient Leadership."

In addition to the presentations, the conference includes an expo, along with hospitality and food and beverage service. It provides an opportunity to connect with many colleagues and consider new approaches for your agency.

events.name: Collective Shows West Winter 2027
events.description:
Kick off the new year with an exclusive preview at Collective Shows West Winter 2027, the industry's first comprehensive read on upcoming active and swim trends. This focused trade show will be held January 12-13, 2027, at the Pasea Hotel & Spa in Huntington Beach, CA. It gathers qualified retailers, media, and leading brands.

Attendees will have an early look at the latest swim, resort, activewear, and accessories collections, offering insight into the year's trends. The event emphasizes direct engagement, allowing for hands-on product interaction and opportunities to build professional relationships. Exhibitors receive all-inclusive booth packages, and attendance is complimentary for qualified retailers and media.

The schedule includes morning fitness events and sunset networking receptions. These activities complement the professional focus, all within the setting of the California coast.

events.name: SnowCamp 2027
events.description:
Prepare for an unparalleled technical deep dive at SnowCamp 2027, gathering engineers, researchers, developers, and architects in Grenoble, France, from January 13 to 16. The event will primarily take place at Alpexpo, espace 1968, providing a forum to explore current and future tools, frameworks, and technologies.

The four-day program begins with a Universities Day, featuring a choice of two intensive three-hour training sessions. This is followed by two days of 45-minute conference talks, where participants can learn about new developments from leading researchers and industry experts.

The program concludes with an Unconference day, designed for open discussion and connection among speakers and attendees, held on the skiing slopes. This structure aims to facilitate learning and professional networking within a stimulating setting.

events.name: CfC St. Moritz 2027
events.description:
Set against the breathtaking backdrop of the Swiss Alps, CfC St. Moritz 2027 offers an unparalleled, application-only experience from January 13th to 15th. This three-day gathering, held at the exclusive Suvretta House, brings together a select group of 250 global leaders and investors. The focus is on connecting the established world of traditional finance with the evolving landscape of digital assets.

The event draws individuals from ultra-high-net-worth backgrounds, family offices, and institutional investment firms. Admission is highly selective, reflecting the caliber of participants. Discussions, covering blockchain, market trends, and investment opportunities, operate under "Suvretta House Rules," meaning all conversations are off the record. This approach encourages open dialogue and the development of trusted, confidential relationships among attendees.

The private setting is designed to facilitate deep learning, meaningful connections, and collaborative thinking. It provides an environment where participants can exchange insights, explore potential collaborations, and understand emerging regulatory shifts within a discreet and focused atmosphere.

events.name: JobTread Connect User Conference 2027
events.description:
Unlock the full potential of your construction business at the JobTread Connect User Conference 2027, taking place January 13-15 in Dallas, TX, at The Renaissance Dallas Addison Hotel. This three-day gathering is for over 1,200 JobTread users and contractors interested in growing their businesses.

Attendees will find over 75 education sessions and hands-on workshops covering essential topics like job costing, sales, scheduling, accounting, and marketing. Participants can learn practical strategies from industry peers and experts, with the chance to earn 10 NARI CEU hours. Additionally, an Automation Lab will be available for those looking to build workflows and integrations.

The conference offers various opportunities to connect with over 60 trusted partners, JobTread staff, and fellow professionals. These connections can be made during industry roundtables, social hours, and exclusive events such as the Welcome Party and Big Night Out.

events.name: ASI Annual Convention 2027
events.description:
The American sheep industry's most anticipated annual gathering, the ASI Annual Convention 2027, invites producers and representatives from across the country to Charleston, South Carolina, from January 13-16.

This four-day gathering provides a chance to connect with colleagues, discuss important topics and challenges facing the industry, and work together to guide its future.

Attendees can expect thoughtful discussions, opportunities to share information, and dedicated time for business interactions. These activities are designed to help build a stronger and more successful sheep industry across the country, by strengthening relationships, offering valuable perspectives, and encouraging contributions that support the overall success of American sheep production.

events.name: The Evive Summit 2027
events.description:
The Evive Summit 2027, a pivotal full-day event for the behavioral health and SUD industry, is scheduled for January 13, 2027, at the World of Blue in East Rutherford, NJ. This gathering is specifically for executives and leaders within the industry, offering a space to connect, share ideas, and consider new approaches that can help their organizations thrive.

Participants will hear from experienced professionals, discussing strategies and technologies essential for understanding and adapting to the changes happening in behavioral health. It's a chance to engage with peers and contribute to ongoing discussions about the industry's direction.

An additional event, "EDGE," focusing on ABA and multi-therapy services, will take place at the same venue the day before.

location.venue: Omni Rancho Las Palmas Resort & Spa

events.name: Maison&Objet Winter 2027
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the forefront of design and lifestyle at Maison&Objet Winter 2027, taking place in Paris from January 14-18.

The Paris Nord Villepinte exhibition center will host a comprehensive display of home decor, design, crafts, and fashion. Attendees will find a wide array of brands, from established names to emerging talents, showcasing their latest work. This gathering provides an opportunity to see both innovative concepts and classic designs.

Beyond the main halls, the event extends into the city with 'Maison&Objet In The City.' This program guides visitors through 100 locations across Paris, including decorator showrooms and artisan workshops. Throughout the event, attendees can experience special installations, attend 'The Talks' conferences for expert perspectives, and consider new directions in design, craftsmanship, and sustainable practices. It offers a setting for discovering new products, finding inspiration, and connecting with others in the global design community.

events.name: DLD Munich 2027
events.description:
Get ready to mark your calendars for DLD Munich 2027, taking place from January 14–16 in the dynamic city of Munich. This event brings together individuals from technology, design, science, and culture to explore important questions about the future, fostering a space where diverse perspectives meet.

While applications are not yet open, attendees can anticipate an environment where new ideas are discussed, challenging conversations happen, and connections form across different fields. It's an opportunity to hear from global leaders and innovators, understanding more about the trends that influence our digital world and what lies ahead.

DLD Munich 2027 aims to be a setting where ideas about the future are examined, shaped, and brought to light.

events.name: FutureCon CyberSecurity Conference Chicago 2027
events.description:
Prepare to navigate the evolving digital threat landscape at the FutureCon CyberSecurity Conference Chicago 2027. On Thursday, January 14, 2027, in Chicago, this hybrid conference will bring together cybersecurity professionals to explore current security approaches. Participants will gain a clearer understanding of how to manage risk in our constantly shifting digital environment, helping them develop strategies to safeguard their organizations.

The event offers opportunities to connect with leading experts, learn about new solutions, and expand your professional network. Whether attending in person or online, FutureCon Chicago 2027 aims to provide the knowledge and connections necessary to strengthen defenses and anticipate future cyber threats.

events.name: Abilities Expo Los Angeles 2027
events.description:
Empowerment and innovation take center stage at Abilities Expo Los Angeles 2027, held from January 14-16 at the Long Beach Convention Center.

This free gathering serves individuals with disabilities, their families, caregivers, and professionals. It provides an extensive overview of current products, assistive technologies, and adaptive solutions designed to support daily life. Attendees can discover offerings from over 200 exhibitors, ranging from mobility aids to smart home technology. There will be opportunities to participate in adaptive activities, including an accessible climbing wall, various sports, and dance. Free workshops will cover topics such as self-advocacy, accessible living, and travel.

A new addition this year is an Early Access Hour on January 16, specifically for individuals with sensory disabilities, offering a quieter environment. The expo is held alongside the Abilities International Accessibility Conference, reflecting a shared commitment to improving accessibility and supporting individuals' lives.

events.name: GRI Chairmen's Retreat 2027
events.description:
Set against the breathtaking backdrop of St. Moritz, Switzerland, the GRI Chairmen's Retreat 2027 - Europe offers an unparalleled gathering for the most influential minds in global real estate. From January 13-17, 2027, at the Badrutt's Palace Hotel, this exclusive, invitation-only event convenes global real estate heads and their immediate #2s – individuals recognized as true decision-makers with capital at risk.

Participants will engage in intimate, agenda-free conversations and strategic plenary sessions, focusing on the industry's future and addressing global challenges. Beyond these formal discussions, the retreat encourages meaningful networking and camaraderie, supported by thoughtfully planned activities and the elegant setting. This environment allows senior leaders to build lasting connections and gain crucial insights, akin to a secluded "living-room conversation."

events.name: New England Mortgage Expo 2027
events.description:
Elevate your mortgage business and expand your professional network at the New England Mortgage Expo 2027. The expo returns to Mohegan Sun in Uncasville, CT, from January 14-15, and expects to welcome between 1,600 and 2,000 mortgage professionals, including executives, independent brokers, and loan officers.

Those attending will find an extensive lineup of exhibitors and have the opportunity to engage with leading industry speakers during many educational sessions. The show floor is arranged to facilitate meaningful networking, alongside live podcasting and raffle prizes. Complimentary food will be provided, offering a relaxed setting for gaining insights and making connections.

This gathering offers a key opportunity for professionals seeking to understand and adapt to the evolving New England mortgage landscape.

events.name: Wine VIT 2027
events.description:
Shaping the future of the $9.5 billion+ Washington wine industry, Wine VIT 2027 presents two pivotal gatherings for professionals. The Winter WineVit® begins on January 14, 2027, at Gård Estate Wines in Prosser. The Summer WineVit® will then take place in June 2027 in Western Washington.

Those attending will explore critical industry trends, new research, and practical solutions. Participants can connect with industry experts during insightful educational sessions. There will also be a tradeshow with over 180 exhibitors, presenting established companies, sustainability solutions, and new technology.

The event provides a setting to strengthen connections within the Washington wine community and foster innovation across the Pacific Northwest's wine and grape sector.

events.name: Destinations The Holiday & Travel Show Manchester 2027
events.description:
Your next adventure begins at Destinations The Holiday & Travel Show Manchester 2027, taking place from January 14-17 at Manchester Central. This event offers a wide range of travel possibilities, bringing together 200 leading travel brands and over 40 tourist boards.

Attendees can find special show offers and hear from over 50 speakers at the Meet The Experts Theatre. There will be global cooking demonstrations on the Food & Travel Stage, alongside engaging cultural performances. The Wanderlust Visions Gallery will showcase photography, and visitors can receive personalized advice for various trips, whether exploring the Canadian wilderness, embarking on American road trips, or planning international getaways. A Destinations ticket also includes access to The Caravan, Motorhome & Holiday Show.

events.name: Behavioral Health Management Forum 2027
events.description:
Mark your calendars for the Behavioral Health Management Forum 2027, convening January 14-15 at Caesars Palace, Las Vegas. This event is designed for senior executives from hospitals, health systems, health plans, and behavioral health centers.

Discussions will explore how to effectively integrate behavioral health across the care continuum, with a focus on practical value-based health and population health strategies. Key topics include addressing disparities, using digital tools and telehealth to expand access, and developing innovative care models for specific populations.

Participants will have opportunities to connect with industry leaders, share insights, and build partnerships aimed at enhancing care quality and improving member well-being in today's changing healthcare environment.

events.name: MLK Ski Weekend 2027
events.description:
Prepare for an extraordinary international getaway as the MLK Ski Weekend celebrates its monumental 30th Anniversary from January 14-18, 2027! For five days and four nights, Blue Mountain, Canada, will host an experience centered on equality, access, and community.

This event includes around 30 activities, combining winter sports with opportunities for personal and professional development. Those attending, who must be 21 or older, can participate in welcome receptions, village day parties, a comedy show, and "MLK Speaks" sessions. These sessions will cover topics like financial empowerment and professional growth. Beyond skiing and snowboarding, there are other activities such as Blue Mountain's Ridge Runner Mountain Coaster, spa treatments, and evening entertainment.

Reservations for the event become available on March 1st.

events.name: Onsite Employee Health & Wellness Centers Summit 2027
events.description:
Elevate your corporate healthcare strategy at the Onsite Employee Health & Wellness Centers Summit 2027, convening January 14-15 at Caesars Palace in Las Vegas.

This gathering is for C-suite executives, HR, medical, and wellness leaders who are committed to establishing and expanding effective onsite health centers. The discussions will focus on practical strategies to manage medical expenses, control overall corporate healthcare costs, and cultivate a healthy, high-performing workforce.

Attendees will explore new approaches to corporate healthcare, including adapting centers for virtual work environments and integrating primary care services. Industry experts will lead conversations on streamlining facility operations, ensuring competitive employee benefits, and effectively managing chronic conditions. The aim is to provide insights that contribute to a healthier and more productive employee base.

events.name: Caravan & Motorhome Holiday Show 2027
events.description:
The ultimate adventure begins at the Caravan & Motorhome Holiday Show 2027, taking place from January 14-17 at Manchester Central. This event is recognized as the North's largest gathering for leisure vehicles, offering a comprehensive look at the latest caravans, motorhomes, campervans, and holiday homes. Attendees will find a wide array of options from 150 different brands, showcasing everything from compact two-berth models to spacious six-berth family vehicles and modern campervan conversions.

The show provides an opportunity to step inside these vehicles, compare different layouts, and discover essential accessories for life on the road. Alongside this, a ticket also grants access to the co-located Destinations: The Holiday & Travel Show. This additional event features expert discussions and travel ideas, covering both UK destinations and international trips.

For those who enjoy touring or are considering this lifestyle, the event offers a chance to explore various possibilities and gather information to help shape their next journey.

events.name: Green Week 2027
events.description:
From January 15 to 24, 2027, Berlin opens its doors to Green Week, an international exhibition dedicated to the future of agriculture, food, and horticulture. Over these ten days, both trade visitors and the general public will find much to engage with. The exhibition explores various 'Theme Worlds,' ranging from displays of flowers to initiatives focused on sustainable living.

Visitors can explore the 'Event Farm,' taste foods from around the world, and see the equestrian shows at Hippologica. The program also features congresses, presentations on the Grüne Woche Stage, and specific days dedicated to startups, where new ideas are presented.

Workshops are designed for younger attendees, and the Regional-Star Award will recognize sustainable regional concepts. Green Week 2027 serves as a meeting point for those interested in rural life and its evolving landscape.

events.name: GCSAA Conference and Trade Show 2027

location.venue: New Orleans Ernest N. Morial Convention Center

events.description:
Elevate your expertise and connect with the future of golf course management at the GCSAA Conference and Trade Show 2027. From January 16-21, golf course superintendents, equipment managers, and industry leaders will gather in New Orleans, Louisiana. This week offers opportunities for learning, exploring new developments, and building professional relationships.

The event features over 500 exhibitors displaying the newest turf equipment, irrigation systems, and agronomic technology within a 178,600 square foot space. Educational seminars will cover practical topics such as robotics, AI applications, and advanced business strategies, led by researchers and experienced peers. Before the main trade show, participants have the option to compete in the GCSAA Golf Championships along the Mississippi Gulf Coast.

Thousands of professionals from the industry will be present, offering a chance to exchange ideas and build connections. Beyond the conference activities, attendees can experience the distinct culture of New Orleans.

events.name: ODAC Dermatology Conference 2027

location.venue: Signia by Hilton Orlando Bonnet Creek

events.description:
Elevate your expertise and connect with leaders in the field at the ODAC Dermatology Conference 2027. From January 15-18, the Signia by Hilton Orlando Bonnet Creek in Orlando, FL, will host a four-day program designed for a broad range of dermatology professionals, including MD/DOs, residents, NPs, PAs, and other medical staff.

Attendees can expect general education sessions, bonus presentations, and an exhibit and poster hall where the latest advancements will be on display. Registration covers meals, conference materials, a welcome reception, and virtual resources.

The conference offers a chance to explore new treatments, refine clinical skills, and build professional connections within the dermatology community.

events.name: Women in Orthodontics Annual Conference 2027
events.description:
Empowering female orthodontists to excel, the annual conference returns to the luxurious Fairmont Scottsdale Princess in Scottsdale, AZ, from January 15th-16th, 2027. This two-day event will bring together over 400 women and their teams, offering 12 CE Credits in a supportive environment.

Participants will explore strategies for the latest clinical treatments, practice efficiency, growth, and achieving work-life balance. The program features 16 expert speakers, including Dr. Courtney Dunn, Dr. Colby Ann Cajero, and Dr. Jennifer Smith. Their presentations will address a range of topics, from establishing new practices to minimizing office dynamics.

Beyond the educational sessions, the experience includes daily meals, cocktail receptions, a welcome gift, and access to the resort's amenities for relaxation. It offers an opportunity to connect with peers and foster a network among women leaders in orthodontics.

events.name: CLOTS Head to Toe 2027

location.venue: Four Seasons Resort Orlando at Walt Disney World Resort

events.description:
The Four Seasons Resort Orlando Disney will host CLOTS Head to Toe 2027, a premier three-day event dedicated to advancing thromboembolic disease care, from January 15-17, 2027. This conference is tailored for various healthcare professionals, including interventional cardiologists, neurologists, vascular surgeons, and advanced practice providers.

The program features sessions led by experts, exploring the latest in clot pathophysiology, treatment strategies, and evolving guidelines. Discussions will cover the importance of multidisciplinary collaboration and the influence of AI and new technologies on future care.

Practical strategies for improving care delivery and patient outcomes will be a focus, with opportunities for hands-on training and interactive workshops. Participants can refine their clinical expertise and connect with leading faculty who are committed to advancing multispecialty clot management.

events.name: FSN Annual Meeting 2027
events.description:
Celebrating six decades of dedication to kidney care, the FSN Annual Meeting 2027 invites you to "The Rhythm of Progress: 60 Years of Nephrology." This gathering will take place from January 15-17, 2027, at the JW Marriott Tampa Water Street in Tampa, Florida. It brings together nephrologists, fellows, residents, researchers, and nurses.

Attendees will hear from leading national and international experts, reflecting on the field's history while looking ahead to future patient care strategies. The program includes discussions on the business aspects of nephrology, a networking opportunity for Women in Nephrology Florida, and the 19th Annual Robert Geronemus Memorial Renal Research Competition. Continuing Medical Education (CME) and Maintenance of Certification (MOC) credits will be available, offering insights into the newest developments in kidney disease prevention and treatment.

This meeting provides a setting for colleagues from Florida and beyond to connect and contribute to the ongoing evolution of nephrology.

location.venue: Indiana State Fairgrounds West Pavilion & Expo Hall

events.name: VMX 2027
events.description:
From January 16-20, 2027, the Orange County Convention Center in Orlando, FL, alongside the VMX Virtual platform, will host VMX 2027 – the world's premier veterinary expo. Over these five days, attendees can explore more than 1,200 hours of continuing education. The curriculum covers a wide range of topics, including small animal surgery, exotic medicine, practice management, and personal wellness.

In the large expo hall, veterinary professionals—nurses, technicians, and practice managers alike—will find new approaches and advanced equipment from hundreds of exhibitors. It's also an opportunity to connect with leading experts, develop skills in hands-on workshops, and build relationships with colleagues.

Regardless of whether one attends in person or virtually, VMX 2027 offers ways to enhance one's practice and contribute to the ongoing evolution of veterinary medicine.

events.name: CMT Die Urlaubs-Messe 2027
events.description:
Get ready to plan your perfect escape at CMT Die Urlaubs-Messe 2027, taking place at Messe Stuttgart. This event brings together a wide range of travel options, allowing visitors to explore different places and experiences. You can find ideas for active trips, like cycling and hiking, as well as options for relaxing wellness breaks, cruises, and even custom-built vehicles such as camper vans.

CMT 2027 serves as a central point for travel ideas and planning. It gathers professionals and companies who present current travel developments. Whether someone is looking for an active vacation, a quiet retreat, or new ways to travel, the fair offers an environment to discover possibilities and help shape future trips.

events.name: World Schools Summit 2027
events.description:
Addressing the pivotal question, "How do we prepare young people for the future of work?", the World Schools Summit 2027 convenes in London, United Kingdom, on 16-17 January. This two-day summit, themed "Shaping The Future Together," brings together global education leaders, including ministers, funders, school leaders, and EdTech CEOs. Its purpose is to foster shared understanding and collaboration across the entire education landscape.

Discussions will explore innovations in teaching methods and technology, particularly the transformative role of AI. The goal is to inspire practical collaborations and commitments among participants. A key part of the summit is the second Global EdTech Prize, which highlights pioneering solutions and helps innovators gain broader recognition. The collective effort aims to shape the future of learning and prepare young people for tomorrow's challenges.

events.name: Hawaiian Eye & Retina 2027
events.description:
Prepare to advance your expertise at Hawaiian Eye & Retina 2027, the premier continuing education meeting for ophthalmology and retina specialists. Healio LIVE organizes this event, which is thoughtfully structured to benefit a wide range of professionals: physicians, residents, allied health professionals, and administrators.

Attendees will find a comprehensive program that delves into the latest advancements, current research, and established best practices in retinal care. It's a chance to learn directly from leading experts and participate in meaningful discussions. Since all program sessions and materials are part of the registration, attendees can fully concentrate on expanding their knowledge and connecting with peers.

events.name: BIJORHCA PARIS 2027
events.description:
Experience the pinnacle of jewelry and watchmaking innovation at BIJORHCA PARIS 2027. From January 16-18, 2027, Porte de Versailles in Paris hosts France's leading professional trade show dedicated to jewelry, watchmaking, and accessories. The event underscores the depth of craftsmanship, professional excellence, and creative diversity within these fields.

Attendees will find two main areas: 'Finished Products,' featuring fine and fashion jewelry, watches, and silverware, and the 'Elements Space,' which focuses on raw materials, components, and technical innovations. Building on a history that began in 1930, BIJORHCA PARIS features a program of conferences, workshops, and trend discussions.

The show is held alongside Who's Next and other fashion events, creating a comprehensive experience for the estimated 38,000 visitors, half of whom travel internationally. It serves as a platform to observe authenticity, expertise, and elegance, with support from BOCI, an organization that champions French creation and addresses market developments.

events.name: Biohackers World Conference & Expo 2027
events.description:
Unlock the future of human potential at the Biohackers World Conference & Expo 2027, set for January 16-17 in vibrant Downtown Miami. This two-day gathering offers a deep dive into biohacking, longevity, and wellness, exploring ways to enhance well-being, sharpen mental clarity, and extend a healthy lifespan.

Attendees will find an exhibition featuring upcoming technologies and innovations. The program includes presentations from over 35 speakers, alongside opportunities for guided movement, meditation, and healing sessions.

The event brings together a global community of more than 1,500 individuals, including executives, medical professionals, and experts from over 20 countries. It's a chance to exchange knowledge and connect with others focused on improving human performance and health.

events.name: Travel Adventure Show Washington DC 2027
events.description:
Prepare to explore the world and plan your ultimate escape at the Travel Adventure Show Washington DC 2027. From January 16-17, the Washington Convention Center will be filled with travel options. Attendees can explore thousands of new vacation ideas and connect with over 350 exhibitors, including representatives from major destinations and cruise lines. Travel professionals will be available to offer advice and help shape your upcoming trips.

The event features a program of over 60 expert-led seminars across three theaters, including presentations by well-known travel personalities Rick Steves and Samantha Brown. These sessions offer insights into the latest trends. Visitors can also discover special offers exclusive to the show and participate in trip giveaways.

events.name: International Conference on Solar Power Technology 2027
events.description:
Uncover the latest breakthroughs and future directions in solar energy at a premier global gathering. The International Conference on Solar Power Technology 2027 (ICSPT-2027) will convene on January 16th in Modinagar, India. This event brings together leading academic scientists, researchers, and practitioners, offering a crucial space for discussion and collaboration. With options for both in-person and virtual attendance, it aims to be accessible to a wide international audience.

Attendees will hear from international speakers during two technical sessions. These sessions will explore key subjects, ranging from advanced PV cell design and energy storage to AI integration and policy economics. The conference also provides opportunities to connect with peers and experts from ITR Group's extensive network of scholars.

Abstracts that are accepted will be published in an ISBN e-book, and full papers may be considered for SCOPUS/WOS-indexed journals. Participants can also gain international visibility, receive feedback on their scientific work, and compete for presentation awards. The conference serves as an important platform for advancing solar power technology and encouraging global cooperation.

events.name: The National Franchise Show Toronto Winter 2027

location.venue: Messe und Congress Centrum Halle Munsterland

events.name: Pacific Telecom Council Annual Meeting 2027
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the future of digital connectivity at the Pacific Telecom Council Annual Meeting 2027. From January 17-20, Honolulu, Hawai‘i, will host this global gathering at the Hilton Hawaiian Village® Waikiki Beach Resort. It brings together professionals, academics, and students from the digital infrastructure, telecommunications, and ICT sectors.

The event features discussions with industry leaders across various formats, including Center Stage sessions, Alaka‘i Stage fireside chats, and focused topical discussions. The program explores critical themes, from emerging technologies like AI, IoT, and the Metaverse, to the evolution of subsea networks, sustainability, and global policies. These conversations aim to shed light on new business models, opportunities in developing regions, and the ongoing shaping of the digital future.

events.name: Winter FancyFaire 2027
events.description:
Kickstarting the year for the specialty food community, the Winter FancyFaire returns to San Francisco from January 17-19, 2027. This gathering provides a space for brands and buyers to connect and offers an early perspective on what's next for the industry. The First Night Celebration will feature the unveiling of the year's key trend, and attendees can taste innovative products from sofi™ Award finalists before the winners are revealed live.

The redesigned Exhibit Hall will be open for exploration, while Discovery Point hosts hands-on demonstrations. The Campus Tasting Trail offers an opportunity to experience local flavors and connect with peers. Throughout the event, participants can gather important industry insights, see new innovations entering the market, and build connections that can influence the coming year.

events.name: CDAO Financial Services New York 2027
events.description:

This three-day event, centered on the theme "Learning without limits," will gather over 37,000 educators, government officials, and solution providers from more than 130 countries.

Participants will have the opportunity to explore new developments in AI, digital strategy, and future learning. They can engage with leading demonstrations and collaborative sessions. Dedicated spaces, including TableTalks, Tech User Labs, and Connect @ Bett, offer significant avenues for professional growth and networking.

The event will also highlight ways to make a tangible impact on the lives of teachers and learners. This includes championing inclusivity at the SEND Village and recognizing female leaders through Women in EdTech. Bett UK 2027 serves as an important forum for discussions that help shape the future of education.

events.name: Fitur 2027
events.description:
The global tourism sector converges at IFEMA MADRID from January 20-24, 2027, for Fitur 2027, the premier international tourism trade fair. The event anticipates bringing together over 10,000 exhibitors and welcoming 155,000 trade professionals, along with 100,000 members of the public from 161 countries. It serves as a key platform for the industry, fostering connections and the discovery of new developments.

Those attending can explore various specialized areas. Fitur TechY focuses on future technologies, Fitur Cruises is dedicated to sustainable "Blue tourism," and Fitur Talent addresses recruitment within the sector. With Puerto Rico as the Partner Country, the fair will also showcase innovations, promote accessible tourism through Fitur 4all, and recognize achievements with different awards. This event is an important meeting point for professionals influencing the direction of travel.

events.name: Learning Technologies France 2027
events.description:
The future of workplace learning and talent development converges at Learning Technologies France 2027, taking place on 20-21 January at Paris Expo, Porte de Versailles.

Co-located with HR Technologies France, this event typically brings together over 14,000 professionals from 50 countries. Attendees can explore an extensive exhibition showcasing the newest digital learning solutions and training innovations.

The program includes over 300 conferences and sessions, presented in both French and English. These discussions offer perspectives on current strategies, provide opportunities to connect with leaders in the field, and help individuals broaden their professional connections. The aim is to help professionals understand how to evolve their HR and training approaches to keep pace with a changing environment.

events.name: HR Technologies France 2027
events.description:
Mark your calendars for HR Technologies France 2027, the premier event dedicated to the future of human resources, taking place on January 20-21, 2027. The event will be held at the enlarged Hall 4 of Paris Expo Porte de Versailles, expecting to bring together more than 14,000 HR professionals, decision-makers, and experts from various regions.

Attendees will find innovations from over 350 exhibitors focused on HR, recruitment, and talent management solutions. The program includes approximately 300 conferences, round tables, keynotes, and case studies, providing perspectives on the evolving HR landscape. Held alongside Learning Technologies France, the event offers a broader view where HR and professional training intersect. It's an opportunity to connect with peers, explore emerging technologies, and gather practical strategies to enhance an organization's HR capabilities.

events.name: FMI Midwinter Executive Conference 2027
events.description:
Prepare to shape the future of the food industry at the FMI Midwinter Executive Conference 2027, scheduled for January 20 - 23 at the stunning Gaylord Pacific in Chula Vista, CA.

This gathering brings together top executives and leaders in food retail. It offers a setting for meaningful discussions and building connections, where participants can explore new ideas, share insights, and work towards shaping the evolving retail landscape.

Discussions will cover key trends, including changing consumer priorities around health and well-being, the strategic importance of private brands, and how technology is transforming grocery shopping. It's an opportunity to connect with peers, gain strategic insights, and collectively consider what's next for food retail.

events.name: Global Virtual Martech Summit 2027
events.description:
Prepare to elevate your marketing strategy at the Global Virtual Martech Summit 2027, a premier online event scheduled for January 20, 2027. This online gathering is designed for marketing professionals across the APAC and EMEA regions, offering a look into current developments in marketing technology.

Organized by BEETc, the summit will explore data-driven strategies, integrated marketing approaches, and the role of AI in Martech. Participants can expect to learn about new solutions and upcoming trends that are influencing the industry.

Registration for the event is free. It provides an opportunity to engage with expert discussions and connect with peers, all from a convenient online setting.

events.name: LAMMA Show 2027
events.description:
The agricultural industry's premier event, LAMMA Show 2027, opens its doors at the NEC, Birmingham, on January 20-21. This gathering brings together over 45,000 attendees and more than 800 exhibitors across 12 halls, serving as a central point for farmers and professionals interested in the latest agricultural developments.

Visitors will find a wide array of machinery, technology, and equipment on display, ranging from advanced tractors to solutions for sustainable farming. The event will feature UK product introductions and practical demonstrations in the Demo Zone. Additionally, LAMMA 2027 is held alongside CropTec and the Low Carbon Agriculture Show, providing a broader perspective on arable farming and sustainable methods.

It's an opportunity to connect with industry leaders and colleagues, fostering discussions that contribute to the ongoing progress of agriculture.

events.name: IMN Winter Real Estate Private Funds 2027
events.description:
North America's leading real estate private funds and private equity event, IMN Winter Real Estate Private Funds 2027, is set to convene January 20-22, 2027, at the luxurious Montage Laguna Beach, California. This 2.5-day gathering brings together over 1200 senior decision-makers, including more than 750 real estate PE funds and LPs. It offers a significant opportunity for these professionals to understand and respond to changes in the commercial real estate market.

Attendees will explore key areas such as macro investment strategies, debt solutions, ESG integration, and emerging technology. The event anticipates thousands of individual meetings, alongside focused sessions and various ways to connect with peers. These include interactive roundtables and a golf outing. Participants can expect to build valuable relationships and hear directly from industry leaders, gaining insights that inform their work.

The environment is designed to foster collaboration among the industry's most influential minds, allowing for a deeper understanding of current trends and future directions in real estate investment.

events.name: Battlefin Discovery Day Miami 2027
events.description:
Prepare to redefine the future of investment research at Battlefin Discovery Day Miami 2027, taking place from January 20-22 at the luxurious Nobu Eden Roc, Miami Beach. Over these three days, the event will explore "Agentic Alpha: The Next Generation of Investment Research," examining how autonomous workflows, intelligent agents, and advanced alternative data are shaping the search for alpha.

Professionals, including data strategists, portfolio managers, and alternative data buyers from leading investment firms, will have the opportunity to meet with innovative data providers. A structured 1:1 meeting format, facilitated by the Ensemble platform, is designed to foster relevant connections and encourage substantive discussions that can lead to lasting collaborations.

Attendees will also find opportunities to engage with industry leaders, explore new sources of alpha, and participate in networking events, such as a VIP Dinner for senior buy-side attendees. The aim is for participants to gain insights into tools and strategies that can help them navigate and succeed in the evolving financial landscape.

events.name: Digital Insurance MENA 2027
events.description:
Prepare to redefine the future of insurance at Digital Insurance MENA 2027, taking place on January 20-21st, 2027, in Dubai, UAE. This event focuses on advancing digital transformation within the industry, bringing together over 1500 attendees, including more than 350 decision-makers and 60% insurers, alongside leading insurtech companies and digital innovators.

The program will explore strategies for resilient growth, emphasizing the use of AI, data, and customer-centric methods across five conference tracks. Participants will hear from over 160 expert speakers, see live demonstrations in the Demo Corner, and learn about successful digital journeys in Transformation Alley.

There will be opportunities to connect with peers and experts at Digital Connect and through Lunch Roundtables. The event also includes the Digital Insurance Awards, recognizing industry pioneers. The aim is to help participants develop agile, future-ready digital ecosystems.

events.name: Sports Licensing & Tailgate Show 2027
events.description:
The Sports Licensing & Tailgate Show 2027, set for January 20-22 at the Las Vegas Convention Center, is the ultimate B2B marketplace for licensed sports and tailgate merchandise. The show will feature over 300 vendors, presenting new collections of apparel, collectibles, gifts, and essential tailgate gear from major leagues such as the NFL, NBA, and MLB.

Retail buyers, representing America's Top 10 retailers, e-commerce giants, university bookstores, and specialty shops, will attend to explore new products and plan their 2027 inventory.

The event provides opportunities for attendees to connect with others in the industry, including through networking receptions. The 'License to Buy' incentive program will also be available. This gathering brings together licensors, licensees, and retailers, offering a chance to understand current market trends.

events.name: BGSA Supply Chain Conference 2027
events.description:
From January 20 to 22, 2027, The Breakers in Palm Beach, FL, will host the BGSA Supply Chain Conference, an exclusive, invitation-only assembly for C-level executives. This gathering brings together key figures from transportation, logistics, and the broader supply chain industry. Participants will explore strategic concepts, emerging technologies, and innovative growth approaches that are influencing the market.

The program is structured around panel discussions, presentations from various speakers, and opportunities for individual conversations with BGSA executives. A notable part of the conference is the BGSA "Shark Tank" Competition, where participants introduce new concepts. The event is designed to foster close peer-to-peer discussions, offering a setting for valuable connections and perspectives that can influence the industry's direction.

events.name: DRI Product Liability Conference 2027
events.description:
Navigating the complex and ever-evolving landscape of product liability demands constant vigilance and expert insight. The DRI Product Liability Conference 2027 provides a forum for legal professionals, corporate counsel, and risk managers to explore the latest trends, challenges, and defense strategies shaping the field.

Attendees will develop a clearer understanding of emerging legal precedents, the impact of new technologies on liability, and practical approaches to regulatory compliance. The program allows for engagement with experts, a review of effective litigation tactics, and consideration of innovative methods for risk mitigation.

This gathering also offers a setting to connect with peers and leaders, fostering discussions that address the dynamic nature of product liability.

events.name: PTC 5K Charity Run/Walk 2027
events.description:
Start your Wednesday, January 20, 2027, with an invigorating experience at the PTC 5K Charity Run/Walk. Attendees of the PTC'27 conference are invited to The Great Lawn, where registration opens at 5:45 AM. The run/walk itself will begin at 6:30 AM.

The route offers a chance to experience the refreshing morning air while moving along the shores of Waikiki. This provides an opportunity to connect with industry colleagues in a relaxed, informal atmosphere.

Beyond the scenic views and physical activity, participation in the event contributes to a meaningful cause, offering a rewarding start to the conference day. It's a chance to energize oneself and contribute to a good cause.

events.name: Business Insurance World Captive Forum 2027
events.description:
From January 20-22, 2027, the Hyatt Regency Miami will host the Business Insurance World Captive Forum, an essential event for the global captive insurance community.

The forum is recognized for its substantial educational program, designed to provide over 500 participants with current insights and practical strategies. Professionals, including captive owners, prospective founders, managers, service providers, investment managers, reinsurers, domicile regulators, and brokers, will gather to explore the latest trends and best practices in the field.

The event offers a comprehensive setting that includes educational sessions, interactive roundtable discussions, and an active exhibit hall. Attendees will find significant opportunities for both group and individual networking, which can help them build connections and explore potential collaborations. The overall experience is intended to help participants deepen their expertise and contribute to ongoing discussions about the future of captive insurance.

events.name: IMM North America 2027
events.description:
Celebrating its 15th year, IMM North America 2027 returns to the Javits Center, NYC, on January 20-21. It brings together travel brands, PR professionals, and leading travel media from across the USA and Canada. Participants can pre-book 24 focused 15-minute appointments using a dedicated Meetings Manager. These sessions are designed for direct story pitches, arranging familiarization trips, and building important connections.

The first day includes the TravMedia Summit, which provides opportunities for professional development and examines current industry trends and shifts in media. Over 7.5 hours are set aside for networking, including sponsored lunches and cocktail functions. This time allows attendees to meet peers, discuss ideas, and contribute to the ongoing conversation about travel narratives.

events.name: C-Suite Outlook 2027
events.description:
Designed exclusively for CEOs, C-suite executives, and select senior leaders, C-Suite Outlook 2027 (also known as '2027: A Year in Preview') offers an unparalleled strategic preview of the year ahead. This forum, held by invitation only, gathers on January 20, 2027, at The Plaza in New York. It provides a private setting where senior leaders can engage in candid conversations with their peers.

Participants will hear directly from leading economists and prominent business figures, including Penny Pennington and Aaron Levie. They will explore the critical forces influencing business conditions, from economic shifts and geopolitical dynamics to rapid technological advancements and evolving workforce needs. The discussions aim to provide practical understanding for navigating challenges like inflation, interest rates, and unexpected 'Gray Swan' events.

Attendance is intentionally kept small, ensuring an environment that encourages open dialogue and deep engagement among executives. This focused approach helps leaders develop the foresight needed to strategically position their organizations for the future.

events.name: DELIVER Middle East 2027
events.description:
Set to redefine the future of retail, supply chain, and logistics, DELIVER Middle East 2027 convenes on 20-21 January at the Hilton Dubai Al Habtoor City, Dubai. This gathering brings together more than 200 senior retail and logistics executives with over 25 innovative solution providers, including Headline Sponsor DP World. Participants will explore current trends, emerging technologies, and sustainable approaches that are influencing e-commerce and delivery.

The program is structured to facilitate focused one-on-one meetings through a matchmaking process, and present solutions from selected providers. Attendees will hear from experienced speakers. The event offers a hosted experience for participants, focusing on fostering strategic connections and opportunities for advancement, while also maintaining a clear commitment to sustainability.

events.name: Sustainable Foods Summit North America 2027
events.description:
The North American edition of the Sustainable Foods Summit returns to San Francisco on January 20-21, 2027, bringing together industry pioneers to navigate the evolving landscape of sustainable food. Ecovia Intelligence organizes this two-day summit, which will examine the most critical environmental and social issues affecting the food sector.

The agenda includes exploring significant developments such as the role of artificial intelligence in advancing sustainability, the principles of regenerative agriculture, and new approaches to sustainable ingredients. Conversations will also address effective marketing strategies for products focused on environmental consciousness.

With support from sponsors like Fair Trade USA, the summit provides an environment for professionals to connect, share insights, and work towards a more sustainable future for the food industry. It offers a space to understand the directions and solutions shaping the food system of tomorrow.

events.name: PCI London 2027
events.description:
The 27th PCI London event, scheduled for January 21st, 2027, at the Park Plaza Victoria, London, is your essential guide to mastering PCI DSS v4.0.1. This year's focus, "Meeting the challenge of 4.0.1," explores the complexities many organizations encounter, from underestimated CDE scope to high technical demands and the nuances of the Customized Approach.

Discussions will cover continuous assurance, e-commerce security requirements for third-party scripts, and the responsible integration of AI in payment environments. Case studies and technical sessions will feature compliance leaders sharing strategies for reducing costs, managing third-party risks, and aligning PCI DSS with broader GRC frameworks.

The event is relevant for CISOs, Compliance Officers, and IT leaders in sectors such as banking, retail, and government, who are looking for practical solutions in the changing payment security environment.

events.name: Construction Safety & Health Conference 2027
events.description:
Dedicated to advancing best practices in the construction industry, the Construction Safety & Health Conference 2027 presents two vital opportunities for professionals. The conference offers two distinct sessions for attendees. The Winter Session takes place from January 20–22, 2027, at the Hard Rock Hotel in San Diego, CA. An alternative is the Summer Session, held from July 13–15, 2027, at the Hyatt Regency Orlando, Orlando, FL.

This conference addresses key aspects of construction safety and health. Attendees will delve into current regulatory updates, explore new strategies for mitigating risks, and examine advanced technologies aimed at protecting workers and improving project efficiency. It's an occasion to connect with industry leaders, exchange insights, and gain practical knowledge that can help foster a robust safety culture and promote healthier conditions on construction sites.

events.name: AAC&U Annual Meeting 2027
events.description:
"Higher Education at 250: Purpose, Trust, and Transformation" sets the stage for the AAC&U Annual Meeting 2027 in Seattle, WA. This gathering brings together leaders from higher education, policy, business, and civil society, alongside registrants from the co-located UERU conference. Attendees will consider higher education's evolving responsibilities, examining current practices to ensure they align with its core purposes.

The meeting will address how to redefine student success for a world in constant flux, rebuild public confidence, and equip students to navigate complex challenges. Conversations will also cover strengthening institutions as vital community anchors, cultivating learning environments rooted in humanistic inquiry and care, and thoughtfully integrating new technologies such as AI. The collective aim is to shape a future where higher education effectively serves the public good and prepares students for a pluralistic democracy.

events.name: Marketopia GROWCON 2027
events.description:
Prepare to transform your MSP business at Marketopia GROWCON 2027, an exclusive, workshop-based event designed for Managed Service Providers and IT service leaders focused on scaling.

The event runs from December 3-5, 2027, at Marketopia HQ in Pinellas Park, FL. Attendees will participate in hands-on sessions, receiving direct feedback on their marketing, sales processes, and overall growth strategy. The environment is designed to be free of vendor pitches, focusing instead on practical application.

The aim is for each participant to develop a personalized, actionable growth plan for 2028. Workshops led by experts who have successfully scaled MSPs, along with peer planning sessions, will help refine lead generation, optimize sales strategies, and foster accountability. Qualified decision-makers may attend at no cost and could be eligible for a travel scholarship. The event offers concrete steps for immediate application and a chance to connect with others in the industry.

events.name: Military Aviation & Air Dominance Summit 2027
events.description:
The Military Aviation & Air Dominance Summit 2027, scheduled for January 20-21 at the Jackson Center in Huntsville, AL, will gather senior military and industry decision-makers. The summit focuses on developing strategies to enhance lethality and secure air dominance against evolving threats.

Discussions will cover key areas such as Future Vertical Lift (FVL), Next-Generation Air Dominance (NGAD) platforms, and the transformative role of unmanned systems. Participants will also examine emerging technologies like AI, digital engineering, and the Modular Open Systems Approach (MOSA) for agile avionic systems.

Participants from U.S. Military Services, the DoD, and international partners can expect to gain critical insights into deploying next-generation operational capabilities and fostering essential global collaborations. The summit operates under the Chatham House Rule, ensuring an unrecorded forum for open strategic dialogue.

events.name: Excellence in Master Data Management & Data Governance Summit 2027
events.description:
Prepare to elevate your data strategy at the Excellence in Master Data Management & Data Governance Summit 2027, taking place in Amsterdam on January 20-21. This gathering brings together senior leaders in data, Master Data Management (MDM), and AI from various international organizations.

Over two days, participants will hear from more than 20 speakers who will share their experiences with real-world implementations and discuss current governance models. The discussions will explore how reliable data contributes to both daily operations and long-term strategy, with particular attention given to how AI is changing data quality, ownership, and automation.

The program includes interactive panels, detailed case studies, and opportunities for private one-on-one meetings. These sessions are designed to help attendees connect with peers and discover practical methods for preparing their organization's data for the evolving AI landscape.

Enterprise AI HR Transformation Assembly January 2027
events.description:
Shape the future of human resources at the Enterprise AI HR Transformation Assembly, an exclusive gathering for Global Chief Human Resource Officers and C-Suite leaders. This event will be held on January 20-21, 2027, at The Fairmont in New Orleans. It provides a forum to examine how AI integration and digital transformation are influencing the HR landscape.

Attendees, who represent a significant number of Fortune 100 companies and have been carefully selected, will engage with an agenda built on current research. The program includes dedicated 1-on-1 meetings and opportunities for C-level professionals to connect, alongside insights from prominent HR executives such as Christy Cole (Abm Industries) and Adam Hickman (The Walt Disney Company). The discussions will focus on developing strategies to enhance HR capabilities through AI, addressing pressing industry challenges, and fostering innovation in an organization's human capital.

events.name: Transformational CHRO Assembly January 2027
events.description:
The Transformational CHRO Assembly, set for January 20-21, 2027, at The Fairmont, New Orleans, offers an unparalleled opportunity for Global Chief Human Resource Officers and Enterprise C-Suite leaders.

This two-day gathering, which draws leaders from 76% of Fortune 100 companies, is designed with a central focus on 'People-First HR for the Digital Age.' Participants will engage in substantive discussions about how digital transformation shapes HR, exploring current industry trends and challenges.

The program includes access to proprietary research, ensures one-on-one meetings with carefully matched peers, and provides direct interaction with C-level leaders. It serves as a setting for gaining strategic insights, making valuable connections, and fostering professional growth, with SHRM recertification credits available.

events.name: Elite CIO/CISO Summit London 2027
events.description:
London is set to host an unparalleled, invitation-only gathering for the world's most influential technology executives: the Elite CIO/CISO Summit on Wednesday, January 20, 2027. This invitation-only gathering, led by peers, is for senior CIOs and CISOs, focusing on the important theme of "Scaling Enterprise AI Without Scaling the Risk."

The day's program will include strategic discussions on AI governance and cyber resilience in an agentic world. Keynote speakers will also address platform modernization and the evolving role of the CIO as a commercial leader. Participants will engage in high-level discussions, roundtables, and fireside chats, all structured to provide practical insights and foster meaningful exchange among colleagues.

The summit will conclude with a champagne reception and gala dinner. This provides a setting for industry leaders to connect, share ideas, and engage in collaborative problem-solving.

events.name: Litestream Ventures Family Office & Venture Capital Forum During World Economic Forum 2027
Leader in Me Symposium Los Angeles 2027
events.description:
Educators and school leaders seeking to cultivate a culture of empowerment and excellence are invited to the Leader in Me Symposium in Los Angeles in 2027. FranklinCovey Education is hosting this gathering for PK-12 professionals who are committed to enhancing their school's learning environments.

Participants will have the opportunity to explore the "Leader in Me" framework, which draws from Stephen R. Covey's 7 Habits. This framework offers insights into developing student leadership, improving academic results, and fostering a positive, principle-centered school culture.

The symposium will feature sessions designed for engagement, allowing individuals to share effective strategies and connect with colleagues who are also dedicated to school-wide improvement. Attendees can explore approaches to empower students and provide their school communities with resources for sustained progress.

events.name: Sundance Film Festival 2027
events.description:
Independent cinema's most anticipated annual gathering, the Sundance Film Festival, will usher in a new era from January 22 to February 01, 2027, as it makes its anticipated move to Boulder.

Over eleven days, film enthusiasts, industry professionals, and storytellers will experience a range of independent films, documentaries, and short features. It's an opportunity to discover new talent, see fresh perspectives in storytelling, and participate in discussions about the direction of film.

The festival aims to support artistic expression and celebrate the unique perspective of independent filmmakers.

events.name: Sirha Lyon 2027
events.description:
The global epicenter for culinary innovation and hospitality excellence returns with Sirha Lyon 2027, taking place from January 21 to 25 at Eurexpo Lyon, France.

Organized by the GL events group, this event serves as a key gathering for professionals across the food service and hospitality sectors. It's a place where new ideas are presented, and insights are exchanged, helping attendees understand the evolving landscape. Visitors can explore current trends, observe prestigious culinary competitions, and gain a clearer picture of the industry's direction.

The environment encourages open discussions and the formation of new professional connections. It provides an opportunity to consider different perspectives and identify practical approaches to industry challenges. Professionals can connect with their peers and find inspiration for their work.

events.name: Pendulum Summit 2027
events.description:
On Thursday, January 21, 2027, The Convention Centre Dublin will host Pendulum Summit 2027, the world's No. 1 Business & Leadership Summit. This internationally accredited CPD event is designed to support senior executives, middle management, founders, and aspiring leaders. The program centers on "Fuelling peak performance and professional resilience," providing an inspiring and actionable experience.

Attendees will hear from leading experts and authorities, who will share insights on core principles such as Holistic Wellbeing, Authentic Relationships, Peak Performance, Vocational Prosperity, and Visionary Leadership.

In addition to the presentations, attendees can explore an extensive expo and engage in networking. These elements offer opportunities for team building, business acquisition, and company branding.

events.name: Rocky Mountain Dental Convention 2027
events.description:
Prepare for three days of innovation and collaboration at the Rocky Mountain Dental Convention 2027, taking place in Denver, CO, from January 21-23. This gathering brings together the full dental team—dentists, hygienists, and practice partners—making it the region's largest professional assembly. Attendees can expect to engage with current dental education, earn necessary CE credits, and consider the evolving landscape of dentistry.

The expansive Expo Hall will feature new products and special offers. Additionally, focused discussions will take place at the Integrated Healthcare Summit and LABX, offering insights into specific areas of practice.

Beyond the formal sessions, there will be opportunities to connect with colleagues. Events like the Mile High Happy Hour and the Friday Night Silent Disco are planned to facilitate these interactions. The convention aims to support professionals in enhancing their practice and growing their network.

events.name: Impressions Expo Long Beach 2027
events.description:
Set to unfold at the Long Beach Convention Center, Impressions Expo Long Beach 2027 stands as the decorated apparel industry's most advanced trade show and conference. From January 20-23, 2027, with the main expo running January 21-23, the event, organized by Impressions Magazine, will present the latest innovations, emerging trends, new products, and services.

Professionals, especially those from California, Nevada, Arizona, Utah, Oregon, and Washington, are expected to attend, connecting with leading exhibitors and industry figures. Those attending can anticipate opportunities to network with peers and a comprehensive conference program. This program will include seminars led by experts, offering valuable insights and practical strategies for business development. The event aims to help participants enhance their knowledge and understand future directions in decorated apparel.

events.name: e-Crime & Cybersecurity Congress Germany Summer 2027
events.description:
On January 21st, 2027, the 27th e-Crime & Cybersecurity Congress Germany will convene at the Crowne Plaza Frankfurt Congress Hotel, bringing together cybersecurity leaders from across the nation's critical infrastructure, finance, telecommunications, and Mittelstand sectors. The congress will address the escalating geopolitical threat landscape and the significant influence of AI on both cyber defense and attack vectors.

Participants will examine practical approaches for navigating the evolving regulatory landscape, including NIS2 and the EU Cyber Resilience Act, with an emphasis on achieving genuine resilience rather than just meeting compliance requirements. Discussions will cover modernizing detection and response, securing AI agents, preparing for quantum computing, and using automation to address skills gaps. The aim is to provide real-world case studies and technical insights that help organizations strengthen their defenses against complex threats and integrate robust security from the outset.

events.name: Milano Home 2027
events.description:
Milano Home 2027, taking place from January 21-24 at Fiera Milano (Rho), Italy, is poised to redefine the future of home stores. The event will explore contemporary living from many angles, presenting new ideas, distinctive products, and opportunities for professional development.

The exhibition is structured around "Four worlds" – Vibes, Mood, Wow, and Taste. Each area aims to spark fresh retail approaches, creative displays, and interesting items appealing to various generations. Additionally, an "Elements pathway" will highlight creative handicraft developed through advanced exploration.

Milano Home 2027 offers a setting for buyers, exhibitors, and Brand Ambassadors to connect, identify emerging trends, and contribute to the evolving landscape of home stores.

events.name: AKJ e-Crime & Cybersecurity Congress Germany Winter 2027
events.description:
Addressing the escalating cyber threat landscape, the AKJ e-Crime & Cybersecurity Congress Germany Winter 2027 will convene on January 21, 2027, at the Crowne Plaza Frankfurt Congress Hotel.

This one-day event is designed for Germany's key information security professionals, including CISOs and IT risk managers. It will explore the specific challenges facing the nation, such as complex IT/OT integration, managing extended supply chains, and the practical application of regulations like NIS2, DORA, and the EU Cyber Resilience Act.

Discussions will cover the geopolitical threat landscape, examine how AI is reshaping both cyber defense and attack strategies, and address the steps organizations need to take for quantum-readiness. Through real-life case studies and detailed technical sessions, participants can expect to develop practical strategies for defending against ransomware, continuously managing their attack surface, and securing digital sovereignty in today's evolving cybersecurity environment.

events.name: Optimize San Francisco 2027
events.description:
Prepare to redefine your Go-to-Market strategy at Optimize San Francisco 2027, taking place on January 21, 2027, at the South San Francisco Conference Centre. This gathering, organized by the Revenue Operations Alliance, will bring together over 750 senior RevOps decision-makers and more than 150 expert speakers from over 600 companies.

The program features multiple tracks designed to address key challenges such as funnel leakage, forecasting complexities, and managing technology sprawl. Discussions will cover how generative AI and automation are being used to streamline operations, improve pipeline accuracy, and create more effective buyer experiences. Participants will also explore approaches for building a unified GTM data layer and navigating change within organizations.

The event provides an opportunity for professionals to align their teams, foster innovation, and contribute to the evolution of cross-functional Go-to-Market success.

events.name: CRA Trade Show 2027
events.description:
Mark your calendars for the Colorado Roofing Association's premier annual event! The CRA Trade Show 2027 is scheduled for Thursday, January 21, from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m. at the Arapahoe County Fairgrounds in Aurora, CO. This Table Top Trade Show serves the Colorado roofing industry.

Those who attend, including installers, builders, architects, and manufacturers, will find an array of products, advanced equipment, and innovative services. It offers a chance to connect with over 1200 industry professionals, build valuable relationships, and discover new ideas. The event is designed for decision-makers and key buyers interested in the future of roofing.

Admission is free for registered attendees. Attendees also receive 1 C.I.U. for general admission.

events.name: Momentum San Francisco 2027
events.description:
Uncover the next era of Go-to-Market excellence at Momentum San Francisco 2027. On January 21, 2027, the South San Francisco Conference Center will bring together more than 100 Go-to-Market leaders. A significant portion, 80%, will be senior management representing over 50 innovative companies. This gathering, presented by GTM Alliance, is intended for executives who are navigating complex, cross-functional challenges across sales, marketing, and customer success.

Attendees will hear from over 25 leading industry experts, including individuals from AWS, Google, and SAP. These speakers will share proven frameworks for successful product launches, fostering pipeline growth, and dismantling functional silos within organizations. Discussions will delve into how evolving buyer behaviors, insights from AI, and broader market shifts are reshaping current Go-to-Market strategies. The event offers a chance to consider how to reimagine existing playbooks, aiming to integrate product, marketing, sales, and customer success into a cohesive, adaptive growth approach.

This is an opportunity to connect with a community of peers, pressure-test new strategies, and identify pathways to accelerate revenue.
