events.description:
On January 22, 2027, the Berlin Marriott Hotel will become the epicenter of retail innovation as it hosts Savant Berlin 2027. This Savant Retail Congress, scheduled from 8:30 AM to 6:30 PM, is designed for qualified retailers and brands interested in shaping the future of their industry. Complimentary VIP passes are available for qualified industry professionals, fostering an environment where key decision-makers can gather.

The day's program includes insights, strategic discussions, and opportunities for professional connection. Participants will explore current strategies, emerging trends, and practical solutions relevant to the evolving retail landscape. It's an occasion to engage with peers, share common challenges, and discover new approaches to support business development.

events.name: Motor Bike Expo 2027
events.description:
The roar of engines and the gleam of chrome will once again fill Veronafiere, Verona, Italy, as Motor Bike Expo 2027 opens its doors from January 22-24. This international gathering brings together those with a deep interest in the motorcycle world, providing a comprehensive look at custom bikes, advanced accessories, and the exciting world of racing.

Visitors will have the opportunity to engage with new concepts and see the latest developments in the industry. The event highlights unique experiences, special offerings from exhibitors, and early glimpses of upcoming innovations. With support from FIM and important regional partners, the expo serves as a meeting point where motorcycle enthusiasts and professionals from the industry can connect and share ideas.

It's a place to observe the evolution of motorcycling, admire exceptional custom builds, and experience the culture that celebrates the freedom of two wheels.

events.name: future@WORK 2027

location.venue: Messe und Congress Centrum Halle Munsterland

events.description:
Mark your calendars for future@WORK 2027, the 4th iteration of the premier Skilled Workers and Further Education Fair. The event will be held in early 2027 at MCC Halle Münsterland. It brings together career starters, experienced professionals, and individuals looking for new opportunities. This gathering provides a space to explore various job openings, learn about specific further education programs, and connect with key employers throughout the Münsterland region.

The Zukunftsarena will feature lectures and discussions that offer perspectives on the changing landscape of work. Attendees can also participate in the future@WORK Challenge, an initiative created to link new talent with companies in the region. The event's theme, "Arrive. Come Together. Get Ahead.", reflects its focus on supporting individuals in their professional development and in acquiring skills relevant for the future.

events.name: Washington, DC Auto Show 2027
events.description:
Get ready for an unparalleled automotive experience at the Washington, DC Auto Show 2027, running from January 22 to 31 at the Walter E. Washington Convention Center.

As the region's largest indoor gathering of its kind and recognized as one of the nation's leading auto shows, it offers a comprehensive look at the future of personal transportation. Car enthusiasts, families, and media professionals will find an extensive display of what's new and what's next in the automotive world. Visitors will have the opportunity to explore the newest models from major manufacturers and engage with significant advancements in automotive technology.

The show highlights a broad spectrum of mobility solutions, ranging from robust vehicles designed for outdoor adventures to environmentally conscious innovations developed for various daily needs. Experiences available include dynamic indoor and outdoor test drives, interactive exhibits for consumers, and detailed presentations from different brands and within specialized pavilions. This gathering provides a comprehensive overview of current and future developments in transportation.

events.name: American Association of Orthodontists Winter Conference 2027

location.venue: JW Marriott San Antonio Hill Country Resort & Spa

events.description:
Orthodontic professionals are invited to explore the cutting edge of their field at the American Association of Orthodontists Winter Conference 2027. This event will take place from January 22-24, 2027, at the JW Marriott San Antonio Hill Country Resort & Spa in San Antonio, TX. The conference theme, "Next-Gen Clinical Excellence: Evidence-Based, Data-Driven, AI-Enabled," will examine how evidence, technology, and artificial intelligence are shaping clinical decision-making, improving efficiency, and enhancing patient outcomes.

Orthodontists and residents attending will explore both established concepts and advanced techniques in non-surgical sagittal correction. Participants can earn up to 16.75 live CE credits from mainstage sessions. These sessions are accessible in person or virtually, with a 30-day replay option for those attending remotely.

Following the main conference, the Women’s Leadership Workshop is scheduled for January 25-26, 2027, at the JW Marriott Phoenix Desert Ridge Resort & Spa. This workshop offers an opportunity to develop leadership skills and build professional connections within the community.

events.name: New York Podiatric Clinical Conference & Exhibition 2027
events.description:
Elevate your practice and explore the forefront of podiatric medicine at the New York Podiatric Clinical Conference & Exhibition 2027. This event is designed for podiatrists and allied health professionals looking to deepen their clinical knowledge and understand the newest developments shaping the industry.

Those attending will have opportunities to engage with recent research, participate in clinical discussions, and acquire practical skills to enhance patient care. The exhibition floor will feature new technologies and solutions from companies like Fusion, Power Step, and ModMed, offering insights into the future of podiatry.

It's a chance to connect with peers, learn from experts, and keep current in a field that continues to evolve.

events.name: SCCACS Annual Meeting 2027
events.description:
Surgeons seeking to advance their knowledge and network will converge at the Ritz-Carlton Bacara, Santa Barbara, for the SCCACS Annual Meeting 2027, taking place January 22-24.

For members of the Southern California Chapter and the American College of Surgeons, this meeting offers a significant opportunity for learning and professional development. The program will focus on surgical research and education, including a dedicated "Writing Workshop – From Abstract to Manuscript" designed to help participants refine their academic writing skills. Young surgeons are also invited, with travel stipends available to support their attendance.

The Call for Abstracts will open in July 2026 and close in September 2026. This gathering provides a chance for attendees to engage in discussions and learn from their colleagues.

events.name: SIGEP WORLD 2027
events.description:
The Rimini Expo Centre in Italy is set to host the 48th edition of SIGEP WORLD – The World Expo for Foodservice Excellence, from 23-27 January 2027. This five-day event serves as a key gathering for international professionals working in the Gelato, Pastry & Chocolate, Coffee, Bakery, and Pizza sectors.

Those attending will have the opportunity to explore the latest trends and innovations influencing these industries. A notable feature is 'SIGEP Vision,' an AI-powered podcast created to help professionals stay current and streamline their daily tasks.

Participants can examine new solutions, connect with leaders from around the world, and consider how artificial intelligence is transforming the future of these culinary areas. The event aims to provide valuable perspectives for the broader foodservice community.

events.name: New York Travel & Adventure Show 2027
events.description:
Your next unforgettable journey begins at the Jacob K. Javits Convention Center from January 23-24, 2027. This gathering features over 550 destinations, cruise lines, and tour companies, providing thousands of new vacation possibilities and special offers available only at the event. Visitors can meet directly with travel experts to tailor their ideal trips.

Over 60 travel seminars will be presented across four stages, offering insights into the latest tips and trends from industry leaders. Attendees will have opportunities to meet travel personalities, including Emmy Award-winning hosts Samantha Brown and Peter Greenberg, alongside Pauline Frommer and Andrew McCarthy.

Specialized areas, such as the LGBTQ and Dive & Water Sports Pavilions, will be open for exploration. Additionally, performances can be experienced at the Global Beats Stage.

events.name: MEAD 2027
events.description:
Mark your calendars for MEAD 2027, Arizona's premier mathematics education event, returning on January 23, 2027. This hybrid conference is designed to help teachers develop more inclusive classroom environments and refine their teaching methods.

Participants can attend either in person at Tucson High Magnet School and the UArizona Grand Ballroom, or remotely through Zoom. The day's schedule includes three blocks of sessions from 8 AM to 12 PM, concluding with a live-streamed Keynote Luncheon. Intended for thousands of mathematics educators, MEAD 2027 offers a space for professional discussions and connections with peers. A professional development certificate will be provided to all attendees, acknowledging their participation in furthering mathematics education.

events.name: TheFitExpo Los Angeles 2027

location.venue: Los Angeles Convention Center South Hall

events.description:
The West Coast's largest fitness event, TheFitExpo Los Angeles 2027, invites thousands of enthusiasts to the Los Angeles Convention Center on January 23-24.

The event serves as a gathering point for individuals passionate about fitness and personal development. It brings together bodybuilders, powerlifters, jiu-jitsu athletes, functional fitness enthusiasts, and those exploring general wellness.

Those attending can expect a range of activities, including free workouts, competitions with cash prizes, and interactive fitness areas. Exhibitors will showcase new gear, supplements, and wellness products, with some offerings for pets. The expo also provides a chance to meet and learn from fitness influencers, celebrities, and experts through seminars, Q&A sessions, and cooking demonstrations. Additionally, there will be lifestyle fashion displays and discussions on various wellness topics.

events.name: The National Franchise Show New York / New Jersey 2027
events.description:
Aspiring entrepreneurs and future business owners, prepare to explore a world of opportunity at The National Franchise Show New York / New Jersey 2027.

The show takes place on January 23-24, 2027, at the New York / New Jersey Meadowlands Expo Center. It offers a chance to examine various full and part-time business ownership possibilities.

Attendees can speak directly with established franchises that are growing in the area, which can streamline the research process. The event also features complimentary seminars where specialists will share insights on legal considerations, financing options, and how to choose a business that fits individual goals. This is an occasion to uncover successful business models and new ventures spanning diverse industries and investment levels, providing clarity and practical steps for those considering entrepreneurship.

events.name: BCOA Gold Coast Educational Retreat 2027
events.description:
The Broward County Optometric Association invites optometrists and eye care professionals to the Gold Coast Educational Retreat 2027, taking place January 23-24 at the Omni Fort Lauderdale. Over two days, participants can earn 16 hours of continuing education credits. The program addresses key areas such as TQ, Medical Errors, Florida Jurisprudence, HIV & AIDS, and Practice Management.

Speakers, including recognized experts and national leaders in the field, will share their perspectives on current clinical strategies, managing ocular diseases, and surgical co-management. Beyond the educational sessions, the retreat provides a comfortable setting for connecting with peers. There will be opportunities to network and share experiences, complemented by the venue's amenities and provided meals. The environment encourages professional development and fosters connections among colleagues.

events.name: SAAOG Annual Meeting 2027
events.description:
Prepare to elevate your expertise at the SAAOG Annual Meeting 2027, a premier gathering for leaders and professionals in obstetrics, gynecology, and infertility. The meeting will take place from January 23-25, 2027, at the Omni Amelia Island Resort & Spa in Fernandina Beach, FL. This event is designed to unite both established practitioners and those early in their careers.

Participants can expect a program of educational sessions focusing on the latest research, trends, and advancements in women’s health. In addition to these learning opportunities, the meeting provides a setting for colleagues to connect and strengthen professional skills. An exhibit hall will showcase innovations from various women’s health organizations. Social gatherings, such as the Presidential Luncheon and the SAAOG 2027 Gala, are also planned.

events.name: Acumatica Summit 2027
events.description:
Embrace the transformative power of AI at Acumatica Summit 2027, held from January 24–27 at the Seattle Convention Center. The Acumatica Community will gather under the theme "PUTTING AI-POWERED INTELLIGENCE TO WORK" to explore how AI is reshaping business operations.

The program features keynotes, hands-on learning, and interactive sessions, providing an early look at emerging AI developments and the latest ERP features. Participants will have opportunities to connect with experts and colleagues, developing practical strategies for creating more adaptable and connected businesses.

The event aims to equip participants with insights to implement AI effectively, enhancing efficiency, driving change, and supporting organizational growth.

events.name: Furniture Show Winter 2027
events.description:
Mark your calendars for the Furniture Show Winter 2027, the UK's largest and most prestigious trade event for furniture design, manufacturing, and retail. From January 24-27, 2027, the NEC Birmingham will host this four-day gathering, returning for its 36th year.

Across four halls, over 500 furniture and interior brands will present more than 50,000 products. This offers a comprehensive view of global furniture design, allowing attendees to discover new products and emerging trends that will influence the year ahead.

The event is designed for over 20,000 buyers, suppliers, and industry professionals. It provides opportunities to connect with key decision-makers, establish new partnerships, and gather insights into the evolving home and interiors market. The show serves as a central point for understanding industry developments and fostering future collaborations.

events.name: TASA Midwinter Conference 2027
events.description:
Texas school leaders are invited to the TASA Midwinter Conference 2027, a pivotal event scheduled for January 24-27 in San Antonio.

The conference, held at the Henry B. Gonzalez Convention Center, offers administrators new ideas and practical approaches to address the challenges in their schools. The program includes more than 200 sessions running simultaneously, each providing different viewpoints and practical strategies.

Beyond the sessions, attendees will find opportunities to connect with colleagues, enjoy student performances, and attend an awards and recognition ceremony. An exhibit hall features over 400 booths, including a specific area for school architecture, where various solutions and resources for schools are presented. The conference provides a setting for professional development and collaboration among Texas educators.

events.name: RSPA Inspire 2027

location.venue: The Royal Sonesta San Juan Puerto Rico Resort

events.description:
Elevate your strategic vision at RSPA Inspire 2027, the Retail IT Channel’s premier leadership conference. This annual gathering brings together C-level, VP-level, and future leaders from VAR, software developer, hardware vendor, and IT distributor organizations. It offers education specifically tailored for executives.

Each morning features presentations, interactive workshops, and panel discussions that explore key areas such as business management, emerging technologies, and leadership strategies. Afternoons and evenings are dedicated to building connections, with opportunities for excursions away from the main venue and social gatherings on-site.

The event provides a setting to foster meaningful relationships and acquire practical knowledge, helping participants navigate the evolving retail, restaurant, grocery, and cannabis sectors. It's a place for leaders to connect, share insights, and develop their capabilities.

events.name: ABA Insurance Risk Management Forum 2027
events.description:
The American Bankers Association presents its Insurance Risk Management Forum 2027, a vital gathering for bank professionals navigating complex financial landscapes. This event brings together insurance risk managers and banking executives to address emerging risks, enhance their bank's protection, and refine its insurance coverage.

Participants will hear from industry experts, learning practical approaches to major risk challenges and evolving liability concerns. There will be opportunities to discuss real-world issues with peers and consider new ways to approach complex problems.

Dedicated sessions are also planned for attendees to connect directly with corporate insurance providers and brokers. These interactions can help banks explore specific coverage options and build stronger relationships that contribute to their overall resilience.

events.name: Las Vegas Market ANDMORE Winter 2027
events.description:
The ultimate sourcing experience for home furnishings, gift, and design professionals awaits at the Las Vegas Market ANDMORE Winter 2027. From January 24-28, 2027, the World Market Center Las Vegas will be home to the West Coast's largest showcase, bringing together over 3,500 brands and products in both permanent showrooms and temporary exhibits.

Buyers, retailers, and designers can explore a diverse global selection of furniture, home décor, gifts, fabrics, lighting, and kitchen & bath products. Over these five days, attendees will have the opportunity to explore the latest industry trends, find new products, and connect with leaders in the trade.

The ANDMORE Markets App is available to help navigate the event. Amenities are also provided to enhance the experience during a visit.

events.name: Corporate Learning & Development Forum Winter 2027
events.description:
Senior leaders in corporate learning and development are invited to a premier, multi-day experience at The Biltmore Miami in Coral Gables, FL, from January 24–26, 2027. Organized by Consero, this forum focuses on exploring the current landscape and future directions in L&D, with an emphasis on effective leadership and nurturing talent.

The program includes panel discussions, breakout sessions, and strategic business meetings. Attendees will also find opportunities for informal interaction during General Sessions, KnowledgeBridge Discussions, and cocktail receptions, fostering connections with peers.

This event offers a space for leaders to collaborate, share perspectives, and collectively consider how to shape the future of corporate learning.

events.name: CAPPO Conference 2027

The program features a range of workshops, breakout sessions, and keynote presentations, including an opening address by AmyK. Participants will have the chance to examine new solutions at the Supplier Expo and within dedicated demo rooms. The schedule also incorporates networking dinners and interactive roundtables, all designed to help individuals enhance their expertise and broaden their professional relationships within the public sector.

events.name: ACM International Conference on Tangible, Embedded and Embodied Interaction 2027
S&P Global Aluminum Symposium 2027

events.description:
The S&P Global Aluminum Symposium 2027, scheduled for January 24-26 at the Marriott Harbor Beach Resort and Spa in Fort Lauderdale, USA, offers a crucial platform for understanding the global aluminum market's transformative phase. The symposium brings together over 400 senior decision-makers, producers, recyclers, traders, and end-users from North America and global markets.

Discussions will cover key topics such as the emerging structural supply gap, the economics of primary and secondary metal, energy pressures, and evolving policy developments. The program aims to help participants develop strategies for addressing tightening scrap feedstock, accelerating demand for secondary metal, and rising power costs.

An optional pre-symposium training session on Aluminum Markets Fundamentals offers an in-depth look at global pricing and trading. A dedicated networking app will be available, allowing participants to connect with peers and discuss the challenges and opportunities in this new era for aluminum.

events.name: HFMA Western Region Symposium 2027
events.description:
Prepare to navigate the evolving landscape of healthcare finance at the HFMA Western Region Symposium 2027, taking place from January 24-27 at the Paris Las Vegas Hotel & Casino. The symposium, themed "Navigating the New Reality 2027," will gather healthcare leaders and aspiring professionals to explore current challenges and opportunities in the field.

Attendees will find opportunities to connect with peers and gain insights from timely, thought-provoking educational sessions. These sessions will include panels, lectures, and keynote speakers, designed to provide practical knowledge.

A substantial exhibition area will also be available, featuring innovative solutions and industry partners, with a focus on advancements like AI in healthcare finance. For individuals from hospitals, health plans, or physician practices, the symposium supports continued professional learning and development.

events.name: WHX Dubai 2027
events.description:
The global healthcare landscape converges at the Dubai Exhibition Centre for WHX Dubai 2027, running from January 25-28. This four-day event, drawing on a long history of industry leadership, brings together decision-makers, innovators, and investors from across the healthcare sector. Participants will explore the latest advancements, with discussions centered on themes such as AI, Digital Health, and Clinical Excellence.

The exhibition floor will showcase new innovations. Attendees can engage with a range of conferences and take part in specialized stages, bootcamps, and masterclasses. Programs like the Xcelerate competition and the Connections Programme are in place to help facilitate new partnerships and support business development.

The event provides an opportunity to evaluate potential suppliers, strengthen existing relationships, and identify new commercial avenues. It aims to contribute to the ongoing evolution of healthcare.

events.name: AHR Expo 2027
events.description:

They will come to see the latest advancements and discuss the trends shaping the future.

Attendees will have the chance to engage directly with new technologies and observe the prestigious Innovation Awards. The event also includes a variety of educational programs, designed to help individuals enhance their expertise.

This is a significant occasion for people to connect, share insights, and discover solutions that improve efficiency, sustainability, and performance throughout the HVACR landscape. It offers an environment where thousands of leaders and innovators can learn from each other and contribute to the ongoing development of environmental comfort and energy solutions.

events.name: Cybertech Global Tel Aviv 2027
events.description:
The global cybersecurity landscape converges in Tel Aviv for Cybertech Global 2027, a premier international event taking place from January 25-27 at the Tel Aviv Expo. Over three days, this conference and exhibition will serve as a central meeting point for government officials, industry leaders, academics, and innovative startups from around the world. Participants will explore current cyber defense strategies, discuss emerging technologies, and examine future trends that are shaping our digital world.

The program features presentations from leading experts, an exhibition displaying new solutions, and various special events. It provides a setting for individuals to connect with others in the global cyber community, discuss potential collaborations, and gather information. This environment allows attendees to gain a clearer understanding of the evolving challenges and opportunities within cybersecurity.

events.name: ALIS 2027
events.description:
The global hotel investment landscape converges at ALIS 2027, returning to the JW Marriott/Ritz-Carlton Los Angeles L.A. LIVE from January 25-27, 2027. This three-day event serves as a central meeting point for approximately 3,000 investors, lenders, developers, and owners from across the hotel industry. It is recognized as a significant forum for those involved in hotel investment.

Attendees typically engage in high-level discussions, explore potential deals, and contribute to conversations that influence market trends. With C-suite executives and representatives from over a third of hotel companies present, the gathering often shapes the direction of the industry.

The ALIS Awards also take place during the event, recognizing notable achievements and individuals who are driving innovation and excellence within the sector.

events.name: AME Roundup 2027
events.description:
The premier gathering for the global mineral exploration and development community, AME Roundup 2027, returns to Vancouver in late January. Under the theme "Minerals for a Changing World," this event, designed by explorers for explorers, brings together delegates, exhibitors, government, and Indigenous leaders. It serves as a key forum for advancing responsible mineral discovery and sustainable resource development.

Attendees can expect four days of technical sessions led by industry leaders and innovators. Features such as the Core Shack, Project Generators Hub, and dedicated student activities ensure a comprehensive experience for all participants.

events.name: Business Transformation World Summit 2027
events.description:
Prepare to redefine the future of enterprise at the Business Transformation World Summit 2027, held from January 25-27 at the Hilton Orlando Lake Buena Vista.

This summit centers on "Activating Human-Centric Transformation for an Agentic Age," a theme relevant to leaders in transformation and AI. Participants will explore how AI can serve as a partner for innovation and growth, alongside crucial human-centric strategies.

The event includes five co-located summits, offering over 90 interactive workshops and more than 10 practical case studies on AI implementation. It brings together leaders in transformation, process, and AI, providing opportunities to gain insights into operational excellence, change management, and developing robust digital foundations for the future. Discussions will cover strategies and tools for navigating the evolving landscape of business transformation.

events.name: The Financial Club Retreat 2027
events.description:
On January 25, 2027, San Francisco will host The Financial Club Retreat 2027, an exclusive, intimate gathering for 175 senior leaders. Its core aim is to cultivate meaningful relationships and foster strong connections among founders, investors, policy leaders, and financial institution executives.

Attendees, representing a balanced mix of those shaping, funding, and regulating the future of finance, will engage in senior-led briefings, Chatham House Rule roundtables, and an 'Industry Hot Seat' panel. The agenda also includes dedicated one-on-one meetings and opportunities for informal discussions. This retreat offers a private environment for conversations about critical trends such as AI, digital assets, and evolving regulatory landscapes, all of which are influencing the future of financial services.

events.name: Customer Contact Week Winter 2027
events.description:
From January 25-27, 2027, immerse yourself in the forefront of customer experience innovation at Customer Contact Week Winter 2027 (CCW Orlando) in sunny Orlando, Florida. This gathering brings together individuals from global brands, customer contact leadership, and executives across various sectors, including Financial Services, Healthcare, and Technology.

Attendees will have the chance to see new technologies in the CCW Expo Hall and hear from over 50 experts. The program is designed to offer practical strategies for the future of contact centers. Discussions will cover important areas such as integrating generative AI, managing omnichannel engagement, using automation for efficiency, and rethinking customer satisfaction.

The goal is to provide ideas that can help streamline operations, manage costs, and build a culture focused on customer success. It's an opportunity to connect with peers and learn new approaches that can benefit teams and improve outcomes.

events.name: INTIX Annual Conference & Exhibition 2027
events.description:
The global ticketing industry's premier annual event, the INTIX Annual Conference & Exhibition 2027, promises to be an essential gathering for professionals shaping the future of live experiences. This event brings together leaders and innovators from sports, arts, and entertainment. It's a place where they can discuss current trends, address emerging challenges, and explore potential solutions for the industry.

Attendees will find sessions dedicated to topics ranging from advanced analytics and fan engagement strategies to secure digital ticketing and sustainable practices. Alongside these discussions, an exhibition area will feature new technologies and services that are influencing how operations are managed and how customers experience events.

The conference provides an environment for professionals to exchange knowledge, establish new connections, and contribute to the ongoing development of the ticketing sector. It offers a chance to understand different perspectives and collectively consider the path ahead for the industry.

events.name: Pipeline Pigging & Integrity Management Conference 2027
events.description:

Over four days, more than 4000 professionals, including engineering management and field operating personnel, will gather. The discussions will center on current practices and developments in onshore and subsea pipeline inspection, assessment, and repair.

The program will cover innovations such as AI and machine learning applications in integrity management, alongside advanced robotic and drone-based inspection technologies. Essential subjects like regulatory compliance, risk management, NDE, and the evolving challenges of hydrogen and CO2 pipelines are also on the agenda. Experts from around the world will share insights and contribute to the ongoing evolution of pipeline integrity.

events.name: Radical Health Festival Helsinki 2027
events.description:
Radical Health Festival Helsinki 2027 will convene from January 25-27 in Helsinki, Finland. It's more than a typical conference; it stands as Europe's foremost festival for health and care, driving a shift in traditional methods and re-evaluating prevention strategies.

A central theme will be "Operationalising Precision Health." Discussions will delve into public-private collaborations, the crucial role of data, and new payment models needed to expand precision health systems. This gathering provides a setting where ambitious ideas can develop into practical solutions, encouraging new partnerships and contributing to broader system changes.

Professionals, innovators, and policymakers committed to shaping the future of health will gather here.

events.name: ITC London 2027
events.description:
The Brewery in London will host an exclusive, invitation-only gathering of senior insurance and insurtech leaders at ITC London 2027, from January 25-26. events.name: Independent Mortgage Bankers Conference 2027

Discussions will center on strengthening financial performance, examining the latest developments in mortgage technology, compliance, and operational efficiency. The insights and collaborative exchanges are essential for navigating the evolving independent mortgage landscape.

events.name: NDC London 2027

events.name: Real Estate Future Forum 2027

events.name: AED Summit 2027
events.description:

events.name: Uncorrelated Miami 2027

events.name: Developer Week Hackathon 2027
events.description:

events.name: SMC3 Jump Start 2027
events.description:

The event typically draws over 6,500 professionals and features more than 430 exhibitors. Over two days, participants engage in content sessions and connect with international colleagues, contributing to ongoing discussions about the future of pharmaceutical practices.

events.name: Festival of Genomics & Biodata London 2027
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the forefront of life sciences at the Festival of Genomics & Biodata London 2027, taking place on January 27-28 at ExCeL, London. As the UK’s largest life sciences gathering, this two-day event extends beyond traditional genomics, exploring the broad areas of biodata, AI, precision medicine, and advanced therapies.

The event is designed for scientists, clinicians, business leaders, and policymakers. Attendees can expect perspectives from over 150 speakers across 16 theatres, alongside insights from more than 180 exhibitors showcasing new developments. There will also be opportunities to participate in workshops and connect with peers during dedicated networking sessions.

Reflecting its commitment to 'Patient Impact Before Profit,' 90% of those attending receive free access. This approach aims to create an inclusive environment that supports collaboration and helps advance scientific research and development.

events.name: Creator Economy Live West 2027
events.description:
Shape the future of brand-creator collaboration at Creator Economy Live West 2027, taking place January 27-28 at Caesars Forum in Las Vegas. This gathering is recognized as the original summit focused on influencer marketing, designed for brands, creators, and agencies interested in mastering authentic storytelling and achieving measurable results. More than 500 brands are expected to attend, with the first 500 sign-ups receiving free admission.

Attendees will hear from over 50 industry leaders, with discussions spanning six distinct topic tracks such as Community Building, Measurement & ROI, and Future Tools & Trends. The agenda includes insights on leveraging AI and automation for influencer discovery and campaign optimization, alongside methods for fostering genuine audience trust. This two-day event provides an environment for establishing valuable partnerships and enhancing content strategies.

events.name: Logistics & Automation 2027
events.description:
Set to redefine the future of supply chain management, Logistics & Automation 2027 will convene at Messe Zürich on January 27-28. This event serves as Switzerland's primary gathering for logistics professionals, drawing over 4500 decision-makers from across the industry. Those who attend can explore the latest products, current trends, and advanced technologies shaping intralogistics.

The focus includes developments in automation, intelligent systems such as AI, machine learning, and blockchain, as well as solutions offered by prominent system integrators. A program of lectures featuring respected experts will provide valuable perspectives.

Held alongside EMPACK, this arrangement fosters connections across related industries and offers opportunities to meet peers, contributing to a broader understanding of the market.

events.name: sTARTUp Day 2027
events.description:
Ignite your entrepreneurial spirit at sTARTUp Day 2027, set to transform Tartu, Estonia, from January 27-29.

This event, centered around the theme "FROM ZERO TO HERO," focuses on deep technology and early-stage startups, bringing together a global community. Over three days, more than 3000 individuals are expected, including over 350 startups and 200 investors. Attendees will have the chance to see new innovations in the Demo Area and engage with various discussions across three stages.

The program includes a dedicated Investor Day, an Executive Breakfast, and the sTARTUp Night afterparty. To facilitate connections, a matchmaking app will be available, enabling 20-minute meetings between founders, potential investors, and partners. Whether someone is just starting out as an entrepreneur, an experienced investor, or a researcher, sTARTUp Day 2027 offers opportunities to learn, build connections, and advance their projects.

events.name: Scottish Renewables Offshore Wind Conference 2027
events.description:
The Scottish Renewables Offshore Wind Conference 2027, set to convene in Glasgow on 27-28 January, will be a crucial gathering for the offshore wind sector. This event brings together leaders, innovators, and policymakers to discuss the latest advancements, strategic challenges, and emerging opportunities within the Scottish and global offshore wind landscape.

Those attending can expect to gain important insights into new technologies, evolving policy frameworks, and key investment trends that are driving the energy transition. The conference provides a significant opportunity for networking, building important collaborations, and helping to shape the future direction of offshore wind development.

There are opportunities for speaking, exhibiting, and sponsorship, allowing organizations to share their work and contribute to this important discussion. This is a chance to connect with key decision-makers and contribute to shaping a sustainable energy future.

events.name: APEX Defense 2027
events.description:
The future of defense innovation and operational readiness will converge in Washington D.C. at APEX Defense 2027, taking place January 27-28, 2027, at the Walter E. Washington Convention Center. This event, organized by Clarion Defense in collaboration with the Hudson Institute, aims to accelerate the development and delivery of impactful solutions for U.S. warfighters and allied forces.

Discussions will span from the seabed to space, addressing pressing operational challenges through practical dialogue. The program is designed around the needs of warfighters, focusing on immediate solutions for areas such as advancing autonomous systems, countering rapidly evolving threats, and operating effectively in contested environments. The gathering will bring together warfighters, acquisition professionals, startups, investors, and industry leaders.

This setting provides an opportunity for innovators to connect with the broader defense community. The goal is to foster collaboration that strengthens capabilities in autonomous warfare and enhances the protection of critical infrastructure. The event will showcase technologies and ideas poised for deployment.

events.name: Doctors' Days 2027
events.description:
Scheduled for January 27-28, 2027, at Helsingin Messukeskus, Doctors' Days 2027 is Finland's foremost continuing medical education and professional healthcare event.

This two-day event, organized by the Finnish Medical Association and Messukeskus, brings together doctors, 5th and 6th-year medical students, and invited guests. Participants will explore the latest medical advancements through a series of training sessions and an extensive exhibition.

The gathering supports professional development, facilitates networking, and offers insights into key innovations in medicine. Building on the success of previous years, which consistently drew over 3500 medical professionals, Doctors' Days is designed for those seeking to enhance their medical knowledge and connect with colleagues and leaders in the field.

events.name: NJASA TECHSPO 2027
events.description:
Prepare to shape the future of education at NJASA TECHSPO 2027, scheduled for January 27-29 at Harrah's Atlantic City. This gathering brings together New Jersey's school administrators and educators to explore technology solutions that can truly make a difference in learning environments. While the detailed agenda will be finalized following a "Call for Proposals" in August 2026, attendees can anticipate exploring new tools, effective strategies, and upcoming trends in educational technology.

TECHSPO 2027 provides a chance to connect with colleagues, learn from experts, and gather practical ideas to help advance technology in their districts. The focus will be on exploring new strategies and considering how technology can best serve the students of tomorrow.

events.name: e-Health+MVTe 2027
events.description:
Scandinavia's leading decision-makers in health and social welfare are invited to e-Health+MVTe 2027, taking place in Stockholm on January 27-28.

This gathering addresses the digital evolution of healthcare, covering everything from administrative processes to advanced clinical treatments. The goal is to improve patient outcomes, elevate service quality, and manage costs more effectively.

Attendees, numbering over 4600 visitors and 2600 delegates, will have the opportunity to engage with more than 250 exhibitors. These exhibitors will present the latest in e-Healthcare and e-Welfare solutions, with a particular emphasis on advancements in Artificial Intelligence. The program includes insightful keynotes, interactive open stages, and structured networking sessions, such as the Speed Meeting Program. Participants can learn about Sweden's pioneering efforts in e-Health and gather valuable perspectives for understanding the SEK 430 billion Swedish healthcare market. A single ticket provides entry to three concurrent events.

events.name: QUAL360 EU 2027
events.description:
"Qual Reimagined: Connecting Humans & Innovation" defines QUAL360 EU 2027, the leading qualitative market research conference.

This gathering will be held on January 27 and 28, 2027, in Berlin, Germany, at the Leonardo Royal Berlin Alexanderplatz. It brings together professionals from the global qualitative research community.

The program explores the future of research, examining how digital tools and artificial intelligence can be integrated into methodologies without losing sight of the essential human perspective. Conversations will address using new insights for strategic decisions, the impact of AI on new product development, and how brand perception is evolving in the digital age.

An independent advisory board has shaped an agenda that includes keynotes, panel discussions, and interactive sessions. These formats are designed to facilitate shared learning and professional exchange, allowing participants to engage with senior decision-makers and strategic partners in the field.

events.name: Digital Pharma Advances Conference 2027
events.description:
Redefine your pharmaceutical marketing approach at the Digital Pharma Advances Conference 2027, hosted by Global Insight Conferences in London. The event begins on January 26th with a Half-Day AI Workshop, designed to explore practical, compliant strategies for integrating AI into pharmaceutical operations. The following day, January 27th, the main conference will focus on developing AI-driven, customer-focused, and healthcare professional (HCP) engagement strategies across various channels.

Professionals in digital pharma marketing will find discussions centered on effectively integrating AI, developing meaningful customer journeys, and streamlining engagement with healthcare professionals. A key emphasis throughout the conference is maintaining regulatory compliance in all these areas.

The conference also provides opportunities for peer-to-peer networking, including a reception after the workshop. Attendees can connect directly with senior professionals from leading European pharmaceutical companies, fostering valuable discussions and connections.

events.name: SmartCom 2027
events.description:
The 11th International Conference on Smart Trends in Computing and Communications, SmartCom 2027, offers a premier hybrid experience for global researchers, academicians, industry professionals, and students. From January 27-30, 2027, participants will explore current ideas and expertise within Information and Communication Technologies (ICT).

The conference begins with an in-person gathering in Udaipur, India, on January 27. It then transitions to an online format from January 28-30. Those attending will examine the latest developments and future directions in Information, Computer Communications, and how these are applied in engineering and managerial settings.

This event provides a forum for discussing smart trends and technological progress. Accepted papers will be published by Springer and indexed in Scopus, SpringerLink, and other prominent databases.

events.name: Payments Leaders' Summit BFSI 2027
events.description:
Driving the future of financial transactions, the Payments Leaders' Summit BFSI 2027 offers an exclusive, invite-only gathering. Beginning on January 27, 2027, in London, this two-day program brings together over 100 UK-based executives from leading Banks, Fintechs, Financial Services, and Crypto sectors. It is tailored for decision-makers such as CFOs, SVPs of Payments, and Heads of Financial Risk, providing a space for open discussions to refine payments strategy.

The program includes expert keynotes, peer-to-peer roundtables, and pre-selected one-on-one meetings. Participants will explore critical themes like Open Finance, the Future of Money, and Payment Risk & Compliance.

The summit emphasizes in-person connection, allowing attendees to build lasting professional relationships and access a broader network of senior leaders. This environment supports collaborative efforts that contribute to advancements across the industry.

events.name: SocialNext Ottawa 2027
events.description:
Canada's premier Non-Profit Marketing Conference, SocialNext Ottawa 2027, convenes on January 27-28, 2027, at the Ottawa Conference and Event Centre. This gathering is designed for marketing and communications professionals working within non-profit and public organizations. Attendees will have the opportunity to learn new strategies and refine existing skills through a program featuring over 15 distinct sessions.

The program explores key areas such as AI in fundraising, digital strategy, content marketing, social media trends, and data analytics. Additionally, optional full-day workshops are available, offering focused learning on topics like Meta Media Buying, engaging audiences sustainably, and developing effective advocacy campaigns. The conference aims to foster an environment where digital marketers, brand strategists, and leaders can exchange ideas and find new ways to create impact for their mission-driven organizations.

events.name: Customer Success Summit Washington 2027
events.description:
Set to unfold on January 27, 2027, in Washington, D.C., the Customer Success Summit Washington 2027 offers a focused opportunity to redefine customer value and accelerate growth. This event will bring together more than 100 senior decision-makers and customer success professionals, representing over 75 companies. Insights will be shared by over 20 industry leaders.

Discussions will explore key areas such as managing revenue outcomes, including net revenue retention and expansion. Participants will also examine how to use advanced AI for scaling operations and predictive analytics, alongside demonstrating the strategic value of customer success in commercial contexts. The agenda includes innovative approaches to reducing customer churn, streamlining complex onboarding processes, and building effective cross-functional collaboration.

Attendees can expect to acquire practical frameworks, key metrics, and effective influence strategies. There will also be opportunities to connect with a community of professionals focused on advancing their careers and contributing to the evolution of Customer Success.

events.name: FPMA SAM Conference 2027
events.description:

Organized by the Florida Podiatric Medical Association, this conference brings together DPMs, residents, students, and new practitioners for a thorough program.

Participants will explore the latest scientific advancements, learn about clinical best practices, and discuss essential strategies for managing a practice. The program covers innovations in foot and ankle health, encourages vital discussions, and provides opportunities to expand professional connections. It offers educational opportunities and resources aimed at improving patient care and practice efficiency.

This five-day gathering fosters learning, collaboration, and professional growth.

events.name: Education Korea 2027
events.description:
Prepare for the future of learning at Education Korea 2027, Asia's premier specialized fair for Education and EdTech. This event, held from January 27th to 29th, 2027, at COEX in Seoul, will explore the ongoing evolution of education in the 4th Industrial Revolution era.

The fair offers a look at new approaches, smart school innovations, and ways to create safe learning environments. These topics are covered across dedicated areas such as EdTech Korea, Early Education, and Next Education, which includes lifelong and vocational learning. Attendees can participate in international conferences at EDUCON, see new solutions at the ORANGE LABEL showcase, and use the EDU-AGORA biz-matching service to connect with others in the field.

Specialized seminars are planned for innovators, teachers, parents, students, and other professionals. This gathering brings together individuals who are actively shaping the next generation of education.

events.name: CHIME Innovation Summit 2027

The program includes confirmed speakers such as Dr. K. Nadeem Ahmed, Chris Akeroyd, and Scott Arnold. Their perspectives, alongside discussions with peers, offer an opportunity to consider the direction of healthcare technology.

events.name: AKJ e-Crime & Cybersecurity Nordics Finland 2027

Participants will explore practical applications of NIS2, advanced ransomware defense, and continuous attack surface discovery. The agenda also addresses the complexities of AI and quantum-readiness, covering topics such as securing non-human actors, mitigating data leakage, and navigating CISO liability within a constantly evolving regulatory landscape. Through real-life case studies and in-depth technical sessions, the discussions aim to provide valuable insights for cybersecurity and IT leaders focused on strengthening their organizations' defenses.

events.name: InsurTech Slopes 2027
events.description:
Elevate your network and insights at InsurTech Slopes 2027, an exclusive, intimate gathering set against the stunning backdrop of Breckenridge, Colorado. This two-day event is structured to encourage genuine dialogue and foster lasting relationships.

Day one includes workshops, presentations, and fireside chats, concluding with a private group dinner. Day two provides opportunities for networking on the ski slopes, allowing connections to form through shared experiences.

The aim is to facilitate discussions that can drive innovation and influence the future of insurance technology within a collaborative setting.

events.name: Data & Analytics Live 2027
events.description:

Professionals, including Chief Data Officers, Chief AI Officers, and other senior practitioners, will discuss important topics such as AI strategy and adoption, robust data governance, and how to translate insights into tangible business impact. Participants can connect with expert speakers and their peers during interactive sessions, fostering learning across industries and collaborative problem-solving. The event offers a look at the evolving landscape of data and AI leadership, providing real-world perspectives on scaling initiatives and driving organizational transformation.

events.name: Fund Finance and Secondaries Investing 2027
events.description:

The agenda will address the forces currently reshaping the market. Discussions will cover evolving GP financing strategies, the rise of non-bank capital, secondaries, continuation vehicles, and new regulatory frameworks. Other areas of focus include middle-market creativity, the evolution of subscription lines, and the accelerating influence of AI. The gathering anticipates over 430 attendees, including more than 200 borrowers, issuers, and investors, alongside 40+ expert speakers, creating an environment for meaningful exchanges.

For GPs, LPs, and Borrowers, specific networking opportunities are available through the Private Credit Club. This includes invitation-only events and a dedicated lounge, providing additional avenues for focused interaction.

events.name: International Jewellery Tokyo Winter 2027
events.description:
International Jewellery Tokyo Winter 2027 invites you to explore the forefront of global jewellery design and innovation from January 27 to 29 at Makuhari Messe, Japan. Leading wholesalers and manufacturers will be exhibiting, showcasing a wide array of products, from high-end luxury items to contemporary designs that reflect current trends. The event offers a chance to build new business relationships, gain international exposure for brands, and conduct sales directly.

The scientific program includes in-depth lectures, live procedure demonstrations, and interactive workshops. The focus is on validated science and evidence-backed techniques, highlighting transformative technologies such as regenerative therapies, advanced energy-based devices, and AI-enhanced treatment planning.

Attendees can expand their knowledge, refine their skills, and connect with internationally recognized experts. This helps them stay current in a rapidly evolving discipline.

events.name: Yankee Dental Congress 2027
events.description:
The future of oral health takes center stage at Yankee Dental Congress 2027, running from January 28–30. With "Connecting for Oral Health" as its theme, the congress offers dental professionals three days focused on learning and collaboration.

Professionals attending will hear from industry experts in continuing education sessions, designed to help practices stay current. The Exhibit Show Floor will feature new products and technologies that are influencing modern dental practice. Beyond the educational sessions, there will be opportunities to connect with colleagues during receptions and networking events, allowing for discussions about the direction of the dental industry.

events.name: World Money Fair 2027
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the fascinating world of numismatics at the World Money Fair 2027, taking place from January 28th to 30th in Berlin, Germany. Recognized as the world's largest numismatics fair, this three-day gathering brings together collectors, traders, and industry professionals.

Attendees can expect to see the latest in coin innovations and minting technologies. Experts from organizations such as Tower Mint London will be present, alongside this year's Guest of Honor, CIT from Liechtenstein, offering their perspectives. The interactive Minting Experience Center provides a hands-on opportunity, and complimentary expert coin appraisals will also be available.

Whether one is a long-time collector or just beginning to explore the world of coinage, the fair offers a chance to learn, connect with others, and consider potential investments. The World Money Fair 2027 provides a comprehensive look into the art and science of coinage.

events.name: Government Innovation California 2027
events.description:
Government Innovation California 2027, convening on January 28 in Sacramento, will be the pivotal event for state and local leaders driving the shift to Government 3.0. This gathering brings together IT professionals, digital service innovators, and public sector strategists to discuss how to build services that are smarter, anticipate needs, and truly focus on the public.

Participants will examine key developments in using data and artificial intelligence, strengthening cybersecurity, and making digital services easy to use. Speakers will share practical ideas, and interactive sessions will encourage different agencies to work together. The discussions aim to help improve California's digital security, ensure everyone has access to digital services, and influence how public services evolve.

Government employees can attend without cost, providing an opportunity to connect with colleagues and private sector representatives.

events.name: Destinations The Holiday & Travel Show London 2027
events.description:

events.name: D2DCON 2027
events.description:
D2DCON 2027, the premier event for door-to-door sales professionals, is poised to redefine success in the industry from January 28-30 in Utah. This three-day conference brings together over 2,800 sales representatives, managers, and business owners across sectors like solar, roofing, pest control, home security, and telecommunications. The event concludes with the Golden Door Awards, recognizing excellence in the field, and provides ample opportunities to connect with peers and build professional relationships. The content is designed to help individuals enhance their skills and improve their performance within the industry.

events.name: FutureCon Cybersecurity Conference Los Angeles 2027
events.description:
Prepare to fortify your defenses and navigate the dynamic world of digital threats at the FutureCon Cybersecurity Conference Los Angeles 2027. Attendees can participate in person at the Hilton Los Angeles Culver City, or engage with the virtual program which begins on March 30.

The program will cover current security approaches and risk management strategies, addressing the evolving digital landscape. It offers opportunities to interact with experts, examine new solutions, and acquire practical knowledge to help safeguard organizations.

FutureCon Los Angeles 2027 serves as a setting for learning, networking, and keeping pace with developments in the field of cybersecurity.

events.name: OMEA Professional Development Conference 2027
events.description:

Recognized as the third largest music conference in the United States, this event provides substantial opportunities for professional development. Participants will find nearly 300 sessions, led by nationally recognized master teachers, delving into research-based best practices in music education. Attendees can also earn continuing education units.

The conference also features over 30 performing ensembles, showcasing the talent of Ohio's students. Additionally, the event hosts the largest music trade show east of the Mississippi, where nearly 250 exhibitors present new industry developments and products.

This gathering offers a valuable setting for improving teaching practices and connecting with a broad community of colleagues.

events.name: Product Marketing Summit Washington, D.C. 2027
events.description:
The future of product marketing takes center stage on January 28, 2027, at Convene Hamilton Square in Washington, D.C. This single-day summit will bring together over 100 senior product marketing decision-makers from more than 75 influential companies, including Amazon, Netflix, and Google.

The day's discussions will cover go-to-market strategies, data-driven storytelling, and adapting product marketing approaches for an AI-driven world.

Attendees will have the opportunity to connect with industry leaders such as Marisa Banigan (Apptio) and Zach Messler, sharing insights on go-to-market execution and product adoption. The event also offers a chance to build connections within the product marketing community and identify new ways to demonstrate the strategic value of product marketing in a changing environment.

events.name: CE's on the Seas 2027
events.description:
Combine essential professional growth with a tropical escape at CE's on the Seas 2027, presented by the Professional Opticians of Florida (POF). This experience takes place aboard the Carnival Paradise, departing from Port Tampa, FL, and sailing to Cozumel, Mexico.

Attendees will hear from leading national speakers during sessions designed to meet license renewal requirements. These learning opportunities are balanced with the amenities of the cruise and a full day dedicated to exploring Cozumel. Through POF's partnerships, members of participating state associations can enroll in approved courses, with a portion of their fees contributing to their home associations.

Cabins begin at $399 per person, based on double occupancy. This price includes taxes, port fees, meals, and onboard entertainment. To be part of the group block, reservations should be made by September 27, 2026.

events.name: FutureCon Cybersecurity Conference Orlando 2027
events.description:

events.name: COMPOST 2027

events.name: National Small Business Conference 2027

Those attending will find significant opportunities to navigate federal procurement, gain strategic insights, and connect with key decision-makers and industry peers.

It aims to help businesses advance, discover new avenues for success, and contribute to shaping the future of government contracting. events.name: micebook EXPO 2027

events.name: PromoStandards Tech Summit 2027

The agenda focuses on providing education about industry trends and technology, encouraging collaboration for better integration, and working towards more efficient supply chains and transactions throughout the sector. Participants will find opportunities to connect with peers, share knowledge, and discuss advancements that contribute to innovation and operational improvements.

events.name: Private Placements Industry Forum 2027
events.description:

events.name: Deluxe Exchange 2027
events.description:

events.name: Sustainable Aviation Futures MENA Congress 2027
events.description:

events.name: Short Term Rental Forum Winter 2027
events.description:

Those attending will participate in focused sessions, collaborative roundtables, and panels featuring industry experts. The aim is to provide new perspectives and facilitate connections that can help advance short-term rental businesses. This gathering is for individuals in the short-term rental sector who want to understand and influence the industry's direction.

events.name: Health Benefits Conference & Expo 2027
events.description:
Elevate your organization's health and wellness initiatives at the 36th Annual Health Benefits Conference & Expo (HBCE), set for February 2027 in picturesque Ponte Vedra Beach, Florida. Attendees can expect high-quality education from experts, opportunities to build a strong peer network, and an Exhibit Hall where new products and services are presented. events.name: North American Refining Technology Conference 2027
events.description:
The North American Refining Technology Conference 2027, convening in Houston, Texas, from February 1-3, is poised to be the definitive gathering for leaders shaping the future of the refining and petrochemical sectors. Over three days, the conference will bring together industry innovators, refinery operators, technology providers, and policy experts to examine important developments.

Participants will explore strategies for building resilience, navigating the energy transition, and addressing decarbonization challenges. Discussions will also cover digital transformation, asset flexibility, and how to attract skilled talent. The agenda includes keynote addresses, panel discussions, and workshops, providing perspectives on scaling Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF) and working towards Net-Zero initiatives.

Decision-makers can expect to find practical solutions and build important relationships, contributing to the strength of the region's energy infrastructure.

events.name: Pink27 2027
events.description:
The 30th Annual ITSM Conference, Pink27 2027, invites IT professionals, teams, and managers to an extraordinary educational experience. Recognized as a significant gathering for IT Service Management professionals, this year's conference centers on the theme, "ITSM: The Next Generation." Attendees can expect insightful keynotes and practical breakout sessions led by experienced speakers from the industry.

The program delves into current topics such as IT Service Management, AI, Lean IT, Agile Scrum, Business Relationship Management, Organizational Change Management, and Employee Experience. events.name: EBA Annual Conference 2027
events.description:
The Environmental Bankers Association (EBA) invites professionals to its Annual Conference 2027, scheduled for February 1 to 4 at the Hyatt Regency Austin in Austin, TX. This gathering brings together professionals in environmental banking and risk management to explore the evolving landscape of sustainable finance.

Attendees will examine discussions on regulatory shifts, emerging environmental risks, and the innovative solutions shaping the industry. The program includes sessions and panels led by experts, providing opportunities to explore best practices and navigate complex challenges.

The conference offers a chance to connect with peers and thought leaders, fostering collaboration for a resilient financial future. A virtual component will also be available, with dates to be announced.

events.name: OneVoice 2027
events.description:
Prepare to gain unparalleled clarity and strategic direction at OneVoice 2027, the essential annual gathering for independent financial services firm executives. From February 1-3 in Tampa, FL, this event provides a chance to connect with peers and industry experts.

Discussions and workshops will explore the key areas influencing the profession: technology, regulation, growth, and leadership. Participants can expect to gain practical insights to help navigate change, address challenges, and advance their firms. Beyond the formal sessions, there will be time for networking, allowing for the sharing of best practices, building professional relationships, and strengthening the community. The aim is for attendees to leave with the knowledge and connections needed to navigate the evolving financial landscape effectively.

events.name: Liquidity 2027

This gathering explores the connections between digital, tokenized, and traditional assets, aiming to illuminate the future of finance. The event typically draws over 1000 professionals from more than 400 institutions, fostering a day of shared learning and industry collaboration. Participants can expect discussions led by global leaders, offering perspectives on current market developments, technological advancements, and evolving regulatory frameworks.

The agenda includes knowledge sessions, expert panels, and smaller group dialogues, addressing critical areas such as risk management, compliance practices, and global policy shifts. Liquidity 2027 serves as a significant platform for strategic discussions and professional connections within the dynamic financial ecosystem.

events.name: CSMFO Annual Conference 2027
events.description:
The CSMFO Annual Conference 2027 invites public finance professionals from across California to the SAFE Credit Union Convention Center in Sacramento, from February 1-4, 2027.

Attendees can earn continuing professional education credits while building relationships with colleagues and industry experts. This environment encourages collaboration to address the specific challenges faced by California's public sector, helping professionals identify effective strategies and contribute to the financial well-being of their communities.

events.name: TAMEST Annual Conference 2027
events.description:
Prepare to engage with Texas's foremost scientific and technical leaders at the TAMEST Annual Conference 2027. This gathering brings together the state's leading experts in medicine, engineering, and science. Participants will examine new research, discuss developing technologies, and consider solutions for important issues impacting Texas and the wider world.

The conference provides a setting for meaningful conversations, collaboration across different fields, and connecting with colleagues and innovators. Individuals can gain perspectives from experts, establish new connections, and contribute to advancing future innovation and discovery.

This event serves as a key forum where ideas about scientific and technological progress are shared and explored.

events.name: NARTC 2027
events.description:
From February 1 to 3, 2027, Houston, Texas, will host the North American Refining Technology Conference (NARTC 2027), offering a vital platform for industry leaders and innovators. This three-day event will explore key technologies and strategies necessary for strengthening the North American refining and petrochemical sectors.

NARTC 2027 will address significant challenges and opportunities, including the energy transition, evolving regulatory landscapes, decarbonization efforts, and the rapid pace of digital transformation. Participants can expect in-depth discussions, engaging panel sessions, and practical workshops, all designed to facilitate connections among peers. The conference brings together refinery operators, technology providers, and policy experts, providing a space to consider and influence the industry's future direction.

events.name: Clean Fuels Conference 2027
events.description:
Prepare to shape the future of sustainable energy at the Clean Fuels Conference 2027. This event brings together professionals working across the biodiesel, renewable diesel, and sustainable aviation fuel industries. It's an environment where participants can learn about current advancements, form collaborations, and collectively contribute to a more sustainable energy landscape.

events.name: Tribal Energy Evolution Summit 2027

location.venue: Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Hollywood

events.description:
A landmark three-day experience awaits at the Seminole Hard Rock Hotel & Casino Hollywood, Florida, from February 1-3, 2027.

This year, the Tribal Energy Evolution Summit 2027 (TEES 2027) is combining with the Seminole Tribe of Florida’s 9th Annual Renewable Energy & Sustainability Conference. The event's theme is "Powering Sovereignty: Advancing Energy Independence in Indian Country."

Tribal leaders and their partners will meet to discuss practical strategies, funding opportunities, and innovative solutions. The aim is to accelerate the adoption of clean energy systems, renewable energy, and sustainable practices across Native American Tribes and Alaska Native Villages, fostering greater energy independence and sovereignty.

events.name: CURT National Conference 2027

The program offers an educational experience through special presentations, networking receptions, and opportunities to connect with industry leaders. It provides a setting to gain insights and build connections relevant to the evolving construction landscape.

events.name: Alaska Forum 2027
events.description:

The Alaska Connect platform, developed in partnership with Knik Tribe, offers technical training throughout the year.

events.name: Pet Industry Leadership Summit 2027

The Summit aims to provide leaders with forward-thinking strategies and encourage high-level conversations. These discussions are important for understanding and navigating the evolving pet care landscape.

events.name: ASEE Conference for Industry and Education Collaboration 2027

events.name: World Fira 2027
events.description:
Mark your calendar for February 2, 2027, as World Fira 2027 unveils the cutting edge of agricultural robotics. The gathering will feature over 40 robots in dynamic, in-field demonstrations, providing a direct view of how new technologies are applied in farming.

Attendees will have opportunities to engage with global experts during discussions and listen to keynote speakers. There's also a Scientific Workshop for exploring new research.

For startups in agricultural robotics, Invest'Day offers a platform to connect with potential investors through pitch sessions and awards. The event also facilitates dedicated B2B meetings and recognizes achievements with the FIRA Awards, providing a comprehensive look for innovators, investors, researchers, and anyone interested in the future direction of sustainable agriculture.

events.name: Surface Design Show 2027
events.description:
The Surface Design Show 2027, running from February 2-4 at London's Business Design Centre, is the definitive event for exploring the forefront of material innovation. This three-day exhibition offers architects, interior designers, and specifiers a focused environment to discover and assess new internal and external surface materials.

Visitors will encounter a spectrum of solutions, encompassing sustainable options and advanced technologies. The show provides CPD-accredited content and hands-on workshops, offering practical insights and fostering creative thinking. It also serves as a place for industry professionals to connect, observe emerging trends, and discuss the evolution of design and built environments.

events.name: ESG & Decarbonizing Real Estate Winter 2027
events.description:
Real estate leaders seeking to unlock superior returns through sustainable practices will converge in Nashville for ESG & Decarbonizing Real Estate Winter 2027. This event draws over 400 professionals, from C-suite executives and investors to developers and owner/operators, all focused on strategies for future-proofing their assets.

The program features expert-led sessions that delve into practical, profitable, and proven approaches to ESG and decarbonization. These discussions aim to provide actionable insights on current topics and offer real-world solutions to sustainability challenges within the industry.

Opportunities for networking are available, designed to facilitate new partnerships and foster collaborative solutions among participants. The overall objective is to support professionals in evolving their real estate portfolios for a sustainable future.

events.name: The Delivery Conference 2027
events.description:
The Royal Lancaster Hotel, London, will host The Delivery Conference 2027 on February 2 & 3, marking a pivotal moment for the logistics and delivery sector. The conference will focus on "The Intelligent Delivery Shift," exploring how data and technology are driving growth in the sector.

More than 1000 industry leaders and representatives from over 500 brands are anticipated to attend. They will examine the technological advancements that are shaping the future of delivery. The agenda includes over 20 sessions featuring more than 25 speakers, covering strategies for improving operational efficiency, enhancing customer experience, and fostering sustainable growth.

Attendees will have the chance to connect with peers, gain new knowledge, and contribute to innovation within this fast-changing industry.

events.name: Oregon Wine Symposium 2027
events.description:
The premier gathering for the Northwest wine industry, the Oregon Wine Symposium 2027, returns to the Oregon Convention Center in Portland on February 2-3. This two-day event brings together over 1,200 industry professionals—growers, winemakers, and business leaders—to share knowledge and discuss approaches for the future.

Discussions will cover current challenges, how the market is changing, and what consumers are looking for. Participants can connect with experts, see new solutions from various suppliers, and build important relationships. The symposium offers a full schedule of educational sessions and includes Spanish language interpretation.

Discounts are available for groups and students. The aim is to help vineyard and winery businesses prepare for what's ahead.

events.name: GeoBuiz Summit 2027
events.description:
Monterey Bay, California, will host the GeoBuiz Summit 2027 from February 2-3, an essential forum for leaders shaping the global space and geospatial industry. Produced by Geospatial World, this summit brings together more than 250 business leaders, policymakers, investors, and innovators. Discussions will center on the theme 'Business Model Reset: Technology | Policy | Partnerships.'

Participants can expect to delve into strategic, economic, and market trends. The agenda will explore frontier technologies such as AI, Digital Twins, Earth Observation, and Spatial Intelligence.

The summit provides a setting for connecting with influential decision-makers, fostering new business discussions, and strengthening professional networks. The program will examine how technology, policy, and partnerships are reshaping markets and driving sustainable growth within the spatial economy.

events.name: Cyber Risk & Insurance Innovation Europe 2027
events.description:
Europe's leading minds in cyber insurance will converge in London for Cyber Risk & Insurance Innovation Europe 2027. From February 2-3, 2027, the focus will be on shaping the future of the rapidly evolving cyber insurance sector.

Participants will engage in discussions covering forward-looking underwriting strategies and pressing debates around systemic risk, reflecting the market's dynamic challenges and opportunities. The gathering brings together a diverse group including insurers, reinsurers, brokers, MGAs, CISOs, risk leaders, legal professionals, security experts, and technology innovators, encouraging collaboration across the industry.

An awards evening will recognize market excellence. Attendees can also expect insights from a speaker lineup to be announced shortly.

events.name: Midwest Energy Solutions Conference 2027
events.description:
The Midwest Energy Solutions Conference 2027 returns to Chicago, IL, from February 2-4, inviting all energy stakeholders to a pivotal three-day event. This gathering focuses on the essential role of energy efficiency throughout the Midwest, acknowledging significant achievements and outlining future directions for programs and policy.

Participants will explore current trends, engage with leaders in the field, and discover new approaches influencing the future of energy. The conference will also feature the annual Inspiring Efficiency Awards, which honor significant contributions within the energy sector.

Organizations interested in connecting with this audience can explore sponsorship and exhibiting options.

events.name: Workforce Management in Fast Casual and QSR Summit 2027
events.description:
Fast Casual and QSR operators face unique workforce challenges in an evolving landscape. The Workforce Management Summit 2027, held February 2-3 at the Renaissance Dallas in Dallas, TX, brings together owner/operators looking for new ways to address these challenges. Over two days, the summit will focus on key aspects of workforce management, including hiring, training, and keeping employees engaged in the fast-paced restaurant industry.

Participants will explore practical strategies through real-world case studies and engage in roundtable discussions.
