They will learn about effective ways to attract and keep good employees, improve training, and build a team that feels connected and motivated. Scheduled breaks provide time to connect with other operators and industry experts, offering a chance to share insights and experiences. This interaction helps businesses develop stronger, more effective teams.

events.name: Pharma Market Research Conference East 2027
events.description:
Prepare to delve into the future of pharmaceutical market research at the Pharma Market Research Conference East 2027. This event is for professionals interested in understanding and influencing the evolving landscape of the industry. Attendees will gain insights and strategies directly from industry leaders.

The agenda includes various session types: MasterClasses, presentations, panels, and interactive roundtables. Participants can explore how leading biotech and pharma companies are innovating and responding to new challenges. Organized with the expertise of Fierce Life Sciences Events, the conference offers an opportunity to connect with peers, learn from shared experiences, and contribute to the advancement of pharma market research.

events.name: Tourism Investment Forum 2027
events.description:
Unlocking unparalleled opportunities in the global tourism sector, the Tourism Investment Forum 2027 arrives in İstanbul on 2-3 February. This two-day gathering will bring together more than 5,000 tourism professionals and investors from around the world.

Those attending will gain a deeper understanding of emerging market trends, explore investment opportunities, and build partnerships that can support future growth. The forum provides a setting to discover innovative projects, understand how market dynamics are changing, and connect with key decision-makers in the industry.

The event is for individuals interested in the tourism sector's potential and its future direction.

events.name: 10DX Ethiopia 2027
events.description:
Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, will be the focal point for senior banking leadership on March 17, 2027, as 10DX Ethiopia 2027 convenes. This gathering, by invitation only, will bring together more than 75 CEOs, CIOs, Heads of Innovation, and other C-suite leaders representing over 25 financial institutions.

Ethiopia's financial sector is changing quickly, with mobile money becoming increasingly common. In this context, participants will examine key approaches to digital transformation. Conversations will focus on how to build digital trust in a society that primarily uses cash, expand financial services through eKYC and payments that work across different systems, and strengthen cybersecurity measures.

Speakers with deep experience will share practical perspectives on modernizing banking platforms, implementing real-time payment systems, and using advanced technologies such as face recognition. The event provides an opportunity for strategic discussions and connections, aiming to help shape the future of banking in Ethiopia.

events.name: Marketplace Risk Austin Conference 2027
events.description:
Prepare to shape the future of the digital economy at the Marketplace Risk Austin Conference 2027 (#MRATX27), the world's largest gathering dedicated to trust, safety, compliance, and risk management for digital platforms. From February 2-3, 2027, the Dell Jewish Community Center in Austin, TX, will host this conference. It brings together founders, operators, solution providers, fintech innovators, and investors.

The agenda addresses significant challenges and practical solutions within the platform economy. Those attending can expect to gain insights, understand new trends, and build connections that are important for navigating the world of online marketplaces.

This event offers a setting for both experienced professionals and those new to the field to deepen their knowledge and contribute to the development of digital platforms.

events.name: 10DX Summit Tanzania 2027
events.description:
Mark your calendars for the 10DX Summit Tanzania 2027, an exclusive, invitation-only event for senior banking and technology leaders. On February 2, in Dar es Salaam, the summit will provide a focused environment to discuss the swift digital changes impacting Tanzanian banking.

Attendees, including Heads of Innovation, Chief Digital Officers, and CISOs, will explore key subjects. These discussions will cover the influence of mobile money and super apps, strategic approaches to digital lending, the implications of regulatory sandboxes, and advanced cybersecurity measures. The agenda also includes how artificial intelligence can enhance customer engagement, help prevent fraud, and further financial inclusion.

This gathering offers an opportunity for meaningful connections and the exchange of strategic perspectives among peers, contributing to the future direction of finance in the region.

events.name: Distressed Forum for Bank Special Assets East 2027
events.description:
Navigate the evolving landscape of distressed assets at the Distressed Forum for Bank Special Assets East 2027. This gathering explores strategies for uncovering value across Commercial Real Estate (CRE), C&I loans, agricultural lending, and other areas. It brings together over 300 senior decision-makers, creating a space where banks looking to sell can connect with buyers interested in acquiring.

Participants will hear from expert panelists and industry leaders, gaining perspectives on current market trends and economic conditions. The forum is designed to foster connections and facilitate discussions that can lead to new opportunities. Attendees can expect ample time for networking and sharing insights on effective practices within the distressed debt markets.

This event offers a focused environment for East Coast professionals working with distressed assets to connect and explore potential avenues for collaboration and investment.

events.name: Excellence in Data Center Construction, Design, and Engineering Forum 2027
events.description:
The Excellence in Data Center Construction, Design, and Engineering Forum 2027, an exclusive, invitation-only event, convenes senior leaders from February 2-4 in Dallas, Texas. The discussions will center on advancing next-generation hyperscale and AI data center infrastructure.

The program features technical presentations, executive panel discussions, and real-world case studies from leading companies such as AWS, Microsoft, and Google. Key topics include reducing time-to-power, designing AI-ready facilities with high-density power and liquid cooling, and optimizing site selection. The agenda also addresses improving construction productivity through modularization, strengthening supply chain resilience, and fostering collaboration across the development lifecycle. The insights shared are intended to help decision-makers develop strategies for the faster, more resilient, and sustainable deployment of gigawatt-scale AI campuses.

events.name: NCSEA Policy Forum 2027
events.description:
Shaping the future of child support policy takes center stage at the NCSEA Policy Forum 2027. From February 2 to 5, 2027, the J.W. Marriott Washington, D.C. will host professionals dedicated to the child support program. This gathering provides an opportunity to explore the latest developments and initiatives affecting child support at federal, state, and local levels.

The event draws IV-D Directors, researchers, policy experts, and other child support professionals. Participants will hear directly from experts within the Legislative and Executive branches, gaining insights into current information and pressing issues. The forum encourages collaboration on strategies to improve how child support programs operate and what they achieve. It is a key gathering for anyone involved in advancing child support policy and practice.

events.name: Cybersecurity Law and Compliance 2027
events.description:
Navigating the complex and rapidly evolving landscape of cybersecurity law and compliance is paramount for organizations worldwide. On February 2–3, 2027, legal and compliance professionals, alongside senior decision-makers, will gather in Washington, DC, for a two-day program. This event is designed to provide practical guidance for 2027, addressing the latest cyber threats and compliance challenges.

Attendees can expect to learn from real-world cyber attack scenarios and engage directly with regulators and enforcers. The program also offers an opportunity to compare current strategies against industry practices, particularly in light of ongoing geopolitical uncertainties. The aim is for participants to leave with concrete ideas for strengthening their organization's cybersecurity policies, identifying vulnerabilities, and building robust resilience to manage risks and navigate evolving legal requirements.

events.name: Financial Services Risk & Compliance 2027
events.description:
Navigating an era of unprecedented change, the 11th Edition of Financial Services Risk & Compliance 2027 offers a vital one-day deep dive into strategic resilience. This conference and exhibition returns to Central London in April 2027, bringing together risk and compliance professionals to explore current challenges and solutions.

The agenda covers practical approaches to complex regulations, the development of compliant AI strategies, and strengthening defenses against fraud and cyber threats. Discussions will also extend to geopolitical risks, ESG alignment, and building operational resilience, helping organizations respond effectively to new challenges.

Over 26 speakers will share their expertise. More than two hours are dedicated to networking, offering attendees a chance to connect with colleagues and gather insights that can help protect against future risks and build stronger strategies.

events.name: Digital Enterprise CIO Transformation Assembly Winter 2027
events.description:
Elevate your digital strategy and forge critical connections at the Digital Enterprise CIO Transformation Assembly Winter 2027, taking place February 2-3, 2027, at the Thompson, Dallas. This gathering brings together Global Chief Information Officers and other C-Suite leaders from major enterprises, including a significant number from Fortune 100 companies, for strategic, in-person discussions.

The agenda is developed from extensive industry research, ensuring discussions focus on the most relevant digital transformation trends and challenges facing leaders today. Participants will have scheduled one-on-one meetings, designed to facilitate meaningful peer collaboration and the exploration of solutions.

Beyond the assembly itself, there is ongoing support to help translate insights into tangible business outcomes, aiding in post-event growth and success.

events.name: ACI-NA CEO Forum 2027
events.description:
North America's airport leaders will converge at the ACI-NA CEO Forum 2027, set against the scenic backdrop of Amelia Island, FL, from February 2-4. This gathering allows airport CEOs to come together for open, strategic conversations.

For three days, attendees will explore the most pressing challenges in aviation. Discussions will cover a range of topics, from navigating new regulations and adapting to technological shifts to ensuring long-term, sustainable development. The forum's structure encourages leaders to collaborate, share successful strategies, and work together on innovative solutions.

Participants can expect to gain practical understanding, build stronger connections with their peers, and contribute to a shared outlook for the future of airports across North America.

events.name: Structure-Based Drug Design Summit San Diego 2027
events.description:
Set to redefine the future of drug discovery, the Structure-Based Drug Design Summit San Diego 2027 convenes from February 2-4 in San Diego, CA. This three-day event brings together structural biologists, computational chemists, and drug discovery leaders from pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology firms, and academic institutions.

Discussions will center on how integrative structural biology, de novo design, and AI are applied to determine the 3D structures of pharmacologically relevant targets. The agenda will cover innovative strategies for addressing challenging drug targets, overcoming Cryo-EM limitations, and broadening the scope of druggability across diverse therapeutic modalities, including biologics and protein degraders.

The program features over 17 expert speakers, with contributions from leaders at companies such as Pfizer and Eli Lilly. Additionally, more than 8 hours are dedicated to networking, with opportunities for in-depth workshops and interactive roundtables.

events.name: Data Center Design, Engineering & Construction 2027
events.description:
Addressing the critical demands of North America's digital infrastructure, the Data Center Design, Engineering & Construction 2027 summit convenes in Washington, DC, from February 2–3, 2027. This invitation-only gathering brings together senior professionals, from C-level executives to directors, who are actively shaping the direction of hyperscale, colocation, and enterprise data centers.

The agenda, led by practitioners, will explore the complexities of current challenges, including AI-driven rack densities, power procurement backlogs, and sustainable construction practices. Discussions will cover innovative solutions in areas such as liquid cooling, modular design, energy efficiency, and advanced automation. Through open conversations, practical case studies, and interactive sessions, participants will gain insights aimed at preparing their infrastructure for future demands, focusing on scalability, resilience, and environmental responsibility within North America's most concentrated data center market.

events.name: From Day One Dallas 2027
events.description:
Dallas' historic Union Station will host From Day One Dallas 2027 on Tuesday, February 2, 2027, bringing together HR and people leaders to tackle the critical theme of "BUILDING THE ADAPTIVE WORKFORCE: HOW PEOPLE LEADERS CAN PREPARE ORGANIZATIONS FOR WHAT COMES NEXT."

The day, from 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM CT, offers a focused environment for executives navigating the evolving landscape of human resources. Discussions will explore designing for continuous change, the impact of AI on workforce skills, new talent acquisition strategies, and reimagining workplace well-being.

Insights will come from experienced HR executives, including David Dart of Caliber and Stephanie Powers of PepsiCo. The day aims to provide practical approaches for leadership training, optimizing employee benefits, and fostering a culture that truly engages people, helping organizations prepare for future challenges.

events.name: Paris Packaging Week 2027
events.description:
Set to redefine the future of packaging, Paris Packaging Week 2027 will open its doors at Paris Expo Porte de Versailles on February 3-4. This event brings together leading professionals from the beauty, drinks, aerosols, and luxury sectors, featuring more than 915 suppliers filling the exhibition's largest hall.

Those attending will find a range of new developments, from sustainable materials showcased in the Refill & Reuse Zone to advancements in AI and smart packaging within the Discovery Zone. Discussions with global design leaders will take place at the Pentawards Festival, while insights will be shared on the Circular Economy Stage, and emerging talent highlighted through the Future Leaders programme.

The week offers a setting for brands, manufacturers, and designers to connect, exchange ideas, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of packaging innovation.

events.name: TechEx Global 2027
events.description:
Prepare for two days of unparalleled technological insight at TechEx Global 2027, taking place on 3-4 February at Olympia, London.

This annual gathering, centered on "Transforming Enterprise Through Technology," is designed as a key intelligence briefing for over 9,000 senior technology decision-makers. It explores what's evolving, what holds significance, and where to focus efforts within critical areas such as AI, Cyber Security, IoT, Digital Transformation, and Data Centre ecosystems.

Participants can expect to hear from over 200 global tech pioneers, see live demonstrations from more than 150 exhibitors, and explore a dedicated Start-Up Area. This environment fosters executive-level insights and encourages learning among peers. The aim is to help organizations refine their strategic roadmaps, strengthen their decision-making processes, and mitigate risks associated with transformation, ultimately aligning them with the ongoing evolution of the digital landscape.

events.name: AI & Big Data Expo Global 2027
events.description:
Unlocking a smarter future through cutting-edge AI and Big Data solutions is the core mission of the AI & Big Data Expo Global 2027. The event will be held on February 3-4, 2027, at Olympia London. It serves as a forum where industry leaders and innovators can discuss the latest developments in the field.

Discussions will cover topics such as Generative AI, Enterprise AI, Machine Learning, Ethical AI, and Data Ecosystems. The event anticipates over 9,000 participants, featuring more than 200 speakers and 150 exhibitors. It incorporates seven co-located expos, all accessible with a single ticket, offering opportunities for learning and observing live demonstrations.

Those holding a Gold Pass will have an additional opportunity to connect at a networking reception held at The Prince, London. The aim is for participants to gain insights into strategies for implementing AI and Big Data, helping their organizations move towards a more intelligent future.

events.name: Fruit Logistica 2027
events.description:
The global fresh produce industry is set to gather in Berlin, Germany, from February 3 to 5, 2027, for Fruit Logistica 2027. This three-day event, spanning 26 halls, provides a comprehensive overview of the entire value chain, from "Point of Seed to Point of Sale." More than 2,500 exhibitors from over 90 countries will present their latest offerings in fresh produce, machinery, technology, and logistics.

Attendees will encounter new developments, ranging from advanced AgTech and AI solutions to sustainable practices that support biodiversity for robust value chains. The program includes Specialist Forums, the Innovation Award, and specific events such as Fruitful Friday and Guided Tours. This gathering serves as a place to explore new products, establish connections, and observe the evolving direction of the industry.

events.name: Digital Transformation Expo Global 2027
events.description:
The future of enterprise innovation converges at Digital Transformation Expo Global 2027, taking place on 3-4 February at Olympia, London.

As part of TechEx Global, this gathering draws over 9,000 senior IT decision-makers and business leaders. Attendees come to understand how strategy, culture, and advanced technology are reshaping organizations for a digital-first world.

The event features insights from more than 200 expert speakers and showcases solutions from over 150 exhibitors. These are presented across co-located expos covering areas such as AI & Big Data, Cyber Security & Cloud, and IoT Tech. It's an environment designed for individuals to accelerate their digital initiatives, learn from established global brands, and connect with peers driving innovation.

For those focused on refining IT strategy or exploring intelligent automation, the expo provides significant opportunities to advance an organization's transformation journey.

events.name: IoT Tech Expo Global 2027
events.description:
The forefront of connected innovation converges at Olympia, London, on 3-4 February 2027, for the highly anticipated IoT Tech Expo Global. This event offers a thorough exploration of the key advancements shaping areas like IoT, Digital Twins, Enterprise Transformation, IoT Security, and Smart Infrastructures. Running alongside TechEx Global, it also covers AI & Big Data, Cyber Security, and Edge Computing, providing a broader perspective.

More than 8,000 professionals, including C-level executives and industry pioneers, are expected to attend. They will hear from over 200 expert speakers and interact with more than 150 technology providers. Participants can expect to find new solutions, make valuable connections, and develop a clearer understanding of the future of connected devices and intelligent automation.

An exclusive VIP networking evening is also planned, designed to foster collaboration among industry leaders.

events.name: Cyber Security & Cloud Expo Global 2027
events.description:
Prepare to navigate the evolving landscape of digital defense at the Cyber Security & Cloud Expo Global 2027, taking place on 3-4 February at Olympia, London. The event focuses on "Zero Trust Strategies for the Modern Enterprise," exploring essential aspects such as Application & Cloud Security, Data Protection, Identity & Access Management, Threat Intelligence, and DevSecOps.

As part of TechEx Global, a pass provides access to seven co-located events, offering broader learning and networking possibilities. Attendees will have opportunities to connect with C-level professionals, CISOs, and CTOs through interactive presentations, expert panels, and live Q&A sessions. For those with a Gold Pass, an exclusive VIP networking evening is planned at The Prince, London. The expo aims to provide insights into the strategies, tools, and innovations that are shaping the future of secure, connected enterprises.

events.name: Tech Arena 2027
events.description:
Prepare for an unparalleled convergence of innovation and enterprise at Tech Arena 2027, Scandinavia's biggest tech and business event. It will be held on February 3-4, 2027, at the Strawberry Arena in Stockholm. This gathering brings together thousands of founders, investors, and business leaders from over 125 nationalities.

Across four stages, more than 300 prominent speakers will share their perspectives on the major trends shaping our future. The program also includes over 300 side events and roundtables. A matchmaking platform, facilitating over 10,000 connections, will help attendees make meaningful connections, discover early-stage startups, and explore new business opportunities.

For executives focused on industry transformation, investors looking for the next significant idea, or startups aiming for growth, Tech Arena 2027 offers a space for inspiration, collaboration, and impactful business within technology, entrepreneurship, and sustainability.

events.name: Step Conference Dubai 2027
events.description:
Dubai Internet City is set to become the epicenter of innovation on February 3-4, 2027, as it hosts Step Conference Dubai. This conference, with its theme "Intelligence Everywhere: The AI Economy," will explore how artificial intelligence is significantly reshaping business, finance, technology, and creativity, influencing the future of tech, culture, and entrepreneurship.

The event expects to welcome over 8,000 founders, investors, creatives, and tech enthusiasts. It offers a significant opportunity for connection and discovery, where participants can engage with more than 400 presenting startups and leading tech and digital brands. The conference also highlights access to over $9 billion in funding. Through four content tracks, interactive workshops, and structured networking, attendees can gain valuable insights into current and future trends.

Beyond the main stages, the experience extends to outdoor activities, brand displays, and smaller meet-ups. These elements are designed to encourage collaboration among participants from the global innovation community.

events.name: Proptech Connect Middle East 2027
events.description:
Proptech Connect Middle East 2027 will unite the region's foremost real estate innovators, investors, and entrepreneurs for two days of unparalleled insight and strategic collaboration. The event is scheduled for February 3rd and 4th at the Grand Hyatt Dubai. It stands as the Middle East's largest PropTech gathering, providing a space to explore new ideas and the advanced technologies influencing future urban environments.

Officially partnered with the Dubai Land Department, this gathering offers an opportunity to delve into emerging solutions across AI, digital transformation, smart building technologies, and sustainable development. Participants can engage with key figures in the industry, pinpoint potential investment avenues, and establish collaborations. These interactions aim to foster greater efficiency, transparency, and lasting value within the evolving real estate sector.

events.name: IT Partners 2027
events.description:
Innovation, business, and unparalleled networking will converge at IT Partners 2027, igniting the French IT & Tech Channel ecosystem. From February 3-4, 2027, the Paris La Défense Arena will welcome around 10,000 professionals for two days focused on accelerating business growth and building new partnerships.

This gathering provides a platform for conferences, interactive workshops, and opportunities to develop business. Attendees can explore new innovations, engage in discussions, and acknowledge progress within the sector.

The event includes dedicated areas for in-depth conversations about major trends and insights from experts. IT Partners 2027 offers a chance to connect with peers, learn about industry developments, and advance future projects in the evolving IT landscape.

events.name: ECP 2027
events.description:
The European Chemistry Partnering (ECP) 2027 is set to ignite innovation and foster collaboration across the chemical industry. This gathering will connect industry leaders, researchers with new ideas, and emerging companies, providing an environment to develop partnerships and discuss the future of chemical science and technology.

The event will offer an atmosphere for meaningful conversations, where participants can learn about significant progress and find business opportunities in various areas of chemistry. While specific dates and the venue are still being finalized, ECP 2027 will provide understanding of new trends, sustainable solutions, and partnerships that influence the market.

Participants will connect with important decision-makers, learn about new technologies, and work together to influence the future of chemistry.

events.name: The Ortus Club TechEx Global Conference 2027
events.description:
Prepare to redefine the future of enterprise technology at The Ortus Club TechEx Global Conference 2027, held on 3-4 February at London's Olympia. This annual gathering brings together over 9,000 senior technology decision-makers, from CIOs to Lead Engineers, to explore significant innovations. With one ticket, participants can access eight co-located events, allowing them to delve into key areas such as AI, Cyber Security, IoT, Digital Transformation, and Physical AI.

The program includes over 200 expert speakers, alongside presentations of real-life use cases, live demonstrations, and a dedicated Startup Area. These sessions aim to provide valuable perspectives and opportunities for connecting with peers. Attendees will discover practical strategies for leveraging data infrastructure, intelligent automation, and edge computing, which can help shape their organizations' technological direction.

events.name: NAPE Summit Week 2027
events.description:
The energy industry converges at NAPE Summit Week 2027, set to ignite new opportunities from February 3-5 at the George R. Brown Convention Center in Houston, TX. Thousands of decision-makers, prospect generators, and capital providers from around the world gather here, looking to buy, sell, and trade energy prospects and producing properties.

NAPE's scope has expanded beyond traditional oil and gas, now encompassing critical minerals, data centers, bitcoin mining, and renewable energy. Those attending can explore current industry trends and emerging technologies within specialized areas such as Prospect Preview, Critical Minerals, and Renewable Energy.

The event includes the Energy Business Conference and an Icebreaker reception, providing settings for discussions, networking, and fostering collaboration across the full range of energy sectors.

events.name: INTRConnect 2027
events.description:
The fifth annual INTRConnect 2027, themed "Made For Impact," is set to redefine the property insurance and restoration landscape. From February 3-5, 2027, Cotality will host professionals from claims, restoration, risk management, and underwriting at the Gaylord Pacific Resort in San Diego, California. The program focuses on understanding current trends, innovations, and best practices that help businesses adapt to evolving industry demands.

Discussions will cover current and future industry challenges through a variety of tracks, sessions, workshops, and panels. A keynote address will be delivered by Garret Gray, President of Cotality's Global Insurance Business Unit. Attendees will also find opportunities to connect with peers and industry leaders.

location.venue: Parc des Expositions de Nantes - Hall XXL

events.name: KeHE Summer Show 2027
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in a world of groundbreaking products and fresh ideas at the KeHE Summer Show 2027. This grocery industry event provides two ways to participate: in person on February 9-10, 2027, in Phoenix, Arizona, or virtually from February 3-19 through KeHE CONNECT®.

The show aims to foster growth and create new business opportunities, bringing together suppliers, retailers, and industry innovators. Participants can explore emerging trends and identify new products for their offerings.

Sustainability is a key focus, with eco-friendly initiatives woven into the event's structure. Attendees have the opportunity to contribute to a more responsible future, expand their professional network, and gain valuable market insights.

events.name: Global Specialty Lens Symposium 2027
events.description:
Dedicated to advancing the field of vision correction, the Global Specialty Lens Symposium 2027 convenes February 3-6 at Paris Las Vegas. Eye care professionals will have the opportunity to explore the latest developments in specialty contact lenses.

The program will cover recent research, clinical techniques, and technological advancements. This includes presentations from experts, detailed papers, and innovative poster sessions.

The symposium serves as a gathering point for optometrists, ophthalmologists, and industry innovators. It's a place where they can collaborate, share insights, and discuss future directions. Participants can also gain continuing education credits and connect with colleagues from around the world, making it an important event for those involved in the global specialty lens community.

events.name: Beyond Activ World Saudi Arabia 2027
events.description:
Beyond Activ World Saudi Arabia 2027, held February 3-4 at the Fairmont Riyadh, is where the future of health, wellness, and sports will be shaped. This gathering brings together over 1,000 executives from more than 30 countries, focusing on leadership, investment, and business-to-business development. With support from the Ministry of Investment, the event explores company investment roadmaps, consumer trends, AI applications, and evolving business models across fitness, hospitality, and preventative health.

Pre-event receptions on February 2 provide an initial opportunity for attendees to connect. Following the main event, a dedicated Investment Summit takes place on February 12-13. This summit is designed to facilitate strategic partnerships and discuss financial growth within EMEA markets. Participants will interact with over 75 speakers and 50 exhibitors, examining topics such as longevity, recovery, and hospitality centered on wellness.

events.name: Digital Transformation Summit Saudi Arabia 2027
events.description:
The Digital Transformation Summit Saudi Arabia 2027 will convene the Kingdom's foremost C-level executives, directors, and heads of technology. This gathering aims to provide leaders with strategic insights into the evolving digital landscape.

Participants will examine developments in areas such as AI, data analytics, cybersecurity, cloud infrastructure, and Web 3.0. These discussions are important for fostering innovation and supporting the objectives of Vision 2030. The event offers a platform to connect with experienced professionals, explore effective approaches for updating existing systems, and learn how to derive greater value from digital projects.

The summit provides a setting for building connections and fostering collaborative partnerships. This environment supports attendees in making well-informed decisions, contributing to more efficient operations and a progressive digital culture.

events.name: Ecommerce Experience Evolution Miami 2027
events.description:
Set against the stunning backdrop of The Ritz-Carlton Key Biscayne, Miami, the Ecommerce Experience Evolution Miami 2027, from February 3-5, is an unparalleled retreat for senior ecommerce and brand executives. This exclusive, invite-only gathering brings together 500 leaders, primarily from high-growth brands with annual revenues ranging from $25M to over $500M. This structure ensures a focused environment for peer-to-peer networking and shared learning.

The program will delve into advanced strategies for customer experience, retention, personalization, and the integration of AI. Attendees can expect practical, operator-level insights and actionable case studies, often drawn from brands generating 8-9 figures in revenue.

Over these three days, the event encourages tactical discussions and the formation of meaningful connections within a premium environment. The aim is to provide participants with fresh perspectives and tools to navigate the evolving landscape of digital commerce.

events.name: Insights Association CEO Summit 2027
events.description:
Set to convene from February 3 to 5, 2027, the Insights Association CEO Summit 2027 offers an unparalleled forum for the insights and analytics industry's most influential leaders. This gathering brings together CEOs and senior executives to discuss the evolving landscape of market research and data intelligence.

Attendees will engage in strategic conversations, examining the industry's key challenges and identifying new possibilities. It's a setting for leaders to exchange ideas, develop innovative solutions, and build important relationships with their peers. The discussions will offer forward-looking insights on how to use new technologies, achieve sustainable growth, and shape the future direction of the insights industry, helping leaders refine their strategies and lead their organizations effectively.

events.name: Beyond Activ World Awards Saudi Arabia 2027
ICI Innovate 2027
events.description:
Mark your calendars for ICI Innovate 2027, taking place from February 3 to 5 in Phoenix, AZ. This three-day event brings together professionals from the asset management and investment company industry who are interested in the latest developments in innovation.

The program will explore new strategies and technologies that are shaping the financial landscape. Discussions will offer perspectives on managing changing market conditions, supporting long-term growth, and using new approaches to stay competitive.

Participants will have the opportunity to connect with leaders in the field, make valuable connections, and discuss future investment solutions. ICI Innovate 2027 provides a forum to learn, share ideas, and contribute to the industry's direction.

events.name: MACP Winter Professional Development Conference 2027
events.description:
Elevate your leadership and strategic capabilities at the MACP Winter Professional Development Conference 2027, taking place from February 3-5 at the Amway Grand Plaza Hotel in Grand Rapids, Michigan.

The Michigan Association of Chiefs of Police hosts this three-day event, created for law enforcement professionals who want to understand and respond to the challenges of modern policing. Participants will engage in important discussions, learn from experienced presenters, and explore new ways to enhance community safety, improve operations, and support officer well-being.

The conference provides a setting for professionals to collaborate, exchange best practices, and build connections within Michigan's law enforcement community. Registration closes on February 1, 2027.

events.name: GRI Data Center India 2027
events.description:
Set to convene on February 3rd, 2027, in Mumbai, GRI Data Center India 2027 offers an exclusive platform for decision-makers from real estate and infrastructure companies with capital at risk.

The event will explore the evolving landscape of India's data center growth. Discussions will cover critical themes, from the impact of AI and hyperscaler demand to investment opportunities and the challenges of execution.

Key investors and developers attending will participate in strategic discussions, fireside chats, and breakout sessions. The agenda includes topics such as future data center buildout, power grid capacity, technological advancements like direct-to-chip cooling, and supply chain resilience. Industry leaders, including JLL India's Rachit Mohan and knowledge partner Trilegal, will share their perspectives. Participants can expect to gain valuable insights and build important connections relevant to India's digital infrastructure future.

events.name: Washington Sportsmen's Show 2027
events.description:
The Pacific Northwest's premier event for outdoor enthusiasts, the Washington Sportsmen's Show 2027, invites you to gear up for adventure from February 3-7 at the Washington State Fair Events Center.

It's a place where hunters, anglers, and outdoor adventurers can see the newest gear, find innovative products, and connect with representatives from brands such as Leupold, Ruger, and Toyota. Attendees can also explore a full schedule of seminars offering expert insights and practical tips, alongside various show attractions that might spark ideas for their next outdoor trip.

Whether someone is looking for new equipment, practical advice, or a chance to connect with other sportsmen, this event offers a helpful resource to get ready for their outdoor pursuits.

events.name: Digital Infrastructure World 2027
events.description:
The future of AI infrastructure will be forged at Digital Infrastructure World 2027, taking place February 3-4, 2027, at the San Jose Convention Center in the heart of Silicon Valley. This gathering brings together over 3,000 senior infrastructure leaders, engineers, and architects. Participants will examine the full range of technologies essential for AI, covering everything from silicon and systems to networking, power, cooling, data centers, software, and operations.

The program features over 100 speakers and more than 120 practitioner-led sessions, structured across five technical tracks. These sessions delve into real-world deployments and engineering insights, with topics such as "Open systems for AI" and "The Data Center: The factory that produces intelligence."

The event provides a setting for individuals to accelerate innovation, address common challenges, and connect with peers who are shaping the AI landscape.

events.name: APTA CSM 2027
events.description:
The American Physical Therapy Association's Combined Sections Meeting (APTA CSM) 2027 promises an unparalleled experience for physical therapy professionals, uniting a vast community dedicated to advancing the field. This large-scale event, open to everyone in the profession, whether an APTA member or not, is planned years ahead. This careful preparation ensures it's accessible and welcoming for all who attend. The host city changes each year, moving around the country to accommodate the diverse membership. Each location is picked thoughtfully, keeping in mind accessibility for all, ease of travel, and comfortable housing options for attendees. This reflects the association's dedication to making the experience smooth for everyone.

Those who come can expect a full schedule. It usually begins with pre-conference sessions on Wednesday, followed by three days of core educational content from Thursday through Saturday. Highlights that happen every year include the respected McMillan Lecture and the ceremony recognizing APTA Specialty and Proficiency. Beyond learning and professional growth, the meeting also encourages attendees to contribute positively to the local community of the host city. To allow for wider participation, a virtual option will also be available alongside the in-person gathering.

events.name: PACE Show 2027
events.description:
Arriving in February 2027 at the KCCC Facility, the PACE Show 2027 is the essential gathering for fuel marketers, c-store, and food/beverage retailers throughout the central Midwest. This event provides access to current, industry-specific information, designed to help professionals navigate market trends and address operational challenges effectively.

The exhibition floor will feature products, services, and equipment from manufacturers and service providers in the industry. Alongside this, attendees can participate in industry meetings focused on critical business issues, fostering discussions that lead to practical solutions and strategic insights. The show also offers chances to connect with peers, build new partnerships, and engage in social events.

events.name: EMITT 2027
events.description:
Istanbul is set to host the landmark 30th East Mediterranean International Tourism & Travel Exhibition, EMITT 2027, from February 4-6 at the IFM (Istanbul Expo Center). This gathering brings together destinations, tourism authorities, and professionals from the global travel industry.

Those attending will have the chance to explore new travel destinations and understand the latest trends shaping the global tourism landscape. The event provides a setting for networking and collaboration, supported by programs such as the VIP Hosted Tour Operator Program and the Eventiqs App, designed to facilitate connections. Exhibitors can present their offerings using Turnkey New Package Stand Models. The aim of this edition is to encourage growth and new partnerships across both the Turkish and international travel sectors.

events.name: CISO Forum Canada 2027
events.description:
On February 4, 2027, CISO Forum Canada 2027 convenes at The Ritz-Carlton, Toronto, bringing together Canada's most senior information security leaders.

This in-person event is designed for director-level and above executives. It focuses on strategic management, innovation, and practical approaches to complex cyber challenges.

The day's discussions will cover important subjects like navigating geopolitical cyber skirmishes, balancing human and AI judgment during a crisis, and effectively communicating cyber risk to boards. Participants will also explore securing AI agents and data pipelines, transforming security culture, and developing strong cyber resilience strategies. Through a full day of sessions led by experts, private roundtables, and an executive reception, attendees can expect to gain valuable perspectives and connect with their peers in Canadian cybersecurity leadership.

events.name: REMIX Summit London 2027
events.description:
Mark your calendars for REMIX Summit London 2027, a special 15th-anniversary edition taking place on February 4-5. This international event brings together innovators and senior leaders from the cultural, technological, and entrepreneurial sectors. It will be held across two distinct venues: Here East and The National Gallery.

Discussions will center on critical themes, including the design of immersive storyworlds, cultivating human-centred approaches to art and technology, and rethinking culture for systemic renewal. Participants will also examine evolving audience expectations and the role of creative individuals in shaping public spaces.

Over two days, more than 60 speakers will share their perspectives through talks, focused discussions, and practical workshops. Attendees can expect to connect with peers, address common challenges, and acquire practical insights to initiate meaningful change and demonstrate its effectiveness. For those unable to attend in person, digital access to all talks will be available, supporting ongoing learning.

events.name: Medicaid Innovations Forum 2027
events.description:
The 18th Annual Medicaid Innovations Forum 2027, scheduled for February 4-5 at Rosen Shingle Creek in Orlando, FL, offers a vital platform for Medicaid health plans, government agencies, and providers.

This two-day event focuses on how to deliver quality, accountable, and cost-efficient care in today's evolving Medicaid environment. Attendees will learn practical approaches to navigate the significant challenges presented by OBBBA and the current administration. The forum offers more than just theoretical policy discussions; it will include insightful case study presentations from leading managed care plans and state agencies, alongside engaging interactive panel discussions with industry experts.

This is a valuable chance to connect with over 250 professionals, learn about new innovations, and find solutions that can influence the future of Medicaid.

events.name: Cloud Tech Tallinn 2027
events.description:
Tallinn Creative Hub will host Cloud Tech Tallinn 2027 on February 4th and 5th, 2027, inviting professionals to explore the transformative power of Microsoft Cloud. Over two days, the event will focus on how advanced data analytics, AI, machine learning, and scalable cloud-native tools can benefit businesses and individual careers. Participants can expect sessions that delve into Microsoft Cloud SaaS products, AI services, collaboration tools, and application development.

Beyond learning from experts, the event also provides a setting for professionals to connect, share ideas, and explore potential collaborations with peers. Each day will conclude with social gatherings, offering a chance to experience Tallinn's unique charm.

The event aims to bring together learning, new ideas, and community for anyone interested in the Microsoft Cloud ecosystem.

events.name: WMCCAI Conference and Expo 2027
events.description:
Mark your calendars for the WMCCAI Conference and Expo 2027, where the future of community associations unfolds. This regional event, themed 'The Wave of the Future,' brings together professionals, leaders, and partners. It's a chance to exchange ideas, refine best practices, and acquire practical tools, all designed to help build stronger communities.

The exhibit hall will feature over 200 exhibitors presenting the latest solutions and innovations. Additionally, participants can attend a dozen education sessions. These sessions are structured to address current challenges and leverage industry developments.

The conference also provides opportunities to connect with peers and experts. The goal is to equip participants to navigate the evolving landscape of community associations effectively.

events.name: DallasCISO ORBIE Awards 2027
events.description:
The DallasCISO ORBIE Awards 2027 offers North Texas an unparalleled celebration of cybersecurity leadership, culminating on February 4, 2027, at the Hyatt Regency Dallas. Organized by DallasCISO, this program recognizes Chief Information Security Officers for their exceptional leadership, their role in driving innovation, and their impact on the region's prominent organizations.

The path to the awards evening starts with the ORBIE Leadership Reception on October 28, 2026, held at Stonebriar Country Club, where the year's nominees are acknowledged. Following this, finalists will come together for a private reception and dinner, featuring a curated menu and wine pairings, at The Adolphus on January 20, 2027.

The main awards ceremony itself is designed to be a high-quality production, celebrating the executive leaders who are shaping the future of technology in Dallas. It also provides an important setting for peers to connect and share insights.

events.name: Atlanta Cybersecurity Summit Winter 2027
events.description:
On Thursday, February 4, 2027, Atlanta, GA, will host the 16th Edition of the Atlanta Cybersecurity Summit Winter. This full-day, in-person event is for CISOs and senior cybersecurity leaders who focus on strengthening their organizations' resilience and connecting security efforts with broader business goals.

Those attending will explore how to manage the challenges presented by AI, automation, and new technological risks. Discussions will also cover strategies for addressing vulnerabilities in supply chains and identity attack surfaces. A key focus is on understanding how cyber risks impact business results and how to communicate this effectively.

The day includes presentations on new solutions, interactive discussions, and chances to connect with peers in a focused setting. Participants can collaborate with colleagues, earn CPE/CEU credits, and learn about new approaches to safeguarding critical infrastructure.

events.name: ATHENA International Awards 2027
events.description:
The Greater Rochester Chamber of Commerce proudly presents the ATHENA International Awards 2027, marking its 41st annual celebration on Thursday, February 4, in Rochester, NY. This event recognizes outstanding women leaders and organizations dedicated to supporting women's professional growth.

Individuals and organizations will be honored across three distinct categories. The ATHENA International Award acknowledges established leaders. The ATHENA Young Professional Award celebrates emerging talent between the ages of 25 and 45. Finally, the ATHENA Organizational Award goes to woman-owned or led entities that champion women's leadership development.

The awards ceremony serves as an important moment to acknowledge significant achievements and the impact of leadership, mentorship, and community involvement in advancing women.

events.name: Smart Commerce 2027
events.description:
Smart Commerce 2027, a pivotal one-day summit, will convene 300 C-level executives and digital commerce leaders on February 4th, 2027, at Clarion Jätkäsaari, Helsinki, Finland. The event will examine the factors shaping the next era of digital commerce and how businesses can grow effectively.

The agenda will address three key areas: Autonomous Commerce, exploring how AI optimizes business operations; Instant Experiences, focusing on new benchmarks for speed and precision; and Marketplace & Social Dominance, considering the influence of platforms and communities. Keynote speaker Christoph Sterkel (Kellanova (Mars)) will share insights on scaling growth, emerging channels, and marketplace acceleration.

events.name: SuperGreen Live 2027
events.description:
Dive into the forefront of environmental innovation at SuperGreen Live 2027, a pioneering all-virtual and televised event on Thursday, February 4, 2027. Devin Thorpe and Professor Alan Tratner will co-host this gathering, which aims to advance climate solutions and build community resources for a future we can all thrive in.

For founders of climate and sustainability companies, the event offers a platform to present their ideas and seek funding. Investors, in turn, can explore promising ventures and engage in direct discussions.

The day's agenda includes live pitch sessions, a demo day, and panel discussions. There will also be a sustainable fashion show. Attendees can connect throughout the day in a dedicated Zoom networking room, and the broadcast is freely accessible to the public. The event brings together individuals interested in green investment and building a sustainable future.

events.name: Bauen + Wohnen Salzburg 2027
events.description:
From February 4th to 7th, 2027, Messezentrum Salzburg GmbH opens its doors for Bauen + Wohnen Salzburg, the essential event for modern building and living. Around 20,000 people will gather across seven halls to see the latest trends and innovations from over 300 exhibitors. Among the displays will be custom furniture from P.MAX®, various flooring options by Austriawood, and sustainable heat pump technology from Mitsubishi Electric.

The event focuses on key areas such as energy saving, smart home solutions, and future-proof construction. Discussions and presentations will cover topics like financing, planning, innovative building materials, photovoltaic systems, and energy-efficient heating, offering valuable perspectives. A dedicated area, WohnArt, will showcase interior design concepts.

This gathering provides a chance to gather comprehensive information and connect with specialists who can help shape home projects.

events.name: The Public Sector Cyber Security Conference 2027
events.description:
Dedicated to fortifying the nation's digital defenses, The Public Sector Cyber Security Conference 2027 convenes on Thursday, 04 February at London's prestigious QEII Centre. This complimentary event is for cyber security and IT professionals across the public and voluntary sectors, providing an opportunity to strengthen their resilience strategies.

The program will feature insights from government strategists and leading experts, delivered through keynotes, case studies, and interactive demonstrations. Discussions will cover essential topics such as navigating evolving threats, the impact of AI on security, protecting supply chains, and establishing robust data protection frameworks.

Attendees will have the chance to connect with colleagues, explore new solutions in the Solutions Showcase, and earn 8 hours of CPD points. The overall aim is to help organizations better prepare for and respond to current cyber challenges.

events.name: IPEC Europe Excipients Forum 2027
events.description:
Dedicated to advancing patient safety through excipient excellence, the IPEC Europe Excipients Forum 2027 will convene on Thursday, 4 February 2027, at the elegant Renaissance Aix-en-Provence in France. Organized by IPEC Europe, this one-day event brings together professionals involved in the production, distribution, and use of pharmaceutical excipients.

Attendees will discuss important topics, including how to best use excipients in medicines, sharing effective practices, and working towards common standards. The forum provides an opportunity to examine recent industry developments and collaborative initiatives, all with the aim of improving patient safety in pharmaceuticals.

As a member of EXCiPACT and IPEC Federation, IPEC Europe is committed to delivering a relevant and focused program. More information about the specific sessions will be available soon.

events.name: IWCA Annual Convention & Trade Show 2027
events.description:
Prepare to elevate your business and skills at Elevate 2027, the IWCA Annual Convention & Trade Show, taking place February 4-7, 2027, at Kalahari Resorts & Conventions in Round Rock/Austin, TX. This four-day gathering, co-located with the PWNA Convention, brings together window washing professionals, contractors, manufacturers, distributors, and suppliers.

Attendees can explore new equipment through outdoor demonstrations and a comprehensive Trade Show. The program also includes hands-on training sessions, workshops focused on business development, and opportunities for essential safety certifications.

Beyond the educational sessions, the convention features a Window Cleaning Competition, the Women In the Industry Luncheon, and an Awards Banquet. These events offer opportunities to connect with peers, learn from industry leaders, and gather insights relevant to your work.

events.name: Bharat Mobility Global Expo 2027

location.venue: Bharat Mandapam, Pragati Maidan + Yashobhoomi, Dwarka

events.description:
Prepare to witness the future of transportation at the Bharat Mobility Global Expo 2027, taking place from February 4th to 9th at Bharat Mandapam and February 4th to 7th at Yashobhoomi in New Delhi. This event will present India's approach to a cleaner, smarter, software-driven, and interconnected mobility system, designed to integrate both urban and rural environments.

The expo addresses the entire mobility value chain, covering automotive and components, energy solutions, AI-driven technology, logistics, and advanced infrastructure. It brings together several focused exhibitions, allowing attendees to explore the latest developments. These include the Auto Expo Motor Show, alongside displays of battery and tyre technologies, air mobility advancements, construction equipment, and urban mass transit solutions.

The event anticipates over 1 lakh visitors, including original equipment manufacturers, global suppliers, startups, and investors. It provides a significant forum for business-to-business and business-to-government discussions, technology demonstrations, and expert sessions that contribute to shaping the next generation of mobility.

events.name: CactusCon 2027
events.description:
CactusCon 15, the highly anticipated community gathering, returns to Mesa, AZ, on February 5-6, 2027. For 15 years, this event has been a place for people to connect and collaborate, evolving into more than just a conference. It's where shared passions bring individuals together to exchange ideas and knowledge.

Attendees can expect two days focused on strengthening relationships, sharing insights, and celebrating the spirit of community that has always been a hallmark of CactusCon. Whether you're a long-time participant or new to the event, CactusCon 15 provides a chance to engage with others, learn from different viewpoints, and contribute to a supportive environment built on mutual respect.

events.name: ATSSA Convention & Traffic Expo 2027
events.description:
Mark your calendars for the ATSSA Convention & Traffic Expo 2027, the premier event for advancing roadway safety and transportation. From February 5-9, Long Beach, California, will bring together thousands of professionals, including key public agency officials, all sharing a common goal: safer roads for everyone.

This gathering provides a chance to explore the newest safety solutions and significant innovations that are shaping the future of transportation infrastructure. Those attending can explore a large expo floor featuring new products and participate in educational sessions led by industry experts.

It's a place where professionals can connect with peers, share knowledge, and contribute to improving roadway safety standards across the nation.

events.name: DallasCIO ORBIE Awards 2027
events.description:
Prepare to celebrate the pinnacle of technology leadership at the DallasCIO ORBIE Awards 2027, a prestigious series honoring North Texas's most impactful Chief Information Officers. The recognition process begins with the ORBIE Leadership Reception on October 27, 2026, at Stonebriar Country Club, where the year's distinguished nominees will be acknowledged.

Following this, an exclusive Finalist Reception & Dinner will be held on January 21, 2027, at The Adolphus. This gathering offers a gourmet experience and an opportunity for leading tech executives to connect. The awards culminate on February 5, 2027, at the Hyatt Regency Dallas, with a broadcast-quality ceremony where the 2027 DallasCIO ORBIE Award winners will be announced live.

This occasion brings together CIOs, executive leaders, and industry partners to celebrate innovation, build connections, and draw inspiration from the visionaries transforming Dallas's technological landscape.

events.name: ACCESS 2027
events.description:
Mark your calendars for May 2, 2027, as ACCESS 2027 convenes as the premier Digital Asset Security Summit. This gathering will bring together professionals and thought leaders from the fields of finance, security, and blockchain technology. Experts representing financial institutions, security leadership, and technology innovation will meet to discuss and help shape security standards for the evolving landscape of digital assets.

Those attending can expect to explore effective strategies for protecting digital assets, understand the complexities of regulatory environments, and learn about advanced security measures. The summit offers a forum for strategic conversations, encouraging participants to work together on the critical challenges facing digital asset security.

The discussions aim to contribute to the development of secure digital finance, supporting the integrity and resilience needed for future financial systems. It's also an opportunity to learn about new approaches and connect with others in the field.

events.name: Capital Link Greek Shipping Forum 2027
events.description:
The Capital Link Greek Shipping Forum 2027, a pivotal event for the global maritime industry, is scheduled for Friday, February 5, 2027, at The Athenaeum Intercontinental Athens, Greece. It will bring together leaders from institutions and the industry to explore the sector's most significant trends, challenges, and emerging opportunities.

Working with DNV, NASDAQ, and NYSE, the forum will host discussions centered on navigating a complex and demanding operational environment. Participants can expect to delve into the effects of changing geopolitical dynamics, evolving tariff structures, energy security concerns, and regulatory demands. The agenda also includes examining shifts in global trade routes and broader economic influences.

These conversations are designed to foster resilience, innovation, and sustainable growth for shipping, recognizing its role as the essential link in the global supply chain. The gathering aims to contribute to shaping the future direction of maritime commerce.

events.name: Pri-Med South 2027
events.description:
Elevate your expertise and enhance patient care at Pri-Med South 2027, the premier event for primary care clinicians. This gathering is for healthcare providers, and NPI information is requested to maintain an accredited learning environment. Participants can earn CME/CE credits to help meet state requirements, while also gaining practical, evidence-based insights.

The program features presentations from keynote speakers and content developed with leading academic partners, ensuring the information shared is current and offers practical strategies. Attendees will also discover new tools that can help improve their practice.

The event provides an opportunity to connect with fellow clinicians. It supports professional growth, helping attendees stay informed about developments in primary care.

events.name: LL&M Winter Symposium 2027

location.venue: JW Marriott Miami Turnberry Resort and Spa

events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in critical discussions and groundbreaking insights at the LL&M Winter Symposium 2027. This event will bring together professionals and leaders from the legal, medical, and management sectors. The focus will be on the complex connections that define modern healthcare.

Attendees will delve into current research, consider new approaches, and discuss the significant issues facing the industry today. The symposium offers a space for sharing knowledge through sessions led by experts, hands-on workshops, and opportunities to connect with peers. The aim is for participants to leave with fresh perspectives, potential partnerships, and practical insights that can influence healthcare delivery and policy.

events.name: UACRS New Orleans 2027
events.description:
Unlock peak financial performance for your urology practice at UACRS New Orleans 2027, taking place February 5-6 at the Caesars New Orleans. This two-day program brings together urologists, APPs, coders, and administrators who want to deepen their understanding of advanced coding and reimbursement strategies.

The agenda covers optimizing E/M coding, identifying new revenue opportunities, managing telehealth services, and applying AI to improve documentation and billing. Participants will learn directly from recognized experts, including Mark Painter, Dr. John Lin, and Marianne Desciose. The event also features hands-on coding workshops designed to provide practical insights and help practices stay current with the latest Medicare and private payer guidelines.

Those attending will earn 14 AAPC CEUs. The registration includes daily meals and six months of access to the PRS Helpdesk, offering continued support for your practice's operational needs.

events.name: AGC CA Installation & Awards Gala After-Party 2027
events.description:
Following the grandeur of the AGC CA Installation & Awards Gala, the celebration continues at the official After-Party on February 5, 2027, at the magnificent Fairmont San Francisco. This event brings together AGC of California members, newly installed leadership, and industry professionals—including owners, contractors, consultants, and public agencies—providing an opportunity to continue conversations in a more relaxed atmosphere.

After an evening dedicated to recognizing achievements in construction, attendees can unwind. It's an occasion to connect with colleagues, build new relationships, and acknowledge the future of California's construction industry.

Procore presents this after-party, offering a way to conclude a night of recognition and shared experience among industry colleagues.

location.venue: Lumen Field Event Center & Bell Harbor Marina

events.name: MIDO 2027
events.description:
From February 6-8, 2027, the global optical industry will once again gather at Fiera Milano, Rho, for MIDO 2027 – the world's leading eyewear show. This three-day event brings together professionals from every part of the eyewear supply chain, covering everything from lenses and machinery to frames and materials.

Across seven pavilions and eight distinct exhibition areas, visitors will encounter the newest collections, emerging trends, and technological advancements influencing the future of eyewear. It's an opportunity to see what's next in the industry.

With more than 1,200 exhibitors and attendees from 160 nations, MIDO 2027 creates a substantial environment for learning, increasing visibility, and building important business relationships. Industry excellence is also acknowledged through prestigious accolades, including the Best Store and Sergio Cereda Design Awards.

events.name: Women in Restaurant Leadership 2027
events.description:
Set to inspire and connect the leading women of the restaurant sector, Women in Restaurant Leadership 2027 will convene from February 6-9 at the Grand Hyatt Scottsdale Resort in Scottsdale, AZ. This gathering focuses on highlighting the perspectives and approaches of women who are shaping the industry as operators, innovators, and culture-shapers, actively redefining what leadership means.

Attendees will find an environment designed for meaningful exchange, where personal experiences can evolve into actionable strategies, and professional connections can build collective momentum. This fosters a shared sense of purpose. The program underscores the value of collaboration, reminding participants that they are part of a larger community, fostering shared growth and a collective vision for the future of restaurants.

The event provides opportunities for gaining insights, engaging in strategic discussions, and building professional relationships. It is supported by various industry partners who share a commitment to advancing women in leadership.

events.name: ABA Marketplace 2027
events.description:
Prepare to connect with the pulse of the motorcoach and bus industry at ABA Marketplace 2027, hosted by the American Bus Association. From February 6-9, the BMO Centre in Calgary, AB, Canada, will bring together motorcoach and tour operators, tourism organizations, and suppliers of essential products and services. This gathering serves as a central point for business within the industry.

Over these four days, attendees can establish new professional relationships and explore solutions for various services, including charters, tours, scheduled routes, and shuttles. It's a chance to discuss future trends with industry leaders and consider how to keep your organization current in passenger transportation.

events.name: International Aquatics & Water Safety Conference and Exposition 2027
events.description:
Prepare to immerse yourself in the forefront of aquatic excellence at the International Aquatics & Water Safety Conference and Exposition 2027. This event, organized by the Association of Aquatic Professionals (AOAP), brings together professionals from around the world at the Grand Sierra in Reno, NV, from February 6-13, 2027.

Those attending can expect opportunities for learning, connecting with peers, and advancing their professional skills. The program explores current trends, new legislation, and important challenges facing the aquatics industry. Sessions led by experts and panel discussions will cover key areas such as safety and risk management, leadership, executive development, facility management, staff training, maintenance, and innovative programming.

The exhibit hall provides a space to connect with others and explore new products and services. The conference aims to support professionals in expanding their knowledge, building connections, and contributing to ongoing efforts for a safer and more effective aquatic environment.

events.name: Great American Outdoor Show 2027
events.description:
Prepare for an unparalleled celebration of America's outdoor heritage at the Great American Outdoor Show 2027. From February 6-14, the Pennsylvania Farm Show Complex in Harrisburg will open its doors for nine days. This expansive event, covering 650,000 square feet, brings together over 1,000 exhibitors. Visitors can see the latest in firearms and fishing tackle, explore RVs and boats, and connect with outfitters from around the world.

Throughout the show, attendees have opportunities to meet well-known figures in the outdoor community and learn from experts during various seminars designed to enhance outdoor skills. The schedule also features competitions, including the Pennsylvania Lumberjack Championships, Dock Dogs, and archery challenges.

For families, there's a dedicated Eddie Eagle Kid's Zone and opportunities for rock climbing. The show offers a wide range of interests, whether someone is an experienced outdoors person or introducing younger generations to hunting, fishing, and conservation.

events.name: Spring Fair 2027
events.description:
Prepare to redefine your retail strategy at Spring Fair 2027, the UK's premier wholesale home, gift, and fashion trade event.

This event takes place over four days, typically in February, at the NEC Birmingham. It brings together over 38,000 buyers and retailers, who come to explore new products and trends. More than 1,500 suppliers participate, offering a wide range of goods from independent artisans to larger manufacturers.

Attendees can find a comprehensive selection of items, from contemporary homewares and seasonal decorations to unique gifts and the latest fashion collections, covering all major retail categories. The event also provides opportunities to connect with peers, attend complimentary seminars led by industry figures, and deepen understanding through masterclasses and one-on-one clinics. Spring Fair 2027 serves as a central point for discovering new products, fostering business relationships, and staying informed about developments in the retail sector.

events.name: CMAA World Conference and Club Business Expo 2027
events.description:
The CMAA World Conference and Club Business Expo 2027, scheduled for February 7–11 in Chicago, IL, stands as the club industry’s largest annual gathering. It's a place where club management professionals come to advance their careers and expand their professional network.

Professionals can work towards their certification goals, identify new talent for their clubs, and mentor future industry leaders. The accompanying Club Business Expo provides an opportunity to explore and find innovative solutions for common challenges clubs face.

Attendees gather fresh ideas and insights, helping them refine their skills and keep their club operations current, ensuring they remain informed about the evolving nature of club management.

events.name: GRAMMY Awards 2027
events.description:
