Across 2.6 million square feet of exhibit space, more than 1,200 exhibitors will present the newest advancements in technology and equipment that are influencing how we farm. It's a place where new solutions are introduced, where industry leaders share their perspectives, and where the progress driving global agriculture can be observed firsthand.

events.name: Medallia Experience 2027
events.description:
Prepare to redefine the future of customer and employee experience at Medallia Experience 2027, held February 9-11 at the opulent WYNN LAS VEGAS. This gathering brings together innovators and leaders from around the world to explore the evolving field of experience management.

Participants will discover practical ways to use data, artificial intelligence, and human-centered design to improve business outcomes and build stronger connections. The event offers an opportunity to learn from organizations such as Hyatt, Santander, Verizon, and Mayo Clinic Laboratories, understanding the strategies they employ to transform their industries. Additionally, a program called 'Share Your Story' provides a platform for individuals to present their work, acknowledge achievements, and receive recognition for their contributions.

The intention is for attendees to connect with peers, exchange knowledge, and contribute to the ongoing evolution of customer and employee experiences.

events.name: ESRI Federal GIS Conference 2027
events.description:
Federal professionals seeking to elevate their mission-critical capabilities will converge at the ESRI Federal GIS Conference 2027, held February 9–10 at the Walter E. Washington Convention Center in Washington, DC. This conference provides significant opportunities for professional growth, exploring how geospatial technology is changing government operations. Participants will examine Esri’s vision for AI-powered enterprise solutions, understanding how geographic insights are fundamental to effective AI, and seeing examples of successful federal applications.

The program includes opportunities to hear from experts during plenary sessions, deepen technical knowledge through various development tracks, and build practical skills in the Hands-On Learning Lab. The Expo offers a chance to explore the newest ArcGIS tools and capabilities, fostering connections with colleagues and leaders in the field. The gathering aims to help organizations improve their preparedness and speed up decision-making by leveraging advanced geospatial solutions.

events.name: MSP Expo 2027
events.description:
MSP Expo 2027, held from February 9-11 in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, is the premier destination for Managed Service Providers and the entire channel community. As a key part of the larger #TECHSUPERSHOW, this event focuses on equipping MSPs with current AI-powered solutions and strategies to address the evolving cybersecurity landscape.

Attendees can engage in practical workshops, with sessions covering topics like AI for MSPs and ITAD Connect. They will also explore new innovations presented at the IDEA and Solutions Showcases. The expo provides various opportunities to connect with industry leaders and peers, including access to a VIP lounge, fostering an environment for discovering new vendors and forming strategic partnerships.

events.name: State of Open Con London 2027
events.description:
Mark your calendars for State of Open Con London 2027, set to unfold on February 9-10 in the vibrant heart of London. OpenUK organizes this two-day conference, designed for anyone interested in the future of open technologies. Those attending will engage in discussions and gain insights into open source software, open data, open hardware, and open innovation.

The event offers a chance to understand the changing environment, identify new trends, and work together on solutions that advance global progress and digital transformation. It provides an opportunity to connect with industry leaders, innovators, and practitioners, helping to build a more collaborative and equitable digital world. Attendees can learn how open principles are shaping the next generation of technology and business.

events.name: CISO Sydney 2027
events.description:
Mark your calendars for CISO Sydney 2027, Australia's leading cybersecurity summit, taking place on February 16-17 in Sydney.

This two-day summit brings together over 500 senior InfoSec decision-makers from New South Wales, alongside more than 50 expert speakers. Leaders in cybersecurity, including CISOs, CTOs, and CIOs, will explore key topics. Discussions will cover how to integrate security into leadership strategies, manage the evolving threats posed by AI, and strengthen defenses against supply chain weaknesses.

The main summit is complemented by co-located events focusing on OT Security, Cloud Security, and AppSec & DevSecOps. Participants have the opportunity to earn CPE points through a partnership with ISACA Sydney.

events.name: TMA Distressed Investing Conference 2027
events.description:
Prepare for an unparalleled deep dive into the future of distressed investing and corporate restructuring at the TMA Distressed Investing Conference 2027. The Encore at the Wynn in Las Vegas will host this event from February 9-12, 2027, where experts and practitioners in the field will gather.

Attendees can expect to explore current market trends, discuss new turnaround strategies, and examine the evolving regulatory landscape. This conference is for professionals aiming to deepen their understanding, connect with peers, and navigate a dynamic economic environment.

Whether your work involves private equity, legal, advisory, or corporate management, this gathering offers a valuable setting for learning and collaboration within the turnaround and restructuring space.

events.name: AI DevWorld 2027
events.description:
Anticipated to be the world's largest artificial intelligence developer event, AI DevWorld 2027 is expected to return to the San Jose Convention Center, CA, around February 18-20. This gathering will bring together over 2500 individuals to explore current AI and Machine Learning developer technologies. Discussions will cover a range of subjects, from developing AI agents and integrating AI within organizations to ethical considerations and new innovations.

The program includes contributions from over 250 speakers and 100 exhibitors. Attendees can participate in workshops, visit an exhibition area, engage in a hackathon, and attend various sessions. These elements are designed for software engineers, data scientists, and AI professionals.

The event offers opportunities to learn about advancements in AI models, production methods, and strategic deployment. It also provides a setting to connect with individuals who are influencing the direction of AI.

events.name: Norway Life Science 2027
events.description:
The essential nexus for Norway's life sciences community, Norway Life Science 2027, will convene on February 9-10, 2027, at Meet Ullevaal, Ullevaal Stadium, Oslo. This two-day conference serves as a key gathering point, bringing together researchers, industry innovators, and leaders from across the life sciences sector.

Organized by UiO:Life Science, with support from a broad group of academic and industry partners, the event focuses on presenting new research and fostering fresh ideas. Attendees will participate in discussions designed to advance innovation, strengthen the life sciences industry, and contribute to national development.

The conference aims to explore Nordic approaches to global challenges and contribute to the future of health and biotechnology.

events.name: TINtech London Market 2027
events.description:
Driving the next wave of transformation within the London insurance market, TINtech London Market 2027 offers an essential platform for leaders, practitioners, and suppliers. This gathering at 155 Bishopsgate, London Liverpool Street, focuses on providing practical strategies for implementing technology, operational, and cultural change.

Discussions will address common hurdles in transformation, and attendees will examine real-world AI applications that are already showing tangible business value. The agenda also covers advanced data and analytics approaches designed to improve workflow efficiency, refine underwriting and claims decisions, and enhance overall organizational effectiveness.

Participants will have the opportunity to connect with industry leaders, compare different strategic approaches, and identify concrete steps towards developing client-focused models and fostering lasting innovation. It's a chance to contribute to the ongoing evolution of the insurance sector.

events.name: Safety Health & Wellbeing Live Manchester 2027
events.description:
Safety Health & Wellbeing Live Manchester 2027 invites safety professionals, leaders, and stakeholders to Manchester Central on 9-10 February for two days of unparalleled insight and innovation. This gathering aims to help professionals strengthen their health and safety approaches, understand new risks, and promote high standards throughout the UK.

Participants can engage with content that offers practical, CPD-accredited learning. This includes dedicated areas like the HSE Experience, the IOSH Communities Theatre, and the NEBOSH Discovery Hub, all designed to encourage shared learning among peers.

The event also features an exhibition where more than 100 suppliers will present their newest products and ideas. This provides a chance to find new solutions, grow professional connections, and gather actionable advice to improve safety and wellbeing within organisations.

events.name: ProductWorld 2027
events.description:
Prepare to shape the future of product innovation at ProductWorld 2027, the world’s largest gathering for product managers and developers. Held alongside DeveloperWeek at the San Jose Convention Center, this gathering provides a unique opportunity for tech professionals to connect and share insights across disciplines.

Attendees, numbering over 2,500 from more than 1,000 companies, will explore current strategies in areas such as AI product development, modern methodologies like Agile and SCRUM, and the changing dynamics of product teams. The program features over 250 expert speakers leading sessions, hands-on workshops, and an expo floor where new tools and approaches are showcased.

Participants can learn about the latest tools, deepen their understanding of the product lifecycle, and connect with leaders from prominent tech organizations. The event aims to offer valuable insights and foster connections that can support future advancements in product development.

events.name: ADP ReThink 2027
events.description:
Prepare to redefine the future of work at ADP ReThink 2027, taking place from February 9-11, 2027, at the Madrid Marriott Auditorium Hotel & Conference Center in vibrant Madrid, Spain. This important gathering, centered on the theme 'LEADING THE NEW WORLD AT WORK,' offers HR and payroll professionals a chance to explore new ideas and effective approaches.

The event includes engaging general and breakout sessions, alongside the ReThink Central exhibition where new solutions can be explored. Attendees will have opportunities to build meaningful connections through executive one-to-one meetings and dedicated networking events, including 'Dine Madrid.' Industry experts will share their perspectives, and discussion groups will provide platforms for exploring various topics.

The aim is for participants to gather strategies and insights that will help them navigate and lead within the evolving landscape of human capital management.

events.name: Accelerate LIVE! Winter 2027
events.description:
Accelerate LIVE! Winter 2027 convenes in sunny West Palm Beach, FL, from February 9th to 11th, offering a critical gathering for home improvement, remodeling, and home services business leaders. This event brings together owners, general managers, and department heads to explore current, practical strategies for navigating today's market challenges. Participants will delve into key areas such as lead generation, refining sales processes, achieving operational excellence, and developing high-performing teams.

The program includes sessions led by experienced professionals, focused leadership discussions, and opportunities for attendees to connect with peers. An optional additional day offers an intensive workshop dedicated to strategies for consistent business growth. The goal is to offer insights and practical tools designed to support consistent profitability and sustained success.

events.name: P2PI Retail Media Summit Canada 2027
events.description:
The Canadian retail media landscape is evolving, and the P2PI Retail Media Summit Canada 2027 is your essential guide to navigating this 'Era of Performance.'

This single-day event in Toronto is designed for senior-level, cross-functional decision-makers. It brings together professionals who are focused on ensuring their media investments translate into clear, measurable business results.

The agenda will explore how to demonstrate true incrementality, streamline complex network fragmentation, and effectively use first-party data to drive growth across all stages of the customer journey. Participants will hear practical strategies from industry experts, including Cyndi Loza and Lisa Johnston, and engage in focused sessions like the 'POWER HOUR.' The discussions aim to equip attendees with the insights needed to transform media spend into tangible business impact.

events.name: Sustainable Manufacturing Expo 2027
events.description:
Drive the future of eco-conscious production at the Sustainable Manufacturing Conference, an official program of MD&M West, taking place February 9-11, 2027, at the Anaheim Convention Center in Anaheim, CA. This gathering brings together professionals and innovators from the industry to explore effective approaches for minimizing environmental footprints, conserving resources, and enhancing operational performance.

The conference is structured around three distinct areas: Responsible Manufacturing, Design Lab, and Smart Factory Hub. Here, participants will discuss topics such as circular economy principles, green product design, sustainable materials, Industry 4.0, and cybersecurity. The discussions are designed to help attendees identify practical solutions, understand evolving regulations, and uncover opportunities for cost savings.

This is an occasion to connect with C-suite executives, engineers, and supply chain professionals. As an integrated part of MD&M West, the conference offers a broader context for networking, allowing individuals to expand their professional connections across medical technology, automation, design, plastics, and packaging sectors.

events.name: CAR-TCR Summit Europe 2027
events.description:
The 10th annual CAR-TCR Summit Europe 2027 is set to convene in London, marking a decade of pioneering advancements in cell therapy. It brings together global experts to explore and advance the next generation of targeted, scalable treatments.

Discussions will delve into key aspects of CAR and TCR development, both *in-vivo* and *ex-vivo*. Participants will examine novel designs, armouring strategies, and engineered signalling pathways.

Beyond the technical specifics, the program will address rapid clinical development, the formation of strategic partnerships, and the essential role of automation and point-of-care solutions. These topics are central to developing cost-effective and accessible therapies, ultimately aiming to improve patient outcomes across Europe and globally.

events.name: HACC-NACC Shipping Conference 2027
events.description:
Prepare to navigate the future of global trade at the 33rd Annual HACC-NACC Shipping Conference, scheduled for Tuesday, February 9th, 2027. This gathering will take place at Apella by Alexandria, bringing together professionals from across the maritime sector.

While the detailed agenda is still being developed, the day will focus on exploring current industry trends, facilitating valuable connections, and offering insights into future directions. It's an occasion to connect with key figures in the industry, discuss pressing challenges, and discover new approaches that are shaping the shipping landscape.

Please mark your calendar for this event. Additional program details will be announced soon.

events.name: Special Air Warfare Symposium 2027
events.description:
Dedicated to advancing the capabilities of aviation-focused Special Operations Forces, the Special Air Warfare Symposium 2027 convenes in Fort Walton Beach, FL, from February 9-11. This gathering provides a central meeting point for the Special Air Warfare community, bringing together its experts and leaders in the heart of U.S. Air Force Special Operations Command (AFSOC).

The symposium program will delve into critical innovations and future strategies. Participants will find opportunities to connect with colleagues, explore new technologies presented in the exhibit hall, and engage in professional development sessions. This environment fosters collaboration and the sharing of insights among peers and thought leaders, contributing to the future readiness of special air warfare operations.

events.name: EspanaSec Cyber Summit 2027
events.description:
Madrid is set to host the 3rd edition of EspanaSec Cyber Summit 2027, convening on February 9th and 10th at the Novotel Madrid City Center. This two-day event, held entirely in Spanish, focuses on "Forging the Future: Building Digital Resilience and Capability in Spain."

Senior IT security experts and key industry figures will discuss cybersecurity's importance in advancing the ‘España Digital 2026’ strategy and strengthening Spain's standing in the global cyber landscape. The agenda, developed by experts, offers insights into current cyber trends, examining how CISOs and cyber leaders are navigating evolving regulatory and geopolitical environments.

Those attending will learn from speakers and explore solutions that can help improve digital resilience.

events.name: Launch Conference 2027

location.venue: Embassy Suites by Hilton Charlotte Concord Golf Resort & Spa

events.description:
Discover the future of credit union success at the Launch Conference 2027, hosted by the Carolinas Credit Union League. This event will be held February 9-10, 2027, at the Embassy Suites by Hilton Charlotte Concord Golf Resort & Spa in Concord, North Carolina. It is designed for credit union professionals at all levels, offering insights for specialists, managers, and directors working in operations, compliance, security, IT, or communications.

The conference program includes keynote presentations, breakout sessions, and pre-conference workshops. A trade show will also be open on both days. The schedule further features the Carolinas Credit Union Foundation Awards Gala, Sprint sessions, and the finals of the Protégé Competition. The goal is to provide information on current industry trends, products, and strategies, helping credit unions enhance their operations and prepare for upcoming challenges.

events.name: Oil & Gas Automation and Technology Week 2027
events.description:
Oil & Gas Automation and Technology Week 2027, organized by AMG World, stands as the premier gathering for industry leaders and innovators. This week will focus on how automation and advanced technologies are shaping the future of the oil and gas sector.

Participants will examine advancements in AI, IoT, data analytics, and robotics, all aimed at improving operational efficiency, safety, and sustainability throughout the industry's value chain. The agenda includes strategies for digital transformation, optimizing production, and navigating the evolving energy landscape.

It's an opportunity to connect with experts, share insights, and discover solutions that advance the industry in a rapidly changing global market. The week provides a setting for gaining strategic insights and networking, which is valuable for staying informed and competitive.

events.name: Therap National Conference 2027
events.description:
Prepare for three days of unparalleled immersion and innovation at the Therap National Conference 2027, taking place from February 9-11 in St. Louis, Missouri. The Saint Charles Convention Center will host this event, which brings together Therap customers, prospective users, and invited guests interested in improving their agency's documentation processes.

Participants can expect to engage with current insights through sessions led by experts, hands-on bootcamps, and presentations from fellow users. There will be opportunities to learn about upcoming AI tools and other advancements designed to streamline operations, with practical experiences aimed at developing skills. The program also includes dedicated 'Ask an Expert' sessions and 'Fast Track' learning paths, offering direct access to solutions and practical advice.

Beyond the structured learning, the conference offers a setting for connecting with peers, sharing effective strategies, and working together on common challenges within the human services sector. It's a chance to build professional relationships and exchange ideas.

events.name: Online Reverse Expo 2027
events.description:
Prepare for a highly efficient and targeted networking experience at the 2027 February Hospital O.R. & Surgical Online Reverse Expo. This virtual event takes place from February 9th to 11th, bringing together healthcare providers and suppliers in the O.R. and surgical sector.

Unlike traditional expos, this online Reverse Expo allows executives from hospitals, surgery centers, imaging centers, and GPOs to select the vendors and manufacturers they wish to meet. Participants will use a dedicated online platform for pre-scheduled, 14-minute one-on-one meetings. This focused approach helps ensure discussions are relevant, giving suppliers an opportunity to present solutions directly to decision-makers who are actively seeking their offerings.

The format is designed to facilitate meaningful connections and allows participants to engage in these important conversations from their own offices.

events.name: NWCOA/NPMA Wildlife Expo 2027

location.venue: DoubleTree by Hilton Orlando Theme Park Resort

events.description:
Elevate your expertise and connect with industry leaders at the NWCOA/NPMA Wildlife Expo 2027.

This gathering, a joint effort by the National Wildlife Control Operators Association and the National Pest Management Association, brings together professionals dedicated to improving wildlife and pest management practices responsibly and effectively. Participants can learn about the latest techniques, understand regulatory changes, and explore innovative technologies influencing the industry.

An exhibit hall will showcase new solutions, and training sessions led by experts will be available. It's also an opportunity to connect with colleagues. The Expo offers a place for improving skills, pursuing certifications, and engaging in strategic discussions to address changes in wildlife control.

events.name: Food Manufacture 360 2027
events.description:
Food Manufacture 360 2027 offers a comprehensive, 360-degree exploration of the food and drink manufacturing sector. This event takes place on 9 February 2027 at the Hilton Birmingham Metropole. It brings together producers, regulators, and academic experts to discuss the industry's complex landscape.

Participants will gain understanding of key areas such as food safety, evolving regulations, and supply chain resilience, alongside discussions on global threats and strategic risk planning. The program also looks ahead, exploring consumer trends, AI's role in purchasing, product innovation, and factory automation.

An Innovation Lab and a Start-Up Competition are also part of the program. The aim is to provide leaders with practical strategies needed to thrive in a constantly changing market.

events.name: Probiota 2027
events.description:
Uniting the cutting edge of microbiome science with dynamic business insights, Probiota 2027 returns to Berlin from February 9-11, 2027. Organized by NutraIngredients.com and William Reed International, in collaboration with the IPA, this gathering brings together individuals from various parts of the microbiome field. Attendees will explore the latest developments in probiotics, prebiotics, and postbiotics. Discussions will cover market data, consumer trends, and the evolving regulatory environment.

The agenda includes important conversations about Women's Health, the Gut-organ Axis, Teen Biotics, and One Health. It also touches on emerging scientific areas such as extracellular vesicles and bacteriophages. There will be opportunities to engage with innovative start-ups through Probiota Pioneers and to learn about groundbreaking research presented at Scientific Frontiers.

Through its sessions, roundtables, and networking moments, Probiota 2027 provides valuable insights. Participants can also earn 51 CPD credits from the Royal Society of Biology.
